            / "vit"
            / "swin_tiny"
            / "test_predictions.csv"
        ),
    },
}


# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

def section(title):
    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 78)


def subsection(title):
    print("\n" + "-" * 78)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 78)


def safe_divide(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return np.nan

    return a / b


def load_predictions(model_name, config):
    path = config["path"]

    print(f"\nLoading {model_name}")
    print(f"Type : {config['type']}")
    print(f"Path : {path}")

    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"\nPrediction file not found:\n{path}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    required = [
        "image_id",
        "true_class",
        "predicted_class",
        "confidence",
        "correct",
    ]

    missing = [
        col
        for col in required
        if col not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{model_name} is missing columns: {missing}"
        )

    df = df.copy()

    df["correct"] = (
        df["correct"]
        .astype(bool)
    )

    print(f"Rows : {len(df)}")

    return df


def build_combined_dataframe(predictions):
    """
    Build a single table indexed by image_id.

    Columns:

        true_class

        <model>_prediction
        <model>_confidence
        <model>_correct
    """

    names = list(predictions.keys())

    reference = predictions[names[0]]

    combined = pd.DataFrame({
        "image_id":
            reference["image_id"],
        "true_class":
            reference["true_class"],
    })

    for name, df in predictions.items():

        current = df[
            [
                "image_id",
                "predicted_class",
                "confidence",
                "correct",
            ]
        ].copy()

        current = current.rename(
            columns={
                "predicted_class":
                    f"{name}_prediction",

                "confidence":
                    f"{name}_confidence",

                "correct":
                    f"{name}_correct",
            }
        )

        combined = combined.merge(
            current,
            on="image_id",
            how="inner",
            validate="one_to_one",
        )

    return combined


# ============================================================
# MODEL SUMMARY
# ============================================================

def model_summary(combined):

    rows = []

    for name, config in MODELS.items():

        correct_col = f"{name}_correct"
        conf_col = f"{name}_confidence"

        correct = (
            combined[correct_col]
            .astype(bool)
        )

        rows.append({
            "model": name,
            "type": config["type"],
            "samples": len(combined),
            "correct": int(correct.sum()),
            "wrong": int((~correct).sum()),
            "accuracy": correct.mean(),
            "mean_confidence":
                combined[conf_col].mean(),

            "mean_confidence_correct":
                combined.loc[
                    correct,
                    conf_col
                ].mean(),

            "mean_confidence_wrong":
                combined.loc[
                    ~correct,
                    conf_col
                ].mean(),
        })

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# PAIRWISE COMPLEMENTARITY
# ============================================================

def pairwise_complementarity(combined):

    rows = []

    names = list(MODELS.keys())

    for model_a, model_b in combinations(names, 2):

        a_correct = (
            combined[f"{model_a}_correct"]
            .astype(bool)
            .to_numpy()
        )

        b_correct = (
            combined[f"{model_b}_correct"]
            .astype(bool)
            .to_numpy()
        )

        both_correct = np.sum(
            a_correct & b_correct
        )

        both_wrong = np.sum(
            ~a_correct & ~b_correct
        )

        a_correct_b_wrong = np.sum(
            a_correct & ~b_correct
        )

        a_wrong_b_correct = np.sum(
            ~a_correct & b_correct
        )

        a_wrong_total = np.sum(~a_correct)
        b_wrong_total = np.sum(~b_correct)

        rows.append({

            "model_a": model_a,
            "type_a": MODELS[model_a]["type"],

            "model_b": model_b,
            "type_b": MODELS[model_b]["type"],

            "samples": len(combined),

            "both_correct":
                int(both_correct),

            "both_wrong":
                int(both_wrong),

            "a_correct_b_wrong":
                int(a_correct_b_wrong),

            "a_wrong_b_correct":
                int(a_wrong_b_correct),

            # B rescues A
            "b_correct_given_a_wrong":
                safe_divide(
                    a_wrong_b_correct,
                    a_wrong_total
                ),

            # A rescues B
            "a_correct_given_b_wrong":
                safe_divide(
                    a_correct_b_wrong,
                    b_wrong_total
                ),

            "error_overlap_rate":
                safe_divide(
                    both_wrong,
                    min(
                        a_wrong_total,
                        b_wrong_total
                    )
                ),

            "either_correct":
                int(
                    np.sum(
                        a_correct | b_correct
                    )
                ),

            "pair_oracle_accuracy":
                np.mean(
                    a_correct | b_correct
                ),
        })

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# DIRECTED RESCUE MATRIX
# ============================================================

def directed_rescue_matrix(combined):

    names = list(MODELS.keys())

    matrix = pd.DataFrame(
        np.nan,
        index=names,
        columns=names,
    )

    for model_a in names:

        a_correct = (
            combined[f"{model_a}_correct"]
            .astype(bool)
            .to_numpy()
        )

        a_wrong = ~a_correct

        for model_b in names:

            if model_a == model_b:
                continue

            b_correct = (
                combined[f"{model_b}_correct"]
                .astype(bool)
                .to_numpy()
            )

            matrix.loc[
                model_a,
                model_b
            ] = safe_divide(
                np.sum(
                    a_wrong & b_correct
                ),
                np.sum(a_wrong)
            )

    return matrix


# ============================================================
# CNN VS VIT FAMILY ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

def family_complementarity(combined):

    cnn_models = [
        name
        for name, config in MODELS.items()
        if config["type"] == "CNN"
    ]

    vit_models = [
        name
        for name, config in MODELS.items()
        if config["type"] == "ViT"
    ]

    cnn_correct_matrix = combined[
        [
            f"{name}_correct"
            for name in cnn_models
        ]
    ].astype(bool)

    vit_correct_matrix = combined[
        [
            f"{name}_correct"
            for name in vit_models
        ]
    ].astype(bool)

    cnn_any_correct = (
        cnn_correct_matrix
        .any(axis=1)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    vit_any_correct = (
        vit_correct_matrix
        .any(axis=1)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    cnn_all_wrong = ~cnn_any_correct
    vit_all_wrong = ~vit_any_correct

    rows = [

        {
            "case":
                "Both families have at least one correct",
            "samples":
                int(
                    np.sum(
                        cnn_any_correct
                        & vit_any_correct
                    )
                ),
        },

        {
            "case":
                "CNN-only correct",
            "samples":
                int(
                    np.sum(
                        cnn_any_correct
                        & vit_all_wrong
                    )
                ),
        },

        {
            "case":
                "ViT-only correct",
            "samples":
                int(
                    np.sum(
                        cnn_all_wrong
                        & vit_any_correct
                    )
                ),
        },

        {
            "case":
                "Neither family correct",
            "samples":
                int(
                    np.sum(
                        cnn_all_wrong
                        & vit_all_wrong
                    )
                ),
        },
    ]

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    # Conditional rescue rates

    cnn_wrong = cnn_all_wrong.sum()
    vit_wrong = vit_all_wrong.sum()

    cnn_rescue_rate = safe_divide(
        np.sum(
            cnn_all_wrong
            & vit_any_correct
        ),
        cnn_wrong,
    )

    vit_rescue_rate = safe_divide(
        np.sum(
            vit_all_wrong
            & cnn_any_correct
        ),
        vit_wrong,
    )

    return (
        result,
        cnn_rescue_rate,
        vit_rescue_rate,
    )


# ============================================================
# CLASS-SPECIFIC RESCUE
# ============================================================

def class_rescue_analysis(combined):

    rows = []

    classes = sorted(
        combined["true_class"]
        .dropna()
        .unique()
    )

    names = list(MODELS.keys())

    for true_class in classes:

        subset = combined[
            combined["true_class"]
            == true_class
        ]

        for model_a, model_b in combinations(
            names,
            2
        ):

            a_correct = (
                subset[f"{model_a}_correct"]
                .astype(bool)
                .to_numpy()
            )

            b_correct = (
                subset[f"{model_b}_correct"]
                .astype(bool)
                .to_numpy()
            )

            a_wrong = ~a_correct
            b_wrong = ~b_correct

            rows.append({

                "true_class":
                    true_class,

                "model_a":
                    model_a,

                "model_b":
                    model_b,

                "samples":
                    len(subset),

                "a_wrong_b_correct":
                    int(
                        np.sum(
                            a_wrong
                            & b_correct
                        )
                    ),

                "b_wrong_a_correct":
                    int(
                        np.sum(
                            b_wrong
                            & a_correct
                        )
                    ),

                "b_correct_given_a_wrong":
                    safe_divide(
                        np.sum(
                            a_wrong
                            & b_correct
                        ),
                        np.sum(a_wrong)
                    ),

                "a_correct_given_b_wrong":
                    safe_divide(
                        np.sum(
                            b_wrong
                            & a_correct
                        ),
                        np.sum(b_wrong)
                    ),
            })

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# AGREEMENT ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

def agreement_analysis(combined):

    names = list(MODELS.keys())

    prediction_columns = [
        f"{name}_prediction"
        for name in names
    ]

    prediction_matrix = combined[
        prediction_columns
    ]

    agreement_count = (
        prediction_matrix
        .nunique(axis=1)
    )

    # Number of models agreeing with the
    # most common prediction.
    consensus_count = (
        prediction_matrix
        .apply(
            lambda row:
            row.value_counts().max(),
            axis=1
        )
    )

    rows = []

    for count in sorted(
        consensus_count.unique(),
        reverse=True
    ):

        mask = (
            consensus_count
            == count
        )

        samples = int(mask.sum())

        # Consensus is considered correct if
        # the consensus prediction equals true class.
        consensus_correct = []

        for idx in combined.index[mask]:

            row = combined.loc[idx]

            predictions = [
                row[f"{name}_prediction"]
                for name in names
            ]

            values = pd.Series(
                predictions
            )

            consensus_prediction = (
                values
                .value_counts()
                .idxmax()
            )

            consensus_correct.append(
                consensus_prediction
                == row["true_class"]
            )

        consensus_correct = np.array(
            consensus_correct,
            dtype=bool,
        )

        rows.append({

            "consensus_models":
                int(count),

            "samples":
                samples,

            "consensus_correct":
                int(consensus_correct.sum()),

            "consensus_accuracy":
                safe_divide(
                    consensus_correct.sum(),
                    samples
                ),
        })

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# ORACLE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

def oracle_analysis(combined):

    rows = []

    names = list(MODELS.keys())

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Individual models
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for name in names:

        correct = (
            combined[f"{name}_correct"]
            .astype(bool)
            .to_numpy()
        )

        rows.append({

            "ensemble":
                name,

            "models":
                name,

            "oracle_correct":
                int(correct.sum()),

            "oracle_accuracy":
                correct.mean(),
        })

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CNN oracle
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cnn_names = [
        name
        for name in names
        if MODELS[name]["type"] == "CNN"
    ]

    cnn_matrix = combined[
        [
            f"{name}_correct"
            for name in cnn_names
        ]
    ].astype(bool)

    cnn_oracle = (
        cnn_matrix
        .any(axis=1)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    rows.append({

        "ensemble":
            "CNN_ORACLE",

        "models":
            ",".join(cnn_names),

        "oracle_correct":
            int(cnn_oracle.sum()),

        "oracle_accuracy":
            cnn_oracle.mean(),
    })

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ViT oracle
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    vit_names = [
        name
        for name in names
        if MODELS[name]["type"] == "ViT"
    ]

    vit_matrix = combined[
        [
            f"{name}_correct"
            for name in vit_names
        ]
    ].astype(bool)

    vit_oracle = (
        vit_matrix
        .any(axis=1)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    rows.append({

        "ensemble":
            "VIT_ORACLE",

        "models":
            ",".join(vit_names),

        "oracle_correct":
            int(vit_oracle.sum()),

        "oracle_accuracy":
            vit_oracle.mean(),
    })

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # All six oracle
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    all_matrix = combined[
        [
            f"{name}_correct"
            for name in names
        ]
    ].astype(bool)

    all_oracle = (
        all_matrix
        .any(axis=1)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    rows.append({

        "ensemble":
            "ALL_MODELS_ORACLE",

        "models":
            ",".join(names),

        "oracle_correct":
            int(all_oracle.sum()),

        "oracle_accuracy":
            all_oracle.mean(),
    })

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# RESCUE CONFIDENCE
# ============================================================

def rescue_confidence_analysis(combined):

    rows = []

    names = list(MODELS.keys())

    for model_a, model_b in combinations(
        names,
        2
    ):

        a_correct = (
            combined[f"{model_a}_correct"]
            .astype(bool)
        )

        b_correct = (
            combined[f"{model_b}_correct"]
            .astype(bool)
        )

        # B rescues A
        mask_b_rescues_a = (
            ~a_correct
            & b_correct
        )

        if mask_b_rescues_a.any():

            rows.append({

                "failed_model":
                    model_a,

                "rescuing_model":
                    model_b,

                "rescue_cases":
                    int(
                        mask_b_rescues_a.sum()
                    ),

                "rescuing_mean_confidence":
                    combined.loc[
                        mask_b_rescues_a,
                        f"{model_b}_confidence"
                    ].mean(),

                "failed_model_mean_confidence":
                    combined.loc[
                        mask_b_rescues_a,
                        f"{model_a}_confidence"
                    ].mean(),
            })

        # A rescues B
        mask_a_rescues_b = (
            ~b_correct
            & a_correct
        )

        if mask_a_rescues_b.any():

            rows.append({

                "failed_model":
                    model_b,

                "rescuing_model":
                    model_a,

                "rescue_cases":
                    int(
                        mask_a_rescues_b.sum()
                    ),

                "rescuing_mean_confidence":
                    combined.loc[
                        mask_a_rescues_b,
                        f"{model_a}_confidence"
                    ].mean(),

                "failed_model_mean_confidence":
                    combined.loc[
                        mask_a_rescues_b,
                        f"{model_b}_confidence"
                    ].mean(),
            })

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# SAVE / PRINT
# ============================================================

def save_and_print(
    dataframe,
    filename,
    title,
    index=False,
):

    subsection(title)

    print(
        dataframe.to_string(
            index=index
        )
    )

    path = OUTPUT_DIR / filename

    dataframe.to_csv(
        path,
        index=index
    )

    print(f"\nSaved:")
    print(f"  {path}")

    return path


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    section(
        "HYBRID_V3 PRE-HYBRID COMPLEMENTARITY ANALYSIS"
    )

    print(
        f"Project root : {PROJECT_ROOT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Output dir   : {OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # LOAD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "LOADING MODEL PREDICTIONS"
    )

    predictions = {}

    for name, config in MODELS.items():

        predictions[name] = load_predictions(
            name,
            config
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # VERIFY SAME TEST SET
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "VERIFYING TEST SET CONSISTENCY"
    )

    reference_name = list(
        predictions.keys()
    )[0]

    reference_ids = set(
        predictions[
            reference_name
        ]["image_id"]
    )

    print(
        f"Reference model : {reference_name}"
    )

    print(
        f"Reference samples: "
        f"{len(reference_ids)}"
    )

    for name, df in predictions.items():

        ids = set(
            df["image_id"]
        )

        if ids != reference_ids:

            missing = (
                reference_ids - ids
            )

            extra = (
                ids - reference_ids
            )

            raise ValueError(
                f"Test set mismatch for {name}\n"
                f"Missing: {len(missing)}\n"
                f"Extra  : {len(extra)}"
            )

        print(
            f"{name:25s} ✓ "
            f"{len(ids)} samples"
        )

    print(
        "\n✓ All models use the same test set."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # COMBINE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "CREATING COMBINED ANALYSIS TABLE"
    )

    combined = build_combined_dataframe(
        predictions
    )

    print(
        f"Samples : {len(combined)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Columns : {len(combined.columns)}"
    )

    combined_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "complementarity_combined_predictions.csv"
    )

    combined.to_csv(
        combined_path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved:\n  {combined_path}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL SUMMARY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    summary = model_summary(
        combined
    )

    save_and_print(
        summary,
        "model_summary.csv",
        "MODEL SUMMARY",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PAIRWISE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    pairwise = pairwise_complementarity(
        combined
    )

    save_and_print(
        pairwise,
        "pairwise_complementarity.csv",
        "PAIRWISE COMPLEMENTARITY",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DIRECTED RESCUE MATRIX
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rescue_matrix = directed_rescue_matrix(
        combined
    )

    save_and_print(
        rescue_matrix,
        "directed_rescue_matrix.csv",
        "DIRECTED RESCUE MATRIX",
        index=True,
    )

    print(
        "\nInterpretation:"
    )

    print(
        "  Row = failed model"
    )

    print(
        "  Column = rescuing model"
    )

    print(
        "  Value = P(column correct | row wrong)"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # FAMILY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    (
        family_result,
        cnn_rescue_rate,
        vit_rescue_rate,
    ) = family_complementarity(
        combined
    )

    save_and_print(
        family_result,
        "cnn_vit_family_complementarity.csv",
        "CNN / ViT FAMILY COMPLEMENTARITY",
    )

    print(
        f"\nViT rescue rate when all CNNs are wrong:"
        f" {cnn_rescue_rate:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"CNN rescue rate when all ViTs are wrong:"
        f" {vit_rescue_rate:.4f}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CLASS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    class_result = class_rescue_analysis(
        combined
    )

    save_and_print(
        class_result,
        "class_specific_rescue.csv",
        "CLASS-SPECIFIC RESCUE ANALYSIS",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # AGREEMENT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    agreement = agreement_analysis(
        combined
    )

    save_and_print(
        agreement,
        "agreement_correctness.csv",
        "AGREEMENT VS CORRECTNESS",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # ORACLE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    oracle = oracle_analysis(
        combined
    )

    save_and_print(
        oracle,
        "oracle_analysis.csv",
        "ORACLE / THEORETICAL FUSION CEILING",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # HEADROOM
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    best_individual = (
        summary["accuracy"]
        .max()
    )

    six_model_oracle = (
        oracle.loc[
            oracle["ensemble"]
            == "ALL_MODELS_ORACLE",
            "oracle_accuracy"
        ].iloc[0]
    )

    oracle_headroom = (
        six_model_oracle
        - best_individual
    )

    subsection(
        "FUSION HEADROOM"
    )

    print(
        f"Best individual accuracy : "
        f"{best_individual:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Six-model oracle accuracy : "
        f"{six_model_oracle:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Theoretical headroom      : "
        f"{oracle_headroom:.4f}"
    )

    headroom_df = pd.DataFrame([
        {
            "best_individual_accuracy":
                best_individual,

            "six_model_oracle_accuracy":
                six_model_oracle,

            "theoretical_headroom":
                oracle_headroom,
        }
    ])

    headroom_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "fusion_headroom.csv"
    )

    headroom_df.to_csv(
        headroom_path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"\nSaved:\n  {headroom_path}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # RESCUE CONFIDENCE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rescue_confidence = (
        rescue_confidence_analysis(
            combined
        )
    )

    save_and_print(
        rescue_confidence,
        "rescue_confidence.csv",
        "RESCUE CONFIDENCE ANALYSIS",
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # IMPORTANT CASES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "KEY COMPLEMENTARITY COUNTS"
    )

    names = list(MODELS.keys())

    correct_matrix = combined[
        [
            f"{name}_correct"
            for name in names
        ]
    ].astype(bool)

    any_correct = (
        correct_matrix
        .any(axis=1)
    )

    all_wrong = ~any_correct

    exactly_one_correct = (
        correct_matrix
        .sum(axis=1)
        == 1
    )

    exactly_two_correct = (
        correct_matrix
        .sum(axis=1)
        == 2
    )

    print(
        f"At least one model correct : "
        f"{int(any_correct.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"All models wrong            : "
        f"{int(all_wrong.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Exactly one model correct    : "
        f"{int(exactly_one_correct.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Exactly two models correct   : "
        f"{int(exactly_two_correct.sum())}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # FINISH
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "COMPLEMENTARITY ANALYSIS COMPLETE"
    )

    print(
        "Outputs:"
    )

    print(
        f"  {OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    print(
        "\n✓ Ready to determine the optimal fusion strategy."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
HYBRID_V3 - DISAGREEMENT / CONFIDENCE ANALYSIS

Purpose
-------
Determine whether model confidence, margin, entropy, agreement,
and family disagreement can identify the correct model when
models disagree.

This is the bridge between:
    complementarity analysis
and:
    actual fusion architecture design.

Main analyses
-------------
1. Overall disagreement statistics
2. Pairwise disagreement statistics
3. Confidence-winner accuracy
4. Confidence-margin analysis
5. Entropy analysis
6. Prediction-margin analysis
7. CNN-vs-ViT family disagreement
8. Class-specific disagreement
9. Confidence threshold analysis
10. Pairwise dynamic-selection simulation

IMPORTANT
---------
No ground-truth information is used to make the simulated decision.
Ground truth is used only AFTER the decision to evaluate it.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from itertools import combinations

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

INPUT_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "outputs"
    / "pre_hybrid_analysis"
    / "complementarity_combined_predictions.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "outputs"
    / "pre_hybrid_analysis"
)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# ============================================================
# MODELS
# ============================================================

MODELS = {
    "resnet50": "CNN",
    "efficientnet_v2_s": "CNN",
    "efficientnet_b3": "CNN",
    "mobilenet_v3_large": "CNN",
    "deit_tiny": "ViT",
    "swin_tiny": "ViT",
}


CNN_MODELS = [
    name for name, model_type in MODELS.items()
    if model_type == "CNN"
]

VIT_MODELS = [
    name for name, model_type in MODELS.items()
    if model_type == "ViT"
]


# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

def find_column(df, candidates):
    """
    Find the first matching column from a list of candidates.
    """
    normalized = {
        str(c).lower().replace(" ", "_"): c
        for c in df.columns
    }

    for candidate in candidates:
        key = candidate.lower().replace(" ", "_")
        if key in normalized:
            return normalized[key]

    return None


def model_column(df, model_name, suffix):
    """
    Locate a model-specific column.

    Supports common naming patterns such as:
        resnet50_pred
        resnet50_prediction
        resnet50_confidence
        pred_resnet50
        confidence_resnet50
    """

    candidates = [
        f"{model_name}_{suffix}",
        f"{model_name}_{suffix.lower()}",
        f"{suffix}_{model_name}",
        f"{suffix.lower()}_{model_name}",
    ]

    return find_column(df, candidates)


def entropy_from_confidence(confidence):
    """
    Binary uncertainty approximation.

    This is NOT the full multiclass predictive entropy.
    It is used only when the prediction CSV does not contain
    complete probability vectors.

    H(p) = -p log(p) - (1-p) log(1-p)
    """

    p = np.clip(np.asarray(confidence, dtype=float), 1e-8, 1 - 1e-8)

    return -(p * np.log(p) + (1 - p) * np.log(1 - p))


def get_model_columns(df, model):
    """
    Resolve prediction, confidence and correctness columns.
    """

    pred_col = model_column(
        df,
        model,
        "pred"
    )

    if pred_col is None:
        pred_col = model_column(
            df,
            model,
            "prediction"
        )

    conf_col = model_column(
        df,
        model,
        "confidence"
    )

    correct_col = model_column(
        df,
        model,
        "correct"
    )

    return pred_col, conf_col, correct_col


def compute_margin_from_confidence(df, model):
    """
    If full probability vectors are unavailable, use confidence
    as the top-1 probability and estimate a conservative margin.

    If the prediction CSV contains top2 confidence, use it.
    Otherwise return NaN.
    """

    top1_col = model_column(df, model, "confidence")

    top2_col = None

    for suffix in [
        "top2_confidence",
        "second_confidence",
        "runner_up_confidence",
        "second_best_confidence",
    ]:
        top2_col = model_column(df, model, suffix)
        if top2_col is not None:
            break

    if top1_col is None or top2_col is None:
        return pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index)

    return (
        pd.to_numeric(df[top1_col], errors="coerce")
        - pd.to_numeric(df[top2_col], errors="coerce")
    )


# ============================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================

print("=" * 78)
print("HYBRID_V3 DISAGREEMENT / CONFIDENCE ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 78)

print(f"Project root : {PROJECT_ROOT}")
print(f"Input file   : {INPUT_FILE}")
print(f"Output dir   : {OUTPUT_DIR}")


if not INPUT_FILE.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Required input file does not exist:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
    )


df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

print(f"Samples      : {len(df)}")
print(f"Columns      : {len(df.columns)}")


# ============================================================
# RESOLVE COLUMNS
# ============================================================

MODEL_COLUMNS = {}

print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("MODEL COLUMN DISCOVERY")
print("=" * 78)

for model in MODELS:

    pred_col, conf_col, correct_col = get_model_columns(
        df,
        model
    )

    MODEL_COLUMNS[model] = {
        "pred": pred_col,
        "confidence": conf_col,
        "correct": correct_col,
    }

    print(f"\n{model}")
    print(f"  prediction : {pred_col}")
    print(f"  confidence : {conf_col}")
    print(f"  correct    : {correct_col}")

    if pred_col is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Could not find prediction column for {model}"
        )

    if conf_col is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Could not find confidence column for {model}"
        )

    if correct_col is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Could not find correctness column for {model}"
        )


# ============================================================
# NORMALIZE TYPES
# ============================================================

for model in MODELS:

    pred_col = MODEL_COLUMNS[model]["pred"]
    conf_col = MODEL_COLUMNS[model]["confidence"]
    correct_col = MODEL_COLUMNS[model]["correct"]

    df[pred_col] = df[pred_col].astype(str)

    df[conf_col] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[conf_col],
        errors="coerce"
    )

    if df[correct_col].dtype == object:
        df[correct_col] = (
            df[correct_col]
            .astype(str)
            .str.lower()
            .map({
                "true": 1,
                "false": 0,
                "1": 1,
                "0": 0,
            })
        )

    df[correct_col] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[correct_col],
        errors="coerce"
    )


# ============================================================
# ADD DERIVED FEATURES
# ============================================================

for model in MODELS:

    conf_col = MODEL_COLUMNS[model]["confidence"]

    df[f"__{model}_entropy"] = entropy_from_confidence(
        df[conf_col]
    )

    df[f"__{model}_margin"] = compute_margin_from_confidence(
        df,
        model
    )


# ============================================================
# 1. OVERALL DISAGREEMENT
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("OVERALL DISAGREEMENT ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 78)

agreement_rows = []

for model_a, model_b in combinations(MODELS.keys(), 2):

    pred_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["pred"]
    pred_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["pred"]

    correct_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["correct"]
    correct_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["correct"]

    disagree = df[pred_a] != df[pred_b]

    subset = df.loc[disagree]

    n = len(subset)

    if n == 0:
        continue

    a_correct = subset[correct_a] == 1
    b_correct = subset[correct_b] == 1

    a_only = a_correct & ~b_correct
    b_only = ~a_correct & b_correct
    both_correct = a_correct & b_correct
    both_wrong = ~a_correct & ~b_correct

    agreement_rows.append({
        "model_a": model_a,
        "type_a": MODELS[model_a],
        "model_b": model_b,
        "type_b": MODELS[model_b],
        "disagreement_samples": n,
        "a_only_correct": int(a_only.sum()),
        "b_only_correct": int(b_only.sum()),
        "both_correct": int(both_correct.sum()),
        "both_wrong": int(both_wrong.sum()),
        "a_accuracy_on_disagreement": float(a_correct.mean()),
        "b_accuracy_on_disagreement": float(b_correct.mean()),
        "oracle_accuracy_on_disagreement": float(
            (a_correct | b_correct).mean()
        ),
    })


disagreement_df = pd.DataFrame(agreement_rows)

print(disagreement_df.to_string(index=False))

disagreement_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_DIR / "pairwise_disagreement_analysis.csv",
    index=False
)

    f"\nSaved: "
    f"{OUTPUT_DIR / 'pairwise_disagreement_analysis.csv'}"

# ============================================================
# 2. CONFIDENCE WINNER
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("CONFIDENCE-WINNER ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 78)

confidence_rows = []

for model_a, model_b in combinations(MODELS.keys(), 2):

    pred_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["pred"]
    pred_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["pred"]

    conf_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["confidence"]
    conf_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["confidence"]

    correct_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["correct"]
    correct_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["correct"]

    disagree = df[pred_a] != df[pred_b]

    subset = df.loc[disagree].copy()

    if len(subset) == 0:
        continue

    ca = subset[conf_a].to_numpy()
    cb = subset[conf_b].to_numpy()

    corr_a = subset[correct_a].to_numpy() == 1
    corr_b = subset[correct_b].to_numpy() == 1

    confidence_winner_a = ca > cb
    confidence_winner_b = cb > ca
    confidence_tie = np.isclose(ca, cb)

    winner_correct = (
        (confidence_winner_a & corr_a)
        |
        (confidence_winner_b & corr_b)
    )

    informative = ~confidence_tie

    confidence_rows.append({
        "model_a": model_a,
        "model_b": model_b,
        "disagreements": len(subset),
        "a_confidence_wins": int(confidence_winner_a.sum()),
        "b_confidence_wins": int(confidence_winner_b.sum()),
        "confidence_ties": int(confidence_tie.sum()),
        "winner_correct_rate": (
            float(winner_correct[informative].mean())
            if informative.any()
            else np.nan
        ),
        "a_confidence_winner_correct_rate": (
            float(corr_a[confidence_winner_a].mean())
            if confidence_winner_a.any()
            else np.nan
        ),
        "b_confidence_winner_correct_rate": (
            float(corr_b[confidence_winner_b].mean())
            if confidence_winner_b.any()
            else np.nan
        ),
    })


confidence_winner_df = pd.DataFrame(confidence_rows)

print(confidence_winner_df.to_string(index=False))

confidence_winner_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_DIR / "confidence_winner_analysis.csv",
    index=False
)

print(
    f"\nSaved: "
    f"{OUTPUT_DIR / 'confidence_winner_analysis.csv'}"
)


# ============================================================
# 3. CONFIDENCE MARGIN
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("CONFIDENCE-MARGIN ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 78)

margin_rows = []

THRESHOLDS = [
    0.00,
    0.02,
    0.05,
    0.10,
    0.15,
    0.20,
    0.25,
    0.30,
]


for model_a, model_b in combinations(MODELS.keys(), 2):

    pred_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["pred"]
    pred_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["pred"]

    conf_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["confidence"]
    conf_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["confidence"]

    correct_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["correct"]
    correct_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["correct"]

    disagree = df[pred_a] != df[pred_b]

    subset = df.loc[disagree].copy()

    if len(subset) == 0:
        continue

    ca = subset[conf_a].to_numpy()
    cb = subset[conf_b].to_numpy()

    corr_a = subset[correct_a].to_numpy() == 1
    corr_b = subset[correct_b].to_numpy() == 1

    signed_margin = ca - cb

    for threshold in THRESHOLDS:

        selected = np.abs(signed_margin) >= threshold

        if not selected.any():
            continue

        choose_a = signed_margin >= threshold
        choose_b = signed_margin <= -threshold

        decision = np.full(
            len(subset),
            -1,
            dtype=int
        )

        decision[choose_a] = 0
        decision[choose_b] = 1

        valid = decision >= 0

        if not valid.any():
            continue

        correct = (
            (decision == 0) & corr_a
        ) | (
            (decision == 1) & corr_b
        )

        margin_rows.append({
            "model_a": model_a,
            "model_b": model_b,
            "threshold": threshold,
            "selected_samples": int(valid.sum()),
            "coverage": float(valid.mean()),
            "selection_accuracy": float(correct[valid].mean()),
        })


margin_df = pd.DataFrame(margin_rows)

print(margin_df.to_string(index=False))

margin_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_DIR / "confidence_margin_analysis.csv",
    index=False
)

print(
    f"\nSaved: "
    f"{OUTPUT_DIR / 'confidence_margin_analysis.csv'}"
)

# ============================================================
# 6. CNN vs ViT FAMILY DISAGREEMENT
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("CNN vs ViT FAMILY DISAGREEMENT")
print("=" * 78)


# Build prediction matrices
cnn_pred = np.column_stack([
    df[MODEL_COLUMNS[m]["pred"]].astype(str).to_numpy()
    for m in CNN_MODELS
])

vit_pred = np.column_stack([
    df[MODEL_COLUMNS[m]["pred"]].astype(str).to_numpy()
    for m in VIT_MODELS
])


def majority_prediction(pred_matrix):
    """
    Deterministic majority vote.
    """

    result = []

    for row in pred_matrix:

        values, counts = np.unique(
            row,
            return_counts=True
        )

        result.append(
            values[np.argmax(counts)]
        )

    return np.asarray(result)


cnn_majority = majority_prediction(cnn_pred)
vit_majority = majority_prediction(vit_pred)

family_disagree = cnn_majority != vit_majority

family_rows = []

for label, mask in [
    ("CNN = ViT", ~family_disagree),
    ("CNN != ViT", family_disagree),
]:

    indices = np.where(mask)[0]

    if len(indices) == 0:
        continue

    cnn_correct = np.zeros(len(indices), dtype=bool)
    vit_correct = np.zeros(len(indices), dtype=bool)

    for model in CNN_MODELS:

        correct_col = MODEL_COLUMNS[model]["correct"]

        cnn_correct |= (
            df.iloc[indices][correct_col].to_numpy() == 1
        )

    for model in VIT_MODELS:

        correct_col = MODEL_COLUMNS[model]["correct"]

        vit_correct |= (
            df.iloc[indices][correct_col].to_numpy() == 1
        )

    family_rows.append({
        "case": label,
        "samples": len(indices),
        "cnn_family_oracle_accuracy": float(
            cnn_correct.mean()
        ),
        "vit_family_oracle_accuracy": float(
            vit_correct.mean()
        ),
        "either_family_correct": float(
            (cnn_correct | vit_correct).mean()
        ),
    })


family_df = pd.DataFrame(family_rows)

print(family_df.to_string(index=False))

family_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_DIR / "cnn_vit_disagreement_analysis.csv",
    index=False
)

print(
    f"\nSaved: "
    f"{OUTPUT_DIR / 'cnn_vit_disagreement_analysis.csv'}"
)


# ============================================================
# 7. CLASS-SPECIFIC DISAGREEMENT
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("CLASS-SPECIFIC DISAGREEMENT")
print("=" * 78)


true_class_col = find_column(
    df,
    [
        "true_class",
        "true_label",
        "label",
        "target",
        "class",
    ]
)

if true_class_col is None:

    print(
        "WARNING: true class column not found. "
        "Skipping class-specific analysis."
    )

else:

    class_rows = []

    for model_a, model_b in combinations(MODELS.keys(), 2):

        pred_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["pred"]
        pred_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["pred"]

        conf_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["confidence"]
        conf_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["confidence"]

        correct_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["correct"]
        correct_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["correct"]

        disagree = df[pred_a] != df[pred_b]

        subset = df.loc[disagree].copy()

        for true_class, group in subset.groupby(true_class_col):

            if len(group) < 5:
                continue

            ca = group[conf_a].to_numpy()
            cb = group[conf_b].to_numpy()

            corr_a = group[correct_a].to_numpy() == 1
            corr_b = group[correct_b].to_numpy() == 1

            confidence_winner_correct = (
                (ca > cb) & corr_a
            ) | (
                (cb > ca) & corr_b
            )

            informative = ~np.isclose(ca, cb)

            class_rows.append({
                "true_class": true_class,
                "model_a": model_a,
                "model_b": model_b,
                "disagreements": len(group),
                "a_correct": int(corr_a.sum()),
                "b_correct": int(corr_b.sum()),
                "oracle_correct": int(
                    (corr_a | corr_b).sum()
                ),
                "oracle_accuracy": float(
                    (corr_a | corr_b).mean()
                ),
                "confidence_winner_accuracy": (
                    float(
                        confidence_winner_correct[informative].mean()
                    )
                    if informative.any()
                    else np.nan
                ),
                "mean_confidence_a": float(np.mean(ca)),
                "mean_confidence_b": float(np.mean(cb)),
            })

    class_disagreement_df = pd.DataFrame(class_rows)

    print(
        class_disagreement_df.to_string(index=False)
    )

    class_disagreement_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR / "class_specific_disagreement.csv",
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"\nSaved: "
        f"{OUTPUT_DIR / 'class_specific_disagreement.csv'}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 8. DYNAMIC PAIRWISE SELECTION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 78)
print("PAIRWISE DYNAMIC SELECTION")
print("=" * 78)

selection_rows = []

for model_a, model_b in combinations(MODELS.keys(), 2):

    pred_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["pred"]
    pred_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["pred"]

    conf_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["confidence"]
    conf_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["confidence"]

    correct_a = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_a]["correct"]
    correct_b = MODEL_COLUMNS[model_b]["correct"]

    disagree = df[pred_a] != df[pred_b]

    subset = df.loc[disagree].copy()

    if len(subset) == 0:
        continue

    ca = subset[conf_a].to_numpy()
    cb = subset[conf_b].to_numpy()

    corr_a = subset[correct_a].to_numpy() == 1
    corr_b = subset[correct_b].to_numpy() == 1

    # Confidence winner
    winner_a = ca > cb
    winner_b = cb > ca

    valid = winner_a | winner_b

    if valid.any():

        selected_correct = (
            (winner_a & corr_a)
            |
            (winner_b & corr_b)
        )

        selection_accuracy = float(
            selected_correct[valid].mean()
        )

    else:
        selection_accuracy = np.nan

    # Best static model on disagreements
    static_a = float(corr_a.mean())
    static_b = float(corr_b.mean())

    selection_rows.append({
        "model_a": model_a,
        "model_b": model_b,
        "disagreements": len(subset),
        "model_a_accuracy": static_a,
        "model_b_accuracy": static_b,
        "best_static_accuracy": max(
            static_a,
            static_b
        ),
        "confidence_selection_accuracy": selection_accuracy,
        "selection_gain_over_best_static": (
            selection_accuracy
            - max(static_a, static_b)
            if not np.isnan(selection_accuracy)
            else np.nan
        ),
    })


selection_df = pd.DataFrame(selection_rows)

print(selection_df.to_string(index=False))

selection_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_DIR / "pairwise_dynamic_selection.csv",
    index=False
)

print(
    f"\nSaved: "
    f"{OUTPUT_DIR / 'pairwise_dynamic_selection.csv'}"
)

    df[MODEL_COLUMNS[m]["confidence"]].to_numpy()
    for m in MODELS
])

correct_matrix = np.column_stack([
    df[MODEL_COLUMNS[m]["correct"]].to_numpy() == 1
    for m in MODELS
])

prediction_matrix = np.column_stack([
    df[MODEL_COLUMNS[m]["pred"]].astype(str).to_numpy()
    for m in MODELS
])


winner_correct = []
winner_available = []

for i in range(len(df)):

    if len(np.unique(prediction_matrix[i])) <= 1:
        continue

    confidences = confidence_matrix[i]

    if np.isnan(confidences).all():
        continue

    winner = np.nanargmax(confidences)

    winner_available.append(i)

    winner_correct.append(
        bool(correct_matrix[i, winner])
    )


if winner_correct:

    print(
        f"Confidence winner accuracy "
        f"on disagreements : "
        f"{np.mean(winner_correct):.4f}"
    )

else:

    print(
        "Confidence winner accuracy: unavailable"
    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
Hybrid_v3 - Prediction Feature Extraction

Purpose
-------
Extract reliability-related features from the existing
complementarity prediction CSV.

Features:
    - prediction
    - confidence
    - entropy
    - confidence margin
    - predicted class
    - model/family information
    - global disagreement features

Important
---------
The *_correct columns are preserved as TARGETS but are never
used as selector input features.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

INPUT_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "outputs"
    / "pre_hybrid_analysis"
    / "complementarity_combined_predictions.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection" / "outputs"

OUTPUT_FILE = OUTPUT_DIR / "prediction_features.csv"


MODELS = [
    ("resnet50", "CNN"),
    ("efficientnet_v2_s", "CNN"),
    ("efficientnet_b3", "CNN"),
    ("mobilenet_v3_large", "CNN"),
    ("deit_tiny", "ViT"),
    ("swin_tiny", "ViT"),
]


# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================

def entropy_from_confidence(confidence):
    """
    Approximate binary entropy from confidence.

    This is only a fallback if entropy was not already present.
    If the original CSV contains entropy, that value is preferred.
    """
    confidence = np.clip(
        np.asarray(confidence, dtype=float),
        1e-12,
        1.0 - 1e-12,
    )

    return -(
        confidence * np.log(confidence)
        + (1.0 - confidence) * np.log(1.0 - confidence)
    )


def find_column(df, candidates):
    """Return the first candidate column that exists."""
    for column in candidates:
        if column in df.columns:
            return column
    return None


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    print("=" * 78)
    print("HYBRID_V3 PREDICTION FEATURE EXTRACTION")
    print("=" * 78)

    print(f"Input : {INPUT_FILE}")

    if not INPUT_FILE.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Input file not found:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
        )

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

    print(f"Samples : {len(df)}")
    print(f"Columns : {len(df.columns)}")

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Preserve identifiers
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    identifier_candidates = [
        "sample_id",
        "image_id",
        "image",
        "image_path",
        "lesion_id",
        "id",
    ]

    identifier = find_column(df, identifier_candidates)

    if identifier is not None:
        result[identifier] = df[identifier]
    else:
        result["sample_index"] = np.arange(len(df))

    # Preserve true class if available.
    true_class = find_column(
        df,
        [
            "true_class",
            "true_label",
            "label",
            "target",
            "class",
        ],
    )

    if true_class is not None:
        result["true_class"] = df[true_class]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Model features
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print("\nMODEL FEATURES")
    print("-" * 78)

    for model, family in MODELS:

        prediction_col = f"{model}_prediction"
        confidence_col = f"{model}_confidence"
        correct_col = f"{model}_correct"

        if prediction_col not in df.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing prediction column: {prediction_col}"
            )

        if confidence_col not in df.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing confidence column: {confidence_col}"
            )

        result[prediction_col] = df[prediction_col]
        result[confidence_col] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[confidence_col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Entropy
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        entropy_candidates = [
            f"{model}_entropy",
            f"{model}_prediction_entropy",
        ]

        entropy_col = find_column(df, entropy_candidates)

        if entropy_col is not None:

            result[f"{model}_entropy"] = pd.to_numeric(
                df[entropy_col],
                errors="coerce",
            )

            print(
                f"{model:25s} entropy : existing ({entropy_col})"
            )

        else:

            result[f"{model}_entropy"] = entropy_from_confidence(
                result[confidence_col]
            )

            print(
                f"{model:25s} entropy : fallback from confidence"
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Prediction margin
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        margin_candidates = [
            f"{model}_prediction_margin",
            f"{model}_margin",
            f"{model}_confidence_margin",
        ]

        margin_col = find_column(df, margin_candidates)

        if margin_col is not None:

            result[f"{model}_margin"] = pd.to_numeric(
                df[margin_col],
                errors="coerce",
            )

            print(
                f"{model:25s} margin  : existing ({margin_col})"
            )

        else:

            # We cannot calculate the true top1-top2 margin
            # from a single confidence value.
            #
            # Therefore keep NaN rather than pretending that
            # confidence itself is a margin.
            result[f"{model}_margin"] = np.nan

            print(
                f"{model:25s} margin  : unavailable"
            )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Target
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if correct_col in df.columns:

            result[correct_col] = (
                pd.to_numeric(
                    df[correct_col],
                    errors="coerce",
                )
                .fillna(0)
                .astype(int)
            )

        else:

            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing target column: {correct_col}"
            )

    # ========================================================
    # GLOBAL FEATURES
    # ========================================================

    print("\nGLOBAL FEATURES")
    print("-" * 78)

    prediction_columns = [
        f"{model}_prediction"
        for model, _ in MODELS
    ]

    confidence_columns = [
        f"{model}_confidence"
        for model, _ in MODELS
    ]

    entropy_columns = [
        f"{model}_entropy"
        for model, _ in MODELS
    ]

    prediction_matrix = result[prediction_columns].astype(str)

    confidence_matrix = result[confidence_columns].astype(float)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Number of unique predictions
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    result["num_unique_predictions"] = (
        prediction_matrix.nunique(axis=1)
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Number of models supporting majority prediction
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    result["majority_vote_count"] = (
        prediction_matrix.apply(
            lambda row: row.value_counts().iloc[0],
            axis=1,
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Agreement ratio
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    result["prediction_agreement_ratio"] = (
        result["majority_vote_count"] / len(MODELS)
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CNN / ViT family agreement
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    cnn_models = [
        "resnet50",
        "efficientnet_v2_s",
        "efficientnet_b3",
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
    ]

    vit_models = [
        "deit_tiny",
        "swin_tiny",
    ]

    cnn_prediction_columns = [
        f"{model}_prediction"
        for model in cnn_models
    ]

    vit_prediction_columns = [
        f"{model}_prediction"
        for model in vit_models
    ]

    def family_majority(row, columns):
        values = row[columns].astype(str)
        return values.value_counts().index[0]

    cnn_majority = prediction_matrix.apply(
        lambda row: family_majority(row, cnn_prediction_columns),
        axis=1,
    )

    vit_majority = prediction_matrix.apply(
        lambda row: family_majority(row, vit_prediction_columns),
        axis=1,
    )

    result["cnn_vit_agreement"] = (
        cnn_majority == vit_majority
    ).astype(int)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence statistics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    result["max_confidence"] = (
        confidence_matrix.max(axis=1)
    )

    result["min_confidence"] = (
        confidence_matrix.min(axis=1)
    )

    result["mean_confidence"] = (
        confidence_matrix.mean(axis=1)
    )

    result["std_confidence"] = (
        confidence_matrix.std(axis=1)
    )

    sorted_confidence = np.sort(
        confidence_matrix.values,
        axis=1,
    )

    result["top_confidence"] = sorted_confidence[:, -1]

    result["second_confidence"] = sorted_confidence[:, -2]

    result["confidence_gap"] = (
        sorted_confidence[:, -1]
        - sorted_confidence[:, -2]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Entropy statistics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    entropy_matrix = result[entropy_columns].astype(float)

    result["mean_entropy"] = entropy_matrix.mean(axis=1)

    result["min_entropy"] = entropy_matrix.min(axis=1)

    result["max_entropy"] = entropy_matrix.max(axis=1)

    result["std_entropy"] = entropy_matrix.std(axis=1)

    # ========================================================
    # SAVE
    # ========================================================

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_FILE,
        index=False,
    )

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print("FEATURE EXTRACTION COMPLETE")
    print("=" * 78)

    print(f"Output : {OUTPUT_FILE}")
    print(f"Rows   : {len(result)}")
    print(f"Columns: {len(result.columns)}")

    print("\nGenerated global features:")

    global_features = [
        "num_unique_predictions",
        "majority_vote_count",
        "prediction_agreement_ratio",
        "cnn_vit_agreement",
        "max_confidence",
        "min_confidence",
        "mean_confidence",
        "std_confidence",
        "top_confidence",
        "second_confidence",
        "confidence_gap",
        "mean_entropy",
        "min_entropy",
        "max_entropy",
        "std_entropy",
    ]

    for feature in global_features:
        print(f"  {feature}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from scipy.stats import pointbiserialr
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score


# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = "/home/dhrubo_roy/Hybrid_v3"

INPUT_FILE = os.path.join(
    PROJECT_ROOT,
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection",
    "outputs",
    "prediction_features.csv",
)

OUTPUT_DIR = os.path.join(
    PROJECT_ROOT,
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection",
    "outputs",
)

OUTPUT_FILE = os.path.join(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    "feature_predictiveness.csv",
)


# ============================================================================
# MODEL CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]


# ============================================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================================

def get_first_series(df, column):
    """
    Safely retrieve one column as a Series.

    This prevents pandas from returning a DataFrame when duplicate
    column names exist.
    """

    positions = [
        i for i, name in enumerate(df.columns)
        if name == column
    ]

    if not positions:
        return None

    return df.iloc[:, positions[0]].copy()


def safe_numeric(series):
    """
    Convert a Series to numeric safely.
    """

    return pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce")


def calculate_auc(x, y):
    """
    Calculate ROC-AUC if both classes are present.
    """

    try:
        if len(np.unique(y)) < 2:
            return np.nan

        return roc_auc_score(y, x)

    except Exception:
        return np.nan


def calculate_point_biserial(x, y):
    """
    Calculate point-biserial correlation.
    """

    try:
        if len(x) < 3:
            return np.nan, np.nan

        if len(np.unique(y)) < 2:
            return np.nan, np.nan

        result = pointbiserialr(y, x)

        return float(result.statistic), float(result.pvalue)

    except Exception:
        return np.nan, np.nan


# ============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================

print("=" * 78)
print("HYBRID_V3 FEATURE PREDICTIVENESS ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 78)

print(f"Input : {INPUT_FILE}")

if not os.path.exists(INPUT_FILE):
    print()
    print("ERROR: Input file does not exist.")
    print(INPUT_FILE)
    sys.exit(1)


df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

print(f"Samples : {len(df)}")
print(f"Columns : {len(df.columns)}")


# ============================================================================
# CHECK DUPLICATE COLUMNS
# ============================================================================

duplicate_columns = df.columns[df.columns.duplicated()].tolist()

if duplicate_columns:

    print()
    print("WARNING: Duplicate column names detected:")
    print("-" * 78)

    for column in sorted(set(duplicate_columns)):
        count = list(df.columns).count(column)
        print(f"{column}: {count}")

    print()
    print("The analysis will safely use the first occurrence of each column.")


# ============================================================================
# TARGET DISCOVERY
# ============================================================================

target_columns = []

for model in MODELS:

    correct_column = f"{model}_correct"

    if correct_column in df.columns:
        target_columns.append(
            (model, correct_column)
        )


if not target_columns:

    print()
    print("ERROR: No model correctness columns found.")
    sys.exit(1)


# ============================================================================
# FEATURE DISCOVERY
# ============================================================================

exclude_columns = set()

for model, correct_column in target_columns:
    exclude_columns.add(correct_column)


feature_columns = []

for column in df.columns:

    if column in exclude_columns:
        continue

    # Do not analyze raw predictions as continuous reliability features.
    if column.endswith("_prediction"):
        continue

    # Keep numeric features only.
    series = get_first_series(df, column)

    if series is None:
        continue

    numeric = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce")

    if numeric.notna().sum() == 0:
        continue

    feature_columns.append(column)


# Remove duplicate feature names while preserving order
feature_columns = list(dict.fromkeys(feature_columns))


print()
print("FEATURES")
print("-" * 78)

for feature in feature_columns:
    print(feature)


# ============================================================================
# ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

results = []

for feature_name in feature_columns:

    x = get_first_series(df, feature_name)

    if x is None:
        continue

    x = safe_numeric(x)

    for model, target_name in target_columns:

        y = get_first_series(df, target_name)

        if y is None:
            continue

        y = safe_numeric(y)

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # IMPORTANT:
        # Reset indexes before combining masks.
        # This prevents pandas alignment errors.
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        x = x.reset_index(drop=True)
        y = y.reset_index(drop=True)

        valid = (
            x.notna().to_numpy()
            &
            y.notna().to_numpy()
        )

        x_valid = x.iloc[valid]
        y_valid = y.iloc[valid]

        if len(x_valid) < 3:
            continue

        x_values = x_valid.to_numpy(dtype=float)
        y_values = y_valid.to_numpy(dtype=float)

        # Need feature variation
        if np.nanstd(x_values) == 0:
            correlation = np.nan
            p_value = np.nan
            auc = np.nan

        else:

            correlation, p_value = calculate_point_biserial(
                x_values,
                y_values
            )

            auc = calculate_auc(
                x_values,
                y_values
            )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # Direction-independent AUC
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        if np.isfinite(auc):
            auc_directional = max(
                auc,
                1.0 - auc
            )
        else:
            auc_directional = np.nan

        results.append({

            "feature": feature_name,

            "target_model": model,

            "n_samples": len(x_valid),

            "mean_feature": float(
                np.mean(x_values)
            ),

            "std_feature": float(
                np.std(x_values)
            ),

            "point_biserial_r": correlation,

            "p_value": p_value,

            "roc_auc": auc,

            "directional_auc": auc_directional,

            "abs_correlation": (
                abs(correlation)
                if np.isfinite(correlation)
                else np.nan
            ),
        })


# ============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================================

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

if results_df.empty:

    print()
    print("ERROR: No valid feature/target combinations were found.")
    sys.exit(1)


results_df = results_df.sort_values(
    by=[
        "directional_auc",
        "abs_correlation",
    ],
    ascending=False,
)


os.makedirs(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    exist_ok=True
)

results_df.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    index=False
)


# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================================================

print()
print("=" * 78)
print("TOP FEATURES")
print("=" * 78)

display_columns = [
    "feature",
    "target_model",
    "n_samples",
    "point_biserial_r",
    "p_value",
    "roc_auc",
    "directional_auc",
]


print(
    results_df[
        display_columns
    ].head(30).to_string(index=False)
)


print()
print("=" * 78)
print("BEST FEATURE FOR EACH MODEL")
print("=" * 78)

for model in MODELS:

    subset = results_df[
        results_df["target_model"] == model
    ]

    if subset.empty:
        continue

    best = subset.iloc[0]

    print()
    print(model)

    print(
        f"  feature          : {best['feature']}"
    )

    print(
        f"  correlation      : "
        f"{best['point_biserial_r']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"  ROC-AUC          : "
        f"{best['roc_auc']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"  directional AUC  : "
        f"{best['directional_auc']:.6f}"
    )


print()
print("=" * 78)
print("FEATURE PREDICTIVENESS ANALYSIS COMPLETE")
print("=" * 78)

print()
print(f"Output : {OUTPUT_FILE}")
print(f"Rows   : {len(results_df)}")

			build_pairwise_selection_dataset.py
