#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3 — 5-FOLD CV DEEP ANALYSIS
================================================

Analyzes the out-of-fold predictions produced by:

    cross_validate_pairwise_selector_v3.py

Purpose:
    1. Verify overall V3 performance across all 1267 images.
    2. Analyze rescues and regressions.
    3. Analyze the remaining V3 -> Oracle headroom.
    4. Identify which model V3 should have selected.
    5. Analyze class-wise failures.
    6. Analyze model-switch behavior.
    7. Analyze confidence / entropy / margin patterns when available.
    8. Analyze pairwise decision behavior when available.
    9. Produce CSV files for V3.1 design decisions.

IMPORTANT:
    These are OUT-OF-FOLD predictions.
    Every image is analyzed using a selector that did not train on that image.

Input:
    outputs/pairwise_v3_cv/all_cv_predictions.csv

Output:
    outputs/pairwise_v3_cv/deep_analysis/
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PHASE4_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR.parent
PROJECT_ROOT = PHASE4_DIR.parent

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PHASE4_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR.parent
OUTPUT_DIR = PHASE4_DIR / "outputs" / "pairwise_v3_cv"

INPUT_FILE = OUTPUT_DIR / "all_cv_predictions.csv"
DEEP_DIR = OUTPUT_DIR / "deep_analysis"

DEEP_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# =============================================================================
# MODELS
# =============================================================================

MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]


# =============================================================================
# HELPERS
# =============================================================================

def header(title: str):

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def save(df: pd.DataFrame, filename: str):

    path = DEEP_DIR / filename
    df.to_csv(path, index=False)
    print(f"[SAVED] {path}")


def safe_mean(series):

    if len(series) == 0:
        return np.nan

    return float(series.mean())


# =============================================================================
# LOAD
# =============================================================================

def load_predictions():

    header("LOADING 5-FOLD OUT-OF-FOLD PREDICTIONS")

    if not INPUT_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Missing CV prediction file:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

    print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")

    print("\nColumns:")
    for c in df.columns:
        print(f"  {c}")

    required = [
        "image_id",
        "true_class",
        "best_model",
        "best_model_prediction",
        "v3_selected_model",
        "v3_prediction",
        "oracle_prediction",
        "best_model_correct",
        "v3_correct",
        "oracle_correct",
    ]

    missing = [
        c for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        raise RuntimeError(
            "Missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in missing)
        )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# OVERALL
# =============================================================================

def analyze_overall(df):

    header("OVERALL 5-FOLD PERFORMANCE")

    n = len(df)

    best = df["best_model_correct"].astype(int)
    v3 = df["v3_correct"].astype(int)
    oracle = df["oracle_correct"].astype(int)

    rescues = ((best == 0) & (v3 == 1)).sum()

    regressions = ((best == 1) & (v3 == 0)).sum()

    both_correct = ((best == 1) & (v3 == 1)).sum()

    both_wrong = ((best == 0) & (v3 == 0)).sum()

    oracle_gap = ((oracle == 1) & (v3 == 0)).sum()

    all_wrong = (oracle == 0).sum()

    all_wrong_rescues = (
        (oracle == 0) &
        (v3 == 1)
    ).sum()

    summary = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "total_images": n,
                "best_model_correct": int(best.sum()),
                "v3_correct": int(v3.sum()),
                "oracle_correct": int(oracle.sum()),
                "best_accuracy": best.mean(),
                "v3_accuracy": v3.mean(),
                "oracle_accuracy": oracle.mean(),
                "v3_improvement": v3.mean() - best.mean(),
                "oracle_headroom": oracle.mean() - v3.mean(),
                "rescues": rescues,
                "regressions": regressions,
                "both_correct": both_correct,
                "both_wrong": both_wrong,
                "oracle_gap_cases": oracle_gap,
                "all_models_wrong": all_wrong,
                "all_wrong_rescues": all_wrong_rescues,
            }
        ]
    )

    print(
        f"Images:                 {n}"
    )
    print(
        f"Best model:             {best.sum()}/{n} = {best.mean():.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"V3:                     {v3.sum()}/{n} = {v3.mean():.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Oracle:                 {oracle.sum()}/{n} = {oracle.mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"\nV3 improvement:         {v3.mean() - best.mean():+.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle headroom:        {oracle.mean() - v3.mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues:                {rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Regressions:            {regressions}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle-gap cases:       {oracle_gap}"
    )

    print(
        f"All-models-wrong:       {all_wrong}"
    )

    print(
        f"All-wrong rescues:      {all_wrong_rescues}"
    )

    save(summary, "overall_deep_summary.csv")


# =============================================================================
# CASE DISTRIBUTION
# =============================================================================

def analyze_case_distribution(df):

    header("CASE DISTRIBUTION")

    best = df["best_model_correct"].astype(int)
    v3 = df["v3_correct"].astype(int)
    oracle = df["oracle_correct"].astype(int)

    conditions = [
        (best == 1) & (v3 == 1),
        (best == 0) & (v3 == 1),
        (best == 1) & (v3 == 0),
        (best == 0) & (v3 == 0),
        (oracle == 1) & (v3 == 0),
        (oracle == 0),
    ]

    labels = [
        "BOTH_CORRECT",
        "RESCUED",
        "REGRESSION",
        "BOTH_WRONG",
        "ORACLE_GAP",
        "ALL_MODELS_WRONG",
    ]

    rows = []

    for label, mask in zip(labels, conditions):

        count = int(mask.sum())

        rows.append(
            {
                "case_type": label,
                "count": count,
                "rate": count / len(df),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    save(result, "case_distribution.csv")


# =============================================================================
# RESCUES
# =============================================================================

def analyze_rescues(df):

    header("SUCCESSFUL RESCUE ANALYSIS")

    mask = (
        (df["best_model_correct"] == 0) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 1)
    )

    rescues = df.loc[mask].copy()

    print(f"Rescues: {len(rescues)}")

    if len(rescues) == 0:
        return

    print("\nSelected models:")

    selected = (
        rescues["v3_selected_model"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("v3_selected_model")
        .reset_index(name="count")
    )

    print(selected.to_string(index=False))

    print("\nTrue classes:")

    classes = (
        rescues["true_class"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("true_class")
        .reset_index(name="count")
    )

    print(classes.to_string(index=False))

    save(rescues, "cv_rescued_cases.csv")
    save(selected, "cv_rescue_selected_models.csv")
    save(classes, "cv_rescue_classes.csv")


# =============================================================================
# REGRESSIONS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_regressions(df):

    header("REGRESSION ANALYSIS")

    mask = (
        (df["best_model_correct"] == 1) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
    )

    regressions = df.loc[mask].copy()

    print(f"Regressions: {len(regressions)}")

    if len(regressions) > 0:

        print("\nSelected models causing regressions:")

        selected = (
            regressions["v3_selected_model"]
            .value_counts()
            .rename_axis("v3_selected_model")
            .reset_index(name="count")
        )

        print(selected.to_string(index=False))

        save(regressions, "cv_regression_cases.csv")
        save(selected, "cv_regression_selected_models.csv")

    else:

        print("[OK] Zero regressions across CV.")

        save(
            pd.DataFrame(),
            "cv_regression_cases.csv"
        )


# =============================================================================
# ORACLE GAP
# =============================================================================

def analyze_oracle_gap(df):

    header("ORACLE GAP ANALYSIS")

    mask = (
        (df["oracle_correct"] == 1) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
    )

    gap = df.loc[mask].copy()

    print(
        f"Oracle cases missed by V3: {len(gap)}"
    )

    if len(gap) == 0:

        print("[EXCELLENT] V3 reached oracle.")

        return

    useful_columns = [
        c for c in [
            "image_id",
            "true_class",
            "best_model",
            "best_model_prediction",
            "v3_selected_model",
            "v3_prediction",
            "oracle_prediction",
            "v3_vote_count",
            "v3_vote_winner_count",
            "v3_vote_tie",
            "v3_vote_margin",
            "pairwise_decisions",
        ]
        if c in gap.columns
    ]

    print(
        gap[useful_columns]
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    save(gap, "oracle_gap_cases.csv")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Which model should have been selected?
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print("\nBest correct model frequency inside oracle-gap cases:")

    rows = []

    for _, row in gap.iterrows():

        true_class = row["true_class"]

        correct_models = []

        for model in MODELS:

            prediction_col = f"{model}_prediction"

            if prediction_col in df.columns:

                if row[prediction_col] == true_class:
                    correct_models.append(model)

        rows.append(
            {
                "image_id": row["image_id"],
                "true_class": true_class,
                "v3_selected_model": row["v3_selected_model"],
                "correct_models": "|".join(correct_models),
                "num_correct_models": len(correct_models),
            }
        )

    correct_model_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    save(
        correct_model_df,
        "oracle_gap_correct_models.csv"
    )

    exploded = []

    for _, row in correct_model_df.iterrows():

        for model in str(
            row["correct_models"]
        ).split("|"):

            if model:

                exploded.append(
                    {
                        "model": model,
                        "count": 1,
                    }
                )

    if exploded:

        frequency = (
            pd.DataFrame(exploded)
            .groupby("model")
            .size()
            .reset_index(name="count")
            .sort_values("count", ascending=False)
        )

        print("\nModels that could have rescued oracle-gap cases:")

        print(
            frequency.to_string(index=False)
        )

        save(
            frequency,
            "oracle_gap_rescue_model_frequency.csv"
        )


# =============================================================================
# ALL MODELS WRONG
# =============================================================================

def analyze_all_wrong(df):

    header("ALL-MODELS-WRONG ANALYSIS")

    mask = df["oracle_correct"] == 0

    wrong = df.loc[mask].copy()

    rescued = wrong.loc[
        wrong["v3_correct"] == 1
    ]

    print(
        f"All models wrong: {len(wrong)}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3 correct among them: {len(rescued)}"
    )

    if len(wrong) > 0:

        print(
            f"All-wrong rescue rate: "
            f"{len(rescued) / len(wrong):.6f}"
        )

    save(wrong, "all_models_wrong_cases.csv")


# =============================================================================
# MODEL SELECTION
# =============================================================================

def analyze_model_selection(df):

    header("V3 MODEL SELECTION ANALYSIS")

    rows = []

    for model in MODELS:

        selected = (
            df["v3_selected_model"] == model
        )

        count = int(selected.sum())

        correct = int(
            df.loc[selected, "v3_correct"].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "model": model,
                "selected": count,
                "selection_rate": count / len(df),
                "selected_correct": correct,
                "selection_accuracy": (
                    correct / count
                    if count > 0
                    else np.nan
                ),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    save(result, "model_selection_analysis.csv")


# =============================================================================
# MODEL SWITCHES
# =============================================================================

def analyze_switches(df):

    header("MODEL SWITCH ANALYSIS")

    mask = (
        df["best_model"] !=
        df["v3_selected_model"]
    )

    switches = df.loc[mask].copy()

    print(
        f"Model switches: {len(switches)}"
    )

    if len(switches) == 0:
        return

    grouped = (
        switches
        .groupby(
            [
                "best_model",
                "v3_selected_model",
            ]
        )
        .agg(
            samples=("image_id", "size"),
            rescues=(
                "v3_correct",
                lambda x: int(x.sum())
            ),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    grouped["regressions"] = (
        grouped["samples"] -
        grouped["rescues"]
    )

    # A regression is only a case where best model was correct.
    grouped["net_gain"] = (
        grouped["rescues"] -
        grouped["regressions"]
    )

    print(
        grouped.to_string(index=False)
    )

    save(
        grouped,
        "model_switch_analysis.csv"
    )

    save(
        switches,
        "all_model_switch_cases.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# CLASS-WISE PERFORMANCE
# =============================================================================

def analyze_classes(df):

    header("CLASS-WISE PERFORMANCE")

    rows = []

    for true_class, group in df.groupby(
        "true_class",
        sort=True
    ):

        n = len(group)

        best_acc = group[
            "best_model_correct"
        ].mean()

        v3_acc = group[
            "v3_correct"
        ].mean()

        oracle_acc = group[
            "oracle_correct"
        ].mean()

        rescues = (
            (group["best_model_correct"] == 0) &
            (group["v3_correct"] == 1)
        ).sum()

        regressions = (
            (group["best_model_correct"] == 1) &
            (group["v3_correct"] == 0)
        ).sum()

        oracle_gap = (
            (group["oracle_correct"] == 1) &
            (group["v3_correct"] == 0)
        ).sum()

        rows.append(
            {
                "true_class": true_class,
                "samples": n,
                "best_accuracy": best_acc,
                "v3_accuracy": v3_acc,
                "oracle_accuracy": oracle_acc,
                "v3_delta": v3_acc - best_acc,
                "oracle_gap": oracle_acc - v3_acc,
                "rescues": int(rescues),
                "regressions": int(regressions),
                "oracle_gap_cases": int(oracle_gap),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    save(result, "class_wise_performance.csv")


# =============================================================================
# PREDICTION TRANSITIONS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_transitions(df):

    header("BEST MODEL → V3 PREDICTION TRANSITIONS")

    matrix = pd.crosstab(
        df["best_model_prediction"],
        df["v3_prediction"],
        dropna=False,
    )

    print(
        matrix.to_string()
    )

    save(
        matrix.reset_index(),
        "prediction_transition_matrix.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# VOTE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_votes(df):

    header("V3 VOTE ANALYSIS")

    if "v3_vote_margin" not in df.columns:

        print(
            "[INFO] v3_vote_margin not available."
        )

        return

    result = (
        df
        .groupby("v3_vote_margin")
        .agg(
            samples=("image_id", "size"),
            accuracy=("v3_correct", "mean"),
            rescues=(
                "v3_correct",
                lambda x: 0
            ),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    rescues = (
        df[
            (df["best_model_correct"] == 0) &
            (df["v3_correct"] == 1)
        ]
        .groupby("v3_vote_margin")
        .size()
        .rename("rescues")
    )

    regressions = (
        df[
            (df["best_model_correct"] == 1) &
            (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
        ]
        .groupby("v3_vote_margin")
        .size()
        .rename("regressions")
    )

    result = result.drop(
        columns=["rescues"]
    )

    result = result.merge(
        rescues,
        on="v3_vote_margin",
        how="left",
    )

    result = result.merge(
        regressions,
        on="v3_vote_margin",
        how="left",
    )

    result[
        ["rescues", "regressions"]
    ] = result[
        ["rescues", "regressions"]
    ].fillna(0).astype(int)

    result["rescue_rate"] = (
        result["rescues"] /
        result["samples"]
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    save(
        result,
        "vote_margin_analysis.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# CASE TYPE × MODEL
# =============================================================================

def analyze_case_type_model(df):

    header("MODEL SELECTION BY CASE TYPE")

    def case(row):

        if (
            row["best_model_correct"] == 1 and
            row["v3_correct"] == 1
        ):
            return "BOTH_CORRECT"

        if (
            row["best_model_correct"] == 0 and
            row["v3_correct"] == 1
        ):
            return "RESCUED"

        if (
            row["best_model_correct"] == 1 and
            row["v3_correct"] == 0
        ):
            return "REGRESSION"

        return "BOTH_WRONG"

    temp = df.copy()

    temp["case_type"] = temp.apply(
        case,
        axis=1,
    )

    result = pd.crosstab(
        temp["v3_selected_model"],
        temp["case_type"],
    )

    print(
        result.to_string()
    )

    save(
        result.reset_index(),
        "model_selection_by_case_type.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# ORACLE GAP BY CLASS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_oracle_gap_by_class(df):

    header("ORACLE GAP BY CLASS")

    gap = (
        (df["oracle_correct"] == 1) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
    )

    result = (
        df.assign(oracle_gap=gap)
        .groupby("true_class")
        .agg(
            samples=("image_id", "size"),
            oracle_gap_cases=("oracle_gap", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    result["oracle_gap_rate"] = (
        result["oracle_gap_cases"] /
        result["samples"]
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    save(
        result,
        "oracle_gap_by_class.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# V3 FAILURES BY SELECTED MODEL
# =============================================================================

def analyze_failures_by_selected_model(df):

    header("V3 FAILURES BY SELECTED MODEL")

    gap = df[
        (df["oracle_correct"] == 1) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
    ].copy()

    if len(gap) == 0:
        return

    result = (
        gap
        .groupby("v3_selected_model")
        .size()
        .reset_index(name="oracle_gap_cases")
        .sort_values(
            "oracle_gap_cases",
            ascending=False,
        )
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    save(
        result,
        "oracle_gap_by_selected_model.csv"
    )

def analyze_class_selection(df):

    header("TRUE CLASS × V3 SELECTED MODEL")

    result = pd.crosstab(
        df["true_class"],
        df["v3_selected_model"],
    )

    print(
        result.to_string()
    )

    save(
        result.reset_index(),
        "true_class_selected_model_matrix.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# PAIRWISE DECISION INSPECTION
# =============================================================================

def analyze_pairwise_decisions(df):

    header("PAIRWISE DECISION AVAILABILITY")

    if "pairwise_decisions" not in df.columns:

        print(
            "[INFO] pairwise_decisions column unavailable."
        )

        return

    non_null = df[
        df["pairwise_decisions"].notna()
    ]

    print(
        f"Rows with pairwise decisions: "
        f"{len(non_null)} / {len(df)}"
    )

    # Save oracle-gap decisions separately.

    gap = df[
        (df["oracle_correct"] == 1) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
    ].copy()

    if len(gap) > 0:

        save(
            gap[
                [
                    "image_id",
                    "true_class",
                    "v3_selected_model",
                    "v3_prediction",
                    "oracle_prediction",
                    "pairwise_decisions",
                ]
            ],
            "oracle_gap_pairwise_decisions.csv"
        )


# =============================================================================
# CONSISTENCY CHECK
# =============================================================================

def consistency_checks(df):

    header("DATA CONSISTENCY CHECKS")

    checks = []

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3 correctness
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    calculated_v3 = (
        df["v3_prediction"] ==
        df["true_class"]
    ).astype(int)

    mismatch = (
        calculated_v3 !=
        df["v3_correct"].astype(int)
    ).sum()

    checks.append(
        {
            "check": "v3_correct_consistency",
            "failures": int(mismatch),
        }
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Best model correctness
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    calculated_best = (
        df["best_model_prediction"] ==
        df["true_class"]
    ).astype(int)

    mismatch = (
        calculated_best !=
        df["best_model_correct"].astype(int)
    ).sum()

    checks.append(
        {
            "check": "best_model_correct_consistency",
            "failures": int(mismatch),
        }
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Oracle correctness
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    calculated_oracle = (
        df["oracle_prediction"] ==
        df["true_class"]
    ).astype(int)

    mismatch = (
        calculated_oracle !=
        df["oracle_correct"].astype(int)
    ).sum()

    checks.append(
        {
            "check": "oracle_correct_consistency",
            "failures": int(mismatch),
        }
    )

    result = pd.DataFrame(checks)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    if result["failures"].sum() == 0:

        print(
            "\n[OK] All correctness fields are internally consistent."
        )

    else:

        print(
            "\n[WARNING] Consistency problems detected."
        )

    save(
        result,
        "consistency_checks.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MASTER ERROR TABLE
# =============================================================================

def create_master_error_table(df):

    header("CREATING MASTER ERROR TABLE")

    temp = df.copy()

    temp["case_type"] = "UNKNOWN"

    temp.loc[
        (temp["best_model_correct"] == 1) &
        (temp["v3_correct"] == 1),
        "case_type"
    ] = "BOTH_CORRECT"

    temp.loc[
        (temp["best_model_correct"] == 0) &
        (temp["v3_correct"] == 1),
        "case_type"
    ] = "RESCUED"

    temp.loc[
        (temp["best_model_correct"] == 1) &
        (temp["v3_correct"] == 0),
        "case_type"
    ] = "REGRESSION"

    temp.loc[
        (temp["best_model_correct"] == 0) &
        (temp["v3_correct"] == 0),
        "case_type"
    ] = "BOTH_WRONG"

    temp["oracle_gap"] = (
        (temp["oracle_correct"] == 1) &
        (temp["v3_correct"] == 0)
    ).astype(int)

    error_cases = temp[
        temp["case_type"] != "BOTH_CORRECT"
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Non-trivial cases: {len(error_cases)}"
    )

    save(
        error_cases,
        "v3_cv_deep_error_cases.csv"
    )


# =============================================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def create_final_summary(df):

    header("FINAL CV DEEP ANALYSIS SUMMARY")

    n = len(df)

    best_acc = df["best_model_correct"].mean()
    v3_acc = df["v3_correct"].mean()
    oracle_acc = df["oracle_correct"].mean()

    rescues = (
        (df["best_model_correct"] == 0) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 1)
    ).sum()

    regressions = (
        (df["best_model_correct"] == 1) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
    ).sum()

    oracle_gap = (
        (df["oracle_correct"] == 1) &
        (df["v3_correct"] == 0)
    ).sum()

    all_wrong = (
        df["oracle_correct"] == 0
    ).sum()

    summary = {
        "images": n,
        "best_accuracy": best_acc,
        "v3_accuracy": v3_acc,
        "oracle_accuracy": oracle_acc,
        "v3_improvement": v3_acc - best_acc,
        "oracle_headroom": oracle_acc - v3_acc,
        "rescues": int(rescues),
        "regressions": int(regressions),
        "oracle_gap_cases": int(oracle_gap),
        "all_models_wrong": int(all_wrong),
        "all_wrong_rescues": int(
            (
                (df["oracle_correct"] == 0) &
                (df["v3_correct"] == 1)
            ).sum()
        ),
    }

    print(
        json.dumps(
            summary,
            indent=2,
        )
    )

    with open(
        DEEP_DIR / "final_cv_deep_summary.json",
        "w",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            summary,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(
        f"\n[SAVED] "
        f"{DEEP_DIR / 'final_cv_deep_summary.json'}"
    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.1
======================

V3.1 improvements over V3:
    - Class-conditional model reliability
    - Predicted-class reliability
    - Confidence-bin reliability
    - Class-conditional pairwise reliability
    - Vote entropy
    - Number of distinct predicted classes
    - Vote margin
    - Model confidence gaps
    - Pairwise agreement/disagreement
    - Confidence-weighted reliability
    - Keeps all reliability statistics train-only

IMPORTANT:
This script trains the selector on the complete prediction-feature dataset.

For unbiased evaluation, use:
    cross_validate_pairwise_selector_v3_1.py

The cross-validation script should rebuild every reliability statistic
inside each fold using training data only.
"""

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json
import math
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    f1_score,
)

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# PATHS
# ============================================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

INPUT_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_cv"
    / "all_cv_predictions.csv"
)

# Prefer the original prediction-feature table if available.
CANDIDATE_FEATURE_FILES = [
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "prediction_features.csv",

    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_prediction_features.csv",

    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "prediction_features"
    / "prediction_features.csv",

    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3"
    / "prediction_features.csv",
]

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_1"
)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# ============================================================================
# MODEL DEFINITIONS
# ============================================================================

MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]

NUM_MODELS = len(MODELS)

CLASSES = [
    "AK",
    "BCC",
    "BKL",
    "DF",
    "MEL",
    "NV",
    "SCC",
    "VASC",
]

NUM_CLASSES = len(CLASSES)

CLASS_TO_ID = {
    c: i for i, c in enumerate(CLASSES)
}

ID_TO_CLASS = {
    i: c for c, i in CLASS_TO_ID.items()
}


# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

RANDOM_STATE = 42

N_ESTIMATORS = 500

MIN_PAIRWISE_SAMPLES = 5
MIN_CLASS_SAMPLES = 5

CONFIDENCE_BINS = [
    0.0,
    0.50,
    0.60,
    0.70,
    0.80,
    0.90,
    1.01,
]


# ============================================================================
# UTILITY FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

def find_feature_file():
    """
    Locate the original prediction-feature table.
    """

    for path in CANDIDATE_FEATURE_FILES:
        if path.exists():
            return path

    raise FileNotFoundError(
        "\nCould not locate prediction-feature CSV.\n\n"
        "Checked:\n"
        + "\n".join(str(p) for p in CANDIDATE_FEATURE_FILES)
        + "\n\n"
        "Please update CANDIDATE_FEATURE_FILES at the top of the script."
    )


def safe_divide(a, b, default=0.0):
    if b == 0:
        return default
    return float(a) / float(b)


def entropy_from_counts(counts):
    """
    Normalized entropy.
    """

    total = sum(counts)

    if total <= 0:
        return 0.0

    probs = [
        c / total
        for c in counts
        if c > 0
    ]

    if len(probs) <= 1:
        return 0.0

    entropy = -sum(
        p * math.log(p)
        for p in probs
    )

    max_entropy = math.log(NUM_CLASSES)

    if max_entropy == 0:
        return 0.0

    return entropy / max_entropy


def confidence_bin(confidence):
    """
    Convert confidence to a discrete confidence bin.
    """

    confidence = float(confidence)

    for i in range(len(CONFIDENCE_BINS) - 1):

        low = CONFIDENCE_BINS[i]
        high = CONFIDENCE_BINS[i + 1]

        if low <= confidence < high:
            return i

    return len(CONFIDENCE_BINS) - 2


def get_prediction_column(df, model):
    candidates = [
        f"{model}_prediction",
        f"{model}_pred",
        f"{model}_class",
    ]

    for c in candidates:
        if c in df.columns:
            return c

    raise KeyError(
        f"Could not find prediction column for {model}. "
        f"Expected one of: {candidates}"
    )


def get_confidence_column(df, model):
    candidates = [
        f"{model}_confidence",
        f"{model}_conf",
        f"{model}_max_probability",
        f"{model}_probability",
    ]

    for c in candidates:
        if c in df.columns:
            return c

    return None


def normalize_prediction_columns(df):
    """
    Ensure every model has a standardized prediction column.

    Confidence columns are optional.
    """

    for model in MODELS:

        source = get_prediction_column(df, model)

        target = f"{model}_prediction"

        if source != target:
            df[target] = df[source]

    return df


# ============================================================================
# RELIABILITY TABLES
# ============================================================================

def build_global_reliability(
    predictions,
    labels,
):
    """
    P(model correct)
    """

    tables = {}

    labels = np.asarray(labels)

    for model in MODELS:

        preds = np.asarray(
            predictions[model]
        )

        correct = (
            preds == labels
        ).astype(float)

        tables[model] = float(
            correct.mean()
        )

    return tables


def build_class_reliability(
    predictions,
    labels,
):
    """
    P(model correct | true class)

    Used only as a training-derived statistic.

    For deployment, the true class is unknown. Therefore this statistic
    is not directly fed using the true label. Instead, the feature builder
    accesses the reliability of the model's predicted class.
    """

    tables = {}

    labels = np.asarray(labels)

    for model in MODELS:

        preds = np.asarray(
            predictions[model]
        )

        model_table = {}

        for cls in CLASSES:

            mask = labels == cls

            if mask.sum() < MIN_CLASS_SAMPLES:
                model_table[cls] = tables.get(
                    model,
                    {}
                ).get(
                    "__global__",
                    0.5
                )
                continue

            model_table[cls] = float(
                (preds[mask] == labels[mask]).mean()
            )

        model_table["__global__"] = float(
            (preds == labels).mean()
        )

        tables[model] = model_table

    return tables


def build_predicted_class_reliability(
    predictions,
    labels,
):
    """
    P(model correct | model predicted class)
    """

    tables = {}

    labels = np.asarray(labels)

    for model in MODELS:

        preds = np.asarray(
            predictions[model]
        )

        model_table = {}

        global_acc = float(
            (preds == labels).mean()
        )

        for cls in CLASSES:

            mask = preds == cls

            if mask.sum() < MIN_CLASS_SAMPLES:
                model_table[cls] = global_acc
            else:
                model_table[cls] = float(
                    (labels[mask] == cls).mean()
                )

        model_table["__global__"] = global_acc

        tables[model] = model_table

    return tables


def build_confidence_reliability(
    predictions,
    confidences,
    labels,
):
    """
    P(model correct | confidence bin)
    """

    tables = {}

    labels = np.asarray(labels)

    for model in MODELS:

        if model not in confidences:
            tables[model] = {
                i: build_global_reliability(
                    predictions,
                    labels
                )[model]
                for i in range(
                    len(CONFIDENCE_BINS) - 1
                )
            }
            continue

        preds = np.asarray(
            predictions[model]
        )

        conf = np.asarray(
            confidences[model],
            dtype=float
        )

        model_table = {}

        global_acc = float(
            (preds == labels).mean()
        )

        for b in range(
            len(CONFIDENCE_BINS) - 1
        ):

            mask = np.array([
                confidence_bin(x) == b
                for x in conf
            ])

            if mask.sum() < MIN_CLASS_SAMPLES:
                model_table[b] = global_acc
            else:
                model_table[b] = float(
                    (preds[mask] == labels[mask]).mean()
                )

        tables[model] = model_table

    return tables


def build_class_confidence_reliability(
    predictions,
    confidences,
    labels,
):
    """
    P(correct | predicted class, confidence bin)
    """

    tables = {}

    labels = np.asarray(labels)

    for model in MODELS:

        preds = np.asarray(
            predictions[model]
        )

        if model in confidences:
            conf = np.asarray(
                confidences[model],
                dtype=float
            )
        else:
            conf = np.ones(
                len(labels),
                dtype=float
            ) * 0.5

        global_acc = float(
            (preds == labels).mean()
        )

        model_table = {}

        for cls in CLASSES:

            model_table[cls] = {}

            for b in range(
                len(CONFIDENCE_BINS) - 1
            ):

                mask = (
                    (preds == cls)
                    &
                    np.array([
                        confidence_bin(x) == b
                        for x in conf
                    ])
                )

                if mask.sum() < MIN_PAIRWISE_SAMPLES:
                    model_table[cls][b] = global_acc
                else:
                    model_table[cls][b] = float(
                        (labels[mask] == cls).mean()
                    )

        model_table["__global__"] = global_acc

        tables[model] = model_table

    return tables


# ============================================================================
# PAIRWISE RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def build_pairwise_reliability(
    predictions,
    labels,
):
    """
    P(model A is correct | model A prediction, model B prediction)

    This is one of the main V3.1 additions.
    """

    labels = np.asarray(labels)

    tables = {}

    for i in range(NUM_MODELS):

        for j in range(i + 1, NUM_MODELS):

            model_a = MODELS[i]
            model_b = MODELS[j]

            pred_a = np.asarray(
                predictions[model_a]
            )

            pred_b = np.asarray(
                predictions[model_b]
            )

            global_a = float(
                (pred_a == labels).mean()
            )

            global_b = float(
                (pred_b == labels).mean()
            )

            table = {}

            for cls_a in CLASSES:

                for cls_b in CLASSES:

                    mask = (
                        (pred_a == cls_a)
                        &
                        (pred_b == cls_b)
                    )

                    key = (
                        f"{cls_a}|{cls_b}"
                    )

                    n = int(mask.sum())

                    if n < MIN_PAIRWISE_SAMPLES:

                        table[key] = (
                            global_a,
                            global_b,
                            n
                        )

                    else:

                        acc_a = float(
                            (pred_a[mask] == labels[mask]).mean()
                        )

                        acc_b = float(
                            (pred_b[mask] == labels[mask]).mean()
                        )

                        table[key] = (
                            acc_a,
                            acc_b,
                            n
                        )

            tables[
                (model_a, model_b)
            ] = table

    return tables


# ============================================================================
# FEATURE BUILDER
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_features(
    df,
    reliability,
    class_reliability,
    predicted_class_reliability,
    confidence_reliability,
    class_confidence_reliability,
    pairwise_reliability,
):
    """
    Build one feature vector per image.

    No true labels are used here.
    """

    feature_rows = []

    prediction_arrays = {
        model: df[
            f"{model}_prediction"
        ].astype(str).values
        for model in MODELS
    }

    confidence_arrays = {}

    for model in MODELS:

        column = get_confidence_column(
            df,
            model
        )

        if column is not None:
            confidence_arrays[model] = (
                pd.to_numeric(
                    df[column],
                    errors="coerce"
                )
                .fillna(0.5)
                .clip(0.0, 1.0)
                .values
            )

    for row_idx in range(len(df)):

        row_features = {}

        row_preds = {
            model: prediction_arrays[model][row_idx]
            for model in MODELS
        }

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Basic model predictions encoded as one-hot-like correctness
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        for model in MODELS:

            pred = row_preds[model]

            for cls in CLASSES:

                row_features[
                    f"{model}_pred_{cls}"
                ] = float(pred == cls)

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Confidence features
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        row_conf = {}

        for model in MODELS:

            if model in confidence_arrays:

                conf = float(
                    confidence_arrays[model][row_idx]
                )

            else:

                conf = 0.5

            row_conf[model] = conf

            row_features[
                f"{model}_confidence"
            ] = conf

            b = confidence_bin(conf)

            row_features[
                f"{model}_confidence_bin"
            ] = float(b)

            global_rel = confidence_reliability[
                model
            ].get(
                b,
                reliability[model]
            )

            row_features[
                f"{model}_confidence_reliability"
            ] = global_rel

            predicted_cls = row_preds[model]

            class_rel = predicted_class_reliability[
                model
            ].get(
                predicted_cls,
                reliability[model]
            )

            row_features[
                f"{model}_predicted_class_reliability"
            ] = class_rel

            class_conf_rel = (
                class_confidence_reliability[
                    model
                ]
                .get(
                    predicted_cls,
                    {}
                )
                .get(
                    b,
                    reliability[model]
                )
            )

            row_features[
                f"{model}_class_confidence_reliability"
            ] = class_conf_rel

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Confidence statistics
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        confidence_values = list(
            row_conf.values()
        )

        row_features[
            "confidence_mean"
        ] = float(
            np.mean(confidence_values)
        )

        row_features[
            "confidence_std"
        ] = float(
            np.std(confidence_values)
        )

        row_features[
            "confidence_max"
        ] = float(
            np.max(confidence_values)
        )

        row_features[
            "confidence_min"
        ] = float(
            np.min(confidence_values)
        )

        sorted_conf = sorted(
            confidence_values,
            reverse=True
        )

        row_features[
            "confidence_top_gap"
        ] = (
            sorted_conf[0]
            - sorted_conf[1]
        )

        row_features[
            "confidence_top2_gap"
        ] = (
            sorted_conf[1]
            - sorted_conf[2]
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Vote distribution
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        vote_counter = Counter(
            row_preds.values()
        )

        vote_counts = [
            vote_counter.get(
                cls,
                0
            )
            for cls in CLASSES
        ]

        sorted_votes = sorted(
            vote_counts,
            reverse=True
        )

        top_vote = sorted_votes[0]

        second_vote = (
            sorted_votes[1]
            if len(sorted_votes) > 1
            else 0
        )

        row_features[
            "vote_top"
        ] = float(top_vote)

        row_features[
            "vote_second"
        ] = float(second_vote)

        row_features[
            "vote_margin"
        ] = float(
            top_vote - second_vote
        )

        row_features[
            "distinct_predictions"
        ] = float(
            len(vote_counter)
        )

        row_features[
            "vote_entropy"
        ] = entropy_from_counts(
            vote_counts
        )

        row_features[
            "vote_unanimous"
        ] = float(
            top_vote == NUM_MODELS
        )

        row_features[
            "vote_tie"
        ] = float(
            top_vote == second_vote
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Vote-class one-hot / normalized vote frequencies
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        for cls in CLASSES:

            count = vote_counter.get(
                cls,
                0
            )

            row_features[
                f"vote_count_{cls}"
            ] = float(count)

            row_features[
                f"vote_fraction_{cls}"
            ] = safe_divide(
                count,
                NUM_MODELS
            )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Pairwise disagreement
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------

        pair_agreements = []
        pair_reliability_values = []

        for i in range(NUM_MODELS):

            for j in range(
                i + 1,
                NUM_MODELS
            ):

                model_a = MODELS[i]
                model_b = MODELS[j]

                pred_a = row_preds[model_a]
                pred_b = row_preds[model_b]

                same = (
                    pred_a == pred_b
                )

                row_features[
                    f"pair_{model_a}_{model_b}_agree"
                ] = float(same)

                pair_agreements.append(
                    float(same)
                )

                # ----------------------------------------------------------
                # Class-conditional pairwise reliability
                # ----------------------------------------------------------

                table = pairwise_reliability.get(
                    (model_a, model_b),
                    {}
                )

                key = (
                    f"{pred_a}|{pred_b}"
                )

                values = table.get(
                    key,
                    (
                        reliability[model_a],
                        reliability[model_b],
                        0
                    )
                )

                rel_a = float(values[0])
                rel_b = float(values[1])

                row_features[
                    f"pair_{model_a}_{model_b}_rel_a"
                ] = rel_a

                row_features[
                    f"pair_{model_a}_{model_b}_rel_b"
                ] = rel_b

                row_features[
                    f"pair_{model_a}_{model_b}_rel_gap"
                ] = rel_a - rel_b

                pair_reliability_values.extend([
                    rel_a,
                    rel_b
                ])

        row_features[
            "pairwise_agreement_mean"
        ] = float(
            np.mean(pair_agreements)
        )

        row_features[
            "pairwise_agreement_std"
        ] = float(
            np.std(pair_agreements)
        )

        row_features[
            "pairwise_disagreement_rate"
        ] = 1.0 - float(
            np.mean(pair_agreements)
        )

        row_features[
            "pairwise_reliability_mean"
        ] = float(
            np.mean(
                pair_reliability_values
            )
        )

        row_features[
            "pairwise_reliability_std"
        ] = float(
            np.std(
                pair_reliability_values
            )
        )

        feature_rows.append(
            row_features
        )

    X = pd.DataFrame(
        feature_rows
    )

    X = X.replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf],
        np.nan
    ).fillna(0.0)

    return X


# ============================================================================
# TRAINING LABEL
# ============================================================================

def build_training_labels(
    df,
):
    """
    Target = which model is correct on this image.

    Each image can have multiple correct models.

    For selector training, we choose the correct model with the highest
    global reliability as the preferred target.
    """

    labels = []

    for idx in range(len(df)):

        true_class = str(
            df.iloc[idx]["true_class"]
        )

        correct_models = []

        for model in MODELS:

            pred = str(
                df.iloc[idx][
                    f"{model}_prediction"
                ]
            )

            if pred == true_class:
                correct_models.append(
                    model
                )

        if len(correct_models) == 0:

            # No model is correct.
            # Select the globally strongest model as fallback.
            labels.append(
                MODELS[0]
            )

        else:

            # Deterministic ordering.
            labels.append(
                correct_models[0]
            )

    return np.asarray(labels)


# ============================================================================
# METRICS
# ============================================================================

def print_metrics(
    name,
    y_true,
    y_pred,
):
    acc = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    bal = balanced_accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    macro = f1_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0
    )

    print(
        f"{name:<32}"
        f"{acc:.6f}    "
        f"Balanced: {bal:.6f}    "
        f"Macro F1: {macro:.6f}"
    )

    return {
        "strategy": name,
        "accuracy": acc,
        "balanced_accuracy": bal,
        "macro_f1": macro,
    }


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    print("=" * 80)
    print("PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.1 — TRAINING")
    print("=" * 80)

    print(
        f"Project root:\n{PROJECT_ROOT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Output directory:\n{OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Locate feature data
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature_file = find_feature_file()

    print(
        f"\nPrediction feature file:\n"
        f"{feature_file}"
    )

    df = pd.read_csv(
        feature_file
    )

    print(
        f"\nFeature table shape: {df.shape}"
    )

    df = normalize_prediction_columns(
        df
    )

    required = [
        "true_class"
    ] + [
        f"{model}_prediction"
        for model in MODELS
    ]

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing)
        )

    print(
        "[OK] Required columns found."
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build arrays
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    labels = df[
        "true_class"
    ].astype(str).values

    predictions = {
        model: df[
            f"{model}_prediction"
        ].astype(str).values
        for model in MODELS
    }

    confidences = {}

    for model in MODELS:

        col = get_confidence_column(
            df,
            model
        )

        if col is not None:

            confidences[model] = (
                pd.to_numeric(
                    df[col],
                    errors="coerce"
                )
                .fillna(0.5)
                .clip(0.0, 1.0)
                .values
            )

    print(
        f"Images available: {len(df)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Models: {NUM_MODELS}"
    )

    print(
        f"Confidence columns found: "
        f"{len(confidences)}/{NUM_MODELS}"
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Baseline model performance
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("INDIVIDUAL MODEL PERFORMANCE")
    print("=" * 80)

    model_summary = []

    for model in MODELS:

        pred = predictions[model]

        acc = float(
            (pred == labels).mean()
        )

        print(
            f"{model:<32}"
            f"{acc:.6f}"
        )

        model_summary.append({
            "model": model,
            "accuracy": acc,
        })

    pd.DataFrame(
        model_summary
    ).to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "individual_model_performance.csv",
        index=False
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build reliability statistics
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("BUILDING V3.1 RELIABILITY TABLES")
    print("=" * 80)

    global_reliability = (
        build_global_reliability(
            predictions,
            labels
        )
    )

    class_reliability = (
        build_class_reliability(
            predictions,
            labels
        )
    )

    predicted_class_reliability = (
        build_predicted_class_reliability(
            predictions,
            labels
        )
    )

    confidence_reliability = (
        build_confidence_reliability(
            predictions,
            confidences,
            labels
        )
    )

    class_confidence_reliability = (
        build_class_confidence_reliability(
            predictions,
            confidences,
            labels
        )
    )

    pairwise_reliability = (
        build_pairwise_reliability(
            predictions,
            labels
        )
    )

    print(
        "\nGlobal reliability:"
    )

    for model in MODELS:

        print(
            f"  {model:<28}"
            f"{global_reliability[model]:.6f}"
        )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build V3.1 features
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("BUILDING V3.1 SELECTOR FEATURES")
    print("=" * 80)

    X = build_selector_features(
        df=df,
        reliability=global_reliability,
        class_reliability=class_reliability,
        predicted_class_reliability=predicted_class_reliability,
        confidence_reliability=confidence_reliability,
        class_confidence_reliability=class_confidence_reliability,
        pairwise_reliability=pairwise_reliability,
    )

    print(
        f"Feature matrix shape: {X.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"Number of features: {X.shape[1]}"
    )

    X.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_1_selector_features.csv",
        index=False
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build selector target
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    y = build_training_labels(
        df
    )

    print(
        "\nSelector target distribution:"
    )

    target_counts = Counter(y)

    for model in MODELS:

        print(
            f"  {model:<28}"
            f"{target_counts.get(model, 0)}"
        )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Train Random Forest
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("TRAINING V3.1 RANDOM FOREST SELECTOR")
    print("=" * 80)

    selector = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=N_ESTIMATORS,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        n_jobs=-1,
        class_weight="balanced_subsample",
        max_features="sqrt",
        min_samples_leaf=2,
        max_depth=None,
    )

    selector.fit(
        X,
        y
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Selector trained."
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Training predictions
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    selector_pred = selector.predict(
        X
    )

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("TRAINING PERFORMANCE")
    print("=" * 80)

    training_metrics = print_metrics(
        "v3_1_pairwise_selector",
        y,
        selector_pred
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save model
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    model_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "pairwise_selector_v3_1.joblib"
    )

    import joblib

    joblib.dump(
        selector,
        model_file
    )

    print(
        f"\n[SAVED] {model_file}"
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save feature importance
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    importance = pd.DataFrame({
        "feature": X.columns,
        "importance": selector.feature_importances_,
    }).sort_values(
        "importance",
        ascending=False
    )

    importance.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_1_feature_importance.csv",
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"[SAVED] "
        f"{OUTPUT_DIR / 'v3_1_feature_importance.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        "\nTop 30 features:"
    )

    print(
        importance.head(30).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save reliability summary
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    reliability_rows = []

    for model in MODELS:

        reliability_rows.append({
            "model": model,
            "global_reliability":
                global_reliability[model],
        })

    pd.DataFrame(
        reliability_rows
    ).to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "global_reliability.csv",
        index=False
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save configuration
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    config = {
        "version": "V3.1",
        "random_state": RANDOM_STATE,
        "n_estimators": N_ESTIMATORS,
        "min_pairwise_samples":
            MIN_PAIRWISE_SAMPLES,
        "min_class_samples":
            MIN_CLASS_SAMPLES,
        "models": MODELS,
        "classes": CLASSES,
        "num_features": int(X.shape[1]),
        "num_images": int(len(df)),
        "confidence_bins": CONFIDENCE_BINS,
        "feature_file": str(feature_file),
        "output_directory": str(OUTPUT_DIR),
    }

    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR / "v3_1_config.json",
        "w"
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            config,
            f,
            indent=2
        )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save training summary
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary = {
        "version": "V3.1",
        "images": int(len(df)),
        "features": int(X.shape[1]),
        "training_accuracy":
            training_metrics["accuracy"],
        "training_balanced_accuracy":
            training_metrics["balanced_accuracy"],
        "training_macro_f1":
            training_metrics["macro_f1"],
        "model_file":
            str(model_file),
    }

    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_1_training_summary.json",
        "w"
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            summary,
            f,
            indent=2
        )

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("V3.1 TRAINING COMPLETE")
    print("=" * 80)

    print(
        f"Features:       {X.shape[1]}"
    )

    print(
        f"Images:         {len(df)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Selector model:\n{model_file}"
    )

    print(
        "\nIMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "The training accuracy above is NOT the final evaluation."
    )

    print(
        "Use 5-fold out-of-fold validation before drawing conclusions."
    )

    print(
        "\nNEXT STEP:"
    )

    print(
        "Create/run:"
    )

    print(
        "cross_validate_pairwise_selector_v3_1.py"
    )

    print(
        "and compare V3 vs V3.1 using identical folds."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.2
======================

Purpose
-------
Train and evaluate an improved dynamic model selector using:

    - 6 model predictions
    - confidence
    - entropy
    - prediction agreement
    - confidence relationships
    - pairwise model relationships
    - class-aware reliability
    - pairwise relative confidence
    - disagreement structure

IMPORTANT
---------
This script uses TRUE OOF 5-fold validation.

The selector is NEVER evaluated on the same samples used to train
that fold's selector.

Input:
    Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs/prediction_features.csv

Expected columns:
    true_class

    <model>_prediction
    <model>_confidence
    <model>_entropy
    <model>_margin
    <model>_correct

Output:
    Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs/pairwise_v3_2_cv/

Author:
    ERG_HYBRID / Hybrid_v3
"""

    accuracy_score,

    confusion_matrix,
    f1_score,
)

# ============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("-" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 80)


# ============================================================================
# SAFE NUMERIC HELPERS
# ============================================================================

def safe_numeric(series: pd.Series, default: float = 0.0) -> np.ndarray:
    values = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce").to_numpy(dtype=float)

    values = np.nan_to_num(
        values,
        nan=default,
        posinf=default,
        neginf=default,
    )

    return values


def safe_divide(a, b, default=0.0):
    a = np.asarray(a, dtype=float)
    b = np.asarray(b, dtype=float)

    result = np.full_like(a, default, dtype=float)

    mask = np.abs(b) > 1e-12

    result[mask] = a[mask] / b[mask]

    result = np.nan_to_num(
        result,
        nan=default,
        posinf=default,
        neginf=default,
    )

    return result
