def load_feature_data():
    section("LOADING PREDICTION FEATURES")

    print(f"Script path : {SCRIPT_PATH}")
    print(f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}")
    print(f"Feature file: {FEATURE_FILE}")
    print(f"Exists      : {FEATURE_FILE.exists()}")

    if not FEATURE_FILE.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "\nPrediction feature file not found:\n"
            f"{FEATURE_FILE}\n\n"
            "Expected project structure:\n"
            "Hybrid_v3/\n"
            "  Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/\n"
            "    outputs/\n"
            "      prediction_features.csv"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(FEATURE_FILE)

    print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate target
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "true_class" not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            "\nRequired target column 'true_class' was not found.\n\n"
            f"Available columns:\n{list(df.columns)}"
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate model columns
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("Model columns:")

    prediction_count = 0
    confidence_count = 0
    correct_count = 0

    for model in MODELS:

        pred_col = f"{model}_prediction"
        conf_col = f"{model}_confidence"
        correct_col = f"{model}_correct"

        pred_ok = pred_col in df.columns
        conf_ok = conf_col in df.columns
        correct_ok = correct_col in df.columns

        if pred_ok:
            prediction_count += 1

        if conf_ok:
            confidence_count += 1

        if correct_ok:
            correct_count += 1

        print(
            f"{model:<28}"
            f"prediction={pred_col:<38}"
            f"confidence={conf_col}"
        )

    print()
    print(f"Prediction columns: {prediction_count}/{len(MODELS)}")
    print(f"Confidence columns: {confidence_count}/{len(MODELS)}")
    print(f"Correct columns:    {correct_count}/{len(MODELS)}")

    missing = []

    for model in MODELS:

        for suffix in [
            "_prediction",
            "_confidence",
            "_entropy",
            "_margin",
            "_correct",
        ]:

            col = f"{model}{suffix}"

            if col not in df.columns:
                missing.append(col)

    if missing:
        print()
        print("[WARNING] Missing optional/required columns:")

        for col in missing:
            print("  ", col)

    return df


# ============================================================================
# MODEL PERFORMANCE
# ============================================================================

def calculate_model_performance(df: pd.DataFrame):
    section("INDIVIDUAL MODEL PERFORMANCE")

    results = []

    for model in MODELS:

        correct_col = f"{model}_correct"

        if correct_col not in df.columns:
            continue

        correct = safe_numeric(df[correct_col])

        accuracy = float(correct.mean())

        results.append(
            {
                "model": model,
                "accuracy": accuracy,
            }
        )

        print(f"{model:<28} {accuracy:.6f}")

    return pd.DataFrame(results)


# ============================================================================
# GLOBAL RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def build_global_reliability(df: pd.DataFrame):
    section("GLOBAL MODEL RELIABILITY")

    reliability = {}

    for model in MODELS:

        col = f"{model}_correct"

        if col in df.columns:
            reliability[model] = float(
                safe_numeric(df[col]).mean()
            )
        else:
            reliability[model] = 0.5

        print(
            f"{model:<28} "
            f"{reliability[model]:.6f}"
        )

    return reliability


# ============================================================================
# V3.2 FEATURE ENGINEERING
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_features(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    reliability: dict[str, float],
):
    section("BUILDING V3.2 SELECTOR FEATURES")

    features = {}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Basic model-level features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model in MODELS:

        for suffix in [
            "_confidence",
            "_entropy",
            "_margin",
        ]:

            col = f"{model}{suffix}"

            if col in df.columns:
                features[col] = safe_numeric(
                    df[col]
                )

        # Global reliability
        features[f"{model}_global_reliability"] = np.full(
            len(df),
            reliability.get(model, 0.5),
            dtype=float,
        )

        # Confidence × reliability
        if f"{model}_confidence" in df.columns:

            conf = safe_numeric(
                df[f"{model}_confidence"]
            )

            rel = reliability.get(model, 0.5)

            features[
                f"{model}_confidence_x_reliability"
            ] = conf * rel

            features[
                f"{model}_confidence_relative_to_reliability"
            ] = conf - rel

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence statistics
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    confidence_arrays = []

    for model in MODELS:

        col = f"{model}_confidence"

        if col in df.columns:
            confidence_arrays.append(
                safe_numeric(df[col])
            )

    if confidence_arrays:

        conf_matrix = np.column_stack(
            confidence_arrays
        )

        features["confidence_mean"] = np.mean(
            conf_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

        features["confidence_std"] = np.std(
            conf_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

        features["confidence_max"] = np.max(
            conf_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

        features["confidence_min"] = np.min(
            conf_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

        sorted_conf = np.sort(
            conf_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

        features["confidence_top"] = sorted_conf[:, -1]

        if conf_matrix.shape[1] >= 2:
            features["confidence_second"] = sorted_conf[:, -2]

            features["confidence_margin"] = (
                sorted_conf[:, -1]
                - sorted_conf[:, -2]
            )

        features["confidence_range"] = (
            np.max(conf_matrix, axis=1)
            - np.min(conf_matrix, axis=1)
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prediction structure
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    prediction_columns = [
        f"{model}_prediction"
        for model in MODELS
        if f"{model}_prediction" in df.columns
    ]

    prediction_matrix = df[
        prediction_columns
    ].astype(str).to_numpy()

    features["distinct_predictions"] = np.array(
        [
            len(set(row))
            for row in prediction_matrix
        ],
        dtype=float,
    )

    features["vote_top"] = np.zeros(len(df))
    features["vote_second"] = np.zeros(len(df))
    features["vote_margin"] = np.zeros(len(df))
    features["vote_entropy"] = np.zeros(len(df))
    features["vote_unanimous"] = np.zeros(len(df))

    for i, row in enumerate(prediction_matrix):

        values, counts = np.unique(
            row,
            return_counts=True,
        )

        order = np.argsort(
            counts
        )[::-1]

        sorted_counts = counts[order]

        top = sorted_counts[0]

        second = (
            sorted_counts[1]
            if len(sorted_counts) > 1
            else 0
        )

        features["vote_top"][i] = top

        features["vote_second"][i] = second

        features["vote_margin"][i] = (
            top - second
        )

        features["vote_unanimous"][i] = (
            1.0 if top == len(row) else 0.0
        )

        probabilities = (
            counts / counts.sum()
        )

        entropy = -np.sum(
            probabilities
            * np.log(
                probabilities + 1e-12
            )
        )

        features["vote_entropy"][i] = entropy

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Pairwise features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model_a, model_b in combinations(
        MODELS,
        2,
    ):

        pred_a_col = f"{model_a}_prediction"
        pred_b_col = f"{model_b}_prediction"

        conf_a_col = f"{model_a}_confidence"
        conf_b_col = f"{model_b}_confidence"

        if (
            pred_a_col not in df.columns
            or pred_b_col not in df.columns
        ):
            continue

        pred_a = df[
            pred_a_col
        ].astype(str).to_numpy()

        pred_b = df[
            pred_b_col
        ].astype(str).to_numpy()

        agree = (
            pred_a == pred_b
        ).astype(float)

        prefix = (
            f"pair_{model_a}_{model_b}"
        )

        features[
            f"{prefix}_agree"
        ] = agree

        # Confidence relationship
        if (
            conf_a_col in df.columns
            and conf_b_col in df.columns
        ):

            conf_a = safe_numeric(
                df[conf_a_col]
            )

            conf_b = safe_numeric(
                df[conf_b_col]
            )

            features[
                f"{prefix}_confidence_gap"
            ] = conf_a - conf_b

            features[
                f"{prefix}_confidence_abs_gap"
            ] = np.abs(
                conf_a - conf_b
            )

            features[
                f"{prefix}_confidence_mean"
            ] = (
                conf_a + conf_b
            ) / 2.0

            features[
                f"{prefix}_confidence_max"
            ] = np.maximum(
                conf_a,
                conf_b,
            )

            # Relative confidence
            total = conf_a + conf_b + 1e-8

            features[
                f"{prefix}_rel_a"
            ] = conf_a / total

            features[
                f"{prefix}_rel_b"
            ] = conf_b / total

            features[
                f"{prefix}_rel_gap"
            ] = (
                conf_a - conf_b
            ) / total

            # Weighted reliability
            rel_a = reliability.get(
                model_a,
                0.5,
            )

            rel_b = reliability.get(
                model_b,
                0.5,
            )

            weighted_a = (
                conf_a * rel_a
            )

            weighted_b = (
                conf_b * rel_b
            )

            weighted_total = (
                weighted_a
                + weighted_b
                + 1e-8
            )

            features[
                f"{prefix}_weighted_a"
            ] = (
                weighted_a
                / weighted_total
            )

            features[
                f"{prefix}_weighted_b"
            ] = (
                weighted_b
                / weighted_total
            )

            features[
                f"{prefix}_weighted_gap"
            ] = (
                weighted_a
                - weighted_b
            ) / weighted_total

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Pairwise agreement statistics
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    pair_agreement_columns = [
        key
        for key in features
        if key.startswith("pair_")
        and key.endswith("_agree")
    ]

    if pair_agreement_columns:

        pair_matrix = np.column_stack(
            [
                features[key]
                for key in pair_agreement_columns
            ]
        )

        features[
            "pairwise_agreement_mean"
        ] = np.mean(
            pair_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

        features[
            "pairwise_agreement_std"
        ] = np.std(
            pair_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

        features[
            "pairwise_disagreement_rate"
        ] = 1.0 - np.mean(
            pair_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CNN vs ViT agreement
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    cnn_models = [
        "resnet50",
        "efficientnet_v2_s",
        "efficientnet_b3",
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
    ]

    vit_models = [
        "deit_tiny",
        "swin_tiny",
    ]

    cnn_pred = np.column_stack(
        [
            df[f"{m}_prediction"]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
            for m in cnn_models
        ]
    )

    vit_pred = np.column_stack(
        [
            df[f"{m}_prediction"]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
            for m in vit_models
        ]
    )

    cnn_majority = []

    for row in cnn_pred:

        vals, counts = np.unique(
            row,
            return_counts=True,
        )

        cnn_majority.append(
            vals[np.argmax(counts)]
        )

    vit_majority = []

    for row in vit_pred:

        vals, counts = np.unique(
            row,
            return_counts=True,
        )

        vit_majority.append(
            vals[np.argmax(counts)]
        )

    features["cnn_vit_agreement"] = (
        np.array(cnn_majority)
        == np.array(vit_majority)
    ).astype(float)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Clean feature matrix
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature_df = pd.DataFrame(
        features,
        index=df.index,
    )

    feature_df = feature_df.replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf],
        np.nan,
    )

    feature_df = feature_df.fillna(0.0)

    # Ensure everything numeric
    for col in feature_df.columns:

        feature_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            feature_df[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

    feature_df = feature_df.fillna(0.0)

    print(
        f"Feature matrix shape: {feature_df.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"Number of features: {feature_df.shape[1]}"
    )

    return feature_df


# ============================================================================
# BUILD SELECTOR TARGET
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_target(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    reliability: dict[str, float],
):
    """
    Target = best model for each image.

    If multiple models are correct, choose the model with:

        1. highest global reliability
        2. highest confidence

    This prevents arbitrary selection between equally-correct models.
    """

    section("BUILDING V3.2 SELECTOR TARGET")

    n = len(df)

    target = []

    for i in range(n):

        candidates = []

        for model in MODELS:

            correct_col = f"{model}_correct"

            if correct_col not in df.columns:
                continue

            correct = float(
                pd.to_numeric(
                    df.iloc[i][correct_col],
                    errors="coerce",
                )
            )

            if correct == 1:

                conf_col = (
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                )

                confidence = 0.0

                if conf_col in df.columns:

                    confidence = float(
                        pd.to_numeric(
                            df.iloc[i][conf_col],
                            errors="coerce",
                        )
                    )

                    if not np.isfinite(
                        confidence
                    ):
                        confidence = 0.0

                candidates.append(
                    (
                        model,
                        reliability.get(
                            model,
                            0.5,
                        ),
                        confidence,
                    )
                )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # If at least one model is correct
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        if candidates:

            candidates.sort(
                key=lambda x: (
                    x[1],
                    x[2],
                ),
                reverse=True,
            )

            target.append(
                candidates[0][0]
            )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # All models wrong
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        else:

            # No model can actually rescue this image.
            #
            # For selector training we use the globally strongest model.
            #
            # These cases are excluded from "oracle" improvement analysis.
            best_model = max(
                MODELS,
                key=lambda m: reliability.get(
                    m,
                    0.5,
                ),
            )

            target.append(best_model)

    target = np.array(
        target,
        dtype=str,
    )

    distribution = (
        pd.Series(target)
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("model")
        .reset_index(name="count")
    )

    print(distribution.to_string(index=False))

    return target


# ============================================================================
# BASELINE PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================================

def best_model_prediction(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    reliability: dict[str, float],
):
    """
    Global best model prediction.
    """

    best_model = max(
        MODELS,
        key=lambda m: reliability[m],
    )

    return (
        df[f"{best_model}_prediction"]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy(),
        best_model,
    )


def confidence_winner_prediction(df):
    predictions = []

    for i in range(len(df)):

        best_model = None
        best_conf = -np.inf

        for model in MODELS:

            col = f"{model}_confidence"

            if col not in df.columns:
                continue

            confidence = float(
                pd.to_numeric(
                    df.iloc[i][col],
                    errors="coerce",
                )
            )

            if not np.isfinite(
                confidence
            ):
                confidence = 0.0

            if confidence > best_conf:

                best_conf = confidence
                best_model = model

        if best_model is None:

            best_model = MODELS[0]

        predictions.append(
            str(
                df.iloc[i][
                    f"{best_model}_prediction"
                ]
            )
        )

    return np.array(
        predictions,
        dtype=str,
    )


def majority_vote_prediction(df):

    predictions = []

    for i in range(len(df)):

        row = [
            str(
                df.iloc[i][
                    f"{model}_prediction"
                ]
            )
            for model in MODELS
        ]

        values, counts = np.unique(
            row,
            return_counts=True,
        )

        predictions.append(
            values[np.argmax(counts)]
        )

    return np.array(
        predictions,
        dtype=str,
    )


# ============================================================================
# ORACLE
# ============================================================================

def oracle_prediction(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    reliability: dict[str, float],
):

    predictions = []

    for i in range(len(df)):

        correct_models = []

        for model in MODELS:

            correct_col = (
                f"{model}_correct"
            )

            if correct_col not in df.columns:
                continue

            correct = float(
                pd.to_numeric(
                    df.iloc[i][correct_col],
                    errors="coerce",
                )
            )

            if correct == 1:

                confidence = 0.0

                conf_col = (
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                )

                if conf_col in df.columns:

                    confidence = float(
                        pd.to_numeric(
                            df.iloc[i][conf_col],
                            errors="coerce",
                        )
                    )

                    if not np.isfinite(
                        confidence
                    ):
                        confidence = 0.0

                correct_models.append(
                    (
                        model,
                        reliability.get(
                            model,
                            0.5,
                        ),
                        confidence,
                    )
                )

        if correct_models:

            correct_models.sort(
                key=lambda x: (
                    x[1],
                    x[2],
                ),
                reverse=True,
            )

            selected_model = (
                correct_models[0][0]
            )

        else:

            selected_model = max(
                MODELS,
                key=lambda m: reliability.get(
                    m,
                    0.5,
                ),
            )

        predictions.append(
            str(
                df.iloc[i][
                    f"{selected_model}_prediction"
                ]
            )
        )

    return np.array(
        predictions,
        dtype=str,
    )


# ============================================================================
# SELECTOR PREDICTION
# ============================================================================

def selector_predictions(
    selector,
    X,
    df,
):

    selected_models = selector.predict(
        X
    )

    predictions = []

    for i, model in enumerate(
        selected_models
    ):

        pred_col = (
            f"{model}_prediction"
        )

        if pred_col not in df.columns:

            # Safety fallback
            model = MODELS[0]

            pred_col = (
                f"{model}_prediction"
            )

        predictions.append(
            str(
                df.iloc[i][pred_col]
            )
        )

    return (
        np.array(
            predictions,
            dtype=str,
        ),
        np.array(
            selected_models,
            dtype=str,
        ),
    )


# ============================================================================
# METRICS
# ============================================================================

def calculate_metrics(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
):

    return {
        "accuracy": float(
            accuracy_score(
                y_true,
                y_pred,
            )
        ),
        "balanced_accuracy": float(
            balanced_accuracy_score(
                y_true,
                y_pred,
            )
        ),
        "macro_f1": float(
            f1_score(
                y_true,
                y_pred,
                average="macro",
                zero_division=0,
            )
        ),
    }


# ============================================================================
# V3 OOF LOADING
# ============================================================================

def load_existing_v3_oof(df):
    """
    Load existing V3 OOF predictions if available.

    This is ONLY used for comparison.

    V3.2 training does NOT depend on this file.
    """

    section("LOADING EXISTING V3 OOF PREDICTIONS")

    print(
        f"V3 CV directory: {V3_CV_DIR}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3 OOF file    : {V3_CV_FILE}"
    )

    if not V3_CV_FILE.exists():

        print(
            "[INFO] Existing V3 OOF file not found."
        )

        print(
            "V3.2 will continue without V3 OOF comparison."
        )

        return None

    try:

        v3_df = pd.read_csv(
            V3_CV_FILE
        )

    except Exception as exc:

        print(
            "[WARNING] Could not load V3 OOF:"
        )

        print(exc)

        return None

    print(
        f"V3 OOF shape: {v3_df.shape}"
    )

    print(
        "V3 OOF columns:"
    )

    for col in v3_df.columns:
        print(
            f"  {col}"
        )

    return v3_df


# ============================================================================
# STRATIFIED CV
# ============================================================================

def run_cross_validation(
    df,
    X,
    target,
):

    section(
        "5-FOLD STRATIFIED OUT-OF-FOLD VALIDATION"
    )

    y_true = (
        df["true_class"]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    skf = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=N_SPLITS,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    )

    oof_predictions = np.empty(
        len(df),
        dtype=object,
    )

    oof_selected_models = np.empty(
        len(df),
        dtype=object,
    )

    fold_numbers = np.empty(
        len(df),
        dtype=int,
    )

    fold_results = []

    all_rescues = []
    all_regressions = []
    all_oracle_gaps = []
    all_wrong_cases = []

    global_best_model = max(
        MODELS,
        key=lambda m: (
            df[f"{m}_correct"]
            .astype(float)
            .mean()
        ),
    )

    global_best_prediction = (
        df[
            f"{global_best_model}_prediction"
        ]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    oracle_pred = oracle_prediction(
        df,
        {
            model: float(
                df[f"{model}_correct"]
                .astype(float)
                .mean()
            )
            for model in MODELS
        },
    )

    for fold_idx, (
        train_idx,
        test_idx,
    ) in enumerate(
        skf.split(
            X,
            target,
        ),
        start=1,
    ):

        print()
        print(
            f"FOLD {fold_idx}/{N_SPLITS}"
        )

        X_train = X.iloc[
            train_idx
        ]

        X_test = X.iloc[
            test_idx
        ]

        y_train = target[
            train_idx
        ]

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Train fold selector
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        selector = RandomForestClassifier(
            n_estimators=N_ESTIMATORS,
            max_depth=MAX_DEPTH,
            min_samples_leaf=MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF,
            max_features=MAX_FEATURES,
            class_weight=CLASS_WEIGHT,
            random_state=(
                RANDOM_STATE
                + fold_idx
            ),
            n_jobs=N_JOBS,
        )

        selector.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # OOF prediction
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        selected_models = selector.predict(
            X_test
        )

        predictions = []

        for local_i, model in enumerate(
            selected_models
        ):

            global_i = test_idx[
                local_i
            ]

            pred_col = (
                f"{model}_prediction"
            )

            predictions.append(
                str(
                    df.iloc[global_i][
                        pred_col
                    ]
                )
            )

            oof_selected_models[
                global_i
            ] = model

            fold_numbers[
                global_i
            ] = fold_idx

        predictions = np.array(
            predictions,
            dtype=str,
        )

        y_test = y_true[
            test_idx
        ]

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Fold baselines
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        best_pred = (
            global_best_prediction[
                test_idx
            ]
        )

        oracle_fold = (
            oracle_pred[
                test_idx
            ]
        )

        selector_metrics = calculate_metrics(
            y_test,
            predictions,
        )

        best_metrics = calculate_metrics(
            y_test,
            best_pred,
        )

        oracle_metrics = calculate_metrics(
            y_test,
            oracle_fold,
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Rescue / regression analysis
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        selector_correct = (
            predictions == y_test
        )

        best_correct = (
            best_pred == y_test
        )

        oracle_correct = (
            oracle_fold == y_test
        )

        rescue_mask = (
            selector_correct
            & ~best_correct
        )

        regression_mask = (
            ~selector_correct
            & best_correct
        )

        oracle_gap_mask = (
            oracle_correct
            & ~selector_correct
        )

        all_wrong_mask = np.ones(
            len(test_idx),
            dtype=bool,
        )

        for model in MODELS:

            model_pred = (
                df.iloc[test_idx][
                    f"{model}_prediction"
                ]
                .astype(str)
                .to_numpy()
            )

            all_wrong_mask &= (
                model_pred != y_test
            )

        all_wrong_rescue_mask = (
            all_wrong_mask
            & selector_correct
        )

        rescues = int(
            rescue_mask.sum()
        )

        regressions = int(
            regression_mask.sum()
        )

        oracle_gaps = int(
            oracle_gap_mask.sum()
        )

        all_wrong = int(
            all_wrong_mask.sum()
        )

        all_wrong_rescues = int(
            all_wrong_rescue_mask.sum()
        )

        print(
            f"Samples:          {len(test_idx)}"
        )

        print(
            f"V3.2 accuracy:    "
            f"{selector_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Best accuracy:    "
            f"{best_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Oracle accuracy:  "
            f"{oracle_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Rescues:          {rescues}"
        )

        print(
            f"Regressions:      {regressions}"
        )

        print(
            f"Oracle gaps:      {oracle_gaps}"
        )

        print(
            f"All-model wrong:   {all_wrong}"
        )

        print(
            f"All-wrong rescues: "
            f"{all_wrong_rescues}"
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Save indices
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        for local_i, global_i in enumerate(
            test_idx
        ):

            if rescue_mask[local_i]:

                all_rescues.append(
                    global_i
                )

            if regression_mask[local_i]:

                all_regressions.append(
                    global_i
                )

            if oracle_gap_mask[local_i]:

                all_oracle_gaps.append(
                    global_i
                )

            if all_wrong_mask[local_i]:

                all_wrong_cases.append(
                    global_i
                )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Store OOF
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        oof_predictions[
            test_idx
        ] = predictions

        fold_results.append(
            {
                "fold": fold_idx,
                "samples": len(test_idx),

                "v3_2_accuracy":
                    selector_metrics["accuracy"],

                "v3_2_balanced_accuracy":
                    selector_metrics[
                        "balanced_accuracy"
                    ],

                "v3_2_macro_f1":
                    selector_metrics[
                        "macro_f1"
                    ],

                "best_accuracy":
                    best_metrics["accuracy"],

                "best_balanced_accuracy":
                    best_metrics[
                        "balanced_accuracy"
                    ],

                "best_macro_f1":
                    best_metrics[
                        "macro_f1"
                    ],

                "oracle_accuracy":
                    oracle_metrics["accuracy"],

                "oracle_balanced_accuracy":
                    oracle_metrics[
                        "balanced_accuracy"
                    ],

                "oracle_macro_f1":
                    oracle_metrics[
                        "macro_f1"
                    ],

                "rescues": rescues,
                "regressions": regressions,
                "oracle_gap_cases": oracle_gaps,
                "all_models_wrong": all_wrong,
                "all_wrong_rescues":
                    all_wrong_rescues,
            }
        )

    # =========================================================================
    # OVERALL OOF
    # =========================================================================

    section(
        "OVERALL 5-FOLD OOF PERFORMANCE"
    )

    best_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_true,
        global_best_prediction,
    )

    v3_2_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_true,
        oof_predictions.astype(str),
    )

    oracle_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_true,
        oracle_pred,
    )

    print(
        f"Images:                 {len(df)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Best model:             "
        f"{best_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.2:                   "
        f"{v3_2_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle:                 "
        f"{oracle_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Best balanced accuracy: "
        f"{best_metrics['balanced_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.2 balanced accuracy: "
        f"{v3_2_metrics['balanced_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle balanced accuracy:"
        f" {oracle_metrics['balanced_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Best Macro F1:           "
        f"{best_metrics['macro_f1']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.2 Macro F1:           "
        f"{v3_2_metrics['macro_f1']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle Macro F1:         "
        f"{oracle_metrics['macro_f1']:.6f}"
    )

    improvement = (
        v3_2_metrics["accuracy"]
        - best_metrics["accuracy"]
    )

    oracle_headroom = (
        oracle_metrics["accuracy"]
        - best_metrics["accuracy"]
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.2 improvement:       "
        f"{improvement:+.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle headroom:         "
        f"{oracle_headroom:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues:                 "
        f"{len(all_rescues)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Regressions:             "
        f"{len(all_regressions)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle-gap cases:        "
        f"{len(all_oracle_gaps)}"
    )

    print(
        f"All-models-wrong:        "
        f"{len(all_wrong_cases)}"
    )

    # =========================================================================
    # OOF DATAFRAME
    # =========================================================================

    oof_df = df.copy()

    oof_df["fold"] = fold_numbers

    oof_df[
        "v3_2_selected_model"
    ] = oof_selected_models

    oof_df[
        "v3_2_prediction"
    ] = oof_predictions

    oof_df[
        "v3_2_correct"
    ] = (
        oof_df[
            "v3_2_prediction"
        ].astype(str)
        == oof_df[
            "true_class"
        ].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)

    oof_df[
        "best_model"
    ] = global_best_model

    oof_df[
        "best_prediction"
    ] = global_best_prediction

    oof_df[
        "best_correct"
    ] = (
        oof_df[
            "best_prediction"
        ].astype(str)
        == oof_df[
            "true_class"
        ].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)

    oof_df[
        "oracle_prediction"
    ] = oracle_pred

    oof_df[
        "oracle_correct"
    ] = (
        oof_df[
            "oracle_prediction"
        ].astype(str)
        == oof_df[
            "true_class"
        ].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)

    oof_df[
        "rescue"
    ] = (
        (
            oof_df[
                "v3_2_correct"
            ] == 1
        )
        & (
            oof_df[
                "best_correct"
            ] == 0
        )
    ).astype(int)

    oof_df[
        "regression"
    ] = (
        (
            oof_df[
                "v3_2_correct"
            ] == 0
        )
        & (
            oof_df[
                "best_correct"
            ] == 1
        )
    ).astype(int)

    oof_df[
        "oracle_gap"
    ] = (
        (
            oof_df[
                "oracle_correct"
            ] == 1
        )
        & (
            oof_df[
                "v3_2_correct"
            ] == 0
        )
    ).astype(int)

    # =========================================================================
    # RETURN
    # =========================================================================

    return (
        oof_df,
        pd.DataFrame(fold_results),
        {
            "accuracy": v3_2_metrics[
                "accuracy"
            ],
            "balanced_accuracy":
                v3_2_metrics[
                    "balanced_accuracy"
                ],
            "macro_f1":
                v3_2_metrics[
                    "macro_f1"
                ],
            "best_accuracy":
                best_metrics[
                    "accuracy"
                ],
            "best_balanced_accuracy":
                best_metrics[
                    "balanced_accuracy"
                ],
            "best_macro_f1":
                best_metrics[
                    "macro_f1"
                ],
            "oracle_accuracy":
                oracle_metrics[
                    "accuracy"
                ],
            "oracle_balanced_accuracy":
                oracle_metrics[
                    "balanced_accuracy"
                ],
            "oracle_macro_f1":
                oracle_metrics[
                    "macro_f1"
                ],
            "improvement":
                improvement,
            "oracle_headroom":
                oracle_headroom,
            "rescues":
                len(all_rescues),
            "regressions":
                len(all_regressions),
            "oracle_gap_cases":
                len(all_oracle_gaps),
            "all_models_wrong":
                len(all_wrong_cases),
        },
    )


# ============================================================================
# MODEL SELECTION ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

def analyze_model_selection(
    oof_df: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "V3.2 MODEL SELECTION ANALYSIS"
    )

    rows = []

    for model in MODELS:

        selected = (
            oof_df[
                "v3_2_selected_model"
            ] == model
        )

        count = int(
            selected.sum()
        )

        if count > 0:

            selected_correct = int(
                oof_df.loc[
                    selected,
                    "v3_2_correct",
                ].sum()
            )

            accuracy = (
                selected_correct
                / count
            )

        else:

            selected_correct = 0
            accuracy = 0.0

        rows.append(
            {
                "model": model,
                "selected": count,
                "selection_rate":
                    count / len(oof_df),
                "selected_correct":
                    selected_correct,
                "selection_accuracy":
                    accuracy,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# CLASS-WISE PERFORMANCE
# ============================================================================

def class_wise_analysis(
    oof_df: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "CLASS-WISE PERFORMANCE"
    )

    rows = []

    for cls in sorted(
        oof_df[
            "true_class"
        ].astype(str).unique()
    ):

        subset = oof_df[
            oof_df[
                "true_class"
            ].astype(str)
            == cls
        ]

        best_acc = float(
            subset[
                "best_correct"
            ].mean()
        )

        v3_2_acc = float(
            subset[
                "v3_2_correct"
            ].mean()
        )

        oracle_acc = float(
            subset[
                "oracle_correct"
            ].mean()
        )

        rescues = int(
            subset[
                "rescue"
            ].sum()
        )

        regressions = int(
            subset[
                "regression"
            ].sum()
        )

        oracle_gaps = int(
            subset[
                "oracle_gap"
            ].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "true_class": cls,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "best_accuracy":
                    best_acc,
                "v3_2_accuracy":
                    v3_2_acc,
                "oracle_accuracy":
                    oracle_acc,
                "v3_2_delta":
                    v3_2_acc - best_acc,
                "oracle_gap":
                    oracle_acc - v3_2_acc,
                "rescues":
                    rescues,
                "regressions":
                    regressions,
                "oracle_gap_cases":
                    oracle_gaps,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# TRANSITION MATRIX
# ============================================================================

def transition_analysis(
    oof_df: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "BEST MODEL → V3.2 PREDICTION TRANSITIONS"
    )

    matrix = pd.crosstab(
        oof_df[
            "best_prediction"
        ],
        oof_df[
            "v3_2_prediction"
        ],
        rownames=[
            "best_model_prediction"
        ],
        colnames=[
            "v3_2_prediction"
        ],
    )

    print(
        matrix.to_string()
    )

    return matrix


# ============================================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# ============================================================================

def train_full_selector(
    X,
    target,
):

    section(
        "TRAINING FINAL V3.2 SELECTOR"
    )

    selector = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=N_ESTIMATORS,
        max_depth=MAX_DEPTH,
        min_samples_leaf=MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF,
        max_features=MAX_FEATURES,
        class_weight=CLASS_WEIGHT,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        n_jobs=N_JOBS,
    )

    selector.fit(
        X,
        target,
    )

    print(
        "[OK] Final selector trained."
    )

    return selector


def save_feature_importance(
    selector,
    feature_names,
):

    importance = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "feature":
                feature_names,
            "importance":
                selector.feature_importances_,
        }
    )

    importance = (
        importance
        .sort_values(
            "importance",
            ascending=False,
        )
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    importance.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_2_feature_importance.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Top 30 features:"
    )

    print(
        importance.head(30)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    return importance


# ============================================================================
# ERROR TABLES
# ============================================================================

def save_error_tables(
    oof_df: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "CREATING V3.2 ERROR TABLES"
    )

    rescue_cases = oof_df[
        oof_df[
            "rescue"
        ] == 1
    ].copy()

    regression_cases = oof_df[
        oof_df[
            "regression"
        ] == 1
    ].copy()

    oracle_gap_cases = oof_df[
        oof_df[
            "oracle_gap"
        ] == 1
    ].copy()

    all_wrong = []

    for idx, row in oof_df.iterrows():

        wrong = True

        for model in MODELS:

            correct_col = (
                f"{model}_correct"
            )

            if (
                correct_col in row
                and int(
                    pd.to_numeric(
                        row[
                            correct_col
                        ],
                        errors="coerce",
                    )
                )
                == 1
            ):
                wrong = False
                break

        if wrong:
            all_wrong.append(idx)

    all_wrong_cases = oof_df.loc[
        all_wrong
    ].copy()

    nontrivial_mask = (
        (oof_df["rescue"] == 1)
        | (oof_df["regression"] == 1)
        | (oof_df["oracle_gap"] == 1)
    )

    nontrivial = oof_df[
        nontrivial_mask
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Non-trivial cases: {len(nontrivial)}"
    )

    rescue_cases.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rescued_cases.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    regression_cases.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "regression_cases.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    oracle_gap_cases.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "oracle_gap_cases.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    all_wrong_cases.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "all_models_wrong_cases.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    nontrivial.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_2_oof_deep_error_cases.csv",
        index=False,
    )

        "best_balanced_accuracy":
            metrics[

            ],

        "best_macro_f1":
            metrics[
                "best_macro_f1"
            ],

        "v3_2_accuracy":
            metrics[
                "accuracy"
            ],

        "v3_2_balanced_accuracy":
            metrics[
                "balanced_accuracy"
            ],

        "v3_2_macro_f1":
            metrics[
                "macro_f1"
            ],

        "oracle_accuracy":
            metrics[
                "oracle_accuracy"
            ],

        "oracle_balanced_accuracy":
            metrics[
                "oracle_balanced_accuracy"
            ],

        "oracle_macro_f1":
            metrics[

            ],

        "v3_2_improvement":
            metrics[

            ],

        "oracle_headroom":

# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.2 — 5-FOLD CV"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Directories
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = load_feature_data()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Individual performance
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    calculate_model_performance(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Global reliability
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    reliability = (
        build_global_reliability(
            df
        )
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    X = build_selector_features(
        df,
        reliability,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build target
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    target = build_selector_target(
        df,
        reliability,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Existing V3
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    load_existing_v3_oof(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CV
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        oof_df,
        fold_df,
        metrics,
    ) = run_cross_validation(
        df,
        X,
        target,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save OOF
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    oof_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "all_oof_predictions.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    fold_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "fold_summary.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    overall = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "method":
                    "best_model",
                "accuracy":
                    metrics[
                        "best_accuracy"
                    ],
                "balanced_accuracy":
                    metrics[
                        "best_balanced_accuracy"
                    ],
                "macro_f1":
                    metrics[
                        "best_macro_f1"
                    ],
            },
            {
                "method":
                    "v3_2",
                "accuracy":
                    metrics[
                        "accuracy"
                    ],
                "balanced_accuracy":
                    metrics[
                        "balanced_accuracy"
                    ],
                "macro_f1":
                    metrics[
                        "macro_f1"
                    ],
            },
            {
                "method":
                    "oracle",
                "accuracy":
                    metrics[
                        "oracle_accuracy"
                    ],
                "balanced_accuracy":
                    metrics[
                        "oracle_balanced_accuracy"
                    ],
                "macro_f1":
                    metrics[
                        "oracle_macro_f1"
                    ],
            },
        ]
    )

    overall.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "overall_oof_performance.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Case distribution
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    case_distribution = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "case":
                    "rescues",
                "count":
                    metrics["rescues"],
            },
            {
                "case":
                    "regressions",
                "count":
                    metrics["regressions"],
            },
            {
                "case":
                    "oracle_gap_cases",
                "count":
                    metrics[
                        "oracle_gap_cases"
                    ],
            },
            {
                "case":
                    "all_models_wrong",
                "count":
                    metrics[
                        "all_models_wrong"
                    ],
            },
        ]
    )

    case_distribution.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "case_distribution.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Model selection
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    selection_df = (
        analyze_model_selection(
            oof_df
        )
    )

    selection_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "model_selection_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Class-wise
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    class_df = (
        class_wise_analysis(
            oof_df
        )
    )

    class_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "class_wise_performance.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition matrix
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    transition_df = (
        transition_analysis(
            oof_df
        )
    )

    transition_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "prediction_transition_matrix.csv"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Error tables
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_error_tables(
        oof_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Train final selector
    #
    # This model is trained on ALL data and should ONLY be used for
    # deployment/inference after CV has been completed.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    final_selector = (
        train_full_selector(
            X,
            target,
        )
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save model
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    model_path = (
        MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "pairwise_selector_v3_2.joblib"
    )

    joblib.dump(
        final_selector,
        model_path,
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"[SAVED] {model_path}"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save feature names
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature_config = {
        "version":
            "v3.2",

        "feature_count":
            int(X.shape[1]),

        "features":
            list(X.columns),

        "models":
            MODELS,

        "random_state":
            RANDOM_STATE,

        "n_splits":
            N_SPLITS,

        "n_estimators":
            N_ESTIMATORS,

        "target":
            "best_correct_model",

        "input_feature_file":
            str(FEATURE_FILE),
    }

    with open(
        MODEL_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "pairwise_selector_v3_2_feature_config.json",
        "w",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            feature_config,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature importance
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    importance = (
        save_feature_importance(
            final_selector,
            X.columns,
        )
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save summary
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary = save_summary(
        metrics,
        df,
        X,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Print final summary
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "FINAL V3.2 5-FOLD CV SUMMARY"
    )

    print(
        json.dumps(
            summary,
            indent=2,
        )
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"[SAVED] {OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "=" * 80
    )

    print(
        "V3.2 5-FOLD OOF VALIDATION COMPLETE"
    )

    print(
        "=" * 80
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Most important files:"
    )

    print(
        "  final_v3_2_cv_summary.json"
    )

    print(
        "  overall_oof_performance.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  fold_summary.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  all_oof_predictions.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  case_distribution.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  rescued_cases.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  regression_cases.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  oracle_gap_cases.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  all_models_wrong_cases.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  model_selection_analysis.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  class_wise_performance.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  prediction_transition_matrix.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  v3_2_oof_deep_error_cases.csv"
    )

    print(
        "  v3_2_feature_importance.csv"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Final model:"
    )

    print(
        f"  {model_path}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "  The V3.2 numbers above are 5-fold OOF numbers."
    )

    print(
        "  Do NOT use the final full-data model's training accuracy"
    )

    print(
        "  as the performance estimate."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ============================================================================
# PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.3
#
# Improvements over V3.2:
#
# 1. Class-aware reliability
# 2. Less biased target generation
# 3. Better pairwise competition
# 4. Confidence + margin based winner features
#
# Dataset:
# ISIC 2019
#
# ============================================================================


from pathlib import Path
from itertools import combinations

import json
import random

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    f1_score,
)

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

import joblib



# ============================================================================
# RANDOM SEED
# ============================================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
random.seed(SEED)



# ============================================================================
# MODELS
# ============================================================================


MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]



# ============================================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================================


SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()

PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_PATH.parents[2]


PHASE4_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
)


FEATURE_FILE = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "prediction_features_v2.csv"
)


OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_3_cv"
)


MODEL_DIR = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "models"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_3"
)



OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)


MODEL_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)



# ============================================================================
# PRINT HELPERS
# ============================================================================


def section(title):

    print()
    print("="*80)
    print(title)
    print("="*80)



def subsection(title):

    print()
    print("-"*80)
    print(title)
    print("-"*80)



# ============================================================================
# SAFE NUMERIC
# ============================================================================


def safe_numeric(
    series,
    default=0.0
):

    values = pd.to_numeric(
        series,
        errors="coerce"
    ).to_numpy(
        dtype=float
    )


    values = np.nan_to_num(
        values,
        nan=default,
        posinf=default,
        neginf=default
    )


    return values




# ============================================================================
# LOAD FEATURES
# ============================================================================


def load_features():

    section(
        "LOADING PREDICTION FEATURES"
    )


    print(
        "Feature file:",
        FEATURE_FILE
    )


    if not FEATURE_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            FEATURE_FILE
        )


    df = pd.read_csv(
        FEATURE_FILE
    )


    print(
        "Shape:",
        df.shape
    )


    required = [
        "true_class"
    ]


    for model in MODELS:

        required += [

            f"{model}_prediction",

            f"{model}_confidence",

            f"{model}_correct",

            f"{model}_entropy",

            f"{model}_margin_top1_top2",

        ]


    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]


    if missing:

        print(
            "Missing columns:"
        )

        for m in missing:
            print(m)

        raise ValueError(
            "Feature file incomplete"
        )


    print(
        "All required columns available"
    )


    return df




# ============================================================================
# GLOBAL RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================


def build_global_reliability(df):

    section(
        "GLOBAL RELIABILITY"
    )


    reliability = {}


    for model in MODELS:


        acc = (
            df[f"{model}_correct"]
            .mean()
        )


        reliability[model] = float(
            acc
        )


        print(
            f"{model:<30}",
            f"{acc:.5f}"
        )


    return reliability




# ============================================================================
# CLASS AWARE RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================


def build_class_reliability(df):

    section(
        "CLASS AWARE RELIABILITY"
    )


    classes = sorted(
        df.true_class.unique()
    )


    class_reliability = {}



    for cls in classes:


        class_reliability[cls] = {}


        subset = df[
            df.true_class == cls
        ]


        print()

        print(
            "CLASS:",
            cls
        )


        for model in MODELS:


            acc = (
                subset[
                    f"{model}_correct"
                ]
                .mean()
            )


            class_reliability[cls][model] = float(
                acc
            )


            print(
                f"{model:<30}",
                f"{acc:.5f}"
            )



    return class_reliability




# ============================================================================
# START
# ============================================================================


def main():


    section(
        "PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.3"
    )


    df = load_features()


    global_reliability = (
        build_global_reliability(df)
    )


    class_reliability = (
        build_class_reliability(df)
    )


    print()

    print(
        "Loaded samples:",
        len(df)
    )


    return (
        df,
        global_reliability,
        class_reliability
    )

# ============================================================================
# V3.3 FEATURE ENGINEERING
# ============================================================================


def build_selector_features(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability,
):

    section(
        "BUILDING V3.3 SELECTOR FEATURES"
    )


    features = {}

    n = len(df)


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL LEVEL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model in MODELS:


        base_features = [

            "_confidence",

            "_entropy",

            "_margin_top1_top2",

            "_margin_top1_top3",

            "_margin_top2_top3",

            "_relative_margin",

        ]


        for suffix in base_features:


            col = (
                f"{model}{suffix}"
            )


            if col in df.columns:

                features[col] = safe_numeric(
                    df[col]
                )



        # Global reliability

        features[
            f"{model}_global_reliability"
        ] = np.full(
            n,
            global_reliability[model]
        )



        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # CLASS CONDITIONED RELIABILITY
        # ------------------------------------------------------------


        predicted_class = (
            df[
                f"{model}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
        )


        class_scores = np.array(

            [

                class_reliability

                .get(
                    cls,
                    {}
                )

                .get(
                    model,
                    0.5
                )

                for cls in predicted_class

            ],

            dtype=float

        )


        features[
            f"{model}_class_reliability"
        ] = class_scores



        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE
        # ------------------------------------------------------------


        confidence = safe_numeric(

            df[
                f"{model}_confidence"
            ]

        )


        features[
            f"{model}_adjusted_confidence"
        ] = (

            confidence
            *
            class_scores

        )



        features[
            f"{model}_confidence_class_gap"
        ] = (

            confidence
            -
            class_scores

        )




    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CONFIDENCE RANKING
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    confidence_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            safe_numeric(
                df[
                    f"{m}_confidence"
                ]
            )

            for m in MODELS

        ]

    )


    ranks = np.argsort(
        np.argsort(
            -confidence_matrix,
            axis=1
        ),
        axis=1
    )



    for idx,model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            f"{model}_confidence_rank"
        ] = ranks[:,idx]




    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE RANK
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    adjusted_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            features[
                f"{m}_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            for m in MODELS

        ]

    )


    adjusted_rank = np.argsort(

        np.argsort(

            -adjusted_matrix,
            axis=1

        ),

        axis=1

    )


    for idx,model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            f"{model}_adjusted_rank"
        ] = adjusted_rank[:,idx]





    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # VOTING FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    prediction_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            df[
                f"{m}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .values

            for m in MODELS

        ]

    )



    features[
        "unique_prediction_count"
    ] = np.array(

        [

            len(set(row))

            for row in prediction_matrix

        ],

        dtype=float

    )



    features[
        "agreement_ratio"
    ] = np.array(

        [

            max(

                np.unique(
                    row,
                    return_counts=True
                )[1]

            )

            /
            len(row)


            for row in prediction_matrix


        ],

        dtype=float

    )




    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # PAIRWISE FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    pair_agreements=[]



    for a,b in combinations(
        MODELS,
        2
    ):


        pred_a = (
            df[
                f"{a}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .values
        )


        pred_b = (
            df[
                f"{b}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .values
        )


        agree = (
            pred_a == pred_b
        ).astype(float)



        prefix = (
            f"pair_{a}_{b}"
        )


        features[
            f"{prefix}_agree"
        ] = agree



        pair_agreements.append(
            agree
        )


        conf_a = safe_numeric(
            df[
                f"{a}_confidence"
            ]
        )


        conf_b = safe_numeric(
            df[
                f"{b}_confidence"
            ]
        )


        features[
            f"{prefix}_confidence_gap"
        ] = (

            conf_a-conf_b

        )


        features[
            f"{prefix}_adjusted_gap"
        ] = (

            features[
                f"{a}_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            -

            features[
                f"{b}_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

        )



    pair_matrix=np.column_stack(
        pair_agreements
    )


    features[
        "pairwise_agreement_mean"
    ] = pair_matrix.mean(axis=1)



    features[
        "pairwise_agreement_std"
    ] = pair_matrix.std(axis=1)



    feature_df = pd.DataFrame(
        features
    )



    feature_df = (

        feature_df
        .replace(
            [np.inf,-np.inf],
            np.nan
        )
        .fillna(0)

    )


    print(
        "Feature matrix:",
        feature_df.shape
    )


    return feature_df





# ============================================================================
# V3.3 TARGET GENERATION
# ============================================================================


def build_selector_target(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability,
):


    section(
        "BUILDING V3.3 TARGET"
    )



    targets=[]



    for idx,row in df.iterrows():


        candidates=[]


        true_class=row["true_class"]



        for model in MODELS:


            if row[
                f"{model}_correct"
            ] != 1:

                continue



            confidence=float(
                row[
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                ]
            )



            class_score = (

                class_reliability

                .get(
                    true_class,
                    {}
                )

                .get(
                    model,
                    0.5
                )

            )



            score=(

                0.6*class_score

                +

                0.3*confidence

                +

                0.1*
                global_reliability[model]

            )



            candidates.append(

                (
                    model,
                    score

                )

            )



        if len(candidates)>0:


            candidates.sort(

                key=lambda x:x[1],

                reverse=True

            )


            targets.append(
                candidates[0][0]
            )


        else:


            # all models wrong

            best=max(

                MODELS,

                key=lambda m:
                global_reliability[m]

            )


            targets.append(
                best
            )



    return np.array(
        targets
    )

# ============================================================================
# V3.3 CLASS AWARE RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def build_class_reliability(df):

    section(
        "BUILDING CLASS AWARE RELIABILITY"
    )

    class_reliability = {}

    classes = sorted(
        df["true_class"]
        .unique()
    )

    for cls in classes:

        class_reliability[cls] = {}

        subset = df[
            df.true_class == cls
        ]

        for model in MODELS:

            col = f"{model}_correct"

            if col in subset.columns:

                score = float(
                    subset[col]
                    .mean()
                )

            else:
                score = 0.5


            class_reliability[cls][model] = score


    for cls in classes:

        print("\n", cls)

        ranked = sorted(
            class_reliability[cls].items(),
            key=lambda x:x[1],
            reverse=True
        )

        for m,s in ranked:

            print(
                f"{m:<25} {s:.3f}"
            )


    return class_reliability



# ============================================================================
# V3.3 TARGET BUILDER
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_target_v33(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    section(
        "BUILDING V3.3 TARGET"
    )


    targets=[]


    for idx,row in df.iterrows():


        cls=row["true_class"]


        candidates=[]


        for model in MODELS:


            correct=row[
                f"{model}_correct"
            ]


            if correct==1:


                class_score = (
                    class_reliability
                    [cls]
                    .get(
                        model,
                        0.5
                    )
                )


                conf=row[
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                ]


                score = (
                    0.7*class_score
                    +
                    0.3*conf
                )


                candidates.append(
                    (
                        model,
                        score
                    )
                )


        if candidates:


            candidates.sort(
                key=lambda x:x[1],
                reverse=True
            )

            targets.append(
                candidates[0][0]
            )


        else:


            # fallback

            best=max(
                MODELS,
                key=lambda m:
                global_reliability[m]
            )


            targets.append(
                best
            )


    return np.array(targets)




if __name__ == "__main__":


    df, global_reliability, class_reliability = main()


    X = build_selector_features(
        df,
        global_reliability,
        class_reliability
    )


    y = build_selector_target_v33(
        df,
        global_reliability,
        class_reliability
    )


    print()

    section(
        "TARGET DISTRIBUTION"
    )


    print(
        pd.Series(y)
        .value_counts()
    )



    section(
        "STARTING 5-FOLD CV"
    )


    skf = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=5,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=SEED
    )


    oof_predictions=[]


    fold_results=[]



    for fold,(train_idx,val_idx) in enumerate(
        skf.split(X,y),
        1
    ):


        print()

        print(
            "="*60
        )

        print(
            f"FOLD {fold}/5"
        )


        X_train=X.iloc[train_idx]

        X_val=X.iloc[val_idx]


        y_train=y[train_idx]

        y_val=y[val_idx]



        model=RandomForestClassifier(

            n_estimators=500,

            max_depth=12,

            min_samples_leaf=3,

            class_weight="balanced",

            random_state=SEED,

            n_jobs=-1

        )



        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train
        )


        pred=model.predict(
            X_val
        )


        acc=accuracy_score(
            y_val,
            pred
        )


        print(
            "Accuracy:",
            acc
        )


        fold_results.append(
            {
                "fold":fold,
                "accuracy":acc
            }
        )


        for idx,p in zip(
            val_idx,
            pred
        ):

            oof_predictions.append(
                {
                    "index":idx,
                    "true_selector":y[idx],
                    "pred_selector":p
                }
            )



    section(
        "V3.3 CV SUMMARY"
    )


    fold_df=pd.DataFrame(
        fold_results
    )


    print(
        fold_df
    )


    print()

    print(
        "Mean accuracy:",
        fold_df.accuracy.mean()
    )



    oof_df=pd.DataFrame(
        oof_predictions
    )


    oof_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "v3_3_oof_predictions.csv",
        index=False
    )


    fold_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "fold_results.csv",
        index=False
    )



    section(
        "TRAINING FINAL V3.3 SELECTOR"
    )


    final_model=RandomForestClassifier(

        n_estimators=500,

        max_depth=12,

        min_samples_leaf=3,

        class_weight="balanced",

        random_state=SEED,

        n_jobs=-1

    )


    final_model.fit(
        X,
        y
    )


    joblib.dump(
        final_model,
        MODEL_DIR /
        "pairwise_selector_v3_3.joblib"
    )


    print(
        "Saved:",
        MODEL_DIR /
        "pairwise_selector_v3_3.joblib"
    )



    importance=pd.DataFrame(

        {
            "feature":X.columns,
            "importance":final_model.feature_importances_
        }

    ).sort_values(
        "importance",
        ascending=False
    )


    importance.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "v3_3_feature_importance.csv",
        index=False
    )


    print()

    print(
        importance.head(30)
    )
