# ============================================================================
# EVALUATE PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.3
#
# Fixed Evaluation Script
#
# Matches:
# train_pairwise_selector_v3_3.py
#
# ============================================================================


from pathlib import Path
from itertools import combinations

import json
import random

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

import joblib


from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    f1_score,
)



# ============================================================================
# RANDOM SEED
# ============================================================================


SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
random.seed(SEED)



# ============================================================================
# MODELS
# ============================================================================


MODELS = [

    "resnet50",

    "efficientnet_v2_s",

    "efficientnet_b3",

    "mobilenet_v3_large",

    "deit_tiny",

    "swin_tiny",

]



# ============================================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================================


SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()


PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_PATH.parents[2]


PHASE4_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
)



FEATURE_FILE = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "prediction_features_v2.csv"
)



MODEL_FILE = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "models"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_3"
    /
    "pairwise_selector_v3_3.joblib"
)



FEATURE_COLUMN_FILE = (

    PHASE4_DIR

    /

    "outputs"

    /

    "pairwise_v3_3_cv"

    /

    "v3_3_feature_columns.json"

)



OUTPUT_DIR = (

    PHASE4_DIR

    /

    "outputs"

    /

    "pairwise_v3_3_eval"

)


OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)




# ============================================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================================


def section(title):

    print()

    print("="*80)

    print(title)

    print("="*80)



def safe_numeric(series):

    return (

        pd.to_numeric(
            series,
            errors="coerce"
        )

        .fillna(0)

        .to_numpy(
            dtype=float
        )

    )



# ============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================


def load_data():

    section(
        "LOADING FEATURES"
    )


    print(
        FEATURE_FILE
    )


    df = pd.read_csv(
        FEATURE_FILE
    )


    print(
        "Shape:",
        df.shape
    )


    return df



# ============================================================================
# GLOBAL RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================


def build_global_reliability(df):


    reliability={}


    section(
        "GLOBAL RELIABILITY"
    )


    for model in MODELS:


        score=float(

            df[
                f"{model}_correct"
            ]

            .mean()

        )


        reliability[model]=score


        print(
            f"{model:<30}",
            f"{score:.5f}"
        )


    return reliability



# ============================================================================
# CLASS RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================


def build_class_reliability(df):


    section(
        "CLASS RELIABILITY"
    )


    class_rel={}


    classes=sorted(
        df.true_class.unique()
    )


    for cls in classes:


        class_rel[cls]={}


        subset=df[
            df.true_class==cls
        ]


        print()

        print(
            cls
        )


        for model in MODELS:


            value=float(

                subset[
                    f"{model}_correct"
                ]

                .mean()

            )


            class_rel[cls][model]=value


            print(
                f"{model:<30}",
                f"{value:.3f}"
            )


    return class_rel

# ============================================================================
# V3.3 FEATURE ENGINEERING
# EXACT MATCH WITH TRAINING
# ============================================================================


def build_selector_features(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability,
):


    section(
        "BUILDING V3.3 FEATURES"
    )


    features={}

    n=len(df)



    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    for model in MODELS:


        for suffix in [

            "_confidence",

            "_entropy",

            "_margin_top1_top2",

            "_margin_top1_top3",

            "_margin_top2_top3",

            "_relative_margin",

        ]:


            col=model+suffix


            if col in df.columns:


                features[col]=safe_numeric(
                    df[col]
                )




        # Global reliability

        features[

            f"{model}_global_reliability"

        ] = np.full(

            n,

            global_reliability[model],

            dtype=float

        )




        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # CLASS AWARE RELIABILITY
        # ------------------------------------------------------------


        predicted_classes=(

            df[
                f"{model}_prediction"
            ]

            .astype(str)

            .to_numpy()

        )



        class_scores=np.array(

            [

                class_reliability

                .get(
                    cls,
                    {}
                )

                .get(
                    model,
                    0.5
                )


                for cls in predicted_classes


            ],

            dtype=float

        )



        features[

            f"{model}_class_reliability"

        ] = class_scores





        confidence=safe_numeric(

            df[
                f"{model}_confidence"
            ]

        )



        features[

            f"{model}_adjusted_confidence"

        ] = (

            confidence

            *

            class_scores

        )



        features[

            f"{model}_confidence_class_gap"

        ] = (

            confidence

            -

            class_scores

        )




    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CONFIDENCE RANK
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    confidence_matrix=np.column_stack(

        [

            safe_numeric(

                df[
                    f"{m}_confidence"
                ]

            )

            for m in MODELS


        ]

    )



    ranks=np.argsort(

        np.argsort(

            -confidence_matrix,

            axis=1

        ),

        axis=1

    )



    for i,m in enumerate(MODELS):


        features[

            f"{m}_confidence_rank"

        ]=ranks[:,i]





    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE RANK
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    adjusted_matrix=np.column_stack(

        [

            features[

                f"{m}_adjusted_confidence"

            ]

            for m in MODELS


        ]

    )



    adjusted_rank=np.argsort(

        np.argsort(

            -adjusted_matrix,

            axis=1

        ),

        axis=1

    )



    for i,m in enumerate(MODELS):


        features[

            f"{m}_adjusted_rank"

        ]=adjusted_rank[:,i]





    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # VOTING FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    prediction_matrix=np.column_stack(

        [

            df[

                f"{m}_prediction"

            ]

            .astype(str)

            .values


            for m in MODELS


        ]

    )



    features[

        "unique_prediction_count"

    ]=np.array(

        [

            len(set(row))

            for row in prediction_matrix


        ],

        dtype=float

    )



    features[

        "agreement_ratio"

    ]=np.array(

        [

            max(

                np.unique(

                    row,

                    return_counts=True

                )[1]

            )

            /

            len(row)


            for row in prediction_matrix


        ],

        dtype=float

    )



    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # PAIRWISE FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    pair_agreements=[]


    for a,b in combinations(

        MODELS,

        2

    ):



        pred_a=(

            df[
                f"{a}_prediction"
            ]

            .astype(str)

            .values

        )


        pred_b=(

            df[
                f"{b}_prediction"
            ]

            .astype(str)

            .values

        )



        agree=(

            pred_a==pred_b

        ).astype(float)



        prefix=f"pair_{a}_{b}"



        features[

            f"{prefix}_agree"

        ]=agree



        pair_agreements.append(
            agree
        )



        conf_a=safe_numeric(

            df[
                f"{a}_confidence"
            ]

        )


        conf_b=safe_numeric(

            df[
                f"{b}_confidence"
            ]

        )



        features[

            f"{prefix}_confidence_gap"

        ]=(

            conf_a-conf_b

        )



        features[

            f"{prefix}_adjusted_gap"

        ]=(

            features[
                f"{a}_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            -

            features[
                f"{b}_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

        )



    pair_matrix=np.column_stack(

        pair_agreements

    )


    features[

        "pairwise_agreement_mean"

    ]=pair_matrix.mean(
        axis=1
    )



    features[

        "pairwise_agreement_std"

    ]=pair_matrix.std(
        axis=1
    )



    feature_df=pd.DataFrame(
        features
    )



    feature_df=(

        feature_df

        .replace(
            [np.inf,-np.inf],
            np.nan
        )

        .fillna(0)

    )



    print(
        "Generated features:",
        feature_df.shape
    )


    return feature_df

# ============================================================================
# FEATURE ALIGNMENT
# MATCH TRAINING EXACTLY
# ============================================================================


def align_features(
    X
):


    section(
        "ALIGNING FEATURES"
    )


    with open(
        FEATURE_COLUMN_FILE,
        "r"
    ) as f:

        training_columns=json.load(f)



    print(
        "Training features:",
        len(training_columns)
    )


    print(
        "Current features:",
        len(X.columns)
    )



    missing=[

        c

        for c in training_columns

        if c not in X.columns

    ]



    if missing:


        print(
            "Adding missing features:"
        )


        for c in missing:

            print(
                c
            )


            X[c]=0.0



    extra=[

        c

        for c in X.columns

        if c not in training_columns

    ]



    if extra:


        print(
            "Removing extra features:",
            len(extra)
        )



    X=X[

        training_columns

    ]



    print(
        "Final feature shape:",
        X.shape
    )


    return X





# ============================================================================
# VOTING BASELINES
# ============================================================================


def majority_vote(row):


    predictions=[

        row[f"{m}_prediction"]

        for m in MODELS

    ]


    return max(

        set(predictions),

        key=predictions.count

    )





def confidence_vote(row):


    best_model=None

    best_conf=-1



    for m in MODELS:


        conf=row[

            f"{m}_confidence"

        ]



        if conf > best_conf:


            best_conf=conf

            best_model=m



    return row[

        f"{best_model}_prediction"

    ]





# ============================================================================
# EVALUATION
# ============================================================================


def evaluate_metrics(
    name,
    correct
):


    print(

        f"{name:<25}",

        f"{correct.mean():.5f}"

    )


    return {

        "method":name,

        "accuracy":correct.mean(),

        "balanced_accuracy":balanced_accuracy_score(

            correct,

            correct

        ),

    }





# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================


def main():


    section(
        "PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.3 EVALUATION"
    )



    df=load_data()



    selector=joblib.load(

        MODEL_FILE

    )



    global_reliability=build_global_reliability(
        df
    )


    class_reliability=build_class_reliability(
        df
    )



    X=build_selector_features(

        df,

        global_reliability,

        class_reliability

    )



    X=align_features(
        X
    )



    section(
        "RUNNING SELECTOR PREDICTION"
    )


    selected_models = selector.predict(
        X
    )


    selected_models = selected_models.tolist()


    print(
        "Predictions completed:",
        len(selected_models)
    )



    df[

        "v3_3_selected_model"

    ]=selected_models




    # selected prediction


    selected_predictions=[]


    for row,model in zip(

        df.to_dict("records"),

        selected_models

    ):


        selected_predictions.append(

            row[

                f"{model}_prediction"

            ]

        )



    df[

        "v3_3_prediction"

    ]=selected_predictions



    df[

        "v3_3_correct"

    ]=(

        df.v3_3_prediction

        ==

        df.true_class

    )



    section(
        "MODEL COMPARISON"
    )



    results=[]


    results.append(

        {

        "method":"V3.3 Selector",

        "accuracy":

            df.v3_3_correct.mean()

        }

    )



    df[

        "majority_prediction"

    ]=df.apply(

        majority_vote,

        axis=1

    )



    results.append(

        {

        "method":"Majority Vote",

        "accuracy":

            (

            df.majority_prediction

            ==

            df.true_class

            )

            .mean()

        }

    )



    df[

        "confidence_prediction"

    ]=df.apply(

        confidence_vote,

        axis=1

    )



    results.append(

        {

        "method":"Confidence Winner",

        "accuracy":

            (

            df.confidence_prediction

            ==

            df.true_class

            )

            .mean()

        }

    )



    for m in MODELS:


        results.append(

            {

            "method":m,

            "accuracy":

                df[

                f"{m}_correct"

                ]

                .mean()

            }

        )



    results_df=pd.DataFrame(
        results
    )



    print(
        results_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ORACLE
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    correct_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            df[f"{m}_correct"].values

            for m in MODELS

        ]

    )


    oracle = correct_matrix.any(
        axis=1
    ).mean()



    print()

    print(
        "Oracle Accuracy:",
        oracle
    )



    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # RESCUE / REGRESSION ANALYSIS
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    selector_correct = (
        df.v3_3_correct
        .values
    )


    any_model_correct = (
        correct_matrix.any(
            axis=1
        )
    )


    rescue = (

        (~any_model_correct)

        &

        selector_correct

    )


    regression = (

        any_model_correct

        &

        (~selector_correct)

    )



    print()

    print(
        "Rescue Cases:",
        rescue.sum()
    )


    print(
        "Regression Cases:",
        regression.sum()
    )



    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SELECTOR DISTRIBUTION
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "SELECTOR CHOICES"
    )


    print(

        df[
            "v3_3_selected_model"
        ]

        .value_counts()

    )



    section(
        "SAVING RESULTS"
    )



    df.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR /

        "all_predictions.csv",

        index=False

    )



    df[rescue].to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR /

        "rescued_cases.csv",

        index=False

    )



    df[regression].to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR /

        "regression_cases.csv",

        index=False

    )



    results_df.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR /

        "final_comparison.csv",

        index=False

    )



    print()

    print(
        "Saved outputs:"
    )


    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )



    section(
        "V3.3 EVALUATION COMPLETE"
    )



# ============================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# ============================================================================


if __name__ == "__main__":


    main()

# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE V3.3 SELECTION GAIN
#
# Analysis:
# - Selector gain over best single model
# - Regression cases
# - Class-wise performance
# - Selected model contribution
#
# ============================================================================


from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np



# ============================================================================
# PATH
# ============================================================================


SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()

PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_PATH.parents[2]


INPUT_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_3_eval"
    /
    "all_predictions.csv"
)



OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_3_analysis"
)


OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)



MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]



def section(x):

    print()
    print("="*80)
    print(x)
    print("="*80)




def main():


    section(
        "LOADING V3.3 RESULTS"
    )


    df=pd.read_csv(
        INPUT_FILE
    )


    print(
        "Samples:",
        len(df)
    )



    # --------------------------------------------------
    # Best baseline
    # --------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "GAIN OVER BEST SINGLE MODEL"
    )


    baseline = (
        df["efficientnet_v2_s_correct"]
        .values
    )


    selector = (
        df["v3_3_correct"]
        .values
    )



    gain = (
        selector
        &
        (~baseline)
    )


    loss = (
        (~selector)
        &
        baseline
    )



    print(
        "Selector gains:",
        gain.sum()
    )


    print(
        "Selector loses:",
        loss.sum()
    )


    print(
        "Net improvement:",
        gain.sum()-loss.sum()
    )



    print(
        "Accuracy gain:",
        selector.mean()
        -
        baseline.mean()
    )



    df.loc[gain].to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "selector_gain_cases.csv",
        index=False
    )


    df.loc[loss].to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "selector_loss_cases.csv",
        index=False
    )



    # --------------------------------------------------
    # Class analysis
    # --------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "CLASS-WISE PERFORMANCE"
    )


    class_results = []


    for cls,group in df.groupby(
        "true_class"
    ):


        result={

            "class":cls,

            "samples":len(group),

            "selector":
            group.v3_3_correct.mean(),

        }


        for m in MODELS:

            result[m]=(
                group[f"{m}_correct"]
                .mean()
            )


        class_results.append(
            result
        )



    class_df=pd.DataFrame(
        class_results
    )


    print(
        class_df
    )


    class_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "class_performance.csv",
        index=False
    )



    # --------------------------------------------------
    # Selected model usage
    # --------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "SELECTED MODEL PERFORMANCE"
    )


    selected=[]


    for model,group in df.groupby(
        "v3_3_selected_model"
    ):

        selected.append(

            {

            "selected_model":model,

            "times_selected":len(group),

            "accuracy":
            group.v3_3_correct.mean()

            }

        )


    selected_df=pd.DataFrame(
        selected
    )


    print(
        selected_df
    )


    selected_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "selected_model_analysis.csv",
        index=False
    )



    # --------------------------------------------------
    # Regression cases
    # --------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "REGRESSION ANALYSIS"
    )


    regressions=df[
        (~df.v3_3_correct)
        &
        (df.efficientnet_v2_s_correct)
    ]


    print(
        "Regression count:",
        len(regressions)
    )


    regressions.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "regression_vs_effnet.csv",
        index=False
    )



    section(
        "COMPLETE"
    )


    print(
        "Saved:",
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )



if __name__=="__main__":

    main()

# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE V3.3 REGRESSIONS
#
# Finds cases where:
#
# EfficientNet_v2_s correct
# BUT
# V3.3 selector chooses another model incorrectly
#
# Purpose:
# Determine whether V3.4 is needed or V3.3 is ready
#
# ============================================================================


from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np



# ============================================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================================


SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()

PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_PATH.parents[2]


INPUT_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_3_eval"
    /
    "all_predictions.csv"
)



OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_3_analysis"
)


OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)



MODELS = [

    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",

]



# ============================================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================================


def section(title):

    print()
    print("="*80)
    print(title)
    print("="*80)




# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================


def main():


    section(
        "LOADING V3.3 RESULTS"
    )


    df = pd.read_csv(
        INPUT_FILE
    )


    print(
        "Samples:",
        len(df)
    )



    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Find regressions
    # ---------------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "FINDING REGRESSION CASES"
    )


    regression_mask = (

        (df["efficientnet_v2_s_correct"] == True)

        &

        (df["v3_3_correct"] == False)

    )


    regressions = df.loc[
        regression_mask
    ].copy()



    print(
        "Regression count:",
        len(regressions)
    )



    if len(regressions)==0:

        print(
            "No regression cases found"
        )

        return



    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence analysis
    # ---------------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "REGRESSION DETAILS"
    )


    analysis=[]



    for _,row in regressions.iterrows():


        selected=row[
            "v3_3_selected_model"
        ]


        true_class=row[
            "true_class"
        ]



        eff_conf=row[
            "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence"
        ]


        selected_conf=row[
            f"{selected}_confidence"
        ]



        analysis.append(

            {

            "true_class":
            true_class,


            "selected_model":
            selected,


            "efficientnet_prediction":
            row["efficientnet_v2_s_prediction"],


            "selected_prediction":
            row[f"{selected}_prediction"],


            "efficientnet_confidence":
            eff_conf,


            "selected_confidence":
            selected_conf,


            "confidence_difference":
            selected_conf-eff_conf,


            }

        )



    regression_df=pd.DataFrame(
        analysis
    )



    regression_df = regression_df.sort_values(
        "confidence_difference",
        ascending=False
    )



    print(
        regression_df.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )



    regression_df.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "detailed_regression_cases.csv",

        index=False

    )




    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Class distribution
    # ---------------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "REGRESSIONS BY CLASS"
    )


    class_counts = (

        regressions
        ["true_class"]
        .value_counts()

    )


    print(
        class_counts
    )



    class_counts.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "regression_class_distribution.csv"

    )




    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Which models steal correct answers?
    # ---------------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "MODEL CAUSING REGRESSIONS"
    )


    selected_counts = (

        regressions
        ["v3_3_selected_model"]
        .value_counts()

    )


    print(
        selected_counts
    )



    selected_counts.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR /
        "regression_selected_models.csv"

    )




    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Compare confidence
    # ---------------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "CONFIDENCE SUMMARY"
    )


    print(

        "EfficientNet mean confidence:",

        regressions[
            "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence"
        ]
        .mean()

    )


    selected_conf=[]


    for _,row in regressions.iterrows():

        model=row[
            "v3_3_selected_model"
        ]

        selected_conf.append(

            row[
                f"{model}_confidence"
            ]

        )


    print(

        "Selected model mean confidence:",

        np.mean(selected_conf)

    )




    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Final
    # ---------------------------------------------------------


    section(
        "COMPLETE"
    )


    print(
        "Saved results:"
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )




if __name__=="__main__":

    main()

# ============================================================================
# ANALYZE V3.3 REGRESSION PATTERNS
#
# Purpose:
#
# Deep analysis of cases where:
#
#   EfficientNet_v2_s is correct
#   BUT
#   V3.3 selector is incorrect
#
# Questions answered:
#
# 1. How confident are the models in regression cases?
# 2. How does regression confidence compare with normal cases?
# 3. How many models support the correct class?
# 4. How many models support the selector's wrong class?
# 5. Is the selected prediction supported by only one model?
# 6. Is the correct prediction supported by multiple models?
# 7. What happens specifically for MEL / BCC / BKL / NV?
# 8. What are the confidence gaps?
# 9. What are the model disagreement patterns?
# 10. Which models are responsible for the regressions?
#
# Input:
#
#   Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/
#   outputs/
#   pairwise_v3_3_eval/
#   all_predictions.csv
#
# Output:
#
#   Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/
#   outputs/
#   pairwise_v3_3_analysis/
#
# ============================================================================


from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================


MODELS = [

    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",

]


SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()

PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_PATH.parents[2]


INPUT_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"

    "pairwise_v3_3_eval"
    /
    "all_predictions.csv"

# ============================================================================

def section(title):

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def subsection(title):

    print()
    print("-" * 70)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 70)


# ============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================


def load_data():

    section(
        "LOADING V3.3 EVALUATION RESULTS"
    )

    print(
        "Input:",
        INPUT_FILE
    )

    if not INPUT_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Could not find:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(
        INPUT_FILE
    )

    print(
        "Samples:",
        len(df)
    )

    print(
        "Columns:",
        len(df.columns)
    )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# CHECK REQUIRED COLUMNS
# ============================================================================


def check_columns(df):

    section(
        "CHECKING REQUIRED COLUMNS"
    )

    required = [

        "true_class",

        "v3_3_selected_model",

        "v3_3_prediction",

        "v3_3_correct",

    ]


    for model in MODELS:

        required.extend([

            f"{model}_prediction",

            f"{model}_confidence",

            f"{model}_correct",

        ])


    missing = [

        column

        for column in required

        if column not in df.columns

    ]


    if missing:

        print(
            "Missing columns:"
        )

        for column in missing:
            print(
                " -",
                column
            )

        raise ValueError(
            "Required columns are missing."
        )


    print(
        "All required columns available."
    )


# ============================================================================
# CREATE PREDICTION SUPPORT FEATURES
# ============================================================================


def build_support_features(df):

    section(
        "BUILDING MODEL SUPPORT FEATURES"
    )

    result = df.copy()


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Number of models predicting the TRUE class
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    true_support = []


    selector_support = []


    unique_predictions = []


    agreement_ratio = []


    for _, row in result.iterrows():

        true_class = str(
            row["true_class"]
        )


        selector_prediction = str(
            row["v3_3_prediction"]
        )


        predictions = [

            str(
                row[
                    f"{model}_prediction"
                ]
            )

            for model in MODELS

        ]


        true_count = sum(

            prediction == true_class

            for prediction in predictions

        )


        selector_count = sum(

            prediction == selector_prediction

            for prediction in predictions

        )


        unique_count = len(
            set(predictions)
        )


        counts = pd.Series(
            predictions
        ).value_counts()


        majority_count = counts.iloc[0]


        true_support.append(
            true_count
        )


        selector_support.append(
            selector_count
        )


        unique_predictions.append(
            unique_count
        )


        agreement_ratio.append(

            majority_count
            /
            len(MODELS)

        )


    result[
        "true_class_support"
    ] = true_support


    result[
        "selector_class_support"
    ] = selector_support


    result[
        "unique_prediction_count"
    ] = unique_predictions


    result[
        "agreement_ratio"
    ] = agreement_ratio


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence of selected model
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    selected_confidence = []


    efficientnet_confidence = []


    confidence_difference = []


    for _, row in result.iterrows():

        selected_model = str(
            row[
                "v3_3_selected_model"
            ]
        )


        selected_conf = float(

            row[
                f"{selected_model}_confidence"
            ]

        )


        efficientnet_conf = float(

            row[
                "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence"
            ]

        )


        selected_confidence.append(
            selected_conf
        )


        efficientnet_confidence.append(
            efficientnet_conf
        )


        confidence_difference.append(

            selected_conf
            -
            efficientnet_conf

        )


    result[
        "selected_model_confidence"
    ] = selected_confidence


    result[
        "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence"
    ] = efficientnet_confidence


    result[
        "selected_vs_efficientnet_confidence_gap"
    ] = confidence_difference


    return result


# ============================================================================
# IDENTIFY REGRESSIONS
# ============================================================================


def identify_regressions(df):

    section(
        "IDENTIFYING V3.3 REGRESSIONS"
    )


    regression_mask = (

        (
            df["v3_3_correct"]
            == False
        )

        &

        (
            df["efficientnet_v2_s_correct"]
            == True
        )

    )


    regressions = df.loc[
        regression_mask
    ].copy()


    print(
        "Regression cases:",
        len(regressions)
    )


    print(
        "Regression rate:",
        f"{len(regressions) / len(df):.5f}"
    )


    regressions.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_3_regression_pattern_cases.csv",

        index=False

    )


    return regressions


# ============================================================================
# NORMAL CASES
# ============================================================================


def identify_normal_cases(df):

    normal_mask = ~(

        (
            df["v3_3_correct"]
            == False
        )

        &

        (
            df["efficientnet_v2_s_correct"]
            == True
        )

    )


    return df.loc[
        normal_mask
    ].copy()


# ============================================================================
# CONFIDENCE COMPARISON
# ============================================================================


def confidence_analysis(
    regressions,
    normal
):

    section(
        "CONFIDENCE ANALYSIS"
    )


    metrics = [

        "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence",

        "selected_model_confidence",

        "selected_vs_efficientnet_confidence_gap",

        "true_class_support",

        "selector_class_support",

        "unique_prediction_count",

        "agreement_ratio",

    ]


    rows = []


    for metric in metrics:

        regression_values = pd.to_numeric(

            regressions[metric],

            errors="coerce"

        )


        normal_values = pd.to_numeric(

            normal[metric],

            errors="coerce"

        )


        rows.append({

            "metric":
            metric,

            "regression_mean":
            regression_values.mean(),

            "regression_median":
            regression_values.median(),

            "normal_mean":
            normal_values.mean(),

            "normal_median":
            normal_values.median(),

            "difference":
            (
                regression_values.mean()
                -
                normal_values.mean()
            ),

        })


    comparison = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )


    print(
        comparison.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )


    comparison.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "confidence_comparison.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# REGRESSIONS BY CLASS
# ============================================================================


def class_analysis(
    regressions,
    df
):

    section(
        "REGRESSION ANALYSIS BY CLASS"
    )


    total_by_class = (

        df[
            "true_class"
        ]
        .value_counts()
    )


    regression_by_class = (

        regressions[
            "true_class"
        ]
        .value_counts()
    )


    rows = []


    for cls in sorted(
        total_by_class.index
    ):

        total = int(
            total_by_class
            .get(
                cls,
                0
            )
        )


        regression_count = int(

            regression_by_class
            .get(
                cls,
                0
            )

        )


        rate = (

            regression_count
            /
            total

            if total > 0

            else 0.0

        )


        rows.append({

            "class":
            cls,

            "samples":
            total,

            "regressions":
            regression_count,

            "regression_rate":
            rate,

        })


    table = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )


    print(
        table.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )


    table.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "regression_by_class.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# SELECTED MODEL ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================


def selected_model_analysis(
    regressions
):

    section(
        "REGRESSIONS BY SELECTED MODEL"
    )


    counts = (

        regressions[
            "v3_3_selected_model"
        ]
        .value_counts()
    )


    rows = []


    for model in MODELS:

        count = int(
            counts.get(
                model,
                0
            )
        )


        rows.append({

            "selected_model":
            model,

            "regression_count":
            count,

            "percentage_of_regressions":
            (
                count
                /
                len(regressions)
                *
                100
                if len(regressions) > 0
                else 0
            ),

        })


    table = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )


    print(
        table.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )


    table.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "regression_by_selected_model.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# SUPPORT ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================


def support_analysis(
    regressions
):

    section(
        "PREDICTION SUPPORT ANALYSIS"
    )


    total = len(
        regressions
    )


    for support in range(
        1,
        len(MODELS) + 1
    ):

        count = (

            regressions[
                "true_class_support"
            ]
            == support
        ).sum()


        print(

            f"Correct class supported by "
            f"{support} model(s): "
            f"{count}"

        )


    print()


    for support in range(
        1,
        len(MODELS) + 1
    ):

        count = (

            regressions[
                "selector_class_support"
            ]
            == support
        ).sum()


        print(

            f"Selected wrong class supported by "
            f"{support} model(s): "
            f"{count}"

        )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Important cases
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    true_multi = regressions[
        regressions[
            "true_class_support"
        ] >= 2
    ]


    selector_single = regressions[
        regressions[
            "selector_class_support"
        ] == 1
    ]


    print()


    print(
        "Regressions where TRUE class has >=2 model support:",
        len(true_multi)
    )


    print(
        "Regressions where WRONG selected class has only 1 model support:",
        len(selector_single)
    )


    true_multi.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "regressions_true_class_multi_support.csv",

        index=False

    )


    selector_single.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "regressions_wrong_class_single_support.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# PREDICTION CONFUSION PATTERNS
# ============================================================================


def confusion_analysis(
    regressions
):

    section(
        "REGRESSION CONFUSION PATTERNS"
    )


    confusion = (

        regressions
        .groupby(
            [
                "true_class",
                "v3_3_prediction"
            ]
        )
        .size()
        .reset_index(
            name="count"
        )
        .sort_values(
            "count",
            ascending=False
        )

    )


    print(
        confusion.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )


    confusion.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "regression_confusion_patterns.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# MODEL PAIR SUPPORT
# ============================================================================


def pair_support_analysis(
    regressions
):

    section(
        "PAIRWISE SUPPORT FOR TRUE CLASS"
    )


    rows = []


    for model_a in MODELS:

        for model_b in MODELS:

            if model_a >= model_b:
                continue


            support = 0


            for _, row in regressions.iterrows():

                true_class = str(
                    row[
                        "true_class"
                    ]
                )


                pred_a = str(

                    row[
                        f"{model_a}_prediction"
                    ]

                )


                pred_b = str(

                    row[
                        f"{model_b}_prediction"
                    ]

                )


                if (

                    pred_a == true_class

                    and

                    pred_b == true_class

                ):

                    support += 1


            rows.append({

                "model_a":
                model_a,

                "model_b":
                model_b,

                "both_correct_in_regressions":
                support,

            })


    table = (

        pd.DataFrame(
            rows
        )
        .sort_values(
            "both_correct_in_regressions",
            ascending=False
        )

    )


    print(
        table.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )


    table.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "regression_pairwise_true_support.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# HIGH CONFIDENCE WRONG PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================================


def high_confidence_analysis(
    regressions
):

    section(
        "HIGH-CONFIDENCE REGRESSION CASES"
    )


    thresholds = [

        0.90,
        0.95,
        0.98,
        0.99,

    ]


    rows = []


    for threshold in thresholds:

        count = (

            regressions[
                "selected_model_confidence"
            ]
            >= threshold
        ).sum()


        rows.append({

            "threshold":
            threshold,

            "count":
            int(count),

            "percentage":
            (
                count
                /
                len(regressions)
                *
                100
                if len(regressions) > 0
                else 0
            ),

        })


    table = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )


    print(
        table.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )


    table.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "high_confidence_regressions.csv",

        index=False

    )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Extremely confident wrong predictions
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    extreme = regressions[
        regressions[
            "selected_model_confidence"
        ] >= 0.95
    ].copy()


    extreme = extreme.sort_values(

        "selected_model_confidence",

        ascending=False

    )


    extreme.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "extreme_confidence_regressions.csv",

        index=False

    )


    print()


    print(
        ">=95% confidence wrong predictions:",
        len(extreme)
    )


# ============================================================================
# CLASS-SPECIFIC MEL ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================


def mel_analysis(
    regressions
):

    section(
        "MEL REGRESSION ANALYSIS"
    )


    mel = regressions[
        regressions[
            "true_class"
        ] == "MEL"
    ].copy()


    print(
        "MEL regressions:",
        len(mel)
    )


    if len(mel) == 0:

        print(
            "No MEL regressions."
        )

        return


    print()


    print(
        "Selected models:"
    )


    print(

        mel[
            "v3_3_selected_model"
        ]
        .value_counts()

    )


    print()


    print(
        "Wrong predictions:"
    )


    print(

        mel[
            "v3_3_prediction"
        ]
        .value_counts()

    )


    print()


    print(
        "Mean EfficientNet confidence:",
        mel[
            "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence"
        ].mean()
    )


    print(
        "Mean selected confidence:",
        mel[
            "selected_model_confidence"
        ].mean()
    )


    mel.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "mel_regression_cases.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# REGRESSION SCOREBOARD
# ============================================================================


def build_scoreboard(
    df,
    regressions
):

    section(
        "V3.3 REGRESSION SCOREBOARD"
    )


    total = len(df)

    regression_count = len(
        regressions
    )


    selector_accuracy = (

        df[
            "v3_3_correct"
        ]
        .mean()

    )


    efficientnet_accuracy = (

        df[
            "efficientnet_v2_s_correct"
        ]
        .mean()

    )


    print(
        f"Total samples:                 {total}"
    )


    print(
        f"V3.3 accuracy:                 {selector_accuracy:.6f}"
    )


    print(
        f"EfficientNet-v2-S accuracy:    {efficientnet_accuracy:.6f}"
    )


    print(
        f"Regression count:              {regression_count}"
    )


    print(
        f"Regression rate:               "
        f"{regression_count / total:.6f}"
    )


    print(
        f"Regression percentage:         "
        f"{regression_count / total * 100:.3f}%"
    )


    # Correct-class support

    multi_support = (

        regressions[
            "true_class_support"
        ] >= 2

    ).sum()


    single_wrong = (

        regressions[
            "selector_class_support"
        ] == 1

    ).sum()


    print()


    print(
        "Regressions with >=2 correct-model support:",
        multi_support
    )


    print(
        "Regressions with wrong class supported by 1 model:",
        single_wrong
    )


    # High confidence

    high_conf = (

        regressions[
            "selected_model_confidence"
        ] >= 0.95

    ).sum()


    print()


    print(
        "Wrong selections with >=95% confidence:",
        high_conf
    )


    # MEL

    mel_count = (

        regressions[
            "true_class"
        ] == "MEL"
    ).sum()


    print(
        "MEL regressions:",
        mel_count
    )


    scoreboard = pd.DataFrame([{

        "total_samples":
        total,

        "selector_accuracy":
        selector_accuracy,

        "efficientnet_accuracy":
        efficientnet_accuracy,

        "regression_count":
        regression_count,

        "regression_rate":
        regression_count / total,

        "correct_class_multi_support":
        multi_support,

        "wrong_class_single_support":
        single_wrong,

        "high_confidence_wrong":
        high_conf,

        "mel_regressions":
        mel_count,

    }])


    scoreboard.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_3_regression_scoreboard.csv",

        index=False

    )


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================


def main():

    section(
        "V3.3 REGRESSION PATTERN ANALYSIS"
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = load_data()


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    check_columns(
        df
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build support features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = build_support_features(
        df
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Find regressions
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    regressions = identify_regressions(
        df
    )


    if len(regressions) == 0:

        section(
            "NO REGRESSIONS FOUND"
        )

        print(
            "V3.3 has no regressions against EfficientNet-v2-S."
        )

        return


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normal comparison population
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    normal = identify_normal_cases(
        df
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Analyses
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    confidence_analysis(

        regressions,
        normal

    )


    class_analysis(

        regressions,
        df

    )


    selected_model_analysis(
        regressions
    )


    support_analysis(
        regressions
    )


    confusion_analysis(
        regressions
    )


    pair_support_analysis(
        regressions
    )


    high_confidence_analysis(
        regressions
    )


    mel_analysis(
        regressions
    )


    build_scoreboard(

        df,
        regressions

    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "ANALYSIS COMPLETE"
    )


    print(
        "Output directory:"
    )


    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )


    print()


    print(
        "Generated files:"
    )


    output_files = sorted(
        OUTPUT_DIR.glob(
            "*.csv"
        )
    )


    for file in output_files:

        print(
            " -",
            file.name
        )


# ============================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# ============================================================================


if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()
