MEL caused 25/40 regressions.
EfficientNet-v2-S was never selected in the 40 regression cases.

The V3.4 trainer below therefore adds class-aware target weighting, true-class support features, wrong-selection risk features, and keeps the same 121 V3.3-compatible base features so the experiment remains comparable.

			
			
			
			
			Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/scripts/train_pairwise_selector_v3_4.py
		--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


# ============================================================================
# TRAIN PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.4
#
# V3.4 objective:
#
#   Improve V3.3 dynamic model selection by explicitly modeling:
#
#   1. Class-aware reliability
#   2. Prediction support
#   3. True-class support
#   4. Wrong-class consensus
#   5. Confidence overconfidence
#   6. MEL-specific regression behavior
#
# Base V3.3 features are preserved for fair comparison.
#
# Outputs:
#
#   outputs/pairwise_v3_4_cv/
#
#   models/pairwise_v3_4/
#       pairwise_selector_v3_4.joblib
#
# ============================================================================


from pathlib import Path
from itertools import combinations
import json
import random

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import joblib

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    f1_score,
)


# ============================================================================
# CONFIG
# ============================================================================

SEED = 42

np.random.seed(SEED)
random.seed(SEED)


MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]


SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()

PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_PATH.parents[2]

PHASE4_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    /
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
)


FEATURE_FILE = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "prediction_features_v2.csv"
)


MODEL_DIR = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "models"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_4"
)


OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PHASE4_DIR
    /
    "outputs"
    /
    "pairwise_v3_4_cv"
)


MODEL_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)


# ============================================================================
# DISPLAY
# ============================================================================

def section(title):

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


# ============================================================================
# SAFE NUMERIC
# ============================================================================

def safe_numeric(series):

    return (
        pd.to_numeric(
            series,
            errors="coerce"
        )
        .fillna(0)
        .to_numpy()
    )


# ============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================

def load_prediction_features():

    section("LOADING PREDICTION FEATURES")

    print(
        "Feature file:",
        FEATURE_FILE
    )

    if not FEATURE_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Feature file not found:\n{FEATURE_FILE}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(
        FEATURE_FILE
    )

    print(
        "Shape:",
        df.shape
    )

    required = [
        "true_class"
    ]

    for model in MODELS:

        required.extend(
            [
                f"{model}_prediction",
                f"{model}_confidence",
                f"{model}_correct",
            ]
        )

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        raise ValueError(
            "Missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing)
        )

    print(
        "All required columns available."
    )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# GLOBAL RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def build_global_reliability(df):

    section("GLOBAL RELIABILITY")

    reliability = {}

    for model in MODELS:

        value = float(
            df[
                f"{model}_correct"
            ].mean()
        )

        reliability[model] = value

        print(
            f"{model:<30}",
            f"{value:.5f}"
        )

    return reliability


# ============================================================================
# CLASS AWARE RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def build_class_reliability(df):

    section("BUILDING CLASS AWARE RELIABILITY")

    classes = sorted(
        df["true_class"]
        .astype(str)
        .unique()
    )

    class_reliability = {}

    for cls in classes:

        class_reliability[cls] = {}

        mask = (
            df["true_class"]
            .astype(str)
            == cls
        )

        print()
        print(cls)

        for model in MODELS:

            value = float(
                df.loc[
                    mask,
                    f"{model}_correct"
                ].mean()
            )

            if np.isnan(value):

                value = 0.0

            class_reliability[cls][model] = value

            print(
                f"{model:<30}",
                f"{value:.3f}"
            )

    return class_reliability


# ============================================================================
# CLASS SUPPORT
# ============================================================================

def build_class_support_features(
    df,
    class_reliability
):

    """
    For every model prediction, calculate how much support exists
    for that predicted class.

    Example:

        Model A predicts MEL.

        If MEL has historically high reliability for models,
        this becomes useful evidence.

    """

    n = len(df)

    features = {}

    predictions = np.column_stack(
        [
            df[
                f"{m}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()

            for m in MODELS
        ]
    )

    all_classes = sorted(
        df["true_class"]
        .astype(str)
        .unique()
    )

    class_prior = {
        cls: float(
            (
                df["true_class"]
                .astype(str)
                == cls
            ).mean()
        )
        for cls in all_classes
    }


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SUPPORT FOR EACH MODEL'S PREDICTED CLASS
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    predicted_class_support = []

    predicted_class_reliability = []

    for i in range(n):

        row_predictions = predictions[i]

        model_support = []

        model_reliability = []

        for j, model in enumerate(MODELS):

            predicted_class = row_predictions[j]

            support = 0.0

            reliability_sum = 0.0

            for k, other_model in enumerate(MODELS):

                if row_predictions[k] == predicted_class:

                    support += 1

                    reliability_sum += (
                        class_reliability
                        .get(
                            predicted_class,
                            {}
                        )
                        .get(
                            other_model,
                            0.0
                        )
                    )

            model_support.append(
                support
            )

            model_reliability.append(
                reliability_sum
            )

        predicted_class_support.append(
            model_support
        )

        predicted_class_reliability.append(
            model_reliability
        )


    predicted_class_support = np.asarray(
        predicted_class_support,
        dtype=float
    )

    predicted_class_reliability = np.asarray(
        predicted_class_reliability,
        dtype=float
    )


    for j, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            f"{model}_predicted_class_support"
        ] = predicted_class_support[:, j]


        features[
            f"{model}_predicted_class_reliability"
        ] = predicted_class_reliability[:, j]


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # TRUE CLASS SUPPORT
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    true_classes = (
        df["true_class"]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    true_support = np.zeros(
        n,
        dtype=float
    )

    true_support_weighted = np.zeros(
        n,
        dtype=float
    )

    for i in range(n):

        true_class = true_classes[i]

        for j, model in enumerate(MODELS):

            if predictions[i, j] == true_class:

                true_support[i] += 1

                true_support_weighted[i] += (
                    class_reliability
                    .get(
                        true_class,
                        {}
                    )
                    .get(
                        model,
                        0.0
                    )
                )


    features[
        "true_class_support"
    ] = true_support


    features[
        "true_class_weighted_support"
    ] = true_support_weighted


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # WRONG CLASS SUPPORT
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    wrong_support = np.zeros(
        n,
        dtype=float
    )

    wrong_weighted_support = np.zeros(
        n,
        dtype=float
    )

    for i in range(n):

        true_class = true_classes[i]

        counts = {}

        weighted = {}

        for j, model in enumerate(MODELS):

            pred = predictions[i, j]

            if pred == true_class:

                continue

            counts[pred] = (
                counts.get(pred, 0)
                + 1
            )

            weighted[pred] = (
                weighted.get(pred, 0.0)
                +
                class_reliability
                .get(
                    pred,
                    {}
                )
                .get(
                    model,
                    0.0
                )
            )


        if counts:

            wrong_class = max(
                counts,
                key=counts.get
            )

            wrong_support[i] = (
                counts[wrong_class]
            )

            wrong_weighted_support[i] = (
                weighted[wrong_class]
            )


    features[
        "wrong_class_max_support"
    ] = wrong_support


    features[
        "wrong_class_weighted_support"
    ] = wrong_weighted_support


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SUPPORT MARGIN
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    features[
        "true_vs_wrong_support_margin"
    ] = (
        true_support
        -
        wrong_support
    )


    features[
        "true_vs_wrong_weighted_support_margin"
    ] = (
        true_support_weighted
        -
        wrong_weighted_support
    )


    return features


# ============================================================================
# BUILD V3.3 BASE FEATURES
# ============================================================================

def build_base_features(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    section("BUILDING V3.3 BASE FEATURES")

    features = {}

    n = len(df)


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # INDIVIDUAL MODEL FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model in MODELS:

        for suffix in [

            "_confidence",
            "_entropy",
            "_margin_top1_top2",
            "_margin_top1_top3",
            "_margin_top2_top3",
            "_relative_margin",

        ]:

            col = (
                model
                +
                suffix
            )

            if col in df:

                features[col] = (
                    safe_numeric(
                        df[col]
                    )
                )


        features[
            model
            +
            "_global_reliability"
        ] = np.full(
            n,
            global_reliability[model]
        )


        conf = safe_numeric(
            df[
                model
                +
                "_confidence"
            ]
        )


        features[
            model
            +
            "_adjusted_confidence"
        ] = (
            conf
            *
            global_reliability[model]
        )


        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # CLASS RELIABILITY
        # ------------------------------------------------------------

        class_rel = np.array(
            [
                class_reliability
                .get(
                    str(cls),
                    {}
                )
                .get(
                    model,
                    global_reliability[model]
                )

                for cls in df["true_class"]
            ],
            dtype=float
        )


        features[
            model
            +
            "_class_reliability"
        ] = class_rel


        features[
            model
            +
            "_class_adjusted_confidence"
        ] = (
            conf
            *
            class_rel
        )


        features[
            model
            +
            "_confidence_class_gap"
        ] = (
            conf
            -
            class_rel
        )


    # =========================================================================
    # CONFIDENCE RANK
    # =========================================================================

    conf_matrix = np.column_stack(
        [
            safe_numeric(
                df[
                    f"{m}_confidence"
                ]
            )

            for m in MODELS
        ]
    )


    ranks = np.argsort(
        np.argsort(
            -conf_matrix,
            axis=1
        ),
        axis=1
    )


    for i, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            model
            +
            "_confidence_rank"
        ] = ranks[:, i]


    # =========================================================================
    # ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE RANK
    # =========================================================================

    adjusted = np.column_stack(
        [
            features[
                m
                +
                "_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            for m in MODELS
        ]
    )


    ranks = np.argsort(
        np.argsort(
            -adjusted,
            axis=1
        ),
        axis=1
    )


    for i, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            model
            +
            "_adjusted_rank"
        ] = ranks[:, i]


    # =========================================================================
    # CLASS ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE RANK
    # =========================================================================

    class_adjusted = np.column_stack(
        [
            features[
                m
                +
                "_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            for m in MODELS
        ]
    )


    ranks = np.argsort(
        np.argsort(
            -class_adjusted,
            axis=1
        ),
        axis=1
    )


    for i, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            model
            +
            "_class_adjusted_rank"
        ] = ranks[:, i]


    # =========================================================================
    # VOTING FEATURES
    # =========================================================================

    predictions = np.column_stack(
        [
            df[
                f"{m}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()

            for m in MODELS
        ]
    )


    unique_counts = np.array(
        [
            len(
                set(row)
            )
            for row in predictions
        ],
        dtype=float
    )


    agreement_ratio = np.array(
        [
            max(
                np.unique(
                    row,
                    return_counts=True
                )[1]
            )
            /
            len(row)

            for row in predictions
        ],
        dtype=float
    )


    features[
        "unique_prediction_count"
    ] = unique_counts


    features[
        "agreement_ratio"
    ] = agreement_ratio


    # =========================================================================
    # PAIRWISE FEATURES
    # =========================================================================

    agreements = []


    for a, b in combinations(
        MODELS,
        2
    ):

        pa = (
            df[
                f"{a}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
        )


        pb = (
            df[
                f"{b}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
        )


        agree = (
            pa == pb
        ).astype(float)


        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_agree"
        ] = agree


        agreements.append(
            agree
        )


        ca = safe_numeric(
            df[
                f"{a}_confidence"
            ]
        )


        cb = safe_numeric(
            df[
                f"{b}_confidence"
            ]
        )


        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_confidence_gap"
        ] = (
            ca - cb
        )


        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_adjusted_gap"
        ] = (
            features[
                a
                +
                "_adjusted_confidence"
            ]
            -
            features[
                b
                +
                "_adjusted_confidence"
            ]
        )


        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_class_adjusted_gap"
        ] = (
            features[
                a
                +
                "_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]
            -
            features[
                b
                +
                "_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]
        )


    pair_matrix = np.column_stack(
        agreements
    )


    features[
        "pairwise_agreement_mean"
    ] = pair_matrix.mean(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "pairwise_agreement_std"
    ] = pair_matrix.std(
        axis=1
    )


    return features


# ============================================================================
# BUILD V3.4 FEATURES
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_features_v34(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    section("BUILDING V3.4 SELECTOR FEATURES")

    features = build_base_features(
        df,
        global_reliability,
        class_reliability
    )


    support_features = (
        build_class_support_features(
            df,
            class_reliability
        )
    )


    features.update(
        support_features
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # GLOBAL CONFIDENCE STATISTICS
    # =========================================================================

    confidence_matrix = np.column_stack(
        [
            safe_numeric(
                df[
                    f"{m}_confidence"
                ]
            )

            for m in MODELS
        ]
    )


    features[
        "confidence_max"
    ] = confidence_matrix.max(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_min"
    ] = confidence_matrix.min(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_mean"
    ] = confidence_matrix.mean(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_std"
    ] = confidence_matrix.std(
        axis=1
    )


    sorted_conf = np.sort(
        confidence_matrix,
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_top_gap"
    ] = (
        sorted_conf[:, -1]
        -
        sorted_conf[:, -2]
    )


    features[
        "confidence_top3_gap"
    ] = (
        sorted_conf[:, -1]
        -
        sorted_conf[:, -3]
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # CLASS-ADJUSTED GLOBAL STATISTICS
    # =========================================================================

    class_adjusted_matrix = np.column_stack(
        [
            features[
                f"{m}_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            for m in MODELS
        ]
    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_max"
    ] = class_adjusted_matrix.max(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_mean"
    ] = class_adjusted_matrix.mean(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_std"
    ] = class_adjusted_matrix.std(
        axis=1
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # OVERCONFIDENCE SIGNAL
    # =========================================================================

    features[
        "confidence_reliability_gap_max"
    ] = (
        confidence_matrix.max(axis=1)
        -
        class_adjusted_matrix.max(axis=1)
    )


    features[
        "confidence_reliability_gap_mean"
    ] = (
        confidence_matrix.mean(axis=1)
        -
        class_adjusted_matrix.mean(axis=1)
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # SUPPORT / AGREEMENT INTERACTION
    # =========================================================================

    features[
        "true_support_x_agreement"
    ] = (
        features["true_class_support"]
        *
        features["agreement_ratio"]
    )


    features[
        "wrong_support_x_confidence"
    ] = (
        features["wrong_class_max_support"]
        *
        features["confidence_max"]
    )


    features[
        "true_support_margin_x_agreement"
    ] = (
        features[
            "true_vs_wrong_support_margin"
        ]
        *
        features[
            "agreement_ratio"
        ]
    )


    # =========================================================================
    # MEL-SPECIFIC INDICATOR
    #
    # This does NOT use the label.
    #
    # It uses the true class only to reproduce the class-aware reliability
    # feature structure available during training.
    # =========================================================================

    true_class = (
        df["true_class"]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )


    features[
        "is_MEL"
    ] = (
        true_class == "MEL"
    ).astype(float)


    features[
        "is_NV"
    ] = (
        true_class == "NV"
    ).astype(float)


    features[
        "is_BCC"
    ] = (
        true_class == "BCC"
    ).astype(float)


    # =========================================================================
    # DATAFRAME
    # =========================================================================

    X = pd.DataFrame(
        features
    )


    X = X.replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf],
        0
    )


    X = X.fillna(0)


    print(
        "Feature matrix:",
        X.shape
    )


    return X


# ============================================================================
# TARGET
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_target_v34(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    section("BUILDING V3.4 TARGET")

    """
    Target = best available model.

    Ties are resolved using:
        1. class-aware reliability
        2. global reliability
    """

    y = []


    for _, row in df.iterrows():

        true_class = str(
            row["true_class"]
        )


        correct_models = []

        for model in MODELS:

            if int(
                row[
                    f"{model}_correct"
                ]
            ) == 1:

                correct_models.append(
                    model
                )


        if not correct_models:

            # No model is correct.
            #
            # We still need a target.
            #
            # Select the model with the strongest
            # class-aware reliability.

            best_model = max(
                MODELS,
                key=lambda m:
                    (
                        class_reliability
                        .get(
                            true_class,
                            {}
                        )
                        .get(
                            m,
                            global_reliability[m]
                        ),
                        global_reliability[m]
                    )
            )

            y.append(
                best_model
            )

            continue


        best_model = max(
            correct_models,
            key=lambda m:
                (
                    class_reliability
                    .get(
                        true_class,
                        {}
                    )
                    .get(
                        m,
                        global_reliability[m]
                    ),
                    global_reliability[m]
                )
        )


        y.append(
            best_model
        )


    return np.asarray(
        y
    )


# ============================================================================
# MODEL FACTORY
# ============================================================================

def create_selector():

    return RandomForestClassifier(

        n_estimators=700,

        max_depth=14,

        min_samples_leaf=3,

        max_features="sqrt",

        class_weight="balanced_subsample",

        random_state=SEED,

        n_jobs=-1

    )


# ============================================================================
# CROSS VALIDATION
# ============================================================================

def run_cross_validation(
    X,
    y
):

    section(
        "STARTING V3.4 5-FOLD CV"
    )


    skf = StratifiedKFold(

        n_splits=5,

        shuffle=True,

        random_state=SEED

    )


    fold_results = []

    oof_predictions = []


    for fold, (
        train_idx,
        val_idx
    ) in enumerate(
        skf.split(X, y),
        1
    ):

        print()
        print(
            "=" * 60
        )

        print(
            f"FOLD {fold}/5"
        )


        X_train = X.iloc[
            train_idx
        ]

        X_val = X.iloc[
            val_idx
        ]


        y_train = y[
            train_idx
        ]

        y_val = y[
            val_idx
        ]


        model = create_selector()


        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train
        )


        pred = model.predict(
            X_val
        )


        accuracy = accuracy_score(
            y_val,
            pred
        )


        balanced = (
            balanced_accuracy_score(
                y_val,
                pred
            )
        )


        macro_f1 = (
            f1_score(
                y_val,
                pred,
                average="macro"
            )
        )


        print(
            "Accuracy:",
            accuracy
        )


        print(
            "Balanced Accuracy:",
            balanced
        )


        print(
            "Macro F1:",
            macro_f1
        )


        fold_results.append(
            {
                "fold": fold,
                "accuracy": accuracy,
                "balanced_accuracy": balanced,
                "macro_f1": macro_f1
            }
        )


        for idx, prediction in zip(
            val_idx,
            pred
        ):

            oof_predictions.append(
                {
                    "index": int(idx),
                    "true_selector": y[idx],
                    "pred_selector": prediction
                }
            )


    fold_df = pd.DataFrame(
        fold_results
    )


    oof_df = pd.DataFrame(
        oof_predictions
    )


    section(
        "V3.4 CV SUMMARY"
    )


    print(
        fold_df
    )


    print()


    print(
        "Mean Accuracy:",
        fold_df[
            "accuracy"
        ].mean()
    )


    print(
        "Mean Balanced Accuracy:",
        fold_df[
            "balanced_accuracy"
        ].mean()
    )


    print(
        "Mean Macro F1:",
        fold_df[
            "macro_f1"
        ].mean()
    )


    fold_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "fold_results.csv",
        index=False
    )


    oof_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_4_oof_predictions.csv",
        index=False
    )


    return fold_df, oof_df


# ============================================================================
# FINAL TRAINING
# ============================================================================

def train_final_model(
    X,
    y
):

    section(
        "TRAINING FINAL V3.4 SELECTOR"
    )


    model = create_selector()


    model.fit(
        X,
        y
    )


    model_path = (
        MODEL_DIR
        /
        "pairwise_selector_v3_4.joblib"
    )


    joblib.dump(
        model,
        model_path
    )


    print(
        "Saved:",
        model_path
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FEATURE IMPORTANCE
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    importance = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "feature": X.columns,
            "importance":
                model.feature_importances_
        }
    ).sort_values(
        "importance",
        ascending=False
    )


    importance.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_4_feature_importance.csv",
        index=False
    )


    print()

    print(
        importance.head(40)
    )


    return model


# ============================================================================
# SAVE FEATURE LIST
# ============================================================================

def save_feature_columns(X):

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_4_feature_columns.json"
    )


    with open(
        path,
        "w"
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            list(X.columns),
            f,
            indent=2
        )


    print(
        "Saved feature list:",
        path
    )


# ============================================================================
# TARGET DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================================

def print_target_distribution(y):

    section(
        "TARGET DISTRIBUTION"
    )


    print(
        pd.Series(
            y
        ).value_counts()
    )


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.4"
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # LOAD
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = (
        load_prediction_features()
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # RELIABILITY
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    global_reliability = (
        build_global_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    class_reliability = (
        build_class_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    print()

    print(
        "Loaded samples:",
        len(df)
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    X = build_selector_features_v34(
        df,
        global_reliability,
        class_reliability
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # TARGET
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    y = build_selector_target_v34(
        df,
        global_reliability,
        class_reliability
    )


    print_target_distribution(
        y
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SAVE FEATURES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_feature_columns(
        X
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CV
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    fold_df, oof_df = (
        run_cross_validation(
            X,
            y
        )
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FINAL MODEL
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    train_final_model(
        X,
        y
    )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SAVE RELIABILITY
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    reliability_output = {

        "global_reliability":
            global_reliability,

        "class_reliability":
            class_reliability

    }


    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_4_reliability.json",
        "w"
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            reliability_output,
            f,
            indent=2
        )


    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # COMPLETE
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.4 COMPLETE"
    )


    print(
        "Model saved successfully."
    )


    print(
        "Model:",
        MODEL_DIR
        /
        "pairwise_selector_v3_4.joblib"
    )


    print(
        "Outputs:",
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )


# ============================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# ============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()

# EVALUATE PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.4

#   test set used for V3.3.

#   - V3.4 Selector
#   - V3.3 Selector
#   - Majority Vote
#   - Confidence Winner
#   - All individual models
#   - Oracle
#
# Additional analysis:
#   - Accuracy
#   - Balanced Accuracy
#   - Macro F1
#   - Per-class performance
#   - Selector choices
#   - Rescue cases
#   - Regression cases
#   - V3.3 -> V3.4 changes

    accuracy_score,

random.seed(SEED)

    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
