# ============================================================================

def load_prediction_features():

    section(
        "LOADING PREDICTION FEATURES"
    )

    print(
        "Feature file:",
        FEATURE_FILE
    )

    if not FEATURE_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Feature file not found:\n{FEATURE_FILE}"
        )


    df = pd.read_csv(
        FEATURE_FILE
    )


    print(
        "Shape:",
        df.shape
    )


    required = [
        "true_class"
    ]


    for model in MODELS:

        required.extend(
            [
                f"{model}_prediction",

                f"{model}_confidence",

                f"{model}_correct",
            ]
        )


    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]


    if missing:

        raise ValueError(
            "Missing required columns:\n"
            +
            "\n".join(missing)
        )


    print(
        "All required columns available."
    )


    return df


# ============================================================================
# GLOBAL RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def build_global_reliability(df):

    reliability = {}


    for model in MODELS:

        value = float(
            df[
                f"{model}_correct"
            ].mean()
        )


        if np.isnan(value):

            value = 0.0


        reliability[model] = value


    return reliability


# ============================================================================
# CLASS-AWARE RELIABILITY
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# Reliability for a model/class pair means:
#
#   P(model correct | model predicted class = class)
#
# NOT:
#
#   P(model correct | true class = class)
#
# The latter would create ground-truth-dependent features.
# ============================================================================

def build_predicted_class_reliability(df):

    class_reliability = {}


    for model in MODELS:

        prediction_col = (
            f"{model}_prediction"
        )

        correct_col = (
            f"{model}_correct"
        )


        predictions = (
            df[prediction_col]
            .astype(str)
        )


        correct = pd.to_numeric(
            df[correct_col],
            errors="coerce"
        ).fillna(0)


        classes = sorted(
            predictions.unique()
        )


        for cls in classes:

            mask = (
                predictions == cls
            )


            count = int(
                mask.sum()
            )


            if count == 0:

                continue


            value = float(
                correct[mask].mean()
            )


            if np.isnan(value):

                continue


            if cls not in class_reliability:

                class_reliability[cls] = {}


            class_reliability[cls][model] = value


    return class_reliability


# ============================================================================
# PRINT RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def print_reliability(
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    section(
        "TRAINING-SPLIT RELIABILITY"
    )


    print()
    print(
        "GLOBAL RELIABILITY"
    )

    print("-" * 60)


    for model in MODELS:

        print(
            f"{model:<30}"
            f"{global_reliability[model]:.5f}"
        )


    print()
    print(
        "PREDICTED-CLASS RELIABILITY"
    )

    print("-" * 60)


    classes = sorted(
        class_reliability.keys()
    )


    for cls in classes:

        print()
        print(
            f"Class: {cls}"
        )


        for model in MODELS:

            value = (
                class_reliability
                .get(cls, {})
                .get(
                    model,
                    global_reliability[model]
                )
            )


            print(
                f"  {model:<28}"
                f"{value:.4f}"
            )


# ============================================================================
# BUILD PREDICTION-AWARE CLASS FEATURES
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# Every feature here depends only on:
#
#   model prediction
#   historical training reliability
#
# It does NOT use true_class.
# ============================================================================

def build_class_support_features(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    n = len(df)

    features = {}


    predictions = np.column_stack(
        [
            df[
                f"{model}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()

            for model in MODELS
        ]
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # PER-MODEL PREDICTED CLASS SUPPORT
    # ========================================================================

    predicted_class_support = []

    predicted_class_reliability = []


    for i in range(n):

        row_predictions = predictions[i]


        model_support = []

        model_reliability = []


        for j, model in enumerate(MODELS):

            predicted_class = (
                row_predictions[j]
            )


            support = 0.0

            reliability_sum = 0.0


            for k, other_model in enumerate(MODELS):

                if (
                    row_predictions[k]
                    ==
                    predicted_class
                ):

                    support += 1.0


                    reliability_sum += (

                        class_reliability
                        .get(
                            predicted_class,
                            {}
                        )
                        .get(
                            other_model,
                            global_reliability[
                                other_model
                            ]
                        )
                    )


            model_support.append(
                support
            )


            model_reliability.append(
                reliability_sum
            )


        predicted_class_support.append(
            model_support
        )


        predicted_class_reliability.append(
            model_reliability
        )


    predicted_class_support = np.asarray(
        predicted_class_support,
        dtype=float
    )


    predicted_class_reliability = np.asarray(
        predicted_class_reliability,
        dtype=float
    )


    for j, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            f"{model}_predicted_class_support"
        ] = (
            predicted_class_support[:, j]
        )


        features[
            f"{model}_predicted_class_reliability"
        ] = (
            predicted_class_reliability[:, j]
        )


    # ========================================================================
    # SUPPORT MARGIN
    #
    # For each model:
    #
    # support of its predicted class
    #
    # minus
    #
    # maximum support of another predicted class
    # ========================================================================

    support_margin = np.zeros(
        n,
        dtype=float
    )


    weighted_support_margin = np.zeros(
        n,
        dtype=float
    )


    for i in range(n):

        row_predictions = predictions[i]


        class_counts = {}

        class_weighted = {}


        for j, model in enumerate(MODELS):

            cls = row_predictions[j]


            class_counts[cls] = (
                class_counts.get(cls, 0)
                +
                1
            )


            class_weighted[cls] = (
                class_weighted.get(
                    cls,
                    0.0
                )
                +
                class_reliability
                .get(
                    cls,
                    {}
                )
                .get(
                    model,
                    global_reliability[model]
                )
            )


        if len(class_counts) <= 1:

            support_margin[i] = (
                max(class_counts.values())
            )

            weighted_support_margin[i] = (
                max(class_weighted.values())
            )

            continue


        sorted_counts = sorted(
            class_counts.values(),
            reverse=True
        )


        sorted_weighted = sorted(
            class_weighted.values(),
            reverse=True
        )


        support_margin[i] = (
            sorted_counts[0]
            -
            sorted_counts[1]
        )


        weighted_support_margin[i] = (
            sorted_weighted[0]
            -
            sorted_weighted[1]
        )


    features[
        "prediction_support_margin"
    ] = support_margin


    features[
        "weighted_prediction_support_margin"
    ] = weighted_support_margin


    # ========================================================================
    # MAXIMUM CLASS SUPPORT
    # ========================================================================

    features[
        "prediction_support_max"
    ] = np.max(
        predicted_class_support,
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "prediction_support_mean"
    ] = np.mean(
        predicted_class_support,
        axis=1
    )


    return features


# ============================================================================
# BUILD BASE FEATURES
# ============================================================================

def build_base_features(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    section(
        "BUILDING V3.4 CLEAN BASE FEATURES"
    )


    features = {}

    n = len(df)


    # ========================================================================
    # INDIVIDUAL MODEL FEATURES
    # ========================================================================

    for model in MODELS:

        for suffix in [

            "_confidence",

            "_entropy",

            "_margin_top1_top2",

            "_margin_top1_top3",

            "_margin_top2_top3",

            "_relative_margin",

        ]:

            col = (
                model
                +
                suffix
            )


            if col in df:

                features[col] = (
                    safe_numeric(
                        df[col]
                    )
                )


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # GLOBAL RELIABILITY
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        features[
            model
            +
            "_global_reliability"
        ] = np.full(
            n,
            global_reliability[model]
        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # CONFIDENCE
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        conf = safe_numeric(
            df[
                model
                +
                "_confidence"
            ]
        )


        features[
            model
            +
            "_adjusted_confidence"
        ] = (
            conf
            *
            global_reliability[model]
        )


        # ====================================================================
        # PREDICTED-CLASS RELIABILITY
        #
        # CRITICAL:
        #
        # Use model prediction, NOT true_class.
        # ====================================================================

        predicted_classes = (
            df[
                f"{model}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
        )


        predicted_class_rel = np.array(

            [

                class_reliability
                .get(
                    str(predicted_class),
                    {}
                )
                .get(
                    model,
                    global_reliability[model]
                )

                for predicted_class
                in predicted_classes

            ],

            dtype=float
        )


        features[
            model
            +
            "_predicted_class_reliability"
        ] = predicted_class_rel


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # CLASS-ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        features[
            model
            +
            "_class_adjusted_confidence"
        ] = (
            conf
            *
            predicted_class_rel
        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # CONFIDENCE / RELIABILITY GAP
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        features[
            model
            +
            "_confidence_class_gap"
        ] = (
            conf
            -
            predicted_class_rel
        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # CONFIDENCE / RELIABILITY RATIO
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        features[
            model
            +
            "_confidence_class_ratio"
        ] = (
            conf
            /
            np.maximum(
                predicted_class_rel,
                1e-6
            )
        )


    # ========================================================================
    # CONFIDENCE MATRIX
    # ========================================================================

    conf_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            safe_numeric(
                df[
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                ]
            )

            for model in MODELS

        ]

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # CONFIDENCE RANK
    # ========================================================================

    ranks = np.argsort(

        np.argsort(
            -conf_matrix,
            axis=1
        ),

        axis=1

    )


    for i, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            model
            +
            "_confidence_rank"
        ] = ranks[:, i]


    # ========================================================================
    # ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE RANK
    # ========================================================================

    adjusted = np.column_stack(

        [

            features[
                model
                +
                "_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            for model in MODELS

        ]

    )


    ranks = np.argsort(

        np.argsort(
            -adjusted,
            axis=1
        ),

        axis=1

    )


    for i, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            model
            +
            "_adjusted_rank"
        ] = ranks[:, i]


    # ========================================================================
    # CLASS-ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE RANK
    # ========================================================================

    class_adjusted = np.column_stack(

        [

            features[
                model
                +
                "_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            for model in MODELS

        ]

    )


    ranks = np.argsort(

        np.argsort(
            -class_adjusted,
            axis=1
        ),

        axis=1

    )


    for i, model in enumerate(MODELS):

        features[
            model
            +
            "_class_adjusted_rank"
        ] = ranks[:, i]


    # ========================================================================
    # PREDICTIONS
    # ========================================================================

    predictions = np.column_stack(

        [

            df[
                f"{model}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()

            for model in MODELS

        ]

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # VOTING FEATURES
    # ========================================================================

    unique_prediction_count = np.array(

        [

            len(
                set(row)
            )

            for row in predictions

        ],

        dtype=float

    )


    agreement_ratio = np.array(

        [

            max(
                np.unique(
                    row,
                    return_counts=True
                )[1]
            )
            /
            len(row)

            for row in predictions

        ],

        dtype=float

    )


    features[
        "unique_prediction_count"
    ] = unique_prediction_count


    features[
        "agreement_ratio"
    ] = agreement_ratio


    # ========================================================================
    # PAIRWISE FEATURES
    # ========================================================================

    agreements = []


    for a, b in combinations(
        MODELS,
        2
    ):

        pa = (
            df[
                f"{a}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
        )


        pb = (
            df[
                f"{b}_prediction"
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .to_numpy()
        )


        agree = (
            pa == pb
        ).astype(float)


        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_agree"
        ] = agree


        agreements.append(
            agree
        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # CONFIDENCE GAP
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        ca = safe_numeric(
            df[
                f"{a}_confidence"
            ]
        )


        cb = safe_numeric(
            df[
                f"{b}_confidence"
            ]
        )


        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_confidence_gap"
        ] = (
            ca
            -
            cb
        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE GAP
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_adjusted_gap"
        ] = (

            features[
                a
                +
                "_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            -

            features[
                b
                +
                "_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
        # CLASS-ADJUSTED GAP
        # --------------------------------------------------------------------

        features[
            f"pair_{a}_{b}_class_adjusted_gap"
        ] = (

            features[
                a
                +
                "_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            -

            features[
                b
                +
                "_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

        )


    # ========================================================================
    # PAIRWISE AGREEMENT STATISTICS
    # ========================================================================

    pair_matrix = np.column_stack(
        agreements
    )


    features[
        "pairwise_agreement_mean"
    ] = pair_matrix.mean(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "pairwise_agreement_std"
    ] = pair_matrix.std(
        axis=1
    )


    return features


# ============================================================================
# BUILD V3.4 CLEAN FEATURES
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_features_v34_clean(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    features = build_base_features(

        df,

        global_reliability,

        class_reliability

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # CLASS SUPPORT
    # ========================================================================

    support_features = (
        build_class_support_features(

            df,

            global_reliability,

            class_reliability

        )
    )


    features.update(
        support_features
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # CONFIDENCE STATISTICS
    # ========================================================================

    confidence_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            safe_numeric(
                df[
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                ]
            )

            for model in MODELS

        ]

    )


    features[
        "confidence_max"
    ] = confidence_matrix.max(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_min"
    ] = confidence_matrix.min(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_mean"
    ] = confidence_matrix.mean(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_std"
    ] = confidence_matrix.std(
        axis=1
    )


    sorted_conf = np.sort(
        confidence_matrix,
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "confidence_top_gap"
    ] = (

        sorted_conf[:, -1]

        -

        sorted_conf[:, -2]

    )


    features[
        "confidence_top3_gap"
    ] = (

        sorted_conf[:, -1]

        -

        sorted_conf[:, -3]

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # CLASS-ADJUSTED GLOBAL STATISTICS
    # ========================================================================

    class_adjusted_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            features[
                f"{model}_class_adjusted_confidence"
            ]

            for model in MODELS

        ]

    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_max"
    ] = class_adjusted_matrix.max(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_min"
    ] = class_adjusted_matrix.min(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_mean"
    ] = class_adjusted_matrix.mean(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_std"
    ] = class_adjusted_matrix.std(
        axis=1
    )


    features[
        "class_adjusted_top_gap"
    ] = (

        np.sort(
            class_adjusted_matrix,
            axis=1
        )[:, -1]

        -

        np.sort(
            class_adjusted_matrix,
            axis=1
        )[:, -2]

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # OVERCONFIDENCE SIGNALS
    # ========================================================================

    features[
        "confidence_reliability_gap_max"
    ] = (

        confidence_matrix.max(
            axis=1
        )

        -

        class_adjusted_matrix.max(
            axis=1
        )

    )


    features[
        "confidence_reliability_gap_mean"
    ] = (

        confidence_matrix.mean(
            axis=1
        )

        -

        class_adjusted_matrix.mean(
            axis=1
        )

    )


    features[
        "confidence_reliability_gap_std"
    ] = (

        confidence_matrix.std(
            axis=1
        )

        -

        class_adjusted_matrix.std(
            axis=1
        )

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # SUPPORT / AGREEMENT INTERACTION
    #
    # IMPORTANT:
    #
    # These are based only on predictions.
    # ========================================================================

    features[
        "prediction_support_x_agreement"
    ] = (

        features[
            "prediction_support_max"
        ]

        *

        features[
            "agreement_ratio"
        ]

    )


    features[
        "weighted_support_x_confidence"
    ] = (

        features[
            "weighted_prediction_support_margin"
        ]

        *

        features[
            "confidence_max"
        ]

    )


    features[
        "support_margin_x_agreement"
    ] = (

        features[
            "prediction_support_margin"
        ]

        *

        features[
            "agreement_ratio"
        ]

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # CONFIDENCE × AGREEMENT
    # ========================================================================

    features[
        "confidence_max_x_agreement"
    ] = (

        features[
            "confidence_max"
        ]

        *

        features[
            "agreement_ratio"
        ]

    )


    features[
        "confidence_top_gap_x_agreement"
    ] = (

        features[
            "confidence_top_gap"
        ]

        *

        features[
            "agreement_ratio"
        ]

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # DATAFRAME
    # ========================================================================

    X = pd.DataFrame(
        features
    )


    X = X.replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf],
        0
    )


    X = X.fillna(0)


    print(
        "Feature matrix:",
        X.shape
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # LEAKAGE CHECK
    # ========================================================================

    forbidden_terms = [

        "true_class",

        "_correct",

        "is_MEL",

        "is_NV",

        "is_BCC",

        "true_support",

        "wrong_support",

    ]


    leakage_columns = [

        col

        for col in X.columns

        if any(
            term in col
            for term in forbidden_terms
        )

    ]


    if leakage_columns:

        raise RuntimeError(

            "POTENTIAL LABEL LEAKAGE DETECTED:\n"

            +

            "\n".join(
                leakage_columns
            )

        )


    print(
        "Leakage check: PASSED"
    )


    return X


# ============================================================================
# TARGET
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# Target is allowed to use true_class and correctness.
#
# The TARGET is supervised information.
#
# Features are not.
# ============================================================================

def build_selector_target_v34(
    df,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    section(
        "BUILDING V3.4 TARGET"
    )


    y = []


    for _, row in df.iterrows():

        correct_models = []


        for model in MODELS:

            value = pd.to_numeric(

                row[
                    f"{model}_correct"
                ],

                errors="coerce"

            )


            if int(
                0 if pd.isna(value)
                else value
            ) == 1:

                correct_models.append(
                    model
                )


        # ====================================================================
        # AT LEAST ONE MODEL CORRECT
        # ====================================================================

        if correct_models:

            # IMPORTANT:
            #
            # We do NOT use true_class here.
            #
            # We use global reliability for tie breaking.
            #
            # The selector's target should identify the strongest correct
            # model, not use information unavailable at inference.
            #

            best_model = max(

                correct_models,

                key=lambda model:
                    global_reliability[model]

            )


            y.append(
                best_model
            )


            continue


        # ====================================================================
        # ALL MODELS WRONG
        #
        # No model is actually correct.
        #
        # We use the globally strongest model only as a fallback target.
        #
        # These samples should be treated carefully during analysis.
        # ====================================================================

        best_model = max(

            MODELS,

            key=lambda model:
                global_reliability[model]

        )


        y.append(
            best_model
        )


    return np.asarray(
        y
    )


# ============================================================================
# MODEL FACTORY
# ============================================================================

def create_selector():

    return RandomForestClassifier(

        n_estimators=700,

        max_depth=14,

        min_samples_leaf=3,

        max_features="sqrt",

        class_weight="balanced_subsample",

        random_state=SEED,

        n_jobs=-1

    )


# ============================================================================
# SAVE RELIABILITY
# ============================================================================

def save_fold_reliability(
    fold,
    global_reliability,
    class_reliability
):

    output = {

        "fold":
            fold,

        "global_reliability":
            global_reliability,

        "predicted_class_reliability":
            class_reliability

    }


    path = (

        OUTPUT_DIR

        /

        f"fold_{fold}_reliability.json"

    )


    with open(
        path,
        "w"
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            output,
            f,
            indent=2
        )


# ============================================================================
# CROSS VALIDATION
#
# IMPORTANT:
#
# Reliability is calculated separately inside every fold.
# ============================================================================

def run_cross_validation(df):

    section(
        "STARTING V3.4 CLEAN 5-FOLD CV"
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # TARGET FOR SPLITTING
    #
    # This is allowed to use labels because it is supervised target creation.
    # ========================================================================

    global_rel_all = (
        build_global_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    class_rel_all = (
        build_predicted_class_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    y_all = build_selector_target_v34(

        df,

        global_rel_all,

        class_rel_all

    )


    skf = StratifiedKFold(

        n_splits=5,

        shuffle=True,

        random_state=SEED

    )


    fold_results = []

    oof_predictions = []


    for fold, (
        train_idx,
        val_idx
    ) in enumerate(

        skf.split(
            df,
            y_all
        ),

        1

    ):

        print()

        print(
            "=" * 70
        )

        print(
            f"FOLD {fold}/5"
        )

        print(
            "=" * 70
        )


        train_df = (
            df.iloc[
                train_idx
            ]
            .reset_index(
                drop=True
            )
        )


        val_df = (
            df.iloc[
                val_idx
            ]
            .reset_index(
                drop=True
            )
        )


        # ====================================================================
        # TRAIN-ONLY RELIABILITY
        # ====================================================================

        global_reliability = (
            build_global_reliability(
                train_df
            )
        )


        class_reliability = (
            build_predicted_class_reliability(
                train_df
            )
        )


        print_reliability(

            global_reliability,

            class_reliability

        )


        save_fold_reliability(

            fold,

            global_reliability,

            class_reliability

        )


        # ====================================================================
        # FEATURES
        #
        # Both train and validation features use TRAIN-ONLY reliability.
        # ====================================================================

        X_train = (
            build_selector_features_v34_clean(

                train_df,

                global_reliability,

                class_reliability

            )
        )


        X_val = (
            build_selector_features_v34_clean(

                val_df,

                global_reliability,

                class_reliability

            )
        )


        # ====================================================================
        # TARGETS
        # ====================================================================

        y_train = (
            build_selector_target_v34(

                train_df,

                global_reliability,

                class_reliability

            )
        )


        y_val = (
            build_selector_target_v34(

                val_df,

                global_reliability,

                class_reliability

            )
        )


        # ====================================================================
        # ALIGN FEATURES
        # ====================================================================

        missing_train = [

            col

            for col in X_val.columns

            if col not in X_train.columns

        ]


        for col in missing_train:

            X_train[col] = 0.0


        missing_val = [

            col

            for col in X_train.columns

            if col not in X_val.columns

        ]


        for col in missing_val:

            X_val[col] = 0.0


        X_val = X_val[
            X_train.columns
        ]


        # ====================================================================
        # TRAIN
        # ====================================================================

        model = create_selector()


        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train
        )


        # ====================================================================
        # PREDICT
        # ====================================================================

        pred = model.predict(
            X_val
        )


        # ====================================================================
        # METRICS
        # ====================================================================

        accuracy = accuracy_score(

            y_val,

            pred

        )


        balanced = (
            balanced_accuracy_score(

                y_val,

                pred

            )
        )


        macro_f1 = (
            f1_score(

                y_val,

                pred,

                average="macro"

            )
        )


        print()

        print(
            "Accuracy:",
            f"{accuracy:.6f}"
        )


        print(
            "Balanced Accuracy:",
            f"{balanced:.6f}"
        )


        print(
            "Macro F1:",
            f"{macro_f1:.6f}"
        )


        # ====================================================================
        # FOLD RESULTS
        # ====================================================================

        fold_results.append(

            {

                "fold":
                    fold,

                "accuracy":
                    accuracy,

                "balanced_accuracy":
                    balanced,

                "macro_f1":
                    macro_f1,

                "train_samples":
                    len(train_df),

                "validation_samples":
                    len(val_df),

                "feature_count":
                    X_train.shape[1]

            }

        )


        # ====================================================================
        # OOF PREDICTIONS
        # ====================================================================

        for local_idx, prediction in enumerate(pred):

            original_idx = int(
                val_idx[local_idx]
            )


            oof_predictions.append(

                {

                    "index":
                        original_idx,

                    "true_selector":
                        y_val[local_idx],

                    "pred_selector":
                        prediction,

                    "fold":
                        fold

                }

            )


    # ========================================================================
    # DATAFRAMES
    # ========================================================================

    fold_df = pd.DataFrame(
        fold_results
    )


    oof_df = pd.DataFrame(
        oof_predictions
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # SUMMARY
    # ========================================================================

    section(
        "V3.4 CLEAN CV SUMMARY"
    )


    print(
        fold_df
    )


    print()


    print(
        "Mean Accuracy:",
        f"{fold_df['accuracy'].mean():.6f}"
    )


    print(
        "Std Accuracy:",
        f"{fold_df['accuracy'].std():.6f}"
    )


    print(
        "Mean Balanced Accuracy:",
        f"{fold_df['balanced_accuracy'].mean():.6f}"
    )


    print(
        "Mean Macro F1:",
        f"{fold_df['macro_f1'].mean():.6f}"
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # SAVE
    # ========================================================================

    fold_df.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "fold_results.csv",

        index=False

    )


    oof_df.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_4_clean_oof_predictions.csv",

        index=False

    )


    return (
        fold_df,
        oof_df
    )


# ============================================================================
# FINAL TRAINING
#
# After CV, train using the entire dataset.
#
# This model is the model we will later use for actual evaluation.
# ============================================================================

def train_final_model(df):

    section(
        "TRAINING FINAL V3.4 CLEAN SELECTOR"
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # FULL-DATA RELIABILITY
    # ========================================================================

    global_reliability = (
        build_global_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    class_reliability = (
        build_predicted_class_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    print_reliability(

        global_reliability,

        class_reliability

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # FEATURES
    # ========================================================================

    X = build_selector_features_v34_clean(

        df,

        global_reliability,

        class_reliability

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # TARGET
    # ========================================================================

    y = build_selector_target_v34(

        df,

        global_reliability,

        class_reliability

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # TRAIN
    # ========================================================================

    model = create_selector()


    model.fit(
        X,
        y
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # SAVE MODEL
    # ========================================================================

    model_path = (

        MODEL_DIR

        /

        "pairwise_selector_v3_4_clean.joblib"

    )


    joblib.dump(

        model,

        model_path

    )


    print()

    print(
        "Saved:",
        model_path
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # FEATURE IMPORTANCE
    # ========================================================================

    importance = pd.DataFrame(

        {

            "feature":
                X.columns,

            "importance":
                model.feature_importances_

        }

    ).sort_values(

        "importance",

        ascending=False

    )


    importance.to_csv(

        OUTPUT_DIR
        /
        "v3_4_clean_feature_importance.csv",

        index=False

    )


    print()

    print(
        "TOP 50 FEATURES"
    )

    print(
        importance.head(50)
        .to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # SAVE FEATURE LIST
    # ========================================================================

    feature_path = (

        OUTPUT_DIR

        /

        "v3_4_clean_feature_columns.json"

    )


    with open(

        feature_path,

        "w"

    ) as f:

        json.dump(

            list(X.columns),

            f,

            indent=2

        )


    print()

    print(
        "Saved feature list:",
        feature_path
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # SAVE RELIABILITY
    # ========================================================================

    reliability_output = {

        "global_reliability":
            global_reliability,

        "predicted_class_reliability":
            class_reliability

    }


    reliability_path = (

        OUTPUT_DIR

        /

        "v3_4_clean_reliability.json"

    )


    with open(

        reliability_path,

        "w"

    ) as f:

        json.dump(

            reliability_output,

            f,

            indent=2

        )


    print()

    print(
        "Saved reliability:",
        reliability_path
    )


    return model


# ============================================================================
# TARGET DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================================

def print_target_distribution(

    df,

    global_reliability,

    class_reliability

):

    section(
        "TARGET DISTRIBUTION"
    )


    y = build_selector_target_v34(

        df,

        global_reliability,

        class_reliability

    )


    counts = (
        pd.Series(y)
        .value_counts()
        .reindex(
            MODELS,
            fill_value=0
        )
    )


    total = len(y)


    distribution = pd.DataFrame(

        {

            "count":
                counts,

            "percentage":
                counts
                /
                total
                *
                100

        }

    )


    print(
        distribution
    )


# ============================================================================
# DATA DIAGNOSTIC
# ============================================================================

def print_model_correctness_distribution(df):

    section(
        "MODEL CORRECTNESS DISTRIBUTION"
    )


    correctness_matrix = np.column_stack(

        [

            pd.to_numeric(

                df[
                    f"{model}_correct"
                ],

                errors="coerce"

            )
            .fillna(0)
            .to_numpy()

            for model in MODELS

        ]

    )


    number_correct = (
        correctness_matrix.sum(
            axis=1
        )
    )


    counts = (
        pd.Series(
            number_correct
        )
        .value_counts()
        .sort_index()
    )


    print()

    print(
        "Number of correct models:"
    )


    for number, count in counts.items():

        percentage = (
            count
            /
            len(df)
            *
            100
        )


        print(

            f"{int(number)} correct:"
            f" {int(count):5d}"
            f" ({percentage:6.2f}%)"

        )


    all_wrong = (
        number_correct == 0
    ).sum()


    all_correct = (
        number_correct == len(MODELS)
    ).sum()


    print()

    print(
        "All models wrong:",
        int(all_wrong)
    )


    print(
        "All models correct:",
        int(all_correct)
    )


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "PAIRWISE SELECTOR V3.4 CLEAN"
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # LOAD
    # ========================================================================

    df = load_prediction_features()


    print()

    print(
        "Loaded samples:",
        len(df)
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # DIAGNOSTIC
    # ========================================================================

    print_model_correctness_distribution(
        df
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # FULL-DATA RELIABILITY FOR TARGET DIAGNOSTIC
    #
    # This is NOT used to create CV validation features.
    # ========================================================================

    global_reliability = (
        build_global_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    class_reliability = (
        build_predicted_class_reliability(
            df
        )
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # TARGET DISTRIBUTION
    # ========================================================================

    print_target_distribution(

        df,

        global_reliability,

        class_reliability

    )


    # ========================================================================
    # CROSS VALIDATION
    # ========================================================================

    fold_df, oof_df = (
        run_cross_validation(
            df
        )
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # FINAL MODEL
    # ========================================================================

    train_final_model(
        df
    )


    # ========================================================================
    # COMPLETE
    # ========================================================================

    section(
        "V3.4 CLEAN COMPLETE"
    )


    print()

    print(
        "Model:"
    )

    print(

        MODEL_DIR
        /
        "pairwise_selector_v3_4_clean.joblib"

    )


    print()

    print(
        "Outputs:"
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )


    print()

    print(
        "CV mean accuracy:",
        f"{fold_df['accuracy'].mean():.6f}"
    )


    print(
        "CV mean balanced accuracy:",
        f"{fold_df['balanced_accuracy'].mean():.6f}"
    )


    print(
        "CV mean macro F1:",
        f"{fold_df['macro_f1'].mean():.6f}"
    )


# ============================================================================
