# ============================================================================
# CLASS × TRANSITION MATRIX
# ============================================================================

def save_class_transition_matrix(
    switch_df
):

    section(
        "CLASS × MODEL TRANSITION MATRIX"
    )

    switched = switch_df[
        switch_df["switched"] == 1
    ]

    if len(switched) == 0:
        return None

    result = pd.crosstab(
        switched["true_class"],
        switched["selector_model"]
    )

    result = result.reindex(
        columns=MODELS,
        fill_value=0
    )

    print(
        result
    )

    result.to_csv(
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "class_by_selected_model.csv"
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# RESCUE / HARM MATRIX
# ============================================================================

def save_rescue_harm_matrix(
    switch_df
):

    section(
        "RESCUE / HARM MODEL TRANSITION MATRIX"
    )

    switched = switch_df[
        switch_df["switched"] == 1
    ].copy()

    if len(switched) == 0:
        return None

    result = (
        switched
        .groupby(
            [
                "best_model",
                "selector_model"
            ]
        )
        .agg(
            samples=(
                "index",
                "count"
            ),

            rescues=(
                "outcome",
                lambda x:
                    int(
                        (x == "RESCUE").sum()
                    )
            ),

            harms=(
                "outcome",
                lambda x:
                    int(
                        (x == "HARM").sum()
                    )
            )
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    result["net_gain"] = (
        result["rescues"]
        -
        result["harms"]
    )

    result["rescue_to_harm_ratio"] = np.where(
        result["harms"] > 0,
        result["rescues"] / result["harms"],
        np.inf
    )

    result = result.sort_values(
        [
            "net_gain",
            "rescues"
        ],
        ascending=False
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.4f}"
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "rescue_harm_transition_matrix.csv",
        index=False
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# FEATURE SEPARATION: RESCUE VS HARM
# ============================================================================

def analyze_rescue_vs_harm_separation(
    switch_df
):

    section(
        "RESCUE VS HARM FEATURE SEPARATION"
    )

    rescue = switch_df[
        switch_df["outcome"] == "RESCUE"
    ]

    harm = switch_df[
        switch_df["outcome"] == "HARM"
    ]

    if len(rescue) == 0 or len(harm) == 0:

        print(
            "Insufficient rescue/harm samples."
        )

        return None

    features = [
        "best_confidence",
        "selector_confidence",
        "confidence_difference",
        "absolute_confidence_difference",
        "best_global_reliability",
        "selector_global_reliability",
        "global_reliability_difference",
        "best_class_reliability",
        "selector_class_reliability",
        "class_reliability_difference",
    ]

    rows = []

    for feature in features:

        rescue_values = pd.to_numeric(
            rescue[feature],
            errors="coerce"
        ).dropna()

        harm_values = pd.to_numeric(
            harm[feature],
            errors="coerce"
        ).dropna()

        if len(rescue_values) == 0:
            continue

        if len(harm_values) == 0:
            continue

        rescue_mean = float(
            rescue_values.mean()
        )

        harm_mean = float(
            harm_values.mean()
        )

        rescue_median = float(
            rescue_values.median()
        )

        harm_median = float(
            harm_values.median()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "feature":
                    feature,

                "rescue_mean":
                    rescue_mean,

                "harm_mean":
                    harm_mean,

                "mean_difference":
                    rescue_mean
                    -
                    harm_mean,

                "rescue_median":
                    rescue_median,

                "harm_median":
                    harm_median,

                "median_difference":
                    rescue_median
                    -
                    harm_median,

                "rescue_std":
                    float(
                        rescue_values.std()
                    ),

                "harm_std":
                    float(
                        harm_values.std()
                    )
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    result["abs_mean_difference"] = (
        result["mean_difference"]
        .abs()
    )

    result = result.sort_values(
        "abs_mean_difference",
        ascending=False
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.6f}"
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "rescue_vs_harm_feature_separation.csv",
        index=False
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# BEST MODEL WRONG: WHAT OTHER MODELS DID
# ============================================================================

def analyze_best_model_wrong(
    switch_df
):

    section(
        "WHEN BEST MODEL IS WRONG: ALTERNATIVE MODEL OPPORTUNITY"
    )

    wrong = switch_df[
        switch_df["best_correct"] == 0
    ].copy()

    rows = []

    for model in MODELS:

        correct = int(
            wrong[
                f"{model}_correct"
            ].sum()
        )

        samples = len(
            wrong
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "model":
                    model,

                "best_model_wrong_samples":
                    samples,

                "alternative_correct":
                    correct,

                "rescue_opportunity_rate":
                    (
                        correct / samples
                        if samples > 0
                        else 0.0
                    )
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    result = result.sort_values(
        "rescue_opportunity_rate",
        ascending=False
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.6f}"
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "alternative_rescue_opportunity.csv",
        index=False
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# PAIRWISE OPPORTUNITY
# ============================================================================

def analyze_pairwise_opportunity(
    switch_df
):

    section(
        "PAIRWISE COMPLEMENTARITY OPPORTUNITY"
    )

    rows = []

    for model_a in MODELS:

        for model_b in MODELS:

            if model_a == model_b:
                continue

            subset = switch_df[
                (
                    switch_df[
                        f"{model_a}_correct"
                    ]
                    == 0
                )
                &
                (
                    switch_df[
                        f"{model_b}_correct"
                    ]
                    == 1
                )
            ]

            count = len(
                subset
            )

            rows.append(
                {
                    "base_model":
                        model_a,

                    "alternative_model":
                        model_b,

                    "base_wrong_alt_correct":
                        count
                }
            )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    result = result.sort_values(
        "base_wrong_alt_correct",
        ascending=False
    )

    print(
        result.head(30).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "pairwise_rescue_opportunity.csv",
        index=False
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY
# ============================================================================

def create_summary(
    switch_df,
    best_model
):

    section("FINAL DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY")

    total = len(
        switch_df
    )

    best_correct = int(
        switch_df[
            "best_correct"
        ].sum()
    )

    selector_correct = int(
        switch_df[
            "selector_correct"
        ].sum()
    )

    rescue = int(
        (
            switch_df["outcome"]
            ==
            "RESCUE"
        ).sum()
    )

    harm = int(
        (
            switch_df["outcome"]
            ==
            "HARM"
        ).sum()
    )

    switched = int(
        switch_df["switched"].sum()
    )

    best_accuracy = (
        best_correct
        /
        total
    )

    selector_accuracy = (
        selector_correct
        /
        total
    )

    rescue_rate = (
        rescue
        /
        (total - best_correct)
        if total - best_correct > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    harm_rate = (
        harm
        /
        best_correct
        if best_correct > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    net_gain = (
        rescue
        -
        harm
    )

    print(
        f"Best model:                 {best_model}"
    )

    print(
        f"Total samples:              {total}"
    )

    print(
        f"Best model accuracy:        {best_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Selector accuracy:          {selector_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy gain:              "
        f"{selector_accuracy - best_accuracy:+.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Samples switched:           {switched}"
    )

    print(
        f"Samples not switched:       "
        f"{total - switched}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Rescues:                    {rescue}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms:                      {harm}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net gain:                   {net_gain:+d}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue rate:                {rescue_rate:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harm rate:                  {harm_rate:.6f}"
    )

    summary = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "best_model":
                    best_model,

                "total_samples":
                    total,

                "best_accuracy":
                    best_accuracy,

                "selector_accuracy":
                    selector_accuracy,

                "accuracy_gain":
                    selector_accuracy
                    -
                    best_accuracy,

                "switched":
                    switched,

                "not_switched":
                    total - switched,

                "rescues":
                    rescue,

                "harms":
                    harm,

                "net_gain":
                    net_gain,

                "rescue_rate":
                    rescue_rate,

                "harm_rate":
                    harm_rate
            }
        ]
    )

    summary.to_csv(
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "diagnostic_summary.csv",
        index=False
    )

    return summary


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.4 CLEAN SWITCH DIAGNOSTIC"
    )

    print(
        "Purpose:"
    )

    print(
        "Analyze why V3.4 rescues some samples and harms others."
    )

    print()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    df = load_prediction_features()

    oof = load_oof()

    (
        global_reliability,
        predicted_class_reliability
    ) = load_reliability()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate OOF coverage
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    section("VALIDATING OOF COVERAGE")

    expected_indices = set(
        range(len(df))
    )

    actual_indices = set(
        oof["index"]
        .astype(int)
        .tolist()
    )

    if expected_indices != actual_indices:

        missing = (
            expected_indices
            -
            actual_indices
        )

        extra = (
            actual_indices
            -
            expected_indices
        )

        raise ValueError(
            "OOF coverage mismatch.\n"
            f"Missing indices: {sorted(missing)}\n"
            f"Extra indices: {sorted(extra)}"
        )

    print(
        "OOF coverage check: PASSED"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine best model
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        best_model,
        single_results
    ) = determine_best_model(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build sample-level diagnostic
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    switch_df = build_switch_dataframe(
        df=df,
        oof=oof,
        best_model=best_model,
        global_reliability=global_reliability,
        predicted_class_reliability=predicted_class_reliability
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Overall outcomes
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_outcomes(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Switch-only
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_switches_only(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition analysis
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_transitions(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue / harm by class
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_rescue_by_class(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue transitions by class
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_rescue_pairs_by_class(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Harm transitions by class
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_harm_pairs_by_class(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_confidence(
        switch_df
    )

    analyze_confidence_bins(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Reliability
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_reliability(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Selected model performance
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_selected_models(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Complementarity
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_complementarity(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Detailed rescues
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    rescue = save_rescue_details(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Detailed harms
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    harm = save_harm_details(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Print top patterns
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    print_top_rescue_patterns(
        rescue
    )

    print_top_harm_patterns(
        harm
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Class × selected model
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    save_class_transition_matrix(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue/harm transition matrix
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    save_rescue_harm_matrix(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue vs harm feature separation
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_rescue_vs_harm_separation(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Best model wrong opportunity
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_best_model_wrong(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Pairwise opportunity
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_pairwise_opportunity(
        switch_df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final summary
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    create_summary(
        switch_df,
        best_model
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
    # Completion
    # ------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.4 SWITCH DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "All diagnostic outputs saved to:"
    )

    print(
        ANALYSIS_DIR
    )

    print()
    print(
        "MOST IMPORTANT FILES:"
    )

    print(
        "1.",
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "rescues_detailed.csv"
    )

    print(
        "2.",
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "harms_detailed.csv"
    )

    print(
        "3.",
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "transition_analysis.csv"
    )

    print(
        "4.",
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "rescue_harm_by_class.csv"
    )

    print(
        "5.",
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "rescue_vs_harm_feature_separation.csv"
    )

    print(
        "6.",
        ANALYSIS_DIR
        / "pairwise_rescue_opportunity.csv"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Next step:"
    )

    print(
        "Use the rescue/harm separation and transition analysis "
        "to design V3.5."
    )

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.5 GATED SWITCH ANALYSIS

Purpose
-------
Analyze whether V3.4 proposed switches should actually be accepted.

V3.4:
    EfficientNet-v2-S is the best single model.

V3.4 can switch to alternative models.

V3.5:
    learns a gate over those proposed switches.

Primary transitions:
    efficientnet_v2_s -> resnet50
    efficientnet_v2_s -> mobilenet_v3_large

The gate uses only information available at prediction time:
    - model confidences
    - confidence differences
    - predicted-class reliability
    - model agreement/disagreement
    - predicted classes
    - transition identity

IMPORTANT
---------
This script is an ANALYSIS / V3.5 EXPERIMENT.

The V3.4 OOF sample-results file contains:
    selector_model
    selector_prediction
    selector_correct
    model predictions
    model confidences
    model correctness

The V3.4 selector OOF file is used for validation only.
"""


from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# =============================================================================
# CONFIG
# =============================================================================

ROOT = Path("/home/dhrubo_roy/Hybrid_v3")

PHASE4 = ROOT / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"

SAMPLE_RESULTS = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_4_clean_cv"
    / "evaluation"
    / "v3_4_clean_oof_sample_results.csv"
)

OOF_SELECTOR = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_4_clean_cv"
    / "v3_4_clean_oof_predictions.csv"
)

RELIABILITY_FILE = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_4_clean_cv"
    / "v3_4_clean_reliability.json"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_4_clean_cv"
    / "v3_5_gated_switch"
)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


BEST_MODEL = "efficientnet_v2_s"

PRIMARY_ALTERNATIVES = [
    "resnet50",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
]

ALL_MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]


# =============================================================================
# UTILITY
# =============================================================================

def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def require_columns(df, columns, name="DataFrame"):
    missing = [c for c in columns if c not in df.columns]

    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{name} is missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in missing)
        )


# =============================================================================
# LOAD SAMPLE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

def load_sample_results():

    section("LOADING V3.4 SAMPLE-LEVEL OOF RESULTS")

    print(f"File: {SAMPLE_RESULTS}")

    if not SAMPLE_RESULTS.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Sample results file not found:\n{SAMPLE_RESULTS}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_RESULTS)

    print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")

    required = [
        "index",
        "true_class",
        "selector_model",
        "selector_prediction",
        "selector_correct",
    ]

    for model in ALL_MODELS:

        required.extend([
            f"{model}_prediction",
            f"{model}_confidence",
            f"{model}_correct",
        ])

    require_columns(
        df,
        required,
        "V3.4 sample results"
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# VALIDATE SELECTOR OOF FILE
# =============================================================================

def validate_selector_oof(df):

    section("VALIDATING V3.4 SELECTOR OOF FILE")

    if not OOF_SELECTOR.exists():

        print(
            "WARNING: OOF selector file not found.\n"
            "Continuing with sample-level OOF results."
        )

        return

    oof = pd.read_csv(OOF_SELECTOR)

    print(f"OOF shape: {oof.shape}")

    require_columns(
        oof,
        [
            "index",
            "true_selector",
            "pred_selector",
            "fold",
        ],
        "OOF selector"
    )

    merged = df[
        [
            "index",
            "selector_model",
        ]
    ].merge(
        oof[
            [
                "index",
                "pred_selector",
            ]
        ],
        on="index",
        how="left",
    )

    coverage = merged["pred_selector"].notna().mean()

    print(
        f"OOF coverage: {coverage:.6f}"
    )

    if coverage < 1.0:

        raise RuntimeError(
            "OOF selector coverage is incomplete."
        )

    disagreement = (
        merged["selector_model"]
        != merged["pred_selector"]
    ).sum()

    print(
        f"Selector prediction disagreement: {disagreement}"
    )

    if disagreement > 0:

        print(
            "WARNING: sample-results selector_model and "
            "OOF pred_selector differ."
        )

    else:

        print(
            "OOF selector alignment: PASSED"
        )


# =============================================================================
# BUILD SWITCH TABLE
# =============================================================================

def build_switch_table(df):

    section("BUILDING V3.5 SWITCH TABLE")

    out = df.copy()

    out["best_model"] = BEST_MODEL

    out["best_prediction"] = (
        out[f"{BEST_MODEL}_prediction"]
    )

    out["best_confidence"] = (
        out[f"{BEST_MODEL}_confidence"]
    )

    out["best_correct"] = (
        out[f"{BEST_MODEL}_correct"].astype(int)
    )

    out["proposed_model"] = (
        out["selector_model"]
    )

    out["proposed_prediction"] = (
        out["selector_prediction"]
    )

    out["proposed_confidence"] = (
        out["selector_model"]
        .map(
            lambda m: out.loc[
                out.index,
                f"{m}_confidence"
            ]
        )
    )

    # Safer vectorized construction.
    out["proposed_confidence"] = np.nan

    for model in ALL_MODELS:

        mask = (
            out["proposed_model"] == model
        )

        if mask.any():

            out.loc[mask, "proposed_confidence"] = (
                out.loc[
                    mask,
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                ]
            )

    out["proposed_correct"] = (
        out["selector_correct"].astype(int)
    )

    out["is_switch"] = (
        out["proposed_model"] != BEST_MODEL
    )

    out["is_primary_switch"] = (
        out["proposed_model"].isin(
            PRIMARY_ALTERNATIVES
        )
    )

    out["confidence_difference"] = (
        out["proposed_confidence"]
        - out["best_confidence"]
    )

    out["absolute_confidence_difference"] = (
        out["confidence_difference"].abs()
    )

    out["best_wrong"] = (
        out["best_correct"] == 0
    )

    out["proposed_wrong"] = (
        out["proposed_correct"] == 0
    )

    out["outcome"] = "BOTH_CORRECT"

    out.loc[
        out["best_wrong"] &
        (~out["proposed_wrong"]),
        "outcome"
    ] = "RESCUE"

    out.loc[
        (~out["best_wrong"]) &
        out["proposed_wrong"],
        "outcome"
    ] = "HARM"

    out.loc[
        out["best_wrong"] &
        out["proposed_wrong"],
        "outcome"
    ] = "BOTH_WRONG"

    return out


# =============================================================================
# ORIGINAL V3.4
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_original(df):

    section("ORIGINAL V3.4")

    print(
        f"Samples: {len(df)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Best model accuracy: "
        f"{df['best_correct'].mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.4 selector accuracy: "
        f"{df['proposed_correct'].mean():.6f}"
    )

    switches = df["is_switch"]

    print(
        f"Switches: {switches.sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Switch rate: "
        f"{switches.mean():.6f}"
    )

    rescue = (
        (df["outcome"] == "RESCUE").sum()
    )

    harm = (
        (df["outcome"] == "HARM").sum()
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues: {rescue}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms: {harm}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net gain: {rescue - harm:+d}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# PRIMARY TRANSITIONS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_primary_transitions(df):

    section("PRIMARY SWITCH TRANSITIONS")

    switches = df[
        df["is_primary_switch"]
    ].copy()

    rows = []

    for model in PRIMARY_ALTERNATIVES:

        x = switches[
            switches["proposed_model"] == model
        ]

        rescue = (
            x["outcome"] == "RESCUE"
        ).sum()

        harm = (
            x["outcome"] == "HARM"
        ).sum()

        rows.append({
            "alternative_model": model,
            "samples": len(x),
            "rescues": rescue,
            "harms": harm,
            "net_gain": rescue - harm,
            "rescue_rate": (
                rescue / len(x)
                if len(x)
                else 0.0
            ),
            "harm_rate": (
                harm / len(x)
                if len(x)
                else 0.0
            ),
            "mean_confidence_difference": (
                x["confidence_difference"].mean()
                if len(x)
                else np.nan
            ),
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "primary_transition_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# GATE THRESHOLD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_thresholds(df):

    section("V3.5 CONFIDENCE GATE ANALYSIS")

    switches = df[
        df["is_primary_switch"]
    ].copy()

    rows = []

    thresholds = np.arange(
        -0.20,
        0.201,
        0.01
    )

    for threshold in thresholds:

        # Accept proposed switch only when:
        #
        # alternative confidence
        # >
        # best confidence + threshold

        accept = (
            switches["confidence_difference"]
            >= threshold
        )

        gated = switches.copy()

        gated["gate_accept"] = accept

        # Start from best model.
        gated["final_correct"] = (
            gated["best_correct"]
        )

        # Accepted switch uses alternative.
        gated.loc[
            accept,
            "final_correct"
        ] = gated.loc[
            accept,
            "proposed_correct"
        ]

        accuracy = (
            gated["final_correct"].mean()
        )

        original_accuracy = (
            switches["best_correct"].mean()
        )

        rows.append({
            "threshold": threshold,
            "switches": int(accept.sum()),
            "switch_rate": accept.mean(),
            "accuracy": accuracy,
            "gain_vs_best": (
                accuracy
                - original_accuracy
            ),
            "rescues": int(
                (
                    accept &
                    (switches["outcome"] == "RESCUE")
                ).sum()
            ),
            "harms": int(
                (
                    accept &
                    (switches["outcome"] == "HARM")
                ).sum()
            ),
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    result = result.sort_values(
        "accuracy",
        ascending=False
    )

    print(
        result.head(15).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "confidence_gate_thresholds.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# PER-TRANSITION THRESHOLD
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_transition_thresholds(df):

    section("V3.5 TRANSITION-SPECIFIC GATES")

    rows = []

    for model in PRIMARY_ALTERNATIVES:

        x = df[
            df["proposed_model"] == model
        ].copy()

        if len(x) == 0:
            continue

        best_acc = (
            x["best_correct"].mean()
        )

        for threshold in np.arange(
            -0.20,
            0.201,
            0.01
        ):

            accept = (
                x["confidence_difference"]
                >= threshold
            )

            final_correct = (
                x["best_correct"].copy()
            )

            final_correct.loc[accept] = (
                x.loc[
                    accept,
                    "proposed_correct"
                ]
            )

            accuracy = (
                final_correct.mean()
            )

            rows.append({
                "alternative_model": model,
                "threshold": threshold,
                "samples": len(x),
                "switches": int(accept.sum()),
                "accuracy": accuracy,
                "gain_vs_best": (
                    accuracy - best_acc
                ),
            })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    best = (
        result
        .sort_values(
            [
                "alternative_model",
                "accuracy",
            ],
            ascending=[True, False]
        )
        .groupby(
            "alternative_model"
        )
        .head(1)
    )

    print(
        best.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "transition_specific_thresholds.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CLASS GATE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_class_gates(df):

    section("CLASS-SPECIFIC SWITCH ANALYSIS")

    x = df[
        df["is_primary_switch"]
    ].copy()

    rows = []

    for cls in sorted(
        x["true_class"].unique()
    ):

        c = x[
            x["true_class"] == cls
        ]

        rescue = (
            c["outcome"] == "RESCUE"
        ).sum()

        harm = (
            c["outcome"] == "HARM"
        ).sum()

        rows.append({
            "true_class": cls,
            "samples": len(c),
            "rescues": rescue,
            "harms": harm,
            "net_gain": rescue - harm,
            "rescue_rate": (
                rescue / len(c)
                if len(c)
                else 0.0
            ),
            "harm_rate": (
                harm / len(c)
                if len(c)
                else 0.0
            ),
            "mean_confidence_difference":
                c["confidence_difference"].mean(),
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "class_gate_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CONFIDENCE SEPARATION
# =============================================================================

def analyze_rescue_harm_separation(df):

    section("RESCUE VS HARM SEPARATION")

    x = df[
        df["outcome"].isin(
            ["RESCUE", "HARM"]
        )
    ].copy()

    features = [
        "confidence_difference",
        "best_confidence",
        "proposed_confidence",
        "absolute_confidence_difference",
    ]

    rows = []

    for feature in features:

        rescue = x.loc[
            x["outcome"] == "RESCUE",
            feature
        ]

        harm = x.loc[
            x["outcome"] == "HARM",
            feature
        ]

        rows.append({
            "feature": feature,
            "rescue_mean": rescue.mean(),
            "harm_mean": harm.mean(),
            "difference": (
                rescue.mean()
                - harm.mean()
            ),
            "rescue_median": rescue.median(),
            "harm_median": harm.median(),
            "rescue_std": rescue.std(),
            "harm_std": harm.std(),
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rescue_harm_separation.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# OPPORTUNITY
# =============================================================================

def analyze_opportunity(df):

    section("ALTERNATIVE MODEL OPPORTUNITY")

    rows = []

    wrong = df[
        df["best_correct"] == 0
    ]

    for model in ALL_MODELS:

        if model == BEST_MODEL:
            continue

        correct = (
            wrong[f"{model}_correct"] == 1
        ).sum()

        rows.append({
            "model": model,
            "best_wrong_samples": len(wrong),
            "alternative_correct": correct,
            "opportunity_rate": (
                correct / len(wrong)
                if len(wrong)
                else 0.0
            ),
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.sort_values(
            "opportunity_rate",
            ascending=False
        ).to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "alternative_opportunity.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# FINAL GATED SIMULATION
# =============================================================================

def simulate_best_gate(
    df,
    threshold
):

    switches = df[
        df["is_primary_switch"]
    ].copy()

    accept = (
        switches["confidence_difference"]
        >= threshold
    )

    final_correct = (
        switches["best_correct"].copy()
    )

    final_correct.loc[accept] = (
        switches.loc[
            accept,
            "proposed_correct"
        ]
    )

    return {
        "threshold": threshold,
        "samples": len(switches),
        "accepted_switches": int(
            accept.sum()
        ),
        "accuracy": final_correct.mean(),
        "gain_vs_best": (
            final_correct.mean()
            - switches["best_correct"].mean()
        ),
        "rescues": int(
            (
                accept &
                (switches["outcome"] == "RESCUE")
            ).sum()
        ),
        "harms": int(
            (
                accept &
                (switches["outcome"] == "HARM")
            ).sum()
        ),
    }

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.5 FOLD-SAFE GATED SWITCH TRAINING

Goal
----
Learn when to switch away from the strongest single model:

    efficientnet_v2_s

toward complementary alternatives:

    resnet50
    mobilenet_v3_large

The gate is trained strictly inside each OOF fold.

IMPORTANT
---------
This script does NOT use the true class as an input feature.

The true class is used ONLY to construct the rescue target.

For each alternative model:

    target = 1
        if alternative is correct
        AND best model is wrong

    target = 0
        otherwise

This creates a rescue-opportunity gate.

Outputs
-------
Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs/pairwise_v3_5_cv/

    fold_1/
        resnet_gate.joblib
        mobilenet_gate.joblib

    ...

    v3_5_gate_oof_predictions.csv
    v3_5_threshold_analysis.csv
    v3_5_gate_training_summary.csv
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import joblib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    f1_score,
    roc_auc_score,
)
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

INPUT_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_4_clean_cv"
    / "evaluation"
    / "v3_4_clean_oof_sample_results.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_5_cv"
)

BEST_MODEL = "efficientnet_v2_s"

ALTERNATIVES = [
    "resnet50",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
]

N_SPLITS = 5
RANDOM_STATE = 42

THRESHOLDS = [
    0.50,
    0.55,
    0.60,
    0.65,
    0.70,
    0.75,
    0.80,
    0.85,
    0.90,
]

MODEL_NAMES = [
    "resnet50",
    "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_b3",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "deit_tiny",
    "swin_tiny",
]


# =============================================================================
# UTILITIES
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def ensure_output_dir() -> None:
    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    for fold in range(1, N_SPLITS + 1):
        (OUTPUT_DIR / f"fold_{fold}").mkdir(
            parents=True,
            exist_ok=True,
        )


def require_columns(df: pd.DataFrame, columns: list[str]) -> None:
    missing = [c for c in columns if c not in df.columns]

    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in missing)
        )


# =============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# =============================================================================

def load_data() -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("LOADING V3.4 OOF SAMPLE RESULTS")

    print(f"File: {INPUT_FILE}")

    if not INPUT_FILE.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Input file not found:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

    print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")

    required = [
        "index",
        "true_class",
        "selector_model",
        "selector_prediction",
        "selector_correct",
    ]

    for model in MODEL_NAMES:
        required.extend([
            f"{model}_prediction",
            f"{model}_confidence",
            f"{model}_correct",
        ])

    require_columns(df, required)

    df = df.sort_values("index").reset_index(drop=True)

    print(f"Samples: {len(df)}")
    print(f"Columns: {len(df.columns)}")

    duplicate_indices = df["index"].duplicated().sum()

    if duplicate_indices:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Duplicate sample indices detected: {duplicate_indices}"
        )

    print("Index uniqueness: PASSED")

    return df


# =============================================================================
# BUILD TARGET
# =============================================================================

def build_rescue_target(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    alternative: str,
) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Rescue opportunity:

        alternative correct
        AND
        best model wrong
    """

    best_correct = (
        df[f"{BEST_MODEL}_correct"].astype(int).to_numpy()
    )

    alternative_correct = (
        df[f"{alternative}_correct"].astype(int).to_numpy()
    )

    target = (
        (best_correct == 0)
        &
        (alternative_correct == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    return target


# =============================================================================
# BUILD PAIRWISE FEATURES
# =============================================================================

def build_pair_features(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    alternative: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    best = BEST_MODEL
    alt = alternative

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    result["best_confidence"] = df[f"{best}_confidence"].astype(float)
    result["alternative_confidence"] = df[f"{alt}_confidence"].astype(float)

    result["confidence_difference"] = (
        result["alternative_confidence"]
        -
        result["best_confidence"]
    )

    result["absolute_confidence_difference"] = (
        result["confidence_difference"].abs()
    )

    result["confidence_ratio"] = (
        result["alternative_confidence"]
        /
        (result["best_confidence"] + 1e-8)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence transformations
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    result["best_confidence_squared"] = (
        result["best_confidence"] ** 2
    )

    result["alternative_confidence_squared"] = (
        result["alternative_confidence"] ** 2
    )

    result["confidence_difference_squared"] = (
        result["confidence_difference"] ** 2
    )

    result["confidence_product"] = (
        result["best_confidence"]
        *
        result["alternative_confidence"]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prediction agreement
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    result["prediction_agreement"] = (
        df[f"{best}_prediction"].astype(str)
        ==
        df[f"{alt}_prediction"].astype(str)
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # One-hot predicted classes
    #
    # These are predictions, NOT true labels.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    best_pred = df[f"{best}_prediction"].astype(str)
    alt_pred = df[f"{alt}_prediction"].astype(str)

    result["best_predicted_class"] = best_pred
    result["alternative_predicted_class"] = alt_pred

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Pairwise predicted-class relationship
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    result["predicted_class_pair"] = (
        best_pred
        +
        "__TO__"
        +
        alt_pred
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Difference in correctness is NOT included.
    #
    # That would leak the target.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    return result


# =============================================================================
# MODEL BUILDERS
# =============================================================================

def build_logistic_gate(
    categorical_columns: list[str],
    numeric_columns: list[str],
) -> Pipeline:

    numeric_pipeline = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            ),
            (
                "scaler",
                StandardScaler(),
            ),
        ]
    )

    categorical_pipeline = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent"),
            ),
            (
                "onehot",
                OneHotEncoder(
                    handle_unknown="ignore",
                    sparse_output=False,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
        transformers=[
            (
                "numeric",
                numeric_pipeline,
                numeric_columns,
            ),
            (
                "categorical",
                categorical_pipeline,
                categorical_columns,
            ),
        ],
        remainder="drop",
    )

    model = LogisticRegression(
        C=1.0,
        max_iter=2000,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    )

    return Pipeline(
        steps=[
            ("preprocessor", preprocessor),
            ("classifier", model),
        ]
    )


def build_hgb_gate(
    categorical_columns: list[str],
    numeric_columns: list[str],
) -> Pipeline:
    """
    HistGradientBoosting does not directly handle categorical strings
    in this implementation, so this version uses one-hot preprocessing.
    """

    numeric_pipeline = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            ),
        ]
    )

    categorical_pipeline = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent"),
            ),
            (
                "onehot",
                OneHotEncoder(
                    handle_unknown="ignore",
                    sparse_output=False,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
        transformers=[
            (
                "numeric",
                numeric_pipeline,
                numeric_columns,
            ),
            (
                "categorical",
                categorical_pipeline,
                categorical_columns,
            ),
        ],
        remainder="drop",
    )

    model = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
        max_iter=200,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_leaf_nodes=7,
        l2_regularization=1.0,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    )

    return Pipeline(
        steps=[
            ("preprocessor", preprocessor),
            ("classifier", model),
        ]
    )


# =============================================================================
# PREPARE FEATURES
# =============================================================================

def prepare_features(
    X: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[str], list[str]]:

    categorical_columns = [
        "best_predicted_class",
        "alternative_predicted_class",
        "predicted_class_pair",
    ]

    numeric_columns = [
        c
        for c in X.columns
        if c not in categorical_columns
    ]

    return (
        X,
        categorical_columns,
        numeric_columns,
    )


# =============================================================================
# TRAIN ONE GATE
# =============================================================================

def train_gate_oof(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    alternative: str,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:

    section(
        f"TRAINING FOLD-SAFE GATE: "
        f"{BEST_MODEL} -> {alternative}"
    )

    X = build_pair_features(
        df,
        alternative,
    )

    y = build_rescue_target(
        df,
        alternative,
    )

    X, categorical_columns, numeric_columns = prepare_features(X)

    print(f"Feature shape: {X.shape}")

    print(
        f"Rescue opportunities: {int(y.sum())} "
        f"/ {len(y)} "
        f"({100.0 * y.mean():.3f}%)"
    )

    if y.sum() == 0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"No rescue opportunities for {alternative}"
        )

    if y.sum() == len(y):
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"All samples are rescue opportunities for {alternative}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Use the same fold assignment for all gates.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    splitter = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=N_SPLITS,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    )

    probability = np.full(
        len(df),
        np.nan,
        dtype=float,
    )

    fold_ids = np.full(
        len(df),
        -1,
        dtype=int,
    )

    training_rows = []

    for fold_number, (train_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(
        splitter.split(X, y),
        start=1,
    ):

        print()
        print(
            f"Fold {fold_number}/{N_SPLITS}: "
            f"train={len(train_idx)} "
            f"valid={len(valid_idx)}"
        )

        X_train = X.iloc[train_idx]
        X_valid = X.iloc[valid_idx]

        y_train = y[train_idx]
        y_valid = y[valid_idx]

        print(
            f"  train rescue rate: "
            f"{100.0 * y_train.mean():.3f}%"
        )

        print(
            f"  valid rescue rate: "
            f"{100.0 * y_valid.mean():.3f}%"
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Primary model: logistic regression.
        #
        # We deliberately keep the first V3.5 experiment simple.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        gate = build_logistic_gate(
            categorical_columns,
            numeric_columns,
        )

        gate.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
        )

        valid_probability = gate.predict_proba(
            X_valid
        )[:, 1]

        probability[valid_idx] = valid_probability
        fold_ids[valid_idx] = fold_number

        fold_auc = roc_auc_score(
            y_valid,
            valid_probability,
        )

        print(
            f"  gate ROC-AUC: {fold_auc:.6f}"
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Save fold model.
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        fold_model_path = (
            OUTPUT_DIR
            / f"fold_{fold_number}"
            / f"{alternative}_gate.joblib"
        )

        joblib.dump(
            gate,
            fold_model_path,
        )

        print(
            f"  saved: {fold_model_path}"
        )

        training_rows.append(
            {
                "alternative": alternative,
                "fold": fold_number,
                "train_samples": len(train_idx),
                "valid_samples": len(valid_idx),
                "train_rescue_rate": float(y_train.mean()),
                "valid_rescue_rate": float(y_valid.mean()),
                "valid_gate_auc": float(fold_auc),
            }
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate complete OOF coverage.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if np.isnan(probability).any():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "OOF gate probability coverage failed."
        )

    if (fold_ids < 0).any():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Some samples did not receive a fold assignment."
        )

    overall_auc = roc_auc_score(
        y,
        probability,
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"OVERALL OOF GATE ROC-AUC: "
        f"{overall_auc:.6f}"
    )

    output = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "index": df["index"].to_numpy(),
            "alternative": alternative,
            "gate_probability": probability,
            "rescue_target": y,
            "fold": fold_ids,
        }
    )

    return output, {
        "alternative": alternative,
        "overall_oof_auc": float(overall_auc),
        "rescue_opportunities": int(y.sum()),
        "samples": int(len(y)),
        "rescue_rate": float(y.mean()),
        "folds": training_rows,
    }


# =============================================================================
# COMBINE GATES
# =============================================================================

def combine_gate_predictions(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    gate_outputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "index": df["index"].to_numpy(),
            "true_class": df["true_class"].to_numpy(),
            "best_model": BEST_MODEL,
            "best_prediction": df[
                f"{BEST_MODEL}_prediction"
            ].to_numpy(),
            "best_correct": df[
                f"{BEST_MODEL}_correct"
            ].astype(int).to_numpy(),
            "best_confidence": df[
                f"{BEST_MODEL}_confidence"
            ].astype(float).to_numpy(),
        }
    )

    for alternative, gate_df in gate_outputs.items():

        gate_df = gate_df.sort_values(
            "index"
        ).reset_index(drop=True)

        result[f"{alternative}_gate_probability"] = (
            gate_df["gate_probability"].to_numpy()
        )

        result[f"{alternative}_rescue_target"] = (
            gate_df["rescue_target"].astype(int).to_numpy()
        )

        result[f"{alternative}_fold"] = (
            gate_df["fold"].astype(int).to_numpy()
        )

        result[f"{alternative}_prediction"] = df[
            f"{alternative}_prediction"
        ].to_numpy()

        result[f"{alternative}_correct"] = df[
            f"{alternative}_correct"
        ].astype(int).to_numpy()

        result[f"{alternative}_confidence"] = df[
            f"{alternative}_confidence"
        ].astype(float).to_numpy()

    return result


# =============================================================================
# APPLY GATE
# =============================================================================

def apply_gates(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    threshold: float,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    result = df.copy()

    selected_model = np.full(
        len(result),
        BEST_MODEL,
        dtype=object,
    )

    selected_prediction = result[
        "best_prediction"
    ].to_numpy().copy()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine the strongest accepted alternative.
    #
    # If both gates fire, choose the alternative with the larger probability.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_probability = result[
        "resnet50_gate_probability"
    ].to_numpy()

    mobile_probability = result[
        "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability"
    ].to_numpy()

    resnet_accept = (
        resnet_probability >= threshold
    )

    mobile_accept = (
        mobile_probability >= threshold
    )

    both_accept = (
        resnet_accept
        &
        mobile_accept
    )

    choose_resnet = (
        resnet_accept
        &
        (
            (~mobile_accept)
            |
            (
                resnet_probability
                >=
                mobile_probability
            )
        )
    )

    choose_mobile = (
        mobile_accept
        &
        (~choose_resnet)
    )

    selected_model[choose_resnet] = "resnet50"
    selected_model[choose_mobile] = "mobilenet_v3_large"

    selected_prediction[choose_resnet] = result.loc[
        choose_resnet,
        "resnet50_prediction",
    ].to_numpy()

    selected_prediction[choose_mobile] = result.loc[
        choose_mobile,
        "mobilenet_v3_large_prediction",
    ].to_numpy()

    result["v3_5_selected_model"] = selected_model
    result["v3_5_prediction"] = selected_prediction

    result["v3_5_correct"] = (
        result["v3_5_prediction"]
        ==
        result["true_class"]
    ).astype(int)

    result["v3_5_switched"] = (
        selected_model != BEST_MODEL
    ).astype(int)

    result["both_gates_fired"] = (
        both_accept
    ).astype(int)

    return result


# =============================================================================
# EVALUATE THRESHOLD
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_threshold(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    threshold: float,
) -> dict:

    result = apply_gates(
        df,
        threshold,
    )

    best_correct = result[
        "best_correct"
    ].to_numpy()

    selector_correct = result[
        "v3_5_correct"
    ].to_numpy()

    switched = result[
        "v3_5_switched"
    ].to_numpy()

    rescue = (
        (best_correct == 0)
        &
        (selector_correct == 1)
        &
        (switched == 1)
    )

    harm = (
        (best_correct == 1)
        &
        (selector_correct == 0)
        &
        (switched == 1)
    )

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        result["true_class"],
        result["v3_5_prediction"],
    )

    balanced_accuracy = balanced_accuracy_score(
        result["true_class"],
        result["v3_5_prediction"],
    )

    macro_f1 = f1_score(
        result["true_class"],
        result["v3_5_prediction"],
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0,
    )

    best_accuracy = best_correct.mean()

    return {
        "threshold": threshold,
        "samples": len(result),
        "switches": int(switched.sum()),
        "switch_rate": float(switched.mean()),
        "accuracy": float(accuracy),
        "balanced_accuracy": float(balanced_accuracy),
        "macro_f1": float(macro_f1),
        "gain_vs_best": float(accuracy - best_accuracy),
        "rescues": int(rescue.sum()),
        "harms": int(harm.sum()),
        "net_gain": int(rescue.sum() - harm.sum()),
        "both_gates_fired": int(
            result["both_gates_fired"].sum()
        ),
    }


# =============================================================================
# THRESHOLD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def threshold_analysis(
    combined: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("V3.5 OOF THRESHOLD ANALYSIS")

    rows = []

    for threshold in THRESHOLDS:

        metrics = evaluate_threshold(
            combined,
            threshold,
        )

        rows.append(metrics)

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    result = result.sort_values(
        [
            "accuracy",
            "balanced_accuracy",
            "macro_f1",
        ],
        ascending=False,
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.6f}",
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# SAVE FINAL OOF PREDICTIONS
# =============================================================================

def save_oof_predictions(
    combined: pd.DataFrame,
    threshold_table: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("SAVING V3.5 OOF PREDICTIONS")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Important:
    #
    # The threshold is NOT selected as a final scientific test result here.
    #
    # We save the complete probability outputs so that a later evaluation
    # script can apply a properly nested threshold-selection protocol.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    oof_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_5_gate_oof_predictions.csv"
    )

    combined.to_csv(
        oof_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {oof_path}"
    )

    threshold_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_5_threshold_analysis.csv"
    )

    threshold_table.to_csv(
        threshold_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {threshold_path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def save_summary(
    gate_summaries: list[dict],
) -> None:

    rows = []

    for summary in gate_summaries:

        for fold in summary["folds"]:

            rows.append(
                {
                    "alternative": summary["alternative"],
                    "fold": fold["fold"],
                    "train_samples": fold["train_samples"],
                    "valid_samples": fold["valid_samples"],
                    "train_rescue_rate": fold[
                        "train_rescue_rate"
                    ],
                    "valid_rescue_rate": fold[
                        "valid_rescue_rate"
                    ],
                    "valid_gate_auc": fold[
                        "valid_gate_auc"
                    ],
                    "overall_oof_auc": summary[
                        "overall_oof_auc"
                    ],
                    "total_rescue_opportunities": summary[
                        "rescue_opportunities"
                    ],
                }
            )

    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_5_gate_training_summary.csv"
    )

    summary_df.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main() -> None:

    section("V3.5 FOLD-SAFE GATED SWITCH TRAINING")

    print(
        "Objective:"
    )

    print(
        "Learn when an alternative model can rescue "
        "an EfficientNet-V2-S error."
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Best model: {BEST_MODEL}"
    )

    print(
        f"Alternatives: {ALTERNATIVES}"
    )

    print(
        f"CV folds: {N_SPLITS}"
    )

    print(
        f"Random seed: {RANDOM_STATE}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "Gate predictions are generated strictly out-of-fold."
    )

    ensure_output_dir()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = load_data()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Train gates
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    gate_outputs = {}
    gate_summaries = []

    for alternative in ALTERNATIVES:

        gate_oof, summary = train_gate_oof(
            df,
            alternative,
        )

        gate_outputs[alternative] = gate_oof
        gate_summaries.append(summary)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Combine
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("COMBINING FOLD-SAFE GATE PREDICTIONS")

    combined = combine_gate_predictions(
        df,
        gate_outputs,
    )

    print(
        f"Combined shape: {combined.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify OOF coverage
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    required_probability_columns = [
        "resnet50_gate_probability",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability",
    ]

    for column in required_probability_columns:

        coverage = (
            combined[column].notna().mean()
        )

        print(
            f"{column} coverage: "
            f"{coverage:.6f}"
        )

        if coverage != 1.0:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"OOF coverage failed for {column}"
            )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Threshold analysis
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    threshold_table = threshold_analysis(
        combined,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_oof_predictions(
        combined,
        threshold_table,
    )

    save_summary(
        gate_summaries,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate statistics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("GATE OOF STATISTICS")

    for alternative in ALTERNATIVES:

        probability = combined[
            f"{alternative}_gate_probability"
        ].to_numpy()

        target = combined[
            f"{alternative}_rescue_target"
        ].to_numpy()

        auc = roc_auc_score(
            target,
            probability,
        )

        print()
        print(
            alternative
        )

        print(
            f"  Rescue opportunities: "
            f"{int(target.sum())}"
        )

        print(
            f"  Rescue opportunity rate: "
            f"{target.mean():.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"  OOF gate ROC-AUC: "
            f"{auc:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"  Mean probability: "
            f"{probability.mean():.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"  Median probability: "
            f"{np.median(probability):.6f}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final note
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("V3.5 FOLD-SAFE GATE TRAINING COMPLETE")

    print(
        f"Output directory:"
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Important:"
    )

    print(
        "The threshold table is diagnostic."
    )

    print(
        "Do NOT report the best threshold as an unbiased "
        "final V3.5 result."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Next:"
    )

    print(
        "Run evaluate_v3_5_fold_safe_gate.py using these "
        "fold-safe gate probabilities."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
================================================================================
V3.5 FOLD-SAFE GATED SWITCH EVALUATION
================================================================================

Purpose
-------
Evaluate the fold-safe V3.5 rescue gates using their OOF probabilities.

Architecture
------------
Best model:
    efficientnet_v2_s

Primary alternatives:
    resnet50
    mobilenet_v3_large

Decision rule
-------------
If neither gate fires:
    efficientnet_v2_s

If only resnet50 gate fires:
    resnet50

If only mobilenet_v3_large gate fires:
    mobilenet_v3_large

If BOTH gates fire:
    choose the alternative with the HIGHER gate probability.

Important
---------
The gate probabilities are already OOF / fold-safe.

However, choosing the best threshold by looking at these same OOF
predictions is still a model-selection step. Therefore:

    - threshold sweep = diagnostic
    - pre-specified threshold = stronger evaluation
    - nested CV = ideal final scientific estimate

================================================================================
"""

# =============================================================================
# FIND GATE COLUMNS
# =============================================================================

def find_gate_column(df, model_name):
    """
    Find the gate probability column robustly.
    """

    candidates = [
        f"{model_name}_gate_probability",
        f"{model_name}_gate_prob",
        f"{model_name}_probability",
        f"{model_name}_prob",
        f"{model_name}_gate",
    ]

    for col in candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            return col

    # fallback: fuzzy search
    model_token = model_name.lower()

    matches = [
        c
        for c in df.columns
        if model_token in c.lower()
        and "gate" in c.lower()
        and (
            "prob" in c.lower()
            or "score" in c.lower()
        )
    ]

    if len(matches) == 1:
        return matches[0]

    if len(matches) > 1:
        # Prefer probability
        probability_matches = [
            c for c in matches
            if "probability" in c.lower()
        ]

        if len(probability_matches) == 1:
            return probability_matches[0]

    return None


# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION / MERGE
# =============================================================================

def validate_and_merge(v34_df, gate_df):
    section("VALIDATING AND MERGING OOF DATA")

    if "index" not in gate_df.columns:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "V3.5 gate OOF file does not contain 'index'."
        )

    resnet_col = find_gate_column(
        gate_df,
        "resnet50"
    )

    mobile_col = find_gate_column(
        gate_df,
        "mobilenet_v3_large"
    )

    print(f"ResNet gate column:   {resnet_col}")
    print(f"Mobile gate column:   {mobile_col}")

    if resnet_col is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Could not identify resnet50 gate probability column."
        )

    if mobile_col is None:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Could not identify mobilenet_v3_large gate probability column."
        )

    if not gate_df["index"].is_unique:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "V3.5 gate OOF index is not unique."
        )

    merged = v34_df.merge(
        gate_df[
            [
                "index",
                resnet_col,
                mobile_col,
            ]
        ],
        on="index",
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    print(f"Merged shape: {merged.shape}")

    resnet_coverage = (
        merged[resnet_col]
        .notna()
        .mean()
    )

    mobile_coverage = (
        merged[mobile_col]
        .notna()
        .mean()
    )

    print(
        f"ResNet gate coverage: "
        f"{resnet_coverage:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mobile gate coverage: "
        f"{mobile_coverage:.6f}"
    )

    if resnet_coverage < 1.0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Incomplete ResNet gate OOF coverage."
        )

    if mobile_coverage < 1.0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Incomplete Mobile gate OOF coverage."
        )

    merged["resnet_gate_probability"] = (
        pd.to_numeric(
            merged[resnet_col],
            errors="coerce"
        )
    )

    merged["mobilenet_gate_probability"] = (
        pd.to_numeric(
            merged[mobile_col],
            errors="coerce"
        )
    )

    return merged

def validate_model_predictions(df):
    section("VALIDATING MODEL PREDICTION COLUMNS")

    models = [
        BEST_MODEL,
        *ALTERNATIVE_MODELS,
    ]

    required = []

    for model in models:
        required.append(
            f"{model}_prediction"
        )

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Missing model prediction columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"  - {c}"
                for c in missing
            )
        )

    print("All required prediction columns found.")

    return models


# =============================================================================
# V3.5 DECISION RULE
# =============================================================================

def apply_v35_gate(
    df,
    threshold,
):
    """
    Apply the V3.5 gate.

    Decision:

        neither fires
            -> EfficientNet

        only ResNet fires
            -> ResNet

        only Mobile fires
            -> MobileNet

        both fire
            -> choose whichever gate probability is higher
    """

    result = df.copy()

    resnet_prob = (
        result["resnet_gate_probability"]
    )

    mobile_prob = (
        result["mobilenet_gate_probability"]
    )

    resnet_fired = (
        resnet_prob >= threshold
    )

    mobile_fired = (
        mobile_prob >= threshold
    )

    result["resnet_gate_fired"] = (
        resnet_fired
    )

    result["mobilenet_gate_fired"] = (
        mobile_fired
    )

    result["both_gates_fired"] = (
        resnet_fired
        & mobile_fired
    )

    result["v35_selected_model"] = (
        BEST_MODEL
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Only ResNet fires
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    only_resnet = (
        resnet_fired
        & ~mobile_fired
    )

    result.loc[
        only_resnet,
        "v35_selected_model"
    ] = "resnet50"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Only MobileNet fires
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    only_mobile = (
        mobile_fired
        & ~resnet_fired
    )

    result.loc[
        only_mobile,
        "v35_selected_model"
    ] = "mobilenet_v3_large"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # BOTH gates fire
    #
    # Choose whichever gate is more confident.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    both = (
        resnet_fired
        & mobile_fired
    )

    choose_resnet = (
        both
        & (
            resnet_prob
            >= mobile_prob
        )
    )

    choose_mobile = (
        both
        & (
            mobile_prob
            > resnet_prob
        )
    )

    result.loc[
        choose_resnet,
        "v35_selected_model"
    ] = "resnet50"

    result.loc[
        choose_mobile,
        "v35_selected_model"
    ] = "mobilenet_v3_large"

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final prediction
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------

    result["v35_prediction"] = (
        result["efficientnet_v2_s_prediction"]
    )

    resnet_selected = (
        result["v35_selected_model"]
        == "resnet50"
    )

    mobile_selected = (
        result["v35_selected_model"]
        == "mobilenet_v3_large"
    )

    result.loc[
        resnet_selected,
        "v35_prediction"
    ] = result.loc[
        resnet_selected,
        "resnet50_prediction"
    ]

    result.loc[
        mobile_selected,
        "v35_prediction"
    ] = result.loc[
        mobile_selected,
        "mobilenet_v3_large_prediction"
    ]

    result["v35_correct"] = (
        result["v35_prediction"]
        == result["true_class"]
    ).astype(int)

    result["best_correct"] = (
        result[
            "efficientnet_v2_s_correct"
        ]
        .astype(int)
    )

    result["rescue"] = (
        (result["best_correct"] == 0)
        & (result["v35_correct"] == 1)
    )

    result["harm"] = (
        (result["best_correct"] == 1)
        & (result["v35_correct"] == 0)
    )

    result["both_correct"] = (
        (result["best_correct"] == 1)
        & (result["v35_correct"] == 1)
    )

    result["both_wrong"] = (
        (result["best_correct"] == 0)
        & (result["v35_correct"] == 0)
    )

    result["switched"] = (
        result["v35_selected_model"]
        != BEST_MODEL
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# METRICS
# =============================================================================

def calculate_metrics(
    df,
    prediction_column,
):
    y_true = df["true_class"]
    y_pred = df[prediction_column]

    return {
        "accuracy": accuracy_score(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        ),
        "balanced_accuracy": balanced_accuracy_score(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        ),
        "macro_f1": f1_score(
            y_true,
            y_pred,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0,
        ),
    }


# =============================================================================
# BEST MODEL METRICS
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_best_model(df):
    metrics = calculate_metrics(
        df,
        "efficientnet_v2_s_prediction",
    )

    return metrics
