def discover_columns(df):

    subsection("COLUMN DISCOVERY")

    print("All columns:")

    for i, c in enumerate(df.columns):
        print(f"{i:3d}: {c}")

    # We expect the V3.6 evaluator to have stored these columns.
    #
    # To make the script robust, discover alternative names when possible.

    def find_column(candidates, required=True):

        for c in candidates:
            if c in df.columns:
                return c

        if required:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Could not identify required column.\n"
                f"Candidates: {candidates}"
            )

        return None

    cols = {}

    cols["prediction"] = find_column(
        [
            "v36_prediction",
            "final_prediction",
            "prediction",
        ]
    )

    cols["correct"] = find_column(
        [
            "v36_correct",
            "final_correct",
            "correct",
        ]
    )

    cols["selected_model"] = find_column(
        [
            "v36_selected_model",
            "selected_model",
            "model_selected",
            "selector_model",
        ]
    )

    cols["best_prediction"] = find_column(
        [
            "best_prediction",
            "efficientnet_v2_s_prediction",
        ]
    )

    cols["best_correct"] = find_column(
        [
            "best_correct",
            "efficientnet_v2_s_correct",
        ]
    )

    cols["best_confidence"] = find_column(
        [
            "best_confidence",
            "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence",
        ]
    )

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        cols[f"{model}_prediction"] = find_column(
            [
                f"{model}_prediction",
            ]
        )

        cols[f"{model}_correct"] = find_column(
            [
                f"{model}_correct",
            ]
        )

        cols[f"{model}_confidence"] = find_column(
            [
                f"{model}_confidence",
            ]
        )

        cols[f"{model}_gate"] = find_column(
            [
                f"{model}_gate_probability",
                f"{model}_gate",
            ],
            required=False,
        )

    print()
    print("Detected columns:")

    for k, v in cols.items():
        print(f"{k:40s} -> {v}")

    return cols


# =============================================================================
# BUILD TRANSITION TABLE
# =============================================================================

def build_transition_table(df, cols):

    section("BUILDING TRANSITION TABLE")

    x = df.copy()

    x["best_model"] = BEST_MODEL

    x["selected_model_v36"] = x[
        cols["selected_model"]
    ]

    x["true_class_v37"] = x["true_class"]

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine whether V3.6 switched away from EfficientNet.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    x["switched"] = (
        x["selected_model_v36"] != BEST_MODEL
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Alternative selected.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    x["alternative_model"] = np.where(
        x["switched"],
        x["selected_model_v36"],
        "none",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Best model correctness.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    x["best_correct_v37"] = (
        x[cols["best_correct"]].astype(int)
    )

    x["v36_correct_v37"] = (
        x[cols["correct"]].astype(int)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue / harm.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    x["rescue"] = (
        (x["best_correct_v37"] == 0)
        &
        (x["v36_correct_v37"] == 1)
    )

    x["harm"] = (
        (x["best_correct_v37"] == 1)
        &
        (x["v36_correct_v37"] == 0)
    )

    x["both_correct"] = (
        (x["best_correct_v37"] == 1)
        &
        (x["v36_correct_v37"] == 1)
    )

    x["both_wrong"] = (
        (x["best_correct_v37"] == 0)
        &
        (x["v36_correct_v37"] == 0)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence difference.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        conf_col = cols[f"{model}_confidence"]

        x[f"{model}_confidence_difference"] = (
            x[conf_col]
            -
            x[cols["best_confidence"]]
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate information.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        gate_col = cols[f"{model}_gate"]

        if gate_col is not None:
            x[f"{model}_gate"] = pd.to_numeric(
                x[gate_col],
                errors="coerce",
            )
        else:
            x[f"{model}_gate"] = np.nan

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate difference.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    x["gate_difference_mobilenet_minus_resnet"] = (
        x["mobilenet_v3_large_gate"]
        -
        x["resnet50_gate"]
    )

    x["gate_max"] = x[
        [
            "resnet50_gate",
            "mobilenet_v3_large_gate",
        ]
    ].max(axis=1)

    x["gate_margin"] = (
        x["resnet50_gate"]
        -
        x["mobilenet_v3_large_gate"]
    ).abs()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence difference for selected alternative.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    x["selected_confidence"] = np.nan

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        mask = (
            x["selected_model_v36"]
            == model
        )

        x.loc[
            mask,
            "selected_confidence"
        ] = x.loc[
            mask,
            cols[f"{model}_confidence"]
        ]

    x["selected_confidence_difference"] = (
        x["selected_confidence"]
        -
        x[cols["best_confidence"]]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate probability for selected alternative.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    x["selected_gate_probability"] = np.nan

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        mask = (
            x["selected_model_v36"]
            == model
        )

        x.loc[
            mask,
            "selected_gate_probability"
        ] = x.loc[
            mask,
            f"{model}_gate"
        ]

    return x


# =============================================================================
# TRANSITION SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def transition_summary(x):

    section("TRANSITION PROFITABILITY")

    rows = []

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        d = x[
            x["selected_model_v36"] == model
        ]

        n = len(d)
        rescues = int(d["rescue"].sum())
        harms = int(d["harm"].sum())

        rows.append(
            {
                "alternative_model": model,
                "samples": n,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "net_gain": rescues - harms,
                "rescue_rate": (
                    rescues / n
                    if n else 0
                ),
                "harm_rate": (
                    harms / n
                    if n else 0
                ),
                "rescue_to_harm_ratio": (
                    rescues / harms
                    if harms else np.inf
                ),
                "mean_gate_probability": d[
                    "selected_gate_probability"
                ].mean(),
                "mean_confidence_difference": d[
                    "selected_confidence_difference"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR / "transition_profitability.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CLASS × TRANSITION
# =============================================================================

def class_transition_analysis(x):

    section("CLASS × TRANSITION PROFITABILITY")

    rows = []

    for cls in CLASSES:

        for model in ALTERNATIVES:

            d = x[
                (x["true_class_v37"] == cls)
                &
                (x["selected_model_v36"] == model)
            ]

            n = len(d)

            if n == 0:
                continue

            rescues = int(
                d["rescue"].sum()
            )

            harms = int(
                d["harm"].sum()
            )

            rows.append(
                {
                    "true_class": cls,
                    "alternative_model": model,
                    "samples": n,
                    "rescues": rescues,
                    "harms": harms,
                    "net_gain": rescues - harms,
                    "rescue_rate": rescues / n,
                    "harm_rate": harms / n,
                    "mean_gate_probability": d[
                        "selected_gate_probability"
                    ].mean(),
                    "mean_confidence_difference": d[
                        "selected_confidence_difference"
                    ].mean(),
                }
            )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if len(result):

        result = result.sort_values(
            [
                "true_class",
                "net_gain",
            ],
            ascending=[
                True,
                False,
            ],
        )

        print(
            result.to_string(index=False)
        )

    result.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR / "class_transition_profitability.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CLASS SWITCH POLICY
# =============================================================================

def class_switch_policy(x):

    section("CLASS SWITCH POLICY ANALYSIS")

    rows = []

    for cls in CLASSES:

        d = x[
            x["true_class_v37"] == cls
        ]

        if len(d) == 0:
            continue

        switched = d[
            d["switched"]
        ]

        rescues = int(
            switched["rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            switched["harm"].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "true_class": cls,
                "samples": len(d),
                "switched": len(switched),
                "switch_rate": (
                    len(switched) / len(d)
                ),
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "net_gain": rescues - harms,
                "rescue_rate": (
                    rescues / len(switched)
                    if len(switched)
                    else 0
                ),
                "harm_rate": (
                    harms / len(switched)
                    if len(switched)
                    else 0
                ),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR / "class_switch_policy.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# RESCUE VS HARM GATE SEPARATION
# =============================================================================

def gate_separation(x):

    section("GATE PROBABILITY: RESCUE VS HARM")

    switched = x[
        x["switched"]
    ].copy()

    rows = []

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        d = switched[
            switched["selected_model_v36"]
            == model
        ]

        if len(d) == 0:
            continue

        rescue = d[
            d["rescue"]
        ]

        harm = d[
            d["harm"]
        ]

        rows.append(
            {
                "alternative_model": model,
                "rescue_samples": len(rescue),
                "harm_samples": len(harm),
                "rescue_gate_mean": rescue[
                    "selected_gate_probability"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_gate_mean": harm[
                    "selected_gate_probability"
                ].mean(),
                "gate_mean_difference": (
                    rescue[
                        "selected_gate_probability"
                    ].mean()
                    -
                    harm[
                        "selected_gate_probability"
                    ].mean()
                ),
                "rescue_gate_median": rescue[
                    "selected_gate_probability"
                ].median(),
                "harm_gate_median": harm[
                    "selected_gate_probability"
                ].median(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR / "gate_rescue_harm_separation.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CONFIDENCE SEPARATION
# =============================================================================

def confidence_separation(x):

    section("CONFIDENCE DIFFERENCE: RESCUE VS HARM")

    switched = x[
        x["switched"]
    ]

    rescue = switched[
        switched["rescue"]
    ]

    harm = switched[
        switched["harm"]
    ]

    features = [
        "selected_confidence_difference",
        "selected_confidence",
        "best_confidence",
        "gate_max",
        "gate_margin",
    ]

    rows = []

    for feature in features:

        r = rescue[feature].dropna()
        h = harm[feature].dropna()

        rows.append(
            {
                "feature": feature,
                "rescue_mean": r.mean(),
                "harm_mean": h.mean(),
                "mean_difference": (
                    r.mean() - h.mean()
                ),
                "rescue_median": r.median(),
                "harm_median": h.median(),
                "rescue_std": r.std(),
                "harm_std": h.std(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR
        / "confidence_rescue_harm_separation.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# GATE THRESHOLD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def threshold_analysis(x):

    section("ALTERNATIVE-SPECIFIC GATE THRESHOLDS")

    switched = x[
        x["switched"]
    ].copy()

    thresholds = np.arange(
        0.50,
        0.951,
        0.025,
    )

    rows = []

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        d = switched[
            switched["selected_model_v36"]
            == model
        ].copy()

        for threshold in thresholds:

            accepted = d[
                d["selected_gate_probability"]
                >= threshold
            ]

            rescues = int(
                accepted["rescue"].sum()
            )

            harms = int(
                accepted["harm"].sum()
            )

            rows.append(
                {
                    "alternative_model": model,
                    "threshold": threshold,
                    "accepted_switches": len(accepted),
                    "rescues": rescues,
                    "harms": harms,
                    "net_gain": rescues - harms,
                    "rescue_rate": (
                        rescues / len(accepted)
                        if len(accepted)
                        else 0
                    ),
                    "harm_rate": (
                        harms / len(accepted)
                        if len(accepted)
                        else 0
                    ),
                }
            )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.sort_values(
            [
                "alternative_model",
                "net_gain",
            ],
            ascending=[
                True,
                False,
            ],
        ).head(30).to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR / "alternative_gate_thresholds.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CLASS-SPECIFIC THRESHOLD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def class_threshold_analysis(x):

    section("CLASS-SPECIFIC GATE THRESHOLDS")

    switched = x[
        x["switched"]
    ].copy()

    thresholds = [
        0.70,
        0.75,
        0.80,
        0.85,
        0.90,
        0.925,
        0.95,
    ]

    rows = []

    for cls in CLASSES:

        for model in ALTERNATIVES:

            d = switched[
                (switched["true_class_v37"] == cls)
                &
                (
                    switched["selected_model_v36"]
                    == model
                )
            ]

            if len(d) == 0:
                continue

            for threshold in thresholds:

                accepted = d[
                    d["selected_gate_probability"]
                    >= threshold
                ]

                rescues = int(
                    accepted["rescue"].sum()
                )

                harms = int(
                    accepted["harm"].sum()
                )

                rows.append(
                    {
                        "true_class": cls,
                        "alternative_model": model,
                        "threshold": threshold,
                        "accepted_switches": len(accepted),
                        "rescues": rescues,
                        "harms": harms,
                        "net_gain": rescues - harms,
                    }
                )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    result.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR
        / "class_specific_gate_thresholds.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # Print only the most useful rows.
    if len(result):

        best = (
            result.sort_values(
                "net_gain",
                ascending=False,
            )
            .groupby(
                [
                    "true_class",
                    "alternative_model",
                ],
                as_index=False,
            )
            .head(1)
        )

        print(
            best.to_string(index=False)
        )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CANDIDATE V3.7 RULES
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_rule(
    x,
    name,
    rule,
):

    selected = np.full(
        len(x),
        BEST_MODEL,
        dtype=object,
    )

    mask = rule(x)

    selected[mask] = x.loc[
        mask,
        "selected_model_v36"
    ].values

    correct = np.zeros(
        len(x),
        dtype=int,
    )

    # Best model prediction.
    best_mask = (
        selected == BEST_MODEL
    )

    correct[best_mask] = x.loc[
        best_mask,
        "best_correct_v37"
    ].astype(int).values

    # Alternative predictions.
    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        mask_model = (
            selected == model
        )

        if mask_model.any():

            correct[mask_model] = x.loc[
                mask_model,
                f"{model}_correct"
            ].astype(int).values

    y_true = x["true_class_v37"]

    # For balanced accuracy / F1 we need predictions.
    prediction = x["best_prediction"].astype(object).copy()

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        mask_model = (
            selected == model
        )

        prediction.loc[mask_model] = x.loc[
            mask_model,
            f"{model}_prediction"
        ]

    accuracy = accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        prediction,
    )

    balanced = balanced_accuracy_score(
        y_true,
        prediction,
    )

    macro_f1 = f1_score(
        y_true,
        prediction,
        average="macro",
        zero_division=0,
    )

    switches = int(
        (selected != BEST_MODEL).sum()
    )

    best_accuracy = (
        x["best_correct_v37"].mean()
    )

    return {
        "rule": name,
        "switches": switches,
        "switch_rate": switches / len(x),
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "balanced_accuracy": balanced,
        "macro_f1": macro_f1,
        "gain_vs_best": (
            accuracy - best_accuracy
        ),
    }


def candidate_rules(x):

    section("CANDIDATE V3.7 TRANSITION RULES")

    rules = []

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule 1:
    # Only accept MobileNet.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rules.append(
        (
            "mobilenet_only_gate_0.90",
            lambda d:
                (
                    (d["selected_model_v36"]
                     == "mobilenet_v3_large")
                    &
                    (
                        d["selected_gate_probability"]
                        >= 0.90
                    )
                ),
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule 2:
    # MobileNet 0.90, ResNet 0.95.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rules.append(
        (
            "mobilenet_0.90_resnet_0.95",
            lambda d:
                (
                    (
                        (d["selected_model_v36"]
                         == "mobilenet_v3_large")
                        &
                        (
                            d["selected_gate_probability"]
                            >= 0.90
                        )
                    )
                    |
                    (
                        (d["selected_model_v36"]
                         == "resnet50")
                        &
                        (
                            d["selected_gate_probability"]
                            >= 0.95
                        )
                    )
                ),
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule 3:
    # High gate + positive confidence difference.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rules.append(
        (
            "gate_0.90_and_positive_confidence",
            lambda d:
                (
                    (d["selected_gate_probability"] >= 0.90)
                    &
                    (d["selected_confidence_difference"] > 0)
                ),
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule 4:
    # High gate + confidence margin.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rules.append(
        (
            "gate_0.90_and_confidence_margin_0.02",
            lambda d:
                (
                    (d["selected_gate_probability"] >= 0.90)
                    &
                    (d["selected_confidence_difference"] >= 0.02)
                ),
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule 5:
    # Protect AK / DF / SCC / VASC.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    protected = {
        "AK",
        "DF",
        "SCC",
        "VASC",
    }

    rules.append(
        (
            "protect_rare_classes_gate_0.90",
            lambda d:
                (
                    (d["selected_gate_probability"] >= 0.90)
                    &
                    (~d["true_class_v37"].isin(protected))
                ),
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule 6:
    # Only switch to MobileNet for useful classes.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    useful_mobilenet = {
        "NV",
        "BCC",
        "BKL",
        "MEL",
    }

    rules.append(
        (
            "mobilenet_class_aware",
            lambda d:
                (
                    (d["selected_model_v36"]
                     == "mobilenet_v3_large")
                    &
                    (d["selected_gate_probability"] >= 0.90)
                    &
                    d["true_class_v37"].isin(
                        useful_mobilenet
                    )
                ),
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rule 7:
    # Strong MobileNet, very strong ResNet.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rules.append(
        (
            "mobilenet_0.90_resnet_0.97",
            lambda d:
                (
                    (
                        (d["selected_model_v36"]
                         == "mobilenet_v3_large")
                        &
                        (
                            d["selected_gate_probability"]
                            >= 0.90
                        )
                    )
                    |
                    (
                        (d["selected_model_v36"]
                         == "resnet50")
                        &
                        (
                            d["selected_gate_probability"]
                            >= 0.97
                        )
                    )
                ),
        )
    )

    results = []

    for name, rule in rules:

        try:

            result = evaluate_rule(
                x,
                name,
                rule,
            )

            results.append(result)

        except Exception as exc:

            warnings.warn(
                f"Rule '{name}' failed: {exc}"
            )

    result_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

    if len(result_df):

        result_df = result_df.sort_values(
            "accuracy",
            ascending=False,
        )

        print(
            result_df.to_string(index=False)
        )

    result_df.to_csv(
        OUT_DIR / "candidate_v37_rules.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result_df

def final_recommendation(
    transition_df,
    class_df,
    rule_df,
):

    section("V3.7 RULE RECOMMENDATION")

    print(
        "IMPORTANT: This recommendation is diagnostic."
    )
    print(
        "It must be validated with fold-safe / nested evaluation."
    )

    if len(transition_df):

        print()
        print("Transition ranking:")

        print(
            transition_df[
                [
                    "alternative_model",
                    "samples",
                    "rescues",
                    "harms",
                    "net_gain",
                    "rescue_to_harm_ratio",
                ]
            ].sort_values(
                "net_gain",
                ascending=False,
            ).to_string(index=False)
        )

    if len(rule_df):

        print()
        print("Candidate rule ranking:")

        print(
            rule_df[
                [
                    "rule",
                    "switches",
                    "accuracy",
                    "balanced_accuracy",
                    "macro_f1",
                    "gain_vs_best",
                ]
            ].to_string(index=False)
        )

        best = rule_df.iloc[0]

        print()
        print(
            "Top diagnostic rule:",
            best["rule"],
        )

        print(
            f"Diagnostic accuracy: "
            f"{best['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Diagnostic gain vs best: "
            f"{best['gain_vs_best']:+.6f}"
        )

    print()
    print("Recommended V3.7 direction:")
    print()
    print("1. Prefer MobileNetV3-Large over ResNet50.")
    print("2. Require a high gate probability before switching.")
    print("3. Add a confidence-based confirmation.")
    print("4. Protect classes with consistently harmful transitions.")
    print("5. Validate the resulting rule inside fold-safe/nested evaluation.")
    print()
    print(
        "DO NOT select the final V3.7 rule from this diagnostic alone."
    )

def main():

    df = load_data()

    cols = discover_columns(
        df
    )

    x = build_transition_table(
        df,
        cols,
    )

    transition_df = transition_summary(
        x
    )

    class_df = class_transition_analysis(
        x
    )

    class_switch_policy(
        x
    )

    gate_separation(
        x
    )

    confidence_separation(
        x
    )

    threshold_analysis(
        x
    )

    class_threshold_analysis(
        x
    )

    rule_df = candidate_rules(
        x
    )

    final_recommendation(
        transition_df,
        class_df,
        rule_df,
    )

    save_full_table(
        x
    )

    section("V3.7 TRANSITION RULE ANALYSIS COMPLETE")

    print()
    print("Output directory:")
    print(OUT_DIR)

    print()
    print("Important files:")

    files = [
        "transition_profitability.csv",
        "class_transition_profitability.csv",
        "class_switch_policy.csv",
        "gate_rescue_harm_separation.csv",
        "confidence_rescue_harm_separation.csv",
        "alternative_gate_thresholds.csv",
        "class_specific_gate_thresholds.csv",
        "candidate_v37_rules.csv",
        "v3_7_transition_analysis_full.csv",
    ]

    for i, name in enumerate(files, 1):
        print(
            f"{i}. {OUT_DIR / name}"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.7 Inference-Valid Nested Evaluation
======================================

V3.7 selective transition gate.

Core design
-----------
Best model:
    EfficientNet-V2-S

Alternatives:
    MobileNetV3-Large
    ResNet50

Decision uses ONLY information available at inference:

    - EfficientNet prediction
    - EfficientNet confidence
    - alternative prediction
    - alternative confidence
    - alternative gate probability

IMPORTANT
---------
true_class is NEVER used to decide whether to switch.

true_class is used ONLY AFTER the prediction has been generated
to calculate rescue / harm / accuracy metrics.

Candidate rules
---------------

V3.7-A:
    MobileNet gate >= 0.90
    AND MobileNet confidence > EfficientNet confidence

V3.7-B:
    predicted-class-aware MobileNet

    protected predicted classes:
        AK, DF, SCC, VASC

    protected:
        MobileNet gate >= 0.95
        AND confidence advantage

    normal:
        MobileNet gate >= 0.90
        AND confidence advantage

V3.7-C:
    predicted-class-aware MobileNet + ResNet

    MobileNet:
        normal gate >= 0.90
        protected gate >= 0.95
        confidence advantage

    ResNet:
        normal gate >= 0.95
        protected gate >= 0.97
        confidence advantage

    MobileNet gets priority.

No threshold sweep is performed.
No new neural network is trained.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, Tuple

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    f1_score,
)

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

V36_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_6_nested"
    / "evaluation"
    / "v3_6_nested_oof_sample_results.csv"
)

V34_FILE = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_4_clean_cv"
    / "evaluation"
    / "v3_4_clean_oof_sample_results.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_7_nested"
)

BEST_MODEL = "efficientnet_v2_s"

MOBILE = "mobilenet_v3_large"
RESNET = "resnet50"

MOBILE_GATE_NORMAL = 0.90
MOBILE_GATE_PROTECTED = 0.95

RESNET_GATE_NORMAL = 0.95
RESNET_GATE_PROTECTED = 0.97

PROTECTED_CLASSES = {
    "AK",
    "DF",
    "SCC",
    "VASC",
}


# =============================================================================
# DISPLAY
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:

    print()
    print("-" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 80)


# =============================================================================
# SCHEMA
# =============================================================================

def require_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: list[str],
    name: str,
) -> None:

    missing = [
        c for c in columns
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} is missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"  - {c}"
                for c in missing
            )
        )


# =============================================================================
# LOAD
# =============================================================================

def load_results() -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:

    section("LOADING V3.6 NESTED OOF RESULTS")

    print(f"File: {V36_FILE}")

    if not V36_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"V3.6 file not found:\n{V36_FILE}"
        )

    v36 = pd.read_csv(V36_FILE)

    print(f"Shape: {v36.shape}")

    section("LOADING V3.4 OOF RESULTS")

    print(f"File: {V34_FILE}")

    if not V34_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"V3.4 file not found:\n{V34_FILE}"
        )

    v34 = pd.read_csv(V34_FILE)

    print(f"Shape: {v34.shape}")

    return v36, v34


# =============================================================================
# SCHEMA VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_schema(
    v36: pd.DataFrame,
    v34: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Tuple[str, str]:

    section("VALIDATING INPUT SCHEMA")

    required_v36 = [

        "index",
        "true_class",

        "best_prediction",
        "best_correct",
        "best_confidence",

        "resnet50_prediction",
        "resnet50_correct",
        "resnet50_confidence",
        "resnet50_gate_probability",

        "mobilenet_v3_large_prediction",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_correct",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_confidence",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability",

        "v36_prediction",
        "v36_correct",

        "switched",
        "rescue",
        "harm",

        "outer_fold",
    ]

    require_columns(
        v36,
        required_v36,
        "V3.6 nested OOF results",
    )

    if "index" not in v34.columns:

        raise ValueError(
            "V3.4 is missing index column."
        )

    prediction_candidates = [
        "v34_prediction",
        "prediction",
        "selected_prediction",
        "selector_prediction",
        "final_prediction",
    ]

    correct_candidates = [
        "v34_correct",
        "correct",
        "selected_correct",
        "selector_correct",
        "final_correct",
    ]

    prediction_col = next(
        (
            c for c in prediction_candidates
            if c in v34.columns
        ),
        None,
    )

    correct_col = next(
        (
            c for c in correct_candidates
            if c in v34.columns
        ),
        None,
    )

    if prediction_col is None:

        raise ValueError(
            "Unable to identify V3.4 prediction column.\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"{i}: {c}"
                for i, c in enumerate(v34.columns)
            )
        )

    if correct_col is None:

        raise ValueError(
            "Unable to identify V3.4 correct column.\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"{i}: {c}"
                for i, c in enumerate(v34.columns)
            )
        )

    print("V3.6 schema: PASSED")

    print(
        f"V3.4 prediction column: {prediction_col}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.4 correct column: {correct_col}"
    )

    print("V3.4 schema: PASSED")

    return prediction_col, correct_col


# =============================================================================
# MERGE
# =============================================================================

def merge_results(
    v36: pd.DataFrame,
    v34: pd.DataFrame,
    prediction_col: str,
    correct_col: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("MERGING V3.6 AND V3.4 RESULTS")

    v34_small = v34[
        [
            "index",
            prediction_col,
            correct_col,
        ]
    ].copy()

    v34_small = v34_small.rename(
        columns={
            prediction_col:
                "v34_prediction",

            correct_col:
                "v34_correct",
        }
    )

    if v36["index"].duplicated().any():

        raise ValueError(
            "V3.6 contains duplicated indices."
        )

    if v34_small["index"].duplicated().any():

        raise ValueError(
            "V3.4 contains duplicated indices."
        )

    df = v36.merge(
        v34_small,
        on="index",
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    print(
        f"Merged shape: {df.shape}"
    )

    coverage = (
        df["v34_prediction"]
        .notna()
        .mean()
    )

    print(
        f"V3.4 coverage: {coverage:.4f}"
    )

    if coverage < 1.0:

        raise ValueError(
            "V3.4 coverage incomplete."
        )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# METRICS
# =============================================================================

def prediction_metrics(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    prediction_column: str,
) -> Dict[str, float]:

    return {

        "accuracy":
            accuracy_score(
                df["true_class"],
                df[prediction_column],
            ),

        "balanced_accuracy":
            balanced_accuracy_score(
                df["true_class"],
                df[prediction_column],
            ),

        "macro_f1":
            f1_score(
                df["true_class"],
                df[prediction_column],
                average="macro",
                zero_division=0,
            ),
    }


# =============================================================================
# INITIALIZE
# =============================================================================

def initialize_rule(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    out = df.copy()

    out["v37_prediction"] = (
        out["best_prediction"]
    )

    out["v37_selected_model"] = (
        BEST_MODEL
    )

    out["v37_switched"] = False

    out["v37_rescue"] = False

    out["v37_harm"] = False

    out["v37_transition"] = "keep"

    return out


# =============================================================================
# APPLY SWITCH
# =============================================================================

def apply_switch(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    mask: pd.Series,
    alternative: str,
) -> None:

    prediction_column = (
        f"{alternative}_prediction"
    )

    df.loc[
        mask,
        "v37_prediction"
    ] = df.loc[
        mask,
        prediction_column
    ]

    df.loc[
        mask,
        "v37_selected_model"
    ] = alternative

    df.loc[
        mask,
        "v37_switched"
    ] = True

    df.loc[
        mask,
        "v37_transition"
    ] = (
        BEST_MODEL
        + "_to_"
        + alternative
    )


# =============================================================================
# FINALIZE
# =============================================================================

def finalize_rule(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    out = df.copy()

    out["v37_rescue"] = (

        out["v37_switched"]

        & ~out["best_correct"].astype(bool)

        & (
            out["v37_prediction"]
            == out["true_class"]
        )
    )

    out["v37_harm"] = (

        out["v37_switched"]

        & out["best_correct"].astype(bool)

        & (
            out["v37_prediction"]
            != out["true_class"]
        )
    )

    return out


# =============================================================================
# V3.7-A
# =============================================================================

def rule_v37_a(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    """
    V3.7-A

    MobileNet:

        gate >= 0.90
        confidence > EfficientNet confidence
    """

    out = initialize_rule(df)

    mobile_mask = (

        out["mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability"]
        >= MOBILE_GATE_NORMAL

    ) & (

        out["mobilenet_v3_large_confidence"]
        > out["best_confidence"]
    )

    apply_switch(
        out,
        mobile_mask,
        MOBILE,
    )

    return finalize_rule(out)


# =============================================================================
# V3.7-B
# =============================================================================

def rule_v37_b(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    """
    V3.7-B

    Class-aware using ONLY EfficientNet's predicted class.

    Protected predictions:

        AK
        DF
        SCC
        VASC

    Normal predictions:

        gate >= 0.90

    Protected predictions:

        gate >= 0.95

    Both require:

        alternative confidence >
        EfficientNet confidence
    """

    out = initialize_rule(df)

    predicted_class = (
        out["best_prediction"]
    )

    protected = (
        predicted_class.isin(
            PROTECTED_CLASSES
        )
    )

    normal = ~protected

    mobile_gate = np.where(
        protected,
        MOBILE_GATE_PROTECTED,
        MOBILE_GATE_NORMAL,
    )

    mobile_mask = (

        out["mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability"]
        >= mobile_gate

    ) & (

        out["mobilenet_v3_large_confidence"]
        > out["best_confidence"]
    )

    mobile_mask = pd.Series(
        mobile_mask,
        index=out.index,
    )

    apply_switch(
        out,
        mobile_mask,
        MOBILE,
    )

    return finalize_rule(out)


# =============================================================================
# V3.7-C
# =============================================================================

def rule_v37_c(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    """
    V3.7-C

    Class-aware MobileNet + ResNet.

    MobileNet has priority.

    Normal:

        MobileNet gate >= 0.90
        ResNet gate >= 0.95

    Protected:

        MobileNet gate >= 0.95
        ResNet gate >= 0.97

    Both require confidence advantage.
    """

    out = initialize_rule(df)

    predicted_class = (
        out["best_prediction"]
    )

    protected = (
        predicted_class.isin(
            PROTECTED_CLASSES
        )
    )

    mobile_gate = np.where(
        protected,
        MOBILE_GATE_PROTECTED,
        MOBILE_GATE_NORMAL,
    )

    resnet_gate = np.where(
        protected,
        RESNET_GATE_PROTECTED,
        RESNET_GATE_NORMAL,
    )

    mobile_mask = (

        out["mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability"]
        >= mobile_gate

    ) & (

        out["mobilenet_v3_large_confidence"]
        > out["best_confidence"]
    )

    mobile_mask = pd.Series(
        mobile_mask,
        index=out.index,
    )

    resnet_mask = (

        out["resnet50_gate_probability"]
        >= resnet_gate

    ) & (

        out["resnet50_confidence"]
        > out["best_confidence"]
    )

    resnet_mask = pd.Series(
        resnet_mask,
        index=out.index,
    )

    apply_switch(
        out,
        mobile_mask,
        MOBILE,
    )

    apply_switch(
        out,
        resnet_mask & ~mobile_mask,
        RESNET,
    )

    return finalize_rule(out)


# =============================================================================
# RULE REGISTRY
# =============================================================================

RULES = {

    "V3.7-A_mobile_gate_0.90_confidence":
        rule_v37_a,

    "V3.7-B_predicted_class_aware_mobile":
        rule_v37_b,

    "V3.7-C_predicted_class_aware_mobile_resnet":
        rule_v37_c,
}


# =============================================================================
# EVALUATE RULE
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_rule(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    name: str,
    function,
) -> Tuple[Dict[str, float], pd.DataFrame]:

    result = function(df)

    metrics = prediction_metrics(
        result,
        "v37_prediction",
    )

    switches = int(
        result["v37_switched"].sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        result["v37_rescue"].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        result["v37_harm"].sum()
    )

    metrics.update({

        "rule": name,

        "samples":
            len(result),

        "switches":
            switches,

        "switch_rate":
            switches / len(result),

        "rescues":
            rescues,

        "harms":
            harms,

        "net_gain":
            rescues - harms,

        "rescue_rate":
            rescues / switches
            if switches else 0.0,

        "harm_rate":
            harms / switches
            if switches else 0.0,

        "rescue_to_harm":
            rescues / harms
            if harms else np.inf,
    })

    return metrics, result


# =============================================================================
# BASELINES
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_baselines(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BASELINE PERFORMANCE")

    rows = []

    baselines = {

        "Best Single / EfficientNet":
            "best_prediction",

        "V3.4":
            "v34_prediction",

        "V3.6":
            "v36_prediction",
    }

    for name, column in baselines.items():

        metrics = prediction_metrics(
            df,
            column,
        )

        rows.append({

            "method":
                name,

            **metrics,
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.6f}",
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# OUTER FOLD
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_outer_folds(
    rule_results: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("OUTER-FOLD PERFORMANCE")

    rows = []

    for rule_name, result in rule_results.items():

        for fold, fold_df in result.groupby(
            "outer_fold",
            sort=True,
        ):

            metrics = prediction_metrics(
                fold_df,
                "v37_prediction",
            )

            switches = int(
                fold_df[
                    "v37_switched"
                ].sum()
            )

            rescues = int(
                fold_df[
                    "v37_rescue"
                ].sum()
            )

            harms = int(
                fold_df[
                    "v37_harm"
                ].sum()
            )

            rows.append({

                "rule":
                    rule_name,

                "outer_fold":
                    fold,

                "samples":
                    len(fold_df),

                **metrics,

                "switches":
                    switches,

                "switch_rate":
                    switches / len(fold_df),

                "rescues":
                    rescues,

                "harms":
                    harms,

                "net_gain":
                    rescues - harms,
            })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.6f}",
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# PER CLASS
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_per_class(
    rule_results: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("PER-CLASS PERFORMANCE")

    rows = []

    for rule_name, result in rule_results.items():

        for cls, class_df in result.groupby(
            "true_class",
            sort=True,
        ):

            correct = (
                class_df["v37_prediction"]
                == class_df["true_class"]
            )

            switches = int(
                class_df["v37_switched"].sum()
            )

            rescues = int(
                class_df["v37_rescue"].sum()
            )

            harms = int(
                class_df["v37_harm"].sum()
            )

            rows.append({

                "rule":
                    rule_name,

                "true_class":
                    cls,

                "samples":
                    len(class_df),

                "accuracy":
                    correct.mean(),

                "switches":
                    switches,

                "rescues":
                    rescues,

                "harms":
                    harms,

                "net_gain":
                    rescues - harms,
            })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.6f}",
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# TRANSITIONS
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_transitions(
    rule_results: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("TRANSITION PERFORMANCE")

    rows = []

    for rule_name, result in rule_results.items():

        switched = result[
            result["v37_switched"]
        ].copy()

        if switched.empty:
            continue

        grouped = (
            switched
            .groupby(
                "v37_selected_model"
            )
            .agg(
                samples=(
                    "index",
                    "size",
                ),
                rescues=(
                    "v37_rescue",
                    "sum",
                ),
                harms=(
                    "v37_harm",
                    "sum",
                ),
            )
            .reset_index()
        )

        grouped["net_gain"] = (
            grouped["rescues"]
            - grouped["harms"]
        )

        grouped["rescue_rate"] = (
            grouped["rescues"]
            / grouped["samples"]
        )

        grouped["harm_rate"] = (
            grouped["harms"]
            / grouped["samples"]
        )

        grouped.insert(
            0,
            "rule",
            rule_name,
        )

        rows.append(grouped)

    if not rows:

        return pd.DataFrame()

    result = pd.concat(
        rows,
        ignore_index=True,
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.6f}",
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# SAVE
# =============================================================================

def save_predictions(
    rule_results: Dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
) -> None:

    prediction_dir = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rule_predictions"
    )

    prediction_dir.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    columns = [

        "index",
        "true_class",
        "outer_fold",

        "best_prediction",
        "best_confidence",

        "v34_prediction",
        "v36_prediction",

        "v37_prediction",
        "v37_selected_model",

        "v37_switched",
        "v37_rescue",
        "v37_harm",

        "v37_transition",
    ]

    for rule_name, result in rule_results.items():

        safe_name = (
            rule_name
            .replace("/", "_")
            .replace(" ", "_")
        )

        path = (
            prediction_dir
            / f"{safe_name}.csv"
        )

        available = [
            c for c in columns
            if c in result.columns
        ]

        result[
            available
        ].to_csv(
            path,
            index=False,
        )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main() -> None:

    section(
        "V3.7 INFERENCE-VALID NESTED EVALUATION"
    )

    print(
        f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Best model: {BEST_MODEL}"
    )

    print(
        "Alternatives:",
        [RESNET, MOBILE],
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "Class protection uses EfficientNet's"
        " predicted class."
    )

    print(
        "Ground-truth class is NEVER used"
        " for switching decisions."
    )

    print(
        "Ground truth is used only for evaluation."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # LOAD
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    v36, v34 = load_results()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # VALIDATE
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    v34_prediction_col, v34_correct_col = (
        validate_schema(
            v36,
            v34,
        )
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # MERGE
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = merge_results(
        v36,
        v34,
        v34_prediction_col,
        v34_correct_col,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # BASELINES
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    baseline_results = (
        evaluate_baselines(df)
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # RULE INFORMATION
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("V3.7 RULE CONFIGURATION")

    print(
        "V3.7-A:"
    )

    print(
        "  MobileNet gate >= 0.90"
    )

    print(
        "  MobileNet confidence > EfficientNet"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "V3.7-B:"
    )

    print(
        "  Protected predicted classes:",
        sorted(PROTECTED_CLASSES),
    )

    print(
        "  Normal MobileNet gate >= 0.90"
    )

    print(
        "  Protected MobileNet gate >= 0.95"
    )

    print(
        "  Confidence advantage required"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "V3.7-C:"
    )

    print(
        "  MobileNet normal gate >= 0.90"
    )

    print(
        "  MobileNet protected gate >= 0.95"
    )

    print(
        "  ResNet normal gate >= 0.95"
    )

    print(
        "  ResNet protected gate >= 0.97"
    )

    print(
        "  Confidence advantage required"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # EVALUATE
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "EVALUATING INFERENCE-VALID V3.7 RULES"
    )

    rule_metrics = []

    rule_results = {}

    for rule_name, function in RULES.items():

        print()
        print(
            f"Evaluating: {rule_name}"
        )

        metrics, result = evaluate_rule(
            df,
            rule_name,
            function,
        )

        rule_metrics.append(
            metrics
        )

        rule_results[
            rule_name
        ] = result

    rule_results_df = pd.DataFrame(
        rule_metrics
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gain vs best
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    best_accuracy = (
        baseline_results.loc[
            baseline_results["method"]
            == "Best Single / EfficientNet",
            "accuracy",
        ].iloc[0]
    )

    v34_accuracy = (
        baseline_results.loc[
            baseline_results["method"]
            == "V3.4",
            "accuracy",
        ].iloc[0]
    )

    rule_results_df[
        "gain_vs_best"
    ] = (
        rule_results_df["accuracy"]
        - best_accuracy
    )

    rule_results_df[
        "gain_vs_v34"
    ] = (
        rule_results_df["accuracy"]
        - v34_accuracy
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Ranking
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.7 RULE RANKING"
    )

    columns = [

        "rule",
        "samples",

        "switches",
        "switch_rate",

        "rescues",
        "harms",
        "net_gain",

        "accuracy",
        "balanced_accuracy",
        "macro_f1",

        "gain_vs_best",
        "gain_vs_v34",

        "rescue_to_harm",
    ]

    ranking = (
        rule_results_df[
            columns
        ]
        .sort_values(
            [
                "accuracy",
                "balanced_accuracy",
                "macro_f1",
            ],
            ascending=False,
        )
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    print(
        ranking.to_string(
            index=False,
            float_format=lambda x:
                f"{x:.6f}",
        )
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # OUTER FOLD
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    outer_results = (
        evaluate_outer_folds(
            rule_results
        )
    )

    # PER CLASS
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    class_results = (

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.8 ERROR-CONDITIONAL TRANSITION ANALYSIS

Purpose
-------
Analyze prediction-to-prediction transitions between the best model
(EfficientNet-V2-S) and alternative models.

The goal is to identify:
    EfficientNet prediction -> Alternative prediction
transitions that are consistently useful or harmful.

This is diagnostic only.

No model is trained.
No final threshold is selected.
No unbiased final performance is claimed.
Ground-truth labels are used ONLY to measure rescue/harm outcomes.

Input
-----
V3.6 nested OOF sample results:
    Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/
    outputs/pairwise_v3_6_nested/evaluation/
    v3_6_nested_oof_sample_results.csv

Outputs
-------
Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/
outputs/pairwise_v3_8_error_transitions/

    transition_profitability_all.csv
    transition_profitability_mobilenet.csv
    transition_profitability_resnet.csv

    class_transition_profitability.csv
    transition_confidence_analysis.csv
    transition_gate_analysis.csv

    safe_transitions.csv
    harmful_transitions.csv

    source_class_profitability.csv
    target_class_profitability.csv

    v3_8_error_transition_analysis_full.csv
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

INPUT_PATH = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_6_nested"
    / "evaluation"
    / "v3_6_nested_oof_sample_results.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_8_error_transitions"
)

BEST_MODEL = "efficientnet_v2_s"

ALTERNATIVES = [
    "resnet50",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
]

MIN_TRANSITION_SAMPLES = 3


# =============================================================================
# DISPLAY HELPERS
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("-" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 80)


# =============================================================================
# COLUMN DISCOVERY
# =============================================================================

def find_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: list[str],
    description: str,
) -> str:
    """
    Find the first matching column from a list of candidates.
    """

    for column in candidates:
        if column in df.columns:
            return column

    raise ValueError(
        f"Could not find {description}.\n"
        f"Expected one of:\n"
        + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in candidates)
    )


def discover_columns(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, str]:

    columns = {}

    columns["true_class"] = find_column(
        df,
        [
            "true_class",
            "target",
            "label",
            "y_true",
        ],
        "true-class column",
    )

    columns["best_prediction"] = find_column(
        df,
        [
            "best_prediction",
            "prediction",
            "v36_prediction",
        ],
        "best-model prediction column",
    )

    columns["best_correct"] = find_column(
        df,
        [
            "best_correct",
            "correct",
            "v36_correct",
        ],
        "best-model correctness column",
    )

    columns["best_confidence"] = find_column(
        df,
        [
            "best_confidence",
        ],
        "best-model confidence column",
    )

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        columns[f"{model}_prediction"] = find_column(
            df,
            [
                f"{model}_prediction",
            ],
            f"{model} prediction column",
        )

        columns[f"{model}_correct"] = find_column(
            df,
            [
                f"{model}_correct",
            ],
            f"{model} correctness column",
        )

        columns[f"{model}_confidence"] = find_column(
            df,
            [
                f"{model}_confidence",
            ],
            f"{model} confidence column",
        )

        columns[f"{model}_gate"] = find_column(
            df,
            [
                f"{model}_gate_probability",
                f"{model}_gate",
            ],
            f"{model} gate probability column",
        )

    return columns


# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_input(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:

    section("VALIDATING INPUT")

    if df.empty:
        raise ValueError("Input dataframe is empty.")

    print(f"Rows: {len(df):,}")
    print(f"Columns: {len(df.columns)}")

    if df["true_class"].isna().any():
        raise ValueError("true_class contains missing values.")

    for column in [
        "best_prediction",
        "best_correct",
        "best_confidence",
    ]:
        if df[column].isna().any():
            raise ValueError(
                f"{column} contains missing values."
            )

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        for suffix in [
            "prediction",
            "correct",
            "confidence",
            "gate",
        ]:
            column = f"{model}_{suffix}"

            if df[column].isna().any():
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{column} contains missing values."
                )

    print("Input validation: PASSED")


# =============================================================================
# BUILD TRANSITION DATA
# =============================================================================

def build_transition_data(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: dict[str, str],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING ERROR-CONDITIONAL TRANSITIONS")

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    out["true_class"] = df[columns["true_class"]]

    out["best_prediction"] = df[
        columns["best_prediction"]
    ]

    out["best_correct"] = (
        df[columns["best_correct"]]
        .astype(bool)
    )

    out["best_confidence"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["best_confidence"]],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        out[f"{model}_prediction"] = df[
            columns[f"{model}_prediction"]
        ]

        out[f"{model}_correct"] = (
            df[columns[f"{model}_correct"]]
            .astype(bool)
        )

        out[f"{model}_confidence"] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[columns[f"{model}_confidence"]],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        out[f"{model}_gate"] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[columns[f"{model}_gate"]],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        out[f"{model}_confidence_difference"] = (
            out[f"{model}_confidence"]
            - out["best_confidence"]
        )

        # A transition only matters when the alternative
        # predicts something different.
        out[f"{model}_disagrees"] = (
            out[f"{model}_prediction"]
            != out["best_prediction"]
        )

        # Rescue:
        # Best model is wrong and alternative is correct.
        out[f"{model}_rescue"] = (
            (~out["best_correct"])
            & out[f"{model}_correct"]
            & out[f"{model}_disagrees"]
        )

        # Harm:
        # Best model is correct and alternative is wrong.
        out[f"{model}_harm"] = (
            out["best_correct"]
            & (~out[f"{model}_correct"])
            & out[f"{model}_disagrees"]
        )

        # Neutral disagreement:
        # Both models wrong or both correct.
        out[f"{model}_neutral_disagreement"] = (
            out[f"{model}_disagrees"]
            & ~out[f"{model}_rescue"]
            & ~out[f"{model}_harm"]
        )

    print(
        f"Transition dataframe created: "
        f"{out.shape}"
    )

    return out


# =============================================================================
# TRANSITION PROFITABILITY
# =============================================================================

def calculate_transition_profitability(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
    model: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    prediction_column = f"{model}_prediction"

    disagreement = data[
        f"{model}_disagrees"
    ]

    working = data.loc[
        disagreement
    ].copy()

    if working.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    group_columns = [
        "best_prediction",
        prediction_column,
    ]

    rows = []

    for (
        source_class,
        target_class,
    ), group in working.groupby(
        group_columns,
        dropna=False,
    ):

        samples = len(group)

        rescues = int(
            group[f"{model}_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            group[f"{model}_harm"].sum()
        )

        net_gain = rescues - harms

        rescue_rate = (
            rescues / samples
            if samples
            else 0.0
        )

        harm_rate = (
            harms / samples
            if samples
            else 0.0
        )

        if harms == 0:
            ratio = (
                np.inf
                if rescues > 0
                else 0.0
            )
        else:
            ratio = rescues / harms

        rows.append(
            {
                "alternative_model": model,
                "source_class": source_class,
                "target_class": target_class,
                "samples": samples,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "net_gain": net_gain,
                "rescue_rate": rescue_rate,
                "harm_rate": harm_rate,
                "rescue_to_harm_ratio": ratio,
                "mean_gate_probability": group[
                    f"{model}_gate"
                ].mean(),
                "mean_alternative_confidence": group[
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                ].mean(),
                "mean_best_confidence": group[
                    "best_confidence"
                ].mean(),
                "mean_confidence_difference": group[
                    f"{model}_confidence_difference"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if not result.empty:
        result = result.sort_values(
            [
                "net_gain",
                "rescue_to_harm_ratio",
                "samples",
            ],
            ascending=[
                False,
                False,
                False,
            ],
        ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CLASS × TRANSITION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def calculate_class_transition_profitability(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    rows = []

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        prediction_column = f"{model}_prediction"

        disagreement = data[
            f"{model}_disagrees"
        ]

        working = data.loc[
            disagreement
        ].copy()

        if working.empty:
            continue

        grouped = working.groupby(
            [
                "true_class",
                "best_prediction",
                prediction_column,
            ],
            dropna=False,
        )

        for (
            true_class,
            source_class,
            target_class,
        ), group in grouped:

            samples = len(group)

            rescues = int(
                group[f"{model}_rescue"].sum()
            )

            harms = int(
                group[f"{model}_harm"].sum()
            )

            net_gain = rescues - harms

            rows.append(
                {
                    "alternative_model": model,
                    "true_class": true_class,
                    "source_class": source_class,
                    "target_class": target_class,
                    "samples": samples,
                    "rescues": rescues,
                    "harms": harms,
                    "net_gain": net_gain,
                    "rescue_rate": (
                        rescues / samples
                        if samples
                        else 0.0
                    ),
                    "harm_rate": (
                        harms / samples
                        if samples
                        else 0.0
                    ),
                    "mean_gate_probability": group[
                        f"{model}_gate"
                    ].mean(),
                    "mean_confidence_difference": group[
                        f"{model}_confidence_difference"
                    ].mean(),
                }
            )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if not result.empty:
        result = result.sort_values(
            [
                "net_gain",
                "samples",
            ],
            ascending=[
                False,
                False,
            ],
        ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return result


# =============================================================================
# CONFIDENCE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def calculate_confidence_analysis(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    rows = []

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        rescue = data[
            f"{model}_rescue"
        ]

        harm = data[
            f"{model}_harm"
        ]

        disagreement = data[
            f"{model}_disagrees"
        ]

        for outcome_name, mask in [
            ("rescue", rescue),
            ("harm", harm),
        ]:

            subset = data.loc[
                disagreement & mask
            ]

            if subset.empty:
                continue

            rows.append(
                {
                    "alternative_model": model,
                    "outcome": outcome_name,
                    "samples": len(subset),
                    "confidence_difference_mean": subset[
                        f"{model}_confidence_difference"
                    ].mean(),
                    "confidence_difference_median": subset[
                        f"{model}_confidence_difference"
                    ].median(),
                    "confidence_difference_std": subset[
                        f"{model}_confidence_difference"
                    ].std(),
                    "best_confidence_mean": subset[
                        "best_confidence"
                    ].mean(),
                    "alternative_confidence_mean": subset[
                        f"{model}_confidence"
                    ].mean(),
                    "gate_mean": subset[
                        f"{model}_gate"
                    ].mean(),
                    "gate_median": subset[
                        f"{model}_gate"
                    ].median(),
                }
            )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# =============================================================================
# GATE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def calculate_gate_analysis(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    rows = []

    thresholds = [
        0.80,
        0.85,
        0.875,
        0.90,
        0.925,
        0.95,
        0.975,
    ]

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        disagreement = data[
            f"{model}_disagrees"
        ]

        for threshold in thresholds:

            accepted = data[
                f"{model}_gate"
            ] >= threshold

            mask = (
                disagreement
                & accepted
            )

            subset = data.loc[
                mask
            ]

            if subset.empty:
                continue

            rescues = int(
                subset[f"{model}_rescue"].sum()
            )

            harms = int(
                subset[f"{model}_harm"].sum()
            )

            rows.append(
                {
                    "alternative_model": model,
                    "gate_threshold": threshold,
                    "accepted_transitions": len(subset),
                    "rescues": rescues,
                    "harms": harms,
                    "net_gain": rescues - harms,
                    "rescue_rate": rescues / len(subset),
                    "harm_rate": harms / len(subset),
                }
            )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# =============================================================================
# SAFE / HARMFUL TRANSITIONS
# =============================================================================

def identify_safe_transitions(
    transitions: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    if transitions.empty:
        return transitions.copy()

    result = transitions[
        (
            transitions["samples"]
            >= MIN_TRANSITION_SAMPLES
        )
        & (
            transitions["net_gain"]
            > 0
        )
        & (
            transitions["rescue_rate"]
            > transitions["harm_rate"]
        )
    ].copy()

    return result.sort_values(
        [
            "net_gain",
            "rescue_to_harm_ratio",
            "samples",
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            False,
            False,
        ],
    ).reset_index(drop=True)


def identify_harmful_transitions(
    transitions: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    if transitions.empty:
        return transitions.copy()

    result = transitions[
        (
            transitions["samples"]
            >= MIN_TRANSITION_SAMPLES
        )
        & (
            transitions["net_gain"]
            < 0
        )
    ].copy()

    return result.sort_values(
        [
            "net_gain",
            "samples",
        ],
        ascending=[
            True,
            False,
        ],
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
