# =============================================================================
# PRINT SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def print_transition_summary(
    transitions: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("TRANSITION PROFITABILITY")

    if transitions.empty:
        print("No disagreement transitions found.")
        return

    display_columns = [
        "alternative_model",
        "source_class",
        "target_class",
        "samples",
        "rescues",
        "harms",
        "net_gain",
        "rescue_rate",
        "harm_rate",
        "rescue_to_harm_ratio",
        "mean_gate_probability",
        "mean_confidence_difference",
    ]

    print(
        transitions[
            display_columns
        ].to_string(index=False)
    )


def print_safe_transitions(
    safe: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("SAFE TRANSITIONS")

    if safe.empty:
        print("No safe transitions found.")
        return

    columns = [
        "alternative_model",
        "source_class",
        "target_class",
        "samples",
        "rescues",
        "harms",
        "net_gain",
        "rescue_rate",
        "harm_rate",
        "rescue_to_harm_ratio",
    ]

    print(
        safe[columns]
        .head(30)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )


def print_harmful_transitions(
    harmful: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("HARMFUL TRANSITIONS")

    if harmful.empty:
        print("No harmful transitions found.")
        return

    columns = [
        "alternative_model",
        "source_class",
        "target_class",
        "samples",
        "rescues",
        "harms",
        "net_gain",
        "rescue_rate",
        "harm_rate",
        "rescue_to_harm_ratio",
    ]

    print(
        harmful[columns]
        .head(30)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )


# =============================================================================
# MODEL COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def print_model_transition_summary(
    data: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("ALTERNATIVE MODEL TRANSITION SUMMARY")

    rows = []

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        disagreement = data[
            f"{model}_disagrees"
        ]

        subset = data.loc[
            disagreement
        ]

        if subset.empty:
            continue

        rescues = int(
            subset[f"{model}_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            subset[f"{model}_harm"].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "alternative_model": model,
                "disagreements": len(subset),
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "net_gain": rescues - harms,
                "rescue_rate": rescues / len(subset),
                "harm_rate": harms / len(subset),
                "rescue_to_harm_ratio": (
                    rescues / harms
                    if harms > 0
                    else np.inf
                ),
                "mean_gate": subset[
                    f"{model}_gate"
                ].mean(),
                "mean_confidence_difference": subset[
                    f"{model}_confidence_difference"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )


# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

def save_dataframe(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    filename: str,
) -> None:

    path = OUTPUT_DIR / filename

    df.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main() -> None:

    section("V3.8 ERROR-CONDITIONAL TRANSITION ANALYSIS")

    print(
        f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Best model: {BEST_MODEL}"
    )

    print(
        f"Alternatives: {ALTERNATIVES}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Diagnostic only."
    )
    print(
        "No new model is trained."
    )
    print(
        "No final selector is selected."
    )
    print(
        "Ground truth is used only to evaluate rescue/harm."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # LOAD
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("LOADING V3.6 NESTED OOF RESULTS")

    if not INPUT_PATH.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Input file does not exist:\n"
            f"{INPUT_PATH}"
        )

    print(
        f"File: {INPUT_PATH}"
    )

    df = pd.read_csv(
        INPUT_PATH
    )

    print(
        f"Shape: {df.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # DISCOVER COLUMNS
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("DISCOVERING INPUT COLUMNS")

    columns = discover_columns(
        df
    )

    for logical_name, actual_name in columns.items():

        print(
            f"{logical_name:40s} -> {actual_name}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # VALIDATE
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_input(
        df.rename(
            columns={
                columns["true_class"]: "true_class",
                columns["best_prediction"]: "best_prediction",
                columns["best_correct"]: "best_correct",
                columns["best_confidence"]: "best_confidence",
            }
            | {
                columns[f"{model}_prediction"]:
                    f"{model}_prediction"
                for model in ALTERNATIVES
            }
            | {
                columns[f"{model}_correct"]:
                    f"{model}_correct"
                for model in ALTERNATIVES
            }
            | {
                columns[f"{model}_confidence"]:
                    f"{model}_confidence"
                for model in ALTERNATIVES
            }
            | {
                columns[f"{model}_gate"]:
                    f"{model}_gate"
                for model in ALTERNATIVES
            }
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # BUILD STANDARDIZED DATA
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    data = build_transition_data(
        df,
        columns,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL SUMMARY
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print_model_transition_summary(
        data
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # TRANSITION PROFITABILITY
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    all_transition_results = []

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        result = calculate_transition_profitability(
            data,
            model,
        )

        if not result.empty:
            all_transition_results.append(
                result
            )

    if all_transition_results:

        transition_all = pd.concat(
            all_transition_results,
            ignore_index=True,
        )

    else:

        transition_all = pd.DataFrame()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CLASS × TRANSITION
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("CLASS × ERROR TRANSITION ANALYSIS")

    class_transition = (
        calculate_class_transition_profitability(
            data
        )
    )

    if not class_transition.empty:

        print(
            class_transition.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CONFIDENCE
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("CONFIDENCE SEPARATION")

    confidence_analysis = (
        calculate_confidence_analysis(
            data
        )
    )

    if not confidence_analysis.empty:

        print(
            confidence_analysis.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # GATE
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("GATE ANALYSIS")

    gate_analysis = (
        calculate_gate_analysis(
            data
        )
    )

    if not gate_analysis.empty:

        print(
            gate_analysis.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SAFE / HARMFUL
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    safe_transitions = identify_safe_transitions(
        transition_all
    )

    harmful_transitions = identify_harmful_transitions(
        transition_all
    )

    print_safe_transitions(
        safe_transitions
    )

    print_harmful_transitions(
        harmful_transitions
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SOURCE CLASS
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("SOURCE CLASS PROFITABILITY")

    source_class = (
        calculate_source_class_profitability(
            data
        )
    )

    if not source_class.empty:

        print(
            source_class.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # TARGET CLASS
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("TARGET CLASS PROFITABILITY")

    target_class = (
        calculate_target_class_profitability(
            data
        )
    )

    if not target_class.empty:

        print(
            target_class.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # OUTPUT
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("SAVING V3.8 ANALYSIS")

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    save_dataframe(
        transition_all,
        "transition_profitability_all.csv",
    )

    for model in ALTERNATIVES:

        model_result = transition_all[
            transition_all["alternative_model"]
            == model
        ].copy()

        safe_name = model

        save_dataframe(
            model_result,
            f"transition_profitability_{safe_name}.csv",
        )

    save_dataframe(
        class_transition,
        "class_transition_profitability.csv",
    )

    save_dataframe(
        confidence_analysis,
        "transition_confidence_analysis.csv",
    )

    save_dataframe(
        gate_analysis,
        "transition_gate_analysis.csv",
    )

    save_dataframe(
        safe_transitions,
        "safe_transitions.csv",
    )

    save_dataframe(
        harmful_transitions,
        "harmful_transitions.csv",
    )

    save_dataframe(
        source_class,
        "source_class_profitability.csv",
    )

    save_dataframe(
        target_class,
        "target_class_profitability.csv",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FULL ANALYSIS
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    full_output = data.copy()

    save_dataframe(
        full_output,
        "v3_8_error_transition_analysis_full.csv",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FINAL SUMMARY
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("V3.8 ERROR TRANSITION ANALYSIS COMPLETE")

    print()
    print(
        "The most important files are:"
    )

    print(
        f"1. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'transition_profitability_all.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"2. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'safe_transitions.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"3. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'harmful_transitions.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"4. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'class_transition_profitability.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"5. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'transition_confidence_analysis.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"6. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'transition_gate_analysis.csv'}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "These results are diagnostic."
    )

    print(
        "Do NOT use the discovered transition rules as final "
        "performance claims."
    )

    print(
        "The next V3.8 selector must be validated with "
        "fold-safe / nested evaluation."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
================================================================================
V3.8 TRANSITION SELECTOR
================================================================================

Purpose
-------
Train a transition-aware dynamic selector for the Hybrid_v3 system.

Base model:
    efficientnet_v2_s

Alternative models:
    resnet50
    mobilenet_v3_large

Decision:
    0 -> KEEP efficientnet_v2_s
    1 -> SWITCH to resnet50
    2 -> SWITCH to mobilenet_v3_large

IMPORTANT
---------
This script does NOT hard-code the V3.8 safe/harmful transition rules.

The V3.8 error-transition analysis is diagnostic only.

The selector learns transition decisions from OOF predictions and
confidence/gate relationships.

Ground truth is used ONLY to construct the training target.

The resulting selector MUST be evaluated using fold-safe / nested
evaluation before any performance claim is made.

================================================================================
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import pickle
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, ExtraTreesClassifier
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    classification_report,
    confusion_matrix,
    f1_score,
)
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

RANDOM_STATE = 42

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

INPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_6_nested"
    / "evaluation"
)

INPUT_FILE = INPUT_DIR / "v3_6_nested_oof_sample_results.csv"

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_8_transition_selector"
)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True,
)


# =============================================================================
# MODEL DEFINITIONS
# =============================================================================

BEST_MODEL = "efficientnet_v2_s"

ALTERNATIVE_MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
]


MODEL_TO_TARGET = {
    "efficientnet_v2_s": 0,
    "resnet50": 1,
    "mobilenet_v3_large": 2,
}


TARGET_NAMES = {
    0: "keep_efficientnet_v2_s",
    1: "switch_resnet50",
    2: "switch_mobilenet_v3_large",
}


# =============================================================================
# UTILITY FUNCTIONS
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def find_column(df: pd.DataFrame, candidates: list[str]) -> str | None:
    """
    Return the first matching column from candidates.
    """

    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate in df.columns:
            return candidate

    return None


def safe_numeric(
    series: pd.Series,
    default: float = 0.0,
) -> pd.Series:

    values = pd.to_numeric(
        series,
        errors="coerce",
    )

    return values.fillna(default)


# =============================================================================
# LOAD DATA
# =============================================================================

def load_data() -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("LOADING V3.6 NESTED OOF RESULTS")

    print(f"File: {INPUT_FILE}")

    if not INPUT_FILE.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Required input file does not exist:\n{INPUT_FILE}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_FILE)

    print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")

    return df


# =============================================================================
# COLUMN DISCOVERY
# =============================================================================

def discover_columns(df):
    """
    Discover all columns required by the V3.8 transition selector.

    IMPORTANT:
    efficientnet_v2_s is represented by the generic V3.6 OOF
    columns:

        best_prediction
        best_correct
        best_confidence

    The function returns a nested dictionary because the downstream
    validation/training code expects:

        columns[model]["prediction"]
        columns[model]["correct"]
        columns[model]["confidence"]
        columns[model]["gate"]
    """

    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print("DISCOVERING INPUT COLUMNS")
    print("=" * 80)

    columns = {}

    # ================================================================
    # GROUND TRUTH
    # ================================================================

    true_candidates = [
        "true_class",
        "target",
        "label",
        "y_true",
    ]

    true_class_col = None

    for col in true_candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            true_class_col = col
            break

    if true_class_col is None:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Missing ground-truth column. Tried: {true_candidates}"
        )

    columns["true_class"] = true_class_col

    print(
        f"{'true_class':40s} -> {true_class_col}"
    )

    # ================================================================
    # BEST MODEL
    # efficientnet_v2_s
    # ================================================================

    best_prediction_candidates = [
        "best_prediction",
        "efficientnet_v2_s_prediction",
    ]

    best_correct_candidates = [
        "best_correct",
        "efficientnet_v2_s_correct",
    ]

    best_confidence_candidates = [
        "best_confidence",
        "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence",
    ]

    def find_column(candidates, description):

        for col in candidates:
            if col in df.columns:
                return col

        raise ValueError(
            f"Missing {description}. Tried: {candidates}"
        )

    best_prediction = find_column(
        best_prediction_candidates,
        "efficientnet_v2_s prediction column",
    )

    best_correct = find_column(
        best_correct_candidates,
        "efficientnet_v2_s correct column",
    )

    best_confidence = find_column(
        best_confidence_candidates,
        "efficientnet_v2_s confidence column",
    )

    # V3.6 does not normally have a gate for the best model.
    best_gate_candidates = [
        "best_gate_probability",
        "best_gate",
        "efficientnet_v2_s_gate_probability",
        "efficientnet_v2_s_gate",
    ]

    best_gate = None

    for col in best_gate_candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            best_gate = col
            break

    columns["efficientnet_v2_s"] = {
        "prediction": best_prediction,
        "correct": best_correct,
        "confidence": best_confidence,
        "gate": best_gate,
    }

    print(
        f"{'efficientnet_v2_s prediction':40s} -> {best_prediction}"
    )

    print(
        f"{'efficientnet_v2_s correct':40s} -> {best_correct}"
    )

    print(
        f"{'efficientnet_v2_s confidence':40s} -> {best_confidence}"
    )

    print(
        f"{'efficientnet_v2_s gate':40s} -> "
        f"{best_gate if best_gate is not None else 'NOT PRESENT'}"
    )

    # ================================================================
    # ALTERNATIVE MODELS
    # ================================================================

    alternatives = [
        "resnet50",
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
    ]

    for model in alternatives:

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # Prediction
        # ------------------------------------------------------------

        prediction_candidates = [
            f"{model}_prediction",
            f"{model}_pred",
        ]

        prediction_col = find_column(
            prediction_candidates,
            f"{model} prediction column",
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # Correct
        # ------------------------------------------------------------

        correct_candidates = [
            f"{model}_correct",
        ]

        correct_col = find_column(
            correct_candidates,
            f"{model} correct column",
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # Confidence
        # ------------------------------------------------------------

        confidence_candidates = [
            f"{model}_confidence",
            f"{model}_conf",
        ]

        confidence_col = find_column(
            confidence_candidates,
            f"{model} confidence column",
        )

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # Gate
        # ------------------------------------------------------------

        gate_candidates = [
            f"{model}_gate_probability",
            f"{model}_gate",
            f"{model}_gate_prob",
        ]

        gate_col = find_column(
            gate_candidates,
            f"{model} gate probability column",
        )

        columns[model] = {
            "prediction": prediction_col,
            "correct": correct_col,
            "confidence": confidence_col,
            "gate": gate_col,
        }

        print(
            f"{model + ' prediction':40s} -> {prediction_col}"
        )

        print(
            f"{model + ' correct':40s} -> {correct_col}"
        )

        print(
            f"{model + ' confidence':40s} -> {confidence_col}"
        )

        print(
            f"{model + ' gate':40s} -> {gate_col}"
        )

    return columns

# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_input(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: dict,
) -> None:

    section("VALIDATING INPUT")

    print(f"Rows: {len(df):,}")
    print(f"Columns: {len(df.columns)}")

    if len(df) == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input dataframe is empty.")

    for model in [
        BEST_MODEL,
        *ALTERNATIVE_MODELS,
    ]:

        prediction_col = columns[model]["prediction"]
        confidence_col = columns[model]["confidence"]
        correct_col = columns[model]["correct"]

        if df[prediction_col].isna().all():
            raise ValueError(
                f"All predictions are missing for {model}"
            )

        if df[confidence_col].isna().all():
            raise ValueError(
                f"All confidences are missing for {model}"
            )

        if df[correct_col].isna().all():
            raise ValueError(
                f"All correctness values are missing for {model}"
            )

    print("Input validation: PASSED")


# =============================================================================
# BUILD TRANSITION TARGET
# =============================================================================

def build_transition_target(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: dict,
) -> pd.Series:

    section("BUILDING TRANSITION TARGET")

    best_correct = (
        safe_numeric(
            df[
                columns[BEST_MODEL]["correct"]
            ]
        )
        .astype(int)
        .clip(0, 1)
    )

    target_values = np.zeros(
        len(df),
        dtype=np.int64,
    )

    rescue_resnet = (
        (best_correct == 0)
        &
        (
            safe_numeric(
                df[
                    columns["resnet50"]["correct"]
                ]
            )
            == 1
        )
    )

    rescue_mobile = (
        (best_correct == 0)
        &
        (
            safe_numeric(
                df[
                    columns["mobilenet_v3_large"]["correct"]
                ]
            )
            == 1
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # If both alternatives rescue the base model, select the alternative with
    # the larger confidence advantage.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    best_conf = safe_numeric(
        df[
            columns[BEST_MODEL]["confidence"]
        ]
    )

    resnet_conf = safe_numeric(
        df[
            columns["resnet50"]["confidence"]
        ]
    )

    mobile_conf = safe_numeric(
        df[
            columns["mobilenet_v3_large"]["confidence"]
        ]
    )

    both_rescue = (
        rescue_resnet
        &
        rescue_mobile
    )

    resnet_advantage = (
        resnet_conf - best_conf
    )

    mobile_advantage = (
        mobile_conf - best_conf
    )

    target_values[
        rescue_resnet
        & ~rescue_mobile
    ] = 1

    target_values[
        rescue_mobile
        & ~rescue_resnet
    ] = 2

    target_values[
        both_rescue
        & (
            resnet_advantage >= mobile_advantage
        )
    ] = 1

    target_values[
        both_rescue
        & (
            mobile_advantage > resnet_advantage
        )
    ] = 2

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Important:
    #
    # If the base model is correct and an alternative is also correct,
    # KEEP the base model.
    #
    # If the base model is wrong and both alternatives are wrong,
    # KEEP the base model because there is no verified rescue.
    #
    # This makes the target specifically a rescue-selection target.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    y = pd.Series(
        target_values,
        index=df.index,
        name="transition_target",
    )

    counts = (
        y.value_counts()
        .sort_index()
    )

    print()
    print("TRANSITION TARGET DISTRIBUTION")
    print("-" * 80)

    for class_id in [0, 1, 2]:

        count = int(
            counts.get(
                class_id,
                0,
            )
        )

        percentage = (
            count / len(y) * 100.0
        )

        print(
            f"{class_id} | "
            f"{TARGET_NAMES[class_id]:35s} | "
            f"{count:5d} | "
            f"{percentage:7.2f}%"
        )

    return y


# =============================================================================
# FEATURE ENGINEERING
# =============================================================================

def build_features(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: dict,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING V3.8 TRANSITION FEATURES")

    features = pd.DataFrame(
        index=df.index
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Raw model confidences
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model in [
        BEST_MODEL,
        *ALTERNATIVE_MODELS,
    ]:

        conf_col = columns[model]["confidence"]

        features[
            f"{model}_confidence"
        ] = safe_numeric(
            df[conf_col]
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate probabilities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for model in ALTERNATIVE_MODELS:

        gate_col = columns[model]["gate"]

        if gate_col is not None:

            features[
                f"{model}_gate_probability"
            ] = safe_numeric(
                df[gate_col]
            )

        else:

            # Missing gates are represented by zero.
            features[
                f"{model}_gate_probability"
            ] = 0.0

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence differences
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    base_conf = features[
        f"{BEST_MODEL}_confidence"
    ]

    for model in ALTERNATIVE_MODELS:

        alt_conf = features[
            f"{model}_confidence"
        ]

        features[
            f"{model}_confidence_difference"
        ] = alt_conf - base_conf

        features[
            f"{model}_absolute_confidence_difference"
        ] = (
            alt_conf - base_conf
        ).abs()

        features[
            f"{model}_confidence_ratio"
        ] = (
            alt_conf
            /
            (
                base_conf + 1e-8
            )
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Alternative-vs-alternative confidence
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_conf = features[
        "resnet50_confidence"
    ]

    mobile_conf = features[
        "mobilenet_v3_large_confidence"
    ]

    features[
        "resnet50_vs_mobilenet_confidence_difference"
    ] = (
        resnet_conf - mobile_conf
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate differences
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_gate = features[
        "resnet50_gate_probability"
    ]

    mobile_gate = features[
        "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability"
    ]

    features[
        "resnet50_vs_mobilenet_gate_difference"
    ] = (
        resnet_gate - mobile_gate
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate × confidence interactions
    #
    # These are useful because V3.8 showed that rescue and harm are separated
    # partially by both confidence and gate strength.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    features[
        "resnet50_gate_x_confidence"
    ] = (
        resnet_gate
        * resnet_conf
    )

    features[
        "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_x_confidence"
    ] = (
        mobile_gate
        * mobile_conf
    )

    features[
        "resnet50_gate_x_confidence_difference"
    ] = (
        resnet_gate
        * (
            resnet_conf - base_conf
        )
    )

    features[
        "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_x_confidence_difference"
    ] = (
        mobile_gate
        * (
            mobile_conf - base_conf
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Maximum / minimum alternative confidence
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    features[
        "alternative_max_confidence"
    ] = np.maximum(
        resnet_conf,
        mobile_conf,
    )

    features[
        "alternative_min_confidence"
    ] = np.minimum(
        resnet_conf,
        mobile_conf,
    )

    features[
        "alternative_mean_confidence"
    ] = (
        resnet_conf
        + mobile_conf
    ) / 2.0

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Base-vs-alternative confidence margins
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    features[
        "best_vs_best_alternative_margin"
    ] = (
        base_conf
        - features[
            "alternative_max_confidence"
        ]
    )

    features[
        "best_vs_mean_alternative_margin"
    ] = (
        base_conf
        - features[
            "alternative_mean_confidence"
        ]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence dispersion
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    confidence_matrix = np.column_stack(
        [
            features[
                f"{BEST_MODEL}_confidence"
            ].values,
            resnet_conf.values,
            mobile_conf.values,
        ]
    )

    features[
        "confidence_std"
    ] = np.std(
        confidence_matrix,
        axis=1,
    )

    features[
        "confidence_range"
    ] = (
        np.max(
            confidence_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )
        -
        np.min(
            confidence_matrix,
            axis=1,
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prediction agreement
    #
    # These are prediction-derived and therefore safe at inference time.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    base_pred = (
        df[
            columns[BEST_MODEL]["prediction"]
        ]
        .astype(str)
    )

    resnet_pred = (
        df[
            columns["resnet50"]["prediction"]
        ]
        .astype(str)
    )

    mobile_pred = (
        df[
            columns["mobilenet_v3_large"]["prediction"]
        ]
        .astype(str)
    )

    features[
        "best_resnet_agreement"
    ] = (
        base_pred == resnet_pred
    ).astype(int)

    features[
        "best_mobile_agreement"
    ] = (
        base_pred == mobile_pred
    ).astype(int)

    features[
        "resnet_mobile_agreement"
    ] = (
        resnet_pred == mobile_pred
    ).astype(int)

    features[
        "all_models_agree"
    ] = (
        (
            base_pred == resnet_pred
        )
        &
        (
            resnet_pred == mobile_pred
        )
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # One-hot encode the PREDICTED class labels.
    #
    # Ground truth is deliberately NOT used.
    #
    # This lets the selector learn patterns such as:
    #   base predicts MEL, alternative predicts NV
    # without explicitly hard-coding MEL -> NV rules.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    prediction_frame = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "best_prediction": base_pred,
            "resnet_prediction": resnet_pred,
            "mobilenet_prediction": mobile_pred,
        },
        index=df.index,
    )

    prediction_dummies = pd.get_dummies(
        prediction_frame,
        prefix=[
            "best_pred",
            "resnet_pred",
            "mobilenet_pred",
        ],
        dtype=float,
    )

    features = pd.concat(
        [
            features,
            prediction_dummies,
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Convert everything to numeric.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    features = features.apply(
        pd.to_numeric,
        errors="coerce",
    )

    features = features.replace(
        [
            np.inf,
            -np.inf,
        ],
        np.nan,
    )

    print(
        f"Feature matrix shape: {features.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"Number of features: {features.shape[1]}"
    )

    return features


# =============================================================================
# MODEL
# =============================================================================

def create_selector():

    """
    ExtraTrees is used as the primary selector.

    Why ExtraTrees?
    ----------------
    - Handles nonlinear transition boundaries.
    - Handles interactions between confidence and gate.
    - Works well with mixed numerical / binary features.
    - Does not require feature scaling.
    - Provides feature importance for diagnostic inspection.
    """

    model = ExtraTreesClassifier(
        n_estimators=500,
        max_depth=8,
        min_samples_leaf=8,
        max_features="sqrt",
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )

    pipeline = Pipeline(
        [
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(
                    strategy="median"
                ),
            ),
            (
                "selector",
                model,
            ),
        ]
    )

    return pipeline


# =============================================================================
# CROSS-VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def cross_validate_selector(
    X: pd.DataFrame,
    y: pd.Series,
):

    section("FOLD-SAFE TRANSITION SELECTOR VALIDATION")

    print(
        "This validation is diagnostic."
    )

    print(
        "The final selector must still be evaluated through the official "
        "nested evaluation pipeline."
    )

    class_counts = y.value_counts()

    print()
    print("Target counts:")
    print(class_counts)

    min_class_count = int(
        class_counts.min()
    )

    n_splits = min(
        5,
        min_class_count,
    )

    if n_splits < 2:
        raise ValueError(
            "Not enough samples in one or more target classes for CV."
        )

    print(
        f"\nUsing {n_splits}-fold stratified CV."
    )

    skf = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=n_splits,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    )

    oof_pred = np.full(
        len(y),
        -1,
        dtype=int,
    )

    oof_proba = np.zeros(
        (
            len(y),
            3,
        ),
        dtype=float,
    )

    fold_rows = []

    for fold, (
        train_idx,
        valid_idx,
    ) in enumerate(
        skf.split(
            X,
            y,
        ),
        start=1,
    ):

        print()
        print(
            f"Fold {fold}/{n_splits}"
        )

        X_train = X.iloc[
            train_idx
        ]

        X_valid = X.iloc[
            valid_idx
        ]

        y_train = y.iloc[
            train_idx
        ]

        y_valid = y.iloc[
            valid_idx
        ]

        model = create_selector()

        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
        )

        pred = model.predict(
            X_valid
        )

        proba = model.predict_proba(
            X_valid
        )

        oof_pred[
            valid_idx
        ] = pred

        oof_proba[
            valid_idx,
            :
        ] = proba

        acc = accuracy_score(
            y_valid,
            pred,
        )

        bal_acc = balanced_accuracy_score(
            y_valid,
            pred,
        )

        macro_f1 = f1_score(
            y_valid,
            pred,
            average="macro",
        )

        fold_rows.append(
            {
                "fold": fold,
                "samples": len(valid_idx),
                "accuracy": acc,
                "balanced_accuracy": bal_acc,
                "macro_f1": macro_f1,
            }
        )

        print(
            f"Accuracy:          {acc:.4f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Balanced Accuracy: {bal_acc:.4f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Macro F1:          {macro_f1:.4f}"
        )

    metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(
        fold_rows
    )

    section("CROSS-VALIDATION SUMMARY")

    print(
        metrics_df.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Mean Accuracy: "
        f"{metrics_df['accuracy'].mean():.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean Balanced Accuracy: "
        f"{metrics_df['balanced_accuracy'].mean():.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean Macro F1: "
        f"{metrics_df['macro_f1'].mean():.4f}"
    )

    return (
        oof_pred,
        oof_proba,
        metrics_df,
    )


# =============================================================================
# TRANSITION PERFORMANCE
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_transition_decisions(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: dict,
    y_true_target: pd.Series,
    selector_pred: np.ndarray,
):

    section("TRANSITION DECISION ANALYSIS")

    base_correct = (
        safe_numeric(
            df[
                columns[BEST_MODEL]["correct"]
            ]
        )
        .astype(int)
    )

    resnet_correct = (
        safe_numeric(
            df[
                columns["resnet50"]["correct"]
            ]
        )
        .astype(int)
    )

    mobile_correct = (
        safe_numeric(
            df[
                columns["mobilenet_v3_large"]["correct"]
            ]
        )
        .astype(int)
    )

    final_correct = np.where(
        selector_pred == 0,
        base_correct,
        np.where(
            selector_pred == 1,
            resnet_correct,
            mobile_correct,
        ),
    )

    baseline_accuracy = (
        base_correct.mean()
    )

    selected_accuracy = (
        final_correct.mean()
    )

    print(
        f"Base model accuracy:     "
        f"{baseline_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Selector accuracy:       "
        f"{selected_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy difference:     "
        f"{selected_accuracy - baseline_accuracy:+.6f}"
    )

    print()

    for class_id in [0, 1, 2]:

        mask = (
            selector_pred
            == class_id
        )

        count = int(
            mask.sum()
        )

        if count == 0:
            continue

        print(
            f"{TARGET_NAMES[class_id]:35s}: "
            f"{count:4d} samples"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue / harm statistics.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    switched = (
        selector_pred != 0
    )

    rescue = (
        switched
        &
        (base_correct == 0)
        &
        (final_correct == 1)
    )

    harm = (
        switched
        &
        (base_correct == 1)
        &
        (final_correct == 0)
    )

    neutral = (
        switched
        &
        ~rescue
        &
        ~harm
    )

    print()
    print("SELECTOR TRANSITION OUTCOMES")
    print("-" * 80)

    print(
        f"Transitions: {switched.sum():4d}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues:     {rescue.sum():4d}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms:       {harm.sum():4d}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral:     {neutral.sum():4d}"
    )

    if harm.sum() > 0:

        ratio = (
            rescue.sum()
            /
            harm.sum()
        )

        print(
            f"Rescue/Harm ratio: "
            f"{ratio:.4f}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save OOF decisions.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    result = df.copy()

    result[
        "v3_8_transition_target"
    ] = y_true_target.values

    result[
        "v3_8_selector_prediction"
    ] = selector_pred

    result[
        "v3_8_selector_prediction_name"
    ] = [
        TARGET_NAMES[int(x)]
        for x in selector_pred
    ]

    result[
        "v3_8_final_correct"
    ] = final_correct

    result[
        "v3_8_transition"
    ] = switched.astype(int)

    result[
        "v3_8_rescue"
    ] = rescue.astype(int)

    result[
        "v3_8_harm"
    ] = harm.astype(int)

    output_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_selector_oof_predictions.csv"
    )

    result.to_csv(
        output_file,
        index=False,
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output_file}"
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# =============================================================================

def calculate_feature_importance(
    X: pd.DataFrame,
    y: pd.Series,
):

    section("TRAINING FINAL V3.8 TRANSITION SELECTOR")

    model = create_selector()

    model.fit(
        X,
        y,
    )

    estimator = model.named_steps[
        "selector"
    ]

    importance = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "feature": X.columns,
            "importance": estimator.feature_importances_,
        }
    )

    importance = (
        importance
        .sort_values(
            "importance",
            ascending=False,
        )
        .reset_index(
            drop=True
        )
    )

    print()
    print("TOP FEATURES")
    print("-" * 80)

    print(
        importance.head(30).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    output_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_feature_importance.csv"
    )

    importance.to_csv(
        output_file,
        index=False,
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output_file}"
    )

    return model, importance


# =============================================================================
# CONFUSION MATRIX
# =============================================================================

def save_confusion_matrix(
    y_true: pd.Series,
    y_pred: np.ndarray,
):

    cm = confusion_matrix(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        labels=[0, 1, 2],
    )

    cm_df = pd.DataFrame(
        cm,
        index=[
            "true_keep",
            "true_resnet50",
            "true_mobilenet_v3_large",
        ],
        columns=[
            "pred_keep",
            "pred_resnet50",
            "pred_mobilenet_v3_large",
        ],
    )

    output_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_confusion_matrix.csv"
    )

    cm_df.to_csv(
        output_file
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {output_file}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# SAVE MODEL
# =============================================================================

def save_model(
    model,
    feature_names,
    importance,
    cv_metrics,
):

    section("SAVING V3.8 SELECTOR")

    model_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_selector.pkl"
    )

    with open(
        model_file,
        "wb",
    ) as f:

        pickle.dump(
            model,
            f,
        )

    print(
        f"Saved: {model_file}"
    )

    feature_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_features.json"
    )

    with open(
        feature_file,
        "w",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            list(feature_names),
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(
        f"Saved: {feature_file}"
    )

    metrics_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_cv_metrics.csv"
    )

    cv_metrics.to_csv(
        metrics_file,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {metrics_file}"
    )

    metadata = {
        "version": "V3.8",
        "best_model": BEST_MODEL,
        "alternative_models": ALTERNATIVE_MODELS,
        "target_names": TARGET_NAMES,
        "random_state": RANDOM_STATE,
        "diagnostic_only": True,
        "ground_truth_used_for_features": False,
        "nested_validation_required": True,
        "feature_count": len(feature_names),
    }

    metadata_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_selector_metadata.json"
    )

    with open(
        metadata_file,
        "w",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            metadata,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(
        f"Saved: {metadata_file}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.8 ERROR-CONDITIONAL TRANSITION SELECTOR"
    )

    print(
        f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Best model: {BEST_MODEL}"
    )

    print(
        f"Alternatives: {ALTERNATIVE_MODELS}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Decision classes:"
    )

    for key, value in TARGET_NAMES.items():

        print(
            f"  {key} -> {value}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Diagnostic training only."
    )

    print(
        "No final selector is claimed."
    )

    print(
        "Ground truth is used only for target construction/evaluation."
    )

    print(
        "Final validation must be fold-safe / nested."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = load_data()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Discover
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    columns = discover_columns(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_input(
        df,
        columns,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build target
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    y = build_transition_target(
        df,
        columns,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build features
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    X = build_features(
        df,
        columns,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save feature matrix
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature_matrix_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_feature_matrix.csv"
    )

    feature_matrix_with_target = X.copy()

    feature_matrix_with_target[
        "transition_target"
    ] = y.values

    feature_matrix_with_target.to_csv(
        feature_matrix_file,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {feature_matrix_file}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Cross-validation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        oof_pred,
        oof_proba,
        cv_metrics,
    ) = cross_validate_selector(
        X,
        y,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # OOF classification report
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "OOF TRANSITION CLASSIFICATION"
    )

    print(
        classification_report(
            y,
            oof_pred,
            labels=[0, 1, 2],
            target_names=[
                TARGET_NAMES[0],
                TARGET_NAMES[1],
                TARGET_NAMES[2],
            ],
            zero_division=0,
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confusion matrix
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_confusion_matrix(
        y,
        oof_pred,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Evaluate actual model transition outcome.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    evaluate_transition_decisions(
        df,
        columns,
        y,
        oof_pred,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Train final model on all available OOF samples.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    final_model, importance = (
        calculate_feature_importance(
            X,
            y,
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save model.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_model(
        final_model,
        X.columns,
        importance,
        cv_metrics,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save OOF probabilities.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    probability_df = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "keep_probability": oof_proba[:, 0],
            "resnet50_probability": oof_proba[:, 1],
            "mobilenet_v3_large_probability": oof_proba[:, 2],
            "true_target": y.values,
            "predicted_target": oof_pred,
        }
    )

    probability_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_transition_oof_probabilities.csv"
    )

    probability_df.to_csv(
        probability_file,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {probability_file}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final message.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.8 TRANSITION SELECTOR TRAINING COMPLETE"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "This selector has NOT yet been established as the final dynamic "
        "selection strategy."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Required next step:"
    )

    print(
        "Run a genuinely fold-safe / nested evaluation in which the "
        "transition selector is trained only from training-fold information "
        "and evaluated on completely held-out samples."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Primary outputs:"
    )

    print(
        f"1. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'v3_8_transition_selector.pkl'}"
    )

    print(
        f"2. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'v3_8_transition_selector_oof_predictions.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"3. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'v3_8_transition_feature_importance.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"4. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'v3_8_transition_confusion_matrix.csv'}"
    )

    print(
        f"5. {OUTPUT_DIR / 'v3_8_transition_cv_metrics.csv'}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "V3.8 TRANSITION SELECTOR COMPLETE."
    )


# =============================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# =============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

V3.8 SELECTOR FAILURE ANALYSIS

Purpose
-------
Analyze the failure modes of the V3.8 transition selector using its OOF
predictions.

This script is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY.

It:
    - does NOT train a model
    - does NOT modify the selector
    - does NOT claim final generalization performance
    - does NOT use the OOF target to train anything

It analyzes:

    1. Base-model vs selector performance
    2. Rescue / harm / neutral transitions
    3. Transition-type frequencies
    4. Selector target vs selector prediction
    5. Confidence distributions
    6. Gate-probability distributions
    7. Model agreement patterns
    8. True-class failure patterns
    9. Prediction-transition patterns
   10. Confidence-gap patterns
   11. Gate-gap patterns
   12. Harm/rescue concentration
   13. Conditional failure rates
   14. Samples where selector makes harmful transitions
   15. Samples where selector successfully rescues
   16. Ranked diagnostic patterns

Input
-----

"""

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("-" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 80)


def fmt(value, digits: int = 4) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "NA"

    try:
        if pd.isna(value):
            return "NA"
    except Exception:
        pass

    if isinstance(value, (float, np.floating)):
        return f"{value:.{digits}f}"

    return str(value)


# =============================================================================
# COLUMN DISCOVERY
# =============================================================================

def find_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: List[str],
    required: bool = True,
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Find a column using exact matching followed by case-insensitive matching.
    """

    # Exact matching
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate in df.columns:
            return candidate

    # Case-insensitive matching
    lower_map = {
        str(col).lower(): col
        for col in df.columns
    }

    for candidate in candidates:
        key = candidate.lower()

        if key in lower_map:
            return lower_map[key]

    if required:
        raise ValueError(
            "\nCould not find required column.\n"
            f"Tried: {candidates}\n\n"
            f"Available columns:\n{list(df.columns)}"
        )

    return None

# =============================================================================
# DATA NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

def normalize_binary_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    column: str,
) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Normalize boolean-like columns to integer 0/1.
    """

    values = df[column]

    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(values):
        return values.astype(int)

    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(values):
        return values.fillna(0).astype(int)

    mapping = {
        "true": 1,
        "false": 0,
        "yes": 1,
        "no": 0,
        "correct": 1,
        "incorrect": 0,
        "1": 1,
        "0": 0,
    }

    result = (
        values.astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
        .map(mapping)
    )

    if result.isna().any():
        bad = values[result.isna()].unique()

        raise ValueError(
            f"Could not normalize binary column '{column}'. "
            f"Unknown values: {bad[:20]}"
        )

    return result.astype(int)


def normalize_prediction_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    column: str,
) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Keep predictions numeric where possible.
    """

    values = df[column]

    numeric = pd.to_numeric(
        values,
        errors="coerce",
    )

    if numeric.notna().all():
        return numeric

    return values.astype(str)

def validate_input(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: Dict[str, Optional[str]],
) -> None:

    section("VALIDATING INPUT")

    print(f"Rows: {len(df):,}")
    print(f"Columns: {len(df.columns):,}")

    required_logical_columns = [
        "true_class",
        "best_prediction",
        "best_correct",
        "best_confidence",
        "resnet50_prediction",
        "resnet50_correct",
        "resnet50_confidence",
        "resnet50_gate",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_prediction",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_correct",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_confidence",
        "mobilenet_v3_large_gate",
        "target",
        "selector_prediction",
    ]

    missing = [
        key
        for key in required_logical_columns
        if columns.get(key) is None
    ]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing required logical columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {x}" for x in missing)
        )

    if len(df) == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input dataframe is empty.")

    print("Input validation: PASSED")


# =============================================================================
# DERIVED COLUMNS
# =============================================================================

def add_derived_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: Dict[str, Optional[str]],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    df = df.copy()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize core fields
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["_true_class"] = df[
        columns["true_class"]
    ]

    df["_best_prediction"] = df[
        columns["best_prediction"]
    ]

    df["_best_correct"] = normalize_binary_column(
        df,
        columns["best_correct"],
    )

    df["_best_confidence"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["best_confidence"]],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    df["_resnet_prediction"] = df[
        columns["resnet50_prediction"]
    ]

    df["_resnet_correct"] = normalize_binary_column(
        df,
        columns["resnet50_correct"],
    )

    df["_resnet_confidence"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["resnet50_confidence"]],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    df["_resnet_gate"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["resnet50_gate"]],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    df["_mobile_prediction"] = df[
        columns["mobilenet_v3_large_prediction"]
    ]

    df["_mobile_correct"] = normalize_binary_column(
        df,
        columns["mobilenet_v3_large_correct"],
    )

    df["_mobile_confidence"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["mobilenet_v3_large_confidence"]],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    df["_mobile_gate"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["mobilenet_v3_large_gate"]],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    df["_target"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["target"]],
        errors="coerce",
    ).astype(int)

    df["_selector_prediction"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[columns["selector_prediction"]],
        errors="coerce",
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Agreement
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["all_three_agree"] = (
        (df["_best_prediction"] == df["_resnet_prediction"])
        &
        (df["_best_prediction"] == df["_mobile_prediction"])
    ).astype(int)

    df["best_resnet_agreement"] = (
        df["_best_prediction"] == df["_resnet_prediction"]
    ).astype(int)

    df["best_mobile_agreement"] = (
        df["_best_prediction"] == df["_mobile_prediction"]
    ).astype(int)

    df["resnet_mobile_agreement"] = (
        df["_resnet_prediction"] == df["_mobile_prediction"]
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence statistics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    confidence_matrix = np.column_stack(
        [
            df["_best_confidence"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["_resnet_confidence"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            df["_mobile_confidence"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
        ]
    )

    df["confidence_mean"] = np.nanmean(
        confidence_matrix,
        axis=1,
    )

    df["confidence_std"] = np.nanstd(
        confidence_matrix,
        axis=1,
    )

    df["confidence_max"] = np.nanmax(
        confidence_matrix,
        axis=1,
    )

    df["confidence_min"] = np.nanmin(
        confidence_matrix,
        axis=1,
    )

    df["confidence_range"] = (
        df["confidence_max"]
        -
        df["confidence_min"]
    )

    df["best_vs_resnet_confidence_gap"] = (
        df["_best_confidence"]
        -
        df["_resnet_confidence"]
    )

    df["best_vs_mobile_confidence_gap"] = (
        df["_best_confidence"]
        -
        df["_mobile_confidence"]
    )

    df["resnet_vs_mobile_confidence_gap"] = (
        df["_resnet_confidence"]
        -
        df["_mobile_confidence"]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate statistics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["gate_mean"] = (
        df["_resnet_gate"]
        +
        df["_mobile_gate"]
    ) / 2.0

    df["gate_max"] = np.maximum(
        df["_resnet_gate"],
        df["_mobile_gate"],
    )

    df["gate_min"] = np.minimum(
        df["_resnet_gate"],
        df["_mobile_gate"],
    )

    df["gate_difference"] = (
        df["_resnet_gate"]
        -
        df["_mobile_gate"]
    )

    df["gate_abs_difference"] = (
        df["gate_difference"].abs()
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate firing
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["resnet_gate_fired"] = (
        df["_resnet_gate"] >= 0.5
    ).astype(int)

    df["mobile_gate_fired"] = (
        df["_mobile_gate"] >= 0.5
    ).astype(int)

    df["both_gates_fired"] = (
        (df["resnet_gate_fired"] == 1)
        &
        (df["mobile_gate_fired"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    df["no_gate_fired"] = (
        (df["resnet_gate_fired"] == 0)
        &
        (df["mobile_gate_fired"] == 0)
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition type
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["target_name"] = (
        df["_target"]
        .map(TRANSITION_NAMES)
        .fillna("unknown")
    )

    df["selector_prediction_name_derived"] = (
        df["_selector_prediction"]
        .map(TRANSITION_NAMES)
        .fillna("unknown")
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition correctness
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["transition_target_correct"] = (
        df["_target"]
        ==
        df["_selector_prediction"]
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine selected model
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    selected_model = np.select(
        [
            df["_selector_prediction"] == 0,
            df["_selector_prediction"] == 1,
            df["_selector_prediction"] == 2,
        ],
        [
            BEST_MODEL,
            "resnet50",
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
        ],
        default="unknown",
    )

    df["selected_model_derived"] = selected_model

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final selected prediction
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["selected_prediction_derived"] = np.where(
        df["_selector_prediction"] == 0,
        df["_best_prediction"],
        np.where(
            df["_selector_prediction"] == 1,
            df["_resnet_prediction"],
            np.where(
                df["_selector_prediction"] == 2,
                df["_mobile_prediction"],
                np.nan,
            ),
        ),
    )

    df["selected_correct_derived"] = (
        df["selected_prediction_derived"]
        ==
        df["_true_class"]
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue / harm
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["rescue_derived"] = (
        (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
        &
        (df["selected_correct_derived"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    df["harm_derived"] = (
        (df["_best_correct"] == 1)
        &
        (df["selected_correct_derived"] == 0)
    ).astype(int)

    df["neutral_derived"] = (
        (
            df["_best_correct"]
            ==
            df["selected_correct_derived"]
        )
    ).astype(int)

    df["switched_derived"] = (
        df["_selector_prediction"] != 0
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Whether selected model differs from best prediction
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["selected_prediction_differs_from_best"] = (
        df["selected_prediction_derived"]
        !=
        df["_best_prediction"]
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Correct alternatives
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["resnet_rescue_available"] = (
        (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
        &
        (df["_resnet_correct"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    df["mobile_rescue_available"] = (
        (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
        &
        (df["_mobile_correct"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    df["both_alternatives_correct"] = (
        (df["_resnet_correct"] == 1)
        &
        (df["_mobile_correct"] == 1)
    ).astype(int)

    df["no_alternative_correct"] = (
        (df["_resnet_correct"] == 0)
        &
        (df["_mobile_correct"] == 0)
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Oracle alternative
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["alternative_oracle_correct"] = (
        (
            df["_resnet_correct"] == 1
        )
        |
        (
            df["_mobile_correct"] == 1
        )
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Which alternative was actually better?
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["resnet_better_than_mobile"] = (
        df["_resnet_correct"]
        >
        df["_mobile_correct"]
    ).astype(int)

    df["mobile_better_than_resnet"] = (
        df["_mobile_correct"]
        >
        df["_resnet_correct"]
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence rank
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["best_confidence_rank"] = (
        df[
            [
                "_best_confidence",
                "_resnet_confidence",
                "_mobile_confidence",
            ]
        ]
        .rank(
            axis=1,
            ascending=False,
            method="average",
        )
        .iloc[:, 0]
    )

    df["resnet_confidence_rank"] = (
        df[
            [
                "_best_confidence",
                "_resnet_confidence",
                "_mobile_confidence",
            ]
        ]
        .rank(
            axis=1,
            ascending=False,
            method="average",
        )
        .iloc[:, 1]
    )

    df["mobile_confidence_rank"] = (
        df[
            [
                "_best_confidence",
                "_resnet_confidence",
                "_mobile_confidence",
            ]
        ]
        .rank(
            axis=1,
            ascending=False,
            method="average",
        )
        .iloc[:, 2]
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# BASIC PERFORMANCE
# =============================================================================

def analyze_base_vs_selector(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BASE MODEL VS V3.8 SELECTOR")

    base_accuracy = df["_best_correct"].mean()

    selector_accuracy = (
        df["selected_correct_derived"].mean()
    )

    oracle_accuracy = (
        df["alternative_oracle_correct"]
        |
        (df["_best_correct"] == 1)
    ).mean()

    print(
        f"Base model accuracy:     {base_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Selector accuracy:       {selector_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy difference:     "
        f"{selector_accuracy - base_accuracy:+.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle accuracy:         {oracle_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    switched = df["switched_derived"].sum()

    rescues = df["rescue_derived"].sum()

    harms = df["harm_derived"].sum()

    neutral = df["neutral_derived"].sum()

    print()
    print(
        f"Transitions:  {switched:,}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues:      {rescues:,}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms:        {harms:,}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral:      {neutral:,}"
    )

    ratio = (
        rescues / harms
        if harms > 0
        else np.inf
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm ratio: {ratio:.4f}"
    )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "metric": "base_accuracy",
                "value": base_accuracy,
            },
            {
                "metric": "selector_accuracy",
                "value": selector_accuracy,
            },
            {
                "metric": "accuracy_difference",
                "value": selector_accuracy - base_accuracy,
            },
            {
                "metric": "oracle_accuracy",
                "value": oracle_accuracy,
            },
            {
                "metric": "transitions",
                "value": switched,
            },
            {
                "metric": "rescues",
                "value": rescues,
            },
            {
                "metric": "harms",
                "value": harms,
            },
            {
                "metric": "neutral",
                "value": neutral,
            },
            {
                "metric": "rescue_harm_ratio",
                "value": ratio,
            },
        ]
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR / "base_vs_selector_summary.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result

def analyze_transition_confusion(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("TRANSITION TARGET VS SELECTOR PREDICTION")

    labels = [0, 1, 2]

    cm = confusion_matrix(
        df["_target"],
        df["_selector_prediction"],
        labels=labels,
    )

    cm_df = pd.DataFrame(
        cm,
        index=[
            TRANSITION_NAMES[x]
            for x in labels
        ],
        columns=[
            TRANSITION_NAMES[x]
            for x in labels
        ],
    )

    print(cm_df.to_string())

    cm_df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "transition_target_vs_prediction.csv"
    )

    print()

    print(
        classification_report(
            df["_target"],
            df["_selector_prediction"],
            labels=labels,
            target_names=[
                TRANSITION_NAMES[x]
                for x in labels
            ],
            zero_division=0,
        )
    )
