# TRANSITION FREQUENCY
# =============================================================================

def analyze_transition_frequencies(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("TRANSITION FREQUENCY")

    result = (
        df["target_name"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("transition")
        .reset_index(name="samples")
    )

    result["percentage"] = (
        result["samples"]
        /
        len(df)
        *
        100.0
    )

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "transition_target_distribution.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    print()

    print("SELECTOR DECISION DISTRIBUTION")

    selector_result = (
        df["selector_prediction_name_derived"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("selector_decision")
        .reset_index(name="samples")
    )

    selector_result["percentage"] = (
        selector_result["samples"]
        /
        len(df)
        *
        100.0
    )

    print(
        selector_result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    selector_result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "selector_decision_distribution.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# RESCUE / HARM BY TRANSITION
# =============================================================================

def analyze_transition_outcomes(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("RESCUE / HARM BY SELECTOR DECISION")

    rows = []

    for decision in [0, 1, 2]:

        subset = df[
            df["_selector_prediction"]
            == decision
        ]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "decision": decision,
                "decision_name": TRANSITION_NAMES[decision],
                "samples": len(subset),
                "base_accuracy": subset["_best_correct"].mean(),
                "selected_accuracy": subset[
                    "selected_correct_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescues": subset["rescue_derived"].sum(),
                "harms": subset["harm_derived"].sum(),
                "neutral": subset["neutral_derived"].sum(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rescue_harm_by_selector_decision.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# RESCUE AVAILABILITY
# =============================================================================

def analyze_rescue_availability(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("RESCUE AVAILABILITY ANALYSIS")

    rows = []

    masks = {
        "base_wrong": df["_best_correct"] == 0,

        "resnet_can_rescue": (
            (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
            &
            (df["_resnet_correct"] == 1)
        ),

        "mobile_can_rescue": (
            (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
            &
            (df["_mobile_correct"] == 1)
        ),

        "either_can_rescue": (
            (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
            &
            (
                (df["_resnet_correct"] == 1)
                |
                (df["_mobile_correct"] == 1)
            )
        ),

        "both_can_rescue": (
            (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
            &
            (df["_resnet_correct"] == 1)
            &
            (df["_mobile_correct"] == 1)
        ),

        "neither_can_rescue": (
            (df["_best_correct"] == 0)
            &
            (df["_resnet_correct"] == 0)
            &
            (df["_mobile_correct"] == 0)
        ),
    }

    for name, mask in masks.items():

        subset = df[mask]

        rows.append(
            {
                "condition": name,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "percentage": (
                    len(subset)
                    /
                    len(df)
                    *
                    100.0
                ),
                "selector_rescue_rate": (
                    subset["rescue_derived"].mean()
                    if len(subset)
                    else np.nan
                ),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rescue_availability.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# MODEL AGREEMENT
# =============================================================================

def analyze_agreement_patterns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("MODEL AGREEMENT PATTERNS")

    patterns = [
        (
            "all_three_agree",
            df["all_three_agree"] == 1,
        ),
        (
            "best_resnet_agree",
            (df["best_resnet_agreement"] == 1)
            &
            (df["best_mobile_agreement"] == 0),
        ),
        (
            "best_mobile_agree",
            (df["best_mobile_agreement"] == 1)
            &
            (df["best_resnet_agreement"] == 0),
        ),
        (
            "resnet_mobile_agree",
            (df["resnet_mobile_agreement"] == 1)
            &
            (df["best_resnet_agreement"] == 0),
        ),
        (
            "all_disagree",
            (df["best_resnet_agreement"] == 0)
            &
            (df["best_mobile_agreement"] == 0)
            &
            (df["resnet_mobile_agreement"] == 0),
        ),
    ]

    rows = []

    for name, mask in patterns:

        subset = df[mask]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "agreement_pattern": name,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "percentage": len(subset) / len(df) * 100,
                "base_accuracy": subset[
                    "_best_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "selector_accuracy": subset[
                    "selected_correct_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "agreement_pattern_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# CONFIDENCE BIN ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def make_bins(
    series: pd.Series,
) -> pd.Series:

    return pd.cut(
        series,
        bins=[
            -np.inf,
            0.40,
            0.50,
            0.60,
            0.70,
            0.80,
            0.90,
            np.inf,
        ],
        labels=[
            "<=0.40",
            "0.40-0.50",
            "0.50-0.60",
            "0.60-0.70",
            "0.70-0.80",
            "0.80-0.90",
            ">0.90",
        ],
        include_lowest=True,
    )


def analyze_confidence(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("CONFIDENCE-CONDITIONAL FAILURE ANALYSIS")

    work = df.copy()

    work["best_confidence_bin"] = make_bins(
        work["_best_confidence"]
    )

    rows = []

    for bin_name, subset in work.groupby(
        "best_confidence_bin",
        observed=False,
    ):

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "confidence_bin": str(bin_name),
                "samples": len(subset),
                "base_accuracy": subset[
                    "_best_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "selector_accuracy": subset[
                    "selected_correct_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "transition_rate": subset[
                    "switched_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_harm_ratio": (
                    subset["rescue_derived"].sum()
                    /
                    max(
                        subset["harm_derived"].sum(),
                        1,
                    )
                ),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "confidence_conditional_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# GATE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_gates(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("GATE-CONDITIONAL FAILURE ANALYSIS")

    rows = []

    conditions = {
        "no_gate_fired": (
            df["no_gate_fired"] == 1
        ),

        "resnet_only": (
            (df["resnet_gate_fired"] == 1)
            &
            (df["mobile_gate_fired"] == 0)
        ),

        "mobile_only": (
            (df["resnet_gate_fired"] == 0)
            &
            (df["mobile_gate_fired"] == 1)
        ),

        "both_gates_fired": (
            df["both_gates_fired"] == 1
        ),
    }

    for name, mask in conditions.items():

        subset = df[mask]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "gate_pattern": name,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "percentage": len(subset) / len(df) * 100,
                "base_accuracy": subset[
                    "_best_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "selector_accuracy": subset[
                    "selected_correct_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "transition_rate": subset[
                    "switched_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "gate_pattern_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# GATE GAP ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_gate_gap(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("GATE DIFFERENCE ANALYSIS")

    work = df.copy()

    work["gate_gap_bin"] = pd.cut(
        work["gate_abs_difference"],
        bins=[
            -np.inf,
            0.05,
            0.10,
            0.20,
            0.30,
            0.40,
            np.inf,
        ],
        labels=[
            "<=0.05",
            "0.05-0.10",
            "0.10-0.20",
            "0.20-0.30",
            "0.30-0.40",
            ">0.40",
        ],
        include_lowest=True,
    )

    rows = []

    for name, subset in work.groupby(
        "gate_gap_bin",
        observed=False,
    ):

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "gate_gap_bin": str(name),
                "samples": len(subset),
                "base_accuracy": subset[
                    "_best_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "selector_accuracy": subset[
                    "selected_correct_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "transition_rate": subset[
                    "switched_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "gate_gap_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )

def analyze_classes(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("TRUE-CLASS FAILURE ANALYSIS")

    rows = []

    for true_class, subset in df.groupby(
        "_true_class"
    ):

        rows.append(
            {
                "true_class": true_class,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "base_accuracy": subset[
                    "_best_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "selector_accuracy": subset[
                    "selected_correct_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "transition_rate": subset[
                    "switched_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_count": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].sum(),
                "harm_count": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].sum(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    result = result.sort_values(
        "harm_rate",
        ascending=False,
    )

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "class_failure_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )

# =============================================================================
# PREDICTION TRANSITION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_prediction_transitions(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("PREDICTION TRANSITION ANALYSIS")

    work = df.copy()

    work["base_to_resnet"] = (
        work["_best_prediction"].astype(str)
        +
        " -> "
        +
        work["_resnet_prediction"].astype(str)
    )

    work["base_to_mobile"] = (
        work["_best_prediction"].astype(str)
        +
        " -> "
        +
        work["_mobile_prediction"].astype(str)
    )

    rows = []

    for transition, subset in work.groupby(
        "base_to_resnet"
    ):

        rows.append(
            {
                "transition": transition,
                "alternative": "resnet50",
                "samples": len(subset),
                "base_accuracy": subset[
                    "_best_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "resnet_accuracy": subset[
                    "_resnet_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    for transition, subset in work.groupby(
        "base_to_mobile"
    ):

        rows.append(
            {
                "transition": transition,
                "alternative": "mobilenet_v3_large",
                "samples": len(subset),
                "base_accuracy": subset[
                    "_best_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "resnet_accuracy": subset[
                    "_mobile_correct"
                ].mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    result = result.sort_values(
        [
            "harm_rate",
            "samples",
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            False,
        ],
    )

    print(
        result.head(50).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "prediction_transition_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# RESCUE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_rescues(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("SUCCESSFUL RESCUE ANALYSIS")

    rescues = df[
        df["rescue_derived"] == 1
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Successful rescues: {len(rescues):,}"
    )

    if len(rescues) == 0:
        print("No rescues found.")
        return

    rescues["rescue_model"] = (
        rescues["selected_model_derived"]
    )

    result = (
        rescues["rescue_model"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("rescue_model")
        .reset_index(name="rescues")
    )

    result["percentage"] = (
        result["rescues"]
        /
        len(rescues)
        *
        100
    )

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rescue_model_distribution.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # Detailed rescue rows
    detail_columns = [
        "_true_class",
        "_best_prediction",
        "_best_confidence",
        "_resnet_prediction",
        "_resnet_confidence",
        "_resnet_gate",
        "_mobile_prediction",
        "_mobile_confidence",
        "_mobile_gate",
        "selected_model_derived",
        "selected_prediction_derived",
        "rescue_derived",
    ]

    detail = rescues[
        detail_columns
    ].copy()

    detail.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "successful_rescue_samples.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# HARM ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_harms(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("HARMFUL TRANSITION ANALYSIS")

    harms = df[
        df["harm_derived"] == 1
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Harmful transitions: {len(harms):,}"
    )

    if len(harms) == 0:
        print("No harms found.")
        return

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Harm by selected model
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    result = (
        harms["selected_model_derived"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("harm_model")
        .reset_index(name="harms")
    )

    result["percentage"] = (
        result["harms"]
        /
        len(harms)
        *
        100
    )

    print()
    print("HARMS BY SELECTED MODEL")

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "harm_model_distribution.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Harm detailed rows
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    detail_columns = [
        "_true_class",
        "_best_prediction",
        "_best_correct",
        "_best_confidence",

        "_resnet_prediction",
        "_resnet_correct",
        "_resnet_confidence",
        "_resnet_gate",

        "_mobile_prediction",
        "_mobile_correct",
        "_mobile_confidence",
        "_mobile_gate",

        "best_resnet_agreement",
        "best_mobile_agreement",
        "resnet_mobile_agreement",

        "confidence_mean",
        "confidence_std",
        "confidence_range",

        "gate_mean",
        "gate_difference",
        "gate_abs_difference",

        "selected_model_derived",
        "selected_prediction_derived",

        "harm_derived",
    ]

    detail_columns = [
        col
        for col in detail_columns
        if col in harms.columns
    ]

    detail = harms[
        detail_columns
    ].copy()

    detail.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "harmful_transition_samples.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Highest-confidence harms
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    high_conf_harms = harms.sort_values(
        "_best_confidence",
        ascending=False,
    )

    high_conf_harms[
        detail_columns
    ].head(100).to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "high_confidence_harms_top100.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# HARM PATTERN ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_harm_patterns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("HARM PATTERN ANALYSIS")

    harms = df[
        df["harm_derived"] == 1
    ].copy()

    if len(harms) == 0:
        print("No harms.")
        return

    patterns = []

    for (
        selected_model,
        best_agreement,
        mobile_agreement,
        resnet_agreement,
    ), subset in harms.groupby(
        [
            "selected_model_derived",
            "best_resnet_agreement",
            "best_mobile_agreement",
            "resnet_mobile_agreement",
        ]
    ):

        patterns.append(
            {
                "selected_model": selected_model,
                "best_resnet_agreement": best_agreement,
                "best_mobile_agreement": mobile_agreement,
                "resnet_mobile_agreement": resnet_agreement,
                "harms": len(subset),
                "percentage_of_harms": (
                    len(subset)
                    /
                    len(harms)
                    *
                    100
                ),
                "mean_best_confidence": subset[
                    "_best_confidence"
                ].mean(),
                "mean_selected_confidence": np.where(
                    subset["selected_model_derived"]
                    == "resnet50",
                    subset["_resnet_confidence"],
                    np.where(
                        subset["selected_model_derived"]
                        == "mobilenet_v3_large",
                        subset["_mobile_confidence"],
                        subset["_best_confidence"],
                    ),
                ).mean(),
                "mean_selected_gate": np.where(
                    subset["selected_model_derived"]
                    == "resnet50",
                    subset["_resnet_gate"],
                    np.where(
                        subset["selected_model_derived"]
                        == "mobilenet_v3_large",
                        subset["_mobile_gate"],
                        np.nan,
                    ),
                ).mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(patterns)

    result = result.sort_values(
        "harms",
        ascending=False,
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "harm_pattern_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# ALTERNATIVE MODEL COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def analyze_alternative_comparison(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("ALTERNATIVE MODEL CONDITIONAL ANALYSIS")

    rows = []

    for model_name, correct_col, conf_col, gate_col in [
        (
            "resnet50",
            "_resnet_correct",
            "_resnet_confidence",
            "_resnet_gate",
        ),
        (
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
            "_mobile_correct",
            "_mobile_confidence",
            "_mobile_gate",
        ),
    ]:

        subset = df[
            df["_best_correct"] == 0
        ]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "model": model_name,
                "base_wrong_samples": len(subset),
                "alternative_accuracy_when_base_wrong": subset[
                    correct_col
                ].mean(),
                "mean_confidence_when_base_wrong": subset[
                    conf_col
                ].mean(),
                "mean_gate_when_base_wrong": subset[
                    gate_col
                ].mean(),
                "selector_selected_rate": (
                    df["selected_model_derived"]
                    == model_name
                ).mean(),
                "selector_rescue_rate": (
                    (
                        df["rescue_derived"] == 1
                    )
                    &
                    (
                        df["selected_model_derived"]
                        == model_name
                    )
                ).sum()
                /
                max(
                    (
                        df["selected_model_derived"]
                        == model_name
                    ).sum(),
                    1,
                ),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "alternative_model_conditional_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# SELECTOR OVER-SWITCH ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_over_switching(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("OVER-SWITCHING ANALYSIS")

    switched = df[
        df["switched_derived"] == 1
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Total switches: {len(switched):,}"
    )

    if len(switched) == 0:
        return

    switched["alternative_was_correct"] = np.where(
        switched["selected_model_derived"]
        == "resnet50",
        switched["_resnet_correct"],
        np.where(
            switched["selected_model_derived"]
            == "mobilenet_v3_large",
            switched["_mobile_correct"],
            0,
        ),
    )

    switched["switch_success"] = (
        switched["alternative_was_correct"] == 1
    ).astype(int)

    switched["switch_failure"] = (
        switched["alternative_was_correct"] == 0
    ).astype(int)

    result = (
        switched.groupby(
            "selected_model_derived"
        )
        .agg(
            switches=(
                "selected_model_derived",
                "size",
            ),
            alternative_correct=(
                "alternative_was_correct",
                "sum",
            ),
            alternative_accuracy=(
                "alternative_was_correct",
                "mean",
            ),
            mean_best_confidence=(
                "_best_confidence",
                "mean",
            ),
            mean_alternative_confidence=(
                "_resnet_confidence",
                "mean",
            ),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "over_switching_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# CONFIDENCE GAP IN RESCUE / HARM
# =============================================================================

def analyze_confidence_gaps(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("CONFIDENCE GAP: RESCUE VS HARM")

    rows = []

    for outcome, mask in [
        (
            "rescue",
            df["rescue_derived"] == 1,
        ),
        (
            "harm",
            df["harm_derived"] == 1,
        ),
        (
            "neutral",
            df["neutral_derived"] == 1,
        ),
    ]:

        subset = df[mask]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "outcome": outcome,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "best_confidence_mean": subset[
                    "_best_confidence"
                ].mean(),
                "best_confidence_median": subset[
                    "_best_confidence"
                ].median(),
                "resnet_confidence_mean": subset[
                    "_resnet_confidence"
                ].mean(),
                "mobile_confidence_mean": subset[
                    "_mobile_confidence"
                ].mean(),
                "confidence_std_mean": subset[
                    "confidence_std"
                ].mean(),
                "confidence_range_mean": subset[
                    "confidence_range"
                ].mean(),
                "gate_difference_abs_mean": subset[
                    "gate_abs_difference"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rescue_harm_confidence_gap_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# SELECTOR TARGET ERROR ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_target_errors(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("TRANSITION TARGET ERROR ANALYSIS")

    work = df.copy()

    work["target_prediction_correct"] = (
        work["_target"]
        ==
        work["_selector_prediction"]
    ).astype(int)

    rows = []

    for target, subset in work.groupby(
        "_target"
    ):

        rows.append(
            {
                "target": target,
                "target_name": TRANSITION_NAMES.get(
                    target,
                    "unknown",
                ),
                "samples": len(subset),
                "selector_correct": subset[
                    "target_prediction_correct"
                ].sum(),
                "selector_wrong": (
                    1
                    -
                    subset[
                        "target_prediction_correct"
                    ]
                ).sum(),
                "target_accuracy": subset[
                    "target_prediction_correct"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(result.to_string(index=False))

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "transition_target_error_analysis.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# FEATURE SUMMARY FOR RESCUE / HARM
# =============================================================================

def analyze_feature_separation(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("RESCUE VS HARM FEATURE SEPARATION")

    numeric_features = [
        "_best_confidence",
        "_resnet_confidence",
        "_mobile_confidence",
        "_resnet_gate",
        "_mobile_gate",
        "confidence_mean",
        "confidence_std",
        "confidence_range",
        "best_vs_resnet_confidence_gap",
        "best_vs_mobile_confidence_gap",
        "resnet_vs_mobile_confidence_gap",
        "gate_mean",
        "gate_difference",
        "gate_abs_difference",
        "best_resnet_agreement",
        "best_mobile_agreement",
        "resnet_mobile_agreement",
        "all_three_agree",
        "resnet_gate_fired",
        "mobile_gate_fired",
        "both_gates_fired",
        "no_gate_fired",
    ]

    rows = []

    rescue = df[
        df["rescue_derived"] == 1
    ]

    harm = df[
        df["harm_derived"] == 1
    ]

    for feature in numeric_features:

        if feature not in df.columns:
            continue

        rescue_mean = (
            rescue[feature].mean()
            if len(rescue)
            else np.nan
        )

        harm_mean = (
            harm[feature].mean()
            if len(harm)
            else np.nan
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "feature": feature,
                "rescue_mean": rescue_mean,
                "harm_mean": harm_mean,
                "difference_rescue_minus_harm": (
                    rescue_mean
                    -
                    harm_mean
                ),
                "absolute_difference": abs(
                    rescue_mean
                    -
                    harm_mean
                ),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    result = result.sort_values(
        "absolute_difference",
        ascending=False,
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "rescue_harm_feature_separation.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# TOP FAILURE PATTERNS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_top_failure_patterns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("TOP HARM PATTERNS")

    harms = df[
        df["harm_derived"] == 1
    ].copy()

    if len(harms) == 0:
        print("No harmful transitions.")
        return

    pattern_columns = [
        "selected_model_derived",
        "best_resnet_agreement",
        "best_mobile_agreement",
        "resnet_mobile_agreement",
        "resnet_gate_fired",
        "mobile_gate_fired",
        "both_gates_fired",
        "no_gate_fired",
        "target_name",
    ]

    available = [
        col
        for col in pattern_columns
        if col in harms.columns
    ]

    rows = []

    for combination, subset in harms.groupby(
        available,
        dropna=False,
    ):

        if not isinstance(combination, tuple):
            combination = (combination,)

        row = dict(
            zip(
                available,
                combination,
            )
        )

        row["harms"] = len(subset)

        row["percentage_of_harms"] = (
            len(subset)
            /
            len(harms)
            *
            100
        )

        rows.append(row)

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    result = result.sort_values(
        [
            "harms",
            "percentage_of_harms",
        ],
        ascending=False,
    )

    print(
        result.head(30).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "top_harm_patterns.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# SELECTOR DECISION QUALITY
# =============================================================================

def analyze_decision_quality(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("SELECTOR DECISION QUALITY")

    rows = []

    for decision in [0, 1, 2]:

        subset = df[
            df["_selector_prediction"]
            == decision
        ]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        target = df[
            "_target"
        ]

        predicted = df[
            "_selector_prediction"
        ]

        # Correct target rate for this decision.
        target_match = (
            subset["_target"]
            ==
            decision
        )

        # When selector chooses this model, is it actually correct?
        selected_correct = subset[
            "selected_correct_derived"
        ]

        rows.append(
            {
                "decision": decision,
                "decision_name": TRANSITION_NAMES[
                    decision
                ],
                "samples": len(subset),
                "decision_frequency": (
                    len(subset)
                    /
                    len(df)
                ),
                "target_match_rate": target_match.mean(),
                "selected_accuracy": selected_correct.mean(),
                "rescue_rate": subset[
                    "rescue_derived"
                ].mean(),
                "harm_rate": subset[
                    "harm_derived"
                ].mean(),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "selector_decision_quality.csv",
        index=False,
    )


# =============================================================================
# RAW DIAGNOSTIC DATASET
# =============================================================================

def save_enriched_diagnostics(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("SAVING ENRICHED DIAGNOSTIC DATASET")

    # Remove temporary underscore columns only after creating diagnostics.
    save_df = df.copy()

    rename_map = {
        "_true_class": "true_class",
        "_best_prediction": "best_prediction",
        "_best_correct": "best_correct",
        "_best_confidence": "best_confidence",
        "_resnet_prediction": "resnet50_prediction",
        "_resnet_correct": "resnet50_correct",
        "_resnet_confidence": "resnet50_confidence",
        "_resnet_gate": "resnet50_gate_probability",
        "_mobile_prediction": "mobilenet_v3_large_prediction",
        "_mobile_correct": "mobilenet_v3_large_correct",
        "_mobile_confidence": "mobilenet_v3_large_confidence",
        "_mobile_gate": "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability",
        "_target": "transition_target",
        "_selector_prediction": "selector_prediction",
    }

    save_df = save_df.rename(
        columns=rename_map
    )

    output_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_selector_failure_enriched.csv"
    )

    save_df.to_csv(
        output_file,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {output_file}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY JSON
# =============================================================================

def save_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("GENERATING SUMMARY")

    base_accuracy = float(
        df["_best_correct"].mean()
    )

    selector_accuracy = float(
        df["selected_correct_derived"].mean()
    )

    transitions = int(
        df["switched_derived"].sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        df["rescue_derived"].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        df["harm_derived"].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        df["neutral_derived"].sum()
    )

    summary = {
        "project": "Hybrid_v3",
        "analysis": "V3.8 selector failure analysis",
        "diagnostic_only": True,

        "samples": int(len(df)),

        "base_model": BEST_MODEL,

        "base_accuracy": base_accuracy,

        "selector_accuracy": selector_accuracy,

        "accuracy_difference": (
            selector_accuracy
            -
            base_accuracy
        ),

        "transitions": transitions,

        "transition_rate": (
            transitions
            /
            len(df)
        ),

        "rescues": rescues,

        "harms": harms,

        "neutral": neutral,

        "rescue_rate": (
            rescues
            /
            max(transitions, 1)
        ),

        "harm_rate": (
            harms
            /
            max(transitions, 1)
        ),

        "rescue_harm_ratio": (
            rescues
            /
            max(harms, 1)
        ),

        "oracle_accuracy": float(
            (
                (
                    df["_best_correct"] == 1
                )
                |
                (
                    df["alternative_oracle_correct"]
                    == 1
                )
            ).mean()
        ),
    }

    output_file = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_8_selector_failure_summary.json"
    )

    with open(
        output_file,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            summary,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(
        f"Saved: {output_file}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        json.dumps(
            summary,
            indent=2,
        )
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section("V3.8 SELECTOR FAILURE ANALYSIS")

    print(
        f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Input: {INPUT_FILE}"
    )

    print(
        f"Output directory: {OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Diagnostic only."
    )

    print(
        "No new model is trained."
    )

    print(
        "No selector is modified."
    )

    print(
        "No final performance claim is made."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Input check
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if not INPUT_FILE.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "\nV3.8 OOF input file does not exist:\n"
            f"{INPUT_FILE}\n\n"
            "Run train_v3_8_transition_selector.py first."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("LOADING V3.8 OOF SELECTOR RESULTS")

    df = pd.read_csv(
        INPUT_FILE
    )

    print(
        f"Shape: {df.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Discover schema
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    columns = discover_columns(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_input(
        df,
        columns,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Derived diagnostics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("BUILDING DERIVED FAILURE VARIABLES")

    df = add_derived_columns(
        df,
        columns,
    )

    print(
        f"Diagnostic dataframe shape: {df.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Analyses
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    analyze_base_vs_selector(
        df
    )

    analyze_transition_confusion(
        df
    )

    analyze_transition_frequencies(
        df
    )

    analyze_transition_outcomes(
        df
    )

    analyze_rescue_availability(
        df
    )

    analyze_agreement_patterns(
        df
    )

    analyze_confidence(
        df
    )

    analyze_gates(
        df
    )

    analyze_gate_gap(
        df
    )

    analyze_classes(
        df
    )

    analyze_base_prediction_patterns(
        df
    )

    analyze_prediction_transitions(
        df
    )

    analyze_rescues(
        df
    )

    analyze_harms(
        df
    )

    analyze_harm_patterns(
        df
    )

    analyze_alternative_comparison(
        df
    )

    analyze_over_switching(
        df
    )

    analyze_confidence_gaps(
        df
    )

    analyze_target_errors(
        df
    )

    analyze_feature_separation(
        df
    )

    analyze_top_failure_patterns(
        df
    )

    analyze_decision_quality(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save complete diagnostic dataset
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_enriched_diagnostics(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_summary(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final message
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("V3.8 SELECTOR FAILURE ANALYSIS COMPLETE")

    print()
    print(
        "Diagnostic outputs saved to:"
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Important:"
    )

    print(
        "This analysis does NOT establish final selector performance."
    )

    print(
        "The next V3.9 design should be based on the identified "
        "rescue/harm patterns."
    )

    print()
