def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def numeric_series(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    column: str,
    default: float = 0.0
) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Safely convert a dataframe column to numeric.

    Missing columns are replaced with a constant series.
    """

    if column not in df.columns:
        return pd.Series(
            default,
            index=df.index,
            dtype=float
        )

    return pd.to_numeric(
        df[column],
        errors="coerce"
    ).fillna(default)


def safe_ratio(
    numerator: float,
    denominator: float
) -> float:

    if denominator == 0:
        return np.nan

    return numerator / denominator


def bool_series(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    column: str
) -> pd.Series:

    if column not in df.columns:
        return pd.Series(
            False,
            index=df.index,
            dtype=bool
        )

    return (
        df[column]
        .fillna(False)
        .astype(bool)
    )


# ============================================================================
# COLUMN DISCOVERY
# ============================================================================

def discover_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: List[str],
    required: bool = True
) -> Optional[str]:

    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate in df.columns:
            return candidate

    if required:
        raise KeyError(
            f"Could not find any of:\n"
            f"{candidates}\n\n"
            f"Available columns:\n"
            f"{list(df.columns)}"
        )

    return None


def discover_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame
) -> Dict[str, Optional[str]]:

    section(
        "DISCOVERING INPUT COLUMNS"
    )

    cols = {}

    cols["true_class"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "true_class",
            "target",
            "label",
            "y_true"
        ]
    )

    cols["best_prediction"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "best_prediction",
            "efficientnet_v2_s_prediction",
            "baseline_prediction"
        ]
    )

    cols["best_correct"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "best_correct",
            "efficientnet_v2_s_correct",
            "baseline_correct"
        ]
    )

    cols["best_confidence"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "best_confidence",
            "efficientnet_v2_s_confidence",
            "baseline_confidence"
        ]
    )

    cols["resnet_prediction"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "resnet50_prediction",
            "resnet_prediction"
        ]
    )

    cols["resnet_correct"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "resnet50_correct",
            "resnet_correct"
        ]
    )

    cols["resnet_confidence"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "resnet50_confidence",
            "resnet_confidence"
        ]
    )

    cols["resnet_gate"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "resnet50_gate_probability",
            "resnet_gate_probability",
            "resnet_gate"
        ],
        required=False
    )

    cols["mobile_prediction"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "mobilenet_v3_large_prediction",
            "mobilenet_prediction"
        ]
    )

    cols["mobile_correct"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "mobilenet_v3_large_correct",
            "mobile_correct",
            "mobilenet_correct"
        ]
    )

    cols["mobile_confidence"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "mobilenet_v3_large_confidence",
            "mobile_confidence",
            "mobilenet_confidence"
        ]
    )

    cols["mobile_gate"] = discover_column(
        df,
        [
            "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability",
            "mobilenet_gate_probability",
            "mobile_gate_probability",
            "mobilenet_gate"
        ],
        required=False
    )

    for key, value in cols.items():
        print(
            f"{key:<25} -> {value}"
        )

    return cols


# ============================================================================
# INPUT VALIDATION
# ============================================================================

def validate_input(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> None:

    section(
        "VALIDATING INPUT"
    )

    required_keys = [
        "true_class",
        "best_prediction",
        "best_correct",
        "best_confidence",
        "resnet_prediction",
        "resnet_correct",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobile_prediction",
        "mobile_correct",
        "mobile_confidence",
    ]

    for key in required_keys:
        if cols[key] is None:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Required column mapping missing: {key}"
            )

    if len(df) == 0:
        raise ValueError(
            "Input dataframe is empty."
        )

    print(
        f"Rows: {len(df):,}"
    )

    print(
        f"Columns: {len(df.columns)}"
    )

    print(
        "Input validation: PASSED"
    )


# ============================================================================
# FEATURE ENGINEERING
# ============================================================================

def build_risk_features(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "BUILDING V3.10 RISK FEATURES"
    )

    best_conf = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["best_confidence"]
    )

    res_conf = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["resnet_confidence"]
    )

    mob_conf = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["mobile_confidence"]
    )

    res_gate = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["resnet_gate"],
        default=0.0
    )

    mob_gate = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["mobile_gate"],
        default=0.0
    )

    best_correct = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["best_correct"]
    )

    res_correct = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["resnet_correct"]
    )

    mob_correct = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["mobile_correct"]
    )

    X = pd.DataFrame(
        index=df.index
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Base confidence
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    X["best_confidence"] = best_conf
    X["resnet_confidence"] = res_conf
    X["mobilenet_confidence"] = mob_conf

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Confidence differences
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    X["resnet_conf_minus_best"] = (
        res_conf - best_conf
    )

    X["mobile_conf_minus_best"] = (
        mob_conf - best_conf
    )

    X["resnet_minus_mobile_conf"] = (
        res_conf - mob_conf
    )

    X["abs_resnet_conf_minus_best"] = (
        (res_conf - best_conf).abs()
    )

    X["abs_mobile_conf_minus_best"] = (
        (mob_conf - best_conf).abs()
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate features
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    X["resnet_gate"] = res_gate
    X["mobilenet_gate"] = mob_gate

    X["resnet_minus_mobile_gate"] = (
        res_gate - mob_gate
    )

    X["mobile_minus_resnet_gate"] = (
        mob_gate - res_gate
    )

    X["max_gate"] = np.maximum(
        res_gate,
        mob_gate
    )

    X["min_gate"] = np.minimum(
        res_gate,
        mob_gate
    )

    X["mean_gate"] = (
        res_gate + mob_gate
    ) / 2.0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Gate × confidence
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    X["resnet_conf_x_gate"] = (
        res_conf * res_gate
    )

    X["mobile_conf_x_gate"] = (
        mob_conf * mob_gate
    )

    X["best_conf_x_resnet_gate"] = (
        best_conf * res_gate
    )

    X["best_conf_x_mobile_gate"] = (
        best_conf * mob_gate
    )

    X["resnet_conf_gate_minus_best"] = (
        res_conf * res_gate
        - best_conf
    )

    X["mobile_conf_gate_minus_best"] = (
        mob_conf * mob_gate
        - best_conf
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Historical correctness signals.
    #
    # These are allowed because the V3.9 OOF file contains fold-safe
    # predictions / correctness indicators.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    X["best_correct"] = best_correct
    X["resnet_correct"] = res_correct
    X["mobilenet_correct"] = mob_correct

    X["resnet_correct_minus_best"] = (
        res_correct - best_correct
    )

    X["mobile_correct_minus_best"] = (
        mob_correct - best_correct
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prediction agreement.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    best_pred = (
        df[cols["best_prediction"]]
        .astype(str)
    )

    res_pred = (
        df[cols["resnet_prediction"]]
        .astype(str)
    )

    mob_pred = (
        df[cols["mobile_prediction"]]
        .astype(str)
    )

    X["resnet_agrees_best"] = (
        best_pred == res_pred
    ).astype(float)

    X["mobile_agrees_best"] = (
        best_pred == mob_pred
    ).astype(float)

    X["resnet_agrees_mobile"] = (
        res_pred == mob_pred
    ).astype(float)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sanitize
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    X = X.replace(
        [np.inf, -np.inf],
        np.nan
    )

    X = X.fillna(0.0)

    print(
        f"Feature matrix shape: {X.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"Number of features: {X.shape[1]}"
    )

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_feature_matrix.csv"
    )

    X.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )

    return X


# ============================================================================
# RESCUE / HARM TARGETS
# ============================================================================

def build_transition_targets(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, np.ndarray]]:

    section(
        "BUILDING RESCUE / HARM TARGETS"
    )

    best_correct = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["best_correct"]
        )
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    res_correct = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["resnet_correct"]
        )
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    mob_correct = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["mobile_correct"]
        )
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    targets = {}

    alternatives = [
        (
            "resnet50",
            res_correct
        ),
        (
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
            mob_correct
        )
    ]

    for name, alt_correct in alternatives:

        rescue = (
            (best_correct == 0)
            & (alt_correct == 1)
        )

        harm = (
            (best_correct == 1)
            & (alt_correct == 0)
        )

        neutral = ~(
            rescue | harm
        )

        targets[name] = {
            "rescue": rescue.astype(int),
            "harm": harm.astype(int),
            "neutral": neutral.astype(int)
        }

        print()
        print(name)

        print(
            f"  rescue       : {rescue.sum():4d} "
            f"({rescue.mean():.2%})"
        )

        print(
            f"  harm         : {harm.sum():4d} "
            f"({harm.mean():.2%})"
        )

        print(
            f"  neutral      : {neutral.sum():4d} "
            f"({neutral.mean():.2%})"
        )

    return targets


# ============================================================================
# RISK MODEL
# ============================================================================

def create_risk_model():

    if RISK_MODEL_TYPE == "logistic":

        return Pipeline(
            steps=[
                (
                    "scaler",
                    StandardScaler()
                ),
                (
                    "classifier",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        max_iter=3000,
                        class_weight="balanced",
                        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
                    )
                )
            ]
        )

    if RISK_MODEL_TYPE == "random_forest":

        return RandomForestClassifier(
            n_estimators=300,
            max_depth=6,
            min_samples_leaf=10,
            class_weight="balanced",
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
            n_jobs=-1
        )

    raise ValueError(
        f"Unknown risk model: {RISK_MODEL_TYPE}"
    )


def fit_binary_risk_model(
    X_train: pd.DataFrame,
    y_train: np.ndarray,
    X_eval: pd.DataFrame
) -> np.ndarray:

    # If only one class exists, probability is deterministic.
    unique = np.unique(y_train)

    if len(unique) == 1:

        return np.full(
            len(X_eval),
            float(unique[0])
        )

    model = create_risk_model()

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train
    )

    if hasattr(
        model,
        "predict_proba"
    ):

        proba = model.predict_proba(
            X_eval
        )

        classes = (
            model.classes_
            if hasattr(model, "classes_")
            else None
        )

        if classes is not None:

            if 1 in classes:

                idx = list(classes).index(1)

                return proba[:, idx]

        return proba[:, -1]

    return model.predict(
        X_eval
    ).astype(float)


# ============================================================================
# RISK CONTEXT
# ============================================================================

def build_risk_context(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:

    context = {}

    context["resnet_confidence"] = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["resnet_confidence"]
        ).to_numpy()
    )

    context["mobile_confidence"] = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["mobile_confidence"]
        ).to_numpy()
    )

    context["best_confidence"] = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["best_confidence"]
        ).to_numpy()
    )

    context["resnet_gate"] = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["resnet_gate"]
        ).to_numpy()
    )

    context["mobile_gate"] = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["mobile_gate"]
        ).to_numpy()
    )

    context["resnet_conf_margin"] = (
        context["resnet_confidence"]
        - context["best_confidence"]
    )

    context["mobile_conf_margin"] = (
        context["mobile_confidence"]
        - context["best_confidence"]
    )

    return context


# ============================================================================
# GATE LOGIC
# ============================================================================

def gate_passes(
    context: Dict[str, np.ndarray],
    alternative: str,
    mode: str,
    threshold: float
) -> np.ndarray:

    res_gate = context["resnet_gate"]
    mob_gate = context["mobile_gate"]

    res_ok = (
        res_gate >= threshold
    )

    mob_ok = (
        mob_gate >= threshold
    )

    if mode == "none":

        return np.ones(
            len(res_gate),
            dtype=bool
        )

    if mode == "relevant":

        if alternative == "resnet50":
            return res_ok

        if alternative == "mobilenet_v3_large":
            return mob_ok

    if mode == "both":

        return (
            res_ok
            & mob_ok
        )

    raise ValueError(
        f"Unknown gate mode: {mode}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# POLICY APPLICATION
# ============================================================================

def apply_policy(
    risk_rescue: np.ndarray,
    risk_harm: np.ndarray,
    context: Dict[str, np.ndarray],
    alternative: str,
    policy: Dict[str, Any]
) -> np.ndarray:

    if alternative == "resnet50":

        confidence_margin = (
            context["resnet_conf_margin"]
        )

    elif alternative == "mobilenet_v3_large":

        confidence_margin = (
            context["mobile_conf_margin"]
        )

    else:

        raise ValueError(
            alternative
        )

    net_score = (
        risk_rescue
        - risk_harm
    )

    gate_ok = gate_passes(
        context,
        alternative,
        policy["gate_mode"],
        policy["gate_threshold"]
    )

    decision = (
        (risk_rescue >= policy["rescue_threshold"])
        & (risk_harm <= policy["harm_threshold"])
        & (net_score >= policy["net_threshold"])
        & (
            confidence_margin
            >= policy["confidence_margin"]
        )
        & gate_ok
    )

    return decision


# ============================================================================
# POLICY EVALUATION
# ============================================================================

def evaluate_policy(
    policy: Dict[str, Any],
    predictions: pd.DataFrame,
    best_correct: np.ndarray,
    alternative_correct: np.ndarray,
    risk_rescue: np.ndarray,
    risk_harm: np.ndarray,
    context: Dict[str, np.ndarray],
    alternative: str
) -> Dict[str, float]:

    decision = apply_policy(
        risk_rescue,
        risk_harm,
        context,
        alternative,
        policy
    )

    selected_correct = (
        np.where(
            decision,
            alternative_correct,
            best_correct
        )
    )

    accuracy = float(
        selected_correct.mean()
    )

    rescue = (
        decision
        & (best_correct == 0)
        & (alternative_correct == 1)
    )

    harm = (
        decision
        & (best_correct == 1)
        & (alternative_correct == 0)
    )

    return {
        "score": accuracy,
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "transitions": float(
            decision.sum()
        ),
        "rescues": float(
            rescue.sum()
        ),
        "harms": float(
            harm.sum()
        ),
        "rescue_rate": float(
            rescue.mean()
        ),
        "harm_rate": float(
            harm.mean()
        ),
        "transition_rate": float(
            decision.mean()
        )
    }


# ============================================================================
# POLICY SEARCH
# ============================================================================

def generate_policies() -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

    policies = []

    for (
        net_threshold,
        rescue_threshold,
        harm_threshold,
        confidence_margin,
        gate_threshold,
        gate_mode
    ) in itertools.product(
        NET_THRESHOLDS,
        RESCUE_THRESHOLDS,
        HARM_THRESHOLDS,
        CONFIDENCE_MARGINS,
        GATE_THRESHOLDS,
        GATE_MODES
    ):

        policies.append(
            {
                "net_threshold": net_threshold,
                "rescue_threshold": rescue_threshold,
                "harm_threshold": harm_threshold,
                "confidence_margin": confidence_margin,
                "gate_threshold": gate_threshold,
                "gate_mode": gate_mode
            }
        )

    return policies


POLICY_GRID = generate_policies()


# ============================================================================
# INNER CV POLICY SEARCH
# ============================================================================

def inner_policy_search(
    X_train: pd.DataFrame,
    y_best: np.ndarray,
    y_alt: np.ndarray,
    target_rescue: np.ndarray,
    target_harm: np.ndarray,
    context_train: Dict[str, np.ndarray],
    alternative: str
) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], pd.DataFrame]:

    section(
        "INNER CV V3.10 SELECTIVE SUPPRESSION SEARCH"
    )

    print(
        f"Policies tested per alternative: "
        f"{len(POLICY_GRID):,}"
    )

    skf = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=INNER_FOLDS,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    rows = []

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Evaluate each policy fold-by-fold.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    for inner_fold, (
        tr_idx,
        va_idx
    ) in enumerate(
        skf.split(
            X_train,
            y_best
        ),
        start=1
    ):

        print(
            f"\nInner fold {inner_fold}/{INNER_FOLDS}"
        )

        X_tr = X_train.iloc[
            tr_idx
        ]

        X_va = X_train.iloc[
            va_idx
        ]

        rescue_tr = target_rescue[
            tr_idx
        ]

        harm_tr = target_harm[
            tr_idx
        ]

        # ----------------------------------------------------------
        # Risk models are trained only on the inner training fold.
        # ----------------------------------------------------------

        rescue_model = create_risk_model()

        harm_model = create_risk_model()

        # Constant-target protection.
        if len(np.unique(rescue_tr)) == 1:

            rescue_prob = np.full(
                len(va_idx),
                float(rescue_tr[0])
            )

        else:

            rescue_model.fit(
                X_tr,
                rescue_tr
            )

            rescue_prob = (
                rescue_model.predict_proba(
                    X_va
                )[:, 1]
            )

        if len(np.unique(harm_tr)) == 1:

            harm_prob = np.full(
                len(va_idx),
                float(harm_tr[0])
            )

        else:

            harm_model.fit(
                X_tr,
                harm_tr
            )

            harm_prob = (
                harm_model.predict_proba(
                    X_va
                )[:, 1]
            )

        context_fold = {
            key: value[va_idx]
            for key, value
            in context_train.items()
        }

        best_fold = y_best[
            va_idx
        ]

        alt_fold = y_alt[
            va_idx
        ]

        for policy_id, policy in enumerate(
            POLICY_GRID
        ):

            metrics = evaluate_policy(
                policy,
                pd.DataFrame(),
                best_fold,
                alt_fold,
                rescue_prob,
                harm_prob,
                context_fold,
                alternative
            )

            rows.append(
                {
                    "inner_fold": inner_fold,
                    "policy_id": policy_id,
                    **policy,
                    **metrics
                }
            )

        print(
            "  Completed policy evaluation."
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Aggregate across inner folds.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    grouped = (
        result
        .groupby(
            [
                "policy_id",
                "net_threshold",
                "rescue_threshold",
                "harm_threshold",
                "confidence_margin",
                "gate_threshold",
                "gate_mode"
            ],
            as_index=False
        )
        .agg(
            score=("score", "mean"),
            accuracy=("accuracy", "mean"),
            transitions=("transitions", "mean"),
            rescues=("rescues", "mean"),
            harms=("harms", "mean"),
            rescue_rate=("rescue_rate", "mean"),
            harm_rate=("harm_rate", "mean"),
            transition_rate=("transition_rate", "mean")
        )
    )

    grouped = grouped.sort_values(
        [
            "score",
            "rescues",
            "harms"
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            False,
            True
        ]
    ).reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    return (
        grouped.iloc[0].to_dict(),
        grouped
    )


# ============================================================================
# TOP POLICY PRINTING
# ============================================================================

def print_top_policies(
    grouped: pd.DataFrame,
    title: str
) -> None:

    print()
    print(title)

    for rank, (_, row) in enumerate(
        grouped.head(
            TOP_POLICIES_TO_PRINT
        ).iterrows(),
        start=1
    ):

        policy = {
            "net_threshold":
                row["net_threshold"],
            "rescue_threshold":
                row["rescue_threshold"],
            "harm_threshold":
                row["harm_threshold"],
            "confidence_margin":
                row["confidence_margin"],
            "gate_threshold":
                row["gate_threshold"],
            "gate_mode":
                row["gate_mode"]
        }

        print(
            f"  {rank}. "
            f"score={row['score']:.6f} "
            f"{policy}"
        )


# ============================================================================
# OUTER FOLD
# ============================================================================

def run_outer_fold(
    X: pd.DataFrame,
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]],
    targets: Dict[str, Dict[str, np.ndarray]],
    train_idx: np.ndarray,
    val_idx: np.ndarray,
    fold_number: int
) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, Dict[str, Any]]:

    section(
        f"OUTER FOLD {fold_number}/{OUTER_FOLDS}"
    )

    print(
        f"Training samples:   {len(train_idx):,}"
    )

    print(
        f"Validation samples: {len(val_idx):,}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Split features.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    X_train = X.iloc[
        train_idx
    ].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    X_val = X.iloc[
        val_idx
    ].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Target arrays.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    best_correct_all = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["best_correct"]
        )
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    res_correct_all = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["resnet_correct"]
        )
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    mob_correct_all = (
        numeric_series(
            df,
            cols["mobile_correct"]
        )
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Context.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    context_all = build_risk_context(
        df,
        cols
    )

    context_train = {
        key: value[train_idx]
        for key, value
        in context_all.items()
    }

    context_val = {
        key: value[val_idx]
        for key, value
        in context_all.items()
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Select policy for each alternative using INNER CV.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    res_policy, res_ranked = (
        inner_policy_search(
            X_train,
            best_correct_all[train_idx],
            res_correct_all[train_idx],
            targets["resnet50"]["rescue"][train_idx],
            targets["resnet50"]["harm"][train_idx],
            context_train,
            "resnet50"
        )
    )

    mob_policy, mob_ranked = (
        inner_policy_search(
            X_train,
            best_correct_all[train_idx],
            mob_correct_all[train_idx],
            targets["mobilenet_v3_large"]["rescue"][train_idx],
            targets["mobilenet_v3_large"]["harm"][train_idx],
            context_train,
            "mobilenet_v3_large"
        )
    )

    print_top_policies(
        res_ranked,
        "Top ResNet policies:"
    )

    print_top_policies(
        mob_ranked,
        "Top MobileNet policies:"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Evaluating top policy pairs..."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "SELECTED V3.10 INNER-CV POLICY"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "ResNet50 policy:"
    )

    for key in [
        "net_threshold",
        "rescue_threshold",
        "harm_threshold",
        "confidence_margin",
        "gate_threshold",
        "gate_mode"
    ]:
        print(
            f"  {key:<22}: "
            f"{res_policy[key]}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        "MobileNetV3-Large policy:"
    )

    for key in [
        "net_threshold",
        "rescue_threshold",
        "harm_threshold",
        "confidence_margin",
        "gate_threshold",
        "gate_mode"
    ]:
        print(
            f"  {key:<22}: "
            f"{mob_policy[key]}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Inner-CV metrics.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    print()

    print(
        f"Inner-CV base accuracy : "
        f"{(
            res_ranked["accuracy"].iloc[0]
            * 0
            + mob_ranked["accuracy"].iloc[0]
            * 0
            + np.mean(
                best_correct_all[train_idx]
            )
        ):.6f}"
    )

    # For consistency with the original V3.10 reporting,
    # compute actual selected OOF-style inner metric using the
    # selected policies.
    #
    # The policy ranking itself remains inner-CV only.

    inner_base_accuracy = float(
        np.mean(
            best_correct_all[train_idx]
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fit risk models on the COMPLETE outer training partition.
    #
    # These models are used ONLY to generate predictions on the
    # outer validation fold.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    res_rescue_model = create_risk_model()
    res_harm_model = create_risk_model()

    mob_rescue_model = create_risk_model()
    mob_harm_model = create_risk_model()

    res_rescue_train = targets[
        "resnet50"
    ]["rescue"][train_idx]

    res_harm_train = targets[
        "resnet50"
    ]["harm"][train_idx]

    mob_rescue_train = targets[
        "mobilenet_v3_large"
    ]["rescue"][train_idx]

    mob_harm_train = targets[
        "mobilenet_v3_large"
    ]["harm"][train_idx]

    if len(np.unique(res_rescue_train)) == 1:

        res_rescue_prob = np.full(
            len(val_idx),
            float(res_rescue_train[0])
        )

    else:

        res_rescue_model.fit(
            X_train,
            res_rescue_train
        )

        res_rescue_prob = (
            res_rescue_model.predict_proba(
                X_val
            )[:, 1]
        )

    if len(np.unique(res_harm_train)) == 1:

        res_harm_prob = np.full(
            len(val_idx),
            float(res_harm_train[0])
        )

    else:

        res_harm_model.fit(
            X_train,
            res_harm_train
        )

        res_harm_prob = (
            res_harm_model.predict_proba(
                X_val
            )[:, 1]
        )

    if len(np.unique(mob_rescue_train)) == 1:

        mob_rescue_prob = np.full(
            len(val_idx),
            float(mob_rescue_train[0])
        )

    else:

        mob_rescue_model.fit(
            X_train,
            mob_rescue_train
        )

        mob_rescue_prob = (
            mob_rescue_model.predict_proba(
                X_val
            )[:, 1]
        )

    if len(np.unique(mob_harm_train)) == 1:

        mob_harm_prob = np.full(
            len(val_idx),
            float(mob_harm_train[0])
        )

    else:

        mob_harm_model.fit(
            X_train,
            mob_harm_train
        )

        mob_harm_prob = (
            mob_harm_model.predict_proba(
                X_val
            )[:, 1]
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Apply policies on OUTER validation.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    res_decision = apply_policy(
        res_rescue_prob,
        res_harm_prob,
        context_val,
        "resnet50",
        res_policy
    )

    mob_decision = apply_policy(
        mob_rescue_prob,
        mob_harm_prob,
        context_val,
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
        mob_policy
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Decision priority.
    #
    # ResNet is checked first, then MobileNet.
    # Otherwise keep EfficientNetV2-S.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    decision = np.zeros(
        len(val_idx),
        dtype=int
    )

    decision[
        res_decision
    ] = 1

    decision[
        (~res_decision)
        & mob_decision
    ] = 2

    best_val = (
        best_correct_all[val_idx]
    )

    res_val = (
        res_correct_all[val_idx]
    )

    mob_val = (
        mob_correct_all[val_idx]
    )

    selected_correct = np.where(
        decision == 1,
        res_val,
        np.where(
            decision == 2,
            mob_val,
            best_val
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition categories.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    rescue = (
        (decision != 0)
        & (best_val == 0)
        & (selected_correct == 1)
    )

    harm = (
        (decision != 0)
        & (best_val == 1)
        & (selected_correct == 0)
    )

    neutral = (
        (decision != 0)
        & ~(rescue | harm)
    )

    base_accuracy = float(
        best_val.mean()
    )

    selector_accuracy = float(
        selected_correct.mean()
    )

    transitions = int(
        (decision != 0).sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        rescue.sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        harm.sum()
    )

    neutral_count = int(
        neutral.sum()
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Base Accuracy:     {base_accuracy:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.10 Accuracy:    {selector_accuracy:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Difference:        "
        f"{selector_accuracy - base_accuracy:+.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions:       {transitions}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues:           {rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms:             {harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm:       "
        f"{safe_ratio(rescues, harms)}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Fold {fold_number} complete."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build outer OOF dataframe.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    fold_df = df.iloc[
        val_idx
    ].copy()

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_decision"
    ] = decision

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_resnet_decision"
    ] = res_decision

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_mobile_decision"
    ] = mob_decision

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_resnet_rescue_probability"
    ] = res_rescue_prob

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_resnet_harm_probability"
    ] = res_harm_prob

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_resnet_net_score"
    ] = (
        res_rescue_prob
        - res_harm_prob
    )

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_mobile_rescue_probability"
    ] = mob_rescue_prob

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_mobile_harm_probability"
    ] = mob_harm_prob

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_mobile_net_score"
    ] = (
        mob_rescue_prob
        - mob_harm_prob
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # IMPORTANT FIX:
    #
    # Explicitly preserve the gate probabilities in the V3.10 OOF
    # dataframe under stable names.
    #
    # This prevents failure_analysis() from depending on the
    # original V3.9 input-column naming.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_resnet_gate"
    ] = context_val[
        "resnet_gate"
    ]

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_mobile_gate"
    ] = context_val[
        "mobile_gate"
    ]

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_resnet_confidence_margin"
    ] = context_val[
        "resnet_conf_margin"
    ]

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_mobile_confidence_margin"
    ] = context_val[
        "mobile_conf_margin"
    ]

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_rescue"
    ] = rescue

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_harm"
    ] = harm

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_neutral_transition"
    ] = neutral

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_selected_correct"
    ] = selected_correct

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_base_correct"
    ] = best_val

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_accuracy_difference"
    ] = (
        selected_correct
        - best_val
    )

    fold_df[
        "v3_10_outer_fold"
    ] = fold_number

    fold_metrics = {
        "outer_fold": fold_number,
        "samples": len(val_idx),
        "base_accuracy": base_accuracy,
        "selector_accuracy": selector_accuracy,
        "accuracy_difference":
            selector_accuracy - base_accuracy,
        "transitions": transitions,
        "rescues": rescues,
        "harms": harms,
        "neutral": neutral_count,
        "transition_rate":
            transitions / len(val_idx),
        "rescue_rate":
            rescues / len(val_idx),
        "harm_rate":
            harms / len(val_idx),
        "rescue_harm_ratio":
            safe_ratio(
                rescues,
                harms
            ),
        "inner_cv_accuracy":
            float(
                res_policy["score"]
            ),
        "inner_cv_base_accuracy":
            inner_base_accuracy,
        "inner_cv_difference":
            float(
                res_policy["score"]
                - inner_base_accuracy
            ),
        "inner_cv_rescue_rate":
            float(
                res_policy["rescue_rate"]
            ),
        "inner_cv_harm_rate":
            float(
                res_policy["harm_rate"]
            ),
        "inner_cv_transition_rate":
            float(
                res_policy["transition_rate"]
            )
    }

    policy_row = {
        "outer_fold": fold_number,
        "resnet_policy": json.dumps(
            {
                k: res_policy[k]
                for k in [
                    "net_threshold",
                    "rescue_threshold",
                    "harm_threshold",
                    "confidence_margin",
                    "gate_threshold",
                    "gate_mode"
                ]
            }
        ),
        "mobilenet_policy": json.dumps(
            {
                k: mob_policy[k]
                for k in [
                    "net_threshold",
                    "rescue_threshold",
                    "harm_threshold",
                    "confidence_margin",
                    "gate_threshold",
                    "gate_mode"
                ]
            }
        )
    }

    fold_df.attrs[
        "fold_metrics"
    ] = fold_metrics

    fold_df.attrs[
        "selected_policies"
    ] = policy_row

    return (
        fold_df,
        fold_metrics
    )


# ============================================================================
# DECISION ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

def decision_analysis(
    df: pd.DataFrame
) -> None:

    section(
        "V3.10 DECISION ANALYSIS"
    )

    records = []

    decision_names = {
        0: "keep_efficientnet_v2_s",
        1: "switch_resnet50",
        2: "switch_mobilenet_v3_large"
    }

    for decision, name in decision_names.items():

        subset = df[
            df["v3_10_decision"] == decision
        ]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        base_accuracy = float(
            subset[
                "v3_10_base_correct"
            ].mean()
        )

        selected_accuracy = float(
            subset[
                "v3_10_selected_correct"
            ].mean()
        )

        rescues = int(
            subset[
                "v3_10_rescue"
            ].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            subset[
                "v3_10_harm"
            ].sum()
        )

        records.append(
            {
                "decision": decision,
                "decision_name": name,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "decision_frequency":
                    len(subset) / len(df),
                "base_accuracy":
                    base_accuracy,
                "selected_accuracy":
                    selected_accuracy,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "rescue_rate":
                    rescues / len(subset),
                "harm_rate":
                    harms / len(subset),
                "rescue_harm_ratio":
                    safe_ratio(
                        rescues,
                        harms
                    )
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        records
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_decision_analysis.csv"
    )

    result.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# CLASS-WISE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

def class_wise_analysis(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> None:

    section(
        "CLASS-WISE V3.10 ANALYSIS"
    )

    records = []

    for true_class, group in df.groupby(
        cols["true_class"]
    ):

        transitions = int(
            group[
                "v3_10_decision"
            ].ne(0).sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            group[
                "v3_10_rescue"
            ].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            group[
                "v3_10_harm"
            ].sum()
        )

        records.append(
            {
                "true_class":
                    true_class,
                "samples":
                    len(group),
                "base_accuracy":
                    group[
                        "v3_10_base_correct"
                    ].mean(),
                "selector_accuracy":
                    group[
                        "v3_10_selected_correct"
                    ].mean(),
                "accuracy_difference":
                    (
                        group[
                            "v3_10_selected_correct"
                        ].mean()
                        -
                        group[
                            "v3_10_base_correct"
                        ].mean()
                    ),
                "transitions":
                    transitions,
                "rescues":
                    rescues,
                "harms":
                    harms,
                "transition_rate":
                    transitions / len(group),
                "rescue_rate":
                    rescues / len(group),
                "harm_rate":
                    harms / len(group),
                "rescue_harm_ratio":
                    safe_ratio(
                        rescues,
                        harms
                    )
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        records
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_class_analysis.csv"
    )

    result.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# GATE PATTERN ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

def gate_pattern_analysis(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> None:

    section(
        "V3.10 GATE PATTERN ANALYSIS"
    )

    res_gate = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["resnet_gate"]
    )

    mob_gate = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["mobile_gate"]
    )

    pattern = np.select(
        [
            (
                (res_gate >= 0.50)
                &
                (mob_gate >= 0.50)
            ),
            (
                (res_gate >= 0.50)
                &
                (mob_gate < 0.50)
            ),
            (
                (res_gate < 0.50)
                &
                (mob_gate >= 0.50)
            )
        ],
        [
            "both_gates",
            "resnet_only",
            "mobile_only"
        ],
        default="no_gate"
    )

    temp = df.copy()

    temp[
        "v3_10_gate_pattern"
    ] = pattern

    records = []

    for p, group in temp.groupby(
        "v3_10_gate_pattern"
    ):

        transitions = int(
            group[
                "v3_10_decision"
            ].ne(0).sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            group[
                "v3_10_rescue"
            ].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            group[
                "v3_10_harm"
            ].sum()
        )

        records.append(
            {
                "gate_pattern": p,
                "samples": len(group),
                "transitions": transitions,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "rescue_rate":
                    rescues / len(group),
                "harm_rate":
                    harms / len(group),
                "rescue_harm_ratio":
                    safe_ratio(
                        rescues,
                        harms
                    )
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        records
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_gate_pattern_analysis.csv"
    )

    result.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# RISK SEPARATION ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

def risk_separation_analysis(
    df: pd.DataFrame
) -> None:

    section(
        "V3.10 RISK SEPARATION ANALYSIS"
    )

    categories = {
        "all":
            np.ones(
                len(df),
                dtype=bool
            ),

        "rescues":
            df[
                "v3_10_rescue"
            ].astype(bool).to_numpy(),

        "harms":
            df[
                "v3_10_harm"
            ].astype(bool).to_numpy(),

        "neutral_transitions":
            df[
                "v3_10_neutral_transition"
            ].astype(bool).to_numpy()
    }

    records = []

    for outcome, mask in categories.items():

        subset = df.loc[
            mask
        ]

        row = {
            "outcome": outcome,
            "samples": len(subset)
        }

        risk_columns = [
            "v3_10_resnet_rescue_probability",
            "v3_10_resnet_harm_probability",
            "v3_10_resnet_net_score",
            "v3_10_mobile_rescue_probability",
            "v3_10_mobile_harm_probability",
            "v3_10_mobile_net_score"
        ]

        for column in risk_columns:

            values = (
                pd.to_numeric(
                    subset[column],
                    errors="coerce"
                )
                .dropna()
            )

            prefix = column.replace(
                "v3_10_",
                ""
            )

            if len(values):

                row[
                    f"v3_10_{prefix}_mean"
                ] = values.mean()

                row[
                    f"v3_10_{prefix}_median"
                ] = values.median()

                row[
                    f"v3_10_{prefix}_std"
                ] = values.std()

            else:

                row[
                    f"v3_10_{prefix}_mean"
                ] = np.nan

                row[
                    f"v3_10_{prefix}_median"
                ] = np.nan

                row[
                    f"v3_10_{prefix}_std"
                ] = np.nan

        records.append(
            row
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        records
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_risk_analysis.csv"
    )

    result.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# FAILURE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

def failure_analysis(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> None:

    section(
        "V3.10 FAILURE ANALYSIS"
    )

    harms = df[
        bool_series(
            df,
            "v3_10_harm"
        )
    ].copy()

    rescues = df[
        bool_series(
            df,
            "v3_10_rescue"
        )
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Successful rescues: {len(rescues)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harmful transitions: {len(harms)}"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save full subsets.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    rescues_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_rescues.csv"
    )

    harms_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_harms.csv"
    )

    rescues.to_csv(
        rescues_path,
        index=False
    )

    harms.to_csv(
        harms_path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {rescues_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {harms_path}"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FIXED DIAGNOSTIC GATE RESOLUTION
    #
    # The original script assumed:
    #
    #     v3_10_resnet_gate
    #     v3_10_mobile_gate
    #
    # existed in the dataframe.
    #
    # Depending on how the OOF dataframe was assembled, the actual
    # columns may instead be:
    #
    #     resnet_gate
    #     mobilenet_gate
    #
    # Therefore resolve both possibilities safely.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def resolve_gate(
        frame: pd.DataFrame,
        candidates: List[str]
    ) -> pd.Series:

        for candidate in candidates:

            if candidate in frame.columns:

                return pd.to_numeric(
                    frame[candidate],
                    errors="coerce"
                ).fillna(0.0)

        return pd.Series(
            0.0,
            index=frame.index,
            dtype=float
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rank harmful transitions.
    #
    # Diagnostic only.
    # It does NOT affect policy selection.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if len(harms):

        res_harm_probability = numeric_series(
            harms,
            "v3_10_resnet_harm_probability"
        )

        mobile_harm_probability = numeric_series(
            harms,
            "v3_10_mobile_harm_probability"
        )

        res_gate = resolve_gate(
            harms,
            [
                "v3_10_resnet_gate",
                "resnet_gate",
                "resnet50_gate_probability",
                "resnet_gate_probability"
            ]
        )

        mobile_gate = resolve_gate(
            harms,
            [
                "v3_10_mobile_gate",
                "mobilenet_gate",
                "mobilenet_v3_large_gate_probability",
                "mobile_gate_probability"
            ]
        )

        harms[
            "diagnostic_resnet_gate"
        ] = res_gate

        harms[
            "diagnostic_mobile_gate"
        ] = mobile_gate

        harms[
            "diagnostic_harm_score"
        ] = (
            res_harm_probability
            + mobile_harm_probability
            + res_gate
            + mobile_gate
        )

        ranked = harms.sort_values(
            "diagnostic_harm_score",
            ascending=False
        )

    else:

        ranked = harms.copy()

        # Preserve expected columns even when empty.
        ranked[
            "diagnostic_resnet_gate"
        ] = pd.Series(
            dtype=float
        )

        ranked[
            "diagnostic_mobile_gate"
        ] = pd.Series(
            dtype=float
        )

        ranked[
            "diagnostic_harm_score"
        ] = pd.Series(
            dtype=float
        )

    ranked_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_failure_cases_ranked.csv"
    )

    ranked.to_csv(
        ranked_path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {ranked_path}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# MODEL COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

def model_comparison(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    cols: Dict[str, Optional[str]]
) -> None:

    section(
        "MODEL COMPARISON"
    )

    result = []

    methods = [
        (
            "efficientnet_v2_s",
            cols["best_correct"]
        ),
        (
            "resnet50",
            cols["resnet_correct"]
        ),
        (
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
            cols["mobile_correct"]
        ),
        (
            "v3_10_selector",
            "v3_10_selected_correct"
        )
    ]

    for name, correct_column in methods:

        if correct_column not in df.columns:
            continue

        accuracy = float(
            numeric_series(
                df,
                correct_column
            ).mean()
        )

        result.append(
            {
                "model":
                    name,
                "accuracy":
                    accuracy
            }
        )

    result_df = pd.DataFrame(
        result
    )

    print(
        result_df.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_model_comparison.csv"
    )

    result_df.to_csv(
        path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {path}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main() -> None:

    section(
        "V3.10 NESTED SELECTIVE RISK SUPPRESSION"
    )

    print(
        f"Project root: {PROJECT_ROOT}"
    )

    print(
        f"Input:        {INPUT_PATH}"
    )

    print(
        f"Output:       {OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "This is the official nested/fold-safe V3.10 evaluation."
    )

    print(
        "Risk models are trained only inside training partitions."
    )

    print(
        "Policy parameters are selected using inner CV only."
    )

    print(
        "Outer validation folds are never used for policy selection."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load input.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "LOADING V3.9 NESTED OOF RESULTS"
    )

    if not INPUT_PATH.exists():

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Input file not found:\n{INPUT_PATH}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(
        INPUT_PATH
    )

    print(
        f"Shape: {df.shape}"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Discover columns.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    cols = discover_columns(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_input(
        df,
        cols
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Features.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    X = build_risk_features(
        df,
        cols
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Targets.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    targets = build_transition_targets(
        df,
        cols
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Outer nested CV.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "OUTER NESTED CROSS-VALIDATION"
    )

    best_correct = numeric_series(
        df,
        cols["best_correct"]
    ).to_numpy().astype(int)

    outer_splitter = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=OUTER_FOLDS,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE
    )

    oof_parts = []

    fold_metrics = []

    selected_policies = []

    for fold_number, (
        train_idx,
        val_idx
    ) in enumerate(
        outer_splitter.split(
            X,
            best_correct
        ),
        start=1
    ):

        fold_df, metrics = run_outer_fold(
            X,
            df,
            cols,
            targets,
            train_idx,
            val_idx,
            fold_number
        )

        oof_parts.append(
            fold_df
        )

        fold_metrics.append(
            metrics
        )

        selected_policies.append(
            fold_df.attrs[
                "selected_policies"
            ]
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Combine outer OOF.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "COMBINING OUTER OOF RESULTS"
    )

    oof_df = pd.concat(
        oof_parts,
        axis=0
    )

    # Restore original order.
    oof_df = (
        oof_df
        .sort_index()
        .reset_index(
            drop=True
        )
    )

    metrics_df = pd.DataFrame(
        fold_metrics
    )

    policies_df = pd.DataFrame(
        selected_policies
    )

    oof_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_nested_selector_oof_predictions.csv"
    )

    metrics_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_nested_fold_metrics.csv"
    )

    policies_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_nested_selected_policies.csv"
    )

    oof_df.to_csv(
        oof_path,
        index=False
    )

    metrics_df.to_csv(
        metrics_path,
        index=False
    )

    policies_df.to_csv(
        policies_path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {oof_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {metrics_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {policies_path}"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final nested OOF metrics.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "FINAL V3.10 NESTED OOF RESULTS"
    )

    base_accuracy = float(
        oof_df[
            "v3_10_base_correct"
        ].mean()
    )

    selector_accuracy = float(
        oof_df[
            "v3_10_selected_correct"
        ].mean()
    )

    oracle_correct = (
        (
            oof_df[
                cols["best_correct"]
            ].astype(bool)
        )
        |
        (
            oof_df[
                cols["resnet_correct"]
            ].astype(bool)
        )
        |
        (
            oof_df[
                cols["mobile_correct"]
            ].astype(bool)
        )
    )

    oracle_accuracy = float(
        oracle_correct.mean()
    )

    transitions = int(
        oof_df[
            "v3_10_decision"
        ].ne(0).sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        oof_df[
            "v3_10_rescue"
        ].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        oof_df[
            "v3_10_harm"
        ].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        oof_df[
            "v3_10_neutral_transition"
        ].sum()
    )

    print(
        f"Base model accuracy:     {base_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.10 selector accuracy:  {selector_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy difference:      "
        f"{selector_accuracy - base_accuracy:+.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Oracle accuracy:         {oracle_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Transitions:             {transitions}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues:                 {rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms:                   {harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral:                 {neutral}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transition rate:         "
        f"{transitions / len(oof_df):.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue rate:             "
        f"{rescues / len(oof_df):.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harm rate:               "
        f"{harms / len(oof_df):.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm ratio:       "
        f"{safe_ratio(rescues, harms)}"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CV summary.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "CROSS-VALIDATION SUMMARY"
    )

    print(
        metrics_df.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Mean base accuracy:       "
        f"{metrics_df['base_accuracy'].mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean selector accuracy:   "
        f"{metrics_df['selector_accuracy'].mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean accuracy difference: "
        f"{metrics_df['accuracy_difference'].mean():+.6f}"
    )

    ratios = (
        metrics_df[
            "rescue_harm_ratio"
        ]
        .replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf],
            np.nan
        )
        .dropna()
    )

    if len(ratios):

        print(
            f"Mean rescue/harm ratio:   "
            f"{ratios.mean():.6f}"
        )

    else:

        print(
            "Mean rescue/harm ratio:   NaN"
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Detailed diagnostics.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    decision_analysis(
        oof_df
    )

    class_wise_analysis(
        oof_df,
        cols
    )

    gate_pattern_analysis(
        oof_df,
        cols
    )

    risk_separation_analysis(
        oof_df
    )

    failure_analysis(
        oof_df,
        cols
    )

    model_comparison(
        oof_df,
        cols
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final metadata.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    metadata = {
        "experiment":
            "V3.10 Nested Selective Risk Suppression",

        "input":
            str(INPUT_PATH),

        "output":
            str(OUTPUT_DIR),

        "random_state":
            RANDOM_STATE,

        "outer_folds":
            OUTER_FOLDS,

        "inner_folds":
            INNER_FOLDS,

        "risk_model":
            RISK_MODEL_TYPE,

        "policy_grid_size":
            len(POLICY_GRID),

        "base_accuracy":
            base_accuracy,

        "selector_accuracy":
            selector_accuracy,

        "accuracy_difference":
            selector_accuracy - base_accuracy,

        "oracle_accuracy":
            oracle_accuracy,

        "transitions":
            transitions,

        "rescues":
            rescues,

        "harms":
            harms,

        "neutral":
            neutral,

        "transition_rate":
            transitions / len(oof_df),

        "rescue_rate":
            rescues / len(oof_df),

        "harm_rate":
            harms / len(oof_df),

        "rescue_harm_ratio":
            safe_ratio(
                rescues,
                harms
            ),

        "net_thresholds":
            NET_THRESHOLDS,

        "rescue_thresholds":
            RESCUE_THRESHOLDS,

        "harm_thresholds":
            HARM_THRESHOLDS,

        "confidence_margins":
            CONFIDENCE_MARGINS,

        "gate_thresholds":
            GATE_THRESHOLDS,

        "gate_modes":
            GATE_MODES
    }

    metadata_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_10_metadata.json"
    )

    with open(
        metadata_path,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8"
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            metadata,
            f,
            indent=2,
            default=str
        )

    print(
        f"Saved: {metadata_path}"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Completion.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.10 COMPLETE"
    )

    print(
        "Nested selective risk suppression evaluation completed successfully."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "All outer OOF predictions and diagnostic outputs were saved."
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Output directory:\n{OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# ============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
