    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


# =============================================================================
# LOADING
# =============================================================================

def load_data() -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("LOADING V3.15 ARTIFACTS")

    for path in [FEATURE_FILE, TARGET_FILE, OOF_FILE]:
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"Required V3.15 artifact does not exist:\n{path}"
            )

    features = pd.read_csv(FEATURE_FILE)
    targets = pd.read_csv(TARGET_FILE)
    oof = pd.read_csv(OOF_FILE)

    print(f"Feature matrix : {features.shape}")
    print(f"Target matrix  : {targets.shape}")
    print(f"OOF predictions: {oof.shape}")

    if not (
        len(features)
        == len(targets)
        == len(oof)
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.15 artifacts do not have the same number of rows."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicit schema validation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    required_features = [
        "efficientnet_confidence",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_gate",
        "mobile_gate",
        "resnet_minus_effnet_conf",
        "mobile_minus_effnet_conf",
        "resnet_abs_conf_gap",
        "mobile_abs_conf_gap",
        "alternative_conf_max",
        "alternative_conf_margin",
        "resnet_gate_minus_effnet_conf",
        "mobile_gate_minus_effnet_conf",
        "resnet_conf_x_gate",
        "mobile_conf_x_gate",
        "resnet_gate_x_conf_gap",
        "mobile_gate_x_conf_gap",
        "resnet_rescue_evidence",
        "mobile_rescue_evidence",
        "resnet_vs_mobile_gate",
        "resnet_vs_mobile_conf",
        "resnet_vs_mobile_score",
        "efficientnet_agrees_resnet",
        "efficientnet_agrees_mobile",
        "resnet_agrees_mobile",
        "efficientnet_disagrees_resnet",
        "efficientnet_disagrees_mobile",
        "resnet_disagrees_mobile",
        "all_agree",
        "num_unique_predictions",
        "resnet_switch_signal",
        "mobile_switch_signal",
        "resnet_switch_advantage",
        "mobile_switch_advantage",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
        "resnet_gate_relative_strength",
        "mobile_gate_relative_strength",
        "alternative_conf_rank",
        "resnet_gate_rank",
        "mobile_gate_rank",
    ]

    required_targets = [
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
    ]

    required_oof = [
        "outer_fold",
        "resnet_rescue_probability",
        "mobile_rescue_probability",
        "base_correct",
        "selected_correct",
        "transition",
        "rescue",
        "harm",
        "neutral_transition",
    ]

    missing_features = [
        c for c in required_features
        if c not in features.columns
    ]

    missing_targets = [
        c for c in required_targets
        if c not in targets.columns
    ]

    missing_oof = [
        c for c in required_oof
        if c not in oof.columns
    ]

    if missing_features:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing V3.15 feature columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {x}" for x in missing_features)
        )

    if missing_targets:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing V3.15 target columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {x}" for x in missing_targets)
        )

    if missing_oof:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing V3.15 OOF columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {x}" for x in missing_oof)
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Concatenate by row order.
    #
    # V3.15 generated these artifacts from the same dataframe and all are
    # exactly 1267 rows. We intentionally do NOT merge on an invented key.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = pd.concat(
        [
            oof.reset_index(drop=True),
            features.reset_index(drop=True),
            targets.reset_index(drop=True),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    print()
    print(f"Combined dataframe: {df.shape}")

    # Detect duplicate column names.
    if df.columns.duplicated().any():
        duplicates = df.columns[df.columns.duplicated()].tolist()
        raise ValueError(
            f"Duplicate columns after concatenation: {duplicates}"
        )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# SANITIZATION
# =============================================================================

def sanitize_numeric(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:

    numeric_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c not in ["selected_model", "resnet_specialist_model",
                     "mobile_specialist_model"]
    ]

    for c in numeric_cols:
        if df[c].dtype == object:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(
                df[c],
                errors="coerce",
            )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# DATA VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_data(df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:

    section("VALIDATING V3.15 DATA")

    if len(df) != 1267:
        print(
            f"WARNING: Expected 1267 rows, found {len(df)}."
        )

    binary_cols = [
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
        "base_correct",
    ]

    for c in binary_cols:
        if c not in df.columns:
            continue

        values = set(
            pd.Series(df[c])
            .dropna()
            .astype(int)
            .unique()
        )

        if not values.issubset({0, 1}):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Column {c} is not binary: {values}"
            )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Basic consistency
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    expected_base_correct = 1 - df["efficientnet_error"].astype(int)

    mismatch = (
        expected_base_correct
        != df["base_correct"].astype(int)
    ).sum()

    if mismatch:
        print(
            f"WARNING: {mismatch} rows have base_correct != "
            f"1 - efficientnet_error."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "✓ base_correct is exactly consistent with efficientnet_error."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rescue/harm sanity
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for specialist in ["resnet", "mobile"]:

        rescue = df[f"{specialist}_rescue"].astype(int)
        harm = df[f"{specialist}_harm"].astype(int)

        overlap = ((rescue == 1) & (harm == 1)).sum()

        print(
            f"{specialist:8s} rescue={rescue.sum():4d} "
            f"harm={harm.sum():4d} "
            f"rescue+harm overlap={overlap:3d}"
        )

        if overlap:
            print(
                f"WARNING: {specialist} contains rows marked both "
                "rescue and harm."
            )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Recoverable errors
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    efficientnet_errors = (
        df["efficientnet_error"].astype(int) == 1
    )

    recoverable = (
        (df["resnet_rescue"].astype(int) == 1)
        | (df["mobile_rescue"].astype(int) == 1)
    )

    recoverable_errors = (
        efficientnet_errors
        & recoverable
    ).sum()

    total_errors = efficientnet_errors.sum()

    print()
    print(f"EfficientNet errors       : {total_errors}")
    print(f"Recoverable errors        : {recoverable_errors}")
    print(
        f"Unrecoverable errors      : "
        f"{total_errors - recoverable_errors}"
    )

    if recoverable_errors:
        print(
            f"Recoverable fraction      : "
            f"{recoverable_errors / total_errors:.4f}"
        )


# =============================================================================
# BASELINE
# =============================================================================

def print_baseline(df: pd.DataFrame) -> Dict[str, float]:

    section("BASELINE")

    n = len(df)

    base_correct = df["base_correct"].astype(int)

    accuracy = base_correct.mean()

    total_errors = (
        df["efficientnet_error"].astype(int).sum()
    )

    recoverable = (
        (
            df["resnet_rescue"].astype(int)
            | df["mobile_rescue"].astype(int)
        )
        & df["efficientnet_error"].astype(int).astype(bool)
    ).sum()

    oracle_correct = (
        base_correct
        | df["resnet_rescue"].astype(int)
        | df["mobile_rescue"].astype(int)
    )

    oracle_accuracy = oracle_correct.mean()

    print(f"Samples                  : {n}")
    print(f"EfficientNet accuracy    : {accuracy:.6f}")
    print(f"EfficientNet errors      : {total_errors}")
    print(f"Recoverable errors       : {recoverable}")
    print(f"Oracle accuracy          : {oracle_accuracy:.6f}")
    print(
        f"Theoretical headroom    : "
        f"{oracle_accuracy - accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    return {
        "n": n,
        "base_accuracy": accuracy,
        "base_errors": total_errors,
        "recoverable_errors": recoverable,
        "oracle_accuracy": oracle_accuracy,
        "headroom": oracle_accuracy - accuracy,
    }


# =============================================================================
# POLICY SCORES
# =============================================================================

def build_policy_scores(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Build inference-time policy scores.

    These are deterministic transformations of V3.15 features/probabilities.
    No target information is used.
    """

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    r = df["resnet_rescue_probability"].astype(float).clip(0, 1)
    m = df["mobile_rescue_probability"].astype(float).clip(0, 1)

    er = df["efficientnet_confidence"].astype(float).clip(0, 1)
    rc = df["resnet_confidence"].astype(float).clip(0, 1)
    mc = df["mobilenet_confidence"].astype(float).clip(0, 1)

    rg = df["resnet_gate"].astype(float).clip(0, 1)
    mg = df["mobile_gate"].astype(float).clip(0, 1)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A: pure rescue probability
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_prob"] = r
    out["mobile_prob"] = m

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # B: probability + specialist gate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_prob_gate"] = r * rg
    out["mobile_prob_gate"] = m * mg

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # C: probability + confidence
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_prob_conf"] = r * rc
    out["mobile_prob_conf"] = m * mc

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # D: probability × relative confidence
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    res_rel_conf = (
        rc - er
    )

    mob_rel_conf = (
        mc - er
    )

    out["resnet_prob_relconf"] = (
        r * (1.0 + res_rel_conf)
    )

    out["mobile_prob_relconf"] = (
        m * (1.0 + mob_rel_conf)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # E: rescue probability × gate-relative strength
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_prob_relstrength"] = (
        r * df["resnet_gate_relative_strength"].astype(float)
    )

    out["mobile_prob_relstrength"] = (
        m * df["mobile_gate_relative_strength"].astype(float)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # F: rescue probability + confidence advantage
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_prob_plus_advantage"] = (
        r + np.maximum(
            df["resnet_switch_advantage"].astype(float),
            0.0,
        )
    )

    out["mobile_prob_plus_advantage"] = (
        m + np.maximum(
            df["mobile_switch_advantage"].astype(float),
            0.0,
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # G: rescue probability × positive confidence advantage
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_prob_x_advantage"] = (
        r * (
            1.0
            + np.maximum(
                df["resnet_minus_effnet_conf"].astype(float),
                0.0,
            )
        )
    )

    out["mobile_prob_x_advantage"] = (
        m * (
            1.0
            + np.maximum(
                df["mobile_minus_effnet_conf"].astype(float),
                0.0,
            )
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # H: rescue probability × agreement/disagreement signal
    #
    # We deliberately do not hard-code disagreement as always good.
    # It is simply an additional policy signal.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_prob_disagreement"] = (
        r
        * (
            1.0
            + df["efficientnet_disagrees_resnet"].astype(float)
        )
    )

    out["mobile_prob_disagreement"] = (
        m
        * (
            1.0
            + df["efficientnet_disagrees_mobile"].astype(float)
        )
    )

    return out


# =============================================================================
# POLICY EVALUATION
# =============================================================================

@dataclass
class PolicyResult:

    policy: str
    threshold: float

    accuracy: float
    gain: float

    transitions: int
    rescues: int
    harms: int
    neutral: int

    rescue_harm_ratio: float
    rescue_precision: float

    recoverable_recall: float
    headroom_captured: float

    switch_rate: float


def evaluate_policy(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    policy_name: str,
    resnet_score: pd.Series,
    mobile_score: pd.Series,
    threshold: float,
    baseline: Dict[str, float],
) -> PolicyResult:

    rscore = np.asarray(
        resnet_score,
        dtype=float,
    )

    mscore = np.asarray(
        mobile_score,
        dtype=float,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Select the best specialist.
    #
    # If both scores are below threshold:
    #     keep EfficientNet.
    #
    # If one exceeds threshold:
    #     switch to that specialist.
    #
    # If both exceed threshold:
    #     choose the larger score.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    best_score = np.maximum(
        rscore,
        mscore,
    )

    switch = best_score > threshold

    choose_resnet = (
        switch
        & (rscore >= mscore)
    )

    choose_mobile = (
        switch
        & (mscore > rscore)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Actual outcome of switching.
    #
    # A switch to specialist produces:
    #
    #   +1 if it rescues
    #   -1 if it harms
    #    0 otherwise
    #
    # If we don't switch:
    #   keep base result.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    base_correct = df["base_correct"].astype(int).to_numpy()

    resnet_rescue = df["resnet_rescue"].astype(int).to_numpy()
    mobile_rescue = df["mobile_rescue"].astype(int).to_numpy()

    resnet_harm = df["resnet_harm"].astype(int).to_numpy()
    mobile_harm = df["mobile_harm"].astype(int).to_numpy()

    delta = np.zeros(len(df), dtype=int)

    delta[choose_resnet] = (
        resnet_rescue[choose_resnet]
        - resnet_harm[choose_resnet]
    )

    delta[choose_mobile] = (
        mobile_rescue[choose_mobile]
        - mobile_harm[choose_mobile]
    )

    policy_correct = (
        base_correct + delta
    )

    # Safety clamp.
    policy_correct = np.clip(
        policy_correct,
        0,
        1,
    )

    accuracy = policy_correct.mean()

    transitions = int(switch.sum())

    rescues = int(
        (
            choose_resnet & (resnet_rescue == 1)
        ).sum()
        +
        (
            choose_mobile & (mobile_rescue == 1)
        ).sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        (
            choose_resnet & (resnet_harm == 1)
        ).sum()
        +
        (
            choose_mobile & (mobile_harm == 1)
        ).sum()
    )

    neutral = transitions - rescues - harms

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Metrics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if harms == 0:
        rescue_harm_ratio = float("inf") if rescues > 0 else 0.0
    else:
        rescue_harm_ratio = rescues / harms

    rescue_precision = (
        rescues / transitions
        if transitions > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    recoverable_mask = (
        (
            resnet_rescue == 1
        )
        |
        (
            mobile_rescue == 1
        )
    ) & (
        df["efficientnet_error"].astype(int).to_numpy() == 1
    )

    recoverable_total = int(
        recoverable_mask.sum()
    )

    recoverable_recalled = int(
        (
            switch
            & recoverable_mask
        ).sum()
    )

    recoverable_recall = (
        recoverable_recalled / recoverable_total
        if recoverable_total > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    headroom = baseline["headroom"]

    gain = accuracy - baseline["base_accuracy"]

    headroom_captured = (
        gain / headroom
        if headroom > EPS
        else 0.0
    )

    switch_rate = (
        transitions / len(df)
    )

    return PolicyResult(
        policy=policy_name,
        threshold=float(threshold),
        accuracy=float(accuracy),
        gain=float(gain),
        transitions=transitions,
        rescues=rescues,
        harms=harms,
        neutral=neutral,
        rescue_harm_ratio=float(rescue_harm_ratio),
        rescue_precision=float(rescue_precision),
        recoverable_recall=float(recoverable_recall),
        headroom_captured=float(headroom_captured),
        switch_rate=float(switch_rate),
    )


# =============================================================================
# THRESHOLD GRID
# =============================================================================

def threshold_grid() -> np.ndarray:

    # Dense low-probability region is important because V3.15's probabilities
    # are strongly concentrated near zero.

    low = np.linspace(
        0.0,
        0.01,
        51,
    )

    mid = np.linspace(
        0.011,
        0.10,
        90,
    )

    high = np.linspace(
        0.11,
        1.0,
        90,
    )

    grid = np.unique(
        np.concatenate(
            [
                low,
                mid,
                high,
            ]
        )
    )

    return grid


# =============================================================================
# POLICY SWEEP
# =============================================================================

def run_policy_sweep(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
    baseline: Dict[str, float],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("RUNNING SELECTIVE POLICY SWEEP")

    policies = [
        (
            "A_max_rescue_probability",
            "resnet_prob",
            "mobile_prob",
        ),
        (
            "B_probability_x_gate",
            "resnet_prob_gate",
            "mobile_prob_gate",
        ),
        (
            "C_probability_x_confidence",
            "resnet_prob_conf",
            "mobile_prob_conf",
        ),
        (
            "D_probability_x_relative_confidence",
            "resnet_prob_relconf",
            "mobile_prob_relconf",
        ),
        (
            "E_probability_x_relative_strength",
            "resnet_prob_relstrength",
            "mobile_prob_relstrength",
        ),
        (
            "F_probability_plus_advantage",
            "resnet_prob_plus_advantage",
            "mobile_prob_plus_advantage",
        ),
        (
            "G_probability_x_positive_advantage",
            "resnet_prob_x_advantage",
            "mobile_prob_x_advantage",
        ),
        (
            "H_probability_x_disagreement",
            "resnet_prob_disagreement",
            "mobile_prob_disagreement",
        ),
    ]

    thresholds = threshold_grid()

    rows = []

    for policy_name, rcol, mcol in policies:

        rscore = scores[rcol]
        mscore = scores[mcol]

        for threshold in thresholds:

            result = evaluate_policy(
                df=df,
                policy_name=policy_name,
                resnet_score=rscore,
                mobile_score=mscore,
                threshold=float(threshold),
                baseline=baseline,
            )

            rows.append(
                result.__dict__
            )

    results = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    return results


# =============================================================================
# BEST POLICY TABLES
# =============================================================================

def print_best_policies(
    results: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("BEST POLICY RESULTS")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Best accuracy
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection("TOP POLICIES BY ACCURACY")

    best_accuracy = (
        results
        .sort_values(
            [
                "accuracy",
                "rescue_harm_ratio",
                "rescue_precision",
            ],
            ascending=[False, False, False],
        )
        .head(20)
    )

    display_cols = [
        "policy",
        "threshold",
        "accuracy",
        "gain",
        "transitions",
        "rescues",
        "harms",
        "neutral",
        "rescue_harm_ratio",
        "rescue_precision",
        "recoverable_recall",
        "headroom_captured",
        "switch_rate",
    ]

    print(
        best_accuracy[display_cols]
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Best rescue/harm
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection("TOP POLICIES BY RESCUE/HARM RATIO")

    ratio_table = results.copy()

    ratio_table["ratio_sort"] = ratio_table[
        "rescue_harm_ratio"
    ].replace(
        np.inf,
        999999.0,
    )

    best_ratio = (
        ratio_table
        .sort_values(
            [
                "ratio_sort",
                "accuracy",
                "rescues",
            ],
            ascending=[False, False, False],
        )
        .head(20)
    )

    print(
        best_ratio[display_cols]
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Conservative policies
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection(
        "CONSERVATIVE POLICIES: RESCUE/HARM >= 2.0"
    )

    conservative = results[
        (
            results["rescue_harm_ratio"] >= 2.0
        )
        &
        (
            results["rescues"] >= 20
        )
    ].copy()

    if len(conservative) == 0:
        print(
            "No policy reached rescue/harm >= 2.0 with at least 20 rescues."
        )
    else:
        conservative = (
            conservative
            .sort_values(
                [
                    "accuracy",
                    "rescues",
                    "harms",
                ],
                ascending=[False, False, True],
            )
            .head(20)
        )

        print(
            conservative[display_cols]
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Useful compromise
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection(
        "USEFUL COMPROMISE POLICIES"
    )

    compromise = results[
        (
            results["gain"] > 0
        )
        &
        (
            results["rescue_precision"] >= 0.60
        )
        &
        (
            results["rescues"] >= 20
        )
    ].copy()

    if len(compromise) == 0:
        print(
            "No positive-gain policy reached rescue precision >= 0.60."
        )
    else:
        compromise = (
            compromise
            .sort_values(
                [
                    "accuracy",
                    "rescue_precision",
                    "rescues",
                ],
                ascending=[False, False, False],
            )
            .head(20)
        )

        print(
            compromise[display_cols]
            .to_string(index=False)
        )


# =============================================================================
# FOLD EVALUATION
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_best_candidates_by_fold(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
    results: pd.DataFrame,
    baseline: Dict[str, float],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("FOLD-WISE ROBUSTNESS")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Select a compact set of candidate policies.
    #
    # We deliberately do not report hundreds of combinations.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    candidates = []

    best_accuracy = (
        results
        .sort_values(
            "accuracy",
            ascending=False,
        )
        .iloc[0]
    )

    candidates.append(
        (
            best_accuracy["policy"],
            best_accuracy["threshold"],
        )
    )

    positive = results[
        results["gain"] > 0
    ]

    if len(positive):
        best_positive = (
            positive
            .sort_values(
                [
                    "rescue_precision",
                    "accuracy",
                ],
                ascending=[False, False],
            )
            .iloc[0]
        )

        candidates.append(
            (
                best_positive["policy"],
                best_positive["threshold"],
            )
        )

    ratio_candidates = results.copy()

    ratio_candidates["ratio_sort"] = (
        ratio_candidates["rescue_harm_ratio"]
        .replace(np.inf, 999999.0)
    )

    best_ratio = (
        ratio_candidates
        .sort_values(
            [
                "ratio_sort",
                "accuracy",
            ],
            ascending=[False, False],
        )
        .iloc[0]
    )

    candidates.append(
        (
            best_ratio["policy"],
            best_ratio["threshold"],
        )
    )

    # Deduplicate.
    candidates = list(
        dict.fromkeys(candidates)
    )

    policy_map = {
        "A_max_rescue_probability": (
            "resnet_prob",
            "mobile_prob",
        ),
        "B_probability_x_gate": (
            "resnet_prob_gate",
            "mobile_prob_gate",
        ),
        "C_probability_x_confidence": (
            "resnet_prob_conf",
            "mobile_prob_conf",
        ),
        "D_probability_x_relative_confidence": (
            "resnet_prob_relconf",
            "mobile_prob_relconf",
        ),
        "E_probability_x_relative_strength": (
            "resnet_prob_relstrength",
            "mobile_prob_relstrength",
        ),
        "F_probability_plus_advantage": (
            "resnet_prob_plus_advantage",
            "mobile_prob_plus_advantage",
        ),
        "G_probability_x_positive_advantage": (
            "resnet_prob_x_advantage",
            "mobile_prob_x_advantage",
        ),
        "H_probability_x_disagreement": (
            "resnet_prob_disagreement",
            "mobile_prob_disagreement",
        ),
    }

    rows = []

    for policy_name, threshold in candidates:

        rcol, mcol = policy_map[policy_name]

        for fold in sorted(
            df["outer_fold"].dropna().unique()
        ):

            mask = (
                df["outer_fold"] == fold
            )

            fold_df = df.loc[mask].copy()

            fold_scores = scores.loc[mask]

            fold_baseline = {
                "base_accuracy": fold_df[
                    "base_correct"
                ].astype(int).mean(),
                "headroom": (
                    (
                        fold_df["base_correct"].astype(int)
                        |
                        fold_df["resnet_rescue"].astype(int)
                        |
                        fold_df["mobile_rescue"].astype(int)
                    ).mean()
                    -
                    fold_df["base_correct"].astype(int).mean()
                ),
            }

            result = evaluate_policy(
                df=fold_df,
                policy_name=policy_name,
                resnet_score=fold_scores[rcol],
                mobile_score=fold_scores[mcol],
                threshold=float(threshold),
                baseline=fold_baseline,
            )

            row = result.__dict__.copy()
            row["fold"] = int(fold)

            rows.append(row)

    fold_results = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if len(fold_results):

        display_cols = [
            "policy",
            "threshold",
            "fold",
            "accuracy",
            "gain",
            "transitions",
            "rescues",
            "harms",
            "rescue_harm_ratio",
            "rescue_precision",
            "recoverable_recall",
        ]

        print(
            fold_results[display_cols]
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

        # Aggregate robustness summary.
        subsection("FOLD ROBUSTNESS SUMMARY")

        summary = (
            fold_results
            .groupby(
                ["policy", "threshold"],
                as_index=False,
            )
            .agg(
                mean_accuracy=("accuracy", "mean"),
                std_accuracy=("accuracy", "std"),
                min_accuracy=("accuracy", "min"),
                mean_gain=("gain", "mean"),
                mean_rescues=("rescues", "mean"),
                mean_harms=("harms", "mean"),
                mean_rescue_precision=(
                    "rescue_precision",
                    "mean",
                ),
                mean_rescue_harm_ratio=(
                    "rescue_harm_ratio",
                    "mean",
                ),
                mean_recoverable_recall=(
                    "recoverable_recall",
                    "mean",
                ),
            )
        )

        print(
            summary
            .sort_values(
                [
                    "mean_accuracy",
                    "mean_rescue_precision",
                ],
                ascending=[False, False],
            )
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

    return fold_results


# =============================================================================
# POLICY COMPARISON AGAINST V3.15
# =============================================================================

def compare_with_v315(
    results: pd.DataFrame,
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    baseline: Dict[str, float],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("COMPARISON WITH V3.15")

    # V3.15's actual outcome.
    v315_accuracy = (
        df["selected_correct"]
        .astype(int)
        .mean()
    )

    v315_rescues = (
        df["rescue"]
        .astype(int)
        .sum()
    )

    v315_harms = (
        df["harm"]
        .astype(int)
        .sum()
    )

    v315_transitions = (
        df["transition"]
        .astype(int)
        .sum()
    )

    v315_ratio = (
        v315_rescues / v315_harms
        if v315_harms > 0
        else float("inf")
    )

    v315_precision = (
        v315_rescues / v315_transitions
        if v315_transitions > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    print()
    print("V3.15 ACTUAL")
    print(
        f"Accuracy             : {v315_accuracy:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Gain                 : "
        f"{v315_accuracy - baseline['base_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Transitions          : {v315_transitions}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescues              : {v315_rescues}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harms                : {v315_harms}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm          : {v315_ratio:.4f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescue precision     : {v315_precision:.4f}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Attach V3.15 comparison values to policy results.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    results = results.copy()

    results["v315_accuracy"] = v315_accuracy
    results["v315_gain"] = (
        v315_accuracy
        - baseline["base_accuracy"]
    )

    results["accuracy_delta_vs_v315"] = (
        results["accuracy"]
        - v315_accuracy
    )

    results["rescue_delta_vs_v315"] = (
        results["rescues"]
        - v315_rescues
    )

    results["harm_delta_vs_v315"] = (
        results["harms"]
        - v315_harms
    )

    results["ratio_delta_vs_v315"] = (
        results["rescue_harm_ratio"]
        - v315_ratio
    )

    return results


# =============================================================================
# POLICY RECOMMENDATION
# =============================================================================

def print_recommendation(
    results: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("V3.16 POLICY RECOMMENDATION")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidates must improve accuracy over EfficientNet.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    positive = results[
        results["gain"] > 0
    ].copy()

    if len(positive) == 0:

        print(
            "No tested policy improves over EfficientNet."
        )

        print()
        print(
            "Conclusion:"
        )

        print(
            "The current V3.15 rescue probability alone is "
            "insufficient for a deterministic policy."
        )

        print(
            "Next step should be a dedicated benefit-vs-harm "
            "policy model."
        )

        return

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Conservative candidate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    conservative = positive[
        positive["rescue_precision"] >= 0.60
    ].copy()

    if len(conservative):

        conservative = (
            conservative
            .sort_values(
                [
                    "accuracy",
                    "rescue_precision",
                    "rescues",
                ],
                ascending=[False, False, False],
            )
            .iloc[0]
        )

    else:
        conservative = None

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Maximum accuracy
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    best = (
        positive
        .sort_values(
            [
                "accuracy",
                "rescue_harm_ratio",
                "rescue_precision",
            ],
            ascending=[False, False, False],
        )
        .iloc[0]
    )

    print()
    print("BEST ACCURACY POLICY")
    print(
        f"Policy               : {best['policy']}"
    )
    print(
        f"Threshold            : {best['threshold']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Accuracy             : {best['accuracy']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Gain                 : {best['gain']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Transitions          : {int(best['transitions'])}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescues              : {int(best['rescues'])}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harms                : {int(best['harms'])}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm          : "
        f"{best['rescue_harm_ratio']:.4f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescue precision     : "
        f"{best['rescue_precision']:.4f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Recoverable recall   : "
        f"{best['recoverable_recall']:.4f}"
    )

    if conservative is not None:

        print()
        print("BEST CONSERVATIVE POLICY")
        print(
            f"Policy               : "
            f"{conservative['policy']}"
        )
        print(
            f"Threshold            : "
            f"{conservative['threshold']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"Accuracy             : "
            f"{conservative['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"Gain                 : "
            f"{conservative['gain']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"Transitions          : "
            f"{int(conservative['transitions'])}"
        )
        print(
            f"Rescues              : "
            f"{int(conservative['rescues'])}"
        )
        print(
            f"Harms                : "
            f"{int(conservative['harms'])}"
        )
        print(
            f"Rescue/Harm          : "
            f"{conservative['rescue_harm_ratio']:.4f}"
        )
        print(
            f"Rescue precision     : "
            f"{conservative['rescue_precision']:.4f}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )
    print(
        "These thresholds are exploratory OOF policy thresholds."
    )
    print(
        "They must NOT be treated as final test-set thresholds."
    )
    print(
        "A promising policy should be re-selected inside "
        "nested validation before final test evaluation."
    )


# =============================================================================
# SAVE
# =============================================================================

def save_outputs(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
    results: pd.DataFrame,
    fold_results: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("SAVING V3.16 OUTPUTS")

    os.makedirs(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    score_path = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "v3_16_policy_scores.csv",
    )

    result_path = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "v3_16_policy_sweep.csv",
    )

    fold_path = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        "v3_16_fold_results.csv",
    )

    scores.to_csv(
        score_path,
        index=False,
    )

    results.to_csv(
        result_path,
        index=False,
    )

    fold_results.to_csv(
        fold_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Policy scores : {score_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy sweep  : {result_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Fold results  : {fold_path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main() -> None:

    section("V3.16 SELECTIVE RESCUE POLICY ANALYSIS")

    print(
        "No model training will be performed."
    )

    print(
        "V3.15 rescue probabilities are treated as ranking signals."
    )

    print(
        "Goal: reduce harmful switching while retaining useful rescues."
    )

    df = load_data()

    df = sanitize_numeric(df)

    validate_data(df)

    baseline = print_baseline(df)

    section("BUILDING POLICY SCORES")

    scores = build_policy_scores(df)

    print(
        f"Generated {scores.shape[1]} policy score variants."
    )

    print()
    print(
        scores.describe()
        .T
        .to_string()
    )

    results = run_policy_sweep(
        df=df,
        scores=scores,
        baseline=baseline,
    )

    print_best_policies(
        results
    )

    fold_results = evaluate_best_candidates_by_fold(
        df=df,
        scores=scores,
        results=results,
        baseline=baseline,
    )

    results = compare_with_v315(
        results=results,
        df=df,
        baseline=baseline,
    )

    print_recommendation(
        results
    )

    save_outputs(
        df=df,
        scores=scores,
        results=results,
        fold_results=fold_results,
    )

    section("V3.16 ANALYSIS COMPLETE")

    print(
        "No models were trained."
    )

    print(
        "The experiment evaluated switching-policy boundaries only."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
