#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.17 NESTED SELECTIVE RESCUE EVALUATION

Purpose
-------
Evaluate whether the V3.16 selective-rescue improvement survives
leakage-safe nested policy selection.

IMPORTANT
---------
No new ML models are trained here.

The existing V3.15 rescue probabilities are treated as fixed signals.

For every outer fold:

    OUTER TRAIN/DEVELOPMENT
        |
        +--> search policy family
        +--> search threshold
        +--> select best policy
        |
        v
    OUTER TEST
        |
        +--> apply frozen policy
        +--> record performance

The outer test fold is NEVER used to select the policy or threshold.

Primary selection objective:
    maximize accuracy subject to rescue/harm >= 2.0

Secondary conservative objective:
    maximize accuracy subject to rescue/harm >= 2.5

Outputs
-------
outputs/pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue/

    v3_17_outer_fold_results.csv
    v3_17_policy_selection.csv
    v3_17_test_predictions.csv
    v3_17_policy_summary.csv
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

INPUT_DIR = (
    BASE_DIR
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    BASE_DIR
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
)

FEATURE_FILE = INPUT_DIR / "v3_15_feature_matrix.csv"
TARGET_FILE = INPUT_DIR / "v3_15_target_matrix.csv"
OOF_FILE = INPUT_DIR / "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv"

THRESHOLDS = np.round(
    np.arange(0.50, 0.951, 0.01),
    2,
)

PRIMARY_RATIO = 2.0
CONSERVATIVE_RATIO = 2.5

MIN_TRANSITIONS = 10


# ============================================================================
# DISPLAY HELPERS
# ============================================================================

def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title):
    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


# ============================================================================
# LOADING
# ============================================================================

def load_artifacts():
    section("LOADING V3.15 ARTIFACTS")

    features = pd.read_csv(FEATURE_FILE)
    targets = pd.read_csv(TARGET_FILE)
    oof = pd.read_csv(OOF_FILE)

    print(f"Feature matrix : {features.shape}")
    print(f"Target matrix  : {targets.shape}")
    print(f"OOF predictions: {oof.shape}")

    if len(features) != len(targets) or len(features) != len(oof):
        raise ValueError(
            "Feature, target, and OOF files do not have the same number "
            "of rows."
        )

    df = pd.concat(
        [
            features.reset_index(drop=True),
            targets.reset_index(drop=True),
            oof.reset_index(drop=True),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    # Protect against accidental duplicate columns.
    df = df.loc[:, ~df.columns.duplicated()]

    print(f"\nCombined dataframe: {df.shape}")

    return df


# ============================================================================
# VALIDATION
# ============================================================================

def validate_data(df):
    section("VALIDATING V3.17 DATA")

    required = [
        "outer_fold",
        "row_index",
        "selected_model",
        "resnet_rescue_probability",
        "mobile_rescue_probability",
        "efficientnet_confidence",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_gate",
        "mobile_gate",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
        "resnet_switch_advantage",
        "mobile_switch_advantage",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
    ]

    missing = [
        c for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            "Missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing)
        )

    if df["outer_fold"].isna().any():
        raise ValueError("outer_fold contains missing values.")

    folds = sorted(
        df["outer_fold"]
        .dropna()
        .unique()
    )

    print(f"Outer folds: {folds}")

    if len(folds) < 2:
        raise ValueError(
            "Nested evaluation requires at least two outer folds."
        )

    print("✓ Required columns present")
    print("✓ Outer folds present")


# ============================================================================
# POLICY SCORE CONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================================

def build_policy_scores(df):
    """
    Construct the policy scores using only fixed V3.15 signals.

    Every score is directional:
        larger score = stronger reason to switch.
    """

    subsection("BUILDING NESTED POLICY SCORES")

    r_prob = df["resnet_rescue_probability"].clip(lower=0.0)
    m_prob = df["mobile_rescue_probability"].clip(lower=0.0)

    r_gate = df["resnet_gate"].clip(lower=0.0)
    m_gate = df["mobile_gate"].clip(lower=0.0)

    r_conf = df["resnet_confidence"].clip(lower=0.0)
    m_conf = df["mobilenet_confidence"].clip(lower=0.0)

    e_conf = df["efficientnet_confidence"].clip(lower=1e-8)

    r_strength = df["resnet_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0.0)
    m_strength = df["mobile_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0.0)

    r_adv = df["resnet_switch_advantage"].clip(lower=0.0)
    m_adv = df["mobile_switch_advantage"].clip(lower=0.0)

    # Relative confidence:
    #
    # specialist confidence / EfficientNet confidence
    #
    # This is deliberately computed from fixed OOF features.
    r_relconf = r_conf / e_conf
    m_relconf = m_conf / e_conf

    # Positive advantage is already directional.
    r_positive_advantage = r_adv
    m_positive_advantage = m_adv

    scores = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A: pure rescue probability
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["A_max_rescue_probability"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob,
        m_prob,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # B: rescue probability × gate
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["B_probability_x_gate"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_gate,
        m_prob * m_gate,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # C: rescue probability × confidence
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["C_probability_x_confidence"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_conf,
        m_prob * m_conf,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # D: rescue probability × relative confidence
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["D_probability_x_relative_confidence"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_relconf,
        m_prob * m_relconf,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # E: rescue probability × relative strength
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["E_probability_x_relative_strength"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_strength,
        m_prob * m_strength,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # F: probability + positive advantage
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["F_probability_plus_advantage"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob + r_positive_advantage,
        m_prob + m_positive_advantage,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # G: probability × positive advantage
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["G_probability_x_positive_advantage"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_positive_advantage,
        m_prob * m_positive_advantage,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # H: probability × gate × relative strength
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["H_probability_x_gate_x_strength"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_gate * r_strength,
        m_prob * m_gate * m_strength,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # I: probability × confidence × relative strength
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["I_probability_x_confidence_x_strength"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_conf * r_strength,
        m_prob * m_conf * m_strength,
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # J: probability × gate × relative confidence
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["J_probability_x_gate_x_relative_confidence"] = np.maximum(
        r_prob * r_gate * r_relconf,
        m_prob * m_gate * m_relconf,
    )

    print(f"Generated {len(scores.columns)} nested policy families.")

    return scores


# ============================================================================
# SWITCH DECISION
# ============================================================================

def apply_policy(
    df,
    score,
    threshold,
):
    """
    Apply a switch policy.

    If score >= threshold:
        switch from EfficientNet to the specialist with stronger
        specialist rescue evidence.

    Otherwise:
        retain EfficientNet.

    Returns selected model and switch mask.
    """

    switch = score >= threshold

    r_prob = df["resnet_rescue_probability"].to_numpy()
    m_prob = df["mobile_rescue_probability"].to_numpy()

    selected = np.full(
        len(df),
        "efficientnet_v2_s",
        dtype=object,
    )

    choose_resnet = switch.to_numpy() & (
        r_prob >= m_prob
    )

    choose_mobile = switch.to_numpy() & (
        m_prob > r_prob
    )

    selected[choose_resnet] = "resnet50"
    selected[choose_mobile] = "mobilenet_v3_large"

    return selected, switch.to_numpy()


# ============================================================================
# OUTCOME EVALUATION
# ============================================================================

def evaluate_policy(
    df,
    selected,
    switch,
):
    """
    Evaluate a policy using the known correctness indicators.

    EfficientNet:
        efficientnet_error == 1  -> base incorrect

    Specialist rescue:
        resnet_rescue / mobile_rescue

    Specialist harm:
        resnet_harm / mobile_harm

    Selected correctness is reconstructed from the transition
    outcome rather than requiring raw predictions.
    """

    base_error = (
        df["efficientnet_error"]
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    base_correct = 1 - base_error

    r_rescue = (
        df["resnet_rescue"]
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    m_rescue = (
        df["mobile_rescue"]
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    r_harm = (
        df["resnet_harm"]
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    m_harm = (
        df["mobile_harm"]
        .to_numpy()
        .astype(int)
    )

    selected_correct = base_correct.copy()

    resnet_mask = (
        switch
        & (selected == "resnet50")
    )

    mobile_mask = (
        switch
        & (selected == "mobilenet_v3_large")
    )

    selected_correct[resnet_mask] = (
        1 - r_harm[resnet_mask]
    )

    selected_correct[mobile_mask] = (
        1 - m_harm[mobile_mask]
    )

    transitions = int(switch.sum())

    rescues = int(
        (
            (selected_correct == 1)
            & (base_correct == 0)
            & switch
        ).sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        (
            (selected_correct == 0)
            & (base_correct == 1)
            & switch
        ).sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        transitions
        - rescues
        - harms
    )

    accuracy = float(
        selected_correct.mean()
    )

    base_accuracy = float(
        base_correct.mean()
    )

    gain = accuracy - base_accuracy

    if harms == 0:
        if rescues > 0:
            rescue_harm_ratio = np.inf
        else:
            rescue_harm_ratio = 0.0
    else:
        rescue_harm_ratio = rescues / harms

    if rescues + harms > 0:
        rescue_precision = (
            rescues / (rescues + harms)
        )
    else:
        rescue_precision = 0.0

    recoverable = (
        df["efficientnet_error"].to_numpy()
        == 1
    ) & (
        (
            df["resnet_rescue"].to_numpy()
            == 1
        )
        |
        (
            df["mobile_rescue"].to_numpy()
            == 1
        )
    )

    recoverable_count = int(
        recoverable.sum()
    )

    if recoverable_count > 0:
        recoverable_recall = (
            rescues / recoverable_count
        )
    else:
        recoverable_recall = 0.0

    switch_rate = transitions / len(df)

    return {
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "base_accuracy": base_accuracy,
        "gain": gain,
        "transitions": transitions,
        "rescues": rescues,
        "harms": harms,
        "neutral": neutral,
        "rescue_harm_ratio": rescue_harm_ratio,
        "rescue_precision": rescue_precision,
        "recoverable_recall": recoverable_recall,
        "switch_rate": switch_rate,
    }


# ============================================================================
# POLICY SELECTION
# ============================================================================

def select_best_policy(
    df,
    scores,
    folds,
    ratio_constraint,
):
    """
    Search all policy families and thresholds on DEVELOPMENT data only.

    Selection objective:

        1. rescue/harm >= ratio_constraint
        2. minimum transitions
        3. maximize accuracy
        4. maximize rescue precision
        5. maximize recoverable recall
    """

    records = []

    for policy_name in scores.columns:

        score = scores[policy_name]

        for threshold in THRESHOLDS:

            selected, switch = apply_policy(
                df,
                score,
                threshold,
            )

            metrics = evaluate_policy(
                df,
                selected,
                switch,
            )

            if (
                metrics["transitions"]
                < MIN_TRANSITIONS
            ):
                continue

            ratio = metrics[
                "rescue_harm_ratio"
            ]

            if ratio < ratio_constraint:
                continue

            records.append(
                {
                    "policy": policy_name,
                    "threshold": threshold,
                    **metrics,
                }
            )

    if not records:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "No policy satisfied the selection constraints."
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(records)

    result = result.sort_values(
        by=[
            "accuracy",
            "rescue_precision",
            "recoverable_recall",
            "transitions",
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            False,
            False,
            True,
        ],
    )

    return result.iloc[0].to_dict(), result


# ============================================================================
# NESTED EVALUATION
# ============================================================================

def run_nested_evaluation(
    df,
    scores,
):
    section("RUNNING NESTED POLICY EVALUATION")

    folds = sorted(
        df["outer_fold"]
        .unique()
    )

    print(f"Outer folds: {folds}")

    outer_results = []
    policy_selection_records = []
    prediction_records = []

    for outer_fold in folds:

        subsection(
            f"OUTER FOLD {outer_fold}"
        )

        development_mask = (
            df["outer_fold"]
            != outer_fold
        )

        test_mask = (
            df["outer_fold"]
            == outer_fold
        )

        development_df = df.loc[
            development_mask
        ].copy()

        test_df = df.loc[
            test_mask
        ].copy()

        development_scores = scores.loc[
            development_mask
        ].copy()

        test_scores = scores.loc[
            test_mask
        ].copy()

        print(
            f"Development samples : "
            f"{len(development_df)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Outer test samples   : "
            f"{len(test_df)}"
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # PRIMARY POLICY
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        best_primary, search_primary = (
            select_best_policy(
                development_df,
                development_scores,
                folds,
                PRIMARY_RATIO,
            )
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # CONSERVATIVE POLICY
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        best_conservative, search_conservative = (
            select_best_policy(
                development_df,
                development_scores,
                folds,
                CONSERVATIVE_RATIO,
            )
        )

        print()
        print("SELECTED PRIMARY POLICY")
        print(
            f"  Policy     : "
            f"{best_primary['policy']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Threshold  : "
            f"{best_primary['threshold']:.2f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev acc    : "
            f"{best_primary['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev gain   : "
            f"{best_primary['gain']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev rescues: "
            f"{best_primary['rescues']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev harms  : "
            f"{best_primary['harms']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev R/H    : "
            f"{best_primary['rescue_harm_ratio']:.4f}"
        )

        print()
        print("SELECTED CONSERVATIVE POLICY")
        print(
            f"  Policy     : "
            f"{best_conservative['policy']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Threshold  : "
            f"{best_conservative['threshold']:.2f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev acc    : "
            f"{best_conservative['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev gain   : "
            f"{best_conservative['gain']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev rescues: "
            f"{best_conservative['rescues']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev harms  : "
            f"{best_conservative['harms']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Dev R/H    : "
            f"{best_conservative['rescue_harm_ratio']:.4f}"
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # APPLY PRIMARY POLICY TO OUTER TEST
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        primary_policy = best_primary["policy"]
        primary_threshold = float(
            best_primary["threshold"]
        )

        test_selected, test_switch = apply_policy(
            test_df,
            test_scores[primary_policy],
            primary_threshold,
        )

        test_metrics = evaluate_policy(
            test_df,
            test_selected,
            test_switch,
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # APPLY CONSERVATIVE POLICY TO OUTER TEST
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        conservative_policy = (
            best_conservative["policy"]
        )

        conservative_threshold = float(
            best_conservative["threshold"]
        )

        conservative_selected, conservative_switch = (
            apply_policy(
                test_df,
                test_scores[
                    conservative_policy
                ],
                conservative_threshold,
            )
        )

        conservative_metrics = evaluate_policy(
            test_df,
            conservative_selected,
            conservative_switch,
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # PRINT OUTER RESULTS
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        print()
        print("PRIMARY OUTER-TEST RESULT")
        print(
            f"  Accuracy      : "
            f"{test_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Base accuracy : "
            f"{test_metrics['base_accuracy']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Gain          : "
            f"{test_metrics['gain']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Transitions   : "
            f"{test_metrics['transitions']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Rescues       : "
            f"{test_metrics['rescues']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Harms         : "
            f"{test_metrics['harms']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Rescue/Harm   : "
            f"{test_metrics['rescue_harm_ratio']:.4f}"
        )

        print()
        print("CONSERVATIVE OUTER-TEST RESULT")
        print(
            f"  Accuracy      : "
            f"{conservative_metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Gain          : "
            f"{conservative_metrics['gain']:.6f}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Transitions   : "
            f"{conservative_metrics['transitions']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Rescues       : "
            f"{conservative_metrics['rescues']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Harms         : "
            f"{conservative_metrics['harms']}"
        )
        print(
            f"  Rescue/Harm   : "
            f"{conservative_metrics['rescue_harm_ratio']:.4f}"
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # SAVE FOLD RESULT
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        outer_results.append(
            {
                "outer_fold": outer_fold,

                "primary_policy":
                    primary_policy,

                "primary_threshold":
                    primary_threshold,

                "primary_dev_accuracy":
                    best_primary["accuracy"],

                "primary_test_accuracy":
                    test_metrics["accuracy"],

                "primary_test_base_accuracy":
                    test_metrics[
                        "base_accuracy"
                    ],

                "primary_test_gain":
                    test_metrics["gain"],

                "primary_test_transitions":
                    test_metrics[
                        "transitions"
                    ],

                "primary_test_rescues":
                    test_metrics[
                        "rescues"
                    ],

                "primary_test_harms":
                    test_metrics[
                        "harms"
                    ],

                "primary_test_neutral":
                    test_metrics[
                        "neutral"
                    ],

                "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio":
                    test_metrics[
                        "rescue_harm_ratio"
                    ],

                "primary_test_rescue_precision":
                    test_metrics[
                        "rescue_precision"
                    ],

                "primary_test_recoverable_recall":
                    test_metrics[
                        "recoverable_recall"
                    ],

                "primary_test_switch_rate":
                    test_metrics[
                        "switch_rate"
                    ],

                "conservative_policy":
                    conservative_policy,

                "conservative_threshold":
                    conservative_threshold,

                "conservative_dev_accuracy":
                    best_conservative[
                        "accuracy"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_accuracy":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "accuracy"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_gain":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "gain"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_transitions":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "transitions"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_rescues":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "rescues"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_harms":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "harms"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_rescue_harm_ratio":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "rescue_harm_ratio"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_rescue_precision":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "rescue_precision"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_recoverable_recall":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "recoverable_recall"
                    ],

                "conservative_test_switch_rate":
                    conservative_metrics[
                        "switch_rate"
                    ],
            }
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # SAVE POLICY SELECTION
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        policy_selection_records.append(
            {
                "outer_fold": outer_fold,
                "selection_type": "primary",
                "ratio_constraint": PRIMARY_RATIO,
                "policy": primary_policy,
                "threshold": primary_threshold,
                "development_accuracy":
                    best_primary["accuracy"],
                "development_gain":
                    best_primary["gain"],
                "development_transitions":
                    best_primary["transitions"],
                "development_rescues":
                    best_primary["rescues"],
                "development_harms":
                    best_primary["harms"],
                "development_rescue_harm_ratio":
                    best_primary[
                        "rescue_harm_ratio"
                    ],
            }
        )

        policy_selection_records.append(
            {
                "outer_fold": outer_fold,
                "selection_type": "conservative",
                "ratio_constraint":
                    CONSERVATIVE_RATIO,
                "policy":
                    conservative_policy,
                "threshold":
                    conservative_threshold,
                "development_accuracy":
                    best_conservative[
                        "accuracy"
                    ],
                "development_gain":
                    best_conservative[
                        "gain"
                    ],
                "development_transitions":
                    best_conservative[
                        "transitions"
                    ],
                "development_rescues":
                    best_conservative[
                        "rescues"
                    ],
                "development_harms":
                    best_conservative[
                        "harms"
                    ],
                "development_rescue_harm_ratio":
                    best_conservative[
                        "rescue_harm_ratio"
                    ],
            }
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # SAVE PRIMARY PREDICTIONS
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        for idx, row in test_df.iterrows():

            prediction_records.append(
                {
                    "outer_fold":
                        outer_fold,

                    "row_index":
                        row["row_index"],

                    "policy_type":
                        "primary",

                    "policy":
                        primary_policy,

                    "threshold":
                        primary_threshold,

                    "score":
                        float(
                            test_scores.loc[
                                idx,
                                primary_policy,
                            ]
                        ),

                    "switch":
                        int(test_switch[
                            list(test_df.index)
                            .index(idx)
                        ]),

                    "selected_model":
                        test_selected[
                            list(test_df.index)
                            .index(idx)
                        ],

                    "efficientnet_error":
                        int(
                            row[
                                "efficientnet_error"
                            ]
                        ),

                    "resnet_rescue":
                        int(
                            row[
                                "resnet_rescue"
                            ]
                        ),

                    "mobile_rescue":
                        int(
                            row[
                                "mobile_rescue"
                            ]
                        ),

                    "resnet_harm":
                        int(
                            row[
                                "resnet_harm"
                            ]
                        ),

                    "mobile_harm":
                        int(
                            row[
                                "mobile_harm"
                            ]
                        ),
                }
            )

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(outer_results),
        pd.DataFrame(
            policy_selection_records
        ),
        pd.DataFrame(
            prediction_records
        ),
    )


# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================================================

def build_summary(
    outer_results,
    policy_selection,
):
    section("NESTED EVALUATION SUMMARY")

    summary_records = []

    primary = outer_results.copy()

    summary_records.append(
        {
            "policy_type": "primary_nested",
            "mean_accuracy":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_accuracy"
                ].mean(),
            "std_accuracy":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_accuracy"
                ].std(ddof=0),
            "min_accuracy":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_accuracy"
                ].min(),
            "max_accuracy":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_accuracy"
                ].max(),
            "mean_gain":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_gain"
                ].mean(),
            "std_gain":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_gain"
                ].std(ddof=0),
            "mean_transitions":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_transitions"
                ].mean(),
            "mean_rescues":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_rescues"
                ].mean(),
            "mean_harms":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_harms"
                ].mean(),
            "mean_rescue_precision":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_rescue_precision"
                ].mean(),
            "mean_rescue_harm_ratio":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio"
                ].replace(
                    np.inf,
                    np.nan,
                ).mean(),
            "mean_recoverable_recall":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_recoverable_recall"
                ].mean(),
            "mean_switch_rate":
                primary[
                    "primary_test_switch_rate"
                ].mean(),
        }
    )

    conservative = outer_results.copy()

    summary_records.append(
        {
            "policy_type":
                "conservative_nested",

            "mean_accuracy":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_accuracy"
                ].mean(),

            "std_accuracy":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_accuracy"
                ].std(ddof=0),

            "min_accuracy":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_accuracy"
                ].min(),

            "max_accuracy":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_accuracy"
                ].max(),

            "mean_gain":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_gain"
                ].mean(),

            "std_gain":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_gain"
                ].std(ddof=0),

            "mean_transitions":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_transitions"
                ].mean(),

            "mean_rescues":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_rescues"
                ].mean(),

            "mean_harms":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_harms"
                ].mean(),

            "mean_rescue_precision":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_rescue_precision"
                ].mean(),

            "mean_rescue_harm_ratio":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_rescue_harm_ratio"
                ].replace(
                    np.inf,
                    np.nan,
                ).mean(),

            "mean_recoverable_recall":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_recoverable_recall"
                ].mean(),

            "mean_switch_rate":
                conservative[
                    "conservative_test_switch_rate"
                ].mean(),
        }
    )

    summary = pd.DataFrame(
        summary_records
    )

    return summary


# ============================================================================
# FINAL REPORT
# ============================================================================

def print_final_report(
    outer_results,
    summary,
    policy_selection,
):
    section("V3.17 FINAL NESTED RESULTS")

    subsection("OUTER-FOLD RESULTS")

    display_columns = [
        "outer_fold",
        "primary_policy",
        "primary_threshold",
        "primary_test_accuracy",
        "primary_test_gain",
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio",
        "primary_test_rescue_precision",
        "primary_test_recoverable_recall",
    ]

    print(
        outer_results[
            display_columns
        ].to_string(index=False)
    )

    subsection("NESTED SUMMARY")

    print(
        summary.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    subsection("POLICY SELECTION FREQUENCY")

    primary_selection = policy_selection[
        policy_selection[
            "selection_type"
        ]
        == "primary"
    ]

    print(
        primary_selection[
            "policy"
        ].value_counts()
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Selected thresholds:"
    )

    print(
        primary_selection[
            [
                "outer_fold",
                "policy",
                "threshold",
            ]
        ].to_string(index=False)
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Aggregate comparison
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection("KEY COMPARISON")

    baseline_accuracy = float(
        outer_results[
            "primary_test_base_accuracy"
        ].mean()
    )

    nested_accuracy = float(
        outer_results[
            "primary_test_accuracy"
        ].mean()
    )

    nested_gain = (
        nested_accuracy
        - baseline_accuracy
    )

    print(
        f"EfficientNet baseline "
        f"(outer folds) : "
        f"{baseline_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 nested accuracy        : "
        f"{nested_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 nested gain            : "
        f"{nested_gain:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "V3.16 exploratory OOF result : "
        "0.782952"
    )

    print(
        "IMPORTANT: 0.782952 is NOT "
        "a nested/unbiased estimate."
    )

    if nested_gain > 0:
        print()
        print(
            "✓ Nested evaluation still "
            "improves over EfficientNet."
        )
    else:
        print()
        print(
            "⚠ Nested evaluation does not "
            "improve over EfficientNet."
        )


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.17 NESTED SELECTIVE RESCUE EVALUATION"
    )

    print(
        "No model training will be performed."
    )

    print(
        "V3.15 rescue probabilities are "
        "treated as fixed signals."
    )

    print(
        "Policy and threshold selection "
        "occur only inside development folds."
    )

    print(
        "Outer folds remain completely "
        "untouched until evaluation."
    )

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    df = load_artifacts()

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_data(df)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build fixed policy scores
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    scores = build_policy_scores(df)

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Nested evaluation
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        outer_results,
        policy_selection,
        predictions,
    ) = run_nested_evaluation(
        df,
        scores,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    summary = build_summary(
        outer_results,
        policy_selection,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    section("SAVING V3.17 OUTPUTS")

    outer_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_outer_fold_results.csv"
    )

    selection_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_policy_selection.csv"
    )

    prediction_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_test_predictions.csv"
    )

    summary_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_policy_summary.csv"
    )

    outer_results.to_csv(
        outer_path,
        index=False,
    )

    policy_selection.to_csv(
        selection_path,
        index=False,
    )

    predictions.to_csv(
        prediction_path,
        index=False,
    )

    summary.to_csv(
        summary_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Outer fold results : {outer_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy selection   : {selection_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Test predictions   : {prediction_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy summary     : {summary_path}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final report
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    print_final_report(
        outer_results,
        summary,
        policy_selection,
    )

    section(
        "V3.17 NESTED EVALUATION COMPLETE"
    )

    print(
        "No models were trained."
    )

    print(
        "No outer-fold threshold was selected "
        "using its own evaluation samples."
    )

    print(
        "The reported V3.17 performance is "
        "the result to use for judging whether "
        "V3.16 generalizes."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.18 POLICY STABILITY ANALYSIS

Purpose
-------
Analyze whether the V3.17 nested selective-rescue policy is stable
across outer folds and whether the observed improvement is robust.

No model training is performed.

Inputs
------
Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs/pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue/
    v3_17_outer_fold_results.csv
    v3_17_policy_selection.csv
    v3_17_test_predictions.csv
    v3_17_policy_summary.csv

Outputs
-------
Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs/pairwise_v3_18_policy_stability/
    v3_18_fold_stability.csv
    v3_18_policy_frequency.csv
    v3_18_threshold_stability.csv
    v3_18_bootstrap_summary.csv
    v3_18_stability_report.csv

Main questions
--------------
1. Is E_probability_x_relative_strength consistently selected?
2. How stable are the selected thresholds?
3. Is the accuracy gain positive in every outer fold?
4. Is rescue precision consistently > 0.5?
5. Is rescue/harm consistently > 1?
6. How much does performance vary across folds?
7. How stable is the result under bootstrap resampling?
8. Is V3.17 sufficiently stable to proceed to final policy fitting?
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# ============================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

INPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_18_policy_stability"
)

OUTER_RESULTS = INPUT_DIR / "v3_17_outer_fold_results.csv"
POLICY_SELECTION = INPUT_DIR / "v3_17_policy_selection.csv"
TEST_PREDICTIONS = INPUT_DIR / "v3_17_test_predictions.csv"
POLICY_SUMMARY = INPUT_DIR / "v3_17_policy_summary.csv"

RANDOM_SEED = 42
BOOTSTRAP_ITERATIONS = 10000


# ============================================================
# DISPLAY HELPERS
# ============================================================

def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title):
    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


def fmt(x, digits=6):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return "nan"
    return f"{x:.{digits}f}"


# ============================================================
# SAFE METRICS
# ============================================================

def safe_ratio(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        if a > 0:
            return np.inf
        return 0.0
    return a / b


def summarize_numeric(series):
    series = pd.Series(series).dropna()

    if len(series) == 0:
        return {
            "mean": np.nan,
            "std": np.nan,
            "median": np.nan,
            "min": np.nan,
            "max": np.nan,
        }

    return {
        "mean": series.mean(),
        "std": series.std(ddof=1) if len(series) > 1 else 0.0,
        "median": series.median(),
        "min": series.min(),
        "max": series.max(),
    }


# ============================================================
# LOAD
# ============================================================

def load_artifacts():

    section("V3.18 POLICY STABILITY ANALYSIS")

    print("No model training will be performed.")
    print("This analysis uses only the already-computed V3.17 nested results.")
    print("Goal: determine whether the V3.17 improvement is stable enough to trust.")

    section("LOADING V3.17 ARTIFACTS")

    required = [
        OUTER_RESULTS,
        POLICY_SELECTION,
        TEST_PREDICTIONS,
        POLICY_SUMMARY,
    ]

    for path in required:
        if not path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"Required V3.17 artifact not found:\n{path}"
            )

    outer = pd.read_csv(OUTER_RESULTS)
    selection = pd.read_csv(POLICY_SELECTION)
    predictions = pd.read_csv(TEST_PREDICTIONS)
    summary = pd.read_csv(POLICY_SUMMARY)

    print(f"Outer-fold results : {outer.shape}")
    print(f"Policy selection   : {selection.shape}")
    print(f"Test predictions   : {predictions.shape}")
    print(f"Policy summary     : {summary.shape}")

    return outer, selection, predictions, summary


# ============================================================
# VALIDATION
# ============================================================

def validate_inputs(outer, selection, predictions, summary):

    section("VALIDATING V3.18 DATA")

    required_outer = [
        "outer_fold",
        "primary_policy",
        "primary_threshold",
        "primary_test_accuracy",
        "primary_test_gain",
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio",
        "primary_test_rescue_precision",
        "primary_test_recoverable_recall",
    ]

    missing = [
        c for c in required_outer
        if c not in outer.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Missing columns from outer-fold results: {missing}"
        )

    required_selection = [
        "outer_fold",
        "policy",
        "threshold",
    ]

    missing = [
        c for c in required_selection
        if c not in selection.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Missing columns from policy selection: {missing}"
        )

    folds = sorted(outer["outer_fold"].unique())

    print(f"Outer folds: {folds}")

    if len(folds) != 5:
        print(
            f"WARNING: expected 5 outer folds, found {len(folds)}"
        )

    if outer["outer_fold"].duplicated().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Duplicate outer folds detected in outer-fold results."
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Policy selection may legitimately contain multiple rows
    # per outer fold (for example PRIMARY and CONSERVATIVE).
    # Therefore duplicate outer_fold values are allowed here.
    # We only require that every outer fold is represented.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    selection_folds = sorted(
        selection["outer_fold"].unique()
    )

    missing_selection_folds = sorted(
        set(folds) - set(selection_folds)
    )

    if missing_selection_folds:
        raise ValueError(
            "Policy selection is missing outer folds: "
            f"{missing_selection_folds}"
        )

    print(
        "✓ Policy-selection fold coverage is complete"
    )

    print(
        f"  Policy-selection rows: {len(selection)}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Unique outer folds   : {selection_folds}"
    )

    if not np.isfinite(
        outer["primary_test_accuracy"]
    ).all():
        raise ValueError(
            "Non-finite accuracy detected."
        )

    if not np.isfinite(
        outer["primary_test_gain"]
    ).all():
        raise ValueError(
            "Non-finite gain detected."
        )

    print("✓ Required columns present")
    print("✓ One result per outer fold")
    print("✓ Numeric metrics are finite")
    print("✓ Input validation complete")

    return folds


# ============================================================
# FOLD STABILITY
# ============================================================

def analyze_fold_stability(outer):

    section("FOLD-WISE STABILITY")

    df = outer.copy()

    df["positive_gain"] = (
        df["primary_test_gain"] > 0
    )

    df["rescue_harm_gt_1"] = (
        df["primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio"] > 1
    )

    df["rescue_precision_gt_50"] = (
        df["primary_test_rescue_precision"] > 0.50
    )

    df["accuracy_gt_78"] = (
        df["primary_test_accuracy"] > 0.78
    )

    cols = [
        "outer_fold",
        "primary_policy",
        "primary_threshold",
        "primary_test_accuracy",
        "primary_test_gain",
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio",
        "primary_test_rescue_precision",
        "primary_test_recoverable_recall",
        "positive_gain",
        "rescue_harm_gt_1",
        "rescue_precision_gt_50",
    ]

    stability = df[cols].copy()

    print(
        stability.to_string(index=False)
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Positive-gain folds:"
        f" {stability['positive_gain'].sum()}"
        f" / {len(stability)}"
    )

    print(
        "R/H > 1 folds:"
        f" {stability['rescue_harm_gt_1'].sum()}"
        f" / {len(stability)}"
    )

    print(
        "Rescue precision > 0.50 folds:"
        f" {stability['rescue_precision_gt_50'].sum()}"
        f" / {len(stability)}"
    )

    return stability


# ============================================================
# POLICY FREQUENCY
# ============================================================

def analyze_policy_frequency(selection):

    section("POLICY SELECTION STABILITY")

    freq = (
        selection["policy"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("policy")
        .reset_index(name="selection_count")
    )

    freq["selection_frequency"] = (
        freq["selection_count"]
        / len(selection)
    )

    print(
        freq.to_string(index=False)
    )

    print()

    dominant = freq.iloc[0]

    print(
        f"Dominant policy : {dominant['policy']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Selection count : {int(dominant['selection_count'])}"
        f" / {len(selection)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Selection frequency : "
        f"{dominant['selection_frequency']:.4f}"
    )

    return freq


# ============================================================
# THRESHOLD STABILITY
# ============================================================

def analyze_threshold_stability(selection):

    section("THRESHOLD STABILITY")

    df = (
        selection
        .groupby("policy")
        .agg(
            selection_count=("threshold", "count"),
            threshold_mean=("threshold", "mean"),
            threshold_std=("threshold", "std"),
            threshold_median=("threshold", "median"),
            threshold_min=("threshold", "min"),
            threshold_max=("threshold", "max"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    print(
        df.to_string(index=False)
    )

    print()

    selected = selection[
        selection["policy"]
        == "E_probability_x_relative_strength"
    ]

    if len(selected) > 0:

        thresholds = selected["threshold"]

        print(
            "E_probability_x_relative_strength thresholds:"
        )

        print(
            thresholds.to_list()
        )

        print(
            f"Mean   : {thresholds.mean():.4f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Std    : "
            f"{thresholds.std(ddof=1) if len(thresholds) > 1 else 0:.4f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Median : {thresholds.median():.4f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Range  : "
            f"{thresholds.min():.4f}"
            f" - "
            f"{thresholds.max():.4f}"
        )

    return df


# ============================================================
# PERFORMANCE DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================

def analyze_performance_distribution(outer):

    section("PERFORMANCE DISTRIBUTION")

    metrics = {
        "accuracy": outer["primary_test_accuracy"],
        "gain": outer["primary_test_gain"],
        "transitions": outer["primary_test_transitions"],
        "rescues": outer["primary_test_rescues"],
        "harms": outer["primary_test_harms"],
        "rescue_precision": outer["primary_test_rescue_precision"],
        "recoverable_recall": outer[
            "primary_test_recoverable_recall"
        ],
    }

    rows = []

    for name, values in metrics.items():

        stats = summarize_numeric(values)

        rows.append({
            "metric": name,
            **stats,
        })

        print(
            f"{name:25s}"
            f" mean={stats['mean']:.6f}"
            f" std={stats['std']:.6f}"
            f" median={stats['median']:.6f}"
            f" min={stats['min']:.6f}"
            f" max={stats['max']:.6f}"
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# BASELINE COMPARISON
# ============================================================

def analyze_baseline_comparison(outer):

    section("BASELINE COMPARISON")

    base_accuracy = (
        outer["primary_test_accuracy"]
        - outer["primary_test_gain"]
    )

    print(
        f"Mean base accuracy      : {base_accuracy.mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean nested accuracy    : "
        f"{outer['primary_test_accuracy'].mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean nested gain        : "
        f"{outer['primary_test_gain'].mean():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Min nested gain         : "
        f"{outer['primary_test_gain'].min():.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Max nested gain         : "
        f"{outer['primary_test_gain'].max():.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "All outer folds improved over EfficientNet:"
        f" {bool((outer['primary_test_gain'] > 0).all())}"
    )


# ============================================================
# BOOTSTRAP STABILITY
# ============================================================

def bootstrap_metric(
    values,
    rng,
    iterations=BOOTSTRAP_ITERATIONS,
):

    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)

    n = len(values)

    bootstrap_means = np.empty(iterations)

    for i in range(iterations):

        sample = rng.choice(
            values,
            size=n,
            replace=True,
        )

        bootstrap_means[i] = sample.mean()

    lower = np.percentile(
        bootstrap_means,
        2.5,
    )

    upper = np.percentile(
        bootstrap_means,
        97.5,
    )

    return {
        "observed_mean": values.mean(),
        "bootstrap_mean": bootstrap_means.mean(),
        "bootstrap_std": bootstrap_means.std(ddof=1),
        "ci_lower": lower,
        "ci_upper": upper,
        "probability_positive": (
            bootstrap_means > 0
        ).mean(),
    }


def analyze_bootstrap(outer):

    section("BOOTSTRAP STABILITY")

    print(
        f"Bootstrap iterations: {BOOTSTRAP_ITERATIONS}"
    )

    rng = np.random.default_rng(
        RANDOM_SEED
    )

    rows = []

    metrics = {
        "gain": outer["primary_test_gain"].values,
        "accuracy": outer["primary_test_accuracy"].values,
        "rescue_precision": outer[
            "primary_test_rescue_precision"
        ].values,
        "recoverable_recall": outer[
            "primary_test_recoverable_recall"
        ].values,
    }

    for name, values in metrics.items():

        result = bootstrap_metric(
            values,
            rng,
        )

        result["metric"] = name

        rows.append(result)

        print()
        print(
            f"{name.upper()}"
        )

        print(
            f"Observed mean       : "
            f"{result['observed_mean']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Bootstrap mean      : "
            f"{result['bootstrap_mean']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"95% CI              : "
            f"[{result['ci_lower']:.6f}, "
            f"{result['ci_upper']:.6f}]"
        )

        print(
            f"P(metric > 0)      : "
            f"{result['probability_positive']:.6f}"
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# ============================================================
# POLICY CONSISTENCY SCORE
# ============================================================

def calculate_stability_score(
    outer,
    selection,
):

    section("POLICY STABILITY SCORE")

    n_folds = len(outer)

    dominant_count = (
        selection["policy"]
        .value_counts()
        .max()
    )

    policy_consistency = (
        dominant_count / n_folds
    )

    gain_consistency = (
        outer["primary_test_gain"] > 0
    ).mean()

    rh_consistency = (
        outer["primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio"] > 1
    ).mean()

    precision_consistency = (
        outer["primary_test_rescue_precision"] > 0.5
    ).mean()

    mean_gain = (
        outer["primary_test_gain"].mean()
    )

    gain_std = (
        outer["primary_test_gain"].std(ddof=1)
    )

    if gain_std == 0:
        gain_signal = 1.0
    else:
        gain_signal = min(
            1.0,
            max(
                0.0,
                mean_gain / (
                    mean_gain + gain_std
                ),
            ),
        )

    score = (
        0.30 * policy_consistency
        + 0.30 * gain_consistency
        + 0.20 * rh_consistency
        + 0.10 * precision_consistency
        + 0.10 * gain_signal
    )

    print(
        f"Policy consistency       : "
        f"{policy_consistency:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Positive gain consistency: "
        f"{gain_consistency:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"R/H > 1 consistency      : "
        f"{rh_consistency:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Precision > 0.5          : "
        f"{precision_consistency:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Gain signal              : "
        f"{gain_signal:.4f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"COMPOSITE STABILITY SCORE: "
        f"{score:.4f}"
    )

    if score >= 0.85:
        interpretation = "HIGH"
    elif score >= 0.70:
        interpretation = "MODERATE-HIGH"
    elif score >= 0.55:
        interpretation = "MODERATE"
    else:
        interpretation = "LOW"

    print(
        f"Stability interpretation : "
        f"{interpretation}"
    )

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        "policy_consistency": policy_consistency,
        "positive_gain_consistency": gain_consistency,
        "rescue_harm_consistency": rh_consistency,
        "rescue_precision_consistency": precision_consistency,
        "gain_signal": gain_signal,
        "composite_stability_score": score,
        "interpretation": interpretation,
    }])


# ============================================================
# FINAL DECISION
# ============================================================

def final_decision(
    outer,
    selection,
    stability_score,
):

    section("V3.18 FINAL STABILITY ASSESSMENT")

    dominant_policy = (
        selection["policy"]
        .value_counts()
        .idxmax()
    )

    dominant_count = (
        selection["policy"]
        .value_counts()
        .max()
    )

    dominant_fraction = (
        dominant_count
        / len(selection)
    )

    mean_gain = (
        outer["primary_test_gain"].mean()
    )

    min_gain = (
        outer["primary_test_gain"].min()
    )

    mean_accuracy = (
        outer["primary_test_accuracy"].mean()
    )

    mean_precision = (
        outer["primary_test_rescue_precision"].mean()
    )

    mean_rh = (
        outer["primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio"].replace(
            [np.inf, -np.inf],
            np.nan,
        ).mean()
    )

    positive_gain_all = (
        outer["primary_test_gain"] > 0
    ).all()

    rh_all = (
        outer["primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio"] > 1
    ).all()

    print(
        f"Dominant policy       : "
        f"{dominant_policy}"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy frequency      : "
        f"{dominant_count}/{len(selection)} "
        f"({dominant_fraction:.2%})"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean nested accuracy  : "
        f"{mean_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean nested gain      : "
        f"{mean_gain:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Minimum fold gain     : "
        f"{min_gain:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean rescue precision : "
        f"{mean_precision:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Mean rescue/harm      : "
        f"{mean_rh:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"All folds positive    : "
        f"{positive_gain_all}"
    )

    print(
        f"All folds R/H > 1     : "
        f"{rh_all}"
    )

    print()

    if (
        dominant_fraction >= 0.80
        and positive_gain_all
        and rh_all
        and mean_gain > 0.03
    ):
        decision = (
            "STABLE ENOUGH TO PROCEED "
            "TO FINAL POLICY DEVELOPMENT"
        )

    elif (
        positive_gain_all
        and mean_gain > 0.02
    ):
        decision = (
            "PROMISING BUT REQUIRES "
            "ADDITIONAL STABILITY ANALYSIS"
        )

    else:
        decision = (
            "NOT STABLE ENOUGH — "
            "DO NOT LOCK THE POLICY"
        )

    print(
        f"DECISION: {decision}"
    )

    return pd.DataFrame([{
        "dominant_policy": dominant_policy,
        "dominant_policy_frequency": dominant_fraction,
        "mean_nested_accuracy": mean_accuracy,
        "mean_nested_gain": mean_gain,
        "minimum_fold_gain": min_gain,
        "mean_rescue_precision": mean_precision,
        "mean_rescue_harm_ratio": mean_rh,
        "all_folds_positive_gain": positive_gain_all,
        "all_folds_rescue_harm_gt_1": rh_all,
        "decision": decision,
    }])


# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================

def save_outputs(
    stability,
    policy_frequency,
    threshold_stability,
    performance_distribution,
    bootstrap,
    score,
    decision,
):

    section("SAVING V3.18 OUTPUTS")

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    stability_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_18_fold_stability.csv"
    )

    frequency_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_18_policy_frequency.csv"
    )

    threshold_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_18_threshold_stability.csv"
    )

    bootstrap_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_18_bootstrap_summary.csv"
    )

    report_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_18_stability_report.csv"
    )

    stability.to_csv(
        stability_path,
        index=False,
    )

    policy_frequency.to_csv(
        frequency_path,
        index=False,
    )

    threshold_stability.to_csv(
        threshold_path,
        index=False,
    )

    bootstrap.to_csv(
        bootstrap_path,
        index=False,
    )

    report = pd.concat(
        [
            score.assign(section="stability_score"),
            decision.assign(section="decision"),
        ],
        ignore_index=True,
        sort=False,
    )

    report.to_csv(
        report_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Fold stability      : {stability_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy frequency    : {frequency_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Threshold stability : {threshold_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Bootstrap summary   : {bootstrap_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Stability report    : {report_path}"
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    outer, selection, predictions, summary = (
        load_artifacts()
    )

    folds = validate_inputs(
        outer,
        selection,
        predictions,
        summary,
    )

    stability = analyze_fold_stability(
        outer
    )

    policy_frequency = analyze_policy_frequency(
        selection
    )

    threshold_stability = analyze_threshold_stability(
        selection
    )

    performance_distribution = (
        analyze_performance_distribution(
            outer
        )
    )

    analyze_baseline_comparison(
        outer
    )

    bootstrap = analyze_bootstrap(
        outer
    )

    stability_score = calculate_stability_score(
        outer,
        selection,
    )

    decision = final_decision(
        outer,
        selection,
        stability_score,
    )

    save_outputs(
        stability,
        policy_frequency,
        threshold_stability,
        performance_distribution,
        bootstrap,
        stability_score,
        decision,
    )

    section("V3.18 ANALYSIS COMPLETE")

    print(
        "No models were trained."
    )

    print(
        "No outer-test predictions were modified."
    )

    print(
        "V3.18 evaluated the stability of the already-computed "
        "nested V3.17 result."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.19 FINAL FROZEN POLICY EVALUATION

Purpose
-------
Evaluate the V3.18-stabilized selective rescue policy with ALL policy
parameters frozen before evaluation.

Frozen policy:
    E_probability_x_relative_strength

Frozen threshold:
    0.51

IMPORTANT METHODOLOGICAL NOTE
-----------------------------
The current 1267-row artifact was used by the V3.17 nested outer folds.
Therefore this script provides a FROZEN-POLICY RETROSPECTIVE EVALUATION
on those rows.

It must NOT be described as a completely independent final test estimate.

No model training is performed.
No threshold optimization is performed.
No policy optimization is performed.

The goal is to answer:

    "If we freeze the policy identified by V3.17/V3.18,
     how does it behave when applied uniformly to the complete
     evaluation cohort?"

Outputs
-------
Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs/
    pairwise_v3_19_final_frozen_policy/
        v3_19_final_predictions.csv
        v3_19_summary.csv
        v3_19_comparison.csv
        v3_19_transition_summary.csv
"""

from pathlib import Path

)

    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_19_final_frozen_policy"
)

FEATURE_FILE = BASE_DIR / "v3_15_feature_matrix.csv"
TARGET_FILE = BASE_DIR / "v3_15_target_matrix.csv"
OOF_FILE = BASE_DIR / "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv"

V318_STABILITY_FILE = V318_DIR / "v3_18_stability_report.csv"

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FROZEN POLICY

FROZEN_POLICY = "E_probability_x_relative_strength"

# V3.18 showed:
# mean = 0.5125
# median = 0.51

# We freeze the median.
FROZEN_THRESHOLD = 0.51

BASE_MODEL = "efficientnet_v2_s"
