# =============================================================================
# DISPLAY HELPERS
# =============================================================================

def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title):
    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


def fmt(x, digits=6):
    if x is None:
        return "N/A"

    if isinstance(x, (float, np.floating)):
        if np.isnan(x):
            return "N/A"
        return f"{x:.{digits}f}"

    return str(x)


# =============================================================================
# LOADING
# =============================================================================

def load_artifacts():

    section("LOADING V3.15 ARTIFACTS")

    feature = pd.read_csv(FEATURE_FILE)
    target = pd.read_csv(TARGET_FILE)
    oof = pd.read_csv(OOF_FILE)

    print(f"Feature matrix : {feature.shape}")
    print(f"Target matrix  : {target.shape}")
    print(f"OOF predictions: {oof.shape}")

    return feature, target, oof


# =============================================================================
# VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_inputs(feature, target, oof):

    section("VALIDATING V3.19 DATA")

    if len(feature) != len(target) or len(feature) != len(oof):
        raise ValueError(
            "Feature, target, and OOF row counts do not match."
        )

    required_features = [
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
    ]

    for col in required_features:
        if col not in feature.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Required feature missing: {col}"
            )

    required_oof = [
        "selected_model",
        "resnet_rescue_probability",
        "mobile_rescue_probability",
        "base_correct",
        "selected_correct",
        "transition",
        "rescue",
        "harm",
        "neutral_transition",
    ]

    for col in required_oof:
        if col not in oof.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Required OOF column missing: {col}"
            )

    required_target = [
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
    ]

    for col in required_target:
        if col not in target.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Required target column missing: {col}"
            )

    print("✓ Required columns present")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Check finite numeric data
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    numeric_columns = required_features + [
        "resnet_rescue_probability",
        "mobile_rescue_probability",
        "base_correct",
    ]

    for col in numeric_columns:

        if col in feature.columns:
            values = feature[col].to_numpy(dtype=float)

        elif col in oof.columns:
            values = oof[col].to_numpy(dtype=float)

        else:
            continue

        if not np.isfinite(values).all():
            raise ValueError(
                f"Non-finite values detected in {col}"
            )

    print("✓ Numeric values are finite")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Check base correctness
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    base_correct = oof["base_correct"].astype(int).to_numpy()

    efficientnet_error = target["efficientnet_error"].astype(int).to_numpy()

    expected_base_correct = 1 - efficientnet_error

    if not np.array_equal(
        base_correct,
        expected_base_correct
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "base_correct is inconsistent with efficientnet_error."
        )

    print("✓ base_correct is consistent with efficientnet_error")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Basic sizes
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    print(f"Samples : {len(feature)}")

    if "outer_fold" in oof.columns:

        folds = sorted(
            pd.Series(
                oof["outer_fold"]
            ).dropna().unique()
        )

        print(f"Outer folds present: {folds}")

    print("✓ Input validation complete")


# =============================================================================
# BUILD FROZEN POLICY
# =============================================================================

def build_frozen_policy(feature, oof):

    section("BUILDING FROZEN V3.19 POLICY")

    df = pd.DataFrame(index=feature.index)

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fixed rescue probabilities from V3.15
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_prob = (
        oof["resnet_rescue_probability"]
        .astype(float)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    mobile_prob = (
        oof["mobile_rescue_probability"]
        .astype(float)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Relative-strength features
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_strength = (
        feature["resnet_relative_strength"]
        .astype(float)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    mobile_strength = (
        feature["mobile_relative_strength"]
        .astype(float)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.16 / V3.18 POLICY E
    #
    # probability x relative strength
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_score = (
        resnet_prob * resnet_strength
    )

    mobile_score = (
        mobile_prob * mobile_strength
    )

    df["resnet_score"] = resnet_score
    df["mobile_score"] = mobile_score

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Select the stronger rescue candidate
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["max_rescue_score"] = np.maximum(
        resnet_score,
        mobile_score,
    )

    choose_resnet = (
        resnet_score > mobile_score
    )

    choose_mobile = (
        mobile_score > resnet_score
    )

    tie = (
        np.isclose(
            resnet_score,
            mobile_score,
            rtol=0.0,
            atol=1e-12,
        )
    )

    # Deterministic tie handling:
    #
    # In a tie we keep EfficientNet rather than switch.
    #
    # This prevents arbitrary switching when both rescue signals
    # are effectively identical.
    choose_resnet = (
        choose_resnet & ~tie
    )

    choose_mobile = (
        choose_mobile & ~tie
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Apply frozen threshold
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    switch = (
        df["max_rescue_score"].to_numpy()
        >= FROZEN_THRESHOLD
    )

    # A switch only happens when the selected specialist is valid.
    switch = (
        switch
        & (choose_resnet | choose_mobile)
    )

    selected_model = np.full(
        len(df),
        BASE_MODEL,
        dtype=object,
    )

    selected_model[
        switch & choose_resnet
    ] = RESNET_MODEL

    selected_model[
        switch & choose_mobile
    ] = MOBILE_MODEL

    df["selected_model"] = selected_model
    df["switch"] = switch.astype(int)
    df["choose_resnet"] = (
        switch & choose_resnet
    ).astype(int)
    df["choose_mobile"] = (
        switch & choose_mobile
    ).astype(int)
    df["tie"] = tie.astype(int)

    print(
        f"Frozen policy  : {FROZEN_POLICY}"
    )

    print(
        f"Frozen threshold: {FROZEN_THRESHOLD:.4f}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"ResNet score max : {resnet_score.max():.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Mobile score max : {mobile_score.max():.6f}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Policy score summary:"
    )

    print(
        df[
            [
                "resnet_score",
                "mobile_score",
                "max_rescue_score",
            ]
        ]
        .describe()
        .to_string()
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# EVALUATION
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_policy(policy_df, oof, target):

    section("EVALUATING FROZEN POLICY")

    base_correct = (
        oof["base_correct"]
        .astype(int)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    switch = (
        policy_df["switch"]
        .astype(int)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    selected_model = (
        policy_df["selected_model"]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Specialist correctness
    #
    # A rescue means:
    #   EfficientNet is wrong
    #   specialist is correct
    #
    # A harm means:
    #   EfficientNet is correct
    #   specialist is wrong
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_rescue = (
        target["resnet_rescue"]
        .astype(int)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    mobile_rescue = (
        target["mobile_rescue"]
        .astype(int)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    efficientnet_error = (
        target["efficientnet_error"]
        .astype(int)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    selected_rescue = np.zeros(
        len(target),
        dtype=int,
    )

    selected_harm = np.zeros(
        len(target),
        dtype=int,
    )

    resnet_selected = (
        switch
        & (selected_model == RESNET_MODEL)
    )

    mobile_selected = (
        switch
        & (selected_model == MOBILE_MODEL)
    )

    selected_rescue[
        resnet_selected
    ] = resnet_rescue[
        resnet_selected
    ]

    selected_rescue[
        mobile_selected
    ] = mobile_rescue[
        mobile_selected
    ]

    # Harm occurs on a base-correct sample where the selected specialist
    # fails.

    selected_harm[
        resnet_selected
    ] = (
        1
        - resnet_rescue[
            resnet_selected
        ]
    )

    selected_harm[
        mobile_selected
    ] = (
        1
        - mobile_rescue[
            mobile_selected
        ]
    )

    # Harm is only meaningful when the base model was correct.
    selected_harm = (
        selected_harm
        * (base_correct == 1)
    )

    # Rescue is only meaningful when the base model was wrong.
    selected_rescue = (
        selected_rescue
        * (base_correct == 0)
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final correctness
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    final_correct = (
        base_correct.copy()
    )

    rescue_mask = (
        selected_rescue == 1
    )

    harm_mask = (
        selected_harm == 1
    )

    final_correct[
        rescue_mask
    ] = 1

    final_correct[
        harm_mask
    ] = 0

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Neutral transition
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    neutral = (
        switch
        & ~rescue_mask
        & ~harm_mask
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Metrics
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    n = len(final_correct)

    base_accuracy = (
        base_correct.mean()
    )

    final_accuracy = (
        final_correct.mean()
    )

    gain = (
        final_accuracy
        - base_accuracy
    )

    transitions = int(
        switch.sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        rescue_mask.sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        harm_mask.sum()
    )

    neutral_count = int(
        neutral.sum()
    )

    recoverable_errors = int(
        ((efficientnet_error == 1) &
         ((resnet_rescue == 1) |
          (mobile_rescue == 1))).sum()
    )

    recoverable_recall = (
        rescues / recoverable_errors
        if recoverable_errors > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    rescue_precision = (
        rescues / transitions
        if transitions > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    rescue_harm_ratio = (
        rescues / harms
        if harms > 0
        else np.inf
    )

    switch_rate = (
        transitions / n
    )

    theoretical_oracle_accuracy = (
        base_accuracy
        + recoverable_errors / n
    )

    headroom = (
        theoretical_oracle_accuracy
        - base_accuracy
    )

    headroom_captured = (
        gain / headroom
        if headroom > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    results = {
        "policy": FROZEN_POLICY,
        "threshold": FROZEN_THRESHOLD,
        "samples": n,
        "base_accuracy": base_accuracy,
        "final_accuracy": final_accuracy,
        "gain": gain,
        "base_errors": int(
            efficientnet_error.sum()
        ),
        "recoverable_errors": recoverable_errors,
        "transitions": transitions,
        "rescues": rescues,
        "harms": harms,
        "neutral": neutral_count,
        "rescue_precision": rescue_precision,
        "rescue_harm_ratio": rescue_harm_ratio,
        "recoverable_recall": recoverable_recall,
        "switch_rate": switch_rate,
        "oracle_accuracy": theoretical_oracle_accuracy,
        "theoretical_headroom": headroom,
        "headroom_captured": headroom_captured,
    }

    return results, final_correct, selected_rescue, selected_harm


# =============================================================================
# TRANSITION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def build_transition_summary(
    policy_df,
    oof,
    selected_rescue,
    selected_harm,
):

    transition = pd.DataFrame()

    transition["selected_model"] = (
        policy_df["selected_model"]
    )

    transition["switch"] = (
        policy_df["switch"]
    )

    transition["rescue"] = (
        selected_rescue
    )

    transition["harm"] = (
        selected_harm
    )

    transition["base_correct"] = (
        oof["base_correct"]
    )

    transition["base_error"] = (
        1
        - transition["base_correct"]
    )

    transition["outcome"] = "neutral"

    transition.loc[
        selected_rescue == 1,
        "outcome"
    ] = "rescue"

    transition.loc[
        selected_harm == 1,
        "outcome"
    ] = "harm"

    rows = []

    for model in [
        BASE_MODEL,
        RESNET_MODEL,
        MOBILE_MODEL,
    ]:

        mask = (
            transition["selected_model"]
            == model
        )

        count = int(mask.sum())

        if count == 0:
            continue

        rescues = int(
            (
                transition.loc[
                    mask,
                    "rescue"
                ]
                .astype(int)
                .sum()
            )
        )

        harms = int(
            (
                transition.loc[
                    mask,
                    "harm"
                ]
                .astype(int)
                .sum()
            )
        )

        neutral = int(
            (
                mask
                & (
                    transition["outcome"]
                    == "neutral"
                )
            ).sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "selected_model": model,
                "samples": count,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "neutral": neutral,
                "rescue_precision": (
                    rescues / count
                    if count > 0
                    else 0.0
                ),
                "rescue_harm_ratio": (
                    rescues / harms
                    if harms > 0
                    else np.inf
                ),
            }
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# =============================================================================
# OOF / NESTED COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def build_comparison(final_results):

    rows = []

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # EfficientNet baseline
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    rows.append(
        {
            "method": "EfficientNet_v2_s_baseline",
            "accuracy": final_results["base_accuracy"],
            "gain_vs_base": 0.0,
        }
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.15
    #
    # This is included for historical comparison only.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    v315_path = (
        BASE_DIR
        / "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv"
    )

    if v315_path.exists():

        v315 = pd.read_csv(
            v315_path
        )

        if "selected_correct" in v315.columns:

            v315_accuracy = (
                v315["selected_correct"]
                .astype(int)
                .mean()
            )

            rows.append(
                {
                    "method": "V3.15_actual",
                    "accuracy": v315_accuracy,
                    "gain_vs_base": (
                        v315_accuracy
                        - final_results[
                            "base_accuracy"
                        ]
                    ),
                }
            )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.16 exploratory
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    v316_summary = (
        PROJECT_ROOT
        / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
        / "outputs"
        / "pairwise_v3_16_selective_rescue_policy"
        / "v3_16_policy_sweep.csv"
    )

    if v316_summary.exists():

        sweep = pd.read_csv(
            v316_summary
        )

        if len(sweep) > 0:

            best = sweep.iloc[
                sweep["accuracy"].idxmax()
            ]

            rows.append(
                {
                    "method": (
                        "V3.16_exploratory_best"
                    ),
                    "accuracy": float(
                        best["accuracy"]
                    ),
                    "gain_vs_base": (
                        float(best["accuracy"])
                        - final_results[
                            "base_accuracy"
                        ]
                    ),
                }
            )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.17 nested
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317_summary = (
        V317_DIR
        / "v3_17_policy_summary.csv"
    )

    if v317_summary.exists():

        v317 = pd.read_csv(
            v317_summary
        )

        primary = v317[
            v317["policy_type"]
            == "primary_nested"
        ]

        if len(primary) > 0:

            value = float(
                primary.iloc[0][
                    "mean_accuracy"
                ]
            )

            rows.append(
                {
                    "method": "V3.17_nested",
                    "accuracy": value,
                    "gain_vs_base": (
                        value
                        - final_results[
                            "base_accuracy"
                        ]
                    ),
                }
            )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.19 frozen
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    rows.append(
        {
            "method": (
                "V3.19_final_frozen_policy"
            ),
            "accuracy": final_results[
                "final_accuracy"
            ],
            "gain_vs_base": final_results[
                "gain"
            ],
        }
    )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


# =============================================================================
# SAVE PREDICTIONS
# =============================================================================

def build_prediction_dataframe(
    feature,
    oof,
    target,
    policy_df,
    final_correct,
    selected_rescue,
    selected_harm,
):

    df = pd.DataFrame()

    df["row_index"] = np.arange(
        len(oof)
    )

    if "outer_fold" in oof.columns:
        df["outer_fold"] = (
            oof["outer_fold"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

    if "row_index" in oof.columns:
        df["source_row_index"] = (
            oof["row_index"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

    df["base_model"] = BASE_MODEL

    df["selected_model"] = (
        policy_df["selected_model"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    df["frozen_policy"] = (
        FROZEN_POLICY
    )

    df["frozen_threshold"] = (
        FROZEN_THRESHOLD
    )

    df["resnet_rescue_probability"] = (
        oof[
            "resnet_rescue_probability"
        ].to_numpy()
    )

    df["mobile_rescue_probability"] = (
        oof[
            "mobile_rescue_probability"
        ].to_numpy()
    )

    df["resnet_policy_score"] = (
        policy_df["resnet_score"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    df["mobile_policy_score"] = (
        policy_df["mobile_score"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    df["max_policy_score"] = (
        policy_df["max_rescue_score"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    df["switch"] = (
        policy_df["switch"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    df["base_correct"] = (
        oof["base_correct"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    df["selected_correct"] = (
        final_correct
    )

    df["rescue"] = (
        selected_rescue
    )

    df["harm"] = (
        selected_harm
    )

    df["neutral_transition"] = (
        (
            policy_df["switch"].to_numpy()
            == 1
        )
        & (selected_rescue == 0)
        & (selected_harm == 0)
    ).astype(int)

    df["transition"] = (
        policy_df["switch"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    df["correctness_change"] = (
        df["selected_correct"]
        - df["base_correct"]
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.19 FINAL FROZEN POLICY EVALUATION"
    )

    print(
        "No model training will be performed."
    )

    print(
        "No policy optimization will be performed."
    )

    print(
        "No threshold tuning will be performed."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "FROZEN POLICY"
    )

    print(
        f"  Policy    : {FROZEN_POLICY}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Threshold : {FROZEN_THRESHOLD:.4f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "This is a frozen-policy retrospective evaluation"
    )

    print(
        "of the existing 1267-row evaluation cohort."
    )

    print(
        "It is NOT an independent external test estimate."
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature, target, oof = (
        load_artifacts()
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_inputs(
        feature,
        target,
        oof,
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build frozen policy
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    policy_df = build_frozen_policy(
        feature,
        oof,
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Evaluate
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    results, final_correct, selected_rescue, selected_harm = (
        evaluate_policy(
            policy_df,
            oof,
            target,
        )
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Print results
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.19 FROZEN POLICY RESULTS"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy                 : "
        f"{results['policy']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Threshold              : "
        f"{results['threshold']:.4f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Samples                : "
        f"{results['samples']}"
    )

    print(
        f"EfficientNet accuracy  : "
        f"{results['base_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Frozen policy accuracy : "
        f"{results['final_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Gain                   : "
        f"{results['gain']:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Base errors            : "
        f"{results['base_errors']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Recoverable errors     : "
        f"{results['recoverable_errors']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions            : "
        f"{results['transitions']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues                : "
        f"{results['rescues']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms                  : "
        f"{results['harms']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral transitions    : "
        f"{results['neutral']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Rescue precision       : "
        f"{results['rescue_precision']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm ratio      : "
        f"{results['rescue_harm_ratio']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Recoverable recall     : "
        f"{results['recoverable_recall']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Switch rate            : "
        f"{results['switch_rate']:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Oracle accuracy        : "
        f"{results['oracle_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Theoretical headroom   : "
        f"{results['theoretical_headroom']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Headroom captured      : "
        f"{results['headroom_captured']:.6f}"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition summary
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "TRANSITION BREAKDOWN"
    )

    transition_summary = (
        build_transition_summary(
            policy_df,
            oof,
            selected_rescue,
            selected_harm,
        )
    )

    print(
        transition_summary.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Comparison
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "COMPARISON WITH PREVIOUS VERSIONS"
    )

    comparison = build_comparison(
        results
    )

    print(
        comparison.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Per-fold retrospective analysis
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "outer_fold" in oof.columns:

        section(
            "FOLD-WISE FROZEN POLICY PERFORMANCE"
        )

        fold_rows = []

        for fold in sorted(
            oof["outer_fold"]
            .dropna()
            .unique()
        ):

            mask = (
                oof["outer_fold"]
                .to_numpy()
                == fold
            )

            fold_base = (
                oof.loc[
                    mask,
                    "base_correct"
                ]
                .astype(int)
                .mean()
            )

            fold_final = (
                final_correct[mask]
                .mean()
            )

            fold_switch = (
                policy_df.loc[
                    mask,
                    "switch"
                ]
                .astype(int)
                .sum()
            )

            fold_rescue = (
                selected_rescue[mask]
                .sum()
            )

            fold_harm = (
                selected_harm[mask]
                .sum()
            )

            fold_rows.append(
                {
                    "outer_fold": fold,
                    "samples": int(mask.sum()),
                    "base_accuracy": fold_base,
                    "frozen_accuracy": fold_final,
                    "gain": (
                        fold_final
                        - fold_base
                    ),
                    "transitions": int(
                        fold_switch
                    ),
                    "rescues": int(
                        fold_rescue
                    ),
                    "harms": int(
                        fold_harm
                    ),
                    "rescue_harm_ratio": (
                        fold_rescue / fold_harm
                        if fold_harm > 0
                        else np.inf
                    ),
                }
            )

        fold_df = pd.DataFrame(
            fold_rows
        )

        print(
            fold_df.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

    else:

        fold_df = pd.DataFrame()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "SAVING V3.19 OUTPUTS"
    )

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    prediction_df = (
        build_prediction_dataframe(
            feature,
            oof,
            target,
            policy_df,
            final_correct,
            selected_rescue,
            selected_harm,
        )
    )

    summary_df = pd.DataFrame(
        [results]
    )

    prediction_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_19_final_predictions.csv"
    )

    summary_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_19_summary.csv"
    )

    comparison_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_19_comparison.csv"
    )

    transition_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_19_transition_summary.csv"
    )

    fold_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_19_fold_results.csv"
    )

    prediction_df.to_csv(
        prediction_path,
        index=False,
    )

    summary_df.to_csv(
        summary_path,
        index=False,
    )

    comparison.to_csv(
        comparison_path,
        index=False,
    )

    transition_summary.to_csv(
        transition_path,
        index=False,
    )

    if not fold_df.empty:
        fold_df.to_csv(
            fold_path,
            index=False,
        )

    print(
        f"Predictions : {prediction_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Summary     : {summary_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Comparison  : {comparison_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions : {transition_path}"
    )

    if not fold_df.empty:
        print(
            f"Fold results: {fold_path}"
        )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final assessment
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.19 FINAL ASSESSMENT"
    )

    print(
        f"Frozen policy       : "
        f"{FROZEN_POLICY}"
    )

    print(
        f"Frozen threshold    : "
        f"{FROZEN_THRESHOLD:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Baseline accuracy   : "
        f"{results['base_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Frozen accuracy     : "
        f"{results['final_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Gain                : "
        f"{results['gain']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue precision    : "
        f"{results['rescue_precision']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm         : "
        f"{results['rescue_harm_ratio']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Recoverable recall  : "
        f"{results['recoverable_recall']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Switch rate         : "
        f"{results['switch_rate']:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    if results["final_accuracy"] > results["base_accuracy"]:
        print(
            "✓ Frozen policy improves over EfficientNet."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "✗ Frozen policy does not improve over EfficientNet."
        )

    if results["rescue_harm_ratio"] > 1:
        print(
            "✓ Rescues exceed harms."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "✗ Harms are greater than or equal to rescues."
        )

    if results["rescue_precision"] > 0.50:
        print(
            "✓ More than half of switches are beneficial."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "✗ Switch precision is below 50%."
        )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "Do NOT call this an independent final-test result."
    )

    print(
        "A truly independent test set is still required for"
    )

    print(
        "a final unbiased performance claim."
    )

    section(
        "V3.19 COMPLETE"
    )

    print(
        "No models were trained."
    )

    print(
        "No thresholds were tuned."
    )

    print(
        "The V3.18 policy was applied as a frozen rule."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    warnings.filterwarnings(
        "ignore"
    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.20 POLICY EQUIVALENCE AUDIT

Purpose
-------
Audit the mathematical and row-level equivalence between:

    V3.17 nested selective-rescue evaluation
    V3.19 frozen-policy evaluation

The goal is to determine why V3.17 reports substantial rescue performance
while V3.19, using the supposedly frozen V3.18 policy, reports zero rescues.

NO MODEL TRAINING
NO POLICY OPTIMIZATION
NO THRESHOLD TUNING
NO NEW PREDICTIONS

This script only audits already-generated artifacts.

Main checks
-----------
1. V3.17 outer-fold results
2. V3.17 policy-selection decisions
3. V3.17 test predictions
4. V3.19 frozen predictions
5. V3.15 feature matrix
6. V3.15 target matrix

The audit attempts to reconstruct the frozen policy from the original
V3.15 feature matrix and compare it against V3.19.

Frozen policy under investigation:

    E_probability_x_relative_strength

    threshold = 0.51

The exact score components are inspected rather than assumed.

Outputs
-------
outputs/pairwise_v3_20_policy_equivalence/

    v3_20_row_level_comparison.csv
    v3_20_score_distribution.csv
    v3_20_mismatch_summary.csv
    v3_20_fold_comparison.csv
    v3_20_rescue_comparison.csv
    v3_20_audit_report.csv
"""


from pathlib import Path
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

PHASE4 = ROOT / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"

V315_DIR = (
    PHASE4

    / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"

    PHASE4

    / "pairwise_v3_19_final_frozen_policy"
)

OUT_DIR = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"

POLICY_NAME = "E_probability_x_relative_strength"
FROZEN_THRESHOLD = 0.51

EPS = 1e-12

def banner(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def section(title):
    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


def fmt(x):
    if isinstance(x, (float, np.floating)):
        return f"{x:.10f}"
    return str(x)


# ============================================================================
# FILE LOADING
# ============================================================================

def load_csv(path, name):
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"\nRequired artifact not found:\n{name}\n{path}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    print(f"{name:<28}: {df.shape}")

    return df


def load_artifacts():

    banner("LOADING V3.20 AUDIT ARTIFACTS")

    feature = load_csv(
        V315_DIR / "v3_15_feature_matrix.csv",
        "V3.15 feature matrix",
    )

    target = load_csv(
        V315_DIR / "v3_15_target_matrix.csv",
        "V3.15 target matrix",
    )

    oof = load_csv(
        V315_DIR / "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv",
        "V3.15 OOF predictions",
    )

    v317_outer = load_csv(
        V317_DIR / "v3_17_outer_fold_results.csv",
        "V3.17 outer-fold results",
    )

    v317_selection = load_csv(
        V317_DIR / "v3_17_policy_selection.csv",
        "V3.17 policy selection",
    )

    v317_predictions = load_csv(
        V317_DIR / "v3_17_test_predictions.csv",
        "V3.17 test predictions",
    )

    v319_predictions = load_csv(
        V319_DIR / "v3_19_final_predictions.csv",
        "V3.19 frozen predictions",
    )

    v319_summary = load_csv(
        V319_DIR / "v3_19_summary.csv",
        "V3.19 summary",
    )

    return (
        feature,
        target,
        oof,
        v317_outer,
        v317_selection,
        v317_predictions,
        v319_predictions,
        v319_summary,
    )

def validate_inputs(
    feature,
    target,
    oof,
    v317_outer,
    v317_selection,
    v317_predictions,
    v319_predictions,
):

    banner("VALIDATING V3.20 INPUTS")

    required_feature = [
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_gate",
        "mobile_gate",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
    ]

    required_oof = [
        "row_index",
        "selected_model",
        "base_correct",
        "selected_correct",
        "transition",
        "rescue",
        "harm",
        "neutral_transition",
    ]

    for col in required_feature:
        if col not in feature.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing feature column: {col}"
            )

    for col in required_oof:
        if col not in oof.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Missing OOF column: {col}"
            )

    if "outer_fold" not in oof.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.15 OOF predictions do not contain outer_fold."
        )

    if "outer_fold" not in v317_predictions.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.17 predictions do not contain outer_fold."
        )

    if "row_index" not in v317_predictions.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.17 predictions do not contain row_index."
        )

    if "row_index" not in v319_predictions.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.19 predictions do not contain row_index."
        )

    print("✓ Required feature columns present")
    print("✓ Required prediction columns present")

    if len(feature) != len(target):
        raise ValueError(
            "Feature and target matrices have different row counts."
        )

    if len(feature) != len(oof):
        raise ValueError(
            "Feature matrix and OOF predictions have different row counts."
        )

    print(f"Samples: {len(feature)}")

    print(
        "Outer folds:",
        sorted(oof["outer_fold"].dropna().unique().tolist())
    )

    print("✓ Basic input validation complete")

def inspect_available_columns(feature, oof, v317_predictions, v319_predictions):

    banner("INSPECTING POLICY-RELEVANT COLUMNS")

    groups = {
        "FEATURE": feature.columns.tolist(),
        "V3.15 OOF": oof.columns.tolist(),
        "V3.17 TEST": v317_predictions.columns.tolist(),
        "V3.19 TEST": v319_predictions.columns.tolist(),
    }

    keywords = [
        "prob",
        "strength",
        "confidence",
        "score",
        "threshold",
        "selected",
        "rescue",
        "harm",
        "correct",
        "row",
        "fold",
    ]

    for group_name, columns in groups.items():

        print()
        print(group_name)

        for col in columns:
            low = col.lower()

            if any(k in low for k in keywords):
                print(f"  {col}")


# ============================================================================
# MATHEMATICAL RECONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================================

def reconstruct_policy_scores(feature):

    banner("RECONSTRUCTING V3.19 FROZEN POLICY")

    df = feature.copy()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate interpretation 1:
    #
    # probability × relative_strength
    #
    # The most direct interpretation of:
    #
    # E_probability_x_relative_strength
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["audit_resnet_prob_x_relative_strength"] = (
        df["resnet_rescue_evidence"].clip(lower=0)
        * df["resnet_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0)
    )

    df["audit_mobile_prob_x_relative_strength"] = (
        df["mobile_rescue_evidence"].clip(lower=0)
        * df["mobile_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0)
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate interpretation 2:
    #
    # rescue probability × gate-relative-strength
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["audit_resnet_prob_x_gate_relative_strength"] = (
        df["resnet_rescue_evidence"].clip(lower=0)
        * df["resnet_gate_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0)
    )

    df["audit_mobile_prob_x_gate_relative_strength"] = (
        df["mobile_rescue_evidence"].clip(lower=0)
        * df["mobile_gate_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0)
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate interpretation 3:
    #
    # direct probability × relative strength without clipping
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["audit_resnet_raw_product"] = (
        df["resnet_rescue_evidence"]
        * df["resnet_relative_strength"]
    )

    df["audit_mobile_raw_product"] = (
        df["mobile_rescue_evidence"]
        * df["mobile_relative_strength"]
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate interpretation 4:
    #
    # probability × max(relative strength, 0)
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["audit_resnet_probability_strength"] = (
        df["resnet_rescue_evidence"]
        * np.maximum(
            df["resnet_relative_strength"],
            0.0,
        )
    )

    df["audit_mobile_probability_strength"] = (
        df["mobile_rescue_evidence"]
        * np.maximum(
            df["mobile_relative_strength"],
            0.0,
        )
    )

    print("Generated candidate reconstructions.")

    score_columns = [
        "audit_resnet_prob_x_relative_strength",
        "audit_mobile_prob_x_relative_strength",
        "audit_resnet_prob_x_gate_relative_strength",
        "audit_mobile_prob_x_gate_relative_strength",
        "audit_resnet_raw_product",
        "audit_mobile_raw_product",
        "audit_resnet_probability_strength",
        "audit_mobile_probability_strength",
    ]

    print()

    for col in score_columns:

        s = df[col]

        print(
            f"{col:<48}"
            f"min={s.min(): .6f} "
            f"mean={s.mean(): .6f} "
            f"max={s.max(): .6f}"
        )

    return df

def identify_v319_columns(v319):

    section("IDENTIFYING V3.19 OUTPUT COLUMNS")

    print("V3.19 columns:")

    for i, col in enumerate(v319.columns):
        print(f"{i:03d}  {col}")

    score_candidates = [
        c for c in v319.columns
        if any(
            k in c.lower()
            for k in [
                "score",
                "prob",
                "strength",
                "threshold",
            ]
        )
    ]

    print()
    print("Policy-related columns:")

    for c in score_candidates:
        print(f"  {c}")

    return score_candidates


# ============================================================================
# MERGE ARTIFACTS
# ============================================================================

def build_comparison(
    feature,
    target,
    oof,
    v317_predictions,
    v319_predictions,
):

    banner("BUILDING ROW-LEVEL COMPARISON")

    n = len(feature)

    df = pd.DataFrame({
        "row_index": np.arange(n)
    })

    # Feature columns
    feature_reset = feature.reset_index(drop=True)

    for col in [
        "efficientnet_confidence",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_gate",
        "mobile_gate",
        "resnet_rescue_evidence",
        "mobile_rescue_evidence",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
        "resnet_gate_relative_strength",
        "mobile_gate_relative_strength",
        "resnet_switch_signal",
        "mobile_switch_signal",
        "resnet_switch_advantage",
        "mobile_switch_advantage",
    ]:
        if col in feature_reset.columns:
            df[col] = feature_reset[col].values

    # Targets
    target_reset = target.reset_index(drop=True)

    for col in target_reset.columns:
        df[f"target_{col}"] = target_reset[col].values

    # V3.15 OOF
    oof_reset = oof.reset_index(drop=True)

    for col in [
        "outer_fold",
        "selected_model",
        "resnet_rescue_probability",
        "mobile_rescue_probability",
        "selection_confidence",
        "selection_strength",
        "switch_threshold",
        "base_correct",
        "selected_correct",
        "transition",
        "rescue",
        "harm",
        "neutral_transition",
    ]:
        if col in oof_reset.columns:
            df[f"v315_{col}"] = oof_reset[col].values

    # V3.17
    v317_reset = v317_predictions.reset_index(drop=True)

    for col in v317_reset.columns:

        if col == "row_index":
            continue

        df[f"v317_{col}"] = v317_reset[col].values

    # V3.19
    v319_reset = v319_predictions.reset_index(drop=True)

    for col in v319_reset.columns:

        if col == "row_index":
            continue

        df[f"v319_{col}"] = v319_reset[col].values

    print("Comparison shape:", df.shape)

    return df


# ============================================================================
# V3.17 TEST DECISION RECONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================================

def reconstruct_v317_decisions(df):

    banner("RECONSTRUCTING V3.17 OUTER-TEST DECISIONS")

    # The V3.17 artifact should contain the actual selected model.
    selected_col = "v317_selected_model"

    if selected_col not in df.columns:

        print(
            "WARNING: V3.17 test predictions do not contain "
            "'selected_model'."
        )

        return df

    df["audit_v317_selected_model"] = (
        df[selected_col].astype(str)
    )

    if "v317_selected_correct" in df.columns:

        df["audit_v317_selected_correct"] = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                df["v317_selected_correct"],
                errors="coerce",
            )
        )

    if "v317_rescue" in df.columns:

        df["audit_v317_rescue"] = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                df["v317_rescue"],
                errors="coerce",
            )
        )

    if "v317_harm" in df.columns:

        df["audit_v317_harm"] = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                df["v317_harm"],
                errors="coerce",
            )
        )

    print(
        "V3.17 selected-model distribution:"
    )

    print(
        df["audit_v317_selected_model"]
        .value_counts(dropna=False)
        .to_string()
    )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# V3.19 DECISION RECONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================================

def reconstruct_v319_decisions(df):

    banner("RECONSTRUCTING V3.19 FROZEN DECISIONS")

    if "v319_selected_model" in df.columns:

        df["audit_v319_selected_model"] = (
            df["v319_selected_model"].astype(str)
        )

        print("V3.19 selected-model distribution:")

        print(
            df["audit_v319_selected_model"]
            .value_counts(dropna=False)
            .to_string()
        )

    else:

        print(
            "WARNING: V3.19 predictions do not contain "
            "'selected_model'."
        )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# DIRECT DECISION COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

def compare_decisions(df):

    banner("V3.17 vs V3.19 DECISION COMPARISON")

    if (
        "audit_v317_selected_model" not in df.columns
        or
        "audit_v319_selected_model" not in df.columns
    ):

        print(
            "Selected-model columns unavailable for direct comparison."
        )

        return df

    df["decision_match"] = (
        df["audit_v317_selected_model"]
        ==
        df["audit_v319_selected_model"]
    )

    mismatch_count = int(
        (~df["decision_match"]).sum()
    )

    match_count = int(
        df["decision_match"].sum()
    )

    print(f"Decision matches    : {match_count}")
    print(f"Decision mismatches : {mismatch_count}")
    print(
        f"Decision agreement  : "
        f"{match_count / len(df):.6f}"
    )

    if mismatch_count > 0:

        print()
        print("Decision mismatch distribution:")

        mismatch = df.loc[
            ~df["decision_match"],
            [
                "row_index",
                "audit_v317_selected_model",
                "audit_v319_selected_model",
            ],
        ]

        print(
            mismatch.head(30).to_string(index=False)
        )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# SCORE CORRELATION AUDIT
# ============================================================================

def score_correlation_audit(df):

    banner("POLICY SCORE EQUIVALENCE AUDIT")

    score_pairs = []

    # Try to find V3.19 score columns automatically.
    v319_score_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c.startswith("v319_")
        and any(
            k in c.lower()
            for k in [
                "score",
                "probability",
                "strength",
            ]
        )
    ]

    print("V3.19 score-like columns:")

    for c in v319_score_cols:
        print(f"  {c}")

    audit_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c.startswith("audit_")
        and (
            "product" in c
            or "probability_strength" in c
        )
    ]

    # Correlate every candidate reconstruction against every V3.19
    # numeric score-like column.
    rows = []

    for a in audit_cols:

        a_values = pd.to_numeric(
            df[a],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        for b in v319_score_cols:

            b_values = pd.to_numeric(
                df[b],
                errors="coerce",
            )

            valid = (
                np.isfinite(a_values)
                &
                np.isfinite(b_values)
            )

            if valid.sum() < 3:
                continue

            x = a_values[valid].to_numpy()
            y = b_values[valid].to_numpy()

            if (
                np.std(x) < EPS
                or
                np.std(y) < EPS
            ):
                corr = np.nan
            else:
                corr = np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1]

            mae = np.mean(np.abs(x - y))
            max_abs = np.max(np.abs(x - y))

            rows.append({
                "audit_score": a,
                "v319_score": b,
                "n": int(valid.sum()),
                "correlation": corr,
                "mae": mae,
                "max_absolute_difference": max_abs,
            })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if len(result) == 0:

        print(
            "No compatible numeric V3.19 score columns "
            "were found automatically."
        )

        return result

    result = result.sort_values(
        by="correlation",
        ascending=False,
        na_position="last",
    )

    print()
    print(
        result.head(30).to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# FROZEN POLICY RECONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================================

def apply_candidate_frozen_policy(df):

    banner("APPLYING CANDIDATE FROZEN POLICY")

    # Primary mathematical interpretation.
    #
    # E_probability_x_relative_strength
    #
    # score = rescue evidence × relative strength

    df["audit_resnet_score"] = (
        df["resnet_rescue_evidence"].clip(lower=0)
        *
        df["resnet_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0)
    )

    df["audit_mobile_score"] = (
        df["mobile_rescue_evidence"].clip(lower=0)
        *
        df["mobile_relative_strength"].clip(lower=0)
    )

    df["audit_max_score"] = np.maximum(
        df["audit_resnet_score"],
        df["audit_mobile_score"],
    )

    # Determine winning alternative.
    df["audit_candidate_model"] = np.select(
        [
            df["audit_resnet_score"]
            >= df["audit_mobile_score"],
            df["audit_mobile_score"]
            >
            df["audit_resnet_score"],
        ],
        [
            "resnet50",
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
        ],
        default="efficientnet_v2_s",
    )

    # Frozen threshold.
    df["audit_switch"] = (
        df["audit_max_score"]
        >= FROZEN_THRESHOLD
    )

    df["audit_frozen_model"] = np.where(
        df["audit_switch"],
        df["audit_candidate_model"],
        "efficientnet_v2_s",
    )

    print(
        f"Frozen threshold: {FROZEN_THRESHOLD:.4f}"
    )

    print(
        "Candidate policy transitions:",
        int(df["audit_switch"].sum()),
    )

    print()
    print("Candidate selected models:")

    print(
        df["audit_frozen_model"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# COMPARE CANDIDATE POLICY AGAINST V3.19
# ============================================================================

def compare_candidate_to_v319(df):

    banner("CANDIDATE FROZEN POLICY vs V3.19")

    if "audit_frozen_model" not in df.columns:
        return df

    if "audit_v319_selected_model" not in df.columns:

        print(
            "V3.19 selected-model column unavailable."
        )

        return df

    df["candidate_v319_match"] = (
        df["audit_frozen_model"]
        ==
        df["audit_v319_selected_model"]
    )

    matches = int(
        df["candidate_v319_match"].sum()
    )

    mismatches = len(df) - matches

    print(f"Matches    : {matches}")
    print(f"Mismatches : {mismatches}")
    print(
        f"Agreement  : "
        f"{matches / len(df):.6f}"
    )

    if mismatches:

        print()
        print("First mismatches:")

        cols = [
            "row_index",
            "audit_resnet_score",
            "audit_mobile_score",
            "audit_max_score",
            "audit_candidate_model",
            "audit_frozen_model",
            "audit_v319_selected_model",
        ]

        cols = [
            c for c in cols
            if c in df.columns
        ]

        print(
            df.loc[
                ~df["candidate_v319_match"],
                cols,
            ]
            .head(50)
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# RESCUE/HARM RECONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================================

def compute_outcomes(df, model_col, prefix):

    if "target_efficientnet_error" not in df.columns:
        return df

    base_error = (
        df["target_efficientnet_error"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    selected_model = df[model_col].astype(str)

    # Target matrices contain only rescue/harm labels for each specialist.
    resnet_rescue = (
        df["target_resnet_rescue"]
        .fillna(0)
        .astype(int)
    )

    mobile_rescue = (
        df["target_mobile_rescue"]
        .fillna(0)
        .astype(int)
    )

    resnet_harm = (
        df["target_resnet_harm"]
        .fillna(0)
        .astype(int)
    )

    mobile_harm = (
        df["target_mobile_harm"]
        .fillna(0)
        .astype(int)
    )

    selected_rescue = np.where(
        selected_model == "resnet50",
        resnet_rescue,
        np.where(
            selected_model == "mobilenet_v3_large",
            mobile_rescue,
            0,
        ),
    )

    selected_harm = np.where(
        selected_model == "resnet50",
        resnet_harm,
        np.where(
            selected_model == "mobilenet_v3_large",
            mobile_harm,
            0,
        ),
    )

    transitions = (
        selected_model
        != "efficientnet_v2_s"
    )

    df[f"{prefix}_transition"] = transitions.astype(int)
    df[f"{prefix}_rescue"] = selected_rescue.astype(int)
    df[f"{prefix}_harm"] = selected_harm.astype(int)

    df[f"{prefix}_neutral"] = (
        transitions
        &
        (selected_rescue == 0)
        &
        (selected_harm == 0)
    ).astype(int)

    return df


# ============================================================================
# RESCUE COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

def rescue_comparison(df):

    banner("RESCUE/HARM COMPARISON")

    rows = []

    configs = []

    if "audit_frozen_model" in df.columns:
        configs.append(
            (
                "audit_reconstructed",
                "audit_frozen_model",
            )
        )

    if "audit_v317_selected_model" in df.columns:
        configs.append(
            (
                "v317_actual",
                "audit_v317_selected_model",
            )
        )

    if "audit_v319_selected_model" in df.columns:
        configs.append(
            (
                "v319_actual",
                "audit_v319_selected_model",
            )
        )

    for name, model_col in configs:

        tmp = df.copy()

        tmp = compute_outcomes(
            tmp,
            model_col,
            f"tmp_{name}",
        )

        transitions = int(
            tmp[f"tmp_{name}_transition"].sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            tmp[f"tmp_{name}_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            tmp[f"tmp_{name}_harm"].sum()
        )

        neutral = int(
            tmp[f"tmp_{name}_neutral"].sum()
        )

        precision = (
            rescues / transitions
            if transitions > 0
            else 0.0
        )

        ratio = (
            rescues / harms
            if harms > 0
            else np.inf
        )

        rows.append({
            "method": name,
            "transitions": transitions,
            "rescues": rescues,
            "harms": harms,
            "neutral": neutral,
            "rescue_precision": precision,
            "rescue_harm_ratio": ratio,
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# FOLD COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

def fold_comparison(df):

    banner("FOLD-WISE POLICY COMPARISON")

    if "outer_fold" not in df.columns:

        # Use V3.15 fold information if available.
        if "v315_outer_fold" in df.columns:
            df["outer_fold"] = df["v315_outer_fold"]

    if "outer_fold" not in df.columns:

        print("Outer-fold information unavailable.")

        return pd.DataFrame()

    rows = []

    for fold, group in df.groupby(
        "outer_fold",
        sort=True,
    ):

        base_acc = (
            group["target_efficientnet_error"]
            .eq(0)
            .mean()
            if "target_efficientnet_error" in group
            else np.nan
        )

        row = {
            "outer_fold": fold,
            "samples": len(group),
            "base_accuracy": base_acc,
        }

        if "audit_frozen_model" in group.columns:

            transitions = (
                group["audit_frozen_model"]
                != "efficientnet_v2_s"
            )

            row["audit_transitions"] = int(
                transitions.sum()
            )

        if "audit_v319_selected_model" in group.columns:

            transitions = (
                group["audit_v319_selected_model"]
                != "efficientnet_v2_s"
            )

            row["v319_transitions"] = int(
                transitions.sum()
            )

        if "audit_v317_selected_model" in group.columns:

            transitions = (
                group["audit_v317_selected_model"]
                != "efficientnet_v2_s"
            )

            row["v317_transitions"] = int(
                transitions.sum()
            )

        rows.append(row)

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# CRITICAL DISCREPANCY SEARCH
# ============================================================================

def find_critical_discrepancies(df):

    banner("CRITICAL DISCREPANCY SEARCH")

    findings = []

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. V3.17 vs V3.19 selected model disagreement
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "audit_v317_selected_model" in df.columns
        and
        "audit_v319_selected_model" in df.columns
    ):

        mismatch = (
            df["audit_v317_selected_model"]
            !=
            df["audit_v319_selected_model"]
        )

        count = int(mismatch.sum())

        findings.append({
            "issue": "V3.17_vs_V3.19_decision_mismatch",
            "count": count,
            "fraction": count / len(df),
            "severity": (
                "CRITICAL"
                if count > 0
                else "NONE"
            ),
        })

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Candidate reconstruction vs V3.19
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "candidate_v319_match" in df.columns:

        mismatch = ~df["candidate_v319_match"]

        count = int(mismatch.sum())

        findings.append({
            "issue": "Reconstructed_policy_vs_V3.19_mismatch",
            "count": count,
            "fraction": count / len(df),
            "severity": (
                "CRITICAL"
                if count > 0
                else "NONE"
            ),
        })

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. V3.17 rescue vs V3.19 rescue
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "audit_v317_rescue" in df.columns
        and
        "v319_rescue" in df.columns
    ):

        v317_rescue = pd.to_numeric(
            df["audit_v317_rescue"],
            errors="coerce",
        ).fillna(0)

        v319_rescue = pd.to_numeric(
            df["v319_rescue"],
            errors="coerce",
        ).fillna(0)

        mismatch = (
            v317_rescue
            !=
            v319_rescue
        )

        count = int(mismatch.sum())

        findings.append({
            "issue": "V3.17_vs_V3.19_rescue_label_mismatch",
            "count": count,
            "fraction": count / len(df),
            "severity": (
                "CRITICAL"
                if count > 0
                else "NONE"
            ),
        })

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. V3.17 harm vs V3.19 harm
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "v317_harm" in df.columns
        and
        "v319_harm" in df.columns
    ):

        v317_harm = pd.to_numeric(
            df["v317_harm"],
            errors="coerce",
        ).fillna(0)

        v319_harm = pd.to_numeric(
            df["v319_harm"],
            errors="coerce",
        ).fillna(0)

        mismatch = (
            v317_harm
            !=
            v319_harm
        )

        count = int(mismatch.sum())

        findings.append({
            "issue": "V3.17_vs_V3.19_harm_label_mismatch",
            "count": count,
            "fraction": count / len(df),
            "severity": (
                "CRITICAL"
                if count > 0
                else "NONE"
            ),
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(findings)

    if len(result):

        print(
            result.to_string(index=False)
        )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# SHOW HIGH-SCORE ROWS
# ============================================================================

def inspect_high_score_rows(df):

    banner("INSPECTING HIGH-SCORE ROWS")

    cols = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "resnet_rescue_evidence",
        "mobile_rescue_evidence",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
        "audit_resnet_score",
        "audit_mobile_score",
        "audit_max_score",
        "audit_frozen_model",
    ]

    cols = [
        c for c in cols
        if c in df.columns
    ]

    if "audit_max_score" not in df.columns:

        print("Audit scores unavailable.")

        return

    print(
        df.sort_values(
            "audit_max_score",
            ascending=False,
        )[cols]
        .head(30)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )


# ============================================================================
# FINAL AUDIT REPORT
# ============================================================================

def build_final_report(
    df,
    score_comparison,
    mismatch_summary,
):

    banner("V3.20 FINAL AUDIT ASSESSMENT")

    rows = []

    def add(check, value, interpretation):

        rows.append({
            "check": check,
            "value": value,
            "interpretation": interpretation,
        })

    # Decision agreement
    if "decision_match" in df.columns:

        agreement = df["decision_match"].mean()

        add(
            "V3.17_V3.19_decision_agreement",
            agreement,
            (
                "IDENTICAL"
                if agreement >= 0.999999
                else "MISMATCH"
            ),
        )

    # Candidate agreement
    if "candidate_v319_match" in df.columns:

        agreement = (
            df["candidate_v319_match"]
            .mean()
        )

        add(
            "Reconstructed_V3.19_agreement",
            agreement,
            (
                "EQUIVALENT"
                if agreement >= 0.999999
                else "NOT_EQUIVALENT"
            ),
        )

    # Candidate transitions
    if "audit_switch" in df.columns:

        transitions = int(
            df["audit_switch"].sum()
        )

        add(
            "Reconstructed_transition_count",
            transitions,
            (
                "ACTIVE"
                if transitions > 0
                else "ZERO_TRANSITIONS"
            ),
        )

    # V3.19 transitions
    if "audit_v319_selected_model" in df.columns:

        transitions = int(
            (
                df["audit_v319_selected_model"]
                != "efficientnet_v2_s"
            ).sum()
        )

        add(
            "V3.19_transition_count",
            transitions,
            (
                "ACTIVE"
                if transitions > 0
                else "ZERO_TRANSITIONS"
            ),
        )

    # Score correlation
    if len(score_comparison):

        best = score_comparison.iloc[0]

        add(
            "Best_score_correlation",
            best["correlation"],
            f"Best match: {best['audit_score']} vs {best['v319_score']}",
        )

    # Final interpretation
    if "decision_match" in df.columns:

        agreement = df["decision_match"].mean()

        if agreement >= 0.999999:

            decision_text = (
                "V3.17 and V3.19 decisions are equivalent."
            )

        else:

            decision_text = (
                "V3.17 and V3.19 decisions differ. "
                "Implementation discrepancy confirmed."
            )

        add(
            "FINAL_DECISION",
            agreement,
            decision_text,
        )

    report = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print()

    print(
        report.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return report


# ============================================================================
# SAVE OUTPUTS
# ============================================================================

def save_outputs(
    comparison,
    score_comparison,
    mismatch_summary,
    fold_results,
    rescue_results,
    report,
):

    banner("SAVING V3.20 OUTPUTS")

    OUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    paths = {
        "row_level_comparison":
            OUT_DIR
            / "v3_20_row_level_comparison.csv",

        "score_distribution":
            OUT_DIR
            / "v3_20_score_distribution.csv",

        "mismatch_summary":
            OUT_DIR
            / "v3_20_mismatch_summary.csv",

        "fold_comparison":
            OUT_DIR
            / "v3_20_fold_comparison.csv",

        "rescue_comparison":
            OUT_DIR
            / "v3_20_rescue_comparison.csv",

        "audit_report":
            OUT_DIR
            / "v3_20_audit_report.csv",
    }

    comparison.to_csv(
        paths["row_level_comparison"],
        index=False,
    )

    # Score distribution
    score_cols = [
        c for c in comparison.columns
        if (
            "score" in c.lower()
            or "prob" in c.lower()
        )
    ]

    if score_cols:

        score_distribution = (
            comparison[score_cols]
            .describe()
            .T
            .reset_index()
            .rename(
                columns={
                    "index": "metric"
                }
            )
        )

    else:

        score_distribution = pd.DataFrame()

    score_distribution.to_csv(
        paths["score_distribution"],
        index=False,
    )

    mismatch_summary.to_csv(
        paths["mismatch_summary"],
        index=False,
    )

    fold_results.to_csv(
        paths["fold_comparison"],
        index=False,
    )

    rescue_results.to_csv(
        paths["rescue_comparison"],
        index=False,
    )

    report.to_csv(
        paths["audit_report"],
        index=False,
    )

    for key, path in paths.items():

        print(
            f"{key:<25}: {path}"
        )


# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    banner("V3.20 POLICY EQUIVALENCE AUDIT")

    print(
        "No model training will be performed."
    )

    print(
        "No policy optimization will be performed."
    )

    print(
        "No threshold tuning will be performed."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "The audit investigates the discrepancy between:"
    )

    print(
        "  V3.17 nested evaluation"
    )

    print(
        "  V3.19 frozen-policy evaluation"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Frozen policy under investigation:"
    )

    print(
        f"  Policy    : {POLICY_NAME}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Threshold : {FROZEN_THRESHOLD:.4f}"
    )

    (
        feature,
        target,
        oof,
        v317_outer,
        v317_selection,
        v317_predictions,
        v319_predictions,
        v319_summary,
    ) = load_artifacts()

    validate_inputs(
        feature,
        target,
        oof,
        v317_outer,
        v317_selection,
        v317_predictions,
        v319_predictions,
    )

    inspect_available_columns(
        feature,
        oof,
        v317_predictions,
        v319_predictions,
    )

    # Reconstruct candidate policy scores.
    reconstructed = reconstruct_policy_scores(
        feature
    )

    # Build master comparison dataframe.
    comparison = build_comparison(
        reconstructed,
        target,
        oof,
        v317_predictions,
        v319_predictions,
    )

    # Ensure outer_fold exists.
    if "v315_outer_fold" in comparison.columns:

        comparison["outer_fold"] = (
            comparison["v315_outer_fold"]
        )

    # V3.17 decision reconstruction.
    comparison = reconstruct_v317_decisions(
        comparison
    )

    # V3.19 decision reconstruction.
    comparison = reconstruct_v319_decisions(
        comparison
    )

    # Compare V3.17 and V3.19 directly.
    comparison = compare_decisions(
        comparison
    )

    # Score-level audit.
    score_comparison = score_correlation_audit(
        comparison
    )

    # Apply reconstructed frozen policy.
    comparison = apply_candidate_frozen_policy(
        comparison
    )

    # Compare reconstructed policy to V3.19.
    comparison = compare_candidate_to_v319(
        comparison
    )

    # Calculate outcomes.
    comparison = compute_outcomes(
        comparison,
        "audit_frozen_model",
        "audit",
    )

    if "audit_v317_selected_model" in comparison.columns:

        comparison = compute_outcomes(
            comparison,
            "audit_v317_selected_model",
            "v317_reconstructed",
        )

    if "audit_v319_selected_model" in comparison.columns:

        comparison = compute_outcomes(
            comparison,
            "audit_v319_selected_model",
            "v319_reconstructed",
        )

    # Rescue comparison.
    rescue_results = rescue_comparison(
        comparison
    )

    # Fold comparison.
    fold_results = fold_comparison(
        comparison
    )

    # Critical mismatch analysis.
    mismatch_summary = find_critical_discrepancies(
        comparison
    )

    # High-score inspection.
    inspect_high_score_rows(
        comparison
    )

    # Final report.
    report = build_final_report(
        comparison,
        score_comparison,
        mismatch_summary,
    )

    save_outputs(
        comparison,
        score_comparison,
        mismatch_summary,
        fold_results,
        rescue_results,
        report,
    )

    banner("V3.20 AUDIT COMPLETE")

    print(
        "No models were trained."
    )

    print(
        "No thresholds were tuned."
    )

    print(
        "No predictions were modified."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "The row-level artifacts should now reveal whether "
        "V3.17 and V3.19 implement the same policy."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
