#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.21 EXACT V3.17 RECONSTRUCTION AUDIT

Purpose
-------
Reconstruct the V3.17 nested outer-test decisions as faithfully as possible
from the saved V3.15 artifacts and compare them row-by-row against the
already-saved V3.17 test predictions.

This is an AUDIT ONLY.

No:
    - model training
    - threshold optimization
    - policy selection
    - modification of predictions

The critical success criterion is:

    100% selected-model agreement
    100% transition agreement
    100% rescue agreement
    100% harm agreement

If exact agreement cannot be obtained, the script reports precisely where
the implementation differs.

Author: ERG_HYBRID / Hybrid_v3
Version: V3.21
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
import math
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT DIRECTORIES
# =============================================================================

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PHASE4_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR.parent
OUTPUT_DIR = PHASE4_DIR / "outputs"

# Actual artifact locations
V315_DIR = OUTPUT_DIR / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"
V317_DIR = OUTPUT_DIR / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
V319_DIR = OUTPUT_DIR / "pairwise_v3_19_final_frozen_policy"

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# Candidate filenames.
# The loader searches several common names because the V3.15 artifact
# naming may differ slightly between installations.

FEATURE_CANDIDATES = [
    "v3_15_feature_matrix.csv",
    "selector_features.csv",
    "v3_15_features.csv",
    "features.csv",
    "feature_matrix.csv",
]

TARGET_CANDIDATES = [
    "v3_15_target_matrix.csv",
    "target_matrix.csv",
    "targets.csv",
]

OOF_CANDIDATES = [
    "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv",
    "selector_oof_predictions.csv",
    "oof_predictions.csv",
]

V317_RESULTS = V317_DIR / "v3_17_outer_fold_results.csv"
V317_SELECTION = V317_DIR / "v3_17_policy_selection.csv"
V317_TEST = V317_DIR / "v3_17_test_predictions.csv"


# =============================================================================
# DISPLAY HELPERS
# =============================================================================

WIDTH = 100


def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * WIDTH)
    print(title)
    print("=" * WIDTH)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("-" * WIDTH)
    print(title)
    print("-" * WIDTH)


def info(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg)


def fail(msg: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


# =============================================================================
# FILE LOADING
# =============================================================================

def find_existing_file(
    directory: Path,
    candidates: list[str],
    description: str,
) -> Path:

    for name in candidates:
        path = directory / name
        if path.exists():
            return path

    available = []

    if directory.exists():
        available = sorted(
            p.name
            for p in directory.iterdir()
            if p.is_file()
        )

    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"\nCould not find {description}.\n"
        f"Directory: {directory}\n"
        f"Tried:\n"
        + "\n".join(f"  - {x}" for x in candidates)
        + "\n\nAvailable files:\n"
        + "\n".join(f"  - {x}" for x in available[:100])
    )


def load_csv(
    path: Path,
    description: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    if not path.exists():
        fail(f"Missing {description}: {path}")

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    if df.empty:
        fail(f"{description} is empty: {path}")

    return df


# =============================================================================
# COLUMN HELPERS
# =============================================================================

def first_existing(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: list[str],
    required: bool = True,
    label: str = "",
):

    for col in candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            return col

    if required:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Could not find required column for {label}.\n"
            f"Tried: {candidates}\n"
            f"Available columns:\n{list(df.columns)}"
        )

    return None


def numeric_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: list[str],
    label: str,
) -> str:

    col = first_existing(
        df,
        candidates,
        required=True,
        label=label,
    )

    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

    if not np.isfinite(df[col].to_numpy(dtype=float)).all():
        raise ValueError(
            f"Column {col} contains non-finite values."
        )

    return col


# =============================================================================
# MODEL NAME NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

MODEL_ALIASES = {
    "efficientnet": "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_v2": "efficientnet_v2_s",
    "efficientnet_v2_s": "efficientnet_v2_s",

    "resnet": "resnet50",
    "resnet50": "resnet50",

    "mobile": "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "mobilenet": "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "mobilenet_v3": "mobilenet_v3_large",
    "mobilenet_v3_large": "mobilenet_v3_large",
}


def normalize_model_name(value):

    if pd.isna(value):
        return value

    text = str(value).strip()

    return MODEL_ALIASES.get(
        text.lower(),
        text,
    )


# =============================================================================
# POLICY NAME NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

def normalize_policy_name(value):

    if pd.isna(value):
        return value

    text = str(value).strip()

    aliases = {
        "E": "E_probability_x_relative_strength",
        "E_probability_x_relative_strength":
            "E_probability_x_relative_strength",

        "F": "F_probability_plus_advantage",
        "F_probability_plus_advantage":
            "F_probability_plus_advantage",
    }

    return aliases.get(text, text)


# =============================================================================
# DATA VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_inputs(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    targets: pd.DataFrame,
    oof: pd.DataFrame,
    v317_results: pd.DataFrame,
    v317_selection: pd.DataFrame,
    v317_test: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("VALIDATING V3.21 INPUTS")

    n = len(features)

    info(f"Feature rows : {features.shape}")
    info(f"Target rows  : {targets.shape}")
    info(f"OOF rows     : {oof.shape}")
    info(f"V3.17 test   : {v317_test.shape}")

    if len(targets) != n:
        fail("Feature and target row counts differ.")

    if len(oof) != n:
        fail("Feature and OOF row counts differ.")

    if len(v317_test) != n:
        fail(
            "V3.17 test predictions do not contain the "
            "same number of rows as the V3.15 artifacts."
        )

    required_feature_columns = [
        "efficientnet_confidence",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_rescue_evidence",
        "mobile_rescue_evidence",
        "resnet_vs_mobile_score",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
    ]

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required_feature_columns
        if c not in features.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        fail(
            "Missing policy-relevant feature columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in missing)
        )

    info("✓ Required policy features present")

    outer_col = first_existing(
        oof,
        ["outer_fold", "fold", "outer"],
        label="OOF outer fold",
    )

    folds = sorted(
        pd.Series(oof[outer_col])
        .dropna()
        .astype(int)
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    info(f"Outer folds: {folds}")

    if len(folds) != 5:
        warnings.warn(
            f"Expected 5 outer folds, found {len(folds)}."
        )

    if len(v317_results) != len(folds):
        fail(
            "V3.17 outer-fold results do not contain "
            "exactly one row per outer fold."
        )

    result_fold_col = first_existing(
        v317_results,
        ["outer_fold", "fold", "outer"],
        label="V3.17 results outer fold",
    )

    result_folds = sorted(
        pd.Series(v317_results[result_fold_col])
        .astype(int)
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    if result_folds != folds:
        fail(
            f"V3.17 result folds {result_folds} "
            f"do not match OOF folds {folds}."
        )

    info("✓ Outer-fold coverage complete")

    selection_fold_col = first_existing(
        v317_selection,
        ["outer_fold", "fold", "outer"],
        label="V3.17 policy-selection outer fold",
    )

    selection_folds = sorted(
        pd.Series(v317_selection[selection_fold_col])
        .astype(int)
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    if selection_folds != folds:
        fail(
            f"V3.17 policy-selection folds "
            f"{selection_folds} do not match {folds}."
        )

    info("✓ Policy-selection fold coverage complete")

    info("✓ Input validation complete")


# =============================================================================
# IDENTIFY ROW INDEX
# =============================================================================

def add_row_index(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    label: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    out = df.copy()

    col = first_existing(
        out,
        [
            "row_index",
            "index",
            "sample_index",
            "source_row_index",
        ],
        required=False,
        label=f"{label} row index",
    )

    if col is None:
        out["_audit_row_index"] = np.arange(
            len(out),
            dtype=int,
        )
    else:
        out["_audit_row_index"] = pd.to_numeric(
            out[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        if out["_audit_row_index"].isna().any():
            raise ValueError(
                f"{label} contains invalid row indices."
            )

    return out


# =============================================================================
# POLICY SCORE DEFINITIONS
# =============================================================================

def safe_series(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    col: str,
) -> pd.Series:

    return pd.to_numeric(
        df[col],
        errors="coerce",
    ).fillna(0.0)


def build_policy_components(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Base confidence
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    efficientnet_conf = safe_series(
        df,
        "efficientnet_confidence",
    )

    resnet_conf = safe_series(
        df,
        "resnet_confidence",
    )

    mobile_conf = safe_series(
        df,
        "mobilenet_confidence",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Evidence
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_evidence = safe_series(
        df,
        "resnet_rescue_evidence",
    )

    mobile_evidence = safe_series(
        df,
        "mobile_rescue_evidence",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Relative strength
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_relative = safe_series(
        df,
        "resnet_relative_strength",
    )

    mobile_relative = safe_series(
        df,
        "mobile_relative_strength",
    )

    resnet_gate_relative = (
        safe_series(df, "resnet_gate_relative_strength")
        if "resnet_gate_relative_strength" in df.columns
        else resnet_relative
    )

    mobile_gate_relative = (
        safe_series(df, "mobile_gate_relative_strength")
        if "mobile_gate_relative_strength" in df.columns
        else mobile_relative
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Probability candidates
    #
    # V3.15 artifacts can expose rescue probability under several names.
    # Prefer those columns if present.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "resnet_rescue_probability" in df.columns:
        resnet_prob = safe_series(
            df,
            "resnet_rescue_probability",
        )
    elif "resnet_rescue_prob" in df.columns:
        resnet_prob = safe_series(
            df,
            "resnet_rescue_prob",
        )
    else:
        # Reconstruct the probability signal from rescue evidence if
        # the original probability was not directly exported.
        resnet_prob = resnet_evidence.clip(
            lower=0.0
        )

    if "mobile_rescue_probability" in df.columns:
        mobile_prob = safe_series(
            df,
            "mobile_rescue_probability",
        )
    elif "mobile_rescue_prob" in df.columns:
        mobile_prob = safe_series(
            df,
            "mobile_rescue_prob",
        )
    else:
        mobile_prob = mobile_evidence.clip(
            lower=0.0
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Candidate score definitions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out["resnet_probability_x_relative"] = (
        resnet_prob * resnet_relative.clip(lower=0.0)
    )

    out["mobile_probability_x_relative"] = (
        mobile_prob * mobile_relative.clip(lower=0.0)
    )

    out["resnet_probability_x_gate_relative"] = (
        resnet_prob * resnet_gate_relative.clip(lower=0.0)
    )

    out["mobile_probability_x_gate_relative"] = (
        mobile_prob * mobile_gate_relative.clip(lower=0.0)
    )

    out["resnet_probability_plus_advantage"] = (
        resnet_prob
        + np.maximum(
            resnet_conf - efficientnet_conf,
            0.0,
        )
    )

    out["mobile_probability_plus_advantage"] = (
        mobile_prob
        + np.maximum(
            mobile_conf - efficientnet_conf,
            0.0,
        )
    )

    out["resnet_probability_plus_relative"] = (
        resnet_prob
        + np.maximum(
            resnet_relative,
            0.0,
        )
    )

    out["mobile_probability_plus_relative"] = (
        mobile_prob
        + np.maximum(
            mobile_relative,
            0.0,
        )
    )

    # Raw evidence variants.
    out["resnet_evidence_x_relative"] = (
        resnet_evidence
        * resnet_relative.clip(lower=0.0)
    )

    out["mobile_evidence_x_relative"] = (
        mobile_evidence
        * mobile_relative.clip(lower=0.0)
    )

    # Store primitive signals too.
    out["resnet_probability"] = resnet_prob
    out["mobile_probability"] = mobile_prob

    out["resnet_relative"] = resnet_relative
    out["mobile_relative"] = mobile_relative

    out["efficientnet_confidence"] = efficientnet_conf
    out["resnet_confidence"] = resnet_conf
    out["mobile_confidence"] = mobile_conf

    return out


# =============================================================================
# EXACT POLICY APPLICATION
# =============================================================================

def apply_policy_E(
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
    threshold: float,
) -> pd.Series:

    resnet = scores[
        "resnet_probability_x_relative"
    ]

    mobile = scores[
        "mobile_probability_x_relative"
    ]

    max_score = np.maximum(
        resnet.to_numpy(),
        mobile.to_numpy(),
    )

    selected = np.where(
        max_score >= threshold,
        np.where(
            resnet.to_numpy() >= mobile.to_numpy(),
            "resnet50",
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
        ),
        "efficientnet_v2_s",
    )

    return pd.Series(
        selected,
        index=scores.index,
    )


def apply_policy_F(
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
    threshold: float,
) -> pd.Series:

    resnet = scores[
        "resnet_probability_plus_advantage"
    ]

    mobile = scores[
        "mobile_probability_plus_advantage"
    ]

    max_score = np.maximum(
        resnet.to_numpy(),
        mobile.to_numpy(),
    )

    selected = np.where(
        max_score >= threshold,
        np.where(
            resnet.to_numpy() >= mobile.to_numpy(),
            "resnet50",
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
        ),
        "efficientnet_v2_s",
    )

    return pd.Series(
        selected,
        index=scores.index,
    )


# =============================================================================
# TARGET / CORRECTNESS RECONSTRUCTION
# =============================================================================

def find_correctness_columns(
    targets: pd.DataFrame,
    oof: pd.DataFrame,
):

    base_correct_col = first_existing(
        oof,
        [
            "base_correct",
            "efficientnet_correct",
            "base_is_correct",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="base correctness",
    )

    efficientnet_error_col = first_existing(
        oof,
        [
            "efficientnet_error",
            "base_error",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="efficientnet error",
    )

    resnet_correct_col = first_existing(
        oof,
        [
            "resnet_correct",
            "resnet_is_correct",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="ResNet correctness",
    )

    mobile_correct_col = first_existing(
        oof,
        [
            "mobile_correct",
            "mobilenet_correct",
            "mobilenet_v3_large_correct",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="MobileNet correctness",
    )

    return {
        "base_correct": base_correct_col,
        "efficientnet_error": efficientnet_error_col,
        "resnet_correct": resnet_correct_col,
        "mobile_correct": mobile_correct_col,
    }


def derive_correctness(
    oof: pd.DataFrame,
    targets: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=oof.index)

    cols = find_correctness_columns(
        targets,
        oof,
    )

    base_col = cols["base_correct"]

    if base_col is not None:
        out["efficientnet_correct"] = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                oof[base_col],
                errors="coerce",
            )
            .fillna(0)
            .astype(int)
        )
    elif cols["efficientnet_error"] is not None:
        error = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                oof[cols["efficientnet_error"]],
                errors="coerce",
            )
            .fillna(1)
        )

        out["efficientnet_correct"] = (
            error == 0
        ).astype(int)
    else:
        out["efficientnet_correct"] = np.nan

    if cols["resnet_correct"] is not None:
        out["resnet_correct"] = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                oof[cols["resnet_correct"]],
                errors="coerce",
            )
            .fillna(0)
            .astype(int)
        )
    else:
        out["resnet_correct"] = np.nan

    if cols["mobile_correct"] is not None:
        out["mobile_correct"] = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                oof[cols["mobile_correct"]],
                errors="coerce",
            )
            .fillna(0)
            .astype(int)
        )
    else:
        out["mobile_correct"] = np.nan

    return out

# =============================================================================
# POLICY SELECTION MAP
# =============================================================================

def build_policy_selection_map(
    selection: pd.DataFrame,
):

    fold_col = first_existing(
        selection,
        [
            "outer_fold",
            "fold",
            "outer",
        ],
        label="policy-selection fold",
    )

    policy_col = first_existing(
        selection,
        [
            "policy",
            "selected_policy",
            "primary_policy",
        ],
        label="policy-selection policy",
    )

    threshold_col = first_existing(
        selection,
        [
            "threshold",
            "selected_threshold",
        ],
        label="policy-selection threshold",
    )

    tmp = selection.copy()

    tmp["_fold"] = (
        pd.to_numeric(
            tmp[fold_col],
            errors="coerce",
        )
        .astype(int)
    )

    tmp["_policy"] = tmp[policy_col].apply(
        normalize_policy_name
    )

    tmp["_threshold"] = pd.to_numeric(
        tmp[threshold_col],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    # V3.17 policy-selection contains two policy rows per fold
    # (primary and conservative). We need the PRIMARY policy.
    role_col = first_existing(
        tmp,
        [
            "policy_type",
            "selection_type",
            "type",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="policy selection role",
    )

    if role_col is not None:
        role = (
            tmp[role_col]
            .astype(str)
            .str.lower()
        )

        primary_mask = role.str.contains(
            "primary",
            regex=False,
        )

        if primary_mask.any():
            tmp = tmp[primary_mask].copy()

    # If no explicit role exists, use the policy that corresponds
    # to the primary_policy column in the outer-fold results.
    if len(tmp) > 5:
        tmp = (
            tmp
            .sort_values(
                ["_fold"]
            )
            .groupby("_fold", as_index=False)
            .first()
        )

    result = {}

    for _, row in tmp.iterrows():

        fold = int(row["_fold"])

        result[fold] = {
            "policy": row["_policy"],
            "threshold": float(row["_threshold"]),
        }

    return result


# =============================================================================
# FALLBACK POLICY MAP FROM OUTER RESULTS
# =============================================================================

def supplement_policy_map_from_results(
    policy_map,
    results: pd.DataFrame,
):

    fold_col = first_existing(
        results,
        [
            "outer_fold",
            "fold",
            "outer",
        ],
        label="outer result fold",
    )

    policy_col = first_existing(
        results,
        [
            "primary_policy",
            "policy",
            "selected_policy",
        ],
        label="outer result primary policy",
    )

    threshold_col = first_existing(
        results,
        [
            "primary_threshold",
            "threshold",
            "selected_threshold",
        ],
        label="outer result primary threshold",
    )

    for _, row in results.iterrows():

        fold = int(row[fold_col])

        policy = normalize_policy_name(
            row[policy_col]
        )

        threshold = float(
            row[threshold_col]
        )

        # The outer-fold result is the authoritative source for
        # the primary policy selected in that fold.
        policy_map[fold] = {
            "policy": policy,
            "threshold": threshold,
        }

    return policy_map


# =============================================================================
# RECONSTRUCTION
# =============================================================================

def reconstruct_v317_decisions(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    oof: pd.DataFrame,
    v317_test: pd.DataFrame,
    policy_map,
):

    section("RECONSTRUCTING V3.17 OUTER-TEST DECISIONS")

    data = features.copy()

    # Add row index.
    data["_audit_row_index"] = np.arange(
        len(data),
        dtype=int,
    )

    # Determine outer fold.
    fold_col = first_existing(
        oof,
        [
            "outer_fold",
            "fold",
            "outer",
        ],
        label="OOF outer fold",
    )

    data["_outer_fold"] = (
        pd.to_numeric(
            oof[fold_col],
            errors="coerce",
        )
        .astype(int)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    scores = build_policy_components(
        data
    )

    reconstructed = pd.DataFrame(
        index=data.index
    )

    reconstructed["row_index"] = (
        data["_audit_row_index"]
    )

    reconstructed["outer_fold"] = (
        data["_outer_fold"]
    )

    reconstructed["policy"] = (
        reconstructed["outer_fold"]
        .map(
            lambda x: policy_map[int(x)]["policy"]
        )
    )

    reconstructed["threshold"] = (
        reconstructed["outer_fold"]
        .map(
            lambda x: policy_map[int(x)]["threshold"]
        )
    )

    # Compute both candidate policy families.
    e_selected = apply_policy_E(
        scores,
        threshold=0.0,
    )

    # F is computed with threshold 0 and later thresholded per row.
    f_selected = apply_policy_F(
        scores,
        threshold=0.0,
    )

    e_resnet_score = scores[
        "resnet_probability_x_relative"
    ]

    e_mobile_score = scores[
        "mobile_probability_x_relative"
    ]

    f_resnet_score = scores[
        "resnet_probability_plus_advantage"
    ]

    f_mobile_score = scores[
        "mobile_probability_plus_advantage"
    ]

    reconstructed["e_resnet_score"] = (
        e_resnet_score
    )

    reconstructed["e_mobile_score"] = (
        e_mobile_score
    )

    reconstructed["e_max_score"] = np.maximum(
        e_resnet_score.to_numpy(),
        e_mobile_score.to_numpy(),
    )

    reconstructed["f_resnet_score"] = (
        f_resnet_score
    )

    reconstructed["f_mobile_score"] = (
        f_mobile_score
    )

    reconstructed["f_max_score"] = np.maximum(
        f_resnet_score.to_numpy(),
        f_mobile_score.to_numpy(),
    )

    selected = []

    for i, row in reconstructed.iterrows():

        policy = row["policy"]
        threshold = float(
            row["threshold"]
        )

        if policy == "E_probability_x_relative_strength":

            rs = float(
                row["e_resnet_score"]
            )

            ms = float(
                row["e_mobile_score"]
            )

        elif policy == "F_probability_plus_advantage":

            rs = float(
                row["f_resnet_score"]
            )

            ms = float(
                row["f_mobile_score"]
            )

        else:
            # Unknown policy: leave diagnostic marker.
            selected.append(
                "UNKNOWN_POLICY"
            )
            continue

        max_score = max(rs, ms)

        if max_score < threshold:
            selected.append(
                "efficientnet_v2_s"
            )
        elif rs >= ms:
            selected.append(
                "resnet50"
            )
        else:
            selected.append(
                "mobilenet_v3_large"
            )

    reconstructed["reconstructed_selected_model"] = (
        selected
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.17 saved decisions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317 = v317_test.copy()

    v317 = add_row_index(
        v317,
        "V3.17 test",
    )

    selected_col = first_existing(
        v317,
        [
            "selected_model",
            "model",
            "selected",
        ],
        label="V3.17 selected model",
    )

    v317["_v317_selected_model"] = (
        v317[selected_col]
        .apply(normalize_model_name)
    )

    # Merge by row index.
    comparison = reconstructed.merge(
        v317[
            [
                "_audit_row_index",
                "_v317_selected_model",
            ]
        ],
        left_on="row_index",
        right_on="_audit_row_index",
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    comparison = comparison.drop(
        columns=["_audit_row_index"]
    )

    comparison["selected_model_match"] = (
        comparison["reconstructed_selected_model"]
        == comparison["_v317_selected_model"]
    )

    return comparison


# =============================================================================
# DECISION METRICS
# =============================================================================

def derive_transition_metrics(
    selected: pd.Series,
    base_model: str = "efficientnet_v2_s",
):

    selected = (
        selected
        .astype(str)
        .apply(normalize_model_name)
    )

    transition = (
        selected != base_model
    )

    return transition.astype(int)


def add_v317_transition_columns(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
    oof: pd.DataFrame,
):

    oof2 = oof.copy()

    oof2 = add_row_index(
        oof2,
        "V3.15 OOF",
    )

    selected_col = first_existing(
        oof2,
        [
            "selected_model",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="OOF selected model",
    )

    base_correct_col = first_existing(
        oof2,
        [
            "base_correct",
            "efficientnet_correct",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="base correctness",
    )

    selected_correct_col = first_existing(
        oof2,
        [
            "selected_correct",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="selected correctness",
    )

    rescue_col = first_existing(
        oof2,
        [
            "rescue",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="rescue",
    )

    harm_col = first_existing(
        oof2,
        [
            "harm",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="harm",
    )

    cols = [
        "_audit_row_index",
    ]

    for col in [
        selected_col,
        base_correct_col,
        selected_correct_col,
        rescue_col,
        harm_col,
    ]:
        if col is not None:
            cols.append(col)

    tmp = oof2[cols].copy()

    rename = {
        "_audit_row_index": "row_index"
    }

    if selected_col is not None:
        rename[selected_col] = "v315_selected_model"

    if base_correct_col is not None:
        rename[base_correct_col] = "v315_base_correct"

    if selected_correct_col is not None:
        rename[selected_correct_col] = "v315_selected_correct"

    if rescue_col is not None:
        rename[rescue_col] = "v315_rescue"

    if harm_col is not None:
        rename[harm_col] = "v315_harm"

    tmp = tmp.rename(
        columns=rename
    )

    return comparison.merge(
        tmp,
        on="row_index",
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )


# =============================================================================
# SCORE DIAGNOSTICS
# =============================================================================

def print_score_diagnostics(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("SCORE RECONSTRUCTION DIAGNOSTICS")

    for col in [
        "e_resnet_score",
        "e_mobile_score",
        "e_max_score",
        "f_resnet_score",
        "f_mobile_score",
        "f_max_score",
    ]:

        values = comparison[col].to_numpy(
            dtype=float
        )

        info(
            f"{col:<38} "
            f"min={np.nanmin(values): .6f} "
            f"mean={np.nanmean(values): .6f} "
            f"max={np.nanmax(values): .6f}"
        )


# =============================================================================
# MISMATCH ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def analyze_mismatches(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("EXACT RECONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT")

    total = len(comparison)

    agreement = (
        comparison[
            "selected_model_match"
        ]
        .sum()
    )

    mismatch = total - agreement

    agreement_rate = (
        agreement / total
        if total
        else 0.0
    )

    info(f"Rows                 : {total}")
    info(f"Exact matches        : {agreement}")
    info(f"Exact mismatches     : {mismatch}")
    info(
        f"Selected-model agreement : "
        f"{agreement_rate:.6f}"
    )

    subsection("RECONSTRUCTED MODEL DISTRIBUTION")

    print(
        comparison[
            "reconstructed_selected_model"
        ]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    subsection("V3.17 SAVED MODEL DISTRIBUTION")

    print(
        comparison[
            "_v317_selected_model"
        ]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    subsection("MISMATCH DISTRIBUTION")

    mismatches = comparison[
        ~comparison[
            "selected_model_match"
        ]
    ]

    if mismatches.empty:
        info("No mismatches found.")
        return mismatches

    mismatch_table = (
        mismatches
        .groupby(
            [
                "reconstructed_selected_model",
                "_v317_selected_model",
            ]
        )
        .size()
        .reset_index(
            name="count"
        )
        .sort_values(
            "count",
            ascending=False,
        )
    )

    print(
        mismatch_table.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    subsection("FIRST 100 MISMATCHES")

    display_cols = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "policy",
        "threshold",
        "e_resnet_score",
        "e_mobile_score",
        "f_resnet_score",
        "f_mobile_score",
        "reconstructed_selected_model",
        "_v317_selected_model",
    ]

    display_cols = [
        c
        for c in display_cols
        if c in mismatches.columns
    ]

    print(
        mismatches[
            display_cols
        ]
        .head(100)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    return mismatches


# =============================================================================
# TRANSITION / RESCUE / HARM COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def compare_transition_behavior(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
    v317_test: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("TRANSITION / RESCUE / HARM RECONSTRUCTION")

    base_model = "efficientnet_v2_s"

    comparison["reconstructed_transition"] = (
        comparison[
            "reconstructed_selected_model"
        ]
        != base_model
    )

    comparison["v317_transition"] = (
        comparison[
            "_v317_selected_model"
        ]
        != base_model
    )

    info(
        "Reconstructed transitions : "
        f"{comparison['reconstructed_transition'].sum()}"
    )

    info(
        "V3.17 saved transitions   : "
        f"{comparison['v317_transition'].sum()}"
    )

    info(
        "Transition agreement      : "
        f"{np.mean(comparison['reconstructed_transition'] == comparison['v317_transition']):.6f}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Correctness from V3.17 test artifact.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317 = v317_test.copy()

    v317 = add_row_index(
        v317,
        "V3.17 test",
    )

    base_correct_col = first_existing(
        v317,
        [
            "base_correct",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="V3.17 base correctness",
    )

    selected_correct_col = first_existing(
        v317,
        [
            "selected_correct",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="V3.17 selected correctness",
    )

    rescue_col = first_existing(
        v317,
        [
            "rescue",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="V3.17 rescue",
    )

    harm_col = first_existing(
        v317,
        [
            "harm",
        ],
        required=False,
        label="V3.17 harm",
    )

    if rescue_col is not None:
        tmp = v317[
            [
                "_audit_row_index",
                rescue_col,
            ]
        ].rename(
            columns={
                "_audit_row_index": "row_index",
                rescue_col: "v317_rescue",
            }
        )

        comparison = comparison.merge(
            tmp,
            on="row_index",
            how="left",
            validate="one_to_one",
        )

    if harm_col is not None:
        tmp = v317[
            [
                "_audit_row_index",
                harm_col,
            ]
        ].rename(
            columns={
                "_audit_row_index": "row_index",
                harm_col: "v317_harm",
            }
        )

        comparison = comparison.merge(
            tmp,
            on="row_index",
            how="left",
            validate="one_to_one",
        )

    if (
        base_correct_col is not None
        and selected_correct_col is not None
    ):

        tmp = v317[
            [
                "_audit_row_index",
                base_correct_col,
                selected_correct_col,
            ]
        ].rename(
            columns={
                "_audit_row_index": "row_index",
                base_correct_col: "v317_base_correct",
                selected_correct_col: "v317_selected_correct",
            }
        )

        comparison = comparison.merge(
            tmp,
            on="row_index",
            how="left",
            validate="one_to_one",
        )

    return comparison


# =============================================================================
# FOLD-WISE COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def foldwise_analysis(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("FOLD-WISE EXACT RECONSTRUCTION")

    rows = []

    for fold, group in comparison.groupby(
        "outer_fold"
    ):

        n = len(group)

        agreement = (
            group["selected_model_match"]
            .mean()
        )

        recon_transitions = int(
            group[
                "reconstructed_transition"
            ].sum()
        )

        v317_transitions = int(
            group[
                "v317_transition"
            ].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "outer_fold": int(fold),
                "samples": n,
                "decision_agreement": agreement,
                "reconstructed_transitions":
                    recon_transitions,
                "v317_transitions":
                    v317_transitions,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# POLICY SCORE THRESHOLD DIAGNOSTICS
# =============================================================================

def threshold_diagnostics(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("THRESHOLD DECISION DIAGNOSTICS")

    # Determine whether saved V3.17 decisions could be reproduced
    # from reconstructed scores using the exact fold threshold.

    comparisons = []

    for _, row in comparison.iterrows():

        policy = row["policy"]
        threshold = float(
            row["threshold"]
        )

        if policy == "E_probability_x_relative_strength":

            score = max(
                float(row["e_resnet_score"]),
                float(row["e_mobile_score"]),
            )

        elif policy == "F_probability_plus_advantage":

            score = max(
                float(row["f_resnet_score"]),
                float(row["f_mobile_score"]),
            )

        else:
            score = np.nan

        comparisons.append(
            {
                "row_index":
                    row["row_index"],
                "policy":
                    policy,
                "threshold":
                    threshold,
                "reconstructed_max_score":
                    score,
                "above_threshold":
                    (
                        score >= threshold
                        if np.isfinite(score)
                        else False
                    ),
            }
        )

    diag = pd.DataFrame(
        comparisons
    )

    info(
        "Rows above reconstructed threshold: "
        f"{diag['above_threshold'].sum()}"
    )

    info(
        "Rows below reconstructed threshold: "
        f"{(~diag['above_threshold']).sum()}"
    )

    return diag


# =============================================================================
# ALTERNATIVE POLICY DEFINITIONS
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_alternative_definitions(
    features: pd.DataFrame,
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("ALTERNATIVE POLICY DEFINITION SEARCH")

    scores = build_policy_components(
        features
    )

    threshold_by_row = comparison[
        "threshold"
    ].to_numpy(
        dtype=float
    )

    definitions = {
        "E_probability_x_relative":
            (
                scores[
                    "resnet_probability_x_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
                scores[
                    "mobile_probability_x_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
            ),

        "E_probability_x_gate_relative":
            (
                scores[
                    "resnet_probability_x_gate_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
                scores[
                    "mobile_probability_x_gate_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
            ),

        "F_probability_plus_advantage":
            (
                scores[
                    "resnet_probability_plus_advantage"
                ].to_numpy(),
                scores[
                    "mobile_probability_plus_advantage"
                ].to_numpy(),
            ),

        "F_probability_plus_relative":
            (
                scores[
                    "resnet_probability_plus_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
                scores[
                    "mobile_probability_plus_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
            ),

        "evidence_x_relative":
            (
                scores[
                    "resnet_evidence_x_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
                scores[
                    "mobile_evidence_x_relative"
                ].to_numpy(),
            ),
    }

    saved = (
        comparison[
            "_v317_selected_model"
        ]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    rows = []

    for name, (rs, ms) in definitions.items():

        selected = np.where(
            np.maximum(rs, ms)
            >= threshold_by_row,
            np.where(
                rs >= ms,
                "resnet50",
                "mobilenet_v3_large",
            ),
            "efficientnet_v2_s",
        )

        agreement = np.mean(
            selected == saved
        )

        transitions = np.sum(
            selected != "efficientnet_v2_s"
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "definition": name,
                "agreement": agreement,
                "mismatches":
                    int(
                        len(selected)
                        - np.sum(
                            selected == saved
                        )
                    ),
                "transitions":
                    int(transitions),
            }
        )

    result = (
        pd.DataFrame(rows)
        .sort_values(
            "agreement",
            ascending=False,
        )
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# FINAL DECISION
# =============================================================================

def final_assessment(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("V3.21 FINAL EXACT-RECONSTRUCTION ASSESSMENT")

    n = len(comparison)

    decision_agreement = (
        comparison[
            "selected_model_match"
        ]
        .mean()
    )

    transition_agreement = (
        comparison[
            "reconstructed_transition"
        ]
        == comparison[
            "v317_transition"
        ]
    ).mean()

    exact = (
        decision_agreement == 1.0
        and transition_agreement == 1.0
    )

    table = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "check":
                    "selected_model_agreement",
                "value":
                    decision_agreement,
                "required":
                    1.0,
                "pass":
                    decision_agreement == 1.0,
            },
            {
                "check":
                    "transition_agreement",
                "value":
                    transition_agreement,
                "required":
                    1.0,
                "pass":
                    transition_agreement == 1.0,
            },
        ]
    )

    print(
        table.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    print()

    if exact:
        info(
            "✓ EXACT V3.17 RECONSTRUCTION ACHIEVED"
        )
        info(
            f"✓ {n}/{n} rows reproduce the saved V3.17 decision."
        )
        info(
            "✓ V3.17 policy implementation can now be frozen."
        )

        decision = (
            "EXACT_RECONSTRUCTION_CONFIRMED"
        )

    else:
        info(
            "✗ EXACT V3.17 RECONSTRUCTION NOT ACHIEVED"
        )

        info(
            f"✗ Decision agreement: "
            f"{decision_agreement:.6f}"
        )

        info(
            f"✗ Transition agreement: "
            f"{transition_agreement:.6f}"
        )

        info(
            "DO NOT proceed to a final frozen-policy claim."
        )

        decision = (
            "IMPLEMENTATION_DISCREPANCY_REMAINS"
        )

    return {
        "decision":
            decision,
        "samples":
            n,
        "selected_model_agreement":
            decision_agreement,
        "transition_agreement":
            transition_agreement,
    }


# =============================================================================
# SAVE OUTPUTS
# =============================================================================

def save_outputs(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
    fold_results: pd.DataFrame,
    threshold_diag: pd.DataFrame,
    alternative_results: pd.DataFrame,
    assessment: dict,
):

    section("SAVING V3.21 OUTPUTS")

    row_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_21_exact_row_comparison.csv"
    )

    fold_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_21_fold_comparison.csv"
    )

    threshold_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_21_threshold_diagnostics.csv"
    )

    alternatives_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_21_alternative_definitions.csv"
    )

    report_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_21_exact_reconstruction_report.csv"
    )

    comparison.to_csv(
        row_path,
        index=False,
    )

    fold_results.to_csv(
        fold_path,
        index=False,
    )

    threshold_diag.to_csv(
        threshold_path,
        index=False,
    )

    alternative_results.to_csv(
        alternatives_path,
        index=False,
    )

    pd.DataFrame(
        [assessment]
    ).to_csv(
        report_path,
        index=False,
    )

    info(
        f"Row comparison       : {row_path}"
    )

    info(
        f"Fold comparison      : {fold_path}"
    )

    info(
        f"Threshold diagnostics: {threshold_path}"
    )

    info(
        f"Alternative policies : {alternatives_path}"
    )

    info(
        f"Exact report         : {report_path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.21 EXACT V3.17 RECONSTRUCTION AUDIT"
    )

    info(
        "No model training will be performed."
    )

    info(
        "No policy optimization will be performed."
    )

    info(
        "No threshold tuning will be performed."
    )

    info(
        "No predictions will be modified."
    )

    info("Starting exact V3.17 reconstruction")
    info(
        "Goal:"
    )
    info(
        "Reproduce the saved V3.17 outer-test decisions "
        "row-by-row."
    )
    info("")
    info(
        "Required success criterion:"
    )
    info(
        "100% selected-model agreement."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load V3.15 artifacts
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "LOADING V3.15 ARTIFACTS"
    )

    feature_path = find_existing_file(
        V315_DIR,
        FEATURE_CANDIDATES,
        "V3.15 feature matrix",
    )

    target_path = find_existing_file(
        V315_DIR,
        TARGET_CANDIDATES,
        "V3.15 target matrix",
    )

    oof_path = find_existing_file(
        V315_DIR,
        OOF_CANDIDATES,
        "V3.15 OOF predictions",
    )

    features = load_csv(
        feature_path,
        "V3.15 feature matrix",
    )

    targets = load_csv(
        target_path,
        "V3.15 target matrix",
    )

    oof = load_csv(
        oof_path,
        "V3.15 OOF predictions",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load V3.17 artifacts
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "LOADING V3.17 ARTIFACTS"
    )

    v317_results = load_csv(
        V317_RESULTS,
        "V3.17 outer-fold results",
    )

    v317_selection = load_csv(
        V317_SELECTION,
        "V3.17 policy selection",
    )

    v317_test = load_csv(
        V317_TEST,
        "V3.17 test predictions",
    )

    info(
        f"Feature matrix      : {features.shape}"
    )

    info(
        f"Target matrix       : {targets.shape}"
    )

    info(
        f"OOF predictions     : {oof.shape}"
    )

    info(
        f"V3.17 outer results : {v317_results.shape}"
    )

    info(
        f"V3.17 policy select : {v317_selection.shape}"
    )

    info(
        f"V3.17 test          : {v317_test.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_inputs(
        features,
        targets,
        oof,
        v317_results,
        v317_selection,
        v317_test,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build policy selection map
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "RECOVERING V3.17 FOLD-SPECIFIC POLICY"
    )

    policy_map = build_policy_selection_map(
        v317_selection
    )

    policy_map = supplement_policy_map_from_results(
        policy_map,
        v317_results,
    )

    for fold in sorted(policy_map):

        info(
            f"Outer fold {fold}: "
            f"{policy_map[fold]['policy']} "
            f"@ "
            f"{policy_map[fold]['threshold']:.4f}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Reconstruct
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    comparison = reconstruct_v317_decisions(
        features,
        oof,
        v317_test,
        policy_map,
    )

    print_score_diagnostics(
        comparison
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Exact agreement
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    mismatches = analyze_mismatches(
        comparison
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition / rescue / harm
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    comparison = compare_transition_behavior(
        comparison,
        v317_test,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fold-wise
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    fold_results = foldwise_analysis(
        comparison
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Threshold diagnostics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    threshold_diag = threshold_diagnostics(
        comparison
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Alternative definitions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    alternative_results = (
        evaluate_alternative_definitions(
            features,
            comparison,
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final assessment
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    assessment = final_assessment(
        comparison
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_outputs(
        comparison,
        fold_results,
        threshold_diag,
        alternative_results,
        assessment,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.21 AUDIT COMPLETE"
    )

    if (
        assessment[
            "decision"
        ]
        == "EXACT_RECONSTRUCTION_CONFIRMED"
    ):

        info(
            "✓ V3.17 has been reproduced exactly."
        )

        info(
            "The next step can be a correctly frozen "
            "V3.22 policy evaluation."
        )

    else:

        info(
            "✗ V3.17 has NOT been reproduced exactly."
        )

        info(
            "Do NOT freeze the policy yet."
        )

        info(
            "Use v3_21_exact_row_comparison.csv to "
            "identify the remaining implementation discrepancy."
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.17 HARM FINGERPRINT ANALYSIS -- ROBUST FIXED VERSION

IMPORTANT DATA MODEL
--------------------

V3.17 prediction artifact:
    v3_17_test_predictions.csv

is the AUTHORITATIVE source for:

    - original sample ID
    - outer fold
    - selected model
    - whether EfficientNet made an error
    - whether ResNet would rescue
    - whether MobileNet would rescue
    - whether ResNet would harm
    - whether MobileNet would harm
    - actual V3.17 transition

V3.15 OOF artifact:
    v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv

contains positional OOF information and probabilities/features.
Its selected_model column is NOT the V3.17 decision and must therefore
NOT be compared against V3.17 selected_model.

V3.15 feature_matrix.csv and target_matrix.csv contain 1267 rows
without an explicit sample ID. They are therefore attached by
POSITIONAL ORDER only.

This script deliberately avoids:
    - requiring row_index in feature_matrix
    - comparing V3.17 selected_model with V3.15 OOF selected_model
    - reconstructing V3.17 selection from V3.15 OOF
    - using V3.15 OOF outcome columns as V3.17 truth

The purpose is diagnostic analysis of the exact V3.17 transitions.
"""

from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# ============================================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================================

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

OUTPUT_BASE = (
    BASE_DIR
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
)

V317_DIR = (
    OUTPUT_BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
)

V315_DIR = (
    OUTPUT_BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    OUTPUT_BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_17_harm_fingerprint"
)

PREDICTION_FILE = (
    V317_DIR
    / "v3_17_test_predictions.csv"
)

OUTER_FILE = (
    V317_DIR
    / "v3_17_outer_fold_results.csv"
)

FEATURE_FILE = (
    V315_DIR
    / "v3_15_feature_matrix.csv"
)

TARGET_FILE = (
    V315_DIR
    / "v3_15_target_matrix.csv"
)

OOF_FILE = (
    V315_DIR
    / "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv"
)


# ============================================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================================

def section(title):

    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title):

    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


def pct(x):

    return f"{100.0 * float(x):.2f}%"


def safe_ratio(a, b):

    if b == 0:

        if a > 0:
            return np.inf

        return 0.0

    return float(a) / float(b)


def ensure_columns(df, columns, name):

    missing = [
        c for c in columns
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} is missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing)
        )


# ============================================================================
# LOAD
# ============================================================================

def load_data():

    section("LOADING V3.17 / V3.15 ARTIFACTS")

    predictions = pd.read_csv(
        PREDICTION_FILE
    )

    features = pd.read_csv(
        FEATURE_FILE
    )

    targets = pd.read_csv(
        TARGET_FILE
    )

    oof = pd.read_csv(
        OOF_FILE
    )

    outer = pd.read_csv(
        OUTER_FILE
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 predictions : {predictions.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 features    : {features.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 targets     : {targets.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 OOF         : {oof.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 outer       : {outer.shape}"
    )

    return (
        predictions,
        features,
        targets,
        oof,
        outer,
    )


# ============================================================================
# VALIDATE PREDICTION ARTIFACT
# ============================================================================

def validate_predictions(predictions):

    section("VALIDATING AUTHORITATIVE V3.17 PREDICTIONS")

    required = [
        "outer_fold",
        "row_index",
        "selected_model",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
    ]

    ensure_columns(
        predictions,
        required,
        "V3.17 predictions"
    )

    if len(predictions) != 1267:

        raise ValueError(
            "Unexpected V3.17 prediction row count: "
            f"{len(predictions)}"
        )

    if predictions["row_index"].duplicated().any():

        raise ValueError(
            "V3.17 prediction row_index contains duplicates."
        )

    print(
        "✓ V3.17 prediction schema valid"
    )

    print(
        f"Rows       : {len(predictions)}"
    )

    print(
        f"row_index  : "
        f"{predictions['row_index'].min()} -> "
        f"{predictions['row_index'].max()}"
    )

    print()
    print("Actual V3.17 selected-model usage:")

    print(
        predictions["selected_model"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Actual V3.17 transitions:",
        (
            predictions["selected_model"]
            != "efficientnet_v2_s"
        ).sum()
    )


# ============================================================================
# POSITIONAL ALIGNMENT
# ============================================================================

def attach_positional_artifacts(
    predictions,
    features,
    targets,
    oof,
):

    section(
        "ATTACHING V3.15 ARTIFACTS BY POSITIONAL ORDER"
    )

    n = len(predictions)

    for name, data in [
        ("features", features),
        ("targets", targets),
        ("OOF", oof),
    ]:

        if len(data) != n:

            raise ValueError(
                f"{name} has {len(data)} rows, "
                f"but V3.17 predictions have {n} rows."
            )

    print(
        "✓ All artifacts contain 1267 rows."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "V3.15 OOF row_index is positional."
    )

    print(
        "V3.17 row_index is the original sample ID."
    )

    print(
        "They are intentionally NOT merged by row_index."
    )

    print(
        "Feature/target/OOF rows are attached positionally."
    )

    # Remove duplicate columns before concatenation.

    features = features.loc[
        :,
        ~features.columns.duplicated()
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    targets = targets.loc[
        :,
        ~targets.columns.duplicated()
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    oof = oof.loc[
        :,
        ~oof.columns.duplicated()
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    predictions = predictions.loc[
        :,
        ~predictions.columns.duplicated()
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Prefix OOF columns to avoid confusing them with V3.17 values.

    oof_prefixed = oof.copy()

    rename_oof = {}

    for c in oof_prefixed.columns:

        rename_oof[c] = (
            c
            if c in ["row_index"]
            else f"oof_{c}"
        )

    oof_prefixed = oof_prefixed.rename(
        columns=rename_oof
    )

    # Prefix target columns.

    target_prefixed = targets.copy()

    target_prefixed = target_prefixed.rename(
        columns={
            c: f"target_{c}"
            for c in target_prefixed.columns
        }
    )

    # Prefix feature columns.

    feature_prefixed = features.copy()

    feature_prefixed = feature_prefixed.rename(
        columns={
            c: f"feature_{c}"
            for c in feature_prefixed.columns
        }
    )

    df = pd.concat(
        [
            predictions,
            feature_prefixed,
            target_prefixed,
            oof_prefixed,
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    df = df.loc[
        :,
        ~df.columns.duplicated()
    ]

    print(
        f"Merged forensic dataframe: {df.shape}"
    )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# RECONSTRUCT ACTUAL V3.17 OUTCOMES
# ============================================================================

def reconstruct_v317_outcomes(df):

    section(
        "RECONSTRUCTING ACTUAL V3.17 OUTCOMES"
    )

    base_error = (
        df["efficientnet_error"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    base_correct = (
        1 - base_error
    )

    selected_model = (
        df["selected_model"]
        .astype(str)
    )

    transition = (
        selected_model
        != "efficientnet_v2_s"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Selected specialist's outcome.
    #
    # For a transition to ResNet:
    #
    #   base correct + resnet harm -> selected wrong
    #   base wrong   + resnet rescue -> selected correct
    #
    # Same logic for MobileNet.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    selected_correct = (
        base_correct
        .astype(int)
        .copy()
    )

    # ResNet transitions

    r_mask = (
        selected_model
        == "resnet50"
    )

    r_harm = (
        df["resnet_harm"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    r_rescue = (
        df["resnet_rescue"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    selected_correct.loc[r_mask] = np.where(
        base_correct.loc[r_mask].astype(bool),
        1 - r_harm.loc[r_mask],
        r_rescue.loc[r_mask],
    )

    # MobileNet transitions

    m_mask = (
        selected_model
        == "mobilenet_v3_large"
    )

    m_harm = (
        df["mobile_harm"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    m_rescue = (
        df["mobile_rescue"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    selected_correct.loc[m_mask] = np.where(
        base_correct.loc[m_mask].astype(bool),
        1 - m_harm.loc[m_mask],
        m_rescue.loc[m_mask],
    )

    selected_correct = (
        pd.Series(
            selected_correct,
            index=df.index
        )
        .astype(int)
    )

    rescue = (
        transition
        & (base_correct == 0)
        & (selected_correct == 1)
    )

    harm = (
        transition
        & (base_correct == 1)
        & (selected_correct == 0)
    )

    neutral = (
        transition
        & ~rescue
        & ~harm
    )

    df["v317_base_correct"] = (
        base_correct.astype(int)
    )

    df["v317_selected_correct"] = (
        selected_correct.astype(int)
    )

    df["v317_transition"] = (
        transition.astype(int)
    )

    df["v317_rescue"] = (
        rescue.astype(int)
    )

    df["v317_harm"] = (
        harm.astype(int)
    )

    df["v317_neutral_transition"] = (
        neutral.astype(int)
    )

    print(
        f"Total samples : {len(df)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions   : {transition.sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues       : {rescue.sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms         : {harm.sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral       : {neutral.sum()}"
    )

    # Expected V3.17 fingerprint.

    print()
    print("EXPECTED V3.17 FINGERPRINT")
    print(
        "Historical target: approximately "
        "171 transitions / 120 rescues / 51 harms."
    )

    print()
    print("ACTUAL RECONSTRUCTION")

    print(
        f"Transitions = {transition.sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues     = {rescue.sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms       = {harm.sum()}"
    )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# CROSS-CHECK PREDICTION FLAGS
# ============================================================================

def cross_check_flags(df):

    section(
        "CROSS-CHECKING V3.17 SPECIALIST FLAGS"
    )

    # ResNet transition outcomes.

    r_mask = (
        df["selected_model"]
        == "resnet50"
    )

    m_mask = (
        df["selected_model"]
        == "mobilenet_v3_large"
    )

    # A rescue flag means:
    # EfficientNet wrong AND specialist correct.

    r_expected_rescue = (
        r_mask
        & (df["efficientnet_error"] == 1)
        & (df["resnet_rescue"] == 1)
    )

    m_expected_rescue = (
        m_mask
        & (df["efficientnet_error"] == 1)
        & (df["mobile_rescue"] == 1)
    )

    r_expected_harm = (
        r_mask
        & (df["efficientnet_error"] == 0)
        & (df["resnet_harm"] == 1)
    )

    m_expected_harm = (
        m_mask
        & (df["efficientnet_error"] == 0)
        & (df["mobile_harm"] == 1)
    )

    print(
        "Selected ResNet transitions:",
        r_mask.sum()
    )

    print(
        "Selected MobileNet transitions:",
        m_mask.sum()
    )

    print(
        "ResNet selected rescues:",
        r_expected_rescue.sum()
    )

    print(
        "MobileNet selected rescues:",
        m_expected_rescue.sum()
    )

    print(
        "ResNet selected harms:",
        r_expected_harm.sum()
    )

    print(
        "MobileNet selected harms:",
        m_expected_harm.sum()
    )

    # Compare with reconstructed outcome.

    reconstructed_rescue = (
        df["v317_rescue"] == 1
    )

    reconstructed_harm = (
        df["v317_harm"] == 1
    )

    flag_rescue = (
        r_expected_rescue
        | m_expected_rescue
    )

    flag_harm = (
        r_expected_harm
        | m_expected_harm
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Rescue mismatch:",
        (
            reconstructed_rescue
            != flag_rescue
        ).sum()
    )

    print(
        "Harm mismatch:",
        (
            reconstructed_harm
            != flag_harm
        ).sum()
    )

    print()
    print(
        "✓ V3.17 outcomes are derived directly from "
        "the V3.17 prediction artifact."
    )


# ============================================================================
# BUILD SCORE FEATURES
# ============================================================================

def build_scores(df):

    section(
        "BUILDING HARM-DISCRIMINATION FEATURES"
    )

    # V3.15 OOF probabilities are attached positionally
    # and explicitly namespaced with oof_.

    required = [
        "oof_resnet_rescue_probability",
        "oof_mobile_rescue_probability",
    ]

    missing = [
        c for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        print()
        print(
            "WARNING: V3.15 OOF probability columns are "
            "not available."
        )

        print(
            "Available OOF columns:"
        )

        print(
            [
                c for c in df.columns
                if c.startswith("oof_")
            ]
        )

        # Do not crash.
        # Harm fingerprint can still run.

        df["oof_resnet_rescue_probability"] = np.nan

        df["oof_mobile_rescue_probability"] = np.nan

    # Feature matrix columns.

    feature_map = {
        "efficientnet_confidence":
            "feature_efficientnet_confidence",

        "resnet_confidence":
            "feature_resnet_confidence",

        "mobilenet_confidence":
            "feature_mobilenet_confidence",

        "resnet_gate":
            "feature_resnet_gate",

        "mobile_gate":
            "feature_mobile_gate",

        "resnet_relative_strength":
            "feature_resnet_relative_strength",

        "mobile_relative_strength":
            "feature_mobile_relative_strength",

        "resnet_switch_advantage":
            "feature_resnet_switch_advantage",

        "mobile_switch_advantage":
            "feature_mobile_switch_advantage",

        "resnet_switch_signal":
            "feature_resnet_switch_signal",

        "mobile_switch_signal":
            "feature_mobile_switch_signal",

        "alternative_confidence":
            "feature_alternative_conf_max",

        "alternative_confidence_margin":
            "feature_alternative_conf_margin",

        "resnet_vs_mobile_score":
            "feature_resnet_vs_mobile_score",

        "resnet_vs_mobile_conf":
            "feature_resnet_vs_mobile_conf",

        "resnet_vs_mobile_gate":
            "feature_resnet_vs_mobile_gate",
    }

    for new_name, source in feature_map.items():

        if source in df.columns:

            df[new_name] = pd.to_numeric(
                df[source],
                errors="coerce"
            )

        else:

            df[new_name] = np.nan

    # Convenience aliases.

    df["rescue_probability_max"] = np.maximum(
        df["oof_resnet_rescue_probability"].fillna(0),
        df["oof_mobile_rescue_probability"].fillna(0),
    )

    df["rescue_probability_margin"] = (
        np.abs(
            df["oof_resnet_rescue_probability"].fillna(0)
            -
            df["oof_mobile_rescue_probability"].fillna(0)
        )
    )

    df["confidence_gap_to_specialist"] = (
        df["efficientnet_confidence"]
        -
        df["alternative_confidence"]
    )

    df["selected_specialist_confidence"] = np.where(
        df["selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_confidence"],
        np.where(
            df["selected_model"] == "mobilenet_v3_large",
            df["mobilenet_confidence"],
            df["efficientnet_confidence"],
        )
    )

    df["selected_specialist_advantage"] = np.where(
        df["selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_switch_advantage"],
        np.where(
            df["selected_model"] == "mobilenet_v3_large",
            df["mobile_switch_advantage"],
            0.0,
        )
    )

    df["selected_specialist_strength"] = np.where(
        df["selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_relative_strength"],
        np.where(
            df["selected_model"] == "mobilenet_v3_large",
            df["mobile_relative_strength"],
            0.0,
        )
    )

    return df

def basic_profile(df):

    section(
        "V3.17 BASIC HARM PROFILE"
    )

    transition = df[
        df["v317_transition"] == 1
    ]

    rescue = df[
        df["v317_rescue"] == 1
    ]

    harm = df[
        df["v317_harm"] == 1
    ]

    neutral = df[
        df["v317_neutral_transition"] == 1
    ]

    print(
        f"Total samples : {len(df)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions   : {len(transition)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues       : {len(rescue)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms         : {len(harm)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral       : {len(neutral)}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Harm rate among transitions:",
        pct(
            len(harm)
            / max(len(transition), 1)
        )
    )

    print(
        "Rescue/Harm ratio:",
        f"{safe_ratio(len(rescue), len(harm)):.4f}"
    )

    print()

    if len(harm):

        print(
            harm["selected_model"]
            .value_counts()
            .to_string()
        )

    print()
    print("TRANSITIONS BY SELECTED MODEL")

    print(
        transition["selected_model"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    print()
    print("HARM BY OUTER FOLD")

    if len(harm):

        print(
            harm["outer_fold"]
            .value_counts()
            .sort_index()
            .to_string()
        )


# ============================================================================
# FEATURE COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

def feature_comparison(df):

    section(
        "HARM VS RESCUE FEATURE COMPARISON"
    )

    groups = {
        "ALL_TRANSITIONS":
            df["v317_transition"] == 1,

        "RESCUE":
            df["v317_rescue"] == 1,

        "HARM":
            df["v317_harm"] == 1,

        "NEUTRAL":
            df["v317_neutral_transition"] == 1,
    }

    columns = [
        "rescue_probability_max",
        "rescue_probability_margin",
        "efficientnet_confidence",
        "alternative_confidence",
        "alternative_confidence_margin",
        "confidence_gap_to_specialist",
        "selected_specialist_confidence",
        "selected_specialist_advantage",
        "selected_specialist_strength",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
        "resnet_switch_advantage",
        "mobile_switch_advantage",
        "resnet_gate",
        "mobile_gate",
    ]

    rows = []

    for name, mask in groups.items():

        subset = df[mask]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        row = {
            "group": name,
            "n": len(subset),
        }

        for c in columns:

            if c not in subset.columns:
                continue

            row[c] = subset[c].mean()

        rows.append(row)

    if not rows:
        return

    table = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        table.to_string(index=False)
    )

    output = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_harm_vs_rescue_features.csv"
    )

    table.to_csv(
        output,
        index=False
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output}"
    )
