# SPECIALIST PROFILE
# ============================================================================

def specialist_profile(df):

    section(
        "SPECIALIST-SPECIFIC HARM PROFILE"
    )

    for model in [
        "resnet50",
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
    ]:

        subset = df[
            (df["v317_harm"] == 1)
            &
            (df["selected_model"] == model)
        ]

        print()
        print("=" * 70)
        print(model)
        print("=" * 70)

        print(
            "Harms:",
            len(subset)
        )

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        cols = [
            "rescue_probability_max",
            "rescue_probability_margin",
            "efficientnet_confidence",
            "alternative_confidence",
            "selected_specialist_confidence",
            "selected_specialist_advantage",
            "selected_specialist_strength",
            "resnet_confidence",
            "mobilenet_confidence",
            "resnet_gate",
            "mobile_gate",
            "resnet_relative_strength",
            "mobile_relative_strength",
            "resnet_switch_advantage",
            "mobile_switch_advantage",
        ]

        cols = [
            c for c in cols
            if c in subset.columns
        ]

        if cols:

            summary = (
                subset[cols]
                .describe()
                .T
            )

            available = [
                c for c in [
                    "mean",
                    "50%",
                    "min",
                    "max",
                ]
                if c in summary.columns
            ]

            print(
                summary[available]
                .to_string()
            )


# ============================================================================
# SCORE BINS
# ============================================================================

def score_bins(df):

    section(
        "RESCUE PROBABILITY / CONFIDENCE BINS"
    )

    transition = df[
        df["v317_transition"] == 1
    ].copy()

    if len(transition) == 0:
        return

    transition["prob_bin"] = pd.cut(
        transition["rescue_probability_max"],
        bins=[
            -np.inf,
            0.10,
            0.25,
            0.40,
            0.50,
            0.60,
            0.75,
            0.90,
            np.inf,
        ],
        include_lowest=True,
    )

    table = (
        transition
        .groupby(
            "prob_bin",
            observed=False
        )
        .agg(
            n=("v317_transition", "size"),
            rescues=("v317_rescue", "sum"),
            harms=("v317_harm", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    table["rescue_rate"] = (
        table["rescues"]
        / table["n"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )

    table["harm_rate"] = (
        table["harms"]
        / table["n"].replace(0, np.nan)
    )

    table["net"] = (
        table["rescues"]
        - table["harms"]
    )

    print(
        table.to_string(index=False)
    )

    output = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_harm_probability_bins.csv"
    )

    table.to_csv(
        output,
        index=False
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# CANDIDATE GUARDS
# ============================================================================

def candidate_guards(df):

    section(
        "CANDIDATE HARM GUARDS"
    )

    transition = df[
        df["v317_transition"] == 1
    ].copy()

    if len(transition) == 0:
        return

    candidates = []

    def evaluate(
        name,
        allow_mask
    ):

        allowed = transition[
            allow_mask
        ]

        rescues = int(
            allowed["v317_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            allowed["v317_harm"].sum()
        )

        transitions = len(allowed)

        blocked_harms = int(
            transition["v317_harm"].sum()
            - harms
        )

        lost_rescues = int(
            transition["v317_rescue"].sum()
            - rescues
        )

        candidates.append(
            {
                "guard": name,
                "allowed_transitions":
                    transitions,
                "rescues":
                    rescues,
                "harms":
                    harms,
                "net":
                    rescues - harms,
                "blocked_harms":
                    blocked_harms,
                "lost_rescues":
                    lost_rescues,
                "rescue_harm_ratio":
                    safe_ratio(
                        rescues,
                        harms
                    ),
            }
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Probability thresholds
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    for threshold in [
        0.10,
        0.20,
        0.30,
        0.40,
        0.50,
        0.60,
        0.70,
        0.80,
        0.90,
    ]:

        evaluate(
            f"rescue_probability_max >= {threshold:.2f}",
            transition["rescue_probability_max"]
            >= threshold
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # EfficientNet confidence ceiling
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    for threshold in [
        0.40,
        0.50,
        0.60,
        0.70,
        0.80,
        0.90,
    ]:

        evaluate(
            f"efficientnet_confidence <= {threshold:.2f}",
            transition["efficientnet_confidence"]
            <= threshold
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Specialist advantage
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    for threshold in [
        -0.50,
        -0.25,
        -0.10,
        0.00,
        0.05,
        0.10,
        0.20,
        0.30,
    ]:

        evaluate(
            f"selected_specialist_advantage >= {threshold:.2f}",
            transition["selected_specialist_advantage"]
            >= threshold
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Specialist confidence
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    for threshold in [
        0.40,
        0.50,
        0.60,
        0.70,
        0.80,
        0.90,
    ]:

        evaluate(
            f"selected_specialist_confidence >= {threshold:.2f}",
            transition["selected_specialist_confidence"]
            >= threshold
        )

    table = pd.DataFrame(
        candidates
    )

    table = table.sort_values(
        [
            "net",
            "blocked_harms",
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            False,
        ],
    )

    print(
        table.to_string(index=False)
    )

    output = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_candidate_guards.csv"
    )

    table.to_csv(
        output,
        index=False
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output}"
    )

# HARM CASE EXPORT

def export_harm_cases(df):

    section(
        "EXPORTING V3.17 HARM CASES"
    )

    harm = df[
        df["v317_harm"] == 1
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Harm cases: {len(harm)}"
    )

    if len(harm) == 0:
        return

    # Keep important columns first.

    first = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "selected_model",
        "policy_type",
        "policy",
        "threshold",
        "score",
        "switch",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
        "v317_base_correct",
        "v317_selected_correct",
        "v317_transition",
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral_transition",
        "rescue_probability_max",
        "rescue_probability_margin",
        "efficientnet_confidence",
        "alternative_confidence",
        "alternative_confidence_margin",
        "selected_specialist_confidence",
        "selected_specialist_advantage",
        "selected_specialist_strength",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",
        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",
        "resnet_switch_advantage",
        "mobile_switch_advantage",
        "resnet_gate",
        "mobile_gate",
    ]

    first = [
        c for c in first
        if c in harm.columns
    ]

    rest = [
        c for c in harm.columns
        if c not in first
    ]

    harm = harm[
        first + rest
    ]

    output = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_harm_cases.csv"
    )

    harm.to_csv(
        output,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {output}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# HARM VS RESCUE TABLE
# ============================================================================

def export_harm_vs_rescue(df):

    section(
        "HARM VS RESCUE SUMMARY"
    )

    rows = []

    for name, mask in [
        (
            "ALL_TRANSITIONS",
            df["v317_transition"] == 1
        ),
        (
            "RESCUE",
            df["v317_rescue"] == 1
        ),
        (
            "HARM",
            df["v317_harm"] == 1
        ),
        (
            "NEUTRAL",
            df["v317_neutral_transition"] == 1
        ),
    ]:

        subset = df[mask]

        if len(subset) == 0:
            continue

        rows.append(
            {
                "group":
                    name,

                "n":
                    len(subset),

                "rescue_probability_mean":
                    subset[
                        "rescue_probability_max"
                    ].mean(),

                "rescue_probability_median":
                    subset[
                        "rescue_probability_max"
                    ].median(),

                "efficientnet_confidence_mean":
                    subset[
                        "efficientnet_confidence"
                    ].mean(),

                "alternative_confidence_mean":
                    subset[
                        "alternative_confidence"
                    ].mean(),

                "specialist_confidence_mean":
                    subset[
                        "selected_specialist_confidence"
                    ].mean(),

                "specialist_advantage_mean":
                    subset[
                        "selected_specialist_advantage"
                    ].mean(),

                "specialist_strength_mean":
                    subset[
                        "selected_specialist_strength"
                    ].mean(),
            }
        )

    table = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    print(
        table.to_string(index=False)
    )

    output = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_harm_vs_rescue.csv"
    )

    table.to_csv(
        output,
        index=False
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# FOLD PROFILE
# ============================================================================

def fold_profile(df):

    section(
        "V3.17 OUTER-FOLD HARM PROFILE"
    )

    table = (
        df[
            df["v317_transition"] == 1
        ]
        .groupby("outer_fold")
        .agg(
            transitions=("v317_transition", "size"),
            rescues=("v317_rescue", "sum"),
            harms=("v317_harm", "sum"),
            neutral=("v317_neutral_transition", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    table["net"] = (
        table["rescues"]
        - table["harms"]
    )

    table["harm_rate"] = (
        table["harms"]
        / table["transitions"]
    )

    table["rescue_rate"] = (
        table["rescues"]
        / table["transitions"]
    )

    print(
        table.to_string(index=False)
    )

    output = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_fold_profile.csv"
    )

    table.to_csv(
        output,
        index=False
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# MODEL TRANSITION PROFILE
# ============================================================================

def transition_profile(df):

    section(
        "V3.17 MODEL TRANSITION PROFILE"
    )

    table = (
        df[
            df["v317_transition"] == 1
        ]
        .groupby("selected_model")
        .agg(
            transitions=("v317_transition", "size"),
            rescues=("v317_rescue", "sum"),
            harms=("v317_harm", "sum"),
            neutral=("v317_neutral_transition", "sum"),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    table["net"] = (
        table["rescues"]
        - table["harms"]
    )

    table["rescue_rate"] = (
        table["rescues"]
        / table["transitions"]
    )

    table["harm_rate"] = (
        table["harms"]
        / table["transitions"]
    )

    table["rescue_harm_ratio"] = (
        table.apply(
            lambda r:
                safe_ratio(
                    r["rescues"],
                    r["harms"]
                ),
            axis=1,
        )
    )

    print(
        table.to_string(index=False)
    )

    output = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_transition_profile.csv"
    )

    table.to_csv(
        output,
        index=False
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved: {output}"
    )

# ============================================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.17 HARM FINGERPRINT ANALYSIS -- ROBUST FIXED VERSION"
    )

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True
    )

    (
        predictions,
        features,
        targets,
        oof,
        outer,
    ) = load_data()

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.17 prediction artifact is authoritative.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_predictions(
        predictions
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Attach V3.15 information positionally.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    df = attach_positional_artifacts(
        predictions,
        features,
        targets,
        oof,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Reconstruct V3.17 outcomes directly from V3.17 flags.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    df = reconstruct_v317_outcomes(
        df
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Cross-check flags.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    cross_check_flags(
        df
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build diagnostic features.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    df = build_scores(
        df
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Analyses.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    basic_profile(
        df
    )

    feature_comparison(
        df
    )

    specialist_profile(
        df
    )

    score_bins(
        df
    )

    candidate_guards(
        df
    )

    fold_profile(
        df
    )

    transition_profile(
        df
    )

    export_harm_vs_rescue(
        df
    )

    export_harm_cases(
        df
    )

    validate_against_outer(
        df,
        outer
    )

    save_forensic_dataframe(
        df
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final summary.
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "FINAL V3.17 FINGERPRINT"
    )

    transitions = int(
        df["v317_transition"].sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        df["v317_rescue"].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        df["v317_harm"].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        df["v317_neutral_transition"].sum()
    )

    print(
        f"Total samples : {len(df)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions   : {transitions}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues       : {rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms         : {harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral       : {neutral}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net gain      : {rescues - harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm   : "
        f"{safe_ratio(rescues, harms):.4f}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "OUTPUT DIRECTORY:"
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )

    print()
    print(
        "✓ V3.17 harm fingerprint analysis completed."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
===============================================================================
V3.22 HARM-AWARE SELECTIVE RESCUE
===============================================================================

Purpose
-------
Extend the V3.17 selective-rescue framework with harm-aware guards.

Important experimental constraints
----------------------------------
1. No model training.
2. V3.15 rescue probabilities are treated as frozen signals.
3. V3.15 artifacts are loaded from:
       outputs/pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker/
4. Policy / threshold / guard selection happens only inside development folds.
5. Outer test folds remain completely untouched until final evaluation.
6. EfficientNet remains the baseline.
7. A transition is accepted only when the selected specialist passes the
   harm-aware rescue policy.
8. All candidate policies are evaluated using only development data.
9. V3.22 outputs are written to a separate V3.22 directory.

V3.22 idea
-----------
V3.17 demonstrated:

    EfficientNet baseline : ~74.43%
    V3.17 nested          : ~79.87%

The harm fingerprint showed that rescue probability alone is insufficient.

Important observations from V3.17 harm analysis:

    - low E/F score -> substantially higher harm rate
    - high EfficientNet confidence -> higher harm rate
    - high specialist probability is not always trustworthy
    - specialist strength is useful for suppressing weak transitions
    - probability + strength guards can improve rescue/harm ratio

V3.22 therefore searches nested combinations of:

    policy
    threshold
    probability floor
    specialist-strength floor
    EfficientNet-confidence ceiling

The final model is still a selective rescue mechanism, not a newly trained
classifier.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import warnings
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

SCRIPT_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve()

PROJECT_ROOT = SCRIPT_PATH.parents[2]

OUTPUT_ROOT = (
    PROJECT_ROOT
    / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"
    / "outputs"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FIXED V3.15 ARTIFACT DIRECTORY
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# THIS WAS THE PATH ERROR IN THE PREVIOUS VERSION.
#
# Actual files:
#
# pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker/
#     v3_15_feature_matrix.csv
#     v3_15_target_matrix.csv
#     v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv
#
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

V315_ROOT = (
    OUTPUT_ROOT
    / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"
)

FEATURE_PATH = (
    V315_ROOT
    / "v3_15_feature_matrix.csv"
)

TARGET_PATH = (
    V315_ROOT
    / "v3_15_target_matrix.csv"
)

OOF_PATH = (
    V315_ROOT
    / "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv"
)

# V3.22 outputs remain separate.
V322_OUTPUT_DIR = (
    OUTPUT_ROOT
    / "pairwise_v3_22_harm_aware"
)


# =============================================================================
# CONSTANTS
# =============================================================================

RANDOM_SEED = 42

# The original outer-fold structure is already encoded in the V3.15 OOF file.
N_OUTER_FOLDS = 5

# Small threshold grid.
POLICY_THRESHOLDS = np.round(
    np.arange(
        0.40,
        1.01,
        0.01,
    ),
    2,
)

# Harm-aware guard candidates.
#
# These are deliberately based on the fingerprint analysis rather than
# arbitrary extreme values.
PROBABILITY_MIN_VALUES = [
    0.00,
    0.50,
    0.55,
    0.60,
    0.65,
    0.70,
    0.75,
    0.80,
]

STRENGTH_MIN_VALUES = [
    0.00,
    0.50,
    0.60,
    0.70,
    0.80,
    0.90,
]

# EfficientNet confidence was strongly associated with harms.
#
# 1.01 effectively means "no confidence ceiling".
EFFICIENTNET_CONFIDENCE_MAX_VALUES = [
    1.01,
    0.95,
    0.90,
    0.85,
    0.80,
]

# Minimum number of development transitions required before accepting a
# candidate. This prevents pathological policies that obtain a high ratio
# from only a handful of transitions.
MIN_DEV_TRANSITIONS = 10


# =============================================================================
# DISPLAY HELPERS
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


# =============================================================================
# ARTIFACT LOADING
# =============================================================================

def load_artifacts() -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("LOADING V3.22 ARTIFACTS")

    print("V3.15 artifact directory:")
    print(V315_ROOT)

    required_paths = [
        FEATURE_PATH,
        TARGET_PATH,
        OOF_PATH,
    ]

    for path in required_paths:

        print()

        print("Checking:")
        print(path)

        if not path.exists():

            raise FileNotFoundError(
                "\nV3.22 could not find the required V3.15 artifact:\n"
                f"{path}\n\n"
                "Expected V3.15 directory:\n"
                f"{V315_ROOT}\n"
            )

        print("✓ Found")

    features = pd.read_csv(
        FEATURE_PATH
    )

    targets = pd.read_csv(
        TARGET_PATH
    )

    oof = pd.read_csv(
        OOF_PATH
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Features          : {features.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"Targets           : {targets.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"OOF               : {oof.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Basic row-count validation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if not (
        len(features)
        == len(targets)
        == len(oof)
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.15 artifacts have different row counts."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge carefully.
    #
    # V3.15 feature matrix and target matrix are aligned by row position.
    # The OOF dataframe contains row_index, which is also validated below.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = pd.concat(
        [
            features.reset_index(drop=True),
            targets.reset_index(drop=True),
            oof.reset_index(drop=True),
        ],
        axis=1,
    )

    # Remove accidental duplicate columns if any.
    if df.columns.duplicated().any():

        duplicated = (
            df.columns[
                df.columns.duplicated()
            ]
            .tolist()
        )

        raise ValueError(
            "Duplicate columns detected after V3.15 merge:\n"
            f"{duplicated}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        f"Combined dataframe : {df.shape}"
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# DATA VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_data(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("VALIDATING V3.22 DATA")

    required = [
        "outer_fold",
        "row_index",

        "efficientnet_confidence",
        "resnet_confidence",
        "mobilenet_confidence",

        "resnet_gate",
        "mobile_gate",

        "resnet_relative_strength",
        "mobile_relative_strength",

        "resnet_switch_advantage",
        "mobile_switch_advantage",

        "resnet_rescue_probability",
        "mobile_rescue_probability",

        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
    ]

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        raise ValueError(
            "Missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing)
        )

    print("✓ Required columns present")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Shape checks
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    n = len(df)

    for column in required:

        if len(df[column]) != n:

            raise ValueError(
                f"Shape mismatch in {column}"
            )

    print(
        f"✓ All columns have {n} rows"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fold validation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    folds = sorted(
        df["outer_fold"]
        .dropna()
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    print(
        f"Outer folds : {folds}"
    )

    if len(folds) != N_OUTER_FOLDS:

        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected {N_OUTER_FOLDS} outer folds, "
            f"found {len(folds)}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Binary target validation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    binary_columns = [
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
    ]

    for column in binary_columns:

        values = set(
            df[column]
            .dropna()
            .astype(int)
            .unique()
            .tolist()
        )

        if not values.issubset({0, 1}):

            raise ValueError(
                f"{column} is not binary: {values}"
            )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # row_index sanity
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if df["row_index"].duplicated().any():

        raise ValueError(
            "Duplicate row_index values detected."
        )

    print("✓ Binary outcomes valid")
    print("✓ row_index valid")


# =============================================================================
# POLICY SCORE CONSTRUCTION
# =============================================================================

def build_policy_scores(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING V3.22 POLICY SCORES")

    scores = pd.DataFrame(
        index=df.index
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # E POLICY
    #
    # V3.17:
    #
    # E = rescue probability × relative strength
    #
    # This rewards a rescue candidate when both its predicted rescue
    # probability and specialist strength are high.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["resnet_E"] = (
        df["resnet_rescue_probability"]
        * df["resnet_relative_strength"]
    )

    scores["mobile_E"] = (
        df["mobile_rescue_probability"]
        * df["mobile_relative_strength"]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # F POLICY
    #
    # F = rescue probability + switch advantage
    #
    # switch advantage is generally negative when switching is not attractive.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["resnet_F"] = (
        df["resnet_rescue_probability"]
        + df["resnet_switch_advantage"]
    )

    scores["mobile_F"] = (
        df["mobile_rescue_probability"]
        + df["mobile_switch_advantage"]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Best specialist under each policy
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["E_selected_model"] = np.where(
        scores["resnet_E"]
        >= scores["mobile_E"],
        "resnet50",
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
    )

    scores["F_selected_model"] = np.where(
        scores["resnet_F"]
        >= scores["mobile_F"],
        "resnet50",
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
    )

    scores["E_score"] = np.maximum(
        scores["resnet_E"],
        scores["mobile_E"],
    )

    scores["F_score"] = np.maximum(
        scores["resnet_F"],
        scores["mobile_F"],
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Specialist-specific quantities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores["E_probability"] = np.where(
        scores["E_selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_rescue_probability"],
        df["mobile_rescue_probability"],
    )

    scores["E_strength"] = np.where(
        scores["E_selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_relative_strength"],
        df["mobile_relative_strength"],
    )

    scores["E_advantage"] = np.where(
        scores["E_selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_switch_advantage"],
        df["mobile_switch_advantage"],
    )

    scores["F_probability"] = np.where(
        scores["F_selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_rescue_probability"],
        df["mobile_rescue_probability"],
    )

    scores["F_strength"] = np.where(
        scores["F_selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_relative_strength"],
        df["mobile_relative_strength"],
    )

    scores["F_advantage"] = np.where(
        scores["F_selected_model"] == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_switch_advantage"],
        df["mobile_switch_advantage"],
    )

    print(
        "✓ E policy constructed"
    )

    print(
        "✓ F policy constructed"
    )

    return scores


# =============================================================================
# OUTCOME LOOKUP
# =============================================================================

def specialist_outcomes(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    selected_model: np.ndarray,
) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Return rescue/harm outcome for the selected specialist.
    """

    selected_model = np.asarray(
        selected_model
    )

    rescue = np.where(
        selected_model == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_rescue"].to_numpy(),
        df["mobile_rescue"].to_numpy(),
    )

    harm = np.where(
        selected_model == "resnet50",
        df["resnet_harm"].to_numpy(),
        df["mobile_harm"].to_numpy(),
    )

    return (
        rescue.astype(int),
        harm.astype(int),
    )


# =============================================================================
# CANDIDATE EVALUATION
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_candidate(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
    policy: str,
    threshold: float,
    probability_min: float,
    strength_min: float,
    efficientnet_confidence_max: float,
) -> Dict:

    if policy == "E_probability_x_relative_strength":

        score = scores["E_score"].to_numpy()

        selected_model = (
            scores["E_selected_model"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

        probability = (
            scores["E_probability"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

        strength = (
            scores["E_strength"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

    elif policy == "F_probability_plus_advantage":

        score = scores["F_score"].to_numpy()

        selected_model = (
            scores["F_selected_model"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

        probability = (
            scores["F_probability"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

        strength = (
            scores["F_strength"]
            .to_numpy()
        )

    else:

        raise ValueError(
            f"Unknown policy: {policy}"
        )

    efficientnet_confidence = (
        df["efficientnet_confidence"]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Core policy threshold
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    policy_pass = (
        score >= threshold
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Harm-aware guards
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    probability_guard = (
        probability >= probability_min
    )

    strength_guard = (
        strength >= strength_min
    )

    confidence_guard = (
        efficientnet_confidence
        <= efficientnet_confidence_max
    )

    transition = (
        policy_pass
        & probability_guard
        & strength_guard
        & confidence_guard
    )

    rescue, harm = specialist_outcomes(
        df,
        selected_model,
    )

    # Only count outcomes where an actual transition occurs.
    applied_rescue = (
        rescue
        & transition
    )

    applied_harm = (
        harm
        & transition
    )

    transitions = int(
        transition.sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        applied_rescue.sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        applied_harm.sum()
    )

    base_correct = (
        1
        - df["efficientnet_error"].to_numpy()
    )

    final_correct = (
        base_correct.copy()
    )

    final_correct[
        transition & (rescue == 1)
    ] = 1

    final_correct[
        transition & (harm == 1)
    ] = 0

    base_accuracy = float(
        base_correct.mean()
    )

    accuracy = float(
        final_correct.mean()
    )

    gain = (
        accuracy
        - base_accuracy
    )

    rescue_precision = (
        rescues / transitions
        if transitions > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    recoverable = int(
        (
            df["resnet_rescue"].to_numpy()
            | df["mobile_rescue"].to_numpy()
        ).sum()
    )

    # For the currently selected specialist, recoverable rescue count is
    # simply the number of positive rescue outcomes among eligible transitions.
    recoverable_recall = (
        rescues / recoverable
        if recoverable > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    rescue_harm_ratio = (
        rescues / harms
        if harms > 0
        else math.inf
    )

    net_gain = (
        rescues
        - harms
    )

    switch_rate = (
        transitions / len(df)
        if len(df) > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    harm_rate = (
        harms / transitions
        if transitions > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    return {
        "policy": policy,
        "threshold": float(threshold),
        "probability_min": float(probability_min),
        "strength_min": float(strength_min),
        "efficientnet_confidence_max": float(
            efficientnet_confidence_max
        ),

        "base_accuracy": base_accuracy,
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "gain": gain,

        "transitions": transitions,
        "rescues": rescues,
        "harms": harms,

        "net_gain": net_gain,

        "rescue_harm_ratio": rescue_harm_ratio,
        "rescue_precision": rescue_precision,
        "recoverable_recall": recoverable_recall,

        "switch_rate": switch_rate,
        "harm_rate": harm_rate,
    }


# =============================================================================
# DEVELOPMENT SEARCH
# =============================================================================

def search_development_policy(
    df_dev: pd.DataFrame,
    scores_dev: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Tuple[Dict, pd.DataFrame]:

    candidates: List[Dict] = []

    policies = [
        "E_probability_x_relative_strength",
        "F_probability_plus_advantage",
    ]

    for policy in policies:

        for threshold in POLICY_THRESHOLDS:

            for probability_min in PROBABILITY_MIN_VALUES:

                for strength_min in STRENGTH_MIN_VALUES:

                    for confidence_max in (
                        EFFICIENTNET_CONFIDENCE_MAX_VALUES
                    ):

                        result = evaluate_candidate(
                            df_dev,
                            scores_dev,
                            policy,
                            threshold,
                            probability_min,
                            strength_min,
                            confidence_max,
                        )

                        # -----------------------------------------------------
                        # Minimum transition guard
                        # -----------------------------------------------------

                        if (
                            result["transitions"]
                            < MIN_DEV_TRANSITIONS
                        ):
                            continue

                        candidates.append(
                            result
                        )

    if not candidates:

        raise RuntimeError(
            "No valid V3.22 development candidates."
        )

    candidate_df = pd.DataFrame(
        candidates
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Selection objective
    #
    # Primary:
    #     maximize development accuracy
    #
    # Secondary:
    #     maximize net gain
    #
    # Third:
    #     maximize rescue/harm ratio
    #
    # Fourth:
    #     fewer transitions
    #
    # This favors genuine accuracy rather than merely maximizing rescue rate.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    candidate_df = candidate_df.sort_values(
        by=[
            "accuracy",
            "net_gain",
            "rescue_harm_ratio",
            "transitions",
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            False,
            False,
            True,
        ],
        kind="mergesort",
    ).reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    best = (
        candidate_df.iloc[0]
        .to_dict()
    )

    return (
        best,
        candidate_df,
    )


# =============================================================================
# NESTED OUTER EVALUATION
# =============================================================================

def run_nested_evaluation(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    scores: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("V3.22 NESTED OUTER EVALUATION")

    outer_results = []

    selection_records = []

    prediction_records = []

    folds = sorted(
        df["outer_fold"]
        .unique()
        .tolist()
    )

    for outer_fold in folds:

        subsection(
            f"OUTER FOLD {outer_fold}"
        )

        outer_mask = (
            df["outer_fold"]
            == outer_fold
        )

        development_mask = ~outer_mask

        df_dev = (
            df.loc[
                development_mask
            ]
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )

        df_test = (
            df.loc[
                outer_mask
            ]
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )

        scores_dev = (
            scores.loc[
                development_mask
            ]
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )

        scores_test = (
            scores.loc[
                outer_mask
            ]
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # SELECT V3.22 policy ONLY on development folds
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        best, candidate_df = (
            search_development_policy(
                df_dev,
                scores_dev,
            )
        )

        print(
            f"Selected policy       : "
            f"{best['policy']}"
        )

        print(
            f"Selected threshold    : "
            f"{best['threshold']:.2f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Probability minimum   : "
            f"{best['probability_min']:.2f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Strength minimum      : "
            f"{best['strength_min']:.2f}"
        )

        print(
            f"EffNet confidence max : "
            f"{best['efficientnet_confidence_max']:.2f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Development accuracy  : "
            f"{best['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Development transitions: "
            f"{best['transitions']}"
        )

        print(
            f"Development rescues   : "
            f"{best['rescues']}"
        )

        print(
            f"Development harms     : "
            f"{best['harms']}"
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Record selection
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        selection_records.append(
            {
                "outer_fold": outer_fold,
                "selection_type": "primary",
                **best,
            }
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Apply frozen selected policy to OUTER TEST
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        test_result = evaluate_candidate(
            df_test,
            scores_test,
            best["policy"],
            best["threshold"],
            best["probability_min"],
            best["strength_min"],
            best["efficientnet_confidence_max"],
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Outer-fold result
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        outer_record = {
            "outer_fold": outer_fold,

            "primary_policy": (
                best["policy"]
            ),

            "primary_threshold": (
                best["threshold"]
            ),

            "primary_probability_min": (
                best["probability_min"]
            ),

            "primary_strength_min": (
                best["strength_min"]
            ),

            "primary_efficientnet_confidence_max": (
                best["efficientnet_confidence_max"]
            ),

            "primary_test_base_accuracy": (
                test_result["base_accuracy"]
            ),

            "primary_test_accuracy": (
                test_result["accuracy"]
            ),

            "primary_test_gain": (
                test_result["gain"]
            ),

            "primary_test_transitions": (
                test_result["transitions"]
            ),

            "primary_test_rescues": (
                test_result["rescues"]
            ),

            "primary_test_harms": (
                test_result["harms"]
            ),

            "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio": (
                test_result["rescue_harm_ratio"]
            ),

            "primary_test_rescue_precision": (
                test_result["rescue_precision"]
            ),

            "primary_test_recoverable_recall": (
                test_result["recoverable_recall"]
            ),

            "primary_test_switch_rate": (
                test_result["switch_rate"]
            ),

            "primary_test_harm_rate": (
                test_result["harm_rate"]
            ),
        }

        outer_results.append(
            outer_record
        )

        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Per-sample prediction records
        # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

        if (
            best["policy"]
            == "E_probability_x_relative_strength"
        ):

            selected_models = (
                scores_test[
                    "E_selected_model"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

            policy_scores = (
                scores_test[
                    "E_score"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

            probabilities = (
                scores_test[
                    "E_probability"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

            strengths = (
                scores_test[
                    "E_strength"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

        else:

            selected_models = (
                scores_test[
                    "F_selected_model"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

            policy_scores = (
                scores_test[
                    "F_score"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

            probabilities = (
                scores_test[
                    "F_probability"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

            strengths = (
                scores_test[
                    "F_strength"
                ]
                .to_numpy()
            )

        policy_pass = (
            policy_scores
            >= best["threshold"]
        )

        probability_pass = (
            probabilities
            >= best["probability_min"]
        )

        strength_pass = (
            strengths
            >= best["strength_min"]
        )

        confidence_pass = (
            df_test[
                "efficientnet_confidence"
            ].to_numpy()
            <= best[
                "efficientnet_confidence_max"
            ]
        )

        transition = (
            policy_pass
            & probability_pass
            & strength_pass
            & confidence_pass
        )

        rescue, harm = specialist_outcomes(
            df_test,
            selected_models,
        )

        for i in range(
            len(df_test)
        ):

            prediction_records.append(
                {
                    "outer_fold": outer_fold,

                    "row_index": int(
                        df_test.iloc[i][
                            "row_index"
                        ]
                    ),

                    "policy": best[
                        "policy"
                    ],

                    "threshold": best[
                        "threshold"
                    ],

                    "probability_min": best[
                        "probability_min"
                    ],

                    "strength_min": best[
                        "strength_min"
                    ],

                    "efficientnet_confidence_max": best[
                        "efficientnet_confidence_max"
                    ],

                    "selected_model": (
                        selected_models[i]
                    ),

                    "policy_score": (
                        policy_scores[i]
                    ),

                    "specialist_probability": (
                        probabilities[i]
                    ),

                    "specialist_strength": (
                        strengths[i]
                    ),

                    "efficientnet_confidence": (
                        df_test.iloc[i][
                            "efficientnet_confidence"
                        ]
                    ),

                    "policy_pass": int(
                        policy_pass[i]
                    ),

                    "probability_pass": int(
                        probability_pass[i]
                    ),

                    "strength_pass": int(
                        strength_pass[i]
                    ),

                    "confidence_pass": int(
                        confidence_pass[i]
                    ),

                    "transition": int(
                        transition[i]
                    ),

                    "rescue": int(
                        rescue[i]
                        if transition[i]
                        else 0
                    ),

                    "harm": int(
                        harm[i]
                        if transition[i]
                        else 0
                    ),

                    "efficientnet_error": int(
                        df_test.iloc[i][
                            "efficientnet_error"
                        ]
                    ),
                }
            )

        print()
        print(
            f"Outer-test base accuracy : "
            f"{test_result['base_accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Outer-test V3.22 accuracy: "
            f"{test_result['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Outer-test gain          : "
            f"{test_result['gain']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Transitions              : "
            f"{test_result['transitions']}"
        )

        print(
            f"Rescues                  : "
            f"{test_result['rescues']}"
        )

        print(
            f"Harms                    : "
            f"{test_result['harms']}"
        )

    return (
        pd.DataFrame(outer_results),
        pd.DataFrame(selection_records),
        pd.DataFrame(prediction_records),
    )


# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def build_summary(
    outer_results: pd.DataFrame,
    policy_selection: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("V3.22 SUMMARY")

    summary_records = []

    numeric_columns = [
        "primary_test_base_accuracy",
        "primary_test_accuracy",
        "primary_test_gain",
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio",
        "primary_test_rescue_precision",
        "primary_test_recoverable_recall",
        "primary_test_switch_rate",
        "primary_test_harm_rate",
    ]

    record = {
        "metric": "MEAN_OUTER_TEST"
    }

    for column in numeric_columns:

        record[column] = float(
            outer_results[
                column
            ].mean()
        )

    summary_records.append(
        record
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Aggregate counts
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    aggregate = {
        "metric": "TOTAL_OUTER_TEST"
    }

    aggregate[
        "primary_test_transitions"
    ] = int(
        outer_results[
            "primary_test_transitions"
        ].sum()
    )

    aggregate[
        "primary_test_rescues"
    ] = int(
        outer_results[
            "primary_test_rescues"
        ].sum()
    )

    aggregate[
        "primary_test_harms"
    ] = int(
        outer_results[
            "primary_test_harms"
        ].sum()
    )

    transitions = (
        aggregate[
            "primary_test_transitions"
        ]
    )

    rescues = (
        aggregate[
            "primary_test_rescues"
        ]
    )

    harms = (
        aggregate[
            "primary_test_harms"
        ]
    )

    aggregate[
        "aggregate_rescue_harm_ratio"
    ] = (
        rescues / harms
        if harms > 0
        else math.inf
    )

    aggregate[
        "aggregate_net_gain"
    ] = (
        rescues - harms
    )

    aggregate[
        "aggregate_harm_rate"
    ] = (
        harms / transitions
        if transitions > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    summary_records.append(
        aggregate
    )

    return pd.DataFrame(
        summary_records
    )


# =============================================================================
# FINAL REPORT
# =============================================================================

def print_final_report(
    outer_results: pd.DataFrame,
    summary: pd.DataFrame,
    policy_selection: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("V3.22 FINAL NESTED RESULTS")

    subsection("OUTER-FOLD RESULTS")

    display_columns = [
        "outer_fold",
        "primary_policy",
        "primary_threshold",
        "primary_probability_min",
        "primary_strength_min",
        "primary_efficientnet_confidence_max",
        "primary_test_base_accuracy",
        "primary_test_accuracy",
        "primary_test_gain",
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio",
        "primary_test_rescue_precision",
        "primary_test_recoverable_recall",
        "primary_test_switch_rate",
    ]

    print(
        outer_results[
            display_columns
        ].to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    subsection("MEAN OUTER-TEST PERFORMANCE")

    row = summary[
        summary["metric"]
        == "MEAN_OUTER_TEST"
    ].iloc[0]

    metrics = [
        "primary_test_base_accuracy",
        "primary_test_accuracy",
        "primary_test_gain",
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_rescue_harm_ratio",
        "primary_test_rescue_precision",
        "primary_test_recoverable_recall",
        "primary_test_switch_rate",
        "primary_test_harm_rate",
    ]

    for metric in metrics:

        print(
            f"{metric:40s}: "
            f"{float(row[metric]):.6f}"
        )

    subsection("TOTAL OUTER-TEST TRANSITIONS")

    total = summary[
        summary["metric"]
        == "TOTAL_OUTER_TEST"
    ].iloc[0]

    print(
        f"Transitions: "
        f"{int(total['primary_test_transitions'])}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues: "
        f"{int(total['primary_test_rescues'])}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms: "
        f"{int(total['primary_test_harms'])}"
    )

    print(
        f"Aggregate rescue/harm: "
        f"{float(total['aggregate_rescue_harm_ratio']):.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Aggregate net gain: "
        f"{int(total['aggregate_net_gain'])}"
    )

    subsection("POLICY SELECTION FREQUENCY")

    primary_selection = (
        policy_selection[
            policy_selection[
                "selection_type"
            ]
            == "primary"
        ]
    )

    print(
        primary_selection[
            "policy"
        ].value_counts()
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Selected V3.22 guards:"
    )

    print(
        primary_selection[
            [
                "outer_fold",
                "policy",
                "threshold",
                "probability_min",
                "strength_min",
                "efficientnet_confidence_max",
            ]
        ].to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Key comparison
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection("KEY COMPARISON")

    baseline_accuracy = float(
        outer_results[
            "primary_test_base_accuracy"
        ].mean()
    )

    v322_accuracy = float(
        outer_results[
            "primary_test_accuracy"
        ].mean()
    )

    gain = (
        v322_accuracy
        - baseline_accuracy
    )

    print(
        f"EfficientNet baseline "
        f"(outer folds) : "
        f"{baseline_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.22 nested accuracy        : "
        f"{v322_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.22 nested gain            : "
        f"{gain:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.22 accuracy percentage    : "
        f"{v322_accuracy * 100:.4f}%"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.22 gain percentage points : "
        f"{gain * 100:.4f}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fold sign
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection("FOLD-LEVEL SIGN")

    positive = int(
        (
            outer_results[
                "primary_test_gain"
            ]
            > 0
        ).sum()
    )

    negative = int(
        (
            outer_results[
                "primary_test_gain"
            ]
            < 0
        ).sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        (
            outer_results[
                "primary_test_gain"
            ]
            == 0
        ).sum()
    )

    print(
        f"Folds with positive gain: "
        f"{positive} / {len(outer_results)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Folds with negative gain: "
        f"{negative} / {len(outer_results)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Folds with zero gain    : "
        f"{neutral} / {len(outer_results)}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compare against V3.17
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    subsection("V3.17 → V3.22 COMPARISON")

    v317_accuracy = 0.798736

    improvement = (
        v322_accuracy
        - v317_accuracy
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 nested accuracy : "
        f"{v317_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.22 nested accuracy : "
        f"{v322_accuracy:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.22 - V3.17         : "
        f"{improvement:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.22 - V3.17 (pp)    : "
        f"{improvement * 100:.4f}"
    )

    if v322_accuracy > v317_accuracy:

        print()
        print(
            "✓ V3.22 IMPROVES OVER V3.17"
        )

    elif v322_accuracy == v317_accuracy:

        print()
        print(
            "⚠ V3.22 MATCHES V3.17"
        )

    else:

        print()
        print(
            "✗ V3.22 REGRESSES FROM V3.17"
        )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main() -> None:

    section(
        "V3.22 HARM-AWARE SELECTIVE RESCUE"
    )

    print(
        "No model training will be performed."
    )

    print(
        "V3.15 rescue probabilities are "
        "treated as fixed signals."
    )

    print(
        "V3.22 introduces harm-aware "
        "selection guards."
    )

    print(
        "Policy, threshold, and guard "
        "selection occur only inside "
        "development folds."
    )

    print(
        "Outer folds remain completely "
        "untouched until evaluation."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Frozen V3.15 source:"
    )

    print(
        V315_ROOT
    )

    print()
    print(
        "V3.22 output directory:"
    )

    print(
        V322_OUTPUT_DIR
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Output directory
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    V322_OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = load_artifacts()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_data(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build fixed policy scores
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    scores = build_policy_scores(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Nested evaluation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        outer_results,
        policy_selection,
        predictions,
    ) = run_nested_evaluation(
        df,
        scores,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary = build_summary(
        outer_results,
        policy_selection,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "SAVING V3.22 OUTPUTS"
    )

    outer_path = (
        V322_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_22_outer_fold_results.csv"
    )

    selection_path = (
        V322_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_22_policy_selection.csv"
    )

    prediction_path = (
        V322_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_22_test_predictions.csv"
    )

    summary_path = (
        V322_OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_22_policy_summary.csv"
    )

    outer_results.to_csv(
        outer_path,
        index=False,
    )

    policy_selection.to_csv(
        selection_path,
        index=False,
    )

    predictions.to_csv(
        prediction_path,
        index=False,
    )

    summary.to_csv(
        summary_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Outer fold results : "
        f"{outer_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy selection   : "
        f"{selection_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Test predictions   : "
        f"{prediction_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Policy summary     : "
        f"{summary_path}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final report
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print_final_report(
        outer_results,
        summary,
        policy_selection,
    )

    section(
        "V3.22 COMPLETE"
    )


# =============================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# =============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":

    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
audit_v3_17_accuracy_discrepancy.py

Purpose
-------
Investigate the discrepancy between:

Historical V3.17 result:
    ~120 rescues
    ~51 harms

Current forensic reconstruction:
    88 rescues
    51 harms
    32 neutral

The script DOES NOT modify any artifact.

Authoritative artifact:
    v3_17_test_predictions.csv

V3.15 artifacts are attached POSITIONALLY because:
    - V3.17 row_index = original sample ID
    - V3.15 OOF row_index = positional index
    - V3.15 feature/target matrices have no row_index

Therefore we intentionally do NOT merge these artifacts by row_index.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys
import warnings

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

BASE = Path(
    "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs"
)

V317_PRED_PATH = (
    BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
    / "v3_17_test_predictions.csv"
)

V315_FEATURE_PATH = (
    BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"
    / "v3_15_feature_matrix.csv"
)

V315_TARGET_PATH = (
    BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"
    / "v3_15_target_matrix.csv"
)

V315_OOF_PATH = (
    BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_15_rescue_ranker"
    / "v3_15_selector_oof_predictions.csv"
)

V317_OUTER_PATH = (
    BASE
    / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
    / "v3_17_outer_results.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    BASE
    / "v3_17_accuracy_discrepancy_audit"
)


# =============================================================================
# UTILITIES
# =============================================================================

def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title):
    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


def fail(message):
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def load_csv(path, name):
    if not path.exists():
        fail(
            f"{name} not found:\n"
            f"{path}"
        )

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    print(
        f"{name:<25}: "
        f"{df.shape}"
    )

    return df


def print_columns(df, name):
    print()
    print(f"{name} columns:")
    for i, c in enumerate(df.columns):
        print(f"  {i:3d}  {c}")


def check_unique(series, name):
    duplicated = series.duplicated(keep=False)

    if duplicated.any():
        print(
            f"WARNING: {name} contains "
            f"{duplicated.sum()} duplicated rows."
        )

        print(
            series[duplicated]
            .value_counts()
            .head(20)
        )

        return False

    return True


def safe_int(x):
    try:
        return int(x)
    except Exception:
        return None

def load_artifacts():

    section("LOADING V3.17 / V3.15 ARTIFACTS")

    pred = load_csv(
        V317_PRED_PATH,
        "V3.17 predictions"
    )

    features = load_csv(
        V315_FEATURE_PATH,
        "V3.15 features"
    )

    targets = load_csv(
        V315_TARGET_PATH,
        "V3.15 targets"
    )

    oof = load_csv(
        V315_OOF_PATH,
        "V3.15 OOF"
    )

    outer = None

    if V317_OUTER_PATH.exists():

        outer = load_csv(
            V317_OUTER_PATH,
            "V3.17 outer results"
        )

    else:

        print()
        print(
            "WARNING: V3.17 outer-results file not found:"
        )
        print(V317_OUTER_PATH)

    return pred, features, targets, oof, outer

# BASIC SCHEMA AUDIT

def audit_prediction_schema(pred):

    section("V3.17 AUTHORITATIVE PREDICTION AUDIT")

    required = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "selected_model",
    ]

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in pred.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        fail(
            "V3.17 prediction artifact is missing:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing)
        )

    print(
        "Rows       :",
        len(pred)
    )

    print(
        "row_index  :",
        pred["row_index"].min(),
        "->",
        pred["row_index"].max()
    )

    print(
        "Unique IDs :",
        pred["row_index"].nunique()
    )

    check_unique(
        pred["row_index"],
        "V3.17 row_index"
    )

    print()
    print("Selected model usage:")
    print(
        pred["selected_model"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    transitions = (
        pred["selected_model"]
        != "efficientnet_v2_s"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Transitions:",
        int(transitions.sum())
    )

    print()
    print("Transition usage by fold:")

    fold_counts = (
        pred.assign(
            transition=transitions
        )
        .groupby(
            ["outer_fold", "transition"]
        )
        .size()
        .unstack(
            fill_value=0
        )
    )

    print(fold_counts)


# =============================================================================
# V3.15 POSITIONAL ALIGNMENT
# =============================================================================

def attach_v315_positionally(
    pred,
    features,
    targets,
    oof
):

    section(
        "ATTACHING V3.15 ARTIFACTS POSITIONALLY"
    )

    n = len(pred)

    for name, df in [
        ("features", features),
        ("targets", targets),
        ("OOF", oof),
    ]:

        if len(df) != n:

            fail(
                f"Length mismatch:\n"
                f"V3.17 predictions = {n}\n"
                f"{name} = {len(df)}"
            )

    print(
        "All artifacts contain",
        n,
        "rows."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "V3.17 row_index is treated as "
        "the original sample identifier."
    )

    print(
        "V3.15 feature/target/OOF rows are "
        "attached positionally."
    )

    print(
        "NO row_index merge is performed."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Prefix V3.15 columns so collisions are impossible.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cols = [
        c
        for c in features.columns
        if c not in oof.columns
    ]

    feature_part = features[feature_cols].copy()

    feature_part.columns = [
        f"feature__{c}"
        for c in feature_part.columns
    ]

    target_part = targets.copy()

    target_part.columns = [
        f"target__{c}"
        for c in target_part.columns
    ]

    oof_part = oof.copy()

    oof_part.columns = [
        f"oof__{c}"
        for c in oof_part.columns
    ]

    result = pd.concat(
        [
            pred.reset_index(drop=True),
            feature_part.reset_index(drop=True),
            target_part.reset_index(drop=True),
            oof_part.reset_index(drop=True),
        ],
        axis=1
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Merged forensic dataframe:",
        result.shape
    )

    return result

# COMPARE V3.17 SELECTED MODEL WITH OOF

def compare_selection(
    df
):

    section(
        "V3.17 SELECTED MODEL VS V3.15 OOF"
    )

    if (
        "selected_model" not in df.columns
        or "oof__selected_model" not in df.columns
    ):

        print(
            "OOF selected_model unavailable."
        )

        return

    mismatch = (
        df["selected_model"].astype(str)
        !=
        df["oof__selected_model"].astype(str)
    )

    print(
        "Selection mismatches:",
        int(mismatch.sum()),
        "/",
        len(df)
    )

    if mismatch.any():

        print()
        print(
            "First selection mismatches:"
        )

        cols = [
            "row_index",
            "outer_fold",
            "selected_model",
            "oof__outer_fold",
            "oof__row_index",
            "oof__selected_model",
        ]

        cols = [
            c
            for c in cols
            if c in df.columns
        ]

        print(
            df.loc[
                mismatch,
                cols
            ]
            .head(50)
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

    else:

        print(
            "✓ Every V3.17 selected_model "
            "matches the positional V3.15 OOF selection."
        )


# =============================================================================
# RECONSTRUCT OUTCOMES FROM V3.15 TARGETS
# =============================================================================

def reconstruct_from_targets(df):

    section(
        "RECONSTRUCTING OUTCOMES FROM V3.15 TARGETS"
    )

    required = [
        "target__resnet_rescue",
        "target__mobile_rescue",
        "target__efficientnet_error",
        "target__resnet_harm",
        "target__mobile_harm",
    ]

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        print(
            "Target columns unavailable:"
        )

        for c in missing:
            print(" ", c)

        return None

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Actual V3.17 transition
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = df.copy()

    df["audit_transition"] = (
        df["selected_model"]
        != "efficientnet_v2_s"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # IMPORTANT:
    #
    # A rescue/harm outcome should only be counted when V3.17 actually
    # switched to the corresponding specialist.
    #
    # Therefore:
    #
    # ResNet rescue:
    #   selected_model == resnet50
    #   AND target says resnet rescue
    #
    # Mobile rescue:
    #   selected_model == mobilenet_v3_large
    #   AND target says mobile rescue
    #
    # Same for harm.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["audit_resnet_rescue"] = (
        (df["selected_model"] == "resnet50")
        &
        (df["target__resnet_rescue"] == 1)
    )

    df["audit_mobile_rescue"] = (
        (df["selected_model"] == "mobilenet_v3_large")
        &
        (df["target__mobile_rescue"] == 1)
    )

    df["audit_resnet_harm"] = (
        (df["selected_model"] == "resnet50")
        &
        (df["target__resnet_harm"] == 1)
    )

    df["audit_mobile_harm"] = (
        (df["selected_model"] == "mobilenet_v3_large")
        &
        (df["target__mobile_harm"] == 1)
    )

    df["audit_rescue"] = (
        df["audit_resnet_rescue"]
        |
        df["audit_mobile_rescue"]
    )

    df["audit_harm"] = (
        df["audit_resnet_harm"]
        |
        df["audit_mobile_harm"]
    )

    df["audit_neutral"] = (
        df["audit_transition"]
        &
        ~df["audit_rescue"]
        &
        ~df["audit_harm"]
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Reconstructed from V3.15 targets:"
    )

    print(
        "Transitions:",
        int(df["audit_transition"].sum())
    )

    print(
        "Rescues:",
        int(df["audit_rescue"].sum())
    )

    print(
        "Harms:",
        int(df["audit_harm"].sum())
    )

    print(
        "Neutral:",
        int(df["audit_neutral"].sum())
    )

    print()
    print(
        "By selected model:"
    )

    summary = []

    for model in [
        "resnet50",
        "mobilenet_v3_large",
    ]:

        mask = (
            df["selected_model"]
            == model
        )

        summary.append(
            {
                "selected_model": model,
                "transitions": int(mask.sum()),
                "rescues": int(
                    df.loc[
                        mask,
                        "audit_rescue"
                    ].sum()
                ),
                "harms": int(
                    df.loc[
                        mask,
                        "audit_harm"
                    ].sum()
                ),
                "neutral": int(
                    df.loc[
                        mask,
                        "audit_neutral"
                    ].sum()
                ),
            }
        )

    print(
        pd.DataFrame(summary)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# COMPARE WITH OOF OUTCOME FLAGS
# =============================================================================

def compare_with_oof_flags(df):

    section(
        "COMPARING RECONSTRUCTED OUTCOMES WITH V3.15 OOF"
    )

    pairs = [
        (
            "rescue",
            "audit_rescue",
            "oof__rescue",
        ),
        (
            "harm",
            "audit_harm",
            "oof__harm",
        ),
        (
            "transition",
            "audit_transition",
            "oof__transition",
        ),
    ]

    for name, audit_col, oof_col in pairs:

        if oof_col not in df.columns:

            print(
                f"{name}: OOF column unavailable"
            )

            continue

        left = (
            df[audit_col]
            .astype(int)
        )

        right = (
            df[oof_col]
            .astype(int)
        )

        mismatch = (
            left != right
        )

        print(
            f"{name:<15}: "
            f"{int(mismatch.sum())} mismatches"
        )

        if mismatch.any():

            print(
                "First mismatches:"
            )

            cols = [
                "row_index",
                "outer_fold",
                "selected_model",
                audit_col,
                oof_col,
            ]

            print(
                df.loc[
                    mismatch,
                    cols
                ]
                .head(20)
                .to_string(index=False)
            )

# OUTER RESULTS AUDIT
