def audit_outer_results(
    outer
):

    section(
        "V3.17 OUTER-RESULTS AUDIT"
    )

    if outer is None:

        print(
            "No outer-results artifact available."
        )

        return None

    print(
        "Outer-results shape:",
        outer.shape
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Columns:"
    )

    for c in outer.columns:
        print(
            " ",
            c
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Identify all rescue/harm columns.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    rescue_cols = [
        c
        for c in outer.columns
        if "rescue" in c.lower()
    ]

    harm_cols = [
        c
        for c in outer.columns
        if "harm" in c.lower()
    ]

    transition_cols = [
        c
        for c in outer.columns
        if "transition" in c.lower()
    ]

    print()
    print(
        "Rescue-related columns:"
    )

    for c in rescue_cols:
        print(
            f"  {c}:",
            outer[c].tolist()
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Harm-related columns:"
    )

    for c in harm_cols:
        print(
            f"  {c}:",
            outer[c].tolist()
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Transition-related columns:"
    )

    for c in transition_cols:
        print(
            f"  {c}:",
            outer[c].tolist()
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicitly calculate sums for primary test metrics.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    result = {}

    for metric in [
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_neutral",
    ]:

        if metric in outer.columns:

            value = pd.to_numeric(
                outer[metric],
                errors="coerce"
            ).sum()

            result[metric] = value

            print()
            print(
                f"SUM {metric}:",
                int(value)
            )

    print()
    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "If primary_test_rescues sums to ~120 "
        "while authoritative reconstruction gives 88,"
    )

    print(
        "then the historical 120 rescue number is "
        "coming from the outer-results accounting."
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# FOLD-LEVEL COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def compare_fold_counts(
    df,
    outer
):

    section(
        "FOLD-LEVEL DISCREPANCY ANALYSIS"
    )

    if outer is None:

        print(
            "Outer results unavailable."
        )

        return

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Current authoritative reconstruction.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    current = (
        df
        .groupby("outer_fold")
        .agg(
            transitions=(
                "audit_transition",
                "sum"
            ),
            rescues=(
                "audit_rescue",
                "sum"
            ),
            harms=(
                "audit_harm",
                "sum"
            ),
            neutral=(
                "audit_neutral",
                "sum"
            ),
        )
        .reset_index()
    )

    print()
    print(
        "CURRENT FORENSIC COUNTS BY FOLD:"
    )

    print(
        current.to_string(index=False)
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Historical outer results.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    historical_cols = [
        "outer_fold",
        "primary_test_transitions",
        "primary_test_rescues",
        "primary_test_harms",
        "primary_test_neutral",
    ]

    available = [
        c
        for c in historical_cols
        if c in outer.columns
    ]

    if "outer_fold" not in available:

        print(
            "Outer-results has no outer_fold column."
        )

        return

    historical = outer[available].copy()

    print()
    print(
        "HISTORICAL OUTER-RESULT COUNTS:"
    )

    print(
        historical.to_string(index=False)
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge fold statistics.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    merged = current.merge(
        historical,
        on="outer_fold",
        how="outer",
        suffixes=(
            "_current",
            "_historical",
        )
    )

    print()
    print(
        "FOLD-LEVEL COMPARISON:"
    )

    print(
        merged.to_string(index=False)
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Differences.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    for metric in [
        "transitions",
        "rescues",
        "harms",
        "neutral",
    ]:

        hcol = f"primary_test_{metric}"

        if hcol not in merged.columns:
            continue

        merged[
            f"{metric}_difference"
        ] = (
            merged[hcol]
            -
            merged[metric]
        )

    print()
    print(
        "HISTORICAL - CURRENT DIFFERENCES:"
    )

    diff_cols = [
        "outer_fold",
        "transitions_difference",
        "rescues_difference",
        "harms_difference",
        "neutral_difference",
    ]

    diff_cols = [
        c
        for c in diff_cols
        if c in merged.columns
    ]

    print(
        merged[diff_cols]
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    return merged


# =============================================================================
# LOCATE THE 32 RESCUE DISCREPANCIES
# =============================================================================

def locate_rescue_discrepancy(
    df
):

    section(
        "LOCATING THE RESCUE DISCREPANCY"
    )

    if "audit_rescue" not in df.columns:
        print(
            "Authoritative rescue reconstruction unavailable."
        )
        return

    if "oof__rescue" not in df.columns:
        print(
            "OOF rescue flag unavailable."
        )
        return

    mismatch = (
        df["audit_rescue"].astype(int)
        !=
        df["oof__rescue"].astype(int)
    )

    print(
        "Authoritative rescue count:",
        int(df["audit_rescue"].sum())
    )

    print(
        "OOF rescue count:",
        int(df["oof__rescue"].sum())
    )

    print(
        "Rescue mismatches:",
        int(mismatch.sum())
    )

    if not mismatch.any():

        print()
        print(
            "✓ OOF rescue accounting matches "
            "authoritative reconstruction."
        )

        return

    print()
    print(
        "Mismatch breakdown:"
    )

    a = (
        df["audit_rescue"].astype(int)
    )

    o = (
        df["oof__rescue"].astype(int)
    )

    print(
        pd.crosstab(
            a,
            o,
            rownames=["authoritative_rescue"],
            colnames=["oof_rescue"],
        )
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Rows where OOF says RESCUE "
        "but authoritative selection is not a rescue:"
    )

    mask = (
        (df["audit_rescue"] == False)
        &
        (df["oof__rescue"] == 1)
    )

    cols = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "selected_model",
        "oof__row_index",
        "oof__selected_model",
        "oof__transition",
        "oof__rescue",
        "oof__harm",
        "target__resnet_rescue",
        "target__mobile_rescue",
        "target__efficientnet_error",
        "target__resnet_harm",
        "target__mobile_harm",
    ]

    cols = [
        c
        for c in cols
        if c in df.columns
    ]

    print(
        df.loc[
            mask,
            cols
        ]
        .head(100)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Rows where authoritative selection is "
        "RESCUE but OOF does not mark rescue:"
    )

    mask2 = (
        (df["audit_rescue"] == True)
        &
        (df["oof__rescue"] == 0)
    )

    print(
        df.loc[
            mask2,
            cols
        ]
        .head(100)
        .to_string(index=False)
    )


# =============================================================================
# CHECK SPECIALIST FLAGS AGAINST TARGETS
# =============================================================================

def specialist_consistency(
    df
):

    section(
        "SPECIALIST TARGET CONSISTENCY"
    )

    checks = [
        (
            "ResNet rescue",
            "selected_model",
            "resnet50",
            "target__resnet_rescue",
        ),
        (
            "MobileNet rescue",
            "selected_model",
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
            "target__mobile_rescue",
        ),
        (
            "ResNet harm",
            "selected_model",
            "resnet50",
            "target__resnet_harm",
        ),
        (
            "MobileNet harm",
            "selected_model",
            "mobilenet_v3_large",
            "target__mobile_harm",
        ),
    ]

    for name, model_col, model, target_col in checks:

        if target_col not in df.columns:
            continue

        selected = (
            df[model_col]
            == model
        )

        target = (
            df[target_col]
            == 1
        )

        print()
        print(
            name
        )

        print(
            "selected specialist:",
            int(selected.sum())
        )

        print(
            "target positive:",
            int(target.sum())
        )

        print(
            "selected AND positive:",
            int(
                (selected & target).sum()
            )
        )

        print(
            "positive but specialist NOT selected:",
            int(
                ((~selected) & target).sum()
            )
        )


# =============================================================================
# CHECK HISTORICAL 120 RESCUE POSSIBILITY
# =============================================================================

def test_historical_120_hypotheses(
    df,
    outer
):

    section(
        "TESTING POSSIBLE SOURCES OF THE HISTORICAL ~120 RESCUES"
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. All target rescues regardless of whether the model was selected.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    for c in [
        "target__resnet_rescue",
        "target__mobile_rescue",
    ]:

        if c in df.columns:

            print(
                f"{c:<35}:",
                int(df[c].sum())
            )

    if all(
        c in df.columns
        for c in [
            "target__resnet_rescue",
            "target__mobile_rescue",
        ]
    ):

        union_target_rescues = (
            (
                df["target__resnet_rescue"] == 1
            )
            |
            (
                df["target__mobile_rescue"] == 1
            )
        )

        print()
        print(
            "Union of all specialist rescue targets "
            "(regardless of selected model):",
            int(union_target_rescues.sum())
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Rescue targets among EfficientNet errors.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if all(
        c in df.columns
        for c in [
            "target__resnet_rescue",
            "target__mobile_rescue",
            "target__efficientnet_error",
        ]
    ):

        recoverable = (
            (
                (
                    df["target__resnet_rescue"] == 1
                )
                |
                (
                    df["target__mobile_rescue"] == 1
                )
            )
            &
            (
                df["target__efficientnet_error"] == 1
            )
        )

        print(
            "Recoverable EfficientNet errors:",
            int(
                df["target__efficientnet_error"]
                .sum()
            )
        )

        print(
            "Union rescue among recoverable errors:",
            int(recoverable.sum())
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. OOF rescue.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "oof__rescue" in df.columns:

        print(
            "V3.15 OOF rescue:",
            int(
                df["oof__rescue"]
                .sum()
            )
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Authoritative selected rescue.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "audit_rescue" in df.columns:

        print(
            "Authoritative selected rescue:",
            int(
                df["audit_rescue"]
                .sum()
            )
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Outer results.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        outer is not None
        and
        "primary_test_rescues" in outer.columns
    ):

        print(
            "Outer-results primary rescue sum:",
            int(
                pd.to_numeric(
                    outer[
                        "primary_test_rescues"
                    ],
                    errors="coerce"
                )
                .sum()
            )
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Interpretation:"
    )

    print(
        "If ~120 appears in the union of target rescue "
        "labels but only 88 appear after conditioning "
        "on the actually selected specialist, then the "
        "historical 120 value represents recoverable "
        "opportunities rather than actual V3.17 rescues."
    )


# =============================================================================
# ACCURACY ACCOUNTING
# =============================================================================

def accuracy_accounting(
    df
):

    section(
        "ACCURACY ACCOUNTING FROM SWITCH OUTCOMES"
    )

    if not all(
        c in df.columns
        for c in [
            "audit_transition",
            "audit_rescue",
            "audit_harm",
        ]
    ):

        print(
            "Outcome columns unavailable."
        )

        return

    transitions = int(
        df["audit_transition"].sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        df["audit_rescue"].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        df["audit_harm"].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        df["audit_neutral"].sum()
    )

    net = rescues - harms

    baseline_accuracy = None

    # If OOF gives base correctness, use it.
    if "oof__base_correct" in df.columns:

        baseline_accuracy = (
            df["oof__base_correct"]
            .astype(int)
            .mean()
        )

        print(
            "Baseline accuracy from OOF:",
            f"{baseline_accuracy:.6f}"
        )

    else:

        print(
            "Baseline correctness unavailable "
            "from OOF."
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Transitions:",
        transitions
    )

    print(
        "Rescues:",
        rescues
    )

    print(
        "Harms:",
        harms
    )

    print(
        "Neutral:",
        neutral
    )

    print(
        "Net gain:",
        net
    )

    print(
        "Net gain percentage:",
        f"{100.0 * net / len(df):.4f} pp"
    )

    print(
        "Rescue/Harm ratio:",
        (
            f"{rescues / harms:.4f}"
            if harms > 0
            else "inf"
        )
    )

    if baseline_accuracy is not None:

        estimated_final_accuracy = (
            baseline_accuracy
            +
            net / len(df)
        )

        print(
            "Estimated final accuracy:",
            f"{estimated_final_accuracy:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            "Estimated final accuracy %:",
            f"{100.0 * estimated_final_accuracy:.4f}%"
        )


# =============================================================================
# SAVE AUDIT DATA
# =============================================================================

def save_outputs(
    df,
    fold_comparison
):

    section(
        "SAVING AUDIT OUTPUTS"
    )

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True
    )

    forensic_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_discrepancy_forensic_dataframe.csv"
    )

    df.to_csv(
        forensic_path,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        "Saved:",
        forensic_path
    )

    if fold_comparison is not None:

        fold_path = (
            OUTPUT_DIR
            / "v3_17_fold_discrepancy_comparison.csv"
        )

        fold_comparison.to_csv(
            fold_path,
            index=False
        )

        print(
            "Saved:",
            fold_path
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary text file.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_discrepancy_summary.txt"
    )

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "V3.17 ACCURACY DISCREPANCY AUDIT"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 80
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Total samples: {len(df)}"
    )

    if "audit_transition" in df.columns:

        lines.append(
            f"Transitions: "
            f"{int(df['audit_transition'].sum())}"
        )

    if "audit_rescue" in df.columns:

        lines.append(
            f"Authoritative rescues: "
            f"{int(df['audit_rescue'].sum())}"
        )

    if "audit_harm" in df.columns:

        lines.append(
            f"Authoritative harms: "
            f"{int(df['audit_harm'].sum())}"
        )

    if "audit_neutral" in df.columns:

        lines.append(
            f"Authoritative neutral: "
            f"{int(df['audit_neutral'].sum())}"
        )

    if "oof__rescue" in df.columns:

        lines.append(
            f"OOF rescues: "
            f"{int(df['oof__rescue'].sum())}"
        )

    if "oof__harm" in df.columns:

        lines.append(
            f"OOF harms: "
            f"{int(df['oof__harm'].sum())}"
        )

    if outer_available_global:

        if (
            outer_global is not None
            and
            "primary_test_rescues"
            in outer_global.columns
        ):

            value = int(
                pd.to_numeric(
                    outer_global[
                        "primary_test_rescues"
                    ],
                    errors="coerce"
                )
                .sum()
            )

            lines.append(
                f"Outer-results primary rescues: "
                f"{value}"
            )

    summary_path.write_text(
        "\n".join(lines)
        + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    print(
        "Saved:",
        summary_path
    )


# =============================================================================
# GLOBALS FOR SUMMARY WRITER
# =============================================================================

outer_global = None
outer_available_global = False


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    global outer_global
    global outer_available_global

    section(
        "V3.17 ACCURACY DISCREPANCY AUDIT"
    )

    print(
        "Purpose:"
    )

    print(
        "Determine why historical V3.17 rescue counts "
        "appear to differ from the current authoritative "
        "forensic reconstruction."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "NO ARTIFACTS WILL BE MODIFIED."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        pred,
        features,
        targets,
        oof,
        outer,
    ) = load_artifacts()

    outer_global = outer
    outer_available_global = (
        outer is not None
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Schema.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    print_columns(
        pred,
        "V3.17 predictions"
    )

    audit_prediction_schema(
        pred
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Positional attachment.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = attach_v315_positionally(
        pred,
        features,
        targets,
        oof
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Selection comparison.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    compare_selection(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Reconstruct actual outcomes.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = reconstruct_from_targets(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # If target reconstruction unavailable, stop gracefully.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    if df is None:

        print()
        print(
            "Cannot continue without V3.15 target columns."
        )

        return 1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compare OOF flags.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    compare_with_oof_flags(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # OOF counts.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    audit_oof_counts(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Authoritative counts.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    authoritative_v317_counts(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Specialist consistency.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    specialist_consistency(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Locate rescue discrepancy.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    locate_rescue_discrepancy(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Outer results.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    outer_summary = audit_outer_results(
        outer
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fold-level comparison.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    fold_comparison = compare_fold_counts(
        df,
        outer
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Historical 120 hypotheses.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    test_historical_120_hypotheses(
        df,
        outer
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Accuracy accounting.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    accuracy_accounting(
        df
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final diagnosis.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "FINAL DISCREPANCY DIAGNOSIS"
    )

    auth_rescues = int(
        df["audit_rescue"].sum()
    )

    auth_harms = int(
        df["audit_harm"].sum()
    )

    auth_transitions = int(
        df["audit_transition"].sum()
    )

    print(
        "AUTHORITATIVE V3.17"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions : {auth_transitions}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues     : {auth_rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms       : {auth_harms}"
    )

    if "oof__rescue" in df.columns:

        print()
        print(
            "V3.15 OOF"
        )

        print(
            f"Rescues     : "
            f"{int(df['oof__rescue'].sum())}"
        )

    if outer is not None:

        if (
            "primary_test_rescues"
            in outer.columns
        ):

            historical_rescues = int(
                pd.to_numeric(
                    outer[
                        "primary_test_rescues"
                    ],
                    errors="coerce"
                )
                .sum()
            )

            print()
            print(
                "V3.17 OUTER RESULTS"
            )

            print(
                f"Rescues     : "
                f"{historical_rescues}"
            )

            print()
            print(
                "Difference:"
            )

            print(
                "Outer-results rescues "
                "- authoritative rescues =",
                historical_rescues
                - auth_rescues
            )

    print()
    print(
        "NEXT DECISION SHOULD BE BASED ON THIS AUDIT."
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_outputs(
        df,
        fold_comparison
    )

    section(
        "AUDIT COMPLETED"
    )

    print(
        "✓ V3.17 discrepancy audit completed."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Output directory:"
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR.resolve()
    )

    return 0

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.17 IDENTITY / ALIGNMENT AUDIT -- ROBUST VERSION

Purpose
-------
Determine whether V3.17 prediction rows correspond to the same original
test samples as the V3.15 artifacts.

IMPORTANT
---------
1. Does NOT modify any existing artifact.
2. Does NOT assume positional alignment between V3.17 and V3.15.
3. Searches for V3.15 artifacts automatically.
4. Uses row_index / sample identity when available.
5. Explicitly reports when identity cannot be established.
6. Separates:
       - sample identity
       - fold identity
       - model selection identity
       - outcome identity
7. Produces forensic CSV/TXT outputs only.

This script is diagnostic only.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable, Optional

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

SCRIPT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PHASE_DIR = SCRIPT_DIR.parent

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PHASE_DIR
    / "outputs"
    / "v3_17_identity_alignment_audit"
)

V317_DIR = (
    PHASE_DIR
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
)


# =============================================================================
# PRINTING
# =============================================================================

WIDTH = 100


def section(title: str):
    print()
    print("=" * WIDTH)
    print(title)
    print("=" * WIDTH)


def subsection(title: str):
    print()
    print("-" * 70)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 70)


def warn(msg: str):
    print(f"WARNING: {msg}")


def ok(msg: str):
    print(f"✓ {msg}")


# =============================================================================
# FILE DISCOVERY
# =============================================================================

def find_files_recursive(
    root: Path,
    patterns: Iterable[str],
) -> list[Path]:

    found = []

    if not root.exists():
        return found

    for pattern in patterns:
        found.extend(root.rglob(pattern))

    # Remove duplicates while preserving deterministic order.
    return sorted(set(found))


def score_candidate(
    path: Path,
    keywords: Iterable[str],
) -> int:

    text = str(path).lower()

    score = 0

    for keyword in keywords:
        if keyword.lower() in text:
            score += 1

    return score


def choose_best_candidate(
    candidates: list[Path],
    keywords: Iterable[str],
) -> Optional[Path]:

    if not candidates:
        return None

    scored = [
        (
            score_candidate(path, keywords),
            path.stat().st_size if path.exists() else 0,
            path,
        )
        for path in candidates
    ]

    scored.sort(
        key=lambda x: (
            x[0],
            x[1],
            str(x[2]),
        ),
        reverse=True,
    )

    return scored[0][2]


def discover_v315_artifact(
    project_root: Path,
    artifact_type: str,
) -> Optional[Path]:

    patterns = {
        "features": [
            "*v3_15*feature*.csv",
            "*v3_15*features*.csv",
            "*selector_features*.csv",
        ],
        "targets": [
            "*v3_15*target*.csv",
            "*v3_15*targets*.csv",
            "*selector_targets*.csv",
        ],
        "oof": [
            "*v3_15*oof*.csv",
            "*v3_15*OOF*.csv",
            "*oof*.csv",
        ],
    }

    keywords = {
        "features": [
            "v3_15",
            "feature",
        ],
        "targets": [
            "v3_15",
            "target",
        ],
        "oof": [
            "v3_15",
            "oof",
        ],
    }

    candidates = find_files_recursive(
        project_root,
        patterns[artifact_type],
    )

    # Remove obvious V3.17 files.
    candidates = [
        p
        for p in candidates
        if "v3_17" not in str(p).lower()
    ]

    chosen = choose_best_candidate(
        candidates,
        keywords[artifact_type],
    )

    return chosen


# =============================================================================
# CSV LOADING
# =============================================================================

def require_csv(
    path: Path,
    name: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    if path is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"{name} could not be discovered automatically."
        )

    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"{name} not found:\n{path.resolve()}"
        )

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(path)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Could not read {name}:\n{path}\n{exc}"
        ) from exc

    print(f"{name:<25}: {df.shape}")
    print(f"  path: {path}")

    return df


# =============================================================================
# COLUMN UTILITIES
# =============================================================================

def find_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: Iterable[str],
) -> Optional[str]:

    normalized = {
        str(col).strip().lower(): col
        for col in df.columns
    }

    for candidate in candidates:

        key = candidate.strip().lower()

        if key in normalized:
            return normalized[key]

    return None


def find_identity_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Optional[str]:

    candidates = [
        "row_index",
        "sample_id",
        "image_id",
        "imageid",
        "image",
        "filename",
        "file_name",
        "path",
        "image_path",
        "isic_id",
        "id",
    ]

    return find_column(df, candidates)


def find_fold_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Optional[str]:

    return find_column(
        df,
        [
            "outer_fold",
            "fold",
            "fold_id",
            "cv_fold",
        ],
    )


def find_selected_model_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Optional[str]:

    return find_column(
        df,
        [
            "selected_model",
            "selected",
            "model",
        ],
    )


# =============================================================================
# VALUE NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

def normalize_identity_series(
    s: pd.Series,
) -> pd.Series:

    def normalize(x):

        if pd.isna(x):
            return "__NA__"

        if isinstance(x, float):

            if np.isfinite(x) and x.is_integer():
                return str(int(x))

        return str(x).strip()

    return s.map(normalize)


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY AUDIT
# =============================================================================

def identity_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    name: str,
) -> dict:

    identity_col = find_identity_column(df)

    fold_col = find_fold_column(df)

    selected_col = find_selected_model_column(df)

    result = {
        "name": name,
        "rows": len(df),
        "identity_column": identity_col,
        "fold_column": fold_col,
        "selected_model_column": selected_col,
        "unique_identity": None,
        "duplicate_identity": None,
    }

    if identity_col is not None:

        ids = normalize_identity_series(
            df[identity_col]
        )

        result["unique_identity"] = ids.nunique(
            dropna=False
        )

        result["duplicate_identity"] = (
            ids.duplicated(keep=False).sum()
        )

    return result


def print_identity_summary(
    summary: dict,
):

    print(
        f"{summary['name']}: "
        f"{summary['rows']} rows"
    )

    print(
        f"  identity column       : "
        f"{summary['identity_column']}"
    )

    print(
        f"  fold column           : "
        f"{summary['fold_column']}"
    )

    print(
        f"  selected model column : "
        f"{summary['selected_model_column']}"
    )

    if summary["unique_identity"] is not None:

        print(
            f"  unique identities     : "
            f"{summary['unique_identity']}"
        )

        print(
            f"  duplicate identity rows: "
            f"{summary['duplicate_identity']}"
        )


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY MATCH
# =============================================================================

def compare_identity(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    v315: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, str, str]:

    v317_id = find_identity_column(v317)
    v315_id = find_identity_column(v315)

    if v317_id is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.17 predictions have no recognizable identity column."
        )

    if v315_id is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.15 artifact has no recognizable identity column."
        )

    a = v317.copy()
    b = v315.copy()

    a["_identity_key"] = normalize_identity_series(
        a[v317_id]
    )

    b["_identity_key"] = normalize_identity_series(
        b[v315_id]
    )

    # Detect duplicates before merging.
    a_dup = a["_identity_key"].duplicated(
        keep=False
    ).sum()

    b_dup = b["_identity_key"].duplicated(
        keep=False
    ).sum()

    print()
    print(
        f"V3.17 identity column: {v317_id}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 identity column: {v315_id}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 duplicate identity rows: {a_dup}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 duplicate identity rows: {b_dup}"
    )

    if a_dup > 0 or b_dup > 0:

        warn(
            "Duplicate identities detected. "
            "Identity-level one-to-one alignment is not guaranteed."
        )

    merged = a.merge(
        b,
        on="_identity_key",
        how="outer",
        suffixes=(
            "__v317",
            "__v315",
        ),
        indicator=True,
    )

    return (
        merged,
        v317_id,
        v315_id,
    )


# =============================================================================
# MATCH REPORT
# =============================================================================

def build_identity_report(
    merged: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    report = pd.DataFrame()

    report["_identity_key"] = merged[
        "_identity_key"
    ]

    report["merge_status"] = merged[
        "_merge"
    ].astype(str)

    report["present_v317"] = (
        report["merge_status"] != "right_only"
    )

    report["present_v315"] = (
        report["merge_status"] != "left_only"
    )

    report["identity_match"] = (
        report["merge_status"] == "both"
    )

    return report


# =============================================================================
# FOLD COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def compare_folds(
    merged: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    v317_fold = find_column(
        merged,
        [
            "outer_fold__v317",
            "outer_fold",
        ],
    )

    v315_fold = find_column(
        merged,
        [
            "outer_fold__v315",
        ],
    )

    if v317_fold is None or v315_fold is None:

        return pd.DataFrame()

    result = merged[
        [
            "_identity_key",
            v317_fold,
            v315_fold,
        ]
    ].copy()

    result["fold_match"] = (
        result[v317_fold].astype(str)
        ==
        result[v315_fold].astype(str)
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# SELECTED MODEL COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def compare_selected_models(
    merged: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    v317_model = find_column(
        merged,
        [
            "selected_model__v317",
        ],
    )

    v315_model = find_column(
        merged,
        [
            "selected_model__v315",
        ],
    )

    if v317_model is None or v315_model is None:

        return pd.DataFrame()

    result = merged[
        [
            "_identity_key",
            v317_model,
            v315_model,
        ]
    ].copy()

    result["selected_model_match"] = (
        result[v317_model].astype(str)
        ==
        result[v315_model].astype(str)
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# OUTCOME COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def find_outcome_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict:

    mapping = {}

    candidates = {
        "transition": [
            "transition",
            "switch",
        ],
        "rescue": [
            "rescue",
            "is_rescue",
        ],
        "harm": [
            "harm",
            "is_harm",
        ],
        "neutral": [
            "neutral",
            "neutral_transition",
        ],
    }

    for key, names in candidates.items():

        col = find_column(
            df,
            names,
        )

        if col is not None:
            mapping[key] = col

    return mapping


def print_outcome_columns(
    name: str,
    df: pd.DataFrame,
):

    mapping = find_outcome_columns(df)

    print(
        f"{name} outcome columns:"
    )

    if not mapping:
        print("  None detected.")
        return

    for key, col in mapping.items():
        print(
            f"  {key:<12}: {col}"
        )


# =============================================================================
# SPECIALIST TARGET ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def detect_specialist_targets(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> list[str]:

    result = []

    for col in df.columns:

        c = str(col).lower()

        if (
            "resnet" in c
            or "mobilenet" in c
        ):

            if (
                "rescue" in c
                or "harm" in c
            ):
                result.append(col)

    return result


# =============================================================================
# ROW-INDEX SPECIAL CHECK
# =============================================================================

def audit_row_index(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    v315: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "ROW_INDEX DIAGNOSTIC"
    )

    v317_row = find_column(
        v317,
        ["row_index"],
    )

    v315_row = find_column(
        v315,
        ["row_index"],
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 row_index column: {v317_row}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 row_index column: {v315_row}"
    )

    if v317_row is None or v315_row is None:

        warn(
            "row_index is not available in both artifacts."
        )

        return

    a = normalize_identity_series(
        v317[v317_row]
    )

    b = normalize_identity_series(
        v315[v315_row]
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 row_index unique: "
        f"{a.nunique()}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 row_index unique: "
        f"{b.nunique()}"
    )

    common = set(a) & set(b)

    print(
        f"Common row_index identities: "
        f"{len(common)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Only V3.17: "
        f"{len(set(a) - set(b))}"
    )

    print(
        f"Only V3.15: "
        f"{len(set(b) - set(a))}"
    )

    if len(common) == len(a) == len(b):

        ok(
            "Both artifacts contain the same row_index identity set."
        )

    else:

        warn(
            "The row_index identity sets differ."
        )


# =============================================================================
# POSITIONAL VS IDENTITY TEST
# =============================================================================

def positional_identity_test(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    v315: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "POSITIONAL VS IDENTITY ALIGNMENT TEST"
    )

    if len(v317) != len(v315):

        print(
            "Different row counts."
        )

        return

    v317_id = find_identity_column(v317)
    v315_id = find_identity_column(v315)

    if v317_id is None or v315_id is None:

        warn(
            "Cannot perform positional identity test."
        )

        return

    a = normalize_identity_series(
        v317[v317_id]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    b = normalize_identity_series(
        v315[v315_id]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    positional_matches = (
        a == b
    ).sum()

    total = len(a)

    rate = (
        positional_matches / total
        if total
        else np.nan
    )

    print(
        f"Total rows          : {total}"
    )

    print(
        f"Positional matches  : "
        f"{positional_matches}"
    )

    print(
        f"Positional match %  : "
        f"{rate * 100:.4f}%"
    )

    if positional_matches == total:

        ok(
            "Artifacts are positionally identity-aligned."
        )

    elif positional_matches == 0:

        warn(
            "ZERO positional identity matches."
        )

        print(
            "This strongly indicates that positional attachment "
            "between V3.17 and V3.15 is invalid."
        )

    else:

        warn(
            "Partial positional identity alignment."
        )


# =============================================================================
# MERGE DIAGNOSTIC
# =============================================================================

def print_merge_diagnostic(
    merged: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "IDENTITY MERGE DIAGNOSTIC"
    )

    counts = (
        merged["_merge"]
        .value_counts()
        .rename_axis("status")
        .reset_index(name="rows")
    )

    print(
        counts.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    both = int(
        (
            merged["_merge"]
            == "both"
        ).sum()
    )

    left = int(
        (
            merged["_merge"]
            == "left_only"
        ).sum()
    )

    right = int(
        (
            merged["_merge"]
            == "right_only"
        ).sum()
    )

    total_v317 = both + left
    total_v315 = both + right

    print()
    print(
        f"V3.17 identities matched: "
        f"{both}/{total_v317}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17-only identities: "
        f"{left}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15-only identities: "
        f"{right}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MODEL MISMATCH ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def model_mismatch_analysis(
    merged: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "SELECTED MODEL IDENTITY ANALYSIS"
    )

    v317_model = find_column(
        merged,
        ["selected_model__v317"],
    )

    v315_model = find_column(
        merged,
        ["selected_model__v315"],
    )

    if v317_model is None or v315_model is None:

        warn(
            "Selected-model columns unavailable."
        )

        return

    valid = merged[
        (merged["_merge"] == "both")
        &
        merged[v317_model].notna()
        &
        merged[v315_model].notna()
    ].copy()

    valid["model_match"] = (
        valid[v317_model].astype(str)
        ==
        valid[v315_model].astype(str)
    )

    mismatches = valid[
        ~valid["model_match"]
    ]

    print(
        f"Identity-matched rows : "
        f"{len(valid)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Model matches         : "
        f"{valid['model_match'].sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Model mismatches      : "
        f"{len(mismatches)}"
    )

    if len(valid):

        print(
            f"Model agreement       : "
            f"{valid['model_match'].mean() * 100:.4f}%"
        )

    if len(mismatches):

        print()
        print(
            "First model mismatches:"
        )

        cols = [
            "_identity_key",
            v317_model,
            v315_model,
        ]

        print(
            mismatches[cols]
            .head(50)
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

        print()

        matrix = pd.crosstab(
            valid[v317_model],
            valid[v315_model],
            margins=True,
        )

        print(
            matrix.to_string()
        )


# =============================================================================
# FOLD MISMATCH ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def fold_mismatch_analysis(
    merged: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "FOLD IDENTITY ANALYSIS"
    )

    v317_fold = find_column(
        merged,
        ["outer_fold__v317"],
    )

    v315_fold = find_column(
        merged,
        ["outer_fold__v315"],
    )

    if v317_fold is None or v315_fold is None:

        warn(
            "Fold columns unavailable in both artifacts."
        )

        return

    valid = merged[
        (merged["_merge"] == "both")
    ].copy()

    valid["fold_match"] = (
        valid[v317_fold].astype(str)
        ==
        valid[v315_fold].astype(str)
    )

    print(
        f"Identity-matched rows: {len(valid)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Fold matches: "
        f"{valid['fold_match'].sum()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Fold mismatches: "
        f"{(~valid['fold_match']).sum()}"
    )

    if len(valid):

        print(
            f"Fold agreement: "
            f"{valid['fold_match'].mean() * 100:.4f}%"
        )

    mismatches = valid[
        ~valid["fold_match"]
    ]

    if len(mismatches):

        print()
        print(
            "Fold mismatch matrix:"
        )

        matrix = pd.crosstab(
            valid[v317_fold],
            valid[v315_fold],
            margins=True,
        )

        print(
            matrix.to_string()
        )


# =============================================================================
# SAVE OUTPUT
# =============================================================================

def save_outputs(
    merged: pd.DataFrame,
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    v315_features: pd.DataFrame,
    v315_targets: pd.DataFrame,
    v315_oof: pd.DataFrame,
):

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    forensic_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_identity_alignment_forensic.csv"
    )

    merged.to_csv(
        forensic_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {forensic_path}"
    )

    summary_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_17_identity_alignment_summary.txt"
    )

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "V3.17 IDENTITY ALIGNMENT AUDIT"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 70
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.17 rows: {len(v317)}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.15 feature rows: {len(v315_features)}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.15 target rows: {len(v315_targets)}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.15 OOF rows: {len(v315_oof)}"
    )

    v317_id = find_identity_column(v317)
    feat_id = find_identity_column(v315_features)
    target_id = find_identity_column(v315_targets)
    oof_id = find_identity_column(v315_oof)

    lines.append(
        f"V3.17 identity column: {v317_id}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.15 feature identity column: {feat_id}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.15 target identity column: {target_id}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.15 OOF identity column: {oof_id}"
    )

    summary_path.write_text(
        "\n".join(lines),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print(
        f"Saved: {summary_path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.17 IDENTITY / ALIGNMENT AUDIT -- ROBUST FIXED VERSION"
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT modify any existing artifact."
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT assume positional alignment."
    )

    print(
        "V3.15 artifacts are discovered automatically."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Locate V3.17 predictions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317_candidates = find_files_recursive(
        V317_DIR,
        [
            "*v3_17*test*pred*.csv",
            "*v3_17*predictions*.csv",
            "*test_predictions*.csv",
        ],
    )

    # Prefer the known naming pattern.
    v317_predictions_path = choose_best_candidate(
        v317_candidates,
        [
            "v3_17",
            "test",
            "pred",
        ],
    )

    if v317_predictions_path is None:

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "Could not locate V3.17 prediction artifact.\n"
            f"Searched under:\n{V317_DIR}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Locate V3.15 artifacts
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "DISCOVERING V3.15 ARTIFACTS"
    )

    v315_features_path = discover_v315_artifact(
        PHASE_DIR,
        "features",
    )

    v315_targets_path = discover_v315_artifact(
        PHASE_DIR,
        "targets",
    )

    v315_oof_path = discover_v315_artifact(
        PHASE_DIR,
        "oof",
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 features candidate:\n"
        f"  {v315_features_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 targets candidate:\n"
        f"  {v315_targets_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 OOF candidate:\n"
        f"  {v315_oof_path}"
    )

    if v315_features_path is None:

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "\nCould not automatically locate V3.15 features.\n"
            "Run:\n\n"
            "find Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs "
            "-type f -iname '*v3*15*feature*.csv'\n\n"
            "and provide the actual path if discovery fails."
        )

    if v315_targets_path is None:

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "\nCould not automatically locate V3.15 targets.\n"
            "Run:\n\n"
            "find Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs "
            "-type f -iname '*v3*15*target*.csv'"
        )

    if v315_oof_path is None:

        raise FileNotFoundError(
            "\nCould not automatically locate V3.15 OOF.\n"
            "Run:\n\n"
            "find Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection/outputs "
            "-type f -iname '*v3*15*oof*.csv'"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "LOADING ARTIFACTS"
    )

    v317 = require_csv(
        v317_predictions_path,
        "V3.17 predictions",
    )

    v315_features = require_csv(
        v315_features_path,
        "V3.15 features",
    )

    v315_targets = require_csv(
        v315_targets_path,
        "V3.15 targets",
    )

    v315_oof = require_csv(
        v315_oof_path,
        "V3.15 OOF",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Basic schema
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "ARTIFACT SCHEMA"
    )

    print(
        "V3.17 columns:"
    )

    for i, col in enumerate(v317.columns):
        print(
            f"  {i:3d}  {col}"
        )

    print()
    print(
        "V3.15 feature columns:"
    )

    print(
        list(v315_features.columns)
    )

    print()
    print(
        "V3.15 target columns:"
    )

    print(
        list(v315_targets.columns)
    )

    print()
    print(
        "V3.15 OOF columns:"
    )

    print(
        list(v315_oof.columns)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity summaries
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "IDENTITY SUMMARY"
    )

    for name, df in [
        ("V3.17 predictions", v317),
        ("V3.15 features", v315_features),
        ("V3.15 targets", v315_targets),
        ("V3.15 OOF", v315_oof),
    ]:

        summary = identity_summary(
            df,
            name,
        )

        print_identity_summary(
            summary
        )

        print()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Row index special audit
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    audit_row_index(
        v317,
        v315_oof,
    )

    audit_row_index(
        v317,
        v315_features,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Positional diagnostic
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    positional_identity_test(
        v317,
        v315_oof,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity merge
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "IDENTITY-BASED V3.17 ↔ V3.15 ALIGNMENT"
    )

    merged, v317_id, v315_id = compare_identity(
        v317,
        v315_oof,
    )

    print_merge_diagnostic(
        merged
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fold analysis
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    fold_mismatch_analysis(
        merged
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Model analysis
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    model_mismatch_analysis(
        merged
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Outcome columns
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "OUTCOME COLUMN DETECTION"
    )

    print_outcome_columns(
        "V3.17",
        v317,
    )

    print()

    print_outcome_columns(
        "V3.15 OOF",
        v315_oof,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Target analysis
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.15 SPECIALIST TARGETS"
    )

    target_cols = detect_specialist_targets(
        v315_targets
    )

    if target_cols:

        for col in target_cols:

            values = pd.to_numeric(
                v315_targets[col],
                errors="coerce",
            )

            print(
                f"{col:<45} "
                f"positive={int((values > 0).sum())}"
            )

    else:

        warn(
            "No specialist rescue/harm target columns detected."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final diagnosis
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "FINAL DIAGNOSTIC INTERPRETATION"
    )

    both = int(
        (
            merged["_merge"]
            == "both"
        ).sum()
    )

    left = int(
        (
            merged["_merge"]
            == "left_only"
        ).sum()
    )

    right = int(
        (
            merged["_merge"]
            == "right_only"
        ).sum()
    )

    if both == len(v317) == len(v315_oof):

        ok(
            "V3.17 and V3.15 OOF contain the same identity set."
        )

    else:

        warn(
            "V3.17 and V3.15 OOF do NOT have identical identity sets."
        )

        print(
            f"Matched : {both}"
        )

        print(
            f"V3.17-only : {left}"
        )

        print(
            f"V3.15-only : {right}"
        )

    print()

    print(
        "CRITICAL:"
    )

    print(
        "The previous discrepancy audit attached V3.15 rows "
        "positionally to V3.17 rows."
    )

    print(
        "This script explicitly tests whether that assumption is valid."
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Do NOT train V3.23 or another harm discriminator "
        "until identity alignment is established."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "SAVING AUDIT OUTPUTS"
    )

    save_outputs(
        merged,
        v317,
        v315_features,
        v315_targets,
        v315_oof,
    )

    section(
        "AUDIT COMPLETED"
    )

    ok(
        "V3.17 identity alignment audit completed."
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Output directory:\n{OUTPUT_DIR.resolve()}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.17 IDENTITY-ALIGNED OUTCOME AUDIT

Purpose
-------
Determine the true V3.17 rescue / harm / neutral outcomes using identity
alignment rather than positional attachment.

This audit is specifically designed to answer:

1. Are V3.17 transitions correctly represented?
2. For each actual V3.17 selected specialist, was that switch a rescue,
   harm, or neutral transition?
3. How many genuine rescues and harms does V3.17 actually contain?
4. Are the historical V3.15 OOF rescue/harm counts merely training/OOF
   opportunities rather than realized V3.17 outcomes?
5. Does the V3.17 accuracy discrepancy survive after identity alignment?
6. Which exact rows constitute rescues and harms?
7. How does V3.17 compare with the V3.15 OOF policy?

IMPORTANT
---------
- This script NEVER modifies existing artifacts.
- V3.17 is joined to V3.15 OOF using row_index.
- No positional V3.17 <-> V3.15 OOF merge is performed.
- V3.15 target rows have no row_index. Therefore targets are attached
  through the V3.15 OOF artifact only after validating that both contain
  the same number of rows and that OOF row_index is a complete identity
  permutation.
- The script explicitly reports this limitation.
"""

from pathlib import Path

def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def require_file(path, name):
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"{name} not found:\n{path.resolve()}"
        )
    return path


def normalize_model(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return value

    value = str(value).strip().lower()

    aliases = {
        "efficientnet": EFFNET,
        "efficientnet_v2_s": EFFNET,
        "efficientnet-v2-s": EFFNET,
        "resnet": RESNET,
        "resnet50": RESNET,
        "mobilenet": MOBILE,
        "mobilenet_v3_large": MOBILE,
        "mobilenet-v3-large": MOBILE,
    }

    return aliases.get(value, value)


def as_bool(series):
    """
    Robust conversion of heterogeneous 0/1, bool, string, and numeric
    columns into a pandas nullable Boolean series.

    Important:
    - Explicitly creates boolean-compatible output.
    - Avoids pandas 3.x LossySetitemError caused by assigning bool
      values into an int64 Series.
    - Preserves missing/unknown values as False for audit purposes.
    """

    if series is None:
        return pd.Series(dtype=bool)

    # Create a fresh boolean-compatible Series.
    out = pd.Series(False, index=series.index, dtype=bool)

    for idx, value in series.items():

        if pd.isna(value):
            out.loc[idx] = False
            continue

        # Native bool
        if isinstance(value, (bool, np.bool_)):
            out.loc[idx] = bool(value)
            continue

        # Numeric 0/1
        if isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
            out.loc[idx] = bool(value != 0)
            continue

        # String representation
        text = str(value).strip().lower()

        if text in {
            "1",
            "true",
            "t",
            "yes",
            "y",
            "on",
        }:
            out.loc[idx] = True

        elif text in {
            "0",
            "false",
            "f",
            "no",
            "n",
            "off",
            "",
            "none",
            "nan",
            "null",
        }:
            out.loc[idx] = False

        else:
            # Conservative fallback:
            # attempt numeric conversion before treating as False.
            try:
                numeric = float(text)
                out.loc[idx] = bool(numeric != 0)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                out.loc[idx] = False

    return out


def find_column(df, candidates):
    lower = {str(c).lower(): c for c in df.columns}

    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate.lower() in lower:
            return lower[candidate.lower()]

    return None


def validate_row_index(df, name):
    if "row_index" not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} does not contain row_index."
        )

    if df["row_index"].isna().any():
        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} contains missing row_index values."
        )

    if not df["row_index"].is_unique:
        duplicates = df.loc[
            df["row_index"].duplicated(keep=False),
            "row_index"
        ].tolist()

        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} contains duplicate row_index values. "
            f"Examples: {duplicates[:20]}"
        )

def audit_schema(v317, oof, targets):

    section("SCHEMA VALIDATION")

    print("V3.17 columns:")
    for i, c in enumerate(v317.columns):
        print(f"  {i:2d}  {c}")

    print()
    print("V3.15 OOF columns:")
    for i, c in enumerate(oof.columns):
        print(f"  {i:2d}  {c}")

    print()
    print("V3.15 target columns:")
    for i, c in enumerate(targets.columns):
        print(f"  {i:2d}  {c}")

    required_v317 = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "selected_model",
        "switch",
    ]

    required_oof = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "selected_model",
    ]

    required_targets = [
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",
    ]

    for c in required_v317:
        if c not in v317.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"V3.17 missing required column: {c}"
            )

    for c in required_oof:
        if c not in oof.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"V3.15 OOF missing required column: {c}"
            )

    for c in required_targets:
        if c not in targets.columns:
            raise ValueError(
                f"V3.15 targets missing required column: {c}"
            )

    print()
    print("✓ Required schemas are present.")


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY AUDIT
# =============================================================================

def audit_identity(v317, oof):

    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    validate_row_index(
        v317,
        "V3.17 predictions"
    )

    validate_row_index(
        oof,
        "V3.15 OOF"
    )

    v317_ids = set(
        v317["row_index"].astype(int)
    )

    oof_ids = set(
        oof["row_index"].astype(int)
    )

    common = v317_ids & oof_ids
    only_v317 = v317_ids - oof_ids
    only_oof = oof_ids - v317_ids

    print(
        f"V3.17 unique identities : {len(v317_ids)}"
    )
    print(
        f"V3.15 OOF identities   : {len(oof_ids)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Common identities      : {len(common)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Only V3.17             : {len(only_v317)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Only V3.15 OOF         : {len(only_oof)}"
    )

    if only_v317:
        print(
            "Examples only in V3.17:",
            sorted(only_v317)[:20]
        )

    if only_oof:
        print(
            "Examples only in V3.15 OOF:",
            sorted(only_oof)[:20]
        )

    if not only_v317 and not only_oof:
        print(
            "✓ Exact identity set match."
        )

    return common


# =============================================================================
# TARGET ↔ OOF VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def attach_targets_to_oof(oof, targets):

    section(
        "V3.15 OOF ↔ TARGET ALIGNMENT VALIDATION"
    )

    print(
        "V3.15 targets do NOT contain row_index."
    )

    print(
        "Therefore target identity must be inherited from the OOF row order."
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"OOF rows    : {len(oof)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Target rows : {len(targets)}"
    )

    if len(oof) != len(targets):
        raise ValueError(
            "V3.15 OOF and targets have different row counts. "
            "Cannot safely attach targets."
        )

    # Validate that OOF row_index is a complete contiguous identity set
    ids = oof["row_index"].astype(int).to_numpy()

    expected = np.arange(len(oof))

    if not np.array_equal(
        np.sort(ids),
        expected
    ):
        print(
            "WARNING: OOF row_index is not exactly 0..N-1."
        )
        print(
            "Target identity cannot be independently verified."
        )

    else:
        print(
            "✓ OOF row_index forms complete 0..N-1 identity set."
        )

    targets = targets.copy()

    # Attach OOF identity to target rows through validated row position.
    targets["row_index"] = oof["row_index"].to_numpy()

    targets["target_outer_fold"] = (
        oof["outer_fold"].to_numpy()
    )

    print(
        "✓ Target rows attached to OOF row_index by validated OOF row order."
    )

    return targets


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY MERGE
# =============================================================================

def build_identity_dataframe(v317, oof, targets):

    section(
        "BUILDING IDENTITY-ALIGNED FORENSIC DATAFRAME"
    )

    # Normalize model names
    v317 = v317.copy()
    oof = oof.copy()

    v317["selected_model"] = (
        v317["selected_model"]
        .map(normalize_model)
    )

    oof["selected_model"] = (
        oof["selected_model"]
        .map(normalize_model)
    )

    targets = targets.copy()

    # Prefix columns before merge
    oof_for_merge = oof.rename(
        columns={
            c: f"oof__{c}"
            for c in oof.columns
            if c != "row_index"
        }
    )

    targets_for_merge = targets.rename(
        columns={
            c: f"target__{c}"
            for c in targets.columns
            if c != "row_index"
        }
    )

    merged = (
        v317
        .merge(
            oof_for_merge,
            on="row_index",
            how="left",
            validate="one_to_one",
        )
        .merge(
            targets_for_merge,
            on="row_index",
            how="left",
            validate="one_to_one",
        )
    )

    print(
        f"Identity-aligned dataframe : {merged.shape}"
    )

    if merged["oof__outer_fold"].isna().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Some V3.17 identities failed to match V3.15 OOF."
        )

    if merged[
        "target__resnet_rescue"
    ].isna().any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Some V3.17 identities failed to match targets."
        )

    return merged
