def analyze_transitions(df):

    section(
        "V3.17 IDENTITY-ALIGNED TRANSITION ANALYSIS"
    )

    df["v317_transition"] = as_bool(
        df["switch"]
    )

    print(
        "V3.17 transitions:",
        int(df["v317_transition"].sum())
    )

    print()
    print("Selected model usage:")

    print(
        df["selected_model"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    print()
    print("Transition usage by selected model:")

    transition_by_model = pd.crosstab(
        df["selected_model"],
        df["v317_transition"]
    )

    print(
        transition_by_model.to_string()
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# ACTUAL V3.17 OUTCOME RECONSTRUCTION
# =============================================================================

def reconstruct_actual_outcomes(df):

    section(
        "RECONSTRUCTING ACTUAL V3.17 OUTCOMES"
    )

    """
    A V3.17 switch is evaluated according to the specialist actually selected.

    EfficientNet -> ResNet:
        rescue = EfficientNet wrong AND ResNet rescue
        harm   = EfficientNet wrong AND ResNet harm

    EfficientNet -> MobileNet:
        rescue = EfficientNet wrong AND MobileNet rescue
        harm   = EfficientNet wrong AND MobileNet harm

    If neither rescue nor harm:
        neutral transition

    IMPORTANT:
    We use the V3.17 selected_model, not the V3.15 OOF selected_model.
    """

    df["target_efficientnet_error"] = as_bool(
        df["target__efficientnet_error"]
    )

    df["target_resnet_rescue"] = as_bool(
        df["target__resnet_rescue"]
    )

    df["target_mobile_rescue"] = as_bool(
        df["target__mobile_rescue"]
    )

    df["target_resnet_harm"] = as_bool(
        df["target__resnet_harm"]
    )

    df["target_mobile_harm"] = as_bool(
        df["target__mobile_harm"]
    )

    df["actual_rescue"] = False
    df["actual_harm"] = False

    resnet_selected = (
        df["selected_model"] == RESNET
    )

    mobile_selected = (
        df["selected_model"] == MOBILE
    )

    transition = df["v317_transition"]

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # RESNET
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_rescue = (
        transition
        & resnet_selected
        & df["target_efficientnet_error"]
        & df["target_resnet_rescue"]
    )

    resnet_harm = (
        transition
        & resnet_selected
        & df["target_efficientnet_error"]
        & df["target_resnet_harm"]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # MOBILENET
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    mobile_rescue = (
        transition
        & mobile_selected
        & df["target_efficientnet_error"]
        & df["target_mobile_rescue"]
    )

    mobile_harm = (
        transition
        & mobile_selected
        & df["target_efficientnet_error"]
        & df["target_mobile_harm"]
    )

    df.loc[
        resnet_rescue | mobile_rescue,
        "actual_rescue"
    ] = True

    df.loc[
        resnet_harm | mobile_harm,
        "actual_harm"
    ] = True

    df["actual_neutral_transition"] = (
        transition
        & ~df["actual_rescue"]
        & ~df["actual_harm"]
    )

    # Catch logically impossible overlap
    overlap = (
        df["actual_rescue"]
        & df["actual_harm"]
    )

    if overlap.any():
        print(
            "WARNING: Rescue/harm overlap detected:",
            int(overlap.sum())
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Actual V3.17 outcome counts:"
    )

    print(
        f"Transitions         : {int(transition.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues             : {int(df['actual_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms               : {int(df['actual_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral transitions : "
        f"{int(df['actual_neutral_transition'].sum())}"
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# SPECIALIST-SPECIFIC ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def specialist_analysis(df):

    section(
        "SPECIALIST-SPECIFIC V3.17 OUTCOME ANALYSIS"
    )

    for model in [RESNET, MOBILE]:

        sub = df[
            df["v317_transition"]
            & (df["selected_model"] == model)
        ]

        print()
        print("-" * 80)
        print(model)
        print("-" * 80)

        print(
            f"Transitions : {len(sub)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Rescues     : {int(sub['actual_rescue'].sum())}"
        )

        print(
            f"Harms       : {int(sub['actual_harm'].sum())}"
        )

        print(
            f"Neutral     : {int(sub['actual_neutral_transition'].sum())}"
        )

        harms = int(
            sub["actual_harm"].sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            sub["actual_rescue"].sum()
        )

        if harms > 0:
            ratio = rescues / harms
        else:
            ratio = np.inf

        print(
            f"Rescue/Harm ratio : {ratio:.4f}"
        )


# =============================================================================
# FOLD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def fold_analysis(df):

    section(
        "FOLD-LEVEL ACTUAL V3.17 OUTCOME ANALYSIS"
    )

    rows = []

    for fold, sub in df.groupby(
        "outer_fold",
        sort=True
    ):

        transitions = int(
            sub["v317_transition"].sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            sub["actual_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            sub["actual_harm"].sum()
        )

        neutral = int(
            sub["actual_neutral_transition"].sum()
        )

        rows.append({
            "outer_fold": fold,
            "samples": len(sub),
            "transitions": transitions,
            "rescues": rescues,
            "harms": harms,
            "neutral": neutral,
            "net_gain": rescues - harms,
        })

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# V3.17 VS V3.15 OOF OUTCOME COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def compare_v317_with_oof(df):

    section(
        "V3.17 VS V3.15 OOF OUTCOME COMPARISON"
    )

    for col in [
        "oof__transition",
        "oof__rescue",
        "oof__harm",
        "oof__neutral_transition",
    ]:

        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = as_bool(df[col])

    print()
    print("Historical V3.15 OOF:")
    print(
        f"Transitions : "
        f"{int(df['oof__transition'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescues     : "
        f"{int(df['oof__rescue'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harms       : "
        f"{int(df['oof__harm'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Neutral     : "
        f"{int(df['oof__neutral_transition'].sum())}"
    )

    print()
    print("Identity-aligned V3.17:")
    print(
        f"Transitions : "
        f"{int(df['v317_transition'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescues     : "
        f"{int(df['actual_rescue'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harms       : "
        f"{int(df['actual_harm'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Neutral     : "
        f"{int(df['actual_neutral_transition'].sum())}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Row-level disagreement
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["transition_disagreement"] = (
        df["v317_transition"]
        != df["oof__transition"]
    )

    df["rescue_disagreement"] = (
        df["actual_rescue"]
        != df["oof__rescue"]
    )

    df["harm_disagreement"] = (
        df["actual_harm"]
        != df["oof__harm"]
    )

    print()
    print("Row-level disagreements:")
    print(
        f"Transition : "
        f"{int(df['transition_disagreement'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescue     : "
        f"{int(df['rescue_disagreement'].sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harm       : "
        f"{int(df['harm_disagreement'].sum())}"
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# ACCURACY ACCOUNTING
# =============================================================================

def accuracy_accounting(df):

    section(
        "IDENTITY-ALIGNED V3.17 ACCURACY ACCOUNTING"
    )

    if "base_correct" in df.columns:
        base_correct = as_bool(
            df["oof__base_correct"]
        )
    else:
        base_correct = None

    # Prefer actual V3.15 OOF base correctness if available.
    if "oof__base_correct" in df.columns:

        base_acc = (
            df["oof__base_correct"]
            .astype(float)
            .mean()
        )

        print(
            f"Baseline accuracy from V3.15 OOF : "
            f"{base_acc:.6f}"
        )

    else:
        print(
            "Baseline correctness column unavailable."
        )
        base_acc = np.nan

    rescues = int(
        df["actual_rescue"].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        df["actual_harm"].sum()
    )

    transitions = int(
        df["v317_transition"].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        df["actual_neutral_transition"].sum()
    )

    net_gain = rescues - harms

    print()
    print(
        f"V3.17 transitions : {transitions}"
    )
    print(
        f"V3.17 rescues     : {rescues}"
    )
    print(
        f"V3.17 harms       : {harms}"
    )
    print(
        f"V3.17 neutral     : {neutral}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Net gain          : {net_gain}"
    )

    if len(df) > 0:

        delta_pp = (
            net_gain / len(df)
        ) * 100.0

        print(
            f"Net accuracy delta: "
            f"{delta_pp:.4f} percentage points"
        )

        if not np.isnan(base_acc):

            estimated_acc = (
                base_acc
                + net_gain / len(df)
            )

            print(
                f"Estimated V3.17 accuracy: "
                f"{estimated_acc:.6f}"
            )

            print(
                f"Estimated V3.17 accuracy %: "
                f"{estimated_acc * 100:.4f}%"
            )

    if harms > 0:

        ratio = rescues / harms

        print(
            f"Rescue/Harm ratio : {ratio:.4f}"
        )

    else:

        print(
            "Rescue/Harm ratio : inf"
        )


# =============================================================================
# ACTUAL RESCUE/HARM TABLES
# =============================================================================

def save_outcome_tables(df):

    section(
        "SAVING ACTUAL V3.17 RESCUE / HARM TABLES"
    )

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True
    )

    rescue_columns = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "selected_model",
        "policy_type",
        "policy",
        "threshold",
        "score",
        "switch",
        "target_efficientnet_error",
        "target_resnet_rescue",
        "target_mobile_rescue",
        "target_resnet_harm",
        "target_mobile_harm",
        "actual_rescue",
        "actual_harm",
    ]

    harm_columns = rescue_columns

    rescue_df = df[
        df["actual_rescue"]
    ][
        [
            c for c in rescue_columns
            if c in df.columns
        ]
    ].copy()

    harm_df = df[
        df["actual_harm"]
    ][
        [
            c for c in harm_columns
            if c in df.columns
        ]
    ].copy()

    rescue_df.to_csv(
        RESCUES_CSV,
        index=False
    )

    harm_df.to_csv(
        HARMS_CSV,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved rescues : {RESCUES_CSV.resolve()}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved harms   : {HARMS_CSV.resolve()}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# RESCUE/HARM DETAIL
# =============================================================================

def print_outcome_details(df):

    section(
        "ACTUAL V3.17 RESCUE DETAILS"
    )

    rescues = df[
        df["actual_rescue"]
    ].copy()

    if len(rescues) == 0:

        print(
            "No actual V3.17 rescues found."
        )

    else:

        columns = [
            "row_index",
            "outer_fold",
            "selected_model",
            "policy_type",
            "policy",
            "threshold",
            "score",
            "target_efficientnet_error",
            "target_resnet_rescue",
            "target_mobile_rescue",
        ]

        columns = [
            c for c in columns
            if c in rescues.columns
        ]

        print(
            rescues[
                columns
            ].to_string(index=False)
        )

    section(
        "ACTUAL V3.17 HARM DETAILS"
    )

    harms = df[
        df["actual_harm"]
    ].copy()

    if len(harms) == 0:

        print(
            "No actual V3.17 harms found."
        )

    else:

        columns = [
            "row_index",
            "outer_fold",
            "selected_model",
            "policy_type",
            "policy",
            "threshold",
            "score",
            "target_efficientnet_error",
            "target_resnet_harm",
            "target_mobile_harm",
        ]

        columns = [
            c for c in columns
            if c in harms.columns
        ]

        print(
            harms[
                columns
            ].to_string(index=False)
        )


# =============================================================================
# CRITICAL RESCUE DISCREPANCY
# =============================================================================

def analyze_historical_rescue_discrepancy(df):

    section(
        "HISTORICAL ~120 RESCUE DISCREPANCY"
    )

    historical = int(
        df["oof__rescue"].sum()
    )

    actual = int(
        df["actual_rescue"].sum()
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 OOF rescue count : {historical}"
    )

    print(
        f"Actual V3.17 rescues   : {actual}"
    )

    print(
        f"Difference             : {historical - actual}"
    )

    print()

    # Historical OOF rescue but not actual V3.17 rescue
    historical_only = df[
        df["oof__rescue"]
        & ~df["actual_rescue"]
    ]

    actual_only = df[
        df["actual_rescue"]
        & ~df["oof__rescue"]
    ]

    print(
        "V3.15 OOF rescue but NOT actual V3.17 rescue:",
        len(historical_only)
    )

    print(
        "Actual V3.17 rescue but NOT V3.15 OOF rescue:",
        len(actual_only)
    )

    print()

    if len(historical_only) > 0:

        print(
            "Why historical OOF rescues do not become V3.17 rescues:"
        )

        reasons = []

        for _, row in historical_only.iterrows():

            selected = row["selected_model"]

            if selected == EFFNET:

                reason = "V3.17 stayed with EfficientNet"

            elif selected == RESNET:

                if not row["target_resnet_rescue"]:
                    reason = (
                        "V3.17 selected ResNet, "
                        "but ResNet target is not rescue"
                    )
                else:
                    reason = (
                        "V3.17 selected ResNet rescue; "
                        "OOF disagreement is policy-level"
                    )

            elif selected == MOBILE:

                if not row["target_mobile_rescue"]:
                    reason = (
                        "V3.17 selected MobileNet, "
                        "but MobileNet target is not rescue"
                    )
                else:
                    reason = (
                        "V3.17 selected MobileNet rescue; "
                        "OOF disagreement is policy-level"
                    )

            else:

                reason = "Unknown selected model"

            reasons.append(reason)

        print(
            pd.Series(reasons)
            .value_counts()
            .to_string()
        )


# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def build_summary(df, fold_df):

    section(
        "FINAL IDENTITY-ALIGNED DIAGNOSIS"
    )

    transitions = int(
        df["v317_transition"].sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        df["actual_rescue"].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        df["actual_harm"].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        df["actual_neutral_transition"].sum()
    )

    oof_rescues = int(
        df["oof__rescue"].sum()
    )

    oof_harms = int(
        df["oof__harm"].sum()
    )

    model_mismatch = int(
        (
            df["selected_model"]
            != df["oof__selected_model"]
        ).sum()
    )

    print()
    print(
        "V3.17 identity-aligned results:"
    )

    print(
        f"  Transitions : {transitions}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Rescues     : {rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Harms       : {harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Neutral     : {neutral}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Historical V3.15 OOF:"
    )

    print(
        f"  Rescues     : {oof_rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Harms       : {oof_harms}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.17 ↔ V3.15 OOF selected-model mismatches: "
        f"{model_mismatch}"
    )

    print()

    if rescues > 0:

        print(
            f"Actual rescue rate among V3.17 transitions: "
            f"{rescues / transitions:.4f}"
        )

    if harms > 0:

        print(
            f"Actual harm rate among V3.17 transitions: "
            f"{harms / transitions:.4f}"
        )

    print()

    if rescues - harms > 0:

        print(
            "✓ V3.17 has positive net switching gain."
        )

    elif rescues - harms == 0:

        print(
            "⚠ V3.17 switching is net neutral."
        )

    else:

        print(
            "✗ V3.17 switching has negative net gain."
        )

    print()

    print(
        "MOST IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "The V3.15 OOF rescue count must NOT be interpreted as "
        "the number of actual V3.17 rescues."
    )

    print(
        "Actual V3.17 outcomes are determined by the model "
        "that V3.17 actually selected for each row."
    )

    print()

    if rescues != oof_rescues:

        print(
            "Therefore the historical ~120 rescue figure and the "
            "identity-aligned V3.17 rescue count are measuring "
            "different quantities."
        )

    print()

    print(
        "Do NOT train V3.23 until this identity-aligned outcome "
        "audit has been reviewed."
    )

    return {
        "v317_transitions": transitions,
        "v317_rescues": rescues,
        "v317_harms": harms,
        "v317_neutral": neutral,
        "v315_oof_rescues": oof_rescues,
        "v315_oof_harms": oof_harms,
        "selected_model_mismatches": model_mismatch,
    }

    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.17 IDENTITY-ALIGNED OUTCOME AUDIT"
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT modify existing artifacts."
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT perform positional V3.17 ↔ V3.15 OOF merging."
    )

    print(
        "V3.17 outcomes are evaluated using the model actually selected by V3.17."
    )

    v317, oof, targets = load_artifacts()

    audit_schema(
        v317,
        oof,
        targets
    )

    audit_identity(
        v317,
        oof
    )

    targets = attach_targets_to_oof(
        oof,
        targets
    )

    df = build_identity_dataframe(
        v317,
        oof,
        targets
    )

    df = analyze_transitions(
        df
    )

    df = reconstruct_actual_outcomes(
        df
    )

    specialist_analysis(
        df
    )

    fold_df = fold_analysis(
        df
    )

    df = compare_v317_with_oof(
        df
    )

    accuracy_accounting(
        df
    )

    analyze_historical_rescue_discrepancy(
        df
    )

    print_outcome_details(
        df
    )

    summary = build_summary(
        df,
        fold_df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SAVE
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "SAVING AUDIT OUTPUTS"
    )

    OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True
    )

    df.to_csv(
        FORENSIC_CSV,
        index=False
    )

    print(
        f"Saved forensic dataframe:"
    )

    print(
        f"  {FORENSIC_CSV.resolve()}"
    )

    save_outcome_tables(
        df
    )

    save_summary(
        summary,
        fold_df
    )

    section(
        "AUDIT COMPLETED"
    )

    print(
        "✓ V3.17 identity-aligned outcome audit completed."
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Output directory:"
    )

    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR.resolve()
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.17 OUTCOME DEFINITION AUDIT
==============================

Purpose
-------
Independently determine the actual outcome of every V3.17 transition.

This script:

1. Loads V3.17 test predictions.
2. Loads V3.15 identity-aligned target information.
3. Uses V3.15 OOF row_index to inherit identity for the target matrix.
4. Aligns all target information by row_index.
5. Evaluates the model actually selected by V3.17.
6. Defines:

       RESCUE
           EfficientNet was wrong
           AND selected specialist was correct

       HARM
           EfficientNet was correct
           AND selected specialist was wrong

       NEUTRAL
           Transition happened but neither rescue nor harm occurred

       NO TRANSITION
           V3.17 stayed with EfficientNet

7. Performs extensive consistency checks.
8. Saves forensic and summary outputs.

IMPORTANT
---------
- Does NOT modify any existing artifact.
- Does NOT perform positional V3.17 <-> V3.15 merging.
- V3.15 target rows are mapped to row_index using the validated
  V3.15 OOF identity table.
"""

def section(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def require_file(path, name):
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"{name} not found:\n{path.resolve()}"
        )
    return path


def normalize_bool(series):
    """
    Robustly convert a pandas Series into strict boolean values.

    Handles:
        True / False
        1 / 0
        strings
        NaN
    """

    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return series.fillna(False).astype(bool)

    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        return (
            pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce")
            .fillna(0)
            .ne(0)
        )

    text = (
        series
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
    )

    true_values = {
        "true",
        "1",
        "yes",
        "y",
        "t",
    }

    false_values = {
        "false",
        "0",
        "no",
        "n",
        "f",
        "",
        "nan",
        "none",
        "null",
    }

    result = pd.Series(
        False,
        index=series.index,
        dtype=bool,
    )

    result.loc[text.isin(true_values)] = True

    unknown = ~text.isin(
        true_values | false_values
    )

    if unknown.any():
        raise ValueError(
            "Unable to safely convert boolean values.\n"
            f"Unknown values: {sorted(text[unknown].unique().tolist())[:20]}"
        )

    return result


def normalize_model(series):
    return (
        series
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
    )


def assert_unique(df, column, name):
    duplicates = df[column].duplicated().sum()

    if duplicates:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{name} contains {duplicates} duplicate "
            f"{column} identities."
        )


def percentage(x, denominator):
    if denominator == 0:
        return 0.0
    return 100.0 * float(x) / float(denominator)

def load_artifacts():
    section("LOADING ARTIFACTS")

    require_file(
        V317_PREDICTIONS,
        "V3.17 predictions",
    )

    require_file(
        V315_TARGETS,
        "V3.15 targets",
    )

    require_file(
        V315_OOF,
        "V3.15 OOF",
    )

    v317 = pd.read_csv(V317_PREDICTIONS)
    targets = pd.read_csv(V315_TARGETS)
    oof = pd.read_csv(V315_OOF)

    print(
        f"V3.17 predictions : {v317.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 targets     : {targets.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.15 OOF         : {oof.shape}"
    )

    if V317_FORENSIC.exists():
        forensic = pd.read_csv(V317_FORENSIC)
        print(
            f"V3.17 forensic    : {forensic.shape}"
        )
    else:
        forensic = None
        print(
            "V3.17 forensic    : not found "
            "(optional)"
        )

    return v317, targets, oof, forensic


# =============================================================================
# SCHEMA VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_schema(v317, targets, oof):
    section("SCHEMA VALIDATION")

    missing_v317 = [
        c for c in REQUIRED_V317_COLUMNS
        if c not in v317.columns
    ]

    missing_targets = [
        c for c in REQUIRED_TARGET_COLUMNS
        if c not in targets.columns
    ]

    missing_oof = [
        c for c in REQUIRED_OOF_COLUMNS
        if c not in oof.columns
    ]

    if missing_v317:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Missing V3.17 columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"  - {x}" for x in missing_v317
            )
        )

    if missing_targets:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Missing V3.15 target columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"  - {x}" for x in missing_targets
            )
        )

    if missing_oof:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Missing V3.15 OOF columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"  - {x}" for x in missing_oof
            )
        )

    print("✓ V3.17 required columns present.")
    print("✓ V3.15 target columns present.")
    print("✓ V3.15 OOF identity columns present.")


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY ALIGNMENT
# =============================================================================

def build_identity_aligned_target_table(
    v317,
    targets,
    oof,
):
    section("BUILDING IDENTITY-ALIGNED TARGET TABLE")

    v317 = v317.copy()
    targets = targets.copy()
    oof = oof.copy()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize identities
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    v317["row_index"] = pd.to_numeric(
        v317["row_index"],
        errors="raise",
    ).astype(int)

    oof["row_index"] = pd.to_numeric(
        oof["row_index"],
        errors="raise",
    ).astype(int)

    assert_unique(
        v317,
        "row_index",
        "V3.17 predictions",
    )

    assert_unique(
        oof,
        "row_index",
        "V3.15 OOF",
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate V3.15 OOF identity coverage
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    expected = set(
        range(len(oof))
    )

    actual = set(
        oof["row_index"].tolist()
    )

    if actual != expected:
        missing = sorted(expected - actual)
        extra = sorted(actual - expected)

        raise RuntimeError(
            "V3.15 OOF row_index is not a complete "
            "0..N-1 identity set.\n"
            f"Missing: {missing[:20]}\n"
            f"Extra: {extra[:20]}"
        )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Target matrix has NO row_index.
    #
    # Therefore the only legitimate way to recover target
    # identity is:
    #
    #     target row position
    #           ↓
    #     V3.15 OOF row position
    #           ↓
    #     OOF row_index
    #
    # This is NOT an assumption. It is the validated artifact
    # construction relationship established by the previous
    # identity audit.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    if len(targets) != len(oof):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "V3.15 targets and OOF row counts differ.\n"
            f"Targets: {len(targets)}\n"
            f"OOF:     {len(oof)}"
        )

    target_identity = oof[
        ["row_index", "outer_fold"]
    ].copy()

    for col in REQUIRED_TARGET_COLUMNS:
        target_identity[col] = targets[col].values

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity diagnostics
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    v317_ids = set(
        v317["row_index"]
    )

    target_ids = set(
        target_identity["row_index"]
    )

    common = v317_ids & target_ids

    only_v317 = v317_ids - target_ids
    only_target = target_ids - v317_ids

    print(
        f"V3.17 identities : {len(v317_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Target identities: {len(target_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Common identities : {len(common)}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17-only        : {len(only_v317)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Target-only       : {len(only_target)}"
    )

    if only_v317 or only_target:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "V3.17 and target identity sets do not match."
        )

    print(
        "✓ Exact identity set match."
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge by identity
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    aligned = v317.merge(
        target_identity,
        on="row_index",
        how="left",
        suffixes=(
            "",
            "_target",
        ),
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    if len(aligned) != len(v317):
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Identity merge changed V3.17 row count."
        )

    for col in REQUIRED_TARGET_COLUMNS:
        if aligned[col].isna().any():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Missing target values after identity "
                f"alignment for {col}."
            )

    print(
        f"Identity-aligned dataframe: {aligned.shape}"
    )

    return aligned


# =============================================================================
# TARGET NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

def normalize_targets(df):
    section("NORMALIZING IDENTITY-ALIGNED TARGETS")

    df = df.copy()

    for col in REQUIRED_TARGET_COLUMNS:
        df[col] = normalize_bool(
            df[col]
        )

    print(
        f"EfficientNet errors : "
        f"{int(df['efficientnet_error'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"EfficientNet correct: "
        f"{int((~df['efficientnet_error']).sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"ResNet rescues      : "
        f"{int(df['resnet_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"ResNet harms        : "
        f"{int(df['resnet_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"MobileNet rescues   : "
        f"{int(df['mobile_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"MobileNet harms     : "
        f"{int(df['mobile_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate rescue/harm logical consistency
    #
    # A rescue must happen when EfficientNet is wrong.
    # A harm must happen when EfficientNet is correct.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    invalid_resnet_rescue = (
        df["resnet_rescue"]
        & ~df["efficientnet_error"]
    )

    invalid_mobile_rescue = (
        df["mobile_rescue"]
        & ~df["efficientnet_error"]
    )

    invalid_resnet_harm = (
        df["resnet_harm"]
        & df["efficientnet_error"]
    )

    invalid_mobile_harm = (
        df["mobile_harm"]
        & df["efficientnet_error"]
    )

    if invalid_resnet_rescue.any():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Found ResNet rescue targets where "
            "EfficientNet was not erroneous."
        )

    if invalid_mobile_rescue.any():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Found MobileNet rescue targets where "
            "EfficientNet was not erroneous."
        )

    if invalid_resnet_harm.any():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Found ResNet harm targets where "
            "EfficientNet was erroneous."
        )

    if invalid_mobile_harm.any():
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Found MobileNet harm targets where "
            "EfficientNet was erroneous."
        )

    print(
        "✓ Rescue/harm target consistency checks passed."
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# RECONSTRUCT ACTUAL V3.17 OUTCOMES
# =============================================================================

def reconstruct_outcomes(df):
    section(
        "RECONSTRUCTING ACTUAL V3.17 OUTCOME DEFINITIONS"
    )

    df = df.copy()

    df["selected_model"] = normalize_model(
        df["selected_model"]
    )

    df["v317_transition"] = normalize_bool(
        df["switch"]
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # EfficientNet correctness
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df["efficientnet_error_actual"] = (
        df["efficientnet_error"]
        .astype(bool)
    )

    df["efficientnet_correct"] = (
        ~df["efficientnet_error_actual"]
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Specialist correctness
    #
    # IMPORTANT:
    # We intentionally use pandas nullable Boolean dtype.
    #
    # There is no reason to fill unknown specialist correctness
    # with np.nan in a float column and later assign bools.
    #
    # This directly fixes the pandas 3.x error encountered before.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df["resnet_correct"] = pd.Series(
        pd.NA,
        index=df.index,
        dtype="boolean",
    )

    df["mobile_correct"] = pd.Series(
        pd.NA,
        index=df.index,
        dtype="boolean",
    )

    # ResNet rescue -> ResNet correct
    resnet_rescue_mask = (
        df["resnet_rescue"]
        & df["efficientnet_error_actual"]
    )

    # ResNet harm -> ResNet incorrect
    resnet_harm_mask = (
        df["resnet_harm"]
        & df["efficientnet_correct"]
    )

    df.loc[
        resnet_rescue_mask,
        "resnet_correct"
    ] = True

    df.loc[
        resnet_harm_mask,
        "resnet_correct"
    ] = False

    # MobileNet
    mobile_rescue_mask = (
        df["mobile_rescue"]
        & df["efficientnet_error_actual"]
    )

    mobile_harm_mask = (
        df["mobile_harm"]
        & df["efficientnet_correct"]
    )

    df.loc[
        mobile_rescue_mask,
        "mobile_correct"
    ] = True

    df.loc[
        mobile_harm_mask,
        "mobile_correct"
    ] = False

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Selected specialist masks
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    resnet_selected = (
        df["selected_model"] == RESNET
    )

    mobile_selected = (
        df["selected_model"] == MOBILENET
    )

    efficientnet_selected = (
        df["selected_model"] == EFFICIENTNET
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # ACTUAL V3.17 RESCUE
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df["independent_rescue"] = False

    resnet_actual_rescue = (
        resnet_selected
        & df["v317_transition"]
        & df["resnet_rescue"]
    )

    mobile_actual_rescue = (
        mobile_selected
        & df["v317_transition"]
        & df["mobile_rescue"]
    )

    df.loc[
        resnet_actual_rescue,
        "independent_rescue"
    ] = True

    df.loc[
        mobile_actual_rescue,
        "independent_rescue"
    ] = True

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # ACTUAL V3.17 HARM
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df["independent_harm"] = False

    resnet_actual_harm = (
        resnet_selected
        & df["v317_transition"]
        & df["resnet_harm"]
    )

    mobile_actual_harm = (
        mobile_selected
        & df["v317_transition"]
        & df["mobile_harm"]
    )

    df.loc[
        resnet_actual_harm,
        "independent_harm"
    ] = True

    df.loc[
        mobile_actual_harm,
        "independent_harm"
    ] = True

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # NEUTRAL
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df["independent_neutral"] = (
        df["v317_transition"]
        & ~df["independent_rescue"]
        & ~df["independent_harm"]
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # NO TRANSITION
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df["independent_no_transition"] = (
        ~df["v317_transition"]
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Aliases used by diagnostic functions
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df["v317_rescue"] = (
        df["independent_rescue"]
    )

    df["v317_harm"] = (
        df["independent_harm"]
    )

    df["v317_neutral"] = (
        df["independent_neutral"]
    )

    df["v317_no_transition"] = (
        df["independent_no_transition"]
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Partition validation
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    outcome_sum = (
        df["independent_rescue"].astype(int)
        + df["independent_harm"].astype(int)
        + df["independent_neutral"].astype(int)
        + df["independent_no_transition"].astype(int)
    )

    invalid_partition = (
        outcome_sum != 1
    )

    if invalid_partition.any():
        print(
            "\nINVALID OUTCOME ROWS:"
        )

        print(
            df.loc[
                invalid_partition,
                [
                    "row_index",
                    "outer_fold",
                    "selected_model",
                    "v317_transition",
                    "resnet_rescue",
                    "mobile_rescue",
                    "resnet_harm",
                    "mobile_harm",
                    "independent_rescue",
                    "independent_harm",
                    "independent_neutral",
                    "independent_no_transition",
                ],
            ]
            .head(30)
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

        raise RuntimeError(
            "Rescue / harm / neutral / no-transition "
            "do not form a complete partition."
        )

    section(
        "INDEPENDENT OUTCOME RECONSTRUCTION COMPLETE"
    )

    print(
        "✓ Correctness reconstructed from "
        "identity-aligned target information."
    )

    print(
        "✓ No raw prediction columns were required."
    )

    print(
        "✓ No positional V3.17 ↔ V3.15 merge "
        "was performed during outcome reconstruction."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Rescue / harm / neutral / no-transition "
        "form a complete partition."
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# BASIC OUTCOME SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def outcome_summary(df):
    section(
        "INDEPENDENT V3.17 OUTCOME COUNTS"
    )

    transitions = int(
        df["v317_transition"].sum()
    )

    rescues = int(
        df["independent_rescue"].sum()
    )

    harms = int(
        df["independent_harm"].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        df["independent_neutral"].sum()
    )

    no_transition = int(
        df["independent_no_transition"].sum()
    )

    total = len(df)

    print(
        f"Transitions         : {transitions}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues             : {rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms               : {harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral transitions : {neutral}"
    )

    print(
        f"No transition       : {no_transition}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Outcome total       : "
        f"{rescues + harms + neutral + no_transition}"
    )

    print(
        f"Dataset total       : {total}"
    )

    if (
        rescues
        + harms
        + neutral
        + no_transition
    ) != total:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Outcome total does not equal dataset total."
        )

    net_gain = rescues - harms

    rescue_rate = (
        rescues / transitions
        if transitions
        else 0.0
    )

    if harms:
        rescue_harm_ratio = (
            rescues / harms
        )
    else:
        rescue_harm_ratio = np.inf

    section(
        "NET SWITCHING ACCOUNTING"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues     : {rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms       : {harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net gain    : {net_gain}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue rate : {rescue_rate:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm ratio : "
        f"{rescue_harm_ratio:.6f}"
        if np.isfinite(rescue_harm_ratio)
        else "Rescue/Harm ratio : inf"
    )

    return {
        "transitions": transitions,
        "rescues": rescues,
        "harms": harms,
        "neutral": neutral,
        "no_transition": no_transition,
        "net_gain": net_gain,
        "rescue_rate": rescue_rate,
        "rescue_harm_ratio": rescue_harm_ratio,
    }


# =============================================================================
# SELECTED MODEL BREAKDOWN
# =============================================================================

def selected_model_analysis(df):
    section(
        "SELECTED MODEL OUTCOME BREAKDOWN"
    )

    rows = []

    for model in [
        EFFICIENTNET,
        RESNET,
        MOBILENET,
    ]:

        subset = df[
            df["selected_model"] == model
        ]

        transitions = int(
            subset["v317_transition"].sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            subset["independent_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            subset["independent_harm"].sum()
        )

        neutral = int(
            subset["independent_neutral"].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "selected_model": model,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "transitions": transitions,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "neutral": neutral,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# FOLD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def fold_analysis(df):
    section(
        "FOLD-LEVEL INDEPENDENT OUTCOME BREAKDOWN"
    )

    rows = []

    for fold in sorted(
        df["outer_fold"].unique()
    ):

        subset = df[
            df["outer_fold"] == fold
        ]

        transitions = int(
            subset["v317_transition"].sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            subset["independent_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            subset["independent_harm"].sum()
        )

        neutral = int(
            subset["independent_neutral"].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "outer_fold": fold,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "transitions": transitions,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "neutral": neutral,
                "net_gain": rescues - harms,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result

# CRITICAL ZERO-HARM INVESTIGATION
# =============================================================================

def investigate_zero_harm(df):
    section(
        "CRITICAL HARM / TRANSITION INVESTIGATION"
    )

    transitions = df[
        df["v317_transition"]
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Total V3.17 transitions : "
        f"{len(transitions)}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "EfficientNet correctness among transitions:"
    )

    print(
        f"  EfficientNet wrong   : "
        f"{int(transitions['efficientnet_error_actual'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  EfficientNet correct : "
        f"{int(transitions['efficientnet_correct'].sum())}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "Actual transition outcomes:"
    )

    print(
        f"  Rescues : "
        f"{int(transitions['independent_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Harms   : "
        f"{int(transitions['independent_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Neutral : "
        f"{int(transitions['independent_neutral'].sum())}"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Logical accounting
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    wrong = transitions[
        transitions["efficientnet_error_actual"]
    ]

    correct = transitions[
        transitions["efficientnet_correct"]
    ]

    print()
    print(
        "When EfficientNet is WRONG:"
    )

    print(
        f"  transitions : {len(wrong)}"
    )

    print(
        f"  rescues     : "
        f"{int(wrong['independent_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  harms       : "
        f"{int(wrong['independent_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  neutral     : "
        f"{int(wrong['independent_neutral'].sum())}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "When EfficientNet is CORRECT:"
    )

    print(
        f"  transitions : {len(correct)}"
    )

    print(
        f"  rescues     : "
        f"{int(correct['independent_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  harms       : "
        f"{int(correct['independent_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  neutral     : "
        f"{int(correct['independent_neutral'].sum())}"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Selected model × EfficientNet correctness
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print(
        "Transition matrix: selected model × "
        "EfficientNet correctness"
    )

    matrix = pd.crosstab(
        transitions["selected_model"],
        transitions["efficientnet_correct"],
        rownames=["selected_model"],
        colnames=["efficientnet_correct"],
    )

    print(
        matrix.to_string()
    )

    return transitions

# TARGET VS ACTUAL SELECTED OUTCOME ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def target_consistency_analysis(df):
    section(
        "TARGET CONSISTENCY / ACTUAL SELECTION ANALYSIS"
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # ResNet
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    for name, target_col in [
        ("resnet_rescue", "resnet_rescue"),
        ("mobile_rescue", "mobile_rescue"),
        ("resnet_harm", "resnet_harm"),
        ("mobile_harm", "mobile_harm"),
    ]:

        stored = int(
            df[target_col].sum()
        )

        if name == "resnet_rescue":
            target = int(
                df[
                    df["resnet_rescue"]
                ][target_col].sum()
            )
        else:
            target = stored

        print()
        print(name)
        print(
            f"  stored positives : {stored}"
        )
        print(
            f"  target positives : {target}"
        )
        print(
            f"  mismatches       : {stored - target}"
        )

# SUMMARY

def write_summary(
    df,
    summary,
    model_result,
    fold_result,
):
    section(
        "WRITING AUDIT SUMMARY"
    )

    FORENSIC_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "V3.17 OUTCOME DEFINITION AUDIT"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 100
    )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Identity alignment"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"V3.17 rows: {len(df)}"
    )

    lines.append(
        "V3.17 and V3.15 target identities: exact match"
    )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Actual V3.17 outcomes"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Transitions: {summary['transitions']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Rescues: {summary['rescues']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Harms: {summary['harms']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Neutral transitions: {summary['neutral']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"No transition: {summary['no_transition']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Net gain: {summary['net_gain']}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Rescue rate among transitions: "
        f"{summary['rescue_rate']:.6f}"
    )

    if np.isfinite(
        summary["rescue_harm_ratio"]
    ):
        lines.append(
            f"Rescue/Harm ratio: "
            f"{summary['rescue_harm_ratio']:.6f}"
        )
    else:
        lines.append(
            "Rescue/Harm ratio: inf"
        )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Selected model breakdown"
    )

    lines.append(
        model_result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Fold breakdown"
    )

    lines.append(
        fold_result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Interpretation"
    )

    if summary["harms"] == 0:
        lines.append(
            "No actual V3.17 harms were identified."
        )
    else:
        lines.append(
            "Actual V3.17 harms were identified."
        )

    if summary["net_gain"] > 0:
        lines.append(
            "V3.17 has positive net switching gain."
        )
    elif summary["net_gain"] < 0:
        lines.append(
            "V3.17 has negative net switching gain."
        )
    else:
        lines.append(
            "V3.17 has zero net switching gain."
        )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "The V3.15 rescue/harm target counts are NOT "
        "equivalent to actual V3.17 outcomes."
    )

    lines.append(
        "Actual V3.17 outcomes depend on the model "
        "that V3.17 actually selected."
    )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "This audit does not modify any V3.17 artifact."
    )

    SUMMARY_OUTPUT.write_text(
        "\n".join(lines),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )

    print(
        f"Saved summary: {SUMMARY_OUTPUT}"
    )

    section(

    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 transitions : "
        f"{summary['transitions']}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 rescues     : "

        f"V3.17 harms       : "
        f"{summary['harms']}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 neutral     : "
        f"{summary['neutral']}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 net gain     : "
        f"{summary['net_gain']}"
    )

    print()

    if summary["harms"] > 0:
        print(
            "✓ Actual V3.17 harms are present."
        )

        print(
            "✓ Harm-aware rescue discrimination "
            "is therefore a meaningful next experiment."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "⚠ No actual V3.17 harms were detected."
        )

    print()

    if summary["net_gain"] > 0:
        print(
            "✓ V3.17 switching is net-positive."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "⚠ V3.17 switching is not net-positive."
        )

    print()
    print(
        "MOST IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "The historical V3.15 rescue count must not "
        "be interpreted as the actual V3.17 rescue count."
    )

    print(
        "The correct V3.17 outcome is determined by:"
    )

    print(
        "  1. Whether V3.17 switched."
    )

    print(
        "  2. Which specialist V3.17 selected."
    )

    print(
        "  3. The identity-aligned rescue/harm target "
        "for that selected specialist."
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.17 OUTCOME DEFINITION AUDIT"
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT modify existing artifacts."
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT perform positional "
        "V3.17 ↔ V3.15 merging."
    )

    print(
        "It independently reconstructs rescue/harm definitions."
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    (
        v317,
        targets,
        oof,
        forensic,
    ) = load_artifacts()

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    validate_schema(
        v317,
        targets,
        oof,
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity alignment
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df = build_identity_aligned_target_table(
        v317,
        targets,
        oof,
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize target information
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df = normalize_targets(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Reconstruct outcomes
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    df = reconstruct_outcomes(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    summary = outcome_summary(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Model analysis
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    model_result = selected_model_analysis(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Fold analysis
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    fold_result = fold_analysis(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Harm investigation
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    investigate_zero_harm(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Specialist analysis
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    specialist_harm_analysis(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Target consistency
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    target_consistency_analysis(
        df
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Save outputs
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    save_forensic(
        df
    )

    save_rescue_harm_tables(
        df
    )

    write_summary(
        df,
        summary,
        model_result,
        fold_result,
    )

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Final diagnosis
    # ---------------------------------------------------------

    final_diagnosis(
        df,
        summary,
    )

    section(
        "AUDIT COMPLETED"
    )

    print(
        "✓ V3.17 outcome definition audit completed."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Output directory:"
    )

    print(
        FORENSIC_DIR
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
V3.23 HARM-AWARE RESCUE DISCRIMINATOR

Purpose
-------
Train a harm-aware discriminator for the V3.17 dynamic-selection policy.

Authoritative outcome definition
---------------------------------
The actual V3.17 outcome is reconstructed from:

    selected_model
    target_efficientnet_error
    target_resnet_rescue
    target_mobile_rescue
    target_resnet_harm
    target_mobile_harm

A transition is defined as:

    selected_model != efficientnet_v2_s

A rescue is:

    transition AND EfficientNet was wrong
    AND selected specialist was correct

A harm is:

    transition AND EfficientNet was correct
    AND selected specialist was wrong

Neutral is:

    transition AND both models have the same correctness

No transition is:

    selected_model == efficientnet_v2_s

IMPORTANT
---------
This script does NOT modify existing artifacts.

It does NOT perform positional V3.17 <-> V3.15 OOF merging.

The V3.15 target matrix is attached to V3.17 row_index only after
identity/count validation because the target matrix contains no identity
columns.

The goal is to train a classifier that distinguishes:

    GOOD SWITCH
        from
    BAD SWITCH

using only information available to the selector.
"""

def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def safe_float(x):
    try:
        value = float(x)
        if np.isfinite(value):
            return value
    except Exception:
        pass
    return np.nan


# =============================================================================
# BOOLEAN NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

TRUE_VALUES = {
    True,
    1,
    1.0,
    "1",
    "1.0",
    "true",
    "True",
    "TRUE",
    "yes",
    "Yes",
    "YES",
    "y",
    "Y",
}

FALSE_VALUES = {
    False,
    0,
    0.0,
    "0",
    "0.0",
    "false",
    "False",
    "FALSE",
    "no",
    "No",
    "NO",
    "n",
    "N",
}


def normalize_bool_series(
    series: pd.Series,
    name: str,
) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Robustly convert a heterogeneous pandas series into dtype=bool.

    Missing values are treated as False only after explicit validation.
    """

    def convert(value):

        if pd.isna(value):
            return False

        if value in TRUE_VALUES:
            return True

        if value in FALSE_VALUES:
            return False

        if isinstance(value, str):
            lowered = value.strip().lower()

            if lowered in {"true", "yes", "y", "1", "1.0"}:
                return True

            if lowered in {"false", "no", "n", "0", "0.0"}:
                return False

        if isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
            if float(value) == 1.0:
                return True

            if float(value) == 0.0:
                return False

        raise ValueError(
            f"Cannot normalize value {value!r} "
            f"in boolean column '{name}'."
        )

    result = series.map(convert)

    return result.astype(bool)


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY HELPERS
# =============================================================================

def validate_identity_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    name: str,
) -> None:

    required = {
        "outer_fold",
        "row_index",
    }

    missing = required - set(df.columns)

    if missing:
        fail(
            f"{name} is missing identity columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in sorted(missing))
        )


def identity_set(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> set:

    return set(
        zip(
            df["outer_fold"].astype(int),
            df["row_index"].astype(int),
        )
    )

def load_artifacts() -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:

    section("LOADING V3.17 ARTIFACTS")

    if not PREDICTION_PATH.exists():
        fail(f"Missing V3.17 prediction file:\n{PREDICTION_PATH}")

    if not FORENSIC_PATH.exists():
        fail(f"Missing V3.17 forensic file:\n{FORENSIC_PATH}")

    if not TARGET_PATH.exists():
        fail(f"Missing V3.15 target file:\n{TARGET_PATH}")

    v317 = pd.read_csv(PREDICTION_PATH)
    forensic = pd.read_csv(FORENSIC_PATH)
    targets = pd.read_csv(TARGET_PATH)

    print(f"V3.17 predictions : {v317.shape}")
    print(f"V3.17 forensic    : {forensic.shape}")
    print(f"V3.15 targets     : {targets.shape}")

    print(f"Predictions path  : {PREDICTION_PATH}")
    print(f"Forensic path     : {FORENSIC_PATH}")
    print(f"Target path       : {TARGET_PATH}")

    return v317, forensic, targets

def validate_schema(

    print("✓ V3.17 required columns present.")
    print("✓ V3.17 identity columns present.")

    if missing_target:
        fail(

            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in sorted(missing_target))
