    print("✓ V3.15 target columns present.")

    if len(v317) != len(targets):
        fail(
            "V3.17 predictions and target matrix have different rowcounts:\n"
            f"  V3.17 : {len(v317)}\n"
            f"  target: {len(targets)}"
        )

    print(
        "✓ Target matrix rowcount matches V3.17 predictions."
    )


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY VALIDATION
# =============================================================================

def validate_identities(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    v_ids = identity_set(v317)
    f_ids = identity_set(forensic)

    common = v_ids & f_ids

    print(f"V3.17 unique identities : {len(v_ids)}")
    print(f"Forensic unique identities: {len(f_ids)}")
    print(f"Common identities       : {len(common)}")
    print(f"V3.17-only              : {len(v_ids - f_ids)}")
    print(f"Forensic-only            : {len(f_ids - v_ids)}")

    if v_ids != f_ids:
        fail(
            "V3.17 and forensic identity sets do not match."
        )

    print("✓ Exact identity set match.")


# =============================================================================
# TARGET BUILDING
# =============================================================================

def build_authoritative_target_table(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    targets: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING AUTHORITATIVE IDENTITY-ALIGNED TARGET TABLE")

    print("Using target artifact:")
    print(f"  {TARGET_PATH}")

    if "outer_fold" in targets.columns and "row_index" in targets.columns:

        print(
            "Target artifact contains explicit identity columns."
        )

        target_table = targets.copy()

        target_table = target_table[
            [
                "outer_fold",
                "row_index",
                "resnet_rescue",
                "mobile_rescue",
                "efficientnet_error",
                "resnet_harm",
                "mobile_harm",
            ]
        ].copy()

        target_ids = identity_set(target_table)
        v_ids = identity_set(v317)

        if target_ids != v_ids:
            fail(
                "Explicit target identities do not match V3.17 identities."
            )

        return target_table

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # TARGET HAS NO IDENTITY COLUMNS
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print(
        "Target artifact has no explicit identity columns."
    )

    print(
        "Using validated V3.17 row_index identity only because "
        "the target artifact has exactly matching rowcount."
    )

    if len(targets) != len(v317):
        fail(
            "Cannot attach target matrix to V3.17 identities because "
            "rowcounts differ."
        )

    target_table = targets[
        [
            "resnet_rescue",
            "mobile_rescue",
            "efficientnet_error",
            "resnet_harm",
            "mobile_harm",
        ]
    ].copy()

    target_table.insert(
        0,
        "row_index",
        v317["row_index"].astype(int).to_numpy(),
    )

    target_table.insert(
        0,
        "outer_fold",
        v317["outer_fold"].astype(int).to_numpy(),
    )

    return target_table


# =============================================================================
# NORMALIZE TARGETS
# =============================================================================

def normalize_targets(
    target_table: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("NORMALIZING AUTHORITATIVE TARGETS")

    target_table = target_table.copy()

    bool_map = {
        "efficientnet_error": "target_efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_rescue": "target_resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue": "target_mobile_rescue",
        "resnet_harm": "target_resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm": "target_mobile_harm",
    }

    for source, destination in bool_map.items():

        target_table[destination] = normalize_bool_series(
            target_table[source],
            source,
        )

    print(
        "EfficientNet errors :",
        int(target_table["target_efficientnet_error"].sum()),
    )

    print(
        "EfficientNet correct:",
        int((~target_table["target_efficientnet_error"]).sum()),
    )

    print(
        "ResNet rescues      :",
        int(target_table["target_resnet_rescue"].sum()),
    )

    print(
        "ResNet harms        :",
        int(target_table["target_resnet_harm"].sum()),
    )

    print(
        "MobileNet rescues   :",
        int(target_table["target_mobile_rescue"].sum()),
    )

    print(
        "MobileNet harms     :",
        int(target_table["target_mobile_harm"].sum()),
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CONSISTENCY
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        target_table["target_resnet_rescue"]
        & target_table["target_resnet_harm"]
    ).any():

        fail(
            "A sample is simultaneously marked ResNet rescue and ResNet harm."
        )

    if (
        target_table["target_mobile_rescue"]
        & target_table["target_mobile_harm"]
    ).any():

        fail(
            "A sample is simultaneously marked MobileNet rescue and "
            "MobileNet harm."
        )

    print("✓ Rescue/harm target consistency checks passed.")

    return target_table


# =============================================================================
# FORENSIC MERGE
# =============================================================================

def build_training_table(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    target_table: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING IDENTITY-ALIGNED V3.23 TRAINING TABLE")

    v = v317.copy()
    f = forensic.copy()
    t = target_table.copy()

    for frame in [v, f, t]:

        frame["outer_fold"] = (
            frame["outer_fold"]
            .astype(int)
        )

        frame["row_index"] = (
            frame["row_index"]
            .astype(int)
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Remove duplicate identity columns from forensic before merge.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    forensic_extra = f.copy()

    duplicate_cols = [
        c
        for c in forensic_extra.columns
        if c not in {"outer_fold", "row_index"}
        and c in v.columns
    ]

    if duplicate_cols:
        forensic_extra = forensic_extra.drop(
            columns=duplicate_cols
        )

    df = v.merge(
        forensic_extra,
        on=["outer_fold", "row_index"],
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    df = df.merge(
        t,
        on=["outer_fold", "row_index"],
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    if len(df) != len(v317):
        fail(
            "Identity-aligned merge changed rowcount."
        )

    required_target_cols = [
        "target_efficientnet_error",
        "target_resnet_rescue",
        "target_mobile_rescue",
        "target_resnet_harm",
        "target_mobile_harm",
    ]

    for col in required_target_cols:

        if col not in df.columns:
            fail(
                f"Authoritative target column missing after merge: {col}"
            )

        if df[col].isna().any():
            fail(
                f"Authoritative target column contains missing values: {col}"
            )

    print(
        "Identity-aligned training dataframe:",
        df.shape,
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOME RECONSTRUCTION
# =============================================================================


def reconstruct_outcomes(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Reconstruct the authoritative V3.17 outcomes.

    IMPORTANT
    ---------
    Outcomes are defined exclusively from:

        1. V3.17 actual transition decision
        2. V3.17 selected specialist
        3. identity-aligned target matrix

    The four outcome classes are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE:

        RESCUE
        HARM
        NEUTRAL TRANSITION
        NO TRANSITION

    Definitions
    -----------

    Rescue:
        transition
        AND EfficientNet was wrong
        AND selected specialist has rescue target

    Harm:
        transition
        AND EfficientNet was correct
        AND selected specialist has harm target

    Neutral:
        transition
        AND not rescue
        AND not harm

    No transition:
        not transition
    """

    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print("RECONSTRUCTING AUTHORITATIVE V3.17 OUTCOMES")
    print("=" * 100)

    required = [
        "switch",
        "selected_model",

        "efficientnet_error_target",

        "resnet_rescue_target",
        "mobile_rescue_target",

        "resnet_harm_target",
        "mobile_harm_target",
    ]

    missing = [c for c in required if c not in df.columns]

    if missing:
        fail(
            "Missing columns required for authoritative outcome "
            "reconstruction:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in missing)
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Work on a copy.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = df.copy()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize transition.
    #
    # Do NOT use astype(bool) directly because strings such as
    # "False" would become True.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def normalize_bool(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
        if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
            return series.fillna(False).astype(bool)

        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
            return series.fillna(0).ne(0)

        normalized = (
            series
            .astype(str)
            .str.strip()
            .str.lower()
        )

        true_values = {
            "true",
            "1",
            "yes",
            "y",
            "t",
        }

        false_values = {
            "false",
            "0",
            "no",
            "n",
            "f",
            "",
            "nan",
            "none",
            "null",
        }

        result = pd.Series(
            False,
            index=series.index,
            dtype=bool,
        )

        result.loc[
            normalized.isin(true_values)
        ] = True

        unknown = ~normalized.isin(
            true_values | false_values
        )

        if unknown.any():
            bad = sorted(
                normalized.loc[unknown]
                .drop_duplicates()
                .tolist()
            )

            fail(
                "Unknown boolean values encountered in "
                f"column '{series.name}': {bad[:20]}"
            )

        return result

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize authoritative target columns.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    efficientnet_error = normalize_bool(
        df["efficientnet_error_target"]
    )

    resnet_rescue_target = normalize_bool(
        df["resnet_rescue_target"]
    )

    mobile_rescue_target = normalize_bool(
        df["mobile_rescue_target"]
    )

    resnet_harm_target = normalize_bool(
        df["resnet_harm_target"]
    )

    mobile_harm_target = normalize_bool(
        df["mobile_harm_target"]
    )

    transition = normalize_bool(
        df["switch"]
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine which specialist was actually selected.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    selected_model = (
        df["selected_model"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
    )

    is_resnet = (
        selected_model.eq("resnet50")
    )

    is_mobile = (
        selected_model.eq("mobilenet_v3_large")
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Selected-specialist rescue/harm targets.
    #
    # These are ONLY relevant when a transition actually occurred.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    selected_rescue_target = pd.Series(
        False,
        index=df.index,
        dtype=bool,
    )

    selected_harm_target = pd.Series(
        False,
        index=df.index,
        dtype=bool,
    )

    selected_rescue_target.loc[is_resnet] = (
        resnet_rescue_target.loc[is_resnet]
    )

    selected_rescue_target.loc[is_mobile] = (
        mobile_rescue_target.loc[is_mobile]
    )

    selected_harm_target.loc[is_resnet] = (
        resnet_harm_target.loc[is_resnet]
    )

    selected_harm_target.loc[is_mobile] = (
        mobile_harm_target.loc[is_mobile]
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # IMPORTANT:
    #
    # Rescue and harm are reconstructed independently from the
    # authoritative definition.
    #
    # Rescue:
    #   E wrong + selected specialist rescue target
    #
    # Harm:
    #   E correct + selected specialist harm target
    #
    # This prevents a rescue row from simultaneously becoming neutral.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    rescue = (
        transition
        & efficientnet_error
        & selected_rescue_target
    )

    harm = (
        transition
        & (~efficientnet_error)
        & selected_harm_target
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # NEUTRAL MUST BE COMPUTED LAST.
    #
    # This is the critical fix.
    #
    # It is impossible for neutral to overlap with rescue/harm.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    neutral = (
        transition
        & (~rescue)
        & (~harm)
    )

    no_transition = ~transition

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Force plain boolean dtype.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["v317_transition"] = transition.astype(bool)

    df["v317_rescue"] = rescue.astype(bool)

    df["v317_harm"] = harm.astype(bool)

    df["v317_neutral"] = neutral.astype(bool)

    df["v317_no_transition"] = (
        no_transition.astype(bool)
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Additional authoritative diagnostic columns.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["efficientnet_error_actual"] = (
        efficientnet_error.astype(bool)
    )

    df["efficientnet_correct"] = (
        (~efficientnet_error).astype(bool)
    )

    # Selected specialist correctness can be derived from:
    #
    #   rescue → specialist correct when E was wrong
    #   harm   → specialist wrong when E was correct
    #
    # But for diagnostic purposes we use the authoritative target
    # representation directly.
    #
    # If neither rescue nor harm is marked, correctness is inferred
    # from the relationship between E and the selected model.
    #
    # For transition accounting, this column is not used to define
    # the four outcome classes.

    resnet_correct = (
        resnet_rescue_target
        | (
            (~efficientnet_error)
            & (~resnet_harm_target)
        )
    )

    mobile_correct = (
        mobile_rescue_target
        | (
            (~efficientnet_error)
            & (~mobile_harm_target)
        )
    )

    df["resnet_correct"] = (
        resnet_correct.astype(bool)
    )

    df["mobile_correct"] = (
        mobile_correct.astype(bool)
    )

    df["independent_rescue"] = (
        df["v317_rescue"]
    )

    df["independent_harm"] = (
        df["v317_harm"]
    )

    df["independent_neutral"] = (
        df["v317_neutral"]
    )

    df["independent_no_transition"] = (
        df["v317_no_transition"]
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # HARD PARTITION VALIDATION
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    outcome_sum = (
        df["v317_rescue"].astype(int)
        + df["v317_harm"].astype(int)
        + df["v317_neutral"].astype(int)
        + df["v317_no_transition"].astype(int)
    )

    bad_partition = outcome_sum.ne(1)

    if bad_partition.any():

        bad = df.loc[
            bad_partition,
            [
                "row_index",
                "selected_model",
                "v317_transition",
                "efficientnet_error_actual",
                "v317_rescue",
                "v317_harm",
                "v317_neutral",
                "v317_no_transition",
            ],
        ].copy()

        print()
        print("INVALID OUTCOME PARTITION")
        print(bad.head(20).to_string(index=False))

        fail(
            "Rescue/harm/neutral/no-transition do not form "
            "a complete mutually-exclusive partition."
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Additional logical checks.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    # Rescue/harm/neutral must only occur during transitions.
    if (
        (
            df["v317_rescue"]
            & (~df["v317_transition"])
        ).any()
    ):
        fail(
            "Invalid outcome: rescue exists without transition."
        )

    if (
        (
            df["v317_harm"]
            & (~df["v317_transition"])
        ).any()
    ):
        fail(
            "Invalid outcome: harm exists without transition."
        )

    if (
        (
            df["v317_neutral"]
            & (~df["v317_transition"])
        ).any()
    ):
        fail(
            "Invalid outcome: neutral exists without transition."
        )

    # No-transition must never overlap with transition.
    if (
        (
            df["v317_no_transition"]
            & df["v317_transition"]
        ).any()
    ):
        fail(
            "Invalid outcome: no-transition overlaps transition."
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Print authoritative reconstruction.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("Outcome reconstruction:")
    print(
        f"  Transitions         : "
        f"{int(df['v317_transition'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Rescues             : "
        f"{int(df['v317_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Harms               : "
        f"{int(df['v317_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Neutral transitions : "
        f"{int(df['v317_neutral'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  No transition       : "
        f"{int(df['v317_no_transition'].sum())}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"  Outcome total       : "
        f"{int(outcome_sum.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Dataset total       : "
        f"{len(df)}"
    )

    print()
    print("✓ Outcome partition validated.")
    print("✓ Rescue, harm, neutral and no-transition are mutually exclusive.")
    print("✓ Every row belongs to exactly one outcome class.")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Expected authoritative V3.17 numbers from the preceding audit.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    actual_transitions = int(
        df["v317_transition"].sum()
    )

    actual_rescues = int(
        df["v317_rescue"].sum()
    )

    actual_harms = int(
        df["v317_harm"].sum()
    )

    actual_neutral = int(
        df["v317_neutral"].sum()
    )

    actual_no_transition = int(
        df["v317_no_transition"].sum()
    )

    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print("V3.17 AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOME SUMMARY")
    print("=" * 100)

    print(
        f"Transitions : {actual_transitions}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues     : {actual_rescues}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms       : {actual_harms}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral     : {actual_neutral}"
    )

    print(
        f"No switch   : {actual_no_transition}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net gain    : "
        f"{actual_rescues - actual_harms}"
    )

    if actual_transitions > 0:
        print(
            f"Rescue rate : "
            f"{actual_rescues / actual_transitions:.6f}"
        )

    if actual_harms > 0:
        print(
            f"Rescue/Harm : "
            f"{actual_rescues / actual_harms:.6f}"
        )
    else:
        print(
            "Rescue/Harm : inf"
        )

    return df

# =============================================================================
# OUTCOME SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def print_outcome_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("AUTHORITATIVE V3.17 OUTCOME SUMMARY")

    transitions = int(df["v317_transition"].sum())
    rescues = int(df["v317_rescue"].sum())
    harms = int(df["v317_harm"].sum())
    neutral = int(df["v317_neutral"].sum())
    no_transition = int(df["v317_no_transition"].sum())

    print(f"Transitions         : {transitions}")
    print(f"Rescues             : {rescues}")
    print(f"Harms               : {harms}")
    print(f"Neutral transitions : {neutral}")
    print(f"No transition       : {no_transition}")

    print()
    print(f"Net gain            : {rescues - harms}")

    if transitions > 0:
        print(
            f"Rescue rate         : "
            f"{rescues / transitions:.6f}"
        )

        if harms > 0:
            print(
                f"Rescue/Harm ratio   : "
                f"{rescues / harms:.6f}"
            )
        else:
            print(
                "Rescue/Harm ratio   : inf"
            )


# =============================================================================
# SELECTED MODEL BREAKDOWN
# =============================================================================

def selected_model_breakdown(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("SELECTED MODEL OUTCOME BREAKDOWN")

    rows = []

    for model in [
        EFFICIENTNET_NAME,
        RESNET_NAME,
        MOBILE_NAME,
    ]:

        subset = df[
            df["selected_model"].astype(str).str.strip()
            == model
        ]

        transitions = int(
            subset["v317_transition"].sum()
        )

        rescues = int(
            subset["v317_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            subset["v317_harm"].sum()
        )

        neutral = int(
            subset["v317_neutral"].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "selected_model": model,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "transitions": transitions,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "neutral": neutral,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# FOLD BREAKDOWN
# =============================================================================

def fold_breakdown(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("FOLD-LEVEL AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOME BREAKDOWN")

    rows = []

    for fold in sorted(
        df["outer_fold"].astype(int).unique()
    ):

        subset = df[
            df["outer_fold"].astype(int)
            == fold
        ]

        rescues = int(
            subset["v317_rescue"].sum()
        )

        harms = int(
            subset["v317_harm"].sum()
        )

        neutral = int(
            subset["v317_neutral"].sum()
        )

        transitions = int(
            subset["v317_transition"].sum()
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "outer_fold": fold,
                "samples": len(subset),
                "transitions": transitions,
                "rescues": rescues,
                "harms": harms,
                "neutral": neutral,
                "net_gain": rescues - harms,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    print(
        result.to_string(index=False)
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# BUILD SELECTOR FEATURES
# =============================================================================

def numeric_candidate_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> List[str]:

    excluded = {
        "outer_fold",
        "row_index",

        # targets
        "resnet_rescue",
        "mobile_rescue",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "resnet_harm",
        "mobile_harm",

        "target_resnet_rescue",
        "target_mobile_rescue",
        "target_efficientnet_error",
        "target_resnet_harm",
        "target_mobile_harm",

        # outcome labels
        "v317_transition",
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",

        "independent_rescue",
        "independent_harm",
        "independent_neutral",
        "independent_no_transition",

        "efficientnet_error_actual",
        "efficientnet_correct",
        "resnet_correct",
        "mobile_correct",
        "selected_correct",

        # categorical
        "selected_model",
        "policy_type",
        "policy",
    }

    candidates = []

    for col in df.columns:

        if col in excluded:
            continue

        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(
            df[col]
        ):

            candidates.append(col)

    return candidates


def add_derived_features(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    numeric_cols: List[str],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    df = df.copy()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Common selector signal transformations
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for col in list(numeric_cols):

        clean_name = (
            str(col)
            .replace(" ", "_")
            .replace("-", "_")
            .replace("/", "_")
        )

        if col != clean_name:
            continue

        values = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        if values.notna().sum() == 0:
            continue

        # Absolute value can capture strength/magnitude.
        df[f"abs__{col}"] = values.abs()

        # Squared signal.
        df[f"sq__{col}"] = values * values

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicit V3.17 policy signals when available.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "score" in df.columns:

        score = pd.to_numeric(
            df["score"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        df["derived_score_abs"] = score.abs()

    if "threshold" in df.columns:

        threshold = pd.to_numeric(
            df["threshold"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        df["derived_threshold_distance"] = (
            pd.to_numeric(
                df.get("score", np.nan),
                errors="coerce",
            )
            - threshold
        )

    if (
        "resnet_rescue_probability"
        in df.columns
        and
        "mobile_rescue_probability"
        in df.columns
    ):

        r = pd.to_numeric(
            df["resnet_rescue_probability"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        m = pd.to_numeric(
            df["mobile_rescue_probability"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        df["derived_specialist_probability_max"] = np.maximum(
            r,
            m,
        )

        df["derived_specialist_probability_min"] = np.minimum(
            r,
            m,
        )

        df["derived_specialist_probability_gap"] = (
            r - m
        ).abs()

    if (
        "resnet_rescue_probability"
        in df.columns
        and
        "selection_confidence"
        in df.columns
    ):

        r = pd.to_numeric(
            df["resnet_rescue_probability"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        c = pd.to_numeric(
            df["selection_confidence"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        df["derived_resnet_confidence_gap"] = (
            r - c
        )

    if (
        "mobile_rescue_probability"
        in df.columns
        and
        "selection_confidence"
        in df.columns
    ):

        m = pd.to_numeric(
            df["mobile_rescue_probability"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        c = pd.to_numeric(
            df["selection_confidence"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        df["derived_mobile_confidence_gap"] = (
            m - c
        )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# TRAINING TARGET
# =============================================================================

def build_discriminator_target(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.Series:

    """
    Binary target:

        1 = GOOD SWITCH
            actual rescue

        0 = BAD / NON-RESCUE SWITCH
            actual harm or neutral

    Only transitions are included in discriminator training.

    The discriminator is NOT trained to predict whether to switch
    from all 1267 samples. Its job is specifically:

        "If V3.17 is considering a specialist switch,
         is that switch likely to be beneficial?"
    """

    transitions = df[
        df["v317_transition"]
    ].copy()

    y = transitions[
        "v317_rescue"
    ].astype(int)

    return y


# =============================================================================
# BUILD TRAINING DATA
# =============================================================================

def build_training_matrix(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.DataFrame]:

    section("BUILDING HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR DATA")

    transitions = df[
        df["v317_transition"]
    ].copy()

    if len(transitions) == 0:
        fail(
            "No V3.17 transitions found."
        )

    print(
        f"Transition samples : {len(transitions)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues            : "
        f"{int(transitions['v317_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms              : "
        f"{int(transitions['v317_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral            : "
        f"{int(transitions['v317_neutral'].sum())}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # For discriminator training:
    #
    # rescue = 1
    # harm/neutral = 0
    #
    # This makes the model explicitly learn "benefit" rather than
    # merely predicting switching.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    y = transitions[
        "v317_rescue"
    ].astype(int)

    feature_cols = numeric_candidate_columns(
        transitions
    )

    transitions = add_derived_features(
        transitions,
        feature_cols,
    )

    feature_cols = numeric_candidate_columns(
        transitions
    )

    # Remove constant columns.
    usable = []

    for col in feature_cols:

        values = pd.to_numeric(
            transitions[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        if values.notna().sum() == 0:
            continue

        if values.nunique(
            dropna=True
        ) <= 1:
            continue

        usable.append(col)

    feature_cols = usable

    if not feature_cols:
        fail(
            "No usable numeric selector features found."
        )

    X = transitions[
        feature_cols
    ].copy()

    X = X.apply(
        pd.to_numeric,
        errors="coerce",
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Discriminator features : {len(feature_cols)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Feature matrix          : {X.shape}"
    )

    print()
    print("Target distribution:")

    print(
        y.value_counts()
        .sort_index()
        .rename(
            index={
                0: "bad_switch",
                1: "rescue",
            }
        )
        .to_string()
    )

    return X, y, transitions


# =============================================================================
# OUT-OF-FOLD TRAINING
# =============================================================================

def make_models():

    models = {

        "logistic_regression": Pipeline(
            [
                (
                    "imputer",
                    SimpleImputer(
                        strategy="median"
                    ),
                ),
                (
                    "scaler",
                    StandardScaler(),
                ),
                (
                    "classifier",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        max_iter=3000,
                        class_weight="balanced",
                        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        ),

        "random_forest": Pipeline(
            [
                (
                    "imputer",
                    SimpleImputer(
                        strategy="median"
                    ),
                ),
                (
                    "classifier",
                    RandomForestClassifier(
                        n_estimators=500,
                        max_depth=6,
                        min_samples_leaf=8,
                        class_weight="balanced",
                        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                        n_jobs=-1,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        ),

        "extra_trees": Pipeline(
            [
                (
                    "imputer",
                    SimpleImputer(
                        strategy="median"
                    ),
                ),
                (
                    "classifier",
                    ExtraTreesClassifier(
                        n_estimators=500,
                        max_depth=7,
                        min_samples_leaf=8,
                        class_weight="balanced",
                        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                        n_jobs=-1,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        ),

        "hist_gradient_boosting": Pipeline(
            [
                (
                    "imputer",
                    SimpleImputer(
                        strategy="median"
                    ),
                ),
                (
                    "classifier",
                    HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
                        max_iter=250,
                        max_depth=5,
                        learning_rate=0.04,
                        min_samples_leaf=15,
                        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        ),
    }

    return models


# =============================================================================
# FOLD-SAFE EVALUATION
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_model_oof(
    model,
    X: pd.DataFrame,
    y: pd.Series,
    groups: pd.Series,
) -> Dict:

    groups = groups.astype(int)

    probabilities = np.full(
        len(X),
        np.nan,
        dtype=float,
    )

    predictions = np.full(
        len(X),
        -1,
        dtype=int,
    )

    unique_groups = sorted(
        groups.unique()
    )

    for fold in unique_groups:

        train_mask = (
            groups != fold
        )

        test_mask = (
            groups == fold
        )

        X_train = X.loc[
            train_mask
        ]

        X_test = X.loc[
            test_mask
        ]

        y_train = y.loc[
            train_mask
        ]

        if y_train.nunique() < 2:
            continue

        fitted = clone(model)

        fitted.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
        )

        if hasattr(
            fitted,
            "predict_proba",
        ):

            prob = fitted.predict_proba(
                X_test
            )[:, 1]

        else:

            raw = fitted.decision_function(
                X_test
            )

            prob = 1.0 / (
                1.0
                + np.exp(
                    -np.clip(
                        raw,
                        -30,
                        30,
                    )
                )
            )

        pred = (
            prob >= 0.5
        ).astype(int)

        probabilities[
            test_mask.to_numpy()
        ] = prob

        predictions[
            test_mask.to_numpy()
        ] = pred

    valid = (
        np.isfinite(probabilities)
        &
        (predictions >= 0)
    )

    if valid.sum() == 0:
        return {
            "roc_auc": np.nan,
            "accuracy": np.nan,
            "balanced_accuracy": np.nan,
            "macro_f1": np.nan,
            "precision": np.nan,
            "recall": np.nan,
            "probabilities": probabilities,
            "predictions": predictions,
        }

    yy = y.to_numpy()[valid]
    pp = probabilities[valid]
    pred = predictions[valid]

    if len(np.unique(yy)) >= 2:
        auc = roc_auc_score(
            yy,
            pp,
        )
    else:
        auc = np.nan

    return {
        "roc_auc": auc,
        "accuracy": accuracy_score(
            yy,
            pred,
        ),
        "balanced_accuracy": balanced_accuracy_score(
            yy,
            pred,
        ),
        "macro_f1": f1_score(
            yy,
            pred,
            average="macro",
            zero_division=0,
        ),
        "precision": precision_score(
            yy,
            pred,
            zero_division=0,
        ),
        "recall": recall_score(
            yy,
            pred,
            zero_division=0,
        ),
        "probabilities": probabilities,
        "predictions": predictions,
    }


# =============================================================================
# MODEL COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def compare_models(
    X: pd.DataFrame,
    y: pd.Series,
    transitions: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Tuple[str, Dict, pd.DataFrame]:

    section("FOLD-SAFE DISCRIMINATOR MODEL COMPARISON")

    groups = transitions[
        "outer_fold"
    ].astype(int)

    models = make_models()

    rows = []

    results = {}

    for name, model in models.items():

        print()
        print(
            f"Evaluating: {name}"
        )

        result = evaluate_model_oof(
            model,
            X,
            y,
            groups,
        )

        results[name] = result

        rows.append(
            {
                "model": name,
                "roc_auc": result["roc_auc"],
                "accuracy": result["accuracy"],
                "balanced_accuracy": result[
                    "balanced_accuracy"
                ],
                "macro_f1": result["macro_f1"],
                "precision": result["precision"],
                "recall": result["recall"],
            }
        )

        print(
            f"  ROC-AUC          : "
            f"{result['roc_auc']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"  Accuracy         : "
            f"{result['accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"  Balanced Acc     : "
            f"{result['balanced_accuracy']:.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"  Macro F1         : "
            f"{result['macro_f1']:.6f}"
        )

    comparison = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    ).sort_values(
        by=[
            "roc_auc",
            "balanced_accuracy",
        ],
        ascending=False,
    )

    print()
    print(
        comparison.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    best_name = (
        comparison.iloc[0]["model"]
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"✓ Best discriminator: {best_name}"
    )

    return (
        best_name,
        results,
        comparison,
    )


# =============================================================================
# THRESHOLD ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

def threshold_analysis(
    probabilities: np.ndarray,
    y: pd.Series,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR THRESHOLD ANALYSIS")

    y_array = y.to_numpy(
        dtype=int
    )

    valid = np.isfinite(
        probabilities
    )

    p = probabilities[
        valid
    ]

    yy = y_array[
        valid
    ]

    rows = []

    thresholds = np.round(
        np.arange(
            0.10,
            0.951,
            0.025,
        ),
        3,
    )

    for threshold in thresholds:

        pred_good = (
            p >= threshold
        )

        accepted = int(
            pred_good.sum()
        )

        rejected = int(
            (~pred_good).sum()
        )

        true_rescues = int(
            (
                pred_good
                & (yy == 1)
            ).sum()
        )

        false_accepts = int(
            (
                pred_good
                & (yy == 0)
            ).sum()
        )

        total_rescues = int(
            (yy == 1).sum()
        )

        total_bad = int(
            (yy == 0).sum()
        )

        rescue_recall = (
            true_rescues / total_rescues
            if total_rescues > 0
            else 0.0
        )

        harm_or_neutral_accept_rate = (
            false_accepts / total_bad
            if total_bad > 0
            else 0.0
        )

        precision_good = (
            true_rescues / accepted
            if accepted > 0
            else 0.0
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "threshold": threshold,
                "accepted_switches": accepted,
                "rejected_switches": rejected,
                "true_rescues": true_rescues,
                "false_accepts": false_accepts,
                "rescue_recall": rescue_recall,
                "bad_accept_rate": harm_or_neutral_accept_rate,
                "rescue_precision": precision_good,
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# TRAIN FINAL MODEL
# =============================================================================

def train_final_model(
    model,
    X: pd.DataFrame,
    y: pd.Series,
):

    section("TRAINING FINAL V3.23 DISCRIMINATOR")

    fitted = clone(model)

    fitted.fit(
        X,
        y,
    )

    print(
        "✓ Final discriminator trained on all V3.17 transition samples."
    )

    return fitted


# =============================================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# =============================================================================

def feature_importance(
    fitted_model,
    feature_names: List[str],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("DISCRIMINATOR FEATURE IMPORTANCE")

    estimator = fitted_model

    if hasattr(
        fitted_model,
        "named_steps",
    ):

        estimator = fitted_model.named_steps.get(
            "classifier",
            fitted_model,
        )

    importances = None

    if hasattr(
        estimator,
        "feature_importances_",
    ):

        importances = estimator.feature_importances_

    elif hasattr(
        estimator,
        "coef_",
    ):

        importances = np.abs(
            estimator.coef_[0]
        )

    if importances is None:

        print(
            "Feature importance unavailable for selected model."
        )

        return pd.DataFrame(
            columns=[
                "feature",
                "importance",
            ]
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "feature": feature_names,
            "importance": importances,
        }
    ).sort_values(
        "importance",
        ascending=False,
    )

    print(
        result.head(30).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    return result

        ),

        ),

        "transition_definition": (
            "selected_model != efficientnet_v2_s"
        ),

        "rescue_definition": (
            "transition AND EfficientNet wrong "
            "AND selected specialist correct"
        ),

        "harm_definition": (
            "transition AND EfficientNet correct "
            "AND selected specialist wrong"
        ),

            "transition AND selected specialist "
            "has same correctness as EfficientNet"
        ),

            "0 = harm or neutral"

        "n_total_samples": int(

        ),

        ),

        ),

            metadata,

            indent=2,

    )

    print(
        f"Saved model           : {model_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved metadata        : {metadata_path}"
    )

    summary_path = (

    rescues = int(

    harms = int(
        df["v317_harm"].sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        df["v317_neutral"].sum()
    )

    transitions = int(
        df["v317_transition"].sum()
    )

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "V3.23 HARM-AWARE RESCUE DISCRIMINATOR"
    )

    lines.append(
        "=" * 80
    )

    lines.append(

    )

    lines.append(

    )

    lines.append(

    )

    lines.append(
        f"Transitions          : {transitions}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Rescues              : {rescues}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Harms                : {harms}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Neutral transitions  : {neutral}"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Net gain             : {rescues - harms}"
    )

    lines.append(
        ""
    )

    lines.append(
        "DISCRIMINATOR"
    )

    lines.append(
        f"Best model           : {best_name}"
    )

    lines.append(
        ""
    )

    lines.append(
        "MODEL COMPARISON"
    )

    lines.append(
        comparison.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    lines.append(
        ""
    )

    lines.append(
        "INTERPRETATION"
    )

    lines.append(
        "The discriminator is trained only on actual V3.17 transitions."
    )

    lines.append(
        "Target = 1 when the selected specialist actually rescued "
        "an EfficientNet error."
    )

    lines.append(
        "Target = 0 for actual harms and neutral transitions."
    )

    lines.append(
        "The model therefore learns whether a proposed switch "
        "is beneficial, rather than simply whether switching is likely."
    )

    with open(
        summary_path,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        f.write(
            "\n".join(lines)
        )

    print(
        f"Saved summary: {summary_path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.23 HARM-AWARE RESCUE DISCRIMINATOR"
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT modify existing artifacts."
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT perform positional V3.17 ↔ V3.15 OOF merging."
    )

    print(
        "The authoritative target is the identity-aligned actual V3.17 outcome."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Output directory:"
    )
    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317, forensic, targets = load_artifacts()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_schema(
        v317,
        forensic,
        targets,
    )

    validate_identities(
        v317,
        forensic,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Authoritative target construction
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    target_table = build_authoritative_target_table(
        v317,
        targets,
    )

    target_table = normalize_targets(
        target_table
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity-aligned feature table
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = build_training_table(
        v317,
        forensic,
        target_table,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CRITICAL:
    # reconstruct transition from selected_model.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = reconstruct_outcomes(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Outcome diagnostics
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print_outcome_summary(
        df
    )

    model_breakdown = selected_model_breakdown(
        df
    )

    fold_table = fold_breakdown(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build discriminator training data
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    X, y, transitions = build_training_matrix(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compare models
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        best_name,
        results,
        comparison,
    ) = compare_models(
        X,
        y,
        transitions,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Best OOF probabilities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    best_result = results[
        best_name
    ]

    probabilities = best_result[
        "probabilities"
    ]

    threshold_table = threshold_analysis(
        probabilities,
        y,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final model
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    models = make_models()

    best_model = models[
        best_name
    ]

    fitted_model = train_final_model(
        best_model,
        X,
        y,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature importance
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    importance = feature_importance(
        fitted_model,
        list(X.columns),
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_outputs(
        df=df,
        X=X,
        y=y,
        transitions=transitions,
        best_name=best_name,
        fitted_model=fitted_model,
        comparison=comparison,
        threshold_table=threshold_table,
        importance=importance,
    )

    write_summary(
        df,
        comparison,
        best_name,
        threshold_table,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final diagnosis
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "FINAL V3.23 TRAINING DIAGNOSIS"
    )

    transitions_n = int(
        df["v317_transition"].sum()
    )

    rescues_n = int(
        df["v317_rescue"].sum()
    )

    harms_n = int(
        df["v317_harm"].sum()
    )

    neutral_n = int(
        df["v317_neutral"].sum()
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 transitions : {transitions_n}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 rescues     : {rescues_n}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 harms       : {harms_n}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 neutral     : {neutral_n}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 net gain     : "
        f"{rescues_n - harms_n}"
    )

    print()

    if harms_n > 0:

        print(
            "✓ Actual V3.17 harms are present."
        )

        print(
            "✓ Harm-aware discrimination is meaningful."
        )

    else:

        print(
            "WARNING: No actual harms detected."
        )

    if rescues_n > harms_n:

        print(
            "✓ V3.17 switching is net-positive."
        )

    else:

        print(
            "WARNING: V3.17 switching is not net-positive."
        )

    print()
    print(
        "CRITICAL IMPLEMENTATION POINT:"
    )

    print(
        "Transition is derived from:"
    )

    print(
        "    selected_model != efficientnet_v2_s"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "The script does NOT depend on a 'switch' column."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "The discriminator target is:"
    )

    print(
        "    1 = actual V3.17 rescue"
    )

    print(
        "    0 = actual V3.17 harm OR neutral"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "This is the correct target for the next harm-aware rescue experiment."
    )

    section(
        "V3.23 TRAINING COMPLETED"
    )

    print(
        "✓ Training completed successfully."
    )

    print(
        f"Output directory:\n{OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
====================================================================================================
V3.23 NESTED HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR EVALUATION
====================================================================================================

Purpose
-------
Evaluate the V3.23 harm-aware rescue discriminator using STRICT outer-fold
evaluation.

IMPORTANT
---------
The final V3.23 discriminator was trained on all 171 V3.17 transitions.
Therefore it MUST NOT be used to evaluate those same transitions.

This script instead:

    1. Loads the identity-aligned V3.17 forensic data.
    2. Loads the V3.23 transition training table.
    3. Uses the existing outer_fold assignments.
    4. For each outer fold:
           train discriminator on the other folds
           predict on the held-out fold
    5. Applies multiple discriminator thresholds.
    6. Reconstructs the final 1267-sample hybrid prediction.
    7. Compares against:
           - EfficientNet baseline
           - Raw V3.17
           - V3.23 nested
    8. Saves complete OOF forensic results.

Target
------
    1 = actual V3.17 rescue
    0 = actual V3.17 harm OR neutral

A switch is accepted only when:

    discriminator_probability >= threshold

If rejected:

    revert to EfficientNet.

This is the intended V3.23 harm-aware rescue policy.
====================================================================================================
"""

# ================================================================================================

def as_bool(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Robust boolean conversion.

    Handles:
        True / False
        1 / 0
        strings
        NaN
    """
    if pd.api.types.is_bool_dtype(series):
        return series.fillna(False).astype(bool)

    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(series):
        return series.fillna(0).astype(float) != 0

    normalized = (
        series.astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .str.lower()
    )

    return normalized.isin(
        {
            "true",
            "1",
            "yes",
            "y",
            "t",
        }
    )


def numeric_series(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce")

    print(f"Predictions path  : {V317_PREDICTIONS}")

# ================================================================================================

def identity_columns(df: pd.DataFrame):
    candidates = [
        "row_index",
        "image_id",
        "image",
        "filename",
        "sample_id",
        "id",
    ]

    return [
        c
        for c in candidates
        if c in df.columns
    ]


def require_identity(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str):
    cols = identity_columns(df)

    if not cols:
        fail(
            f"{name} has no recognizable identity column."
        )

    return cols


def validate_identity(v317: pd.DataFrame, forensic: pd.DataFrame):
    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    v317_ids = require_identity(
        v317,
        "V3.17 predictions",
    )

    forensic_ids = require_identity(
        forensic,
        "V3.17 forensic",
    )

    identity_col = "row_index"

    if identity_col not in v317.columns:
        identity_col = v317_ids[0]

    if identity_col not in forensic.columns:
        identity_col = forensic_ids[0]

    a = set(v317[identity_col].tolist())
    b = set(forensic[identity_col].tolist())

    common = a & b

    print(
        f"V3.17 unique identities : {len(a)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Forensic unique identities: {len(b)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Common identities       : {len(common)}"
    )
    print(
        f"V3.17-only              : {len(a - b)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Forensic-only           : {len(b - a)}"
    )

    if a != b:
        fail(
            "V3.17 and forensic identity sets do not match."
        )

    print("✓ Exact identity set match.")

    return identity_col

    # identities
    "row_index",
    "image_id",
    "image",
    "filename",
    "sample_id",
    "id",

    # fold / structural metadata
    "outer_fold",

    # V3.17 selection
    "selected_model",

    # authoritative outcomes

    "v317_rescue",
