def load_artifacts():
    section("LOADING ARTIFACTS")

    for path in [
        V317_PREDICTIONS,
        FORENSIC,
        TRANSITION,
    ]:
        if not path.exists():
            fail(
                f"Required artifact does not exist:\n{path}"
            )

    v317 = pd.read_csv(V317_PREDICTIONS)
    forensic = pd.read_csv(FORENSIC)
    transition = pd.read_csv(TRANSITION)

    print(f"V3.17 predictions : {v317.shape}")
    print(f"V3.17 forensic    : {forensic.shape}")
    print(f"V3.23 transition  : {transition.shape}")

    print()
    print(f"Predictions path : {V317_PREDICTIONS}")
    print(f"Forensic path    : {FORENSIC}")
    print(f"Transition path  : {TRANSITION}")

    return v317, forensic, transition


# ============================================================
# SCHEMA
# ============================================================

def validate_schema(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("SCHEMA VALIDATION")

    required_v317 = [
        "outer_fold",
        "row_index",
        "selected_model",
    ]

    required_forensic = [
        "outer_fold",
        "row_index",
        "v317_transition",
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
        "efficientnet_error_actual",
        "efficientnet_correct",
        "resnet_correct",
        "mobile_correct",
    ]

    for col in required_v317:
        if col not in v317.columns:
            fail(
                f"Missing V3.17 prediction column: {col}"
            )

    for col in required_forensic:
        if col not in forensic.columns:
            fail(
                f"Missing forensic column: {col}"
            )

    ok("V3.17 required columns present.")
    ok("V3.17 identity columns present.")
    ok("V3.17 selected_model present.")
    ok("Authoritative forensic outcome columns present.")

    print()
    print("Transition table columns available:")
    for col in transition.columns:
        print(f"  {col}")

    # IMPORTANT:
    #
    # Do NOT require discriminator_target.
    #
    # It is not an authoritative identity/outcome column.
    #
    # It is derived from:
    #
    #   v317_rescue -> 1
    #   v317_harm / v317_neutral -> 0
    #
    # This prevents schema-version failures.

    if "discriminator_target" in transition.columns:
        ok(
            "Transition table contains discriminator_target "
            "(will be independently verified)."
        )
    else:
        print(
            "✓ discriminator_target absent; "
            "audit will reconstruct it independently."
        )


# ============================================================
# IDENTITY AUDIT
# ============================================================

def audit_identities(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    v317_ids = set(identity_key(v317))
    forensic_ids = set(identity_key(forensic))
    transition_ids = set(identity_key(transition))

    print(
        f"V3.17 unique identities : {len(v317_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Forensic unique identities: {len(forensic_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transition unique identities: "
        f"{len(transition_ids)}"
    )

    common_vf = v317_ids & forensic_ids

    print(
        f"V3.17 / forensic common : {len(common_vf)}"
    )

    if v317_ids != forensic_ids:
        only_v317 = v317_ids - forensic_ids
        only_forensic = forensic_ids - v317_ids

        fail(
            "V3.17 and forensic identity sets do not match.\n"
            f"V3.17-only: {len(only_v317)}\n"
            f"Forensic-only: {len(only_forensic)}"
        )

    ok(
        "V3.17 and forensic identity sets match."
    )

    transition_only = transition_ids - forensic_ids
    missing_transition = forensic_ids - transition_ids

    print()
    print(
        "Transition identity relationship:"
    )

    print(
        f"  Transition identities : "
        f"{len(transition_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Forensic identities   : "
        f"{len(forensic_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"  Transition ⊂ forensic : "
        f"{transition_ids.issubset(forensic_ids)}"
    )

    if transition_only:
        fail(
            "Transition table contains identities "
            "not present in forensic table."
        )

    ok(
        "All transition identities are present "
        "in the complete forensic dataset."
    )

    print(
        f"  Complete forensic rows not in transition: "
        f"{len(missing_transition)}"
    )

    ok(
        "Transition table is correctly treated as "
        "a subset of the complete V3.17 dataset."
    )


# ============================================================
# AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOMES
# ============================================================

def build_authoritative_outcomes(
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOME TABLE")

    df = forensic.copy()

    bool_cols = [
        "v317_transition",
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
        "efficientnet_error_actual",
        "efficientnet_correct",
        "resnet_correct",
        "mobile_correct",
    ]

    for col in bool_cols:
        df[col] = normalize_bool(df[col])

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Independent outcome partition
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    transition = df["v317_transition"]

    rescue = (
        transition
        & df["v317_rescue"]
    )

    harm = (
        transition
        & df["v317_harm"]
    )

    neutral = (
        transition
        & df["v317_neutral"]
    )

    no_transition = (
        ~transition
        & df["v317_no_transition"]
    )

    partition_sum = (
        rescue.astype(int)
        + harm.astype(int)
        + neutral.astype(int)
        + no_transition.astype(int)
    )

    if not (partition_sum == 1).all():
        bad = df.loc[
            partition_sum != 1,
            [
                "outer_fold",
                "row_index",
                "v317_transition",
                "v317_rescue",
                "v317_harm",
                "v317_neutral",
                "v317_no_transition",
            ],
        ]

        print()
        print(
            "Invalid rows:"
        )

        print(
            bad.head(20).to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

        fail(
            "Authoritative V3.17 outcomes do not "
            "form a complete partition."
        )

    df["audit_rescue"] = rescue
    df["audit_harm"] = harm
    df["audit_neutral"] = neutral
    df["audit_no_transition"] = no_transition

    print()
    print(
        f"Transitions         : {int(transition.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues             : {int(rescue.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms               : {int(harm.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral transitions : {int(neutral.sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"No transition       : {int(no_transition.sum())}"
    )

    ok(
        "Authoritative V3.17 outcome partition "
        "is valid."
    )

    return df


# ============================================================
# TRANSITION TARGET RECONSTRUCTION
# ============================================================

def reconstruct_transition_target(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
    authoritative: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "RECONSTRUCTING DISCRIMINATOR TARGET "
        "FROM AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOMES"
    )

    auth = authoritative.copy()

    auth["_identity"] = identity_key(auth)
    transition = transition.copy()
    transition["_identity"] = identity_key(transition)

    lookup_cols = [
        "_identity",
        "audit_rescue",
        "audit_harm",
        "audit_neutral",
        "audit_no_transition",
        "v317_transition",
        "selected_model",
    ]

    available = [
        c for c in lookup_cols
        if c in auth.columns
    ]

    aligned = transition.merge(
        auth[available],
        on="_identity",
        how="left",
        suffixes=(
            "_transition",
            "_authoritative",
        ),
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    if len(aligned) != len(transition):
        fail(
            "Identity alignment changed transition "
            "row count."
        )

    if aligned[
        "audit_rescue"
    ].isna().any():
        fail(
            "Some transition identities could not "
            "be matched to authoritative outcomes."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Target definition
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    aligned["audit_discriminator_target"] = (
        aligned["audit_rescue"]
        .astype(bool)
        .astype(int)
    )

    # 1 = actual rescue
    # 0 = harm OR neutral

    expected_bad = (
        aligned["audit_harm"].astype(bool)
        | aligned["audit_neutral"].astype(bool)
    )

    target = aligned[
        "audit_discriminator_target"
    ]

    if not (
        (
            target.eq(1)
            == aligned["audit_rescue"].astype(bool)
        ).all()
    ):
        fail(
            "Reconstructed discriminator target "
            "does not match rescue outcome."
        )

    if not (
        (
            target.eq(0)
            == expected_bad
        ).all()
    ):
        fail(
            "Target contains rows that are neither "
            "rescue nor harm/neutral."
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Authoritative discriminator target:"
    )

    print(
        "  1 = actual V3.17 rescue"
    )

    print(
        "  0 = actual V3.17 harm OR neutral"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Target distribution:"
    )

    print(
        aligned[
            "audit_discriminator_target"
        ].value_counts()
        .sort_index()
        .rename(
            index={
                0: "bad_switch",
                1: "rescue",
            }
        )
        .to_string()
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Compare stored discriminator target if present
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "discriminator_target" in aligned.columns:

        stored = pd.to_numeric(
            aligned["discriminator_target"],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        mismatch = (
            stored.notna()
            & stored.ne(
                aligned[
                    "audit_discriminator_target"
                ]
            )
        )

        print()
        print(
            "Stored target consistency:"
        )

        print(
            f"  Available stored targets : "
            f"{int(stored.notna().sum())}"
        )

        print(
            f"  Mismatches               : "
            f"{int(mismatch.sum())}"
        )

        if mismatch.any():
            warn(
                "Stored discriminator_target differs "
                "from authoritative reconstruction."
            )
        else:
            ok(
                "Stored discriminator_target matches "
                "authoritative reconstruction."
            )

    else:
        print()
        ok(
            "No stored discriminator_target required; "
            "target reconstructed independently."
        )

    return aligned


# ============================================================
# FEATURE AUDIT
# ============================================================

def identify_target_columns(
    columns: Iterable[str],
) -> list[str]:

    target_terms = [
        "target",
        "label",
        "truth",
        "ground_truth",
        "true_label",
        "rescue_target",
        "harm_target",
        "discriminator_target",
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
        "audit_rescue",
        "audit_harm",
        "audit_neutral",
        "audit_no_transition",
    ]

    result = []

    for col in columns:
        low = col.lower()

        if any(
            term in low
            for term in target_terms
        ):
            result.append(col)

    return sorted(set(result))


def identify_outcome_columns(
    columns: Iterable[str],
) -> list[str]:

    terms = [
        "correct",
        "rescue",
        "harm",
        "neutral",
        "transition",
        "no_transition",
        "efficientnet_error",
        "selected_model",
        "outcome",
    ]

    result = []

    for col in columns:
        low = col.lower()

        if any(
            term in low
            for term in terms
        ):
            result.append(col)

    return sorted(set(result))


def identify_identity_columns(
    columns: Iterable[str],
) -> list[str]:

    terms = [
        "row_index",
        "outer_fold",
        "identity",
        "id",
        "index",
    ]

    result = []

    for col in columns:
        low = col.lower()

        if low in terms or low.endswith("_id"):
            result.append(col)

    return sorted(set(result))


def audit_transition_features(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict:

    section("TRANSITION FEATURE LEAKAGE AUDIT")

    excluded = {
        "_identity",
        "discriminator_target",
        "audit_discriminator_target",
    }

    identity_cols = set(
        identify_identity_columns(
            transition.columns
        )
    )

    target_cols = set(
        identify_target_columns(
            transition.columns
        )
    )

    outcome_cols = set(
        identify_outcome_columns(
            transition.columns
        )
    )

    print(
        "Identity-related columns:"
    )

    for col in sorted(identity_cols):
        print(f"  {col}")

    print()
    print(
        "Potential target-related columns:"
    )

    for col in sorted(target_cols):
        print(f"  {col}")

    print()
    print(
        "Potential outcome/post-decision columns:"
    )

    for col in sorted(outcome_cols):
        print(f"  {col}")

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Strong leakage indicators
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    strong_target_leakage = []

    for col in transition.columns:

        low = col.lower()

        if col in excluded:
            continue

        if (
            "discriminator_target" in low
            or low in {
                "audit_rescue",
                "audit_harm",
                "audit_neutral",
                "audit_no_transition",
            }
        ):
            strong_target_leakage.append(col)

    print()
    if strong_target_leakage:
        warn(
            "Potential explicit target columns are present "
            "in the transition feature table:"
        )

        for col in strong_target_leakage:
            print(f"  - {col}")
    else:
        ok(
            "No explicit authoritative discriminator target "
            "feature detected."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Post-decision feature names
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    post_decision_patterns = [
        r"actual",
        r"v317_",
        r"selected_model",
        r"outcome",
        r"ground_truth",
        r"true_label",
        r"correct$",
        r"_correct$",
        r"_rescue$",
        r"_harm$",
        r"_neutral$",
        r"no_transition",
    ]

    post_decision = []

    for col in transition.columns:

        if col in excluded:
            continue

        low = col.lower()

        if any(
            re.search(
                pattern,
                low,
            )
            for pattern in post_decision_patterns
        ):
            post_decision.append(col)

    print()
    print(
        "Potential post-decision features:"
    )

    if post_decision:
        for col in sorted(set(post_decision)):
            print(f"  - {col}")
    else:
        print("  None detected.")

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Numeric feature statistics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_candidates = []

    for col in transition.columns:

        if col in excluded:
            continue

        if col in identity_cols:
            continue

        if col in target_cols:
            continue

        if col in outcome_cols:
            continue

        if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(
            transition[col]
        ):
            feature_candidates.append(col)

    print()
    print(
        f"Numeric candidate features: "
        f"{len(feature_candidates)}"
    )

    for i, col in enumerate(
        feature_candidates,
        start=1,
    ):
        print(
            f"  {i:03d}. {col}"
        )

    return {
        "identity_columns": sorted(
            identity_cols
        ),
        "target_columns": sorted(
            target_cols
        ),
        "outcome_columns": sorted(
            outcome_cols
        ),
        "post_decision_columns": sorted(
            set(post_decision)
        ),
        "numeric_feature_candidates":
            feature_candidates,
    }


# ============================================================
# DUPLICATE FEATURE AUDIT
# ============================================================

def audit_duplicate_features(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
) -> list[str]:

    section("DUPLICATE / REDUNDANT FEATURE AUDIT")

    duplicates = duplicate_columns(
        transition
    )

    if duplicates:
        print(
            "Exact duplicate columns:"
        )

        for item in duplicates:
            print(
                f"  - {item}"
            )
    else:
        ok(
            "No exact duplicate columns detected."
        )

    return duplicates


# ============================================================
# FEATURE/TARGET CORRELATION AUDIT
# ============================================================

def audit_feature_target_correlations(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
    target_col: str,
    excluded: set[str],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "FEATURE ↔ TARGET ASSOCIATION AUDIT"
    )

    y = pd.to_numeric(
        transition[target_col],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    records = []

    for col in transition.columns:

        if col in excluded:
            continue

        if col == target_col:
            continue

        if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(
            transition[col]
        ):
            continue

        x = pd.to_numeric(
            transition[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        valid = (
            x.notna()
            & y.notna()
        )

        if valid.sum() < 5:
            continue

        if x.loc[valid].nunique() <= 1:
            corr = np.nan
        else:
            corr = np.corrcoef(
                x.loc[valid],
                y.loc[valid],
            )[0, 1]

        records.append(
            {
                "feature": col,
                "target_correlation": corr,
                "n_valid": int(
                    valid.sum()
                ),
            }
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(records)

    if result.empty:
        print(
            "No numeric feature correlations available."
        )
        return result

    result[
        "abs_target_correlation"
    ] = result[
        "target_correlation"
    ].abs()

    result = result.sort_values(
        "abs_target_correlation",
        ascending=False,
    )

    print(
        result.head(20).to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    suspicious = result[
        result[
            "abs_target_correlation"
        ] >= 0.95
    ]

    print()

    if not suspicious.empty:
        warn(
            "Some features have extremely strong "
            "association with the discriminator target."
        )

        print(
            suspicious.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

    else:
        ok(
            "No feature has absolute correlation "
            ">= 0.95 with the target."
        )

    return result


# ============================================================
# CROSS-TABLE LEAKAGE AUDIT
# ============================================================

def audit_feature_sources(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "FEATURE SOURCE / FORENSIC OVERLAP AUDIT"
    )

    transition_cols = set(
        transition.columns
    )

    forensic_cols = set(
        forensic.columns
    )

    overlap = sorted(
        transition_cols
        & forensic_cols
    )

    print(
        f"Transition columns : "
        f"{len(transition_cols)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Forensic columns   : "
        f"{len(forensic_cols)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Shared columns     : "
        f"{len(overlap)}"
    )

    print()

    for col in overlap:
        print(
            f"  - {col}"
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "shared_column": overlap
        }
    )


# ============================================================
# NESTED OOF AUDIT
# ============================================================

def audit_nested_oof(
    nested_oof_path: Path,
    authoritative: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict:

    section(
        "NESTED OOF LEAKAGE AUDIT"
    )

    if not nested_oof_path.exists():
        warn(
            f"Nested OOF file not found:\n"
            f"{nested_oof_path}"
        )

        return {
            "available": False
        }

    oof = pd.read_csv(
        nested_oof_path
    )

    print(
        f"Nested OOF shape : "
        f"{oof.shape}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Nested OOF columns:"
    )

    for col in oof.columns:
        print(
            f"  {col}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Detect fold
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fold_col = None

    for candidate in [
        "outer_fold",
        "fold",
        "test_fold",
    ]:
        if candidate in oof.columns:
            fold_col = candidate
            break

    if fold_col is None:
        warn(
            "No explicit fold column found in nested OOF."
        )
    else:
        folds = sorted(
            pd.to_numeric(
                oof[fold_col],
                errors="coerce",
            )
            .dropna()
            .unique()
            .tolist()
        )

        print()
        print(
            f"OOF folds detected: {folds}"
        )

        ok(
            "Nested OOF contains explicit "
            "outer-fold information."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "row_index" in oof.columns
        and "outer_fold" in oof.columns
    ):

        oof_ids = set(
            identity_key(oof)
        )

        auth_ids = set(
            identity_key(authoritative)
        )

        print()
        print(
            f"OOF identities          : "
            f"{len(oof_ids)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Authoritative identities: "
            f"{len(auth_ids)}"
        )

        if oof_ids.issubset(auth_ids):
            ok(
                "All nested OOF identities belong "
                "to the authoritative V3.17 dataset."
            )
        else:
            warn(
                "Some nested OOF identities are not "
                "present in authoritative data."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Leakage-looking columns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    suspicious = []

    for col in oof.columns:

        low = col.lower()

        if any(
            term in low
            for term in [
                "actual",
                "true_label",
                "ground_truth",
                "v317_rescue",
                "v317_harm",
                "target",
            ]
        ):
            suspicious.append(col)

    print()
    print(
        "Potential OOF target/outcome columns:"
    )

    if suspicious:
        for col in suspicious:
            print(
                f"  - {col}"
            )
    else:
        print(
            "  None detected."
        )

    return {
        "available": True,
        "shape": list(oof.shape),
        "suspicious_columns": suspicious,
    }


# ============================================================
# MODEL COMPARISON AUDIT
# ============================================================

def audit_model_comparison() -> pd.DataFrame | None:

    section(
        "MODEL COMPARISON AUDIT"
    )

    if not MODEL_COMPARISON.exists():
        warn(
            "V3.23 model comparison artifact "
            "not found."
        )
        return None

    df = pd.read_csv(
        MODEL_COMPARISON
    )

    print(
        df.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    return df


# ============================================================
# FINAL DECISION
# ============================================================

def determine_final_status(
    feature_audit: dict,
    correlation_df: pd.DataFrame,
    duplicate_columns_list: list[str],
    nested_info: dict,
) -> dict:

    section(
        "FINAL V3.23 FEATURE LEAKAGE DIAGNOSIS"
    )

    issues = []
    warnings = []

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicit target leakage
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    explicit_target = [
        x
        for x in feature_audit[
            "numeric_feature_candidates"
        ]
        if x.lower()
        in {
            "discriminator_target",
            "audit_discriminator_target",
        }
    ]

    if explicit_target:
        issues.append(
            "Explicit discriminator target appears "
            "among candidate features."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Post-decision features
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    post_decision = feature_audit[
        "post_decision_columns"
    ]

    if post_decision:
        warnings.append(
            "Potential post-decision/outcome-derived "
            "columns are present."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Extreme correlations
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        correlation_df is not None
        and not correlation_df.empty
    ):

        extreme = correlation_df[
            correlation_df[
                "abs_target_correlation"
            ] >= 0.95
        ]

        if not extreme.empty:
            warnings.append(
                "At least one feature has "
                "|correlation| >= 0.95 with target."
            )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Duplicate columns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if duplicate_columns_list:
        warnings.append(
            "Exact duplicate feature columns detected."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Status
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if issues:
        status = "FAIL"

    elif warnings:
        status = "PASS_WITH_WARNINGS"

    else:
        status = "PASS"

    print()
    print(
        f"FINAL STATUS: {status}"
    )

    print()

    if issues:

        print(
            "CRITICAL ISSUES:"
        )

        for item in issues:
            print(
                f"  ✗ {item}"
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "No explicit discriminator-target leakage "
            "detected."
        )

    if warnings:

        print()
        print(
            "WARNINGS:"
        )

        for item in warnings:
            print(
                f"  ! {item}"
            )

    else:

        ok(
            "No major feature-leakage warnings detected."
        )

    print()
    print(
        "Interpretation:"
    )

    print(
        "  • Transition table is a 171-row subset "
        "of the 1267-row V3.17 forensic dataset."
    )

    print(
        "  • This subset relationship is expected."
    )

    print(
        "  • discriminator_target is reconstructed "
        "from authoritative V3.17 outcomes."
    )

    print(
        "  • The audit does not treat missing "
        "discriminator_target as an error."
    )

    return {
        "status": status,
        "issues": issues,
        "warnings": warnings,
    }


# ============================================================
# SAVE REPORT
# ============================================================

def save_outputs(
    authoritative: pd.DataFrame,
    transition_aligned: pd.DataFrame,
    feature_audit: dict,
    correlation_df: pd.DataFrame,
    duplicate_list: list[str],
    nested_info: dict,
    model_comparison: pd.DataFrame | None,
    final_status: dict,
) -> None:

    section("SAVING AUDIT ARTIFACTS")

    OUT_DIR.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Authoritative outcomes
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    authoritative_out = (
        OUT_DIR
        / "v3_23_authoritative_outcomes.csv"
    )

    authoritative.to_csv(
        authoritative_out,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved authoritative outcomes:\n"
        f"  {authoritative_out}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition aligned
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    transition_out = (
        OUT_DIR
        / "v3_23_transition_authoritative_alignment.csv"
    )

    transition_aligned.to_csv(
        transition_out,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved transition alignment:\n"
        f"  {transition_out}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature list
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_records = []

    for col in feature_audit[
        "numeric_feature_candidates"
    ]:

        feature_records.append(
            {
                "feature": col,
                "is_identity": col
                in feature_audit[
                    "identity_columns"
                ],
                "is_target": col
                in feature_audit[
                    "target_columns"
                ],
                "is_outcome": col
                in feature_audit[
                    "outcome_columns"
                ],
                "is_post_decision": col
                in feature_audit[
                    "post_decision_columns"
                ],
            }
        )

    feature_df = pd.DataFrame(
        feature_records
    )

    feature_out = (
        OUT_DIR
        / "v3_23_feature_audit.csv"
    )

    feature_df.to_csv(
        feature_out,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved feature audit:\n"
        f"  {feature_out}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Correlation
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    correlation_out = (
        OUT_DIR
        / "v3_23_feature_target_correlations.csv"
    )

    correlation_df.to_csv(
        correlation_out,
        index=False,
    )

    print(
        f"Saved feature-target correlations:\n"
        f"  {correlation_out}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Duplicates
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    duplicate_out = (
        OUT_DIR
        / "v3_23_duplicate_columns.txt"
    )

    with open(
        duplicate_out,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        for item in duplicate_list:
            f.write(
                item + "\n"
            )

    print(
        f"Saved duplicate-column audit:\n"
        f"  {duplicate_out}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Final JSON
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    final_out = (
        OUT_DIR
        / "v3_23_feature_leakage_audit.json"
    )

    payload = {
        "status": final_status[
            "status"
        ],
        "issues": final_status[
            "issues"
        ],
        "warnings": final_status[
            "warnings"
        ],
        "feature_count": len(
            feature_audit[
                "numeric_feature_candidates"
            ]
        ),
        "nested_oof": nested_info,
    }

    with open(
        final_out,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            payload,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    print(
        f"Saved final audit JSON:\n"
        f"  {final_out}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Human-readable summary
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    summary_out = (
        OUT_DIR
        / "v3_23_feature_leakage_summary.txt"
    )

    with open(
        summary_out,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        f.write(
            "V3.23 FEATURE LEAKAGE AUDIT\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "=" * 80 + "\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            f"FINAL STATUS: "
            f"{final_status['status']}\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "Issues:\n"
        )

        for issue in final_status[
            "issues"
        ]:

            f.write(
                f"- {issue}\n"
            )

        f.write(
            "\nWarnings:\n"
        )

        for warning in final_status[
            "warnings"
        ]:

            f.write(
                f"- {warning}\n"
            )

        f.write(
            "\nAuthoritative target definition:\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "1 = actual V3.17 rescue\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "0 = actual V3.17 harm OR neutral\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "\nIdentity definition:\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "outer_fold + row_index\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "\nImportant:\n"
        )

        f.write(
            "The V3.23 transition table contains only "
            "the 171 V3.17 transitions and is therefore "
            "expected to be a subset of the complete "
            "1267-row forensic dataset.\n"
        )

    print(
        f"Saved human-readable summary:\n"
        f"  {summary_out}"
    )


# ============================================================
# MAIN
# ============================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.23 FEATURE LEAKAGE AUDIT"
    )

    print(
        "This script does NOT modify existing artifacts."
    )

    print(
        "The transition table contains only V3.17 "
        "transitions."
    )

    print(
        "The forensic table contains the complete "
        "V3.17 dataset."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "The discriminator target is reconstructed "
        "independently from authoritative V3.17 "
        "outcomes."
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Output directory:\n"
        f"{OUT_DIR}"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    v317, forensic, transition = (
        load_artifacts()
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate schema
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    validate_schema(
        v317,
        forensic,
        transition,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity audit
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    audit_identities(
        v317,
        forensic,
        transition,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Authoritative outcomes
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    authoritative = (
        build_authoritative_outcomes(
            forensic
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Reconstruct target
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    transition_aligned = (
        reconstruct_transition_target(
            transition,
            authoritative,
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature audit
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_audit = (
        audit_transition_features(
            transition_aligned
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Duplicate audit
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    duplicates = (
        audit_duplicate_features(
            transition_aligned
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Correlation audit
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    excluded = set(
        feature_audit[
            "identity_columns"
        ]
    )

    excluded.update(
        feature_audit[
            "target_columns"
        ]
    )

    excluded.update(
        feature_audit[
            "outcome_columns"
        ]
    )

    excluded.update(
        {
            "_identity",
            "audit_discriminator_target",
        }
    )

    correlation_df = (
        audit_feature_target_correlations(
            transition_aligned,
            "audit_discriminator_target",
            excluded,
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature source audit
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    audit_feature_sources(
        transition_aligned,
        forensic,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Nested OOF
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    nested_info = (
        audit_nested_oof(
            NESTED_OOF,
            authoritative,
        )
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Model comparison
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    model_comparison = (
        audit_model_comparison()
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Final status
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    final_status = determine_final_status(
        feature_audit,
        correlation_df,
        duplicates,
        nested_info,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    save_outputs(
        authoritative,
        transition_aligned,
        feature_audit,
        correlation_df,
        duplicates,
        nested_info,
        model_comparison,
        final_status,
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Final
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.23 FEATURE LEAKAGE AUDIT COMPLETED"
    )

    print(
        f"Final status: "
        f"{final_status['status']}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Output directory:\n"
        f"{OUT_DIR}"
    )

    print()

    if final_status["status"] == "FAIL":
        print(
            "✗ Critical leakage issues detected."
        )
        raise SystemExit(2)

    elif (
        final_status["status"]
        == "PASS_WITH_WARNINGS"
    ):
        print(
            "✓ Audit completed with warnings."
        )

    else:
        print(
            "✓ No major feature leakage detected."
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
V3.24 CLEAN HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR
====================================

Purpose
-------
Train the V3.24 discriminator using ONLY leakage-safe,
decision-time features from the V3.17 transition table.

Target
------
1 = V3.17 rescue
0 = V3.17 harm OR neutral

Important
---------
The discriminator NEVER uses:

    v317_rescue
    v317_harm
    v317_neutral
    v317_no_transition
    *_target
    *_y
    *_actual
    *_correct
    selected_model
    independent_* outcome columns
    authoritative outcome columns
    forensic outcome columns

The authoritative V3.17 outcome is reconstructed independently
and joined to the transition table using:

    outer_fold + row_index

Only the 171 V3.17 transitions are used.

This script trains full-data candidate models for later deployment.
Strict nested evaluation is performed by a separate evaluation script.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.ensemble import (
    ExtraTreesClassifier,
    RandomForestClassifier,
    HistGradientBoostingClassifier,
)
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,
    balanced_accuracy_score,
    classification_report,
    confusion_matrix,
    f1_score,
    precision_score,
    recall_score,
    roc_auc_score,
)
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler


warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


# =============================================================================
# PATHS
# =============================================================================

ROOT = Path.home() / "Hybrid_v3"

PHASE4 = ROOT / "Phase_4_Dynamic_Selection"

V317_PREDICTIONS = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_17_nested_selective_rescue"
    / "v3_17_test_predictions.csv"
)

V317_FORENSIC = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "v3_17_identity_outcome_audit"
    / "v3_17_outcome_definition_forensic.csv"
)

V323_TRANSITION = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_23_harm_aware_discriminator"
    / "v3_23_transition_training_table.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    PHASE4
    / "outputs"
    / "pairwise_v3_24_clean_harm_discriminator"
)

OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


# =============================================================================
# CONSTANTS
# =============================================================================

IDENTITY_COLUMNS = [
    "outer_fold",
    "row_index",
]


# These are allowed because they are available before the final outcome.
# They describe the V3.17 switching decision and its decision-time scores.
SAFE_FEATURES = [
    "threshold",
    "score",
    "switch",
    "efficientnet_error_x",
    "resnet_rescue_x",
    "mobile_rescue_x",
    "resnet_harm_x",
    "mobile_harm_x",
]


# Explicit leakage / post-decision columns.
FORBIDDEN_EXACT = {
    # authoritative outcome
    "v317_rescue",
    "v317_harm",
    "v317_neutral",
    "v317_no_transition",

    # transition outcome
    "v317_transition",
    "v317_transition_authoritative",

    "efficientnet_correct",

    "mobile_correct",

    "audit_discriminator_target",

    "_target",
    "_actual",
    "_correct",
    "_y",
    "authoritative",
    "audit_",
    "independent_",
]


# =============================================================================
# PRINTING
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)


# =============================================================================
# LOADING
# =============================================================================

def load_artifacts():
    section("LOADING ARTIFACTS")

    for path, name in [
        (V317_PREDICTIONS, "V3.17 predictions"),
        (V317_FORENSIC, "V3.17 forensic"),
        (V323_TRANSITION, "V3.23 transition"),
    ]:
        if not path.exists():
            fail(f"Missing {name}: {path}")

    v317 = pd.read_csv(V317_PREDICTIONS)
    forensic = pd.read_csv(V317_FORENSIC)
    transition = pd.read_csv(V323_TRANSITION)

    print(f"V3.17 predictions : {v317.shape}")
    print(f"V3.17 forensic    : {forensic.shape}")
    print(f"V3.23 transition  : {transition.shape}")

    print()
    print(f"Predictions path : {V317_PREDICTIONS}")
    print(f"Forensic path    : {V317_FORENSIC}")
    print(f"Transition path  : {V323_TRANSITION}")

    return v317, forensic, transition


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY
# =============================================================================

def validate_identity_columns(df: pd.DataFrame, name: str) -> None:
    missing = [c for c in IDENTITY_COLUMNS if c not in df.columns]

    if missing:
        fail(
            f"{name} is missing identity columns: {missing}"
        )


def normalize_identity(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = df.copy()

    out["outer_fold"] = pd.to_numeric(
        out["outer_fold"],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    out["row_index"] = pd.to_numeric(
        out["row_index"],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    if out[IDENTITY_COLUMNS].isna().any().any():
        fail("Identity columns contain missing values.")

    out["outer_fold"] = out["outer_fold"].astype(int)
    out["row_index"] = out["row_index"].astype(int)

    return out


def identity_set(df: pd.DataFrame):
    return set(
        zip(
            df["outer_fold"].astype(int),
            df["row_index"].astype(int),
        )
    )


def validate_identities(v317, forensic, transition):
    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    validate_identity_columns(v317, "V3.17 predictions")
    validate_identity_columns(forensic, "V3.17 forensic")
    validate_identity_columns(transition, "V3.23 transition")

    v317 = normalize_identity(v317)
    forensic = normalize_identity(forensic)
    transition = normalize_identity(transition)

    v317_ids = identity_set(v317)
    forensic_ids = identity_set(forensic)
    transition_ids = identity_set(transition)

    print(f"V3.17 unique identities : {len(v317_ids)}")
    print(f"Forensic unique identities: {len(forensic_ids)}")
    print(f"Transition unique identities: {len(transition_ids)}")
    print(f"Common identities       : {len(v317_ids & forensic_ids)}")

    if v317_ids != forensic_ids:
        fail(
            "V3.17 predictions and forensic identity sets do not match."
        )

    print("✓ Exact identity set match.")

    if not transition_ids.issubset(forensic_ids):
        missing = transition_ids - forensic_ids

        fail(
            "Transition identities are missing from forensic dataset. "
            f"Missing count={len(missing)}"
        )

    print("✓ All transition identities exist in forensic dataset.")

    return v317, forensic, transition


# =============================================================================
# FIND OUTCOME COLUMNS
# =============================================================================

def find_column(df: pd.DataFrame, candidates):
    for col in candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            return col

    return None


def detect_outcome_columns(forensic: pd.DataFrame):
    rescue = find_column(
        forensic,
        [
            "v317_rescue",
            "rescue",
            "authoritative_rescue",
        ],
    )

    harm = find_column(
        forensic,
        [
            "v317_harm",
            "harm",
            "authoritative_harm",
        ],
    )

    neutral = find_column(
        forensic,
        [
            "v317_neutral",
            "neutral",
            "authoritative_neutral",
        ],
    )

    no_transition = find_column(
        forensic,
        [
            "v317_no_transition",
            "no_transition",
            "authoritative_no_transition",
        ],
    )

    missing = []

    if rescue is None:
        missing.append("rescue")

    if harm is None:
        missing.append("harm")

    if neutral is None:
        missing.append("neutral")

    if no_transition is None:
        missing.append("no_transition")

    if missing:
        fail(
            "Could not identify authoritative outcome columns: "
            + ", ".join(missing)
        )

    print("Detected authoritative columns:")
    print(f"  rescue       : {rescue}")
    print(f"  harm         : {harm}")
    print(f"  neutral      : {neutral}")
    print(f"  no_transition: {no_transition}")

    return rescue, harm, neutral, no_transition


# =============================================================================
# AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOMES
# =============================================================================

def build_authoritative_outcomes(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING AUTHORITATIVE V3.17 OUTCOME TABLE")

    rescue_col, harm_col, neutral_col, no_transition_col = (
        detect_outcome_columns(forensic)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # IMPORTANT:
    # Preserve outer_fold + row_index from the forensic table.
    #
    # This fixes the previous failure:
    #
    #   Authoritative table missing identity column: outer_fold
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    keep = IDENTITY_COLUMNS + [
        rescue_col,
        harm_col,
        neutral_col,
        no_transition_col,
    ]

    auth = forensic[keep].copy()

    auth = normalize_identity(auth)

    # Rename into canonical names.
    auth = auth.rename(
        columns={
            rescue_col: "v317_rescue",
            harm_col: "v317_harm",
            neutral_col: "v317_neutral",
            no_transition_col: "v317_no_transition",
        }
    )

    # Convert flags safely.
    for col in [
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
    ]:
        auth[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            auth[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        if auth[col].isna().any():
            fail(
                f"Authoritative outcome column contains missing values: {col}"
            )

        auth[col] = (auth[col] > 0).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Remove accidental duplicates.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if auth.duplicated(IDENTITY_COLUMNS).any():
        dup_count = auth.duplicated(IDENTITY_COLUMNS).sum()

        fail(
            f"Authoritative outcome table contains {dup_count} "
            "duplicate identities."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Raw outcome combinations
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("Raw outcome flag combinations:")

    print(
        auth[
            [
                "v317_rescue",
                "v317_harm",
                "v317_neutral",
                "v317_no_transition",
            ]
        ]
        .value_counts()
        .sort_index()
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate the complete partition.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    total_flags = (
        auth["v317_rescue"]
        + auth["v317_harm"]
        + auth["v317_neutral"]
        + auth["v317_no_transition"]
    )

    if not (total_flags == 1).all():
        bad = auth.loc[
            total_flags != 1,
            IDENTITY_COLUMNS
            + [
                "v317_rescue",
                "v317_harm",
                "v317_neutral",
                "v317_no_transition",
            ],
        ]

        print()
        print("Invalid outcome rows:")
        print(bad.to_string(index=False))

        fail(
            "Authoritative V3.17 outcomes are not mutually exclusive "
            "and exhaustive."
        )

    print()
    print(
        f"Transitions         : "
        f"{int((auth['v317_rescue'] | auth['v317_harm'] | auth['v317_neutral']).sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues             : {int(auth['v317_rescue'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms               : {int(auth['v317_harm'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral transitions : {int(auth['v317_neutral'].sum())}"
    )

    print(
        f"No transition       : {int(auth['v317_no_transition'].sum())}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save complete authoritative table.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_authoritative_outcomes_complete.csv"
    )

    auth.to_csv(path, index=False)

    print()
    print(f"Saved authoritative outcomes:")
    print(path)

    return auth


# =============================================================================
# BUILD CLEAN TRAINING DATASET
# =============================================================================

def build_clean_dataset(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
    authoritative: pd.DataFrame,
):
    section("BUILDING CLEAN V3.24 TRAINING DATASET")

    transition = transition.copy()
    authoritative = authoritative.copy()

    transition = normalize_identity(transition)
    authoritative = normalize_identity(authoritative)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # The transition table must contain the decision-time feature candidates.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    missing_safe = [
        col
        for col in SAFE_FEATURES
        if col not in transition.columns
    ]

    if missing_safe:
        fail(
            "Transition table is missing required leakage-safe features:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {x}" for x in missing_safe)
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Only transition identities.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    auth_transition = authoritative[
        (
            authoritative["v317_rescue"] == 1
        )
        | (
            authoritative["v317_harm"] == 1
        )
        | (
            authoritative["v317_neutral"] == 1
        )
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Authoritative transition rows : {len(auth_transition)}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge by exact identity.
    #
    # This is the critical fix for the previous:
    #
    #   missing outer_fold
    #
    # error.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    merge_cols = IDENTITY_COLUMNS + [
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
    ]

    auth_transition = auth_transition[merge_cols]

    if auth_transition.duplicated(IDENTITY_COLUMNS).any():
        fail(
            "Authoritative transition table contains duplicate identities."
        )

    df = transition.merge(
        auth_transition,
        on=IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
        suffixes=("", "_authoritative"),
    )

    print(f"Merged training table : {df.shape}")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Every transition must have an authoritative outcome.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    outcome_cols = [
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
    ]

    missing_outcomes = df[outcome_cols].isna().any(axis=1)

    if missing_outcomes.any():
        print(
            df.loc[
                missing_outcomes,
                IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
            ].to_string(index=False)
        )

        fail(
            f"{int(missing_outcomes.sum())} transition identities "
            "could not be aligned with authoritative outcomes."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Construct target.
    #
    # rescue = 1
    # harm/neutral = 0
    #
    # No transition should never be present here.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["discriminator_target"] = (
        df["v317_rescue"] == 1
    ).astype(int)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify the transition dataset.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    invalid_no_transition = (
        df["v317_no_transition"] == 1
    )

    if invalid_no_transition.any():
        fail(
            "No-transition rows entered the discriminator training dataset."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify target distribution.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("Target distribution:")

    print(
        df["discriminator_target"]
        .map({
            1: "rescue",
            0: "bad_switch",
        })
        .value_counts()
    )

    rescue_count = int(
        (df["discriminator_target"] == 1).sum()
    )

    bad_count = int(
        (df["discriminator_target"] == 0).sum()
    )

    print()
    print(f"Rescue samples    : {rescue_count}")
    print(f"Bad-switch samples: {bad_count}")
    print(f"Total             : {len(df)}")

    if rescue_count == 0 or bad_count == 0:
        fail(
            "Training dataset contains only one target class."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Select CLEAN features.
    #
    # Only SAFE_FEATURES are allowed.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature_candidates = []

    print()
    print("Candidate features:")

    for col in SAFE_FEATURES:
        if col not in df.columns:
            continue

        feature_candidates.append(col)
        print(f"  ✓ {col}")

    if not feature_candidates:
        fail("No clean discriminator features available.")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Ensure absolutely no forbidden features slipped through.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for col in feature_candidates:

        lower = col.lower()

        if col in FORBIDDEN_EXACT:
            fail(
                f"Forbidden leakage feature selected: {col}"
            )

        for token in FORBIDDEN_TOKENS:
            if token in lower:
                fail(
                    f"Potential leakage feature selected: "
                    f"{col} contains '{token}'"
                )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Numeric conversion.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    for col in feature_candidates:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Check feature values.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    print()
    print("Feature missingness:")

    for col in feature_candidates:
        missing = int(df[col].isna().sum())

        print(
            f"  {col:<35} missing={missing}"
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Drop rows with no feature information at all.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    all_missing = df[feature_candidates].isna().all(axis=1)

    if all_missing.any():
        print(
            f"\nDropping {int(all_missing.sum())} rows "
            "with all discriminator features missing."
        )

        df = df.loc[~all_missing].copy()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save clean training table.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    clean_columns = (
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + feature_candidates
        + [
            "v317_rescue",
            "v317_harm",
            "v317_neutral",
            "v317_no_transition",
            "discriminator_target",
        ]
    )

    clean_df = df[clean_columns].copy()

    clean_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_clean_training_table.csv"
    )

    clean_df.to_csv(
        clean_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print()
    print(f"Saved clean training table:")
    print(clean_path)

    return clean_df, feature_candidates


# =============================================================================
# FEATURE AUDIT
# =============================================================================

def audit_features(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    features,
):
    section("V3.24 CLEAN FEATURE AUDIT")

    print(f"Final feature count: {len(features)}")

    for i, col in enumerate(features, 1):
        print(f"  {i:02d}. {col}")

    print()
    print("Forbidden-column audit:")

    problems = []

    for col in features:
        lower = col.lower()

        if col in FORBIDDEN_EXACT:
            problems.append(col)

        for token in FORBIDDEN_TOKENS:
            if token in lower:
                problems.append(col)

    problems = sorted(set(problems))

    if problems:
        print()
        for col in problems:
            print(f"  ✗ {col}")

        fail(
            "Forbidden feature detected."
        )

    print("✓ No forbidden outcome-derived features.")

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Correlations are diagnostic only.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    target = df["discriminator_target"]

    rows = []

    for col in features:

        x = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

        valid = (
            x.notna()
            & target.notna()
        )

        if valid.sum() < 3:
            corr = np.nan
        else:
            corr = np.corrcoef(
                x.loc[valid],
                target.loc[valid],
            )[0, 1]

        rows.append(
            {
                "feature": col,
                "target_correlation": corr,
                "abs_target_correlation": (
                    abs(corr)
                    if np.isfinite(corr)
                    else np.nan
                ),
                "n_valid": int(valid.sum()),
            }
        )

    corr_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    corr_df = corr_df.sort_values(
        "abs_target_correlation",
        ascending=False,
        na_position="last",
    )

    print()
    print(corr_df.to_string(index=False))

    corr_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_clean_feature_target_correlations.csv"
    )

    corr_df.to_csv(
        corr_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print()
    print(f"Saved feature correlations:")
    print(corr_path)


# =============================================================================
# MODEL BUILDERS
# =============================================================================

def make_models():
    models = {}

    models["logistic_regression"] = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            ),
            (
                "scaler",
                StandardScaler(),
            ),
            (
                "classifier",
                LogisticRegression(
                    max_iter=5000,
                    class_weight="balanced",
                    random_state=42,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    models["random_forest"] = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            ),
            (
                "classifier",
                RandomForestClassifier(
                    n_estimators=500,
                    max_depth=6,
                    min_samples_leaf=3,
                    class_weight="balanced",
                    random_state=42,
                    n_jobs=-1,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    models["extra_trees"] = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            ),
            (
                "classifier",
                ExtraTreesClassifier(
                    n_estimators=500,
                    max_depth=8,
                    min_samples_leaf=2,
                    class_weight="balanced",
                    random_state=42,
                    n_jobs=-1,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    models["hist_gradient_boosting"] = Pipeline(
        steps=[
            (
                "imputer",
                SimpleImputer(strategy="median"),
            ),
            (
                "classifier",
                HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
                    max_iter=300,
                    learning_rate=0.05,
                    max_leaf_nodes=15,
                    l2_regularization=1.0,
                    random_state=42,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    return models


# =============================================================================
# TRAIN FULL DATA
# =============================================================================

def train_models(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    features,
):
    section("TRAINING V3.24 CLEAN DISCRIMINATORS")

    X = df[features].copy()
    y = df["discriminator_target"].astype(int)

    print(f"Samples : {len(df)}")
    print(f"Features: {len(features)}")

    models = make_models()

    results = []

    trained_models = {}

    for name, model in models.items():

        print()
        print("-" * 100)
        print(f"MODEL: {name}")
        print("-" * 100)

        model.fit(X, y)

        trained_models[name] = model

        pred = model.predict(X)

        if hasattr(model, "predict_proba"):
            probability = model.predict_proba(X)[:, 1]
        else:
            probability = None

        acc = accuracy_score(
            y,
            pred,
        )

        bal_acc = balanced_accuracy_score(
            y,
            pred,
        )

        macro_f1 = f1_score(
            y,
            pred,
            average="macro",
        )

        precision = precision_score(
            y,
            pred,
            zero_division=0,
        )

        recall = recall_score(
            y,
            pred,
            zero_division=0,
        )

        if probability is not None:
            auc = roc_auc_score(
                y,
                probability,
            )
        else:
            auc = np.nan

        print(f"Accuracy          : {acc:.6f}")
        print(f"Balanced accuracy : {bal_acc:.6f}")
        print(f"Macro F1          : {macro_f1:.6f}")
        print(f"Precision         : {precision:.6f}")
        print(f"Recall            : {recall:.6f}")
        print(f"ROC-AUC           : {auc:.6f}")

        print()
        print("Confusion matrix:")
        print(
            confusion_matrix(
                y,
                pred,
            )
        )

        results.append(
            {
                "model": name,
                "accuracy": acc,
                "balanced_accuracy": bal_acc,
                "macro_f1": macro_f1,
                "precision": precision,
                "recall": recall,
                "roc_auc": auc,
            }
        )

    results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

    results_df = results_df.sort_values(
        "roc_auc",
        ascending=False,
    )

    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print("V3.24 MODEL COMPARISON")
    print("=" * 100)

    print(
        results_df.to_string(
            index=False,
        )
    )

    results_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_clean_model_comparison.csv"
    )

    results_df.to_csv(
        results_path,
        index=False,
    )

    print()
    print(f"Saved model comparison:")
    print(results_path)

    return trained_models, results_df


# =============================================================================
# SAVE MODELS
# =============================================================================

def save_models(
    models,
    features,
):
    section("SAVING V3.24 MODELS")

    try:
        import joblib
    except ImportError:
        fail(
            "joblib is required to save trained models."
        )

    model_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / "models"
    model_dir.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    saved = []

    for name, model in models.items():

        path = (
            model_dir
            / f"v3_24_{name}.joblib"
        )

        joblib.dump(
            model,
            path,
        )

        saved.append(
            {
                "model": name,
                "path": str(path),
            }
        )

        print(
            f"✓ {name}: {path}"
        )

    metadata = {
        "version": "V3.24",
        "target_definition": {
            "positive": "V3.17 rescue",
            "negative": "V3.17 harm OR neutral",
        },
        "n_samples": int(
            sum(
                1
                for _ in models
            )
            * 0
        ),
        "features": features,
        "forbidden_features": sorted(
            FORBIDDEN_EXACT
        ),
    }

    metadata_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_model_metadata.json"
    )

    with open(
        metadata_path,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            metadata,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    print()
    print(f"Saved metadata:")
    print(metadata_path)

    return saved


# =============================================================================
# SAVE TRAINING SUMMARY
# =============================================================================

def save_summary(
    df,
    features,
    results_df,
):
    section("SAVING V3.24 SUMMARY")

    rescue = int(
        (df["discriminator_target"] == 1).sum()
    )

    bad = int(
        (df["discriminator_target"] == 0).sum()
    )

    lines = []

    lines.append(
        "V3.24 CLEAN HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR"
    )
    lines.append(
        "=" * 70
    )
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Dataset"
    )
    lines.append(
        f"Total transition samples : {len(df)}"
    )
    lines.append(
        f"Rescue samples           : {rescue}"
    )
    lines.append(
        f"Harm/neutral samples     : {bad}"
    )
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Target"
    )
    lines.append(
        "1 = V3.17 rescue"
    )
    lines.append(
        "0 = V3.17 harm OR neutral"
    )
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Clean features"
    )

    for feature in features:
        lines.append(
            f"  - {feature}"
        )

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "Forbidden outcome-derived features were excluded."
    )
    lines.append(
        "Strict nested evaluation must be performed separately."
    )
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(
        "MODEL RESULTS"
    )
    lines.append(
        results_df.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_clean_harm_discriminator_summary.txt"
    )

    with open(
        path,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:
        f.write(
            "\n".join(lines)
        )

    print(path)


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section("V3.24 CLEAN HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR")

    print(
        "This version fixes the previous authoritative-outcome "
        "identity-loss problem."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Target:"
    )
    print(
        "  1 = V3.17 rescue"
    )
    print(
        "  0 = V3.17 harm OR neutral"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Only decision-time features are allowed."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317, forensic, transition = load_artifacts()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Identity validation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317, forensic, transition = validate_identities(
        v317,
        forensic,
        transition,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Authoritative outcomes
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    authoritative = build_authoritative_outcomes(
        v317,
        forensic,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Clean dataset
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df, feature_candidates = build_clean_dataset(
        transition,
        authoritative,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature audit
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    audit_features(
        df,
        feature_candidates,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Train models
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    trained_models, results_df = train_models(
        df,
        feature_candidates,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save models
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_models(
        trained_models,
        feature_candidates,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_summary(
        df,
        feature_candidates,
        results_df,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section("V3.24 TRAINING COMPLETED")

    print(
        "✓ Authoritative outcomes reconstructed."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Identity preserved using outer_fold + row_index."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Only V3.17 transition rows used."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Rescue = positive target."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Harm + neutral = negative target."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Outcome-derived features excluded."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Full-data candidate models trained."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Output directory:"
    )
    print(
        OUTPUT_DIR
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

"""
V3.24 CLEAN HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR
====================================

Purpose
-------
Evaluate the V3.24 clean harm-aware discriminator without target leakage.

V3.24 target:

    1 = V3.17 rescue
    0 = V3.17 harm OR neutral

Decision-time features only:

    threshold
    score
    switch
    efficientnet_error_x
    resnet_rescue_x
    mobile_rescue_x
    resnet_harm_x
    mobile_harm_x

Important
---------
The V3.17 forensic artifact does NOT contain the original lesion
true_label. Therefore this evaluator does NOT attempt to invent one.

The evaluation is performed on the authoritative V3.17 outcome:

    rescue
    harm
    neutral

The actual V3.17 selected model is preserved and compared against
a discriminator-controlled policy.

The discriminator is evaluated using nested OOF predictions when
available.

No test-set retraining is performed.

"""

from __future__ import annotations

)
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

# =============================================================================
# UTILITIES
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:

    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:

    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def normalize_identity(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:

    out = df.copy()

    for col in IDENTITY_COLUMNS:

        if col not in out.columns:
            fail(
                f"Missing identity column: {col}"
            )

    out["outer_fold"] = pd.to_numeric(
        out["outer_fold"],
        errors="raise",
    ).astype(int)

    out["row_index"] = pd.to_numeric(
        out["row_index"],
        errors="raise",
    ).astype(int)

    return out


def identity_index(df: pd.DataFrame):

    return pd.MultiIndex.from_frame(
        df[IDENTITY_COLUMNS]
    )


def ensure_unique_identities(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    name: str,
) -> None:

    idx = identity_index(df)

    duplicated = idx.duplicated()

    if duplicated.any():

        n = int(duplicated.sum())

        fail(
            f"{name} contains {n} duplicated identities."
        )


def print_distribution(
    series: pd.Series,
    name: str,
) -> None:

    print()
    print(name)

    print(
        series.value_counts(
            dropna=False
        ).to_string()
    )

def load_artifacts():

    for path in [

        if not path.exists():

                f"Required artifact does not exist:\n{path}"

    v317 = pd.read_csv(
        V317_PREDICTIONS
    )

    forensic = pd.read_csv(
        FORENSIC_FILE
    )

    training = pd.read_csv(
        TRAINING_FILE
    )

    authoritative = pd.read_csv(
        AUTHORITATIVE_FILE
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 predictions : {v317.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 forensic    : {forensic.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 training    : {training.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 outcomes    : {authoritative.shape}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Predictions path : {V317_PREDICTIONS}"
    )

    print(
        f"Forensic path    : {FORENSIC_FILE}"
    )

    print(
        f"Training path    : {TRAINING_FILE}"
    )

    print(
        f"Outcomes path    : {AUTHORITATIVE_FILE}"
    )

    return (
        normalize_identity(v317),
        normalize_identity(forensic),
        normalize_identity(training),
        normalize_identity(authoritative),
    )
