def validate_identities(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    training: pd.DataFrame,
    authoritative: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    for df, name in [
        (v317, "V3.17"),
        (forensic, "forensic"),
        (training, "V3.24 training"),
        (authoritative, "authoritative"),
    ]:

        ensure_unique_identities(
            df,
            name,
        )

    v317_ids = identity_index(v317)
    forensic_ids = identity_index(forensic)
    training_ids = identity_index(training)
    authoritative_ids = identity_index(authoritative)

    print(
        f"V3.17 identities      : {len(v317_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Forensic identities   : {len(forensic_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Training identities   : {len(training_ids)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Outcome identities    : {len(authoritative_ids)}"
    )

    if set(v317_ids) != set(forensic_ids):

        fail(
            "V3.17 and forensic identity sets do not match."
        )

    print(
        "✓ V3.17 / forensic identity sets match."
    )

    if not set(training_ids).issubset(
        set(v317_ids)
    ):

        fail(
            "V3.24 training identities are outside V3.17."
        )

    print(
        "✓ V3.24 training identities belong to V3.17."
    )

    if not set(authoritative_ids).issubset(
        set(v317_ids)
    ):

        fail(
            "Authoritative outcome identities are outside V3.17."
        )

    print(
        "✓ Authoritative outcome identities belong to V3.17."
    )


# =============================================================================
# AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOME
# =============================================================================

def build_authoritative_outcomes(
    authoritative: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "BUILDING AUTHORITATIVE V3.17 OUTCOME TABLE"
    )

    required = [
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
    ]

    missing = [
        c
        for c in required
        if c not in authoritative.columns
    ]

    if missing:

        fail(
            "Authoritative outcome table missing:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing)
        )

    out = authoritative[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS + required
    ].copy()

    for col in required:

        out[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            out[col],
            errors="coerce",
        )

    if out[required].isna().any().any():

        fail(
            "Missing values detected in authoritative outcome flags."
        )

    out[required] = (
        out[required]
        .astype(int)
    )

    raw = (
        out[required]
        .value_counts()
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Raw outcome combinations:"
    )

    print(
        raw.to_string()
    )

    total = (
        out[
            "v317_rescue"
        ]
        + out[
            "v317_harm"
        ]
        + out[
            "v317_neutral"
        ]
        + out[
            "v317_no_transition"
        ]
    )

    bad = total != 1

    if bad.any():

        fail(
            "Authoritative V3.17 outcome flags are not mutually exclusive."
        )

    out["outcome"] = np.select(
        [
            out["v317_rescue"] == 1,
            out["v317_harm"] == 1,
            out["v317_neutral"] == 1,
            out["v317_no_transition"] == 1,
        ],
        [
            "rescue",
            "harm",
            "neutral",
            "no_transition",
        ],
        default="unknown",
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Outcome distribution:"
    )

    print(
        out["outcome"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    transition_mask = (
        out["outcome"]
        != "no_transition"
    )

    transition_count = int(
        transition_mask.sum()
    )

    rescue_count = int(
        (
            out["outcome"]
            == "rescue"
        ).sum()
    )

    harm_count = int(
        (
            out["outcome"]
            == "harm"
        ).sum()
    )

    neutral_count = int(
        (
            out["outcome"]
            == "neutral"
        ).sum()
    )

    no_transition_count = int(
        (
            out["outcome"]
            == "no_transition"
        ).sum()
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Transitions         : {transition_count}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues             : {rescue_count}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms               : {harm_count}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral transitions : {neutral_count}"
    )

    print(
        f"No transition       : {no_transition_count}"
    )

    out["discriminator_target"] = np.where(
        out["outcome"] == "rescue",
        1,
        np.where(
            out["outcome"].isin(
                ["harm", "neutral"]
            ),
            0,
            np.nan,
        ),
    )

    out["is_transition"] = (
        out["outcome"]
        .isin(
            [
                "rescue",
                "harm",
                "neutral",
            ]
        )
    )

    return out


# =============================================================================
# EVALUATION DATASET
# =============================================================================

def build_evaluation_dataset(
    training: pd.DataFrame,
    authoritative: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "BUILDING EVALUATION DATASET"
    )

    missing_features = [
        c
        for c in FEATURES
        if c not in training.columns
    ]

    if missing_features:

        fail(
            "V3.24 training table is missing features:\n"
            + "\n".join(missing_features)
        )

    training_ids = identity_index(
        training
    )

    authoritative_ids = identity_index(
        authoritative
    )

    if not set(training_ids).issubset(
        set(authoritative_ids)
    ):

        fail(
            "Training identities are not all present "
            "in authoritative outcomes."
        )

    outcome_cols = [
        "outcome",
        "discriminator_target",
        "is_transition",
        "v317_rescue",
        "v317_harm",
        "v317_neutral",
        "v317_no_transition",
    ]

    outcomes_small = authoritative[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + outcome_cols
    ].copy()

    df = training[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + FEATURES
    ].merge(
        outcomes_small,
        on=IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    if len(df) != len(training):

        fail(
            "Identity merge changed the number of training rows."
        )

    if df[
        "discriminator_target"
    ].isna().any():

        fail(
            "Missing discriminator targets after identity merge."
        )

    for feature in FEATURES:

        df[feature] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[feature],
            errors="coerce",
        )

    if df[FEATURES].isna().any().any():

        print()
        print(
            "Feature missingness:"
        )

        print(
            df[FEATURES]
            .isna()
            .sum()
            .to_string()
        )

        fail(
            "Missing decision-time feature values."
        )

    print(
        f"Evaluation dataset : {df.shape}"
    )

    print_distribution(
        df["outcome"],
        "Outcome distribution:",
    )

    print_distribution(
        df["discriminator_target"],
        "Discriminator target distribution:",
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# MODEL CONSTRUCTION
# =============================================================================

def build_models():

    models = {}

    models[
        "logistic_regression"
    ] = Pipeline(
        [
            (
                "scaler",
                StandardScaler(),
            ),
            (
                "classifier",
                LogisticRegression(
                    max_iter=5000,
                    class_weight="balanced",
                    random_state=42,
                ),
            ),
        ]
    )

    models[
        "random_forest"
    ] = RandomForestClassifier(
        n_estimators=500,
        max_depth=None,
        min_samples_leaf=2,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )

    models[
        "extra_trees"
    ] = ExtraTreesClassifier(
        n_estimators=500,
        max_depth=None,
        min_samples_leaf=2,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=42,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )

    models[
        "hist_gradient_boosting"
    ] = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
        max_iter=300,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_leaf_nodes=15,
        l2_regularization=1.0,
        random_state=42,
    )

    return models


# =============================================================================
# NESTED OOF
# =============================================================================

def generate_oof_predictions(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Dict[str, pd.Series]:

    section(
        "GENERATING OUT-OF-FOLD DISCRIMINATOR PREDICTIONS"
    )

    X = df[
        FEATURES
    ].to_numpy(
        dtype=float
    )

    y = df[
        TARGET_COLUMN
    ].astype(int).to_numpy()

    folds = df[
        "outer_fold"
    ].astype(int).to_numpy()

    models = build_models()

    results = {}

    for model_name, base_model in models.items():

        print()
        print(
            f"MODEL: {model_name}"
        )

        probabilities = np.full(
            len(df),
            np.nan,
            dtype=float,
        )

        unique_folds = sorted(
            np.unique(folds)
        )

        for fold in unique_folds:

            test_mask = (
                folds == fold
            )

            train_mask = (
                folds != fold
            )

            if train_mask.sum() == 0:
                continue

            model = clone(
                base_model
            )

            model.fit(
                X[train_mask],
                y[train_mask],
            )

            if hasattr(
                model,
                "predict_proba",
            ):

                proba = model.predict_proba(
                    X[test_mask]
                )[:, 1]

            else:

                decision = model.decision_function(
                    X[test_mask]
                )

                proba = (
                    1.0
                    /
                    (
                        1.0
                        + np.exp(
                            -np.clip(
                                decision,
                                -50,
                                50,
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )

            probabilities[
                test_mask
            ] = proba

        valid = np.isfinite(
            probabilities
        )

        if valid.sum() != len(df):

            fail(
                f"OOF predictions incomplete for {model_name}."
            )

        pred = (
            probabilities
            >= 0.5
        ).astype(int)

        print(
            f"OOF samples : {int(valid.sum())}"
        )

        print(
            f"Accuracy    : "
            f"{accuracy_score(y, pred):.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Balanced acc: "
            f"{balanced_accuracy_score(y, pred):.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"Macro F1    : "
            f"{f1_score(y, pred, average='macro'):.6f}"
        )

        print(
            f"ROC-AUC     : "
            f"{roc_auc_score(y, probabilities):.6f}"
        )

        results[
            model_name
        ] = pd.Series(
            probabilities,
            index=df.index,
            name=model_name,
        )

    return results


# =============================================================================
# OOF MODEL COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def compare_oof_models(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    oof: Dict[str, pd.Series],
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "V3.24 OOF MODEL COMPARISON"
    )

    y = df[
        TARGET_COLUMN
    ].astype(int).to_numpy()

    rows = []

    for model_name, proba_series in oof.items():

        proba = proba_series.to_numpy()

        pred = (
            proba >= 0.5
        ).astype(int)

        tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(
            y,
            pred,
            labels=[0, 1],
        ).ravel()

        rows.append(
            {
                "model": model_name,
                "accuracy": accuracy_score(
                    y,
                    pred,
                ),
                "balanced_accuracy": balanced_accuracy_score(
                    y,
                    pred,
                ),
                "macro_f1": f1_score(
                    y,
                    pred,
                    average="macro",
                ),
                "precision": precision_score(
                    y,
                    pred,
                    zero_division=0,
                ),
                "recall": recall_score(
                    y,
                    pred,
                    zero_division=0,
                ),
                "roc_auc": roc_auc_score(
                    y,
                    proba,
                ),
                "tn": int(tn),
                "fp": int(fp),
                "fn": int(fn),
                "tp": int(tp),
            }
        )

    result = (
        pd.DataFrame(rows)
        .sort_values(
            [
                "balanced_accuracy",
                "roc_auc",
            ],
            ascending=False,
        )
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_oof_model_comparison.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# SELECT BEST MODEL
# =============================================================================

def select_best_model(
    comparison: pd.DataFrame,
) -> str:

    # Primary criterion:
    # balanced accuracy
    #
    # Secondary:
    # ROC-AUC

    row = (
        comparison
        .sort_values(
            [
                "balanced_accuracy",
                "roc_auc",
            ],
            ascending=False,
        )
        .iloc[0]
    )

    model_name = str(
        row["model"]
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Best OOF discriminator: {model_name}"
    )

    return model_name


# =============================================================================
# POLICY METRICS
# =============================================================================

def calculate_policy_metrics(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    allow_switch: np.ndarray,
    model_name: str,
    probability: np.ndarray,
    threshold: float,
) -> Dict:

    outcome = (
        df["outcome"]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    is_transition = (
        df["is_transition"]
        .astype(bool)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    rescue_mask = (
        outcome == "rescue"
    )

    harm_mask = (
        outcome == "harm"
    )

    neutral_mask = (
        outcome == "neutral"
    )

    no_transition_mask = (
        outcome == "no_transition"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # IMPORTANT:
    #
    # Everything below uses element-wise '&'.
    #
    # NEVER do:
    #
    # int(neutral_mask.sum() & allow_switch)
    #
    # because that attempts scalar/array bitwise arithmetic.
    #
    # Correct:
    #
    # int((neutral_mask & allow_switch).sum())
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    switched_rescue = int(
        (
            rescue_mask
            & allow_switch
        ).sum()
    )

    switched_harm = int(
        (
            harm_mask
            & allow_switch
        ).sum()
    )

    switched_neutral = int(
        (
            neutral_mask
            & allow_switch
        ).sum()
    )

    switched_no_transition = int(
        (
            no_transition_mask
            & allow_switch
        ).sum()
    )

    blocked_rescue = int(
        (
            rescue_mask
            & (~allow_switch)
        ).sum()
    )

    blocked_harm = int(
        (
            harm_mask
            & (~allow_switch)
        ).sum()
    )

    blocked_neutral = int(
        (
            neutral_mask
            & (~allow_switch)
        ).sum()
    )

    n_transition = int(
        is_transition.sum()
    )

    n_switch = int(
        allow_switch.sum()
    )

    n_no_switch = int(
        (~allow_switch).sum()
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.17 baseline on transition set:
    #
    # Every actual V3.17 transition is already categorized as rescue/harm/
    # neutral.
    #
    # Policy improvement is therefore:
    #
    # +1 for a rescue retained as a switch
    # -1 for a harm switched
    #  0 for neutral
    #
    # The evaluator additionally reports rescue recall and harm rate.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rescue_total = int(
        rescue_mask.sum()
    )

    harm_total = int(
        harm_mask.sum()
    )

    neutral_total = int(
        neutral_mask.sum()
    )

    rescue_recall = (
        switched_rescue / rescue_total
        if rescue_total > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    harm_rate = (
        switched_harm / harm_total
        if harm_total > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    neutral_switch_rate = (
        switched_neutral / neutral_total
        if neutral_total > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    net_gain = (
        switched_rescue
        - switched_harm
    )

    rescue_harm_ratio = (
        switched_rescue / switched_harm
        if switched_harm > 0
        else math.inf
    )

    return {
        "model": model_name,
        "threshold": float(threshold),
        "n_total": int(len(df)),
        "n_transition": n_transition,
        "n_switch": n_switch,
        "n_no_switch": n_no_switch,
        "switched_rescue": switched_rescue,
        "switched_harm": switched_harm,
        "switched_neutral": switched_neutral,
        "switched_no_transition": switched_no_transition,
        "blocked_rescue": blocked_rescue,
        "blocked_harm": blocked_harm,
        "blocked_neutral": blocked_neutral,
        "rescue_total": rescue_total,
        "harm_total": harm_total,
        "neutral_total": neutral_total,
        "rescue_recall": rescue_recall,
        "harm_rate": harm_rate,
        "neutral_switch_rate": neutral_switch_rate,
        "net_gain": net_gain,
        "rescue_harm_ratio": rescue_harm_ratio,
    }


# =============================================================================
# THRESHOLD SEARCH
# =============================================================================

def search_policy_threshold(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    probability: np.ndarray,
    model_name: str,
) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, Dict]:

    section(
        f"POLICY THRESHOLD SEARCH — {model_name}"
    )

    thresholds = np.linspace(
        0.05,
        0.95,
        181,
    )

    rows = []

    for threshold in thresholds:

        # Higher rescue probability means:
        #
        # "this transition looks more like a rescue"
        #
        # Therefore permit the V3.17 switch when probability >= threshold.

        allow_switch = (
            np.asarray(
                probability,
                dtype=float,
            )
            >= float(threshold)
        )

        metrics = calculate_policy_metrics(
            df=df,
            allow_switch=allow_switch,
            model_name=model_name,
            probability=probability,
            threshold=float(threshold),
        )

        rows.append(
            metrics
        )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Conservative objective:
    #
    # First maximize net gain.
    # Then maximize rescue recall.
    # Then minimize harm rate.
    # Then prefer fewer switches.
    #
    # This avoids selecting a threshold simply because it switches almost
    # everything.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    result = result.sort_values(
        [
            "net_gain",
            "rescue_recall",
            "harm_rate",
            "n_switch",
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            False,
            True,
            True,
        ],
    ).reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    best = result.iloc[0].to_dict()

    print()
    print(
        "BEST POLICY:"
    )

    for key in [
        "threshold",
        "n_switch",
        "switched_rescue",
        "switched_harm",
        "switched_neutral",
        "rescue_recall",
        "harm_rate",
        "net_gain",
        "rescue_harm_ratio",
    ]:

        print(
            f"{key:25s}: {best[key]}"
        )

    result.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / f"v3_24_{model_name}_threshold_search.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result, best


# =============================================================================
# POLICY SIMULATION
# =============================================================================

def simulate_policy(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    probability: np.ndarray,
    model_name: str,
    threshold: float,
) -> Dict:

    section(
        "V3.24 POLICY SIMULATION"
    )

    probability = np.asarray(
        probability,
        dtype=float,
    ).reshape(-1)

    if len(probability) != len(df):

        fail(
            "Probability length does not match evaluation dataset."
        )

    # Explicit bool array.
    #
    # This is important because later we perform element-wise boolean
    # operations with masks.
    allow_switch = (
        probability
        >= float(threshold)
    ).astype(bool)

    policy = calculate_policy_metrics(
        df=df,
        allow_switch=allow_switch,
        model_name=model_name,
        probability=probability,
        threshold=threshold,
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Model                  : {model_name}"
    )

    print(
        f"Threshold              : {threshold:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Total samples          : {policy['n_total']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Transition samples     : {policy['n_transition']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Allowed switches       : {policy['n_switch']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Blocked switches       : {policy['n_no_switch']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Rescues switched       : "
        f"{policy['switched_rescue']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms switched         : "
        f"{policy['switched_harm']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral switched       : "
        f"{policy['switched_neutral']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"Rescue recall          : "
        f"{policy['rescue_recall']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harm rate              : "
        f"{policy['harm_rate']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Neutral switch rate    : "
        f"{policy['neutral_switch_rate']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net gain               : "
        f"{policy['net_gain']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescue/Harm ratio      : "
        f"{policy['rescue_harm_ratio']}"
    )

    return policy


# =============================================================================
# V3.17 BASELINE
# =============================================================================

def calculate_v317_baseline(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Dict:

    section(
        "V3.17 BASELINE POLICY"
    )

    outcome = (
        df["outcome"]
        .astype(str)
        .to_numpy()
    )

    rescue = (
        outcome == "rescue"
    )

    harm = (
        outcome == "harm"
    )

    neutral = (
        outcome == "neutral"
    )

    no_transition = (
        outcome == "no_transition"
    )

    # V3.17 actually switched on all transition rows.

    allow_switch = (
        rescue
        | harm
        | neutral
    )

    switched_rescue = int(
        (
            rescue
            & allow_switch
        ).sum()
    )

    switched_harm = int(
        (
            harm
            & allow_switch
        ).sum()
    )

    switched_neutral = int(
        (
            neutral
            & allow_switch
        ).sum()
    )

    metrics = {
        "policy": "V3.17_original",
        "n_total": int(len(df)),
        "n_transition": int(
            allow_switch.sum()
        ),
        "n_switch": int(
            allow_switch.sum()
        ),
        "switched_rescue": switched_rescue,
        "switched_harm": switched_harm,
        "switched_neutral": switched_neutral,
        "net_gain": (
            switched_rescue
            - switched_harm
        ),
        "rescue_recall": (
            switched_rescue
            / int(rescue.sum())
            if rescue.sum() > 0
            else 0.0
        ),
        "harm_rate": (
            switched_harm
            / int(harm.sum())
            if harm.sum() > 0
            else 0.0
        ),
    }

    print()

    for key, value in metrics.items():

        print(
            f"{key:25s}: {value}"
        )

    return metrics


# =============================================================================
# DISCRIMINATOR VS V3.17
# =============================================================================

def compare_policy_to_v317(
    baseline: Dict,
    policy: Dict,
) -> Dict:

    section(
        "V3.24 POLICY VS V3.17"
    )

    comparison = {
        "v317_switches": baseline[
            "n_switch"
        ],
        "v324_switches": policy[
            "n_switch"
        ],
        "switch_reduction": (
            baseline["n_switch"]
            - policy["n_switch"]
        ),
        "v317_rescues": baseline[
            "switched_rescue"
        ],
        "v324_rescues": policy[
            "switched_rescue"
        ],
        "rescues_lost": (
            baseline["switched_rescue"]
            - policy["switched_rescue"]
        ),
        "v317_harms": baseline[
            "switched_harm"
        ],
        "v324_harms": policy[
            "switched_harm"
        ],
        "harms_removed": (
            baseline["switched_harm"]
            - policy["switched_harm"]
        ),
        "v317_net_gain": baseline[
            "net_gain"
        ],
        "v324_net_gain": policy[
            "net_gain"
        ],
        "net_gain_change": (
            policy["net_gain"]
            - baseline["net_gain"]
        ),
    }

    for key, value in comparison.items():

        print(
            f"{key:25s}: {value}"
        )

    return comparison


# =============================================================================
# TRAIN FINAL MODELS ON ALL 171 SAMPLES
# =============================================================================

def train_final_models(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> Dict:

    section(
        "TRAINING FINAL V3.24 MODELS"

    )

    X = df[
        FEATURES
    ].to_numpy(
        dtype=float
    )

    y = df[
        TARGET_COLUMN
    ].astype(int).to_numpy()

    models = build_models()

    fitted = {}

    for name, model in models.items():

        print(
            f"Training {name}..."
        )

        model.fit(
            X,
            y,
        )

        fitted[
            name
        ] = model

        path = (
            OUTPUT_DIR
            / "models"
        )

        path.mkdir(
            parents=True,
            exist_ok=True,
        )

        joblib.dump(
            model,
            path
            / f"v3_24_eval_{name}.joblib",
        )

    print(
        "✓ Final models trained."
    )

    return fitted


# =============================================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# =============================================================================

def feature_importance_report(
    fitted_models: Dict,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "V3.24 FEATURE IMPORTANCE"
    )

    rows = []

    for name, model in fitted_models.items():

        if name == "logistic_regression":

            classifier = (
                model.named_steps[
                    "classifier"
                ]
            )

            values = np.abs(
                classifier.coef_[0]
            )

        elif hasattr(
            model,
            "feature_importances_",
        ):

            values = (
                model.feature_importances_
            )

        else:

            continue

        for feature, value in zip(
            FEATURES,
            values,
        ):

            rows.append(
                {
                    "model": name,
                    "feature": feature,
                    "importance": float(value),
                }
            )

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        rows
    )

    if len(result) > 0:

        print(
            result.to_string(
                index=False
            )
        )

        result.to_csv(
            OUTPUT_DIR
            / "v3_24_feature_importance.csv",
            index=False,
        )

    return result


# =============================================================================
# SAVE POLICY PREDICTIONS
# =============================================================================

def save_policy_predictions(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    probability: np.ndarray,
    model_name: str,
    threshold: float,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    probability = np.asarray(
        probability,
        dtype=float,
    ).reshape(-1)

    allow_switch = (
        probability
        >= float(threshold)
    ).astype(int)

    out = df[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + [
            "outcome",
            "discriminator_target",
            "v317_rescue",
            "v317_harm",
            "v317_neutral",
            "v317_no_transition",
        ]
    ].copy()

    out[
        "discriminator_model"
    ] = model_name

    out[
        "nested_rescue_probability"
    ] = probability

    out[
        "policy_threshold"
    ] = float(threshold)

    out[
        "allow_switch"
    ] = allow_switch

    out[
        "actual_v317_outcome"
    ] = out[
        "outcome"
    ]

    out.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_policy_predictions.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return out


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.24 CLEAN HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR EVALUATION"
    )

    print(
        "Evaluation is based on authoritative V3.17 outcomes."
    )

    print(
        "No unavailable lesion true_label is assumed."
    )

    print(
        "OOF discriminator predictions are used for policy selection."
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Load
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    (
        v317,
        forensic,
        training,
        authoritative,
    ) = load_artifacts()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate identities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    validate_identities(
        v317,
        forensic,
        training,
        authoritative,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Authoritative outcomes
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    outcomes = build_authoritative_outcomes(
        authoritative
    )

    outcomes.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_evaluation_authoritative_outcomes.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Build evaluation table
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = build_evaluation_dataset(
        training,
        outcomes,
    )

    df.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_evaluation_dataset.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Generate OOF
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    oof = generate_oof_predictions(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compare models
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    comparison = compare_oof_models(
        df,
        oof,
    )

    best_model_name = select_best_model(
        comparison
    )

    best_probability = (
        oof[
            best_model_name
        ]
        .to_numpy(
            dtype=float
        )
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Threshold search
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    threshold_table, best_policy = (
        search_policy_threshold(
            df=df,
            probability=best_probability,
            model_name=best_model_name,
        )
    )

    best_threshold = float(
        best_policy[
            "threshold"
        ]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.17 baseline
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    baseline = calculate_v317_baseline(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Simulate best policy
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    policy = simulate_policy(
        df=df,
        probability=best_probability,
        model_name=best_model_name,
        threshold=best_threshold,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compare
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    comparison_policy = compare_policy_to_v317(
        baseline,
        policy,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save OOF predictions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    oof_output = df[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + [
            "outcome",
            TARGET_COLUMN,
        ]
    ].copy()

    for name, values in oof.items():

        oof_output[
            f"{name}_oof_probability"
        ] = values.to_numpy()

        oof_output[
            f"{name}_oof_prediction"
        ] = (
            values.to_numpy()
            >= 0.5
        ).astype(int)

    oof_output.to_csv(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_oof_predictions.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save best policy predictions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    save_policy_predictions(
        df=df,
        probability=best_probability,
        model_name=best_model_name,
        threshold=best_threshold,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Train final models
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    fitted_models = train_final_models(
        df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature importance
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    feature_importance_report(
        fitted_models
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summary
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.24 FINAL EVALUATION SUMMARY"
    )

    print(
        f"Best discriminator : {best_model_name}"
    )

    print(
        f"Best threshold     : {best_threshold:.6f}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.17 switches     : "
        f"{baseline['n_switch']}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 switches     : "
        f"{policy['n_switch']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Switch reduction   : "
        f"{comparison_policy['switch_reduction']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.17 rescues      : "
        f"{baseline['switched_rescue']}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 rescues      : "
        f"{policy['switched_rescue']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Rescues lost       : "
        f"{comparison_policy['rescues_lost']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.17 harms        : "
        f"{baseline['switched_harm']}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 harms        : "
        f"{policy['switched_harm']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Harms removed      : "
        f"{comparison_policy['harms_removed']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.17 net gain     : "
        f"{baseline['net_gain']}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 net gain     : "
        f"{policy['net_gain']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net gain change    : "
        f"{comparison_policy['net_gain_change']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.24 rescue recall: "
        f"{policy['rescue_recall']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 harm rate    : "
        f"{policy['harm_rate']:.6f}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.24 neutral rate  : "
        f"{policy['neutral_switch_rate']:.6f}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save JSON
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary = {
        "best_model": best_model_name,
        "best_threshold": best_threshold,
        "baseline_v317": baseline,
        "v324_policy": policy,
        "comparison": comparison_policy,
        "oof_model_comparison": comparison.to_dict(
            orient="records"
        ),
        "features": FEATURES,
        "n_samples": int(len(df)),
        "n_transition_samples": int(
            df["is_transition"].sum()
        ),
        "target_distribution": (
            df[TARGET_COLUMN]
            .value_counts()
            .to_dict()
        ),
    }

    with open(
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_24_evaluation_summary.json",
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            summary,
            f,
            indent=2,
            default=str,
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Human-readable summary
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary_txt = (
        "V3.24 CLEAN HARM-AWARE DISCRIMINATOR EVALUATION\n"
        "=" * 80
        + "\n\n"
        f"Best discriminator: {best_model_name}\n"
        f"Best threshold: {best_threshold:.6f}\n\n"
        f"V3.17 switches: {baseline['n_switch']}\n"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
V3.25 FULL TEST POLICY EVALUATION

Purpose
-------
Evaluate the V3.24 clean harm-aware discriminator as a policy on the
complete V3.17 test set.

Important:
    This script does NOT claim that the discriminator was trained on
    the full test set in a deployment-valid manner.

Instead it provides two clearly separated analyses:

1. OOF / development analysis
   - Uses V3.24 nested OOF predictions.
   - Used for selecting the discriminator and threshold.

2. Full-test policy accounting
   - Applies the selected policy to the V3.17 transition population.
   - Reports what the policy would have done on every V3.17 transition.
   - Uses authoritative V3.17 outcomes ONLY for retrospective evaluation.

The lesion true_label is intentionally NOT required.

Target:
    1 = V3.17 rescue
    0 = V3.17 harm OR neutral

Decision-time features:
    threshold
    score
    switch
    efficientnet_error_x
    resnet_rescue_x
    mobile_rescue_x
    resnet_harm_x
    mobile_harm_x

No outcome-derived feature is allowed as a model input.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import joblib
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.base import clone
from sklearn.ensemble import (
    ExtraTreesClassifier,
    HistGradientBoostingClassifier,
    RandomForestClassifier,
)
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score,

    confusion_matrix,

    precision_score,

)

# ============================================================================
# UTILITIES
# ============================================================================

def section(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("=" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 100)


def subsection(title: str) -> None:
    print()
    print("-" * 100)
    print(title)
    print("-" * 100)


def fail(message: str) -> None:
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def require_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: list[str],
    name: str,
) -> None:
    missing = [c for c in columns if c not in df.columns]

    if missing:
        fail(
            f"{name} is missing required columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(f"  - {c}" for c in missing)
        )


def identity_frame(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    require_columns(df, IDENTITY_COLUMNS, "Identity dataframe")

    result = df[IDENTITY_COLUMNS].copy()

    result["outer_fold"] = pd.to_numeric(
        result["outer_fold"],
        errors="raise",
    ).astype(int)

    result["row_index"] = pd.to_numeric(
        result["row_index"],
        errors="raise",
    ).astype(int)

    return result


def identity_set(df: pd.DataFrame) -> set[tuple[int, int]]:
    ids = identity_frame(df)

    return set(
        zip(
            ids["outer_fold"].astype(int),
            ids["row_index"].astype(int),
        )
    )


def assert_unique_identities(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    name: str,
) -> None:
    ids = identity_frame(df)

    duplicated = ids.duplicated(
        subset=IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
        keep=False,
    )

    if duplicated.any():
        examples = ids.loc[
            duplicated,
            IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
        ].head(10)

        fail(
            f"{name} contains duplicate identities.\n"
            f"Examples:\n{examples.to_string(index=False)}"
        )


def safe_auc(y_true, score) -> float:
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true)
    score = np.asarray(score)

    if len(np.unique(y_true)) < 2:
        return float("nan")

    return float(
        roc_auc_score(
            y_true,
            score,
        )
    )


def binary_metrics(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    score,
) -> dict:
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).astype(int)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred).astype(int)
    score = np.asarray(score).astype(float)

    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(
        y_true,
        y_pred,
        labels=[0, 1],
    ).ravel()

    return {
        "accuracy": float(
            accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
        ),
        "balanced_accuracy": float(
            balanced_accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)
        ),
        "macro_f1": float(
            f1_score(
                y_true,
                y_pred,
                average="macro",
                zero_division=0,
            )
        ),
        "precision": float(
            precision_score(
                y_true,
                y_pred,
                zero_division=0,
            )
        ),
        "recall": float(
            recall_score(
                y_true,
                y_pred,
                zero_division=0,
            )
        ),
        "roc_auc": safe_auc(
            y_true,
            score,
        ),
        "tn": int(tn),
        "fp": int(fp),
        "fn": int(fn),
        "tp": int(tp),
    }

def validate_identities(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    training: pd.DataFrame,
    outcomes: pd.DataFrame,
) -> None:

    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    for df, name in [
        (v317, "V3.17 predictions"),
        (forensic, "V3.17 forensic"),
        (training, "V3.24 training"),
        (outcomes, "V3.24 outcomes"),
    ]:
        require_columns(
            df,
            IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
            name,
        )

        assert_unique_identities(
            df,
            name,
        )

    ids_v317 = identity_set(v317)
    ids_forensic = identity_set(forensic)
    ids_training = identity_set(training)
    ids_outcomes = identity_set(outcomes)

    print(
        f"V3.17 identities      : {len(ids_v317)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Forensic identities   : {len(ids_forensic)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Training identities   : {len(ids_training)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Outcome identities    : {len(ids_outcomes)}"
    )

    if ids_v317 != ids_forensic:
        fail(
            "V3.17 and forensic identity sets do not match."
        )

    print(
        "✓ V3.17 / forensic identity sets match."
    )

    if not ids_training.issubset(ids_v317):
        fail(
            "V3.24 training identities contain "
            "identities outside V3.17."
        )

    print(
        "✓ V3.24 training identities belong to V3.17."
    )

    if not ids_outcomes.issubset(ids_v317):
        fail(
            "V3.24 outcome identities contain "
            "identities outside V3.17."
        )

    print(
        "✓ Authoritative outcome identities belong to V3.17."
    )


# ============================================================================
# AUTHORITATIVE OUTCOMES
# ============================================================================

def detect_outcome_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:

    candidates = {
        "rescue": [
            "v317_rescue",
            "authoritative_rescue",
        ],
        "harm": [
            "v317_harm",
            "authoritative_harm",
        ],
        "neutral": [
            "v317_neutral",
            "authoritative_neutral",
        ],
        "no_transition": [
            "v317_no_transition",
            "authoritative_no_transition",
        ],
    }

    found = {}

    for key, cols in candidates.items():
        for col in cols:
            if col in df.columns:
                found[key] = col
                break

    missing = [
        key
        for key in candidates
        if key not in found
    ]

    if missing:
        fail(
            "Could not detect authoritative outcome columns:\n"
            + "\n".join(
                f"  - {x}"
                for x in missing
            )
        )

    return (
        found["rescue"],
        found["harm"],
        found["neutral"],
        found["no_transition"],
    )


def build_authoritative_outcomes(
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "BUILDING AUTHORITATIVE V3.17 OUTCOME TABLE"
    )

    require_columns(
        forensic,
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
        "Forensic dataframe",
    )

    (
        rescue_col,
        harm_col,
        neutral_col,
        no_transition_col,
    ) = detect_outcome_columns(
        forensic
    )

    print(
        f"Detected authoritative columns:"
    )
    print(
        f"  rescue        : {rescue_col}"
    )
    print(
        f"  harm          : {harm_col}"
    )
    print(
        f"  neutral       : {neutral_col}"
    )
    print(
        f"  no_transition : {no_transition_col}"
    )

    df = forensic[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + [
            rescue_col,
            harm_col,
            neutral_col,
            no_transition_col,
        ]
    ].copy()

    for col in [
        rescue_col,
        harm_col,
        neutral_col,
        no_transition_col,
    ]:
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            df[col],
            errors="raise",
        ).astype(int)

        if not df[col].isin([0, 1]).all():
            fail(
                f"Outcome column {col} contains values "
                "other than 0/1."
            )

    print()
    print("Raw outcome combinations:")
    print(
        df[
            [
                rescue_col,
                harm_col,
                neutral_col,
                no_transition_col,
            ]
        ].value_counts().to_string()
    )

    outcome_sum = (
        df[rescue_col]
        + df[harm_col]
        + df[neutral_col]
        + df[no_transition_col]
    )

    if not (outcome_sum == 1).all():
        bad = df.loc[
            outcome_sum != 1,
            IDENTITY_COLUMNS
            + [
                rescue_col,
                harm_col,
                neutral_col,
                no_transition_col,
            ],
        ]

        fail(
            "Authoritative V3.17 outcomes are not mutually "
            "exclusive/exhaustive.\n"
            f"Bad rows:\n{bad.head(20).to_string(index=False)}"
        )

    result = df[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
    ].copy()

    result["v317_rescue"] = df[rescue_col]
    result["v317_harm"] = df[harm_col]
    result["v317_neutral"] = df[neutral_col]
    result["v317_no_transition"] = df[
        no_transition_col
    ]

    result["outcome"] = np.select(
        [
            result["v317_rescue"] == 1,
            result["v317_harm"] == 1,
            result["v317_neutral"] == 1,
            result["v317_no_transition"] == 1,
        ],
        [
            "rescue",
            "harm",
            "neutral",
            "no_transition",
        ],
        default="invalid",
    )

    if (result["outcome"] == "invalid").any():
        fail(
            "Invalid authoritative outcome encountered."
        )

    print()
    print("Outcome distribution:")
    print(
        result["outcome"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Transitions         : "
        f"{int((result['outcome'] != 'no_transition').sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Rescues             : "
        f"{int((result['outcome'] == 'rescue').sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harms               : "
        f"{int((result['outcome'] == 'harm').sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"Neutral transitions : "
        f"{int((result['outcome'] == 'neutral').sum())}"
    )
    print(
        f"No transition       : "
        f"{int((result['outcome'] == 'no_transition').sum())}"
    )

    return result


# ============================================================================
# BUILD EVALUATION DATASET
# ============================================================================

def build_evaluation_dataset(
    training: pd.DataFrame,
    outcomes: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section("BUILDING FULL TEST EVALUATION DATASET")

    require_columns(
        training,
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS + FEATURES,
        "V3.24 training",
    )

    require_columns(
        outcomes,
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + [
            "outcome",
            "v317_rescue",
            "v317_harm",
            "v317_neutral",
            "v317_no_transition",
        ],
        "V3.24 authoritative outcomes",
    )

    transition_outcomes = outcomes[
        outcomes["outcome"] != "no_transition"
    ].copy()

    print(
        f"Authoritative transition rows : "
        f"{len(transition_outcomes)}"
    )

    df = training[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + FEATURES
    ].merge(
        transition_outcomes[
            IDENTITY_COLUMNS
            + [
                "outcome",
                "v317_rescue",
                "v317_harm",
                "v317_neutral",
                "v317_no_transition",
            ]
        ],
        on=IDENTITY_COLUMNS,
        how="inner",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    if len(df) != len(training):
        fail(
            "Training/outcome merge lost rows.\n"
            f"Training rows : {len(training)}\n"
            f"Merged rows   : {len(df)}"
        )

    df["discriminator_target"] = (
        df["outcome"] == "rescue"
    ).astype(int)

    print(
        f"Evaluation dataset : {df.shape}"
    )

    print()
    print("Outcome distribution:")
    print(
        df["outcome"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    print()
    print("Discriminator target distribution:")
    print(
        df["discriminator_target"]
        .value_counts()
        .to_string()
    )

    return df


# ============================================================================
# MODEL FACTORIES
# ============================================================================

def make_model(name: str):

    if name == "logistic_regression":
        return Pipeline(
            [
                (
                    "scaler",
                    StandardScaler(),
                ),
                (
                    "model",
                    LogisticRegression(
                        max_iter=5000,
                        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
                    ),
                ),
            ]
        )

    if name == "random_forest":
        return RandomForestClassifier(
            n_estimators=500,
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
            class_weight="balanced",
            min_samples_leaf=2,
            n_jobs=-1,
        )

    if name == "extra_trees":
        return ExtraTreesClassifier(
            n_estimators=500,
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
            class_weight="balanced",
            min_samples_leaf=2,
            n_jobs=-1,
        )

    if name == "hist_gradient_boosting":
        return HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
            max_iter=300,
            learning_rate=0.05,
            max_leaf_nodes=15,
            l2_regularization=1.0,
            random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        )

    fail(
        f"Unknown model: {name}"
    )


# ============================================================================
# OOF PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================================

def generate_oof_predictions(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    model_name: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    X = df[FEATURES].astype(float)
    y = df["discriminator_target"].astype(int)

    model = make_model(model_name)

    folds = 5

    splitter = StratifiedKFold(
        n_splits=folds,
        shuffle=True,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
    )

    oof_probability = np.zeros(
        len(df),
        dtype=float,
    )

    oof_prediction = np.zeros(
        len(df),
        dtype=int,
    )

    for fold, (train_idx, valid_idx) in enumerate(
        splitter.split(X, y),
        start=1,
    ):
        fold_model = clone(model)

        fold_model.fit(
            X.iloc[train_idx],
            y.iloc[train_idx],
        )

        probability = fold_model.predict_proba(
            X.iloc[valid_idx]
        )[:, 1]

        prediction = (
            probability >= 0.5
        ).astype(int)

        oof_probability[
            valid_idx
        ] = probability

        oof_prediction[
            valid_idx
        ] = prediction

    metrics = binary_metrics(
        y,
        oof_prediction,
        oof_probability,
    )

    print()
    print(f"MODEL: {model_name}")
    print(
        f"OOF samples : {len(df)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Accuracy    : {metrics['accuracy']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Balanced acc: {metrics['balanced_accuracy']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Macro F1    : {metrics['macro_f1']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"ROC-AUC     : {metrics['roc_auc']:.6f}"
    )

    result = df[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + [
            "outcome",
            "discriminator_target",
        ]
    ].copy()

    result[
        "discriminator_probability"
    ] = oof_probability

    result[
        "discriminator_prediction"
    ] = oof_prediction

    result["model"] = model_name

    return result


# ============================================================================
# OOF MODEL COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

def evaluate_all_oof_models(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "GENERATING OUT-OF-FOLD DISCRIMINATOR PREDICTIONS"
    )

    all_predictions = {}
    rows = []

    for model_name in MODELS:

        pred = generate_oof_predictions(
            df,
            model_name,
        )

        all_predictions[
            model_name
        ] = pred

        metrics = binary_metrics(
            pred["discriminator_target"],
            pred["discriminator_prediction"],
            pred["discriminator_probability"],
        )

        rows.append(
            {
                "model": model_name,
                **metrics,
            }
        )

    comparison = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    comparison = comparison.sort_values(
        [
            "roc_auc",
            "balanced_accuracy",
        ],
        ascending=False,
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    print()
    print(
        "V3.25 OOF MODEL COMPARISON"
    )
    print(
        comparison.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    best_model = comparison.iloc[0][
        "model"
    ]

    print()
    print(
        f"Best OOF discriminator: {best_model}"
    )

    comparison.to_csv(
        V325_DIR
        / "v3_25_oof_model_comparison.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    for name, pred in all_predictions.items():
        pred.to_csv(
            V325_DIR
            / f"v3_25_{name}_oof_predictions.csv",
            index=False,
        )

    return (
        comparison,
        all_predictions,
        str(best_model),
    )


# ============================================================================
# POLICY ACCOUNTING
# ============================================================================

def calculate_policy_metrics(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
    allow_switch,
) -> dict:

    allow_switch = np.asarray(
        allow_switch,
        dtype=bool,
    )

    if len(allow_switch) != len(transition):
        fail(
            "Policy mask length does not match transition rows."
        )

    rescue_mask = (
        transition["outcome"].to_numpy()
        == "rescue"
    )

    harm_mask = (
        transition["outcome"].to_numpy()
        == "harm"
    )

    neutral_mask = (
        transition["outcome"].to_numpy()
        == "neutral"
    )

    n_switch = int(
        allow_switch.sum()
    )

    rescue = int(
        (rescue_mask & allow_switch).sum()
    )

    harm = int(
        (harm_mask & allow_switch).sum()
    )

    neutral = int(
        (neutral_mask & allow_switch).sum()
    )

    total_rescues = int(
        rescue_mask.sum()
    )

    total_harms = int(
        harm_mask.sum()
    )

    total_neutral = int(
        neutral_mask.sum()
    )

    rescue_recall = (
        rescue / total_rescues
        if total_rescues > 0
        else float("nan")
    )

    harm_rate = (
        harm / total_harms
        if total_harms > 0
        else float("nan")
    )

    neutral_rate = (
        neutral / total_neutral
        if total_neutral > 0
        else float("nan")
    )

    if harm == 0:
        rescue_harm_ratio = (
            float("inf")
            if rescue > 0
            else float("nan")
        )
    else:
        rescue_harm_ratio = (
            rescue / harm
        )

    net_gain = rescue - harm

    return {
        "n_total": int(len(transition)),
        "n_switch": n_switch,
        "blocked_switches": int(
            len(transition) - n_switch
        ),
        "switched_rescue": rescue,
        "switched_harm": harm,
        "switched_neutral": neutral,
        "total_rescues": total_rescues,
        "total_harms": total_harms,
        "total_neutral": total_neutral,
        "rescue_recall": rescue_recall,
        "harm_rate": harm_rate,
        "neutral_switch_rate": neutral_rate,
        "net_gain": net_gain,
        "rescue_harm_ratio": rescue_harm_ratio,
    }


# ============================================================================
# THRESHOLD SEARCH
# ============================================================================

def search_threshold(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
    probabilities: np.ndarray,
) -> tuple[float, pd.DataFrame]:

    section(
        "V3.25 POLICY THRESHOLD SEARCH"
    )

    probabilities = np.asarray(
        probabilities,
        dtype=float,
    )

    if len(probabilities) != len(transition):
        fail(
            "Probability length does not match transition dataset."
        )

    rows = []

    thresholds = np.round(
        np.arange(
            0.05,
            0.951,
            0.01,
        ),
        2,
    )

    for threshold in thresholds:

        allow_switch = (
            probabilities >= threshold
        )

        metrics = calculate_policy_metrics(
            transition,
            allow_switch,
        )

        metrics["threshold"] = float(
            threshold
        )

        rows.append(metrics)

    result = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    # Primary objective:
    #   maximize rescue retention
    #   then minimize harm
    #   then maximize net gain
    #   then minimize switches
    result = result.sort_values(
        [
            "rescue_recall",
            "switched_harm",
            "net_gain",
            "n_switch",
        ],
        ascending=[
            False,
            True,
            False,
            True,
        ],
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    best = result.iloc[0]

    threshold = float(
        best["threshold"]
    )

    print()
    print("BEST POLICY:")
    print(
        f"threshold            : {threshold:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"n_switch             : {int(best['n_switch'])}"
    )
    print(
        f"switched_rescue      : {int(best['switched_rescue'])}"
    )
    print(
        f"switched_harm        : {int(best['switched_harm'])}"
    )
    print(
        f"switched_neutral     : {int(best['switched_neutral'])}"
    )
    print(
        f"rescue_recall        : {best['rescue_recall']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"harm_rate            : {best['harm_rate']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"net_gain             : {best['net_gain']}"
    )

    result.to_csv(
        V325_DIR
        / "v3_25_threshold_search.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return threshold, result


# ============================================================================
# BASELINE
# ============================================================================

def evaluate_baseline(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict:

    section(
        "V3.17 BASELINE POLICY"
    )

    allow_switch = np.ones(
        len(transition),
        dtype=bool,
    )

    metrics = calculate_policy_metrics(
        transition,
        allow_switch,
    )

    print()
    print(
        "policy                   : V3.17_original"
    )

    for key in [
        "n_total",
        "n_switch",
        "switched_rescue",
        "switched_harm",
        "switched_neutral",
        "net_gain",
        "rescue_recall",
        "harm_rate",
    ]:
        print(
            f"{key:24s}: {metrics[key]}"
        )

    return metrics


# ============================================================================
# POLICY SIMULATION
# ============================================================================

def simulate_policy(
    transition: pd.DataFrame,
    probabilities: np.ndarray,
    threshold: float,
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict]:

    section(
        "V3.25 FULL TEST POLICY SIMULATION"
    )

    probabilities = np.asarray(
        probabilities,
        dtype=float,
    )

    allow_switch = (
        probabilities >= threshold
    )

    result = transition[
        IDENTITY_COLUMNS
        + FEATURES
        + [
            "outcome",
            "v317_rescue",
            "v317_harm",
            "v317_neutral",
            "v317_no_transition",
        ]
    ].copy()

    result[
        "discriminator_probability"
    ] = probabilities

    result["threshold"] = threshold

    result["allow_switch"] = (
        allow_switch.astype(int)
    )

    result["policy_action"] = np.where(
        allow_switch,
        "switch",
        "keep_efficientnet",
    )

    result["v317_policy_outcome"] = (
        result["outcome"]
    )

    metrics = calculate_policy_metrics(
        result,
        allow_switch,
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Model policy threshold:"
    )
    print(
        f"threshold              : {threshold:.6f}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Total transition rows  : {len(result)}"
    )
    print(
        f"Allowed switches       : {metrics['n_switch']}"
    )
    print(
        f"Blocked switches       : {metrics['blocked_switches']}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Rescues switched       : "
        f"{metrics['switched_rescue']}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harms switched         : "
        f"{metrics['switched_harm']}"
    )
    print(
        f"Neutral switched       : "
        f"{metrics['switched_neutral']}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        f"Rescue recall          : "
        f"{metrics['rescue_recall']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Harm rate              : "
        f"{metrics['harm_rate']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Neutral switch rate    : "
        f"{metrics['neutral_switch_rate']:.6f}"
    )
    print(
        f"Net gain               : "
        f"{metrics['net_gain']}"
    )

    result.to_csv(
        V325_DIR
        / "v3_25_full_test_policy_predictions.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result, metrics

# ============================================================================
# FINAL MODEL TRAINING
# ============================================================================

def train_final_models(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
) -> dict:

    section(
        "TRAINING FINAL V3.25 DISCRIMINATORS"
    )

    X = df[FEATURES].astype(float)
    y = df["discriminator_target"].astype(int)

    models = {}

    for model_name in MODELS:

        print(
            f"Training {model_name}..."
        )

        model = make_model(
            model_name
        )

        model.fit(
            X,
            y,
        )

        models[
            model_name
        ] = model

        output_path = (
            V325_DIR
            / f"v3_25_{model_name}.joblib"
        )

        joblib.dump(
            model,
            output_path,
        )

    print(
        "✓ Final models trained."
    )

    return models


# ============================================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE
# ============================================================================

def extract_feature_importance(
    model,
    model_name: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    if model_name == "logistic_regression":

        estimator = model.named_steps[
            "model"
        ]

        importance = np.abs(
            estimator.coef_[0]
        )

    elif hasattr(
        model,
        "feature_importances_",
    ):

        importance = (
            model.feature_importances_
        )

    else:
        return pd.DataFrame(
            columns=[
                "model",
                "feature",
                "importance",
            ]
        )

    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "model": model_name,
            "feature": FEATURES,
            "importance": importance,
        }
    )


def save_feature_importance(
    models: dict,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    section(
        "V3.25 FEATURE IMPORTANCE"
    )

    tables = []

    for model_name, model in models.items():

        table = extract_feature_importance(
            model,
            model_name,
        )

        tables.append(table)

    result = pd.concat(
        tables,
        ignore_index=True,
    )

    print(
        result.to_string(
            index=False
        )
    )

    result.to_csv(
        V325_DIR
        / "v3_25_feature_importance.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    return result

            "V3.25 FULL TEST POLICY SUMMARY\n"
        )
        f.write(
            "=" * 80
            + "\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            f"Best discriminator : {best_model}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"Threshold          : {threshold:.6f}\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            f"V3.17 switches     : {baseline['n_switch']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"V3.25 switches     : {policy['n_switch']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"Switch reduction   : {switch_reduction}\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            f"V3.17 rescues      : {baseline['switched_rescue']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"V3.25 rescues      : {policy['switched_rescue']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"Rescues lost       : {rescues_lost}\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            f"V3.17 harms        : {baseline['switched_harm']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"V3.25 harms        : {policy['switched_harm']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"Harms removed      : {harms_removed}\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            f"V3.17 net gain     : {baseline['net_gain']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"V3.25 net gain     : {policy['net_gain']}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"Net gain change    : {net_gain_change}\n\n"
        )

        f.write(
            f"Rescue recall      : "
            f"{policy['rescue_recall']:.6f}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"Harm rate          : "
            f"{policy['harm_rate']:.6f}\n"
        )
        f.write(
            f"Neutral rate       : "
            f"{policy['neutral_switch_rate']:.6f}\n"
        )

# ============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.25 FULL TEST POLICY EVALUATION"
    )

    print(
        "This script evaluates the V3.24 clean harm-aware "
        "discriminator on the complete V3.17 transition set."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "Important:"
    )
    print(
        "  • No lesion true_label is required."
    )
    print(
        "  • V3.17 authoritative outcomes are used retrospectively."
    )
    print(
        "  • OOF predictions determine model/threshold selection."
    )
    print(
        "  • Only decision-time features are model inputs."
    )

    v317, forensic, training, outcomes = (
        load_artifacts()
    )

    validate_identities(
        v317,
        forensic,
        training,
        outcomes,
    )

    authoritative = (
        build_authoritative_outcomes(
            forensic
        )
    )

    authoritative.to_csv(
        V325_DIR
        / "v3_25_authoritative_outcomes.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    df = build_evaluation_dataset(
        training,
        authoritative,
    )

    df.to_csv(
        V325_DIR
        / "v3_25_evaluation_dataset.csv",
        index=False,
    )

    (
        comparison,
        all_oof,
        best_model,
    ) = evaluate_all_oof_models(
        df
    )

    best_oof = all_oof[
        best_model
    ]

    probabilities = (
        best_oof[
            "discriminator_probability"
        ]
        .to_numpy()
    )

    transition = df.copy()

    threshold, threshold_table = (
        search_threshold(
            transition,
            probabilities,
        )
    )

    baseline = evaluate_baseline(
        transition
    )

    policy_table, policy_metrics = (
        simulate_policy(
            transition,
            probabilities,
            threshold,
        )
    )

    compare_policies(
        baseline,
        policy_metrics,
    )

    models = train_final_models(
        df
    )

    save_feature_importance(
        models
    )

    save_summary(
        best_model,
        threshold,
        baseline,
        policy_metrics,
    )

    metadata = {
        "script": "evaluate_v3_25_full_test_policy.py",
        "best_model": best_model,
        "threshold": threshold,
        "features": FEATURES,
        "n_transition_rows": int(
            len(transition)
        ),
        "n_full_v317_rows": int(
            len(authoritative)
        ),
        "v317_total_rescues": int(
            (authoritative["outcome"] == "rescue").sum()
        ),
        "v317_total_harms": int(
            (authoritative["outcome"] == "harm").sum()
        ),
        "v317_total_neutral": int(
            (authoritative["outcome"] == "neutral").sum()
        ),
        "v317_total_no_transition": int(
            (authoritative["outcome"] == "no_transition").sum()
        ),
    }

    with open(
        V325_DIR
        / "v3_25_metadata.json",
        "w",
    ) as f:
        json.dump(
            metadata,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    section(
        "V3.25 EVALUATION COMPLETED"
    )

    print(
        f"Output directory:\n{V325_DIR}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "✓ OOF discriminator comparison completed."
    )
    print(
        "✓ Threshold search completed."
    )
    print(
        "✓ Full V3.17 transition policy simulated."
    )
    print(
        "✓ V3.17 baseline comparison completed."
    )
    print(
        "✓ Final discriminator models trained."
    )
    print(
        "✓ Feature importance saved."
    )
    print(
        "✓ Final summary saved."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
