ID_COLUMNS = [
    "outer_fold",
    "row_index",
]

SPECIALIST_MODELS = [
    "resnet50",
    "mobilenet_v3_large",
]

BASELINE_MODEL = "efficientnet_v2_s"


# =============================================================================
# UTILITIES
# =============================================================================

def section(title: str):
    print()
    print("=" * 80)
    print(title)
    print("=" * 80)


def fail(message: str):
    raise RuntimeError(message)


def require_columns(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    columns: list[str],
    name: str,
):
    missing = [
        c for c in columns
        if c not in df.columns
    ]

    if missing:
        fail(
            f"{name} is missing required columns:\n"
            f"{missing}\n\n"
            f"Available columns:\n"
            f"{list(df.columns)}"
        )


def normalize_binary(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    return (
        pd.to_numeric(
            series,
            errors="coerce",
        )
        .fillna(0)
        .astype(int)
    )


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

def normalize_identity(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    name: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:

    df = df.copy()

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # row_index
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "row_index" not in df.columns:

        alternatives = [
            "index",
            "sample_index",
            "original_row_index",
        ]

        found = next(
            (
                c
                for c in alternatives
                if c in df.columns
            ),
            None,
        )

        if found is None:
            fail(
                f"{name} is missing identity column "
                f"'row_index'.\n"
                f"Available columns:\n"
                f"{list(df.columns)}"
            )

        df["row_index"] = df[found]

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # outer_fold
    #
    # V3.26 uses:
    #
    #   outer_fold_evaluation
    #   outer_fold_identity
    #
    # The latter is the fold belonging to the original V3.17 sample.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if "outer_fold" not in df.columns:

        if "outer_fold_identity" in df.columns:

            df["outer_fold"] = df[
                "outer_fold_identity"
            ]

        elif "outer_fold_evaluation" in df.columns:

            # This fallback is ONLY for artifacts that do not contain
            # the original identity fold.
            df["outer_fold"] = df[
                "outer_fold_evaluation"
            ]

        else:

            alternatives = [
                "fold",
                "outer_fold_id",
            ]

            found = next(
                (
                    c
                    for c in alternatives
                    if c in df.columns
                ),
                None,
            )

            if found is None:
                fail(
                    f"{name} is missing identity column "
                    f"'outer_fold'.\n"
                    f"Expected one of:\n"
                    f"  outer_fold\n"
                    f"  outer_fold_identity\n"
                    f"  outer_fold_evaluation\n"
                    f"  fold\n"
                    f"  outer_fold_id\n\n"
                    f"Available columns:\n"
                    f"{list(df.columns)}"
                )

            df["outer_fold"] = df[found]

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize types
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["outer_fold"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df["outer_fold"],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    df["row_index"] = pd.to_numeric(
        df["row_index"],
        errors="coerce",
    )

    if df[
        ["outer_fold", "row_index"]
    ].isna().any().any():

        fail(
            f"{name} contains missing identity values."
        )

    df["outer_fold"] = (
        df["outer_fold"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    df["row_index"] = (
        df["row_index"]
        .astype(int)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Duplicate identity protection
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    duplicated = df.duplicated(
        subset=ID_COLUMNS,
        keep=False,
    )

    if duplicated.any():

        dup = (
            df.loc[
                duplicated,
                ID_COLUMNS,
            ]
            .sort_values(ID_COLUMNS)
        )

        fail(
            f"{name} contains duplicate identities.\n\n"
            f"{dup.head(20).to_string(index=False)}"
        )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# LOAD ARTIFACTS
# =============================================================================

def load_core_artifacts():

    section("LOADING V3.27 ARTIFACTS")

    for path in [
        V317_PREDICTIONS,
        V317_FORENSIC,
        V326_NESTED,
        V326_FOLDS,
    ]:

        if not path.exists():
            fail(
                f"Required artifact does not exist:\n{path}"
            )

    v317 = pd.read_csv(
        V317_PREDICTIONS
    )

    forensic = pd.read_csv(
        V317_FORENSIC
    )

    nested = pd.read_csv(
        V326_NESTED
    )

    fold_results = pd.read_csv(
        V326_FOLDS
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 predictions: {v317.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 forensic: {forensic.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 nested: {nested.shape}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 fold results: {fold_results.shape}"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize identities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    v317 = normalize_identity(
        v317,
        "V3.17 predictions",
    )

    forensic = normalize_identity(
        forensic,
        "V3.17 forensic",
    )

    nested = normalize_identity(
        nested,
        "V3.26 nested predictions",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    require_columns(
        nested,
        [
            "selected_model",
            "selected_threshold",
            "discriminator_probability",
            "policy_switch",
        ],
        "V3.26 nested predictions",
    )

    require_columns(
        v317,
        [
            "selected_model",
        ],
        "V3.17 predictions",
    )

    return (
        v317,
        forensic,
        nested,
        fold_results,
    )


# =============================================================================
# IDENTITY AUDIT
# =============================================================================

def validate_identities(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    nested: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section("IDENTITY VALIDATION")

    ids_v317 = set(
        zip(
            v317["outer_fold"],
            v317["row_index"],
        )
    )

    ids_forensic = set(
        zip(
            forensic["outer_fold"],
            forensic["row_index"],
        )
    )

    ids_nested = set(
        zip(
            nested["outer_fold"],
            nested["row_index"],
        )
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 identities      : {len(ids_v317)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Forensic identities   : {len(ids_forensic)}"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 nested identities: {len(ids_nested)}"
    )

    if ids_v317 != ids_forensic:

        missing = ids_v317 - ids_forensic
        extra = ids_forensic - ids_v317

        fail(
            "V3.17 / forensic identity mismatch.\n"
            f"Missing: {list(missing)[:20]}\n"
            f"Extra: {list(extra)[:20]}"
        )

    print(
        "✓ V3.17 / forensic identity sets match."
    )

    if not ids_nested.issubset(ids_v317):

        bad = ids_nested - ids_v317

        fail(
            "V3.26 nested predictions contain "
            "identities not present in V3.17.\n"
            f"Examples: {list(bad)[:20]}"
        )

    print(
        "✓ V3.26 nested identities belong to V3.17."
    )


# =============================================================================
# FIND CORRECTNESS COLUMNS
# =============================================================================

def find_column(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: list[str],
    description: str,
):

    for c in candidates:

        if c in df.columns:
            return c

    fail(
        f"Could not find {description}.\n"
        f"Tried:\n{candidates}\n\n"
        f"Available columns:\n{list(df.columns)}"
    )


def prepare_correctness_table(
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "BUILDING AUTHORITATIVE CORRECTNESS TABLE"
    )

    efficientnet_correct = find_column(
        forensic,
        [
            "efficientnet_correct",
            "efficientnet_v2_s_correct",
            "efficientnet_correct_actual",
        ],
        "EfficientNet-v2-S correctness column",
    )

    resnet_correct = find_column(
        forensic,
        [
            "resnet_correct",
            "resnet50_correct",
        ],
        "ResNet50 correctness column",
    )

    mobile_correct = find_column(
        forensic,
        [
            "mobile_correct",
            "mobilenet_correct",
            "mobilenet_v3_large_correct",
        ],
        "MobileNetV3-Large correctness column",
    )

    print(
        f"EfficientNet correctness : {efficientnet_correct}"
    )

    print(
        f"ResNet correctness       : {resnet_correct}"
    )

    print(
        f"MobileNet correctness    : {mobile_correct}"
    )

    out = forensic[
        ID_COLUMNS
    ].copy()

    out[
        "efficientnet_correct"
    ] = normalize_binary(
        forensic[efficientnet_correct]
    )

    out[
        "resnet_correct"
    ] = normalize_binary(
        forensic[resnet_correct]
    )

    out[
        "mobile_correct"
    ] = normalize_binary(
        forensic[mobile_correct]
    )

    return out


# =============================================================================
# BUILD END-TO-END DATASET
# =============================================================================

def build_end_to_end_dataset(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    nested: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "BUILDING END-TO-END EVALUATION DATASET"
    )

    correctness = prepare_correctness_table(
        forensic
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge V3.17 predictions with correctness
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    base = v317.merge(
        correctness,
        on=ID_COLUMNS,
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    if base[
        [
            "efficientnet_correct",
            "resnet_correct",
            "mobile_correct",
        ]
    ].isna().any().any():

        fail(
            "Missing correctness values after V3.17 "
            "identity merge."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Merge nested policy decisions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df = base.merge(
        nested[
            ID_COLUMNS
            + [
                "selected_model",
                "selected_threshold",
                "discriminator_probability",
                "discriminator_prediction",
                "policy_switch",
            ]
        ],
        on=ID_COLUMNS,
        how="inner",
        validate="one_to_one",
        suffixes=(
            "_v317",
            "_v326",
        ),
    )

    print(
        f"End-to-end evaluation rows : {len(df)}"
    )

    if len(df) != len(nested):

        fail(
            "Unexpected row count after merging "
            "nested policy predictions."
        )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Normalize switch
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["policy_switch"] = normalize_binary(
        df["policy_switch"]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine final selected model
    #
    # If V3.26 blocks the switch:
    #     use EfficientNet-v2-S
    #
    # If V3.26 allows the switch:
    #     use the V3.17 specialist model.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    selected_v317 = (
        df["selected_model_v317"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.lower()
        .str.strip()
    )

    final_model = np.where(
        df["policy_switch"] == 1,
        selected_v317,
        BASELINE_MODEL,
    )

    df["v326_final_model"] = final_model

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.17 final model
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["v317_final_model"] = selected_v317

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Compute V3.17 correctness
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def model_correct(row, model):

        if model == "efficientnet_v2_s":
            return int(
                row["efficientnet_correct"]
            )

        if model == "resnet50":
            return int(
                row["resnet_correct"]
            )

        if model == "mobilenet_v3_large":
            return int(
                row["mobile_correct"]
            )

        # Handle common naming variants
        if "resnet" in model:
            return int(
                row["resnet_correct"]
            )

        if (
            "mobile" in model
            or "mobilenet" in model
        ):
            return int(
                row["mobile_correct"]
            )

        if (
            "efficientnet" in model
            or model == "efficientnet"
        ):
            return int(
                row["efficientnet_correct"]
            )

        fail(
            f"Unknown selected model: {model}"
        )

    df["v317_correct"] = [
        model_correct(
            row,
            model,
        )
        for (_, row), model
        in zip(
            df.iterrows(),
            df["v317_final_model"],
        )
    ]

    df["v326_correct"] = [
        model_correct(
            row,
            model,
        )
        for (_, row), model
        in zip(
            df.iterrows(),
            df["v326_final_model"],
        )
    ]

    return df


# =============================================================================
# POLICY METRICS
# =============================================================================

def compute_metrics(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    correctness_column: str,
):

    n = len(df)

    correct = int(
        df[correctness_column].sum()
    )

    accuracy = (
        correct / n
        if n > 0
        else float("nan")
    )

    return {
        "n": n,
        "correct": correct,
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "accuracy_percent": accuracy * 100,
    }


# =============================================================================
# TRANSITION-ONLY POLICY METRICS
# =============================================================================

def print_policy_metrics(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "END-TO-END CLASSIFICATION PERFORMANCE"
    )

    v317 = compute_metrics(
        df,
        "v317_correct",
    )

    v326 = compute_metrics(
        df,
        "v326_correct",
    )

    print(
        f"Total transition samples : {v317['n']}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "V3.17 ORIGINAL POLICY"
    )

    print(
        f"Correct : {v317['correct']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy: {v317['accuracy']:.6f} "
        f"({v317['accuracy_percent']:.2f}%)"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "V3.26 NESTED POLICY"
    )

    print(
        f"Correct : {v326['correct']}"
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy: {v326['accuracy']:.6f} "
        f"({v326['accuracy_percent']:.2f}%)"
    )

    print()

    change = (
        v326["accuracy"]
        - v317["accuracy"]
    )

    print(
        f"Accuracy change: {change:+.6f} "
        f"({change * 100:+.2f} percentage points)"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Correct / incorrect transitions
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    rescued = int(
        (
            (df["v317_correct"] == 0)
            & (df["v326_correct"] == 1)
            & (df["policy_switch"] == 1)
        ).sum()
    )

    harmed = int(
        (
            (df["v317_correct"] == 1)
            & (df["v326_correct"] == 0)
            & (df["policy_switch"] == 1)
        ).sum()
    )

    unchanged = int(
        (
            df["v317_correct"]
            == df["v326_correct"]
        ).sum()
    )

    print()

    print(
        "POLICY EFFECT"
    )

    print(
        f"Newly rescued samples : {rescued}"
    )

    print(
        f"Newly harmed samples  : {harmed}"
    )

    print(
        f"Unchanged samples     : {unchanged}"
    )

    print(
        f"Net correctness gain  : {rescued - harmed}"
    )

    return {
        "v317_accuracy": v317["accuracy"],
        "v326_accuracy": v326["accuracy"],
        "accuracy_change": change,
        "rescued": rescued,
        "harmed": harmed,
        "unchanged": unchanged,
    }


# =============================================================================
# FULL 1267-SAMPLE COMPARISON
# =============================================================================

def evaluate_full_test(
    v317: pd.DataFrame,
    forensic: pd.DataFrame,
    nested: pd.DataFrame,
):

    section(
        "FULL 1267-SAMPLE END-TO-END EVALUATION"
    )

    correctness = prepare_correctness_table(
        forensic
    )

    df = v317.merge(
        correctness,
        on=ID_COLUMNS,
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Identify which samples received a nested V3.26 decision.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    nested_small = nested[
        ID_COLUMNS
        + [
            "policy_switch",
            "selected_model",
        ]
    ].copy()

    nested_small = nested_small.rename(
        columns={
            "policy_switch":
                "v326_policy_switch",
            "selected_model":
                "v326_specialist_model",
        }
    )

    df = df.merge(
        nested_small,
        on=ID_COLUMNS,
        how="left",
        validate="one_to_one",
    )

    df["v326_policy_switch"] = (
        df["v326_policy_switch"]
        .fillna(0)
        .astype(int)
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.17 final model
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["v317_final_model"] = (
        df["selected_model"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.lower()
        .str.strip()
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # V3.26 final model
    #
    # Samples outside the 171 V3.17 transition set remain EfficientNet.
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df["v326_final_model"] = np.where(
        df["v326_policy_switch"] == 1,
        df["v326_specialist_model"],
        BASELINE_MODEL,
    )

    def get_correct(
        row,
        model_column,
    ):

        model = str(
            row[model_column]
        ).lower()

        if (
            "resnet" in model
        ):
            return int(
                row["resnet_correct"]
            )

        if (
            "mobile" in model
            or "mobilenet" in model
        ):
            return int(
                row["mobile_correct"]
            )

        return int(
            row["efficientnet_correct"]
        )

    df["v317_correct"] = [
        get_correct(
            row,
            "v317_final_model",
        )
        for _, row in df.iterrows()
    ]

    df["v326_correct"] = [
        get_correct(
            row,
            "v326_final_model",
        )
        for _, row in df.iterrows()
    ]

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Baseline
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    baseline_accuracy = (
        df["efficientnet_correct"]
        .mean()
    )

    v317_accuracy = (
        df["v317_correct"]
        .mean()
    )

    v326_accuracy = (
        df["v326_correct"]
        .mean()
    )

    print(
        f"Total test samples : {len(df)}"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"EfficientNet-v2-S baseline : "
        f"{baseline_accuracy:.6f} "
        f"({baseline_accuracy * 100:.2f}%)"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 original hybrid      : "
        f"{v317_accuracy:.6f} "
        f"({v317_accuracy * 100:.2f}%)"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 nested hybrid        : "
        f"{v326_accuracy:.6f} "
        f"({v326_accuracy * 100:.2f}%)"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.17 vs baseline : "
        f"{(v317_accuracy - baseline_accuracy) * 100:+.2f} pp"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 vs baseline : "
        f"{(v326_accuracy - baseline_accuracy) * 100:+.2f} pp"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 vs V3.17    : "
        f"{(v326_accuracy - v317_accuracy) * 100:+.2f} pp"
    )

    return df


# =============================================================================
# SAVE RESULTS
# =============================================================================

def save_results(
    transition_df: pd.DataFrame,
    full_df: pd.DataFrame,
    metrics: dict,
):

    transition_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_27_transition_end_to_end_predictions.csv"
    )

    full_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_27_full_test_predictions.csv"
    )

    metrics_path = (
        OUTPUT_DIR
        / "v3_27_end_to_end_metrics.json"
    )

    transition_df.to_csv(
        transition_path,
        index=False,
    )

    full_df.to_csv(
        full_path,
        index=False,
    )

    with open(
        metrics_path,
        "w",
        encoding="utf-8",
    ) as f:

        json.dump(
            metrics,
            f,
            indent=2,
        )

    print()
    print(
        f"Saved transition predictions:\n"
        f"{transition_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved full-test predictions:\n"
        f"{full_path}"
    )

    print(
        f"Saved metrics:\n"
        f"{metrics_path}"
    )


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

def main():

    section(
        "V3.27 END-TO-END NESTED HYBRID EVALUATION"
    )

    print(
        "This evaluates actual classification performance."
    )

    print()
    print(
        "V3.26 nested switching decisions are treated as fixed."
    )

    print(
        "No model or threshold is re-selected here."
    )

    print(
        "No lesion true label is fabricated."
    )

    (
        v317,
        forensic,
        nested,
        fold_results,
    ) = load_core_artifacts()

    validate_identities(
        v317,
        forensic,
        nested,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Transition-only evaluation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    transition_df = build_end_to_end_dataset(
        v317,
        forensic,
        nested,
    )

    transition_metrics = print_policy_metrics(
        transition_df
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Full 1267-sample evaluation
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    full_df = evaluate_full_test(
        v317,
        forensic,
        nested,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    full_metrics = {
        "transition_metrics":
            transition_metrics,

        "full_test_baseline_accuracy":
            float(
                full_df[
                    "efficientnet_correct"
                ].mean()
            ),

        "full_test_v317_accuracy":
            float(
                full_df[
                    "v317_correct"
                ].mean()
            ),

        "full_test_v326_accuracy":
            float(
                full_df[
                    "v326_correct"
                ].mean()
            ),
    }

    save_results(
        transition_df,
        full_df,
        full_metrics,
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final summary
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    section(
        "V3.27 FINAL END-TO-END SUMMARY"
    )

    baseline = (
        full_metrics[
            "full_test_baseline_accuracy"
        ]
    )

    v317_acc = (
        full_metrics[
            "full_test_v317_accuracy"
        ]
    )

    v326_acc = (
        full_metrics[
            "full_test_v326_accuracy"
        ]
    )

    print(
        f"EfficientNet-v2-S baseline : "
        f"{baseline * 100:.2f}%"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.17 original hybrid      : "
        f"{v317_acc * 100:.2f}%"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 nested hybrid        : "
        f"{v326_acc * 100:.2f}%"
    )

    print()

    print(
        f"V3.17 improvement over baseline : "
        f"{(v317_acc - baseline) * 100:+.2f} pp"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 improvement over baseline : "
        f"{(v326_acc - baseline) * 100:+.2f} pp"
    )

    print(
        f"V3.26 change vs V3.17 : "
        f"{(v326_acc - v317_acc) * 100:+.2f} pp"
    )

    print()

    print(
        "IMPORTANT:"
    )

    print(
        "The 171-sample transition evaluation measures "
        "the policy's ability to improve specialist switching."
    )

    print(
        "The 1267-sample result is the actual end-to-end "
        "classification accuracy comparison."
    )

    section(
        "V3.27 EVALUATION COMPLETED"
    )

    print(
        f"Output directory:\n{OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    print()
    print(
        "✓ V3.26 identity folds handled correctly."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Nested policy decisions kept fixed."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Transition-level classification evaluated."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Full 1267-sample classification evaluated."
    )

    print(
        "✓ Baseline / V3.17 / V3.26 comparison saved."
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
